    <summary>How sheets calc into other sheets</summary>
    <ol>
     <li><b>INCOME</b> sums entitlements & deductions → gross, net, annual (×12)</li>
     <li><b>EXPENSES</b> line items → section totals → grand living</li>
     <li><b>DEBT</b> balance + APR% + terms left → amount due = principal/terms + full-month daily interest</li>
     <li>Cash pay can be EXPENSES <b>Pay to debt</b>; DTI uses amount due; surplus uses cash pay</li>
     <li><b>ASSETS</b> sums holdings; liabilities ← <span class="c">DEBT.totalBalance</span>; net worth = assets − debt</li>
     <li><b>SUMMARY</b> pulls gross/net from INCOME, living from EXPENSES, debt pays from DEBT; <span class="c">surplus = net − living − debt</span></li>
     <li><b>RANKS</b> drag-order expense items (H/D/A/M/E) · pools from REVIEW money</li>
     <li>Score = realistic joy_factors · Exp6 <b>run()</b> live</li>
     <li>Money depreciates · age reshapes happiness · external stays random</li>
     <li><b>CALENDAR</b>: Year→Month→Week→Day→Hour→Action→Item · living-core authored</li>
     <li><b>PREVIEW</b>: Board-selected score breakdown · portions · jmethod viz (prototype)</li>
     <li><b>MODEL TOOLS</b>: score factors · attach/author jmethods · math play-out · 3D entities · place/navigate · run() meetup sims</li>
     <li>living-core discovers/inserts joys/views into this project (bridge); ranking_ui owns SoT</li>

  /** Absolute amount (no $). */
  function moneyAbs(n){n=Number(n)||0;return Math.abs(n).toLocaleString(undefined,{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});}

  function moneyText(n, pol){

   var v=Number(n)||0;
   if(pol==='gain'||pol==='+') return '+$'+core;
   if(pol==='spend'||pol==='-') return '−$'+core;
   if(pol==='auto'){
    if(v>0) return '+$'+core;
    if(v<0) return '−$'+core;
    return '$'+core;
   }
   return core;
  }

    var v=Number(n)||0;
    if(v>0) return '<span class="m-gain">+$'+core+'</span>';
    if(v<0) return '<span class="m-spend">−$'+core+'</span>';
    return '<span class="m-zero">$'+core+'</span>';
   }
   return core;
  }

  function formatStatusTime(iso){

  }
  function showStatus(msg,kind){

  function log(lines){
   if(typeof lines==='string') lines=[lines];
   $('log').innerHTML=lines.map(function(l){
    if(l.indexOf('✅')===0) return '<span class="ok">'+esc(l)+'</span>';
    if(l.indexOf('❌')===0) return '<span class="bad">'+esc(l)+'</span>';
    if(l.indexOf('→')>=0) return '<span class="calc">'+esc(l)+'</span>';
    return esc(l);
   }).join('\n');
  }
  function esc(s){
   return String(s==null?'':s)
    .replace(/&/g,'&amp;')
    .replace(/</g,'&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g,'&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g,'&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g,'&#39;');
  }

  function normalizeSc(sc){
   sc = String(sc || 'current').toLowerCase();
   if(sc === 'projected_review' || sc === 'proj+review' || sc === 'proj_review') return 'review';
   if(sc === 'projected' || sc === 'review') return sc;

  }

  function lineField(sc){

  function debtPayField(sc){

  /** Prefer scenario field; fall back projected → current. */
  function amt(obj, keyCur, keyProj){
   if(obj == null) return 0;
   if(typeof obj === 'number') return obj;
   return lineAmt(obj);
  }
  function lineAmt(it, sc){
   if(!it) return 0;
   sc = normalizeSc(sc || activeSc());
   if(it.uid && sc !== 'current' && WB && WB.redundancy){ var _rw = rdWinner(it, sc); if(_rw) return _rw.amount; }
   var order =
    sc === 'review'
      ? ['review', 'projected', 'current']
      : sc === 'projected'
        ? ['projected', 'current', 'review']
        : ['current', 'projected', 'review'];
   for(var i = 0; i < order.length; i++){
    var k = order[i];
    var v = it[k];
    if(v !== '' && v != null && isFinite(Number(v))) return Number(v);
   }
   return 0;
  }

  function calcIncome(){
   var e=WB.income.entitlements||[], d=WB.income.deductions||[];
   var g=0, ded=0;
   e.forEach(function(i){ g += lineAmt(i); });
   d.forEach(function(i){ ded += lineAmt(i); });
   return {
    gross: g,
    deductions: ded,
    net: g - ded,
    annualGross: g * 12,
    annualNet: (g - ded) * 12
   };
  }

  /** Expense row is a monthly payment toward a DEBT line (not living). */
  function isDebtPay(it){
   return it && it.payDebt != null && it.payDebt !== '' && !isNaN(Number(it.payDebt));
  }
  function debtPayIndex(it){
   return isDebtPay(it) ? Number(it.payDebt) : -1;
  }

  /**
   * Living = expense items NOT linked to a debt.
   * Debt-pay rows still listed in sections but excluded from living grand.
   */
  function calcExpenses(){
   var debtPay=0;
   var sections=(WB.expenses.sections||[]).map(function(sec){
    var all=0, living=0;
    (sec.items||[]).forEach(function(it){
     var a=lineAmt(it);
     all+=a;
     if(isDebtPay(it)) debtPay+=a;
     else living+=a;
    });
    return { name:sec.name, all:all, living:living, items:sec.items||[] };
   });
   var all=0, living=0;
   sections.forEach(function(s){ all+=s.all; living+=s.living; });
   return {
    sections: sections,
    all: all,
    grand: living,    // living only
    debtPays: debtPay
   };
  }

  /**
   * Exact port of legacy/test_calc_debt.js (lender amount due):
   *
   *  apr = aprPct * 0.01          // 5.750 → 0.0575
   *  dailyRate = apr / 365
   *  durationApr = dailyRate * balance * days
   *  actualPayment = balance / remainingTerms
   *  totalDurationPayment = actualPayment + durationApr
   *
   * `days` = billing days in the period (test used 29; average month ≈ 365/12).
   * Amount due ≡ totalDurationPayment (min cash to stay on schedule that month).
   */
  function debtMonthMath(d){
   var balance = Number(d.balance);
   if(!isFinite(balance) || balance < 0) balance = null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */;

   // Always treat UI field as percent points (5.750), same as test: 5.750 * 0.01
   var aprPct = Number(d.aprPct);
   if(!isFinite(aprPct) || aprPct < 0) aprPct = 0;
   var apr = aprPct * 0.01;

   var daysPerMonth = 365 / 12; // reference only (named in test file)
   var days = Number(d.days);
   if(!isFinite(days) || days <= 0) {
    // default full average month; set days=29 to reproduce test_calc_debt.js numbers
    days = daysPerMonth;
   }

   var terms = Number(d.remainingTerms);
   if(!isFinite(terms) || terms <= 0) terms = 1;

   var dailyRate = apr / 365;
   var durationApr = dailyRate * balance * days;
   var actualPayment = balance / terms;
   var totalDurationPayment = actualPayment + durationApr;

   function cents(x){ return Math.round(x * 100) / 100; }
   return {
    balance: balance,
    apr: apr,
    aprPct: aprPct,
    days: days,
    daysPerMonth: daysPerMonth,
    remainingTerms: terms,
    dailyRate: dailyRate,
    // raw (for equality checks) + cents for money display
    durationApr: durationApr,
    durationAprCents: cents(durationApr),
    actualPayment: actualPayment,
    principalSlice: cents(actualPayment),
    totalDurationPayment: totalDurationPayment,
    totalDurationPaymentCents: cents(totalDurationPayment),
    interestMonth: cents(durationApr),
    amountDue: cents(totalDurationPayment) // displayed = rounded totalDurationPayment
   };
  }


  /**
   * Months to [REDACTED-AMOUNT] if you keep paying `payment` every term.
   * Same interest as amount due: durationApr = (apr/365)×balance×days, then
   * balance += interest − payment. ∞ when cash never beats interest.
   */
  function debtPayoffTerms(balance, apr, days, payment){
   if(!isFinite(balance) || balance <= 0.005) return {terms:0, never:false};
   if(!isFinite(payment) || payment <= 0) return {terms:null, never:true};
   if(!isFinite(apr) || apr < 0) apr = null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */;
   if(!isFinite(days) || days <= 0) days = 365/12;
   var dailyRate = apr / 365;
   var bal = balance;
   var n = 0;
   var cap = 600;
   while(bal > 0.005 && n < cap){
    var interest = dailyRate * bal * days;
    if(payment + 1e-9 <= interest) return {terms:null, never:true};
    bal = bal + interest - payment;
    n++;
   }
   if(bal > 0.005) return {terms:cap, never:false, over:true};
   return {terms:n, never:false};
  }

  /** easy211: one month of lender math — interest then payment; balance floored at 0. */
  function debtStepBalance(balance, apr, days, payment){
    if(!isFinite(balance) || balance <= 0.005) return 0;
    if(!isFinite(apr) || apr < 0) apr = null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */;
    if(!isFinite(days) || days <= 0) days = 365/12;
    if(!isFinite(payment) || payment < 0) payment = null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */;
    var interest = (apr / 365) * balance * days;
    var next = balance + interest - payment;
    if(next < 0.005) return 0;
    return next;
  }

  /**
   * easy211: debt cash by month over the horizon.
   * Fixed payment while balance > 0; [REDACTED-AMOUNT] after payoff. Balances amortize (interest + pay).
   * Cached per debts snapshot — Jump/Suggest stock must not freeze payments forever.
   */
  var __debtPaySchedCache = null;
  var __debtPaySchedKey = '';
  
  /** easy211: YYYY-MM-DD → {y,m,d} (local civil). */
  function debtParseYMD(s){
    if(!s) return null;
    var m = String(s).trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
    if(!m) return null;
    return { y: +m[1], m: (+m[2]) - 1, d: +m[3] };
  }
  function debtYmdFromParts(y, m, d){
    function z(n){ n=n|0; return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }
    return (y|0) + '-' + z((m|0)+1) + '-' + z(d|0);
  }
  function debtCivilToday(){
    try {
      if(typeof easyNowCST === 'function'){
        var n = easyNowCST();
        if(n && n.y != null) return { y: n.y|0, m: n.m|0, d: (n.d != null ? n.d|0 : 1) };
      }
    } catch(_e){}
    try {
      var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Chicago', year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' }).formatToParts(new Date());
      var y=0, mo=1, da=1;
      parts.forEach(function(p){
        if(p.type==='year') y=+p.value;
        if(p.type==='month') mo=+p.value;
        if(p.type==='day') da=+p.value;
      });
      return { y:y, m:mo-1, d:da };
    } catch(_e2){
      var dt=new Date();
      return { y:dt.getFullYear(), m:dt.getMonth(), d:dt.getDate() };
    }
  }
  function debtFocusCivil(){
    // Prefer an explicit picked day; else today (CST). Do NOT use month-view day=1 — that false-fires Car pays.
    try {
      if(typeof easyCal !== 'undefined' && easyCal && easyCal.pick && easyCal.pick.y != null && easyCal.pick.d != null){
        return { y: easyCal.pick.y|0, m: easyCal.pick.m|0, d: easyCal.pick.d|0 };
      }
    } catch(_p){}
    return debtCivilToday();
  }
  function debtDaysBetween(a, b){
    // civil UTC noon delta
    var t0 = Date.UTC(a.y, a.m, a.d);
    var t1 = Date.UTC(b.y, b.m, b.d);
    return Math.round((t1 - t0) / [REDACTED-ACCOUNT-DIGITS]);
  }
  function debtCmpCivil(a, b){
    if(a.y !== b.y) return a.y - b.y;
    if(a.m !== b.m) return a.m - b.m;
    return a.d - b.d;
  }
  function debtAddMonths(y, m, delta){
    var x = y * 12 + m + delta;
    return { y: Math.floor(x / 12), m: ((x % 12) + 12) % 12 };
  }
  function debtClampDay(y, m, d){
    var dim = 31;
    try {
      if(window.RankingCalendar && RankingCalendar.daysInMonth) dim = RankingCalendar.daysInMonth(y, m);
      else dim = new Date(y, m+1, 0).getDate();
    } catch(_d){ dim = new Date(y, m+1, 0).getDate(); }
    return Math.max(1, Math.min(d|0, dim|0));
  }

  /** Calendar pay day (1–31) for a debt index — from linked expense Board act cadence monthly. */
  function debtCalendarPayDay(debtIndex){
    debtIndex = debtIndex|0;
    var expenseNames = [];
    try {
      (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
        (sec.items || []).forEach(function(it){
          if((typeof debtPayIndex === 'function' ? debtPayIndex(it) : -1) === debtIndex){
            expenseNames.push(String(it.name || ''));
          }
        });
      });
    } catch(_e){}
    var acts = [];
    try { acts = (WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || []; } catch(_a){}
    for(var i=0;i<acts.length;i++){
      var a = acts[i];
      if(!a) continue;
      var en = String(a.expenseName || a.name || '');
      if(expenseNames.indexOf(en) < 0 && expenseNames.indexOf(String(a.name||'')) < 0) continue;
      if(String(a.cadence||'').toLowerCase() === 'monthly' && Number(a.day) > 0) return Number(a.day)|0;
    }
    // fallback: debt.days-as-billing doesn't give calendar day; use 1
    return 1;
  }

  function debtCashForIndex(debtIndex){
    debtIndex = debtIndex|0;
    var debts = (WB && WB.debts) || [];
    var d = debts[debtIndex];
    if(!d) return 0;
    var cash = null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */;
    try {
      (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
        (sec.items || []).forEach(function(it){
          if((typeof debtPayIndex === 'function' ? debtPayIndex(it) : -1) === debtIndex){
            cash += (typeof lineAmt === 'function') ? lineAmt(it) : (Number(it.current)||0);
          }
        });
      });
    } catch(_l){}
    if(!(cash > 0)){
      var payKey = (typeof debtPayField === 'function') ? debtPayField() : 'current_payment';
      cash = Number(d[payKey]);
      if(!(cash > 0)) cash = Number(d.current_payment)||0;
    }
    return cash > 0 ? cash: null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */;
  }

  /**
   * easy211: live balance at target civil date.
   * Starts from balanceInitial @ balanceAsOf (defaults: balance @ today).
   * Applies calendar monthly pay hits (Car 1st, Student 25th, …): interest for elapsed days, then cash.
   */
  function debtLiveAtDate(debtIndex, targetCivil){
    var debts = (WB && WB.debts) || [];
    var d = debts[debtIndex];
    if(!d) return { live:0, initial:0, asOf:null, target:null, gap:0, pays:0 };
    var initial = Number(d.balanceInitial != null ? d.balanceInitial : d.balance) || 0;
    var asOf = debtParseYMD(d.balanceAsOf) || debtCivilToday();
    // Persist defaults lazily without forcing save
    if(d.balanceInitial == null) d.balanceInitial = initial;
    if(!d.balanceAsOf) d.balanceAsOf = debtYmdFromParts(asOf.y, asOf.m, asOf.d);
    var target = targetCivil || debtFocusCivil() || debtCivilToday();
    var aprPct = Number(d.aprPct);
    if(!isFinite(aprPct) && d.apr != null){
      var a = Number(d.apr); aprPct = a > 1 ? a : a * 100;
    }
    if(!isFinite(aprPct) || aprPct < 0) aprPct = 0;
    var apr = aprPct * 0.01;
    var cash = debtCashForIndex(debtIndex);
    var payDay = debtCalendarPayDay(debtIndex);
    var termsInitial = Number(d.remainingTermsInitial != null ? d.remainingTermsInitial : d.remainingTerms);
    if(!isFinite(termsInitial) || termsInitial < 0) termsInitial = 0;
    if(d.remainingTermsInitial == null && isFinite(Number(d.remainingTerms))) d.remainingTermsInitial = Number(d.remainingTerms);
    var bal = initial;
    var last = { y: asOf.y, m: asOf.m, d: asOf.d };
    var pays = 0;
    if(debtCmpCivil(target, asOf) <= 0){
      return { live: bal, initial: initial, asOf: d.balanceAsOf, target: debtYmdFromParts(target.y,target.m,target.d), gap: 0, pays: 0, payDay: payDay, termsInitial: termsInitial, termsLive: termsInitial };
    }
    // Walk payment dates from first pay on/after day after asOf through target
    var ym = { y: asOf.y, m: asOf.m };
    var guard = 0;
    while(guard++ < 2500){
      var pd = debtClampDay(ym.y, ym.m, payDay);
      var payCivil = { y: ym.y, m: ym.m, d: pd };
      if(debtCmpCivil(payCivil, asOf) <= 0){
        ym = debtAddMonths(ym.y, ym.m, 1);
        continue;
      }
      if(debtCmpCivil(payCivil, target) > 0) break;
      var days = debtDaysBetween(last, payCivil);
      if(days < 0) days = 0;
      if(bal > 0.005){
        var interest = (apr / 365) * bal * days;
        var pay = cash;
        if(!(pay > 0)) pay = 0;
        bal = bal + interest - pay;
        if(bal < 0.005) bal = null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */;
        pays++;
      }
      last = payCivil;
      ym = debtAddMonths(ym.y, ym.m, 1);
      if(!(bal > 0.005)) break;
    }
    // Accrue interest from last event to target (no payment)
    if(bal > 0.005){
      var days2 = debtDaysBetween(last, target);
      if(days2 > 0) bal = bal + (apr / 365) * bal * days2;
    }
    if(bal < 0.005) bal = null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */;
    var gap = initial - bal;
    if(gap < 0) gap = 0;
    var termsLive = termsInitial - pays;
    if(termsLive < 0) termsLive = 0;
    if(!(bal > 0.005)) termsLive = 0;
    return {
      live: Math.round(bal * 100) / 100,
      initial: initial,
      asOf: d.balanceAsOf,
      target: debtYmdFromParts(target.y, target.m, target.d),
      gap: Math.round(gap * 100) / 100,
      pays: pays,
      payDay: payDay,
      termsInitial: termsInitial,
      termsLive: termsLive
    };
  }

  function debtEnsureAsOfDefaults(){
    var today = debtCivilToday();
    var ymd = debtYmdFromParts(today.y, today.m, today.d);
    ((WB && WB.debts) || []).forEach(function(d){
      if(!d) return;
      if(d.balanceInitial == null && d.balance != null) d.balanceInitial = Number(d.balance)||0;
      if(d.balanceInitial != null) d.balance = Number(d.balanceInitial)||0;
      if(d.remainingTermsInitial == null && d.remainingTerms != null) d.remainingTermsInitial = Number(d.remainingTerms)||0;
      if(d.remainingTermsInitial != null) d.remainingTerms = Number(d.remainingTermsInitial)||0;
      if(!d.balanceAsOf) d.balanceAsOf = ymd;
    });
  }

function debtPaymentSchedule(maxMonths){
    maxMonths = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(maxMonths) || 1, 2000));
    var debts = (WB && WB.debts) || [];
    var keyParts = [String(maxMonths)];
    // Resolve cash payment per debt the same way calcDebt links expense payDebt rows.
    var linked = {};
    try {
      (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
        (sec.items || []).forEach(function(it){
          var di = (typeof debtPayIndex === 'function') ? debtPayIndex(it) : -1;
          if(di < 0 || !debts[di]) return;
          if(!linked[di]) linked[di] = 0;
          linked[di] += (typeof lineAmt === 'function') ? lineAmt(it) : (Number(it.current) || 0);
        });
      });
    } catch(_l){}
    var states = debts.map(function(d, i){
      var bal = (function(){ try { var L=debtLiveAtDate(i, debtCivilToday()); return Number(L && L.live) || 0; } catch(_L){ return Number(d.balance)||0; } })();
      var aprPct = Number(d.aprPct);
      if(!isFinite(aprPct) && d.apr != null){
        var a = Number(d.apr);
        aprPct = a > 1 ? a : a * 100;
      }
      if(!isFinite(aprPct) || aprPct < 0) aprPct = 0;
      var apr = aprPct * 0.01;
      var days = Number(d.days);
      if(!isFinite(days) || days <= 0) days = 365/12;
      var cash = linked[i];
      if(!(cash > 0)){
        var payKey = (typeof debtPayField === 'function') ? debtPayField() : 'current_payment';
        cash = Number(d[payKey]);
        if(!(cash > 0)) cash = Number(d.current_payment) || 0;
      }
      if(!(cash > 0)) cash = null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */;
      keyParts.push([i, bal.toFixed(2), aprPct, days, cash.toFixed(2)].join(':'));
      return { bal: bal, apr: apr, days: days, cash: cash };
    });
    var key = keyParts.join('|');
    if(__debtPaySchedCache && __debtPaySchedKey === key) return __debtPaySchedCache;
    var payments = new Array(maxMonths);
    var still = states.map(function(s){ return s.bal; });
    for(var m = 0; m < maxMonths; m++){
      var paySum = 0;
      for(var i = 0; i < states.length; i++){
        var s = states[i];
        var bal = still[i];
        if(!(bal > 0.005) || !(s.cash > 0)){
          still[i] = 0;
          continue;
        }
        // Pay min(cash, bal+interest) effectively via step; schedule charges contractual cash while live.
        paySum += s.cash;
        still[i] = debtStepBalance(bal, s.apr, s.days, s.cash);
      }
      payments[m] = paySum;
    }
    var out = { payments: payments, maxMonths: maxMonths, key: key };
    __debtPaySchedCache = out;
    __debtPaySchedKey = key;
    return out;
  }

  function debtCashAtMonth(monthIndex, maxMonths){
    monthIndex = monthIndex|0;
    if(monthIndex < 0) monthIndex = 0;
    var horiz = maxMonths;
    if(!(horiz > 0)){
      try {
        horiz = (typeof easyHorizonYears === 'function' ? easyHorizonYears() : 150) * 12;
      } catch(_h){ horiz = 150 * 12; }
    }
    horiz = Math.max(monthIndex + 1, Math.min(horiz|0, 2000));
    var sched = debtPaymentSchedule(horiz);
    if(monthIndex >= sched.payments.length) return 0;
    return Number(sched.payments[monthIndex]) || 0;
  }

  /** Cumulative Money stock after `monthIndex` months of gain − living − amortizing debt. */
  function easyMoneyStockAfterMonths(monthIndex, savings0, gain, living){
    monthIndex = monthIndex|0;
    if(monthIndex < 0) monthIndex = 0;
    savings0 = Number(savings0) || 0;
    gain = Number(gain) || 0;
    living = Number(living) || 0;
    if(monthIndex === 0) return savings0;
    var stock = savings0;
    var horiz = Math.min(Math.max(monthIndex, 1), 2000);
    var sched = debtPaymentSchedule(horiz);
    for(var m = 0; m < monthIndex; m++){
      var debtPay = (m < sched.payments.length) ? (Number(sched.payments[m]) || 0) : 0;
      stock += gain - living - debtPay;
    }
    return stock;
  }

  /** Months until stock >= need (amortizing debt). null if never within horizon. */
  function easyMonthsUntilStock(need, savings0, gain, living, maxMonths){
    need = Number(need) || 0;
    savings0 = Number(savings0) || 0;
    if(need <= savings0) return 0;
    maxMonths = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(maxMonths) || 1800, 2000));
    var stock = savings0;
    var sched = debtPaymentSchedule(maxMonths);
    for(var m = 0; m < maxMonths; m++){
      var debtPay = Number(sched.payments[m]) || 0;
      stock += (Number(gain) || 0) - (Number(living) || 0) - debtPay;
      if(stock + 1e-9 >= need) return m + 1;
    }
    return null;
  }



  function payoffTermsHtml(po, scheduled){
   if(!po || po.never){
    return '<span class="neg" title="Cash pay ≤ interest this term; balance never falls">∞</span>';
   }
   var lab = po.over ? (po.terms+'+') : String(po.terms);
   var tip = 'Months to [REDACTED-AMOUNT] at current cash pay (same dailyRate×days as amount due)';
   if(scheduled > 0) tip += '. Schedule terms: '+scheduled;
   var cls = po.over ? 'neg' : (scheduled > 0 && po.terms < scheduled ? 'pos' : '');
   return '<span'+(cls?' class="'+cls+'"':'')+' title="'+esc(tip)+'">'+lab+'</span>';
  }
  /**
   * Debt payments: calculated amountDue (totalDurationPayment) is the
   * lender minimum for on-time payoff. Linked EXPENSES $ is what you actually
   * pay this month (may be higher/lower — warn if < interest).
   */
  function calcDebt(){
   var linked = {}; // debtIndex → {amount, names:[]}
   (WB.expenses.sections||[]).forEach(function(sec){
    (sec.items||[]).forEach(function(it){
     var di = debtPayIndex(it);
     if(di < 0 || !WB.debts[di]) return;
     if(!linked[di]) linked[di] = {amount: null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */, names:[]};
     linked[di].amount += lineAmt(it);
     linked[di].names.push(it.name);
    });
   });

   var bal=null /* [REDACTED-AMOUNT] */, intSum=0;
   var lines = (WB.debts||[]).map(function(d, i){
    if(d.aprPct == null && d.apr != null){
     var a = Number(d.apr);
     d.aprPct = a > 1 ? a : a * 100;
    }
    if(d.aprPct == null) d.aprPct = 0;
    if(d.remainingTerms == null || !(Number(d.remainingTerms)>0)){
     var guessPay = Number(d.current_payment)||Number(d.payment)||0;
     d.remainingTerms = guessPay > 0
      ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Number(d.balance)||0) / guessPay))
      : 155;
    }
    if(d.days == null || !(Number(d.days) > 0)) d.days = 365 / 12;
    // easy211: month math on LIVE balance (initial stays in WB.debts[i].balance / balanceInitial)
    var liveInfo = null;
    try {
      if(typeof debtEnsureAsOfDefaults === 'function') debtEnsureAsOfDefaults();
      liveInfo = debtLiveAtDate(i, debtFocusCivil());
    } catch(_lv){ liveInfo = null; }
    var dMath = Object.assign({}, d, {
      balance: (liveInfo && isFinite(liveInfo.live)) ? liveInfo.live : (Number(d.balance)||0)
    });
    var math = debtMonthMath(dMath);
    bal += math.balance;
    intSum += math.durationApr;
    var dueShow = math.amountDue;

    var L = linked[i];
    var cash;
    var payKey = debtPayField();
    var scPay = Number(d[payKey]);
    if(L){
     cash = L.amount;
     d[payKey] = cash;
     d._fromExpense = L.names.join(', ');
    } else {
     d._fromExpense = null;
     cash = isFinite(scPay) && scPay > 0 ? scPay : Number(d.current_payment);
     if(!isFinite(cash) || cash <= 0){
      cash = dueShow;
      d[payKey] = dueShow;
     }
    }

    var payoff = debtPayoffTerms(math.balance, math.apr, math.days, cash);
    return {
     index: i,
     creditor: d.creditor,
     purpose: d.purpose,
     balance: math.balance,
     balanceInitial: liveInfo ? liveInfo.initial : (Number(d.balanceInitial != null ? d.balanceInitial : d.balance)||0),
     balanceAsOf: liveInfo ? liveInfo.asOf : (d.balanceAsOf || ''),
     balanceLive: liveInfo ? liveInfo.live : math.balance,
     balanceGap: liveInfo ? liveInfo.gap : 0,
     balanceTarget: liveInfo ? liveInfo.target : '',
     payDay: liveInfo ? liveInfo.payDay : null,
     paysApplied: liveInfo ? liveInfo.pays : 0,
     termsInitial: liveInfo ? liveInfo.termsInitial : (Number(d.remainingTermsInitial != null ? d.remainingTermsInitial : d.remainingTerms)||0),
     termsLive: liveInfo ? liveInfo.termsLive : (Number(d.remainingTerms)||0),
     aprPct: Number(d.aprPct)||0,
     remainingTerms: (liveInfo && liveInfo.termsLive != null) ? liveInfo.termsLive : math.remainingTerms,
     days: math.days,
     durationApr: math.durationAprCents,
     principalSlice: math.principalSlice,
     totalDurationPayment: math.totalDurationPaymentCents,
     amountDue: math.amountDue,
     totalDurationPaymentRaw: math.totalDurationPayment,
     payment: cash,
     current_payment: cash,
     contractual: dueShow,
     fromExpense: L ? L.names : null,
     underMin: cash + 1e-9 < dueShow,
     underInterest: cash + 1e-9 < math.durationAprCents,
     payoffTerms: payoff.terms,
     payoffNever: !!payoff.never,
     payoffOver: !!payoff.over,
     payoff: payoff,
     math: math
    };
   });

   var contractual = 0, cashPay = 0;
   lines.forEach(function(L){
    contractual += L.amountDue;
    cashPay += L.payment;
   });

   var inc=calcIncome();
   var dti = inc.gross ? contractual/inc.gross : 0;
   return {
    payments: cashPay,
    amountDue: contractual,
    totalBalance: bal,
    totalInterestMonth: Math.round(intSum*100)/100,
    dti: dti,
    lines: lines,
    linked: linked
   };
  }

  /** Auto-link Car / Student Loan expense names → debt rows once. */
  function ensureDebtPayLinks(){
   if(!WB || !WB.debts || !WB.debts.length) return;
   function findDebt(pred){
    for(var i=0;i<WB.debts.length;i++){
     if(pred(WB.debts[i], i)) return i;
    }
    return -1;
   }
   (WB.expenses.sections||[]).forEach(function(sec){
    (sec.items||[]).forEach(function(it){
     if(isDebtPay(it)) return; // already linked
     var n = String(it.name||'').toLowerCase();
     var di = -1;
     if(/\bcar\b/.test(n) && !/insurance|gas|wash/.test(n)){
      di = findDebt(function(d){
       return /auto|car|[REDACTED-INSTITUTION]|vehicle/i.test(d.creditor+' '+d.purpose);
      });
     } else if(/student|stuent|loan/.test(n)){
      di = findDebt(function(d){
       return /student|first\s*mark|loan/i.test(d.creditor+' '+d.purpose);
      });
     }
     if(di >= 0) it.payDebt = di;
    });
   });
  }

  function calcAssets(){
   var a=0;
   ['savings','real_estate','personal'].forEach(function(k){
    (WB.assets[k]||[]).forEach(function(i){a+=Number(i.current)||0;});
   });
   var debt=calcDebt();
   return {totalAssets:a, liabilities:debt.totalBalance, netWorth:a-debt.totalBalance};
  }

  function calcSummary(){
   var inc=calcIncome(), exp=calcExpenses(), debt=calcDebt();
   return {
    gross: inc.gross,
    net: inc.net,
    living: exp.grand,
    debtPayments: debt.payments,
    surplus: inc.net - exp.grand - debt.payments,
    dti: debt.dti
   };
  }

  /**
   * HDAME pools — derived from REVIEW / sheet money + calendar horizon.
   * Not a separate tab; view on JOYS. No manual HDAME edits.
   */
  function calcHdame(){
   // horizon: calendar years if present, else stored default, else 150
   var years =  150;
   try {
    if (WB.calendar && Number(WB.calendar.years) > 0) years = Number(WB.calendar.years);
    else if (WB.hdame && Number(WB.hdame.years) > 0) years = Number(WB.hdame.years);
   } catch(_y){}
   var months = years * 12;
   // H/E monthly units: structural joy defaults (not sheet $)
   var hPer = (WB.hdame && Number(WB.hdame.hPerMonth) > 0) ? Number(WB.hdame.hPerMonth) : 100;
   var ePer = (WB.hdame && Number(WB.hdame.ePerMonth) > 0) ? Number(WB.hdame.ePerMonth) : 20;
   // money from same densest path as REVIEW (sheet SoT · never invent)
   var sum = calcSummary();
   var net = sum.net;
   var living = sum.living;
   var debtCash = sum.debtPayments;
   var surplus = sum.surplus;
   return {
    years: years,
    months: months,
    H: hPer * months,
    D: 365 * months / 12,
    A: months,
    M: net * months,
    E: ePer * months,
    hPerMonth: hPer,
    ePerMonth: ePer,
    netProjected: net,
    net: net,
    living: living,
    debtCash: debtCash,
    surplus: surplus,
    source: 'review+sheet',
    joyMap: {
     H: 'joy_age_happiness',
     D: 'joy_calendar',
     A: 'joy_age_happiness',
     M: 'joy_money',
     E: 'joy_external',
     surplus: 'joy_surplus_freedom',
     debt: 'joy_debt_urgency'
    }
   };
  }

  function parseHdamePack(s){
   if(!s) return null;
   if(typeof s==='object' && s.H!=null) return s;
   var m=String(s).match(/([0-9.eE+-]+)([HDAEM])/g);
   if(!m||!m.length) return null;
   var out={};
   m.forEach(function(tok){
    var mm=tok.match(/([0-9.eE+-]+)([HDAEM])/);
    if(mm) out[mm[2]]=parseFloat(mm[1]);
   });
   return out.H!=null||out.M!=null ? out : null;
  }

  /** Rankable expense lines only — must have a money amount (> 0). */
  function expenseItems(){
   var out=[];
   (WB.expenses.sections||[]).forEach(function(sec,si){
    (sec.items||[]).forEach(function(it,ii){
     if(!it.name||!String(it.name).trim()) return;
     var cost = lineAmt(it);
     // zero / empty $ → list on EXPENSES but never ranked
     if(!(cost > 0)) return;
     out.push({
      name: it.name,
      cost: cost,
      pack: it.hdame || parseHdamePack(it.remarks),
      _si: si, _ii: ii
     });
    });
   });
   return out;
  }

  /** Board/calendar acts eligible for HDAME ranks (Work, Gym, Lunch, bills, …). */
  function boardRankCandidates(){
   var out = [];
   var acts = [];
   try {
     if(typeof easyBoardActs === 'function') acts = easyBoardActs() || [];
     else if(typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function') acts = easyScheduleActions() || [];
     else if(typeof getCalendarCustomActions === 'function') acts = getCalendarCustomActions() || [];
   } catch(_a){ acts = []; }
   (acts || []).forEach(function(a){
     if(!a || a.suggestOnly || a.enabled === false) return;
     if(String(a.id || '').indexOf('__sug_') === 0) return;
     var nm = null;
     try { nm = (typeof easyExpenseNameOf === 'function') ? easyExpenseNameOf(a) : (a.expenseName || a.name); } catch(_n){ nm = a.expenseName || a.name; }
     if(!nm || !String(nm).trim()) return;
     var incomeAmt = 0;
     try {
       if(typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') incomeAmt = Math.abs(Number(easyActMonthAmount(a)) || 0);
       else incomeAmt = Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
     } catch(_c){ incomeAmt = 0; }
     var pol = a.polarity || null;
     var isGain = (a.kind === 'work') || pol === 'gain' || pol === 'produce';
     // M ranks use cost (spend). Work/gain pay is income — never a positive M cost.
     var cost = isGain ? 0 : incomeAmt;
     out.push({
       name: String(nm),
       cost: cost,
       incomeAmt: isGain ? incomeAmt : 0,
       kind: a.kind || 'schedule',
       polarity: pol || (isGain ? 'gain' : null),
       fromBoard: true,
       id: a.id || null
     });
   });
   return out;
  }

  /**
   * Everything that appears on RANKS: valued expenses + every Board item.
   * Schedule rituals (Gym/Lunch) and Work get cost 0 on M but still rank on H/D/A/E/custom.
   */
  function rankItems(){
   var by = Object.create(null);
   expenseItems().forEach(function(it){
     if(!it || !it.name) return;
     by[it.name] = {
       name: it.name,
       cost: Number(it.cost) || 0,
       pack: it.pack || null,
       fromExpense: true,
       fromBoard: false,
       _si: it._si, _ii: it._ii
     };
   });
   boardRankCandidates().forEach(function(it){
     if(!it || !it.name) return;
     var isGain = (it.kind === 'work') || it.polarity === 'gain' || it.polarity === 'produce';
     if(by[it.name]){
       // Work/gain: M cost stays 0 (pay is incomeAmt, not spend). Else take max sheet/board $.
       if(isGain){
         by[it.name].cost = 0;
         by[it.name].incomeAmt = Number(it.incomeAmt) || Number(it.cost) || by[it.name].incomeAmt || 0;
       } else {
         by[it.name].cost = Math.max(Number(by[it.name].cost) || 0, Number(it.cost) || 0);
       }
       by[it.name].fromBoard = true;
       by[it.name].kind = it.kind;
       if(it.polarity) by[it.name].polarity = it.polarity;
       if(it.id) by[it.name].id = it.id;
     } else {
       by[it.name] = {
         name: it.name,
         cost: isGain ? 0 : (Number(it.cost) || 0),
         incomeAmt: isGain ? (Number(it.incomeAmt) || 0) : 0,
         pack: null,
         fromExpense: false,
         fromBoard: true,
         kind: it.kind,
         polarity: it.polarity || (isGain ? 'gain' : null),
         id: it.id || null
       };
     }
   });
   return Object.keys(by).map(function(k){ return by[k]; });
  }

  /** True when item is Work/gain — earn, not a spend cost on M. */
  function isRankMoneyGain(it){
   if(!it) return false;
   if(it.kind === 'work') return true;
   var pol = it.polarity;
   return pol === 'gain' || pol === 'produce';
  }

  /** Names that exist on expense sheets (setExpenseCost targets). */
  function expenseSheetNameSet(){
   var set = Object.create(null);
   (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
     (sec.items || []).forEach(function(it){
       if(it && it.name && String(it.name).trim()) set[it.name] = 1;
     });
   });
   return set;
  }

  function allRankDims(){
   var base = (typeof DIMS !== 'undefined' && DIMS) ? DIMS.slice() : ['H','D','A','M','E'];
   var extra = (WB && Array.isArray(WB.customRankDims)) ? WB.customRankDims : [];
   extra.forEach(function(d){
     if(!d || !d.id) return;
     if(base.indexOf(d.id) < 0) base.push(d.id);
   });
   return base;
  }

  function rankDimLabel(d){
   if(DIM_LABEL && DIM_LABEL[d]) return DIM_LABEL[d];
   var extra = (WB && WB.customRankDims) || [];
   for(var i = 0; i < extra.length; i++){
     if(extra[i] && extra[i].id === d) return extra[i].label || d;
   }
   return d;
  }

  /** Short text above #1: what higher ranking means for this score factor. */
  function rankDimHigherMeans(d){
   if(WB && WB.rankFactorMeans && WB.rankFactorMeans[d]) return String(WB.rankFactorMeans[d]);
   var extra = (WB && WB.customRankDims) || [];
   for(var i = 0; i < extra.length; i++){
     if(extra[i] && extra[i].id === d && extra[i].higherMeans) return String(extra[i].higherMeans);
   }
   if(DIM_HIGHER_MEANS && DIM_HIGHER_MEANS[d]) return DIM_HIGHER_MEANS[d];
   return 'Higher ranking = larger score share for this factor (unless inverted).';
  }

  function setRankFactorHigherMeans(d, text){
   if(!d) return;
   text = String(text == null ? '' : text).trim();
   if(!WB.rankFactorMeans) WB.rankFactorMeans = {};
   if(text) WB.rankFactorMeans[d] = text;
   else delete WB.rankFactorMeans[d];
   var extra = WB.customRankDims || [];
   for(var i = 0; i < extra.length; i++){
     if(extra[i] && extra[i].id === d){
       extra[i].higherMeans = text || '';
       break;
     }
   }
   try { if(typeof saveLocal === 'function') saveLocal(); } catch(_s){}
  }

  /** Item excluded from a score factor (non-factor) — no share, no # rank. */
  function isRankNonFactor(dim, name){
   if(!dim || !name || !WB || !WB.rankNonFactors) return false;
   var bag = WB.rankNonFactors[dim];
   return !!(bag && bag[name]);
  }

  function setRankNonFactor(dim, name, isNon){
   if(!dim || !name) return;
   if(!WB.rankNonFactors) WB.rankNonFactors = {};
   if(!WB.rankNonFactors[dim]) WB.rankNonFactors[dim] = {};
   if(isNon) WB.rankNonFactors[dim][name] = 1;
   else delete WB.rankNonFactors[dim][name];
   try { if(typeof saveLocal === 'function') saveLocal(); } catch(_s){}
  }

  /** Order used for harmonic shares / display numbers — skips non-factors. */
  function activeRankOrder(dim){
   return (WB.rankOrders[dim] || []).filter(function(n){
     return n && !isRankNonFactor(dim, n);
   });
  }

  function rankDimInverted(d){
   if(INVERT_DIMS && INVERT_DIMS[d]) return true;
   var extra = (WB && WB.customRankDims) || [];
   for(var i = 0; i < extra.length; i++){
     if(extra[i] && extra[i].id === d) return !!extra[i].invert;
   }
   return false;
  }

  /** Add a custom HDAME-style score factor (new rank dimension). */
  function addRankFactor(id, label, invert, higherMeans){
   id = String(id || '').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9_]/g, '');
   if(!id || id.length > 12) return { ok: false, err: 'bad id' };
   if(DIMS.indexOf(id) >= 0) return { ok: false, err: 'built-in' };
   if(!WB.customRankDims) WB.customRankDims = [];
   for(var i = 0; i < WB.customRankDims.length; i++){
     if(WB.customRankDims[i] && WB.customRankDims[i].id === id) return { ok: false, err: 'exists' };
   }
   var means = String(higherMeans == null ? '' : higherMeans).trim();
   WB.customRankDims.push({ id: id, label: label || id, invert: !!invert, higherMeans: means });
   if(means){
     if(!WB.rankFactorMeans) WB.rankFactorMeans = {};
     WB.rankFactorMeans[id] = means;
   }
   if(!WB.rankOrders) WB.rankOrders = {};
   var names = rankItems().map(function(it){ return it.name; });
   WB.rankOrders[id] = names.slice();
   try { if(typeof saveLocal === 'function') saveLocal(); } catch(_s){}
   return { ok: true, id: id };
  }

  /**
   * Keep WB.rankOrders in sync with ALL rankable item names (Board + expenses).
   * moneyMode: 'values' = $ drives M rank · 'ranks' = M rank drives $
   */
  function ensureRankState(){
   if(!WB.rankOrders) WB.rankOrders = { H:[], D:[], A:[], M:[], E:[], T:[], U:[], S:[] };
   if(!Array.isArray(WB.customRankDims)) WB.customRankDims = WB.customRankDims || [];
   ensureFactorOrder();
   if(WB.moneyMode !== 'ranks') WB.moneyMode = 'values';
   if(WB.timeMode !== 'ranks') WB.timeMode = 'values';
   if(WB.daysMode !== 'ranks') WB.daysMode = 'values';
   if(WB.debtMode !== 'ranks') WB.debtMode = 'values';
   if(WB.surplusMode !== 'ranks') WB.surplusMode = 'values';
   var items = rankItems();
   var names = items.map(function(i){ return i.name; });
   var nameSet = {};
   names.forEach(function(n){ nameSet[n]=1; });

   var dimsAll = allRankDims();
   var needSeed = dimsAll.every(function(d){ return !(WB.rankOrders[d]&&WB.rankOrders[d].length); });
   if(needSeed && items.length){
    var byH = items.slice().sort(function(a,b){
     var ha=(a.pack&&a.pack.H)||0, hb=(b.pack&&b.pack.H)||0;
     if(hb!==ha) return hb-ha;
     return (b.cost||0)-(a.cost||0);
    });
    var byCost = items.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (b.cost||0)-(a.cost||0); });
    dimsAll.forEach(function(d){
     WB.rankOrders[d] = (d==='M' ? byCost : byH).map(function(i){ return i.name; });
    });
    WB.moneyMode = 'values';
   }

   dimsAll.forEach(function(d){
    var order = (WB.rankOrders[d]||[]).filter(function(n){ return nameSet[n]; });
    names.forEach(function(n){
     if(order.indexOf(n)<0) order.push(n);
    });
    WB.rankOrders[d] = order;
   });

   // Migrate: seed T (Time/calendar) from D once if empty
   if((!WB.rankOrders.T || !WB.rankOrders.T.length) && WB.rankOrders.D && WB.rankOrders.D.length){
     WB.rankOrders.T = WB.rankOrders.D.slice();
   }
   // Seed U (Debt/urgency) / S (Surplus/freedom) from H order if empty
   if((!WB.rankOrders.U || !WB.rankOrders.U.length) && WB.rankOrders.H && WB.rankOrders.H.length){
     WB.rankOrders.U = WB.rankOrders.H.slice();
   }
   if((!WB.rankOrders.S || !WB.rankOrders.S.length) && WB.rankOrders.H && WB.rankOrders.H.length){
     WB.rankOrders.S = WB.rankOrders.H.slice();
   }
   // values mode: exact order rebuild is engine work (traversalTick), never on paint
   var needsValues = (WB.moneyMode === 'values' || WB.timeMode === 'values'
     || WB.daysMode === 'values' || WB.debtMode === 'values' || WB.surplusMode === 'values');
   if(needsValues && (!lastEmit || lastEmit.worldGen !== worldGen)){
     requestTraversal();
   }
  }

  /** Sort M ranks by monthly $ (desc). Old ranking_ui auto-sort money. */
  function syncMoneyRankFromValues(){
   var items = rankItems().slice().sort(function(a,b){
    var ca = Number(a.cost)||0, cb = Number(b.cost)||0;
    if(cb !== ca) return cb - ca;
    return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name));
   });
   var names = items.map(function(i){ return i.name; });
   var factors = names.filter(function(n){ return !isRankNonFactor('M', n); });
   var nons = names.filter(function(n){ return isRankNonFactor('M', n); });
   WB.rankOrders.M = factors.concat(nons);
  }

  /** Duration minutes for one occurrence of an act (calendar-defined). */
  function rankActDurationMin(a){
   if(!a) return 0;
   if(a.kind === 'work'){
     try {
       var wh = (typeof easyWorkBlockHours === 'function') ? easyWorkBlockHours() : null;
       var w0 = (a.startMin != null) ? Number(a.startMin) : (wh ? wh.startMin : 15*60);
       var w1 = (a.endMin != null) ? Number(a.endMin) : (wh ? wh.endMin : 23*60);
       if(w1 > w0) return w1 - w0;
     } catch(_w){}
     return 8 * 60;
   }
   if(a.allDay || (a.hours && a.hours[0] === 'all')){
     /* all-day presence: 1h credit/day so it ranks from calendar days without crushing timed blocks */
     return 60;
   }
   if(a.startMin != null && a.endMin != null && Number(a.endMin) > Number(a.startMin)){
     return Number(a.endMin) - Number(a.startMin);
   }
   try {
     if(typeof easyActTimePair === 'function' && typeof easyParseHHMM === 'function'){
       var tp = easyActTimePair(a);
       if(tp && tp.s && tp.e){
         var s0 = easyParseHHMM(tp.s), e0 = easyParseHHMM(tp.e);
         if(s0 != null && e0 != null && e0 > s0) return e0 - s0;
       }
     }
   } catch(_t){}
   return 30; /* default short slot when placed but untimed */
  }

  /** Focus month for calendar→rank (same as calendar UI when possible). */
  function rankCalendarFocusMonth(){
   try {
     if(typeof easyFocusMonth === 'function'){
       var fm = easyFocusMonth();
       if(fm && fm.y != null && fm.m != null) return { y: fm.y|0, m: fm.m|0 };
     }
   } catch(_f){}
   var n = new Date();
   return { y: n.getFullYear(), m: n.getMonth() };
  }

  /** Board acts matching a rank item name. */
  function rankActsForName(name){
   var out = [];
   if(!name) return out;
   var acts = [];
   try {
     if(typeof easyBoardActs === 'function') acts = easyBoardActs() || [];
     else if(typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function') acts = easyScheduleActions() || [];
   } catch(_a){ acts = []; }
   (acts || []).forEach(function(a){
     if(!a || a.suggestOnly) return;
     var nm = null;
     try { nm = (typeof easyExpenseNameOf === 'function') ? easyExpenseNameOf(a) : (a.expenseName || a.name); } catch(_n){ nm = a.expenseName || a.name; }
     if(nm === name || a.name === name) out.push(a);
   });
   return out;
  }

  /**
   * One focus-month walk → hours (days×duration) and unique day count.
   * Shared by T (Time) and D (Days) values mode.
   */
  function rankItemCalendarCover(name){
   var acts = rankActsForName(name);
   if(!acts.length) return { hours: 0, days: 0 };
   var fm = rankCalendarFocusMonth();
   var dim = 31;
   try { dim = (typeof easyDimOf === 'function') ? (easyDimOf(fm.y, fm.m)|0) : 31; } catch(_d){ dim = 31; }
   var minutes = 0;
   var dayHit = Object.create(null);
   acts.forEach(function(a){
     var dur = rankActDurationMin(a);
     var daysOn = 0;
     for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
       var on = false;
       try {
         if(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function') on = !!easyActCoversDay(a, { y: fm.y, m: fm.m, d: d });
         else if(typeof easyOccurs === 'function') on = !!easyOccurs(a, fm.y, fm.m, d);
       } catch(_o){ on = false; }
       if(on){
         daysOn++;
         dayHit[d] = 1;
       }
     }
     if(dur > 0) minutes += daysOn * dur;
   });
   var uniq = 0;
   for(var k in dayHit){ if(dayHit[k]) uniq++; }
   return { hours: Math.round((minutes / 60) * 100) / 100, days: uniq };
  }

  /**
   * Calendar-derived time value: hours in the focus month this item occupies
   * (days it occurs × duration). Same role as monthly $ for Money.
   */
  function rankItemCalendarHours(name){
   return rankItemCalendarCover(name).hours;
  }

  /**
   * Calendar-derived Days (D) value: count of unique focus-month days the item covers.
   * Parallel to T hours — reuse rankActsForName / easyActCoversDay via cover walk.
   */
  function rankItemCalendarDays(name){
   return rankItemCalendarCover(name).days;
  }

  /** Map name → calendar hours (cached per ensure tick). */
  function rankCalendarHoursMap(){
   var map = Object.create(null);
   rankItems().forEach(function(it){
     if(!it || !it.name) return;
     map[it.name] = rankItemCalendarHours(it.name);
   });
   return map;
  }

  /** Map name → calendar day counts (cached per ensure tick). */
  function rankCalendarDaysMap(){
   var map = Object.create(null);
   rankItems().forEach(function(it){
     if(!it || !it.name) return;
     map[it.name] = rankItemCalendarDays(it.name);
   });
   return map;
  }

  /** Sort T ranks by calendar hours (desc) — like $ → M rank. */
  function syncTimeRankFromCalendar(){
   var hours = rankCalendarHoursMap();
   var items = rankItems().slice().sort(function(a,b){
     var ha = Number(hours[a.name])||0, hb = Number(hours[b.name])||0;
     if(hb !== ha) return hb - ha;
     return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name));
   });
   var namesT = items.map(function(i){ return i.name; });
   var factorsT = namesT.filter(function(n){ return !isRankNonFactor('T', n); });
   var nonsT = namesT.filter(function(n){ return isRankNonFactor('T', n); });
   WB.rankOrders.T = factorsT.concat(nonsT);
   WB._timeHoursCache = hours;
  }

  /** Sort D ranks by calendar day counts (desc) — parallel to T from hours. */
  function syncDaysRankFromCalendar(){
   var days = rankCalendarDaysMap();
   var items = rankItems().slice().sort(function(a,b){
     var da = Number(days[a.name])||0, db = Number(days[b.name])||0;
     if(db !== da) return db - da;
     return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name));
   });
   var namesD = items.map(function(i){ return i.name; });
   var factorsD = namesD.filter(function(n){ return !isRankNonFactor('D', n); });
   var nonsD = namesD.filter(function(n){ return isRankNonFactor('D', n); });
   WB.rankOrders.D = factorsD.concat(nonsD);
   WB._daysCache = days;
  }

  /**
   * Debt-tab urgency for a rank item name (linked expense pay or creditor).
   * Uses duration interest + APR pressure + payoff stress from calcDebt().
   */
  function rankItemDebtUrgency(name){
   if(!name) return 0;
   var lines = [];
   try {
     var D = calcDebt();
     lines = (D && D.lines) ? D.lines : [];
   } catch(_d){ lines = []; }
   var best = 0;
   lines.forEach(function(L){
     if(!L) return;
     var hit = false;
     if(L.creditor && L.creditor === name) hit = true;
     if(!hit && L.fromExpense && L.fromExpense.length){
       for(var i = 0; i < L.fromExpense.length; i++){
         if(L.fromExpense[i] === name){ hit = true; break; }
       }
     }
     if(!hit && L.purpose && String(L.purpose) === name) hit = true;
     if(!hit) return;
     var interest = Number(L.durationApr);
     if(!isFinite(interest)) interest = Number(L.math && L.math.durationApr) || 0;
     var bal = Number(L.balance) || 0;
     var apr = Number(L.aprPct) || 0;
     if(apr > 1) {/* already pct */}
     var u = interest + (apr * 0.01 * bal) / 12;
     if(L.underInterest) u *= 1.75;
     if(L.underMin) u *= 1.25;
     if(L.payoffNever) u *= 2.5;
     else if(L.payoffOver) u *= 1.5;
     else if(L.payoffTerms != null && L.payoffTerms > 0){
       u += Math.min(50, 200 / Math.max(1, Number(L.payoffTerms)));
     }
     if(u > best) best = u;
   });
   return Math.round(best * 100) / 100;
  }

  function rankDebtUrgencyMap(){
   var map = Object.create(null);
   rankItems().forEach(function(it){
     if(!it || !it.name) return;
     map[it.name] = rankItemDebtUrgency(it.name);
   });
   return map;
  }

  /** Sort U ranks from Debt-tab urgency (desc) — like $ → M and calendar → T. */
  function syncDebtRankFromUrgency(){
   var urg = rankDebtUrgencyMap();
   var items = rankItems().slice().sort(function(a,b){
     var ua = Number(urg[a.name])||0, ub = Number(urg[b.name])||0;
     if(ub !== ua) return ub - ua;
     return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name));
   });
   var namesU = items.map(function(i){ return i.name; });
   var factorsU = namesU.filter(function(n){ return !isRankNonFactor('U', n); });
   var nonsU = namesU.filter(function(n){ return isRankNonFactor('U', n); });
   WB.rankOrders.U = factorsU.concat(nonsU);
   WB._debtUrgencyCache = urg;
  }

  /**
   * Per-item surplus/freedom contribution from INCOME + EXPENSES math
   * (same identity as summary: surplus = net − living − debtPays).
   * Income/work → +$; living/debt-pay expenses → −$. Higher = more freedom left.
   */
  function rankItemSurplusContribution(name){
   if(!name) return 0;
   var contrib = 0;
   try {
     (WB.income && WB.income.entitlements || []).forEach(function(it){
       if(it && it.name === name) contrib += Number(lineAmt(it)) || 0;
     });
     (WB.income && WB.income.deductions || []).forEach(function(it){
       if(it && it.name === name) contrib -= Number(lineAmt(it)) || 0;
     });
   } catch(_i){}
   try {
     (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
       (sec.items || []).forEach(function(it){
         if(!it || it.name !== name) return;
         contrib -= Number(lineAmt(it)) || 0;
       });
     });
   } catch(_e){}
   /* Board acts not already counted via sheet name */
   try {
     var acts = rankActsForName(name);
     var sheetHit = contrib !== 0;
     if(!sheetHit){
       acts.forEach(function(a){
         if(!a) return;
         var amt = 0;
         try {
           if(typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') amt = Math.abs(Number(easyActMonthAmount(a)) || 0);
           else amt = Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
         } catch(_a){ amt = 0; }
         if(!(amt > 0)) return;
         if(a.kind === 'work' || a.polarity === 'gain') contrib += amt;
         else contrib -= amt;
       });
     }
   } catch(_b){}
   return Math.round(contrib * 100) / 100;
  }

  function rankSurplusContributionMap(){
   var map = Object.create(null);
   rankItems().forEach(function(it){
     if(!it || !it.name) return;
     map[it.name] = rankItemSurplusContribution(it.name);
   });
   return map;
  }

  /** Sort S from income/expenses surplus contribution (desc). */
  function syncSurplusRankFromSheet(){
   var map = rankSurplusContributionMap();
   var items = rankItems().slice().sort(function(a,b){
     var sa = Number(map[a.name])||0, sb = Number(map[b.name])||0;
     if(sb !== sa) return sb - sa;
     return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name));
   });
   var names = items.map(function(i){ return i.name; });
   var factors = names.filter(function(n){ return !isRankNonFactor('S', n); });
   var nons = names.filter(function(n){ return isRankNonFactor('S', n); });
   WB.rankOrders.S = factors.concat(nons);
   WB._surplusContribCache = map;
  }

  /**
   * After drag on M: distribute money pool by harmonic ranks into projected $.
   * Pool = current sum of projected costs (preserve total living $).
   */
  function applyMoneyRanksToValues(){
   var order = WB.rankOrders.M || [];
   if(!order.length) return;
   var sheet = expenseSheetNameSet();
   var byName = Object.create(null);
   rankItems().forEach(function(it){ if(it && it.name) byName[it.name] = it; });
   // Harmonic pool only across expense spend factors — skip Work / board-only / gain
   var targets = order.filter(function(name){
     if(!sheet[name]) return false;
     if(isRankMoneyGain(byName[name])) return false;
     return true;
   });
   // inverted: drag #1 among spend targets gets least $ (money is a cost)
   var shares = harmonicShares(targets.length ? targets : order.filter(function(n){ return !!sheet[n]; }), true);
   var pool = 0;
   expenseItems().forEach(function(it){
     if(isRankMoneyGain(byName[it.name])) return;
     pool += Number(it.cost)||0;
   });
   if(pool <= 0){
    var h = calcHdame();
    pool = h.net || h.netProjected || 1000;
   }
   (targets.length ? targets : Object.keys(shares)).forEach(function(name){
     if(!sheet[name] || isRankMoneyGain(byName[name])) return;
     var sh = shares[name] || 0;
     var dollars = Math.round(sh * pool * 100) / 100;
     setExpenseCost(name, dollars);
   });
   WB.moneyMode = 'ranks';
  }

  function setExpenseCost(name, dollars){
   (WB.expenses.sections||[]).forEach(function(sec){
    (sec.items||[]).forEach(function(it){
     if(it.name === name){
      it.current = dollars;
      // clear legacy projected so lineAmt stays current-only
      if(it.projected != null) it.projected = dollars;
     }
    });
   });
  }
  function setExpenseProjected(name, dollars){ setExpenseCost(name, dollars); }

  /**
   * Harmonic 0–1 weights from drag order.
   * invert=true (A, E, M ranks): list #1 → effective rank n → smallest share
   *  (negative / cost dims — top of list is “worst / most costly to minimize share”).
   * invert=false (H, D): list #1 → rank 1 → largest share.
   */
  function harmonicShares(order, invert){
   var n = order.length;
   if(!n) return {};
   var sumW=0, weights={};
   order.forEach(function(name,i){
    var pos = i + 1; // drag position
    var r = invert ? Math.max(1, n - pos + 1) : pos;
    var w = 1 / r;
    weights[name] = w;
    sumW += w;
   });
   var shares={};
   order.forEach(function(name){
    shares[name] = sumW > 0 ? weights[name] / sumW : 0;
   });
   return shares;
  }

  /** Default factor-vs-factor order: happy & money matter more, then days/time/surplus… */
  var DEFAULT_FACTOR_ORDER = ['H','M','D','T','S','U','A','E'];

  /**
   * WB.factorOrder — drag order of score dims (H,D,A,M,E,T,U,S + customs).
   * #1 factor = most important → largest harmonic weight in composite.
   */
  function ensureFactorOrder(){
   var dims = allRankDims();
   var dimSet = {};
   dims.forEach(function(d){ dimSet[d] = 1; });
   var order = Array.isArray(WB.factorOrder) ? WB.factorOrder.slice() : [];
   order = order.filter(function(d){ return !!dimSet[d]; });
   var present = {};
   order.forEach(function(d){ present[d] = 1; });
   if(!order.length){
    DEFAULT_FACTOR_ORDER.forEach(function(d){
     if(dimSet[d] && !present[d]){ order.push(d); present[d] = 1; }
    });
   }
   dims.forEach(function(d){
    if(!present[d]){ order.push(d); present[d] = 1; }
   });
   WB.factorOrder = order;
   return order;
  }

  /** Harmonic weights from factorOrder → { H:w, M:w, … } summing to 1. */
  function factorWeights(){
   ensureFactorOrder();
   return harmonicShares(WB.factorOrder, false);
  }

  /**
   * Factor-vs-factor importance UI.
   * mode 'full' (PREVIEW) | 'compact' (RANKS mirror) | 'modeltools' (MODEL TOOLS authoring).
   * listId distinguishes drag targets when both appear.
   * All modes write the same SoT: WB.factorOrder.
   */
  function renderFactorImportanceHtml(mode){
   mode = mode || 'full';
   ensureFactorOrder();
   var fw = factorWeights();
   var listId = mode === 'compact' ? 'factor-order-list-ranks'
     : (mode === 'modeltools' ? 'factor-order-list-mt' : 'factor-order-list');
   var wrapClass = 'factor-importance' + (mode === 'compact' ? ' factor-importance-compact'
     : (mode === 'modeltools' ? ' factor-importance-mt' : ' factor-importance-full'));
   var wrapId = mode === 'compact' ? 'factor-importance-ranks'
     : (mode === 'modeltools' ? 'factor-importance-mt' : 'factor-importance');
   var html = '';
   html += '<div class="'+wrapClass+'" id="'+wrapId+'">';
   if(mode === 'compact'){
     html += '<h3 class="section-h" style="margin-top:0">Factor importance <span class="cm">(mirror)</span></h3>';
     html += '<p class="hint">Compact mirror — edit on <b>PREVIEW</b> or <b>MODEL TOOLS</b>. Drag here still updates composite weights.</p>';
   } else if(mode === 'modeltools'){
     html += '<h3 class="section-h" style="margin-top:0">Score factors <span class="cm">(author)</span></h3>';
     html += '<p class="hint"><b>MODEL TOOLS</b> authors the factor-vs-factor model (same SoT as PREVIEW/RANKS). '
       + 'Drag to set composite weights → <code>WB.factorOrder</code>. Click a row to edit that factor\'s model. Harmonic % from order.</p>';
   } else {
     html += '<h3 class="section-h" style="margin-top:0">Factor importance</h3>';
     html += '<p class="hint"><b>Model:</b> how H / M / D / … weigh against each other in the composite / PREVIEW total. '
       + 'Higher = this factor counts more. Money ≠ Happy — rank them. Harmonic % from drag order. '
       + 'Also authored on <b>MODEL TOOLS</b> (same <code>WB.factorOrder</code>).</p>';
   }
   html += '<ul class="rank-list factor-order-list" id="'+listId+'">';
   (WB.factorOrder || []).forEach(function(fd, fi){
     var wPct = scorePct(fw[fd] || 0);
     var sel = (mode === 'modeltools' && typeof _mtFactorDim !== 'undefined' && _mtFactorDim === fd);
     html += '<li class="rank-item factor-order-item'+(sel?' selected':'')+'" draggable="true" data-factor-dim="'+String(fd).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'"'
      +(sel?' style="outline:1px solid var(--edit);background:rgba(126,200,255,.08)"':'')+'>'+
      '<span class="rn">'+(fi+1)+'</span>'+
      '<span class="nm">'+esc(fd)+' · '+esc(rankDimLabel(fd))+(rankDimInverted(fd)?' ↓':'')+'</span>'+
      '<span class="sc" title="Harmonic weight in composite">'+wPct+'</span>'+
      '</li>';
   });
   html += '</ul>';
   html += '</div>';
   return html;
  }

  function effectiveRank(order, name, invert){
   var n = order.length;
   var pos = order.indexOf(name);
   if(pos < 0) return n || 1;
   var p = pos + 1;
   return invert ? Math.max(1, n - p + 1) : p;
  }

  // Negative / cost dimensions: invert harmonic weight from drag order
  var INVERT_DIMS = { A: true, E: true, M: true };

  /**
   * Rank scores from RANKS UI order (expense items with $ only).
   * H/D: top of list → biggest share.
   * A/E/M: top of list → smallest share (inverted — age/external/spend are “bad”).
   * M values mode: score = actual $ share of total (not inverted ranks).
   */
  function calcRanks(){
   ensureRankState();
   var h=calcHdame();
   var items=rankItems();

   var shareH=harmonicShares(activeRankOrder('H'), false);
   var shareD=harmonicShares(activeRankOrder('D'), false);
   var shareT=harmonicShares(activeRankOrder('T'), false); // Time/calendar
   var shareU=harmonicShares(activeRankOrder('U'), false); // Debt/urgency
   var shareS=harmonicShares(activeRankOrder('S'), false); // Surplus/freedom
   var shareA=harmonicShares(activeRankOrder('A'), true); // age — inverted
   var shareE=harmonicShares(activeRankOrder('E'), true); // external — inverted

   // Money is always a cost dim (inverted):
   // - values mode: order already sorted high $ → top (syncMoneyRankFromValues);
   //  inverted harmonic → higher $ = worse = smaller score share
   // - ranks mode: drag #1 → least $ allocation (also inverted)
   var shareM = harmonicShares(activeRankOrder('M'), true);

   var monthlyH=h.H/Math.max(h.months,1);
   var monthlyD=h.D/Math.max(h.months,1);
   var monthlyE=h.E/Math.max(h.months,1);

   var world = {
    monthsTotal: h.months,
    monthIndex: 0,
    M: (function(){ try { return calcIncome().net; } catch(_e){ return 1000; } })(),
    E: h.ePerMonth,
    Emax: h.ePerMonth,
    discountRate: (WB.hdame && WB.hdame.discountRate != null) ? WB.hdame.discountRate : 0.04
   };

   var out=items.map(function(it){
    var sH=isRankNonFactor('H', it.name) ? 0 : (shareH[it.name]||0);
    var sD=isRankNonFactor('D', it.name) ? 0 : (shareD[it.name]||0);
    var sT=isRankNonFactor('T', it.name) ? 0 : (shareT[it.name]||0);
    var sU=isRankNonFactor('U', it.name) ? 0 : (shareU[it.name]||0);
    var sS=isRankNonFactor('S', it.name) ? 0 : (shareS[it.name]||0);
    var sA=isRankNonFactor('A', it.name) ? 0 : (shareA[it.name]||0);
    var sM=isRankNonFactor('M', it.name) ? 0 : (shareM[it.name]||0);
    var sE=isRankNonFactor('E', it.name) ? 0 : (shareE[it.name]||0);
    var row = {
     name: it.name,
     cost: it.cost,
     scoreH: sH, scoreD: sD, scoreT: sT, scoreU: sU, scoreS: sS, scoreA: sA, scoreM: sM, scoreE: sE,
     H: monthlyH*sH,
     D: monthlyD*sD,
     T: sT,
     U: sU,
     S: sS,
     A: sA,
     M: it.cost,
     E: monthlyE*sE,
     rankH: isRankNonFactor('H', it.name) ? null : effectiveRank(activeRankOrder('H'), it.name, false),
     rankD: isRankNonFactor('D', it.name) ? null : effectiveRank(activeRankOrder('D'), it.name, false),
     rankT: isRankNonFactor('T', it.name) ? null : effectiveRank(activeRankOrder('T'), it.name, false),
     rankU: isRankNonFactor('U', it.name) ? null : effectiveRank(activeRankOrder('U'), it.name, false),
     rankS: isRankNonFactor('S', it.name) ? null : effectiveRank(activeRankOrder('S'), it.name, false),
     rankA: isRankNonFactor('A', it.name) ? null : effectiveRank(activeRankOrder('A'), it.name, true),
     rankM: isRankNonFactor('M', it.name) ? null : effectiveRank(activeRankOrder('M'), it.name, true),
     rankE: isRankNonFactor('E', it.name) ? null : effectiveRank(activeRankOrder('E'), it.name, true),
     moneyMode: WB.moneyMode,
     fromBoard: !!it.fromBoard,
     fromExpense: !!it.fromExpense,
     kind: it.kind || null,
     polarity: it.polarity || null,
     incomeAmt: Number(it.incomeAmt) || 0
    };
    // custom score factors
    allRankDims().forEach(function(d){
      if(d === 'H' || d === 'D' || d === 'A' || d === 'M' || d === 'E' || d === 'T' || d === 'U' || d === 'S') return;
      var inv = rankDimInverted(d);
      var sh = harmonicShares(activeRankOrder(d), inv);
      var s = isRankNonFactor(d, it.name) ? 0 : (sh[it.name] || 0);
      row['score'+d] = s;
      row[d] = s;
      row['rank'+d] = isRankNonFactor(d, it.name) ? null : effectiveRank(activeRankOrder(d), it.name, inv);
    });
    // Factor-vs-factor composite: Σ weight[d] * itemScoreShare[d]
    // (source of truth — Money ≠ Happy; factorOrder sets relative importance)
    var fw = factorWeights();
    var scoreRaw = 0;
    var usedFactorW = false;
    (WB.factorOrder || []).forEach(function(d){
      var w = Number(fw[d]) || 0;
      if(!(w > 0)) return;
      usedFactorW = true;
      var s = Number(row['score' + d]);
      if(!isFinite(s)) s = 0;
      scoreRaw += w * s;
    });
    if(usedFactorW){
     row.scoreRaw = scoreRaw;
     row.factorWeights = fw;
    } else if(JFAC && JFAC.compositeItemScore){
     row.scoreRaw = JFAC.compositeItemScore(row, world, fw);
    } else {
     row.scoreRaw = sH;
    }
    return row;
   });
   // normalize composite to 0–1 shares for % display
   var sumRaw = 0;
   out.forEach(function(it){ sumRaw += Math.max(0, it.scoreRaw||0); });
   out.forEach(function(it){
    it.score = sumRaw > 0 ? Math.max(0, it.scoreRaw||0) / sumRaw : 0;
   });
   var map={};
   out.forEach(function(it){ map[it.name]=it; });
   return { items:out, hdame:h, byName:map, orders:WB.rankOrders, moneyMode: WB.moneyMode, world: world };
  }

  /** 0–1 share → percent with 0.001 precision (e.g. 12.345%). */
  function scorePct(s){
   s=Number(s)||0;
   if(s<0) s=0;
   if(s>1) s=1;
   return (s*100).toFixed(3)+'%';
  }

  function fullCalc(){
   return {
    income: calcIncome(),
    expenses: calcExpenses(),
    debt: calcDebt(),
    assets: calcAssets(),
    summary: calcSummary(),
    hdame: calcHdame(),
    ranks: calcRanks()
   };
  }

  /* ========== RENDER ========== */

   // legacy: HDAME/JOYS → PREVIEW (score debug for Board selection)
   if(activeTab === 'HDAME' || activeTab === 'JOYS') activeTab = 'PREVIEW';

    return '<div class="tab'+(t===activeTab?' active':'')+'" data-tab="'+t+'">'+t+'</div>';
   }).join('') + asofCtlHtml();

  }

  function renderKpis(){
   var C=fullCalc();
   var cal=(lastBest&&lastBest.calendar)||{gain:0,living:0,debt:0,surplus:0};
   var sur=Number(cal.surplus)||0;
   var gain=Number(cal.gain)||0;
   var spend=(Number(cal.living)||0)+(Number(cal.debt)||0);
   var b=lastBest&&lastBest.ok?lastBest.stocks:{};
   $('kpis').innerHTML=
    kpi('Surplus', money(sur,'auto'), (function(){ var f=(lastBest&&lastBest.calendar&&lastBest.calendar.y!=null)?{y:lastBest.calendar.y,m:lastBest.calendar.m}:(typeof easyFocusMonth==='function'?easyFocusMonth():null); var lab=f?(f.y+'-'+((f.m|0)+1<10?'0':'')+((f.m|0)+1)):'month'; return lab+' · '+(lastBest&&lastBest.path?lastBest.path:'run')+' n='+(lastBest&&lastBest.n!=null?lastBest.n:0); })())+
    kpi('DTI', pct(C.summary.dti), 'due÷gross · sheet')+
    kpi('NET', money(gain,'gain'), 'cal income')+
    kpi('Living', money(spend,'spend'), 'cal spend')+
    kpi('run() H', b.H!=null?Number(b.H).toFixed(2):'—', lastBest&&lastBest.ok?(lastBest.ms+'ms'):'—')+
    kpi('run() M', b.M!=null?Number(b.M).toFixed(2):'—', 'after run()')+
    kpi('Rank items', String(C.ranks.items.length), 'from EXPENSES')+
    kpi('Net worth', money(C.assets.netWorth,'auto'), 'assets−liab');
   try { asofKpis(); } catch(eK){ if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.warn('asofKpis', eK); }
  }
  function kpi(l,n,s){return '<div class="kpi"><div class="lbl">'+l+'</div><div class="num">'+n+'</div><div class="lbl" style="margin-top:3px">'+s+'</div></div>';}

  function inp(path, val, wide){
   return '<input data-path="'+path+'" type="number" step="any" value="'+(Number(val)||0)+'"'+(wide?' style="max-width:none"':'')+' />';
  }
  function textInp(path, val){
   return '<input data-path="'+path+'" type="text" value="'+String(val||'').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" style="max-width:none;text-align:left" />';
  }

  function bindInputs(root){
   root.querySelectorAll('input[data-path]').forEach(function(el){
    var apply=function(){
     setPath(el.getAttribute('data-path'), el.type==='number' ? (parseFloat(el.value)||0) : el.value);
     renderAll();
     try { if(window.JWorkbookMoho&&JWorkbookMoho.moneySpark) JWorkbookMoho.moneySpark(); } catch(_m){}
    };
    el.addEventListener('change', apply);
    if(el.type==='number'){
     el.addEventListener('input', function(){
      setPath(el.getAttribute('data-path'), parseFloat(el.value)||0);
      scheduleLiveBest();
      softUpdateExpenseScores();
      renderTabs();
     });
    }
   });
   root.querySelectorAll('select[data-path]').forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener('change', function(){
     var v = el.value;
     if(v === '') setPath(el.getAttribute('data-path'), null);
     else setPath(el.getAttribute('data-path'), parseInt(v, 10));
     renderAll();
     showStatus(v===''?'Living expense':'Linked as debt payment','ok');
    });
   });
   root.querySelectorAll('[data-del]').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick=function(){
     delPath(btn.getAttribute('data-del'));
     renderAll();
    };
   });
  }

  function setPath(path, val){
   // path like income.entitlements.0.current
   var parts=path.split('.');
   var o=WB;
   for(var i=0;i<parts.length-1;i++){
    var p=parts[i];
    if(/^\d+$/.test(p)) p=parseInt(p,10);
    o=o[p];
   }
   var last=parts[parts.length-1];
   o[last]=val;
   // editing expense $ → money ranks follow values (old ranking_ui)
   if(/expenses\.sections\.\d+\.items\.\d+\.(current|projected|review)/.test(path)){
    WB.moneyMode = 'values';
    // Keep calendar placements; only refresh amountMonthly on matching acts.
    try {
      var m = path.match(/expenses\.sections\.(\d+)\.items\.(\d+)\./);
      if(m){
        var sec = (WB.expenses.sections || [])[parseInt(m[1],10)];
        var row = sec && (sec.items || [])[parseInt(m[2],10)];
        var nm = row && row.name;
        if(nm && WB.calendars){
          ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){
            var bag = WB.calendars[sc];
            if(!bag || !bag.customActions) return;
            bag.customActions.forEach(function(a){
              if(!a) return;
              if(a.expenseName === nm || a.name === nm){
                var amt = (typeof lineAmt === 'function') ? Math.abs(Number(lineAmt(row, sc))||0) : Math.abs(Number(val)||0);
                a.amountMonthly = amt;
              }
            });
          });
          try { if(typeof invalidateCalendarCache === 'function') invalidateCalendarCache(); } catch(_ic){}
        }
      }
    } catch(_sync){}
   }
   // clear payDebt when set to null
   if(last === 'payDebt' && (val === null || val === '')){
    o.payDebt = null;
   }
  }
  function delPath(path){
   var parts=path.split('.');
   var o=WB;
   for(var i=0;i<parts.length-1;i++){
    var p=parts[i];
    if(/^\d+$/.test(p)) p=parseInt(p,10);
    o=o[p];
   }
   var last=parts[parts.length-1];
   if(Array.isArray(o)) o.splice(parseInt(last,10),1);
   else delete o[last];
  }

  function softUpdateExpenseScores(){
   if(activeTab!=='EXPENSES') return;
   var R=calcRanks();
   var C=calcExpenses();
   var pane=$('pane');
   if(!pane) return;
   pane.querySelectorAll('table.grid tbody tr').forEach(function(tr){
    var nameInp=tr.querySelector('input[data-path*=".name"]');
    if(!nameInp) return;

    if(!sc) return;
    var it=null;
    (C.sections||[]).forEach(function(sec){
     (sec.items||[]).forEach(function(row){ if(row.name===nameInp.value) it=row; });
    });
    sc.innerHTML=it && lineAmt(it)>0 ? expenseTabScoreHtml(it, R, C) : '—';
   });
  }

    '</div>';
