  function expenseTabWeight(it, R){
   if(!it || !(lineAmt(it) > 0)) return 0;
   var rk = R && R.byName && R.byName[it.name];
   var w = 0;
   if(rk){
    if(rk.scoreRaw != null && isFinite(Number(rk.scoreRaw))) w = Math.max(0, Number(rk.scoreRaw)||0);
    else w = Math.max(0, Number(rk.score)||0);
   }
   if(!(w > 0)) w = lineAmt(it);
   return w;
  }
  function expenseTabExtremes(R, C){
   var maxW = 0, maxC = 0;
   (C && C.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
    (sec.items || []).forEach(function(row){
     var w = expenseTabWeight(row, R);
     var c = lineAmt(row);
     if(w > maxW) maxW = w;
     if(c > maxC) maxC = c;
    });
   });
   return { maxW: maxW, maxC: maxC };
  }
  /** 0–800 value vs 0–100 spend. Best value row = 800. Diff = value100 − spend100. */
  function expenseTabScoreHtml(it, R, C){
   if(!it || !(lineAmt(it) > 0)) return '—';
   var ext = expenseTabExtremes(R, C);
   if(!(ext.maxW > 0)) return '—';
   var mine = expenseTabWeight(it, R);
   var n = Math.round(800 * (mine / ext.maxW));
   if(n < 0) n = 0;
   if(n > 800) n = 800;
   var value100 = 100 * (mine / ext.maxW);
   var spend100 = ext.maxC > 0 ? 100 * (lineAmt(it) / ext.maxC) : 0;
   var diff = value100 - spend100;
   var sign = diff > 0.05 ? '+' : (diff < -0.05 ? '−' : '');
   var abs = Math.abs(diff);
   var shown = (abs >= 10 ? abs.toFixed(0) : abs.toFixed(1)) + '%';
   if(Math.abs(diff) < 0.05){ sign = ''; shown = '0%'; }
   var cls = diff > 0.05 ? 'm-gain' : (diff < -0.05 ? 'm-spend' : '');
   var tip = 'value '+value100.toFixed(0)+' − spend '+spend100.toFixed(0)+' on 0–100';
   return n+' <span class="'+cls+'" title="'+esc(tip)+'">'+sign+shown+'</span>';
  }
  function expenseTabRelPct(it, R, C){
   return expenseTabScoreHtml(it, R, C);
  }

  /* ===== easy215 Redundancy + jreq (staged) =====
   * WB.redundancy = { version:2, items:{ <uid>: { name, virtual?, start?, seq?, req?:[ref], alts:[Alt] } } }
   * Alt = { key, label, amount, cadence, start?, trigger, value(0-800), available, unavailReason, unavailDate, req?:[ref], children:[Alt] }
   * ref = 'uid' (item must have a resolved winner) | 'uid.KEY' (that alt — or a child of it — must be the winner).
   * jreq mirrors vendor/JFactor_exp6.js:
   *  - JAction.Validate / JGroup.Validate: ready iff jreq==null OR the required action is in the chosen option set.
   *    Here the chosen set = resolved winners; unready => -Number.MAX_VALUE (same as atomic fail / jfBatchScore skip).
   *  - JGroup.Consider: a child with jreq==null inherits the parent's jreq  -> leaf alts inherit parent-alt / item req.
   *  - Blueprint chain: each sequence instance's jreq = previous sequence member -> items with `seq` implicitly
   *    require the item with the next-lower seq.
   * Resolution: topological over refs (cycle members fail, flagged), per level cheap argmax (jfArgmaxJGroup), no SimulatedBest.
   * Totals: CURRENT always = pinned bank actual (it.current). PROJECTED/REVIEW use the jreq-resolved winner; if it fails,
   * fall back to the base line. Virtual items (milestones) never enter totals. lineAmt is month-agnostic, so dated
   * alternatives (start) are shown on the timeline / month strip only, not in today's totals. */
  var RD_OPEN = {}, RD_CACHE = null;
  function rdItems(){ return (WB && WB.redundancy && WB.redundancy.items) || {}; }
  function rdEntry(it){
   if(!it || !it.uid) return null;
   var e = rdItems()[it.uid];
   return (e && e.alts && e.alts.length) ? e : null;
  }
  function rdLeafAmt(a){ return Number(a && a.amount) || 0; }
  /* easy218: per-line end dates. normal amt before finalMonth; finalAmount in finalMonth; prorated in endDate month (no finalMonth); [REDACTED-AMOUNT] after endDate's month */
  function rdEndAmt(o, ym, base){
   if(!o || !o.endDate) return base;
   var em = String(o.endDate).slice(0,7);
   if(o.finalMonth && ym === o.finalMonth) return Number(o.finalAmount) || 0;
   if(ym > em || (o.finalMonth && ym > o.finalMonth)) return Number(o.afterEnd) || 0;
   if(ym === em && !o.finalMonth){ var p = String(o.endDate).split('-'), y=+p[0], mo=+p[1], d=+p[2]||1; var dim = new Date(y, mo, 0).getDate(); return Math.round(base*(d-1)/dim*100)/100; }
   return base;
  }
  function rdScore(a, maxAmt){
   var v = (a.value != null ? Number(a.value) : 400) / 8;
   var s = maxAmt > 0 ? rdLeafAmt(a) / maxAmt * 100 : 0;
   return Math.round((v - s) * 10) / 10;
  }
  function rdMaxAmt(alts){
   var m = 0;
   (alts||[]).forEach(function(a){ m = Math.max(m, rdLeafAmt(a), rdMaxAmt(a.children)); });
   return m;
  }
  function rdFind(alts, key){
   for(var i=0;i<(alts||[]).length;i++){ if(alts[i].key===key) return alts[i]; var c=rdFind(alts[i].children,key); if(c) return c; }
   return null;
  }
  function rdItemReqs(uid){
   // item req + implicit chain req from seq (Blueprint chain: jreq = previous sequence member)
   var items = rdItems(), e = items[uid], out = (e.req||[]).slice();
   if(e.seq != null){
    var prev = null;
    Object.keys(items).forEach(function(k){ var o=items[k]; if(o.seq!=null && o.seq<e.seq && (!prev || o.seq>items[prev].seq)) prev=k; });
    if(prev && out.indexOf(prev) < 0 && !out.some(function(r){ return r.split('.')[0]===prev; })) out.push(prev);
   }
   return out;
  }
  function rdAllRefs(uid){
   var out = rdItemReqs(uid).slice();
   (function walk(alts){ (alts||[]).forEach(function(a){ (a.req||[]).forEach(function(r){ if(out.indexOf(r)<0) out.push(r); }); walk(a.children); }); })(rdItems()[uid].alts);
   return out;
  }
  function rdRefOk(ref, R){
   var p = String(ref).split('.'), r = R[p[0]];
   if(!r || !r.winner) return false;
   if(p.length < 2) return true;
   return r.winner.key === p[1] || r.top === p[1] || String(r.winner.key).indexOf(p[1]) === 0;
  }
  function rdResolve(sc){
   sc = normalizeSc(sc || activeSc());
   if(RD_CACHE && RD_CACHE.sc === sc) return RD_CACHE.R;
   var items = rdItems(), uids = Object.keys(items), R = {}, state = {}, order = [];
   // topo + cycle detection (DFS colors)
   function visit(u, stack){
    if(state[u] === 2) return;
    if(state[u] === 1){ var i = stack.indexOf(u); stack.slice(i).forEach(function(c){ (R[c]=R[c]||{}).cycle = stack.slice(i).concat(u); }); return; }
    if(!items[u]) return;
    state[u] = 1; stack.push(u);
    rdAllRefs(u).forEach(function(ref){ visit(ref.split('.')[0], stack); });
    stack.pop(); state[u] = 2; order.push(u);
   }
   uids.forEach(function(u){ visit(u, []); });
   var argmax = (typeof jfArgmaxJGroup === 'function') ? jfArgmaxJGroup : function(gr, skip){
    var best=null, bs=-Infinity; gr.jgroup.forEach(function(a){ if(skip&&skip(a)) return; var s=a.jmethod(); if(s>bs){bs=s;best=a;} }); return { action:best, score:bs };
   };
   order.forEach(function(u){
    var e = items[u], rr = R[u] = R[u] || {}, maxAmt = rdMaxAmt(e.alts);
    rr.fail = {}; // key -> [unmet refs]
    if(rr.cycle){ rr.winner = null; return; }
    var itemReq = rdItemReqs(u);
    function level(alts, inheritReq){
     var acts = (alts||[]).map(function(a){
      var req = (a.req && a.req.length) ? a.req.concat(inheritReq) : inheritReq; // Consider(): child inherits jreq
      var unmet = req.filter(function(ref){ return !rdRefOk(ref, R); });
      if(unmet.length) rr.fail[a.key] = unmet;
      var leaf = a, sc2;
      if(a.children && a.children.length){ var sub = level(a.children, req); leaf = sub.alt; sc2 = sub.alt ? sub.score : -Number.MAX_VALUE; }
      else sc2 = rdScore(a, maxAmt);
      var quota = (a.available === false || unmet.length || !leaf) ? 0 : 1;   // Quota.Limit(0) / Validate fail
      return { alt:a, leaf:leaf, jmax:quota, jmethod:function(){ return quota>0 ? sc2 : -Number.MAX_VALUE; } };
     });
     var r = argmax({ jgroup: acts }, function(x){ return x.jmax === 0; });
     if(!r.action || r.score <= -Number.MAX_VALUE) return { alt:null, score:-Number.MAX_VALUE };
     return { alt:r.action.leaf, top:r.action.alt.key, score:r.score };
    }
    var res = level(e.alts, itemReq);
    rr.winner = res.alt; rr.top = res.top; rr.score = res.score; rr.req = itemReq;
   });
   RD_CACHE = { sc: sc, R: R };
   return R;
  }
  function rdDirty(){ RD_CACHE = null; }
  function rdWinner(it, sc){
   var e = rdEntry(it); if(!e) return null;
   sc = normalizeSc(sc || activeSc());
   var r = rdResolve(sc)[it.uid] || {};
   if(sc === 'current') return { pinned:true, amount:Number(it.current)||0, label:'Bank actual (pinned)', key:'★', plan:r.winner, cycle:r.cycle };
   if(!r.winner) return null; // failing (prereq / all unavailable / cycle) -> base line
   return { pinned:false, amount:rdLeafAmt(r.winner), label:r.winner.label, key:r.winner.key, score:r.score };
  }
  function rdNeededBy(uid){
   var items = rdItems(), out = [];
   Object.keys(items).forEach(function(k){ if(k!==uid && rdAllRefs(k).some(function(r){ return r.split('.')[0]===uid; })) out.push(items[k].name||k); });
   return out;
  }
  function rdChainHtml(uid, refs){
   var items = rdItems(), R = rdResolve();
   if(!refs || !refs.length) return '';
   var seen = {};
   function chain(ref, depth){
    if(depth > 6) return '…';
    var u = ref.split('.')[0], ok = rdRefOk(ref, R), e = items[u];
    var lab = (e ? e.name : u) + (ref.indexOf('.')>0 ? ' ('+ref.split('.')[1]+')' : '');
    var s = '<span style="color:'+(ok?'#22c55e':'#ef4444')+'">'+(ok?'✓ ':'✖ ')+esc(lab)+'</span>';
    if(e && !seen[u]){ seen[u]=1; var nxt = rdItemReqs(u); if(nxt.length) s += ' → ' + nxt.map(function(n){ return chain(n, depth+1); }).join(' + '); }
    return s;
   }
   return refs.map(function(r){ return chain(r, 0); }).join(' + ');
  }
  function rdReqLine(uid){
   var R = rdResolve(), r = R[uid] || {}, h = '';
   var c = rdChainHtml(uid, rdItemReqs(uid));
   if(r.cycle) h += '<div class="calc" style="font-size:10px;color:#ef4444">⟳ cycle: '+esc(r.cycle.map(function(u){ return (rdItems()[u]||{}).name||u; }).join(' → '))+'</div>';
   if(c) h += '<div class="calc" style="font-size:10px">Requires: '+c+'</div>';
   var nb = rdNeededBy(uid);
   if(nb.length) h += '<div class="calc" style="font-size:10px;opacity:.8">Needed by: '+esc(nb.join(', '))+'</div>';
   return h;
  }
  function rdNewUid(){ return 'exp-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7); }
  function rdAltRows(uid, alts, depth, winKey, base, maxAmt){
   var h = '', rr = rdResolve()[uid] || {};
   (alts||[]).forEach(function(a){
    var off = a.available === false, unmet = rr.fail && rr.fail[a.key];
    var isWin = winKey === a.key;
    var hasKids = a.children && a.children.length;
    var amt = rdLeafAmt(a), impact = base - amt;
    var st = (off||unmet) ? 'text-decoration:line-through;opacity:.55' : '';
    h += '<tr class="rd-alt" style="'+(isWin?'background:rgba(34,197,94,.08)':(unmet&&!off?'background:rgba(239,68,68,.06)':''))+'">'+
     '<td class="name" style="padding-left:'+(18+depth*16)+'px"><span style="'+st+'"><b>'+esc(a.key)+'</b> · '+esc(rdTok(a.label||''))+'</span>'+
      (isWin?' <span class="calc" style="color:#22c55e">✓ plan winner</span>':'')+
      (a.start?'<span class="calc" style="font-size:10px;opacity:.8"> · from '+esc(a.start)+'</span>':'')+
      (a.trigger?'<div class="calc" style="font-size:10px;opacity:.8">trigger: '+esc(a.trigger)+'</div>':'')+
      ((a.req&&a.req.length)?'<div class="calc" style="font-size:10px">Requires: '+rdChainHtml(uid, a.req)+'</div>':'')+
      (unmet&&!off?'<div class="calc" style="font-size:10px;color:#ef4444">blocked · jreq unmet → −MAX ('+esc(unmet.join(', '))+')</div>':'')+
      (off?'<div class="calc" style="font-size:10px;color:#ef4444">unavailable · quota 0'+(a.unavailReason?' · '+esc(a.unavailReason):'')+(a.unavailDate?' · '+esc(a.unavailDate):'')+'</div>':'')+
     '</td>'+
     '<td class="calc" style="'+st+'">'+(hasKids?'<span style="opacity:.6">see '+esc(a.key)+'1…</span>':money(amt,'spend'))+
      '<div style="font-size:10px;opacity:.75">'+esc(a.cadence||'monthly')+'</div></td>'+
     '<td class="calc" style="font-size:11px">'+(hasKids?'':('surplus '+(impact>=0?'+':'−')+'$'+Math.abs(impact).toFixed(2)))+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+(hasKids?'':'<b>'+((off||unmet)?'−MAX':rdScore(a,maxAmt))+'</b>')+'</td>'+
     '<td><button class="btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px" data-rd-avail="'+esc(uid)+'|'+esc(a.key)+'">'+(off?'Restore':'Unavail.')+'</button></td></tr>';
    if(hasKids) h += rdAltRows(uid, a.children, depth+1, winKey, base, maxAmt);
   });
   return h;
  }
  function rdBlock(it, si, ii){
   var e = rdEntry(it), sc = activeSc();
   var key = it.uid || ('p'+si+'.'+ii), open = !!RD_OPEN[key];
   var tog = '<button class="btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:1px 6px;margin-right:4px" data-rd-open="'+esc(key)+'">'+(open?'▾':'▸')+'</button>';
   if(!e){
    var sub = open ? '<tr class="rd-alt"><td class="name" style="padding-left:18px"><b>Plan A</b> · this line ('+money(lineAmt(it),'spend')+')</td><td colspan="3" class="calc" style="font-size:11px;opacity:.7">no alternatives yet</td>'+
     '<td><button class="btn btn-ok" style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px" data-rd-add="'+si+'.'+ii+'">+ alternative</button></td></tr>' : '';
    return { tog:tog, sub:sub, win:null };
   }
   var win = rdWinner(it, sc), R = rdResolve(sc), rr = R[it.uid] || {}, maxAmt = rdMaxAmt(e.alts);
   var plan = rr.winner;
   var base = Number(sc==='current' ? it.current : (it[sc]!=null&&it[sc]!==''?it[sc]:it.projected)) || 0;
   var planTxt = plan ? 'plan <b>'+esc(plan.key)+'</b> · '+esc(plan.label)+(plan.start?' (from '+esc(plan.start)+')':'') : '<span style="color:#ef4444">plan blocked → fallback base line</span>';
   var tag = '<span class="calc" style="font-size:10px">'+(sc==='current' ? '★ pinned bank-actual today · ' : (win?'winner · ':''))+planTxt+'</span>' + rdReqLine(it.uid);
   var sub = '';
   if(open){
    if(sc==='current') sub += '<tr class="rd-alt" style="background:rgba(56,189,248,.08)"><td class="name" style="padding-left:18px"><b>★</b> · Bank actual (pinned, today\'s totals)</td><td class="calc">'+money(Number(it.current)||0,'spend')+'</td><td class="calc" style="font-size:11px">alternatives = future / backups</td><td></td><td></td></tr>';
    sub += rdAltRows(it.uid, e.alts, 0, plan && plan.key, base, maxAmt);
    sub += '<tr class="rd-alt"><td colspan="4"></td><td><button class="btn btn-ok" style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px" data-rd-add="'+si+'.'+ii+'">+ alternative</button></td></tr>';
   }
   return { tog:tog, sub:sub, win:win, tag:tag };
  }

  /* easy219 (staged): CASH AFTER column — running checking balance per jreq step. Plain arithmetic, once per render. */
  var RD_CASH_DEFAULT = { start:677.51, asOf: '[REDACTED-DATE]', src:'[REDACTED-INSTITUTION] checking [REDACTED-ACCOUNT-MASK] available [REDACTED-AMOUNT] − [REDACTED-INSTITUTION] card [REDACTED-ACCOUNT-MASK] [REDACTED-AMOUNT]', firstMonth:'2026-11', e4BaseNew:3482.40, e4Src:'DFAS 2026 enlisted basic pay table (eff. 2026-01-01): [REDACTED-PAY-GRADE] over 3 yrs [REDACTED-AMOUNT] vs [REDACTED-PAY-GRADE] over 2 [REDACTED-AMOUNT] (2027 table unpublished)', e4SrcUrl:'https://www.dfas.mil/militarymembers/payentitlements/pay-tables/basic-pay/em/', e4JuneFrac:0.4667, moveDeposit:625, efTarget:1000 };
  function rdCashCfg(){ var c = (WB && WB.redundancy && WB.redundancy.cash) || {}, o = {}; Object.keys(RD_CASH_DEFAULT).forEach(function(k){ o[k] = (c[k]!=null) ? c[k] : RD_CASH_DEFAULT[k]; });
   // easy220: start = ASSETS "Checking Accounts" (actual/available) − credit-card balances in DEBT (paid in full monthly)
   var chk = null; ((WB && WB.assets && WB.assets.savings) || []).forEach(function(a){ if(/checking/i.test(a.name||'') && chk === null) chk = Number(a.current)||0; });
   var card = 0, cardN = [], asOf = '';
   ((WB && WB.debts) || []).forEach(function(d){ if(/credit card/i.test((d.purpose||'')+' '+(d.creditor||''))){ card += Number(d.balance)||0; cardN.push(d.creditor||'card'); if(d.balanceAsOf) asOf = d.balanceAsOf; } });
   if(chk !== null && c.start == null){ o.start = Math.round((chk - card)*100)/100; o.checking = chk; o.card = Math.round(card*100)/100;
    o.src = 'ASSETS Checking $'+moneyAbs(chk)+(c.checkingNote?' ('+c.checkingNote+')':'')+' − '+cardN.join(' + ')+' $'+moneyAbs(card); o.asOf = c.asOf || asOf || o.asOf; }
   // easy221: SrA ([REDACTED-PAY-GRADE]) raise = sourced basic-pay step, converted to net with the workbook's own base-pay deduction ratio
   (function(){ var inc = (WB && WB.income) || {}, g = function(arr, re){ var v = 0; (arr||[]).forEach(function(x){ if(re.test(x.name||'')) v += Number(x.current)||0; }); return v; };
    var base = g(inc.entitlements, /base pay/i) || 3015, ded = g(inc.deductions, /FITW|FICA|^TSP/i);
    o.e4BaseOld = base; o.e4NetRatio = Math.round((1 - ded/base)*10000)/10000;
    o.e4RaiseGross = Math.round((Number(o.e4BaseNew) - base)*100)/100;
    o.e4Raise = Math.round(o.e4RaiseGross * o.e4NetRatio * 100)/100; })();
   return o; }
  var RD_TOK_CACHE = null;
  function rdTok(str){
   str = String(str == null ? '' : str); if(str.indexOf('{') < 0) return str;
   if(!RD_TOK_CACHE || RD_TOK_CACHE.key !== RD_CACHE){ var R = rdResolve(); RD_TOK_CACHE = { key: RD_CACHE, plan: rdCashPlan(R, rdSortedSteps(R)) }; }
   var P = RD_TOK_CACHE.plan, cfg = P.cfg, f = function(n){ return n == null ? '?' : (n<0?'−':'')+'$'+moneyAbs(n); };
   var dec = P.rows['ms-cash-dec'], vis = P.rows['ms-visit'];
   return str.replace(/\{checking\}/g, f(cfg.checking)).replace(/\{card\}/g, f(cfg.card)).replace(/\{start\}/g, f(cfg.start))
    .replace(/\{dec24\}/g, f(dec && dec.bal)).replace(/\{dec24after\}/g, f(vis && vis.bal)).replace(/\{asOf\}/g, cfg.asOf||'');
  }
  function rdIsOneOff(a){ var c = String((a && a.cadence)||'').toLowerCase(); return /one-off|check|milestone|^—$|^-$/.test(c) || c === ''; }
  function rdIsIncome(a){ return /income/i.test(String((a && a.cadence)||'')); }
  function rdYm(d){ return String(d||'').slice(0,7); }
  function rdNextYm(m){ var y=+m.slice(0,4), mo=+m.slice(5,7)+1; if(mo>12){ mo=1; y++; } return y+'-'+(mo<10?'0':'')+mo; }
  function rdCashPlan(R, sortedSteps){
   if(ASOF && WB && WB.__asofClone) return asofWithLive(function(){ var R2 = rdResolve(); return rdCashPlan(R2, rdSortedSteps(R2)); });
   var cfg = rdCashCfg(), items = rdItems(), lineByUid = {};
   (WB.expenses.sections||[]).forEach(function(sec){ (sec.items||[]).forEach(function(it){ if(it.uid && items[it.uid]) lineByUid[it.uid] = it; }); });
   var S = 0; try { S = Number(calcSummary().surplus) || 0; } catch(_){ }
   // a prerequisite step costs cash only if the chosen plan actually uses it (lease fees only when the lease wins)
   var dependents = {}, used = {};
   Object.keys(items).forEach(function(k){ rdAllRefs(k).forEach(function(r){ var b = r.split('.')[0]; (dependents[b] = dependents[b] || []).push(k); }); });
   function winPathReqs(k){ var rk = R[k] || {}, e = items[k], out = rdItemReqs(k).slice(); if(!rk.winner) return [];
    var top = rk.top ? rdFind(e.alts, rk.top) : null; [top, rk.winner].forEach(function(a){ (a && a.req || []).forEach(function(r){ out.push(r); }); }); return out; }
   Object.keys(items).forEach(function(u){
    var ds = dependents[u] || [];
    var wu = R[u] && R[u].winner;
    used[u] = !ds.length || rdIsIncome(wu) || ds.some(function(k){ return winPathReqs(k).some(function(r){ return r.split('.')[0] === u; }); });
   });
   function wStart(u){ var w = R[u] && R[u].winner; return (w && w.start) || items[u].start || ''; }
   // easy223: meal card dropped (AF Form 220) when BAH starts → Meal Deduction line stops; BAS already in income
   var mealDed = 0; ((WB.income && WB.income.deductions) || []).forEach(function(x){ if(/meal deduction/i.test(x.name||'')) mealDed += Number(x.current)||0; });
   var mealU = null; ['ms-bah','ms-bah-er'].forEach(function(u){ if(items[u] && R[u] && R[u].winner && used[u] && rdIsIncome(R[u].winner)){ if(!mealU || wStart(u) < wStart(mealU)) mealU = u; } });
   // recurring month delta vs today's CURRENT surplus (same rule as the month strip: winner active from its start month)
   function monthDelta(m){
    var d = S, parts = [];
    Object.keys(items).forEach(function(u){
     var e = items[u], w = R[u] && R[u].winner, st = rdYm(wStart(u)), it = lineByUid[u];
     if(it){ var cur = Number(it.current)||0, on = w && (!st || st <= m), v = on ? rdLeafAmt(w) : rdEndAmt(it, m, cur); if(v !== cur){ d += cur - v; parts.push([e.name||u, cur - v]); } return; }
     if(!e.virtual || !w || !used[u] || rdIsOneOff(w) || !rdLeafAmt(w) || (st && st > m)) return;
     var x = rdIsIncome(w) ? rdLeafAmt(w) : -rdLeafAmt(w); d += x; parts.push([e.name||u, x]);
    });
    var e4 = R['ms-e4'] && R['ms-e4'].winner;
    if(mealU && mealDed && rdYm(wStart(mealU)) <= m){ d += mealDed; parts.push(['meal deduction ends (BAH start)', mealDed]); }
    var e4m = rdYm(wStart('ms-e4'));
    if(e4 && cfg.e4Raise && e4m <= m){ var rz = e4m === m ? Math.round(cfg.e4Raise * cfg.e4JuneFrac * 100)/100 : cfg.e4Raise; d += rz; parts.push(['SrA ([REDACTED-PAY-GRADE]) pay raise net'+(e4m === m ? ' (partial month)' : ''), rz]); }
    return { d: Math.round(d*100)/100, parts: parts };
   }
   // one-time cash per step (virtual one-offs + assumed move-in deposit on the rent winner)
   function oneOff(u){
    var e = items[u], w = R[u] && R[u].winner, out = [];
    if(!w || !used[u]) return out;
    if(e.virtual && rdIsOneOff(w) && rdLeafAmt(w)) out.push([w.label || e.name, rdIsIncome(w) ? rdLeafAmt(w) : -rdLeafAmt(w)]);
    if(u === 'exp-rent' && cfg.moveDeposit) out.push(['move-in deposit (assumed, prior cash model)', -cfg.moveDeposit]);
    return out;
   }
   var steps = sortedSteps.map(function(u, i){ return { u:u, i:i, date:wStart(u), ok: !!(R[u] && R[u].winner) && used[u] }; });
   var dated = steps.filter(function(s){ return s.ok && s.date; }).sort(function(a,b){ return a.date < b.date ? -1 : a.date > b.date ? 1 : a.i - b.i; });
   var bal = Number(cfg.start)||0, accrued = cfg.firstMonth, out = {}, minBal = Infinity, minU = null, monthCache = {};
   function md(m){ return monthCache[m] || (monthCache[m] = monthDelta(m)); }
   dated.forEach(function(s){
    var tgt = rdYm(s.date), n = 0, sum = 0, from = accrued;
    while(accrued < tgt){ sum += md(accrued).d; n++; accrued = rdNextYm(accrued); }
    bal += sum; var why = [];
    if(n) why.push('+'+n+' mo net ('+from+(n>1?'…'+(function(){ var x=from; for(var k=1;k<n;k++) x=rdNextYm(x); return x; })():'')+') '+(sum>=0?'+':'−')+'$'+Math.abs(sum).toFixed(2));
    oneOff(s.u).forEach(function(o){ bal += o[1]; why.push((o[1]>=0?'+':'−')+'$'+Math.abs(o[1]).toFixed(2)+' '+o[0]); });
    bal = Math.round(bal*100)/100;
    out[s.u] = { bal: bal, why: why.join(', ') || 'no cash change' };
    if(bal < minBal){ minBal = bal; minU = s.u; }
   });
   // month-end ledger (for reconciliation with month-based tables)
   var led = [], b2 = Number(cfg.start)||0, m = cfg.firstMonth, oneByM = {};
   dated.forEach(function(s){ oneOff(s.u).forEach(function(o){ var k = rdYm(s.date); oneByM[k] = (oneByM[k]||0) + o[1]; }); });
   for(var k=0; k<16; k++){ b2 += md(m).d + (oneByM[m]||0); led.push([m, Math.round(b2*100)/100]); m = rdNextYm(m); }
   var lowM = led.reduce(function(a,x){ return x[1] < a[1] ? x : a; }, led[0]);
   if(minU) out[minU].low = true;
   return { rows: out, used: used, cfg: cfg, S: S, ledger: led, lowM: lowM, mealU: mealU, mealDed: mealDed, mealStart: mealU ? wStart(mealU) : '' };
  }
  function rdCashCell(c, cfg){
   if(!c) return '<td class="calc" style="font-size:11px;opacity:.6">—'+(c===false?'<div style="font-size:9px">not used by chosen plan</div>':'')+'</td>';
   var col = c.bal < 0 ? '#ef4444' : (c.bal < cfg.efTarget ? '#f59e0b' : '#22c55e');
   var flag = c.bal < 0 ? ' ⚠ below [REDACTED-AMOUNT]' : (c.bal < cfg.efTarget ? ' ⚠ < $'+cfg.efTarget+' EF' : '');
   return '<td class="calc" data-rd-cash="'+c.bal+'" title="'+esc(c.why)+'" style="font-size:11px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap"><b style="color:'+col+'">'+money(c.bal,'auto')+'</b>'+
    (c.low?' <span style="color:#f59e0b;font-size:10px">▼ low</span>':'')+(flag?'<div style="font-size:9px;color:'+col+'">'+flag+'</div>':'')+
    '<div style="font-size:9px;opacity:.7;white-space:normal;max-width:220px;margin-left:auto">'+esc(c.why)+'</div></td>';
  }
  function rdSortedSteps(R){
   var items = rdItems();
   function when(u){ var e=items[u], w=R[u]&&R[u].winner; return (w&&w.start)||e.start||''; }
   return Object.keys(items).sort(function(a,b){ var sa=items[a].seq, sb=items[b].seq; if(sa!=null&&sb!=null&&sa!==sb) return sa-sb; return String(when(a)||'9').localeCompare(String(when(b)||'9')); });
  }

  function rdBind(){
   if(window.__rdBound) return; window.__rdBound = true;
   document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
    var b = ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('[data-rd-open],[data-rd-avail],[data-rd-add],[data-rd-raise]');
    if(!b) return;
    if(b.hasAttribute('data-rd-raise')){ var cc = rdCashCfg(); var v = window.prompt('[REDACTED-PAY-GRADE] monthly basic pay after promotion (2026 DFAS: over 3 yrs 3482.40; over 2 yrs 3303.00):', cc.e4BaseNew); if(v===null) return; v = Number(String(v).replace(/[$,]/g,'')); if(!(v>0)) return;
     if(!WB.redundancy) WB.redundancy={version:2,items:{}}; WB.redundancy.cash = WB.redundancy.cash || {}; WB.redundancy.cash.e4BaseNew = v;
     var fr = window.prompt('Share of the raise counted in the promotion month (0–1):', cc.e4JuneFrac); if(fr!==null && Number(fr)>=0 && Number(fr)<=1) WB.redundancy.cash.e4JuneFrac = Number(fr);
     rdDirty(); renderAll(); return; }
    if(b.hasAttribute('data-rd-open')){ var k=b.getAttribute('data-rd-open'); RD_OPEN[k]=!RD_OPEN[k]; renderAll(); return; }
    if(b.hasAttribute('data-rd-avail')){
     var p=b.getAttribute('data-rd-avail').split('|'); var e=rdItems()[p[0]]; var a=e&&rdFind(e.alts,p[1]); if(!a) return;
     if(a.available===false){ a.available=true; a.restoredDate=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); }
     else { var why=window.prompt('Why is '+a.key+' unavailable?', a.unavailReason||''); if(why===null) return; a.available=false; a.unavailReason=why; a.unavailDate=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); }
     rdDirty(); renderAll(); return;
    }
    if(b.hasAttribute('data-rd-add')){
     var q=b.getAttribute('data-rd-add').split('.'); var it=WB.expenses.sections[+q[0]].items[+q[1]];
     var label=window.prompt('Alternative name for '+it.name+':',''); if(!label) return;

     e2.alts.push({key:String.fromCharCode(65+e2.alts.length),label:label,amount:amt,cadence:'monthly',trigger:'',value:400,available:true,children:[]});
     RD_OPEN[it.uid]=true; rdDirty(); renderAll();
    }

  function asofToday(){ var d=new Date(); return d.getFullYear()+'-'+('0'+(d.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+d.getDate()).slice(-2); }
  function asofWithLive(fn){ if(!(ASOF && WB && WB.__asofClone)) return fn(); var cl=WB; WB=ASOF.live; RD_CACHE=null; RD_TOK_CACHE=null;
   try { return fn(); } finally { ASOF.live=WB; WB=cl; RD_CACHE=null; RD_TOK_CACHE=null; } }
  function asofDerive(live, date){
   var ym = date.slice(0,7), info = { date:date, ym:ym, notes:[], holes:[], oneOffs:[] };
   RD_CACHE = null; var R = rdResolve(), CASH = rdCashPlan(R, rdSortedSteps(R)), items = rdItems(), cfg = CASH.cfg;
   var W = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(live)); W.__asofClone = true;
   function wS(u){ var w=R[u]&&R[u].winner; return (w&&w.start)||(items[u]&&items[u].start)||''; }
   function on(u){ var w=R[u]&&R[u].winner; if(!w || !items[u]) return false; var st=wS(u); return !st || st<=date; }
   var lineAmtByUid = {};
   (W.expenses.sections||[]).forEach(function(sec){ (sec.items||[]).forEach(function(it){
    var cur = Number(it.current)||0, v = cur, why = '', w = it.uid && items[it.uid] && R[it.uid] && R[it.uid].winner;
    if(w && on(it.uid)){ v = rdLeafAmt(w); why = 'plan '+w.key+' · '+rdTok(w.label)+' (from '+wS(it.uid)+')'; }
    else if(it.endDate){ v = rdEndAmt(it, ym, cur); if(v !== cur) why = 'line ends '+it.endDate+(it.finalMonth?' (final '+it.finalMonth+')':''); }
    if(Math.abs(v-cur) > 0.004) info.notes.push([it.name, cur, v, why]);
    var $f = function(n){ return '$'+moneyAbs(n); }, fut = w && !on(it.uid) ? wS(it.uid) : '';
    if(Math.abs(v-cur) > 0.004) it.__asofTag = cur === 0 ? { k:'new', t:'new · '+why } : (v === 0 ? { k:'ended', t:(it.endDate ? 'ended '+it.endDate : why)+' · was '+$f(cur) } : { k:'chg', t:'was '+$f(cur)+' → '+$f(v)+' · '+why });
    else if(fut && v === 0) it.__asofTag = { k:'future', t:'starts '+fut+' · plan '+w.key+' '+$f(rdLeafAmt(w))+'/mo' };
    else if(fut) it.__asofTag = { k:'chg', t:'current line until '+fut+', then plan '+w.key+' '+$f(rdLeafAmt(w))+'/mo' };
    it.current = v; if(it.uid) lineAmtByUid[it.uid] = v; delete it.endDate; delete it.finalMonth; delete it.finalAmount; delete it.afterEnd;
   }); });
   var vsec = { name:'PLAN MILESTONES (as-of)', items:[] }, ent = W.income.entitlements;
   Object.keys(items).forEach(function(u){
    var e = items[u], w = R[u] && R[u].winner; if(!e.virtual || !w || !CASH.used[u]) return;
    var amt = rdLeafAmt(w), st = wS(u);
    if(rdIsOneOff(w)){ if(amt && rdYm(st) === ym) info.oneOffs.push([st, rdIsIncome(w)?amt:-amt, rdTok(w.label||e.name), st<=date]); return; }
    if(!amt) return;
    if(!on(u)){ var fr = { name:e.name+' · '+w.key, current:0, __asofTag:{ k:'future', t:'starts '+st+' · '+(rdIsIncome(w)?'+':'')+'$'+moneyAbs(amt)+'/mo · '+rdTok(w.label||'') } };
     if(rdIsIncome(w)) ent.push(fr); else vsec.items.push(fr); return; }
    var row = { name:e.name+' · '+w.key, current:amt, __asofTag:{ k:'new', t:'new · plan from '+st+' · '+rdTok(w.label||'') } };
    if(rdIsIncome(w)) ent.push(row); else vsec.items.push(row);
    info.notes.push([row.name, 0, rdIsIncome(w)?amt:-amt, 'plan from '+st]);
   });
   if(vsec.items.length) W.expenses.sections.push(vsec);
   if(R['exp-rent'] && R['exp-rent'].winner && CASH.used['exp-rent'] && cfg.moveDeposit && rdYm(wS('exp-rent')) === ym)
    info.oneOffs.push([wS('exp-rent'), -cfg.moveDeposit, 'move-in deposit (assumed)', wS('exp-rent')<=date]);
   // SrA ([REDACTED-PAY-GRADE]) raise — same cashSettings as the Cash-after row (easy221); full month amount shown from the promotion day
   var e4 = R['ms-e4'] && R['ms-e4'].winner;
   if(e4 && on('ms-e4') && cfg.e4BaseNew && cfg.e4BaseOld){ var k = cfg.e4BaseNew/cfg.e4BaseOld;
    ent.forEach(function(x){ if(/base pay/i.test(x.name||'')){ x.__asofTag = { k:'chg', t:'was $'+moneyAbs(x.current)+' → $'+moneyAbs(cfg.e4BaseNew)+' · SrA ([REDACTED-PAY-GRADE]) raise from '+wS('ms-e4')+' (DFAS 2026 table)' }; x.current = cfg.e4BaseNew; } });
    (W.income.deductions||[]).forEach(function(x){ if(/FITW|FICA|^TSP/i.test(x.name||'')){ var nv = Math.round((Number(x.current)||0)*k*100)/100; x.__asofTag = { k:'chg', t:'was $'+moneyAbs(x.current)+' → $'+moneyAbs(nv)+' · scaled with SrA base pay' }; x.current = nv; } });
    info.notes.push(['SrA ([REDACTED-PAY-GRADE]) basic pay', cfg.e4BaseOld, cfg.e4BaseNew, 'promotion '+wS('ms-e4')+' · net +$'+moneyAbs(cfg.e4Raise)+'/mo (taxes/TSP scaled)']); }
   else if(e4 && cfg.e4BaseNew) ent.forEach(function(x){ if(/base pay/i.test(x.name||'')) x.__asofTag = { k:'future', t:'SrA raise starts '+wS('ms-e4')+' → $'+moneyAbs(cfg.e4BaseNew)+' (+$'+moneyAbs(cfg.e4Raise)+' net/mo)', keep:1 }; });
   // easy223: meal deduction ends when BAH starts (same resolved BAH winner as the Cash-after ledger; whole-month → from BAH start month)
   if(CASH.mealU && CASH.mealDed){ var ms = CASH.mealStart, mOn = rdYm(ms) <= ym;
    (W.income.deductions||[]).forEach(function(x){ if(!/meal deduction/i.test(x.name||'')) return;
     if(mOn){ info.notes.push([x.name, Number(x.current)||0, 0, 'ended '+ms+' with BAH (AF Form 220; BAS paid in cash)']); x.__asofTag = { k:'ended', t:'ended '+ms+' with BAH start · was $'+moneyAbs(x.current)+' (AF Form 220; BAS paid in cash)' }; x.current = 0; }
     else x.__asofTag = { k:'future', keep:1, t:'ends '+ms+' when BAH starts (+$'+moneyAbs(x.current)+'/mo net)' }; }); }
   // debts: amortize installment loans month by month from balanceAsOf
   (W.debts||[]).forEach(function(d){ var pay=Number(d.current_payment)||0, b=Number(d.balance)||0, r=(Number(d.aprPct)||0)/1200; if(!(pay>0) || !(b>0)) return;
    var from = String(d.balanceAsOf||asofToday()).slice(0,7), n = 0, m = from; while(m < ym && n < 600){ m = rdNextYm(m); n++; }
    for(var i=0;i<n && b>0;i++) b = b*(1+r) - pay; b = Math.max(0, Math.round(b*100)/100);
    if(n){ info.notes.push([(d.creditor||'debt')+' balance', Number(d.balance)||0, b, n+' payments of $'+moneyAbs(pay)+' since '+from]); d.__asofTag = { k:'chg', t:'projected balance $'+moneyAbs(b)+' (was $'+moneyAbs(Number(d.balance)||0)+' on '+(d.balanceAsOf||'')+') · '+n+' payments' }; d.balance = b; d.balanceInitial = b; d.balanceAsOf = date; d.remainingTerms = Math.max(0,(Number(d.remainingTerms)||0)-n); }
   });
   // cash on the date: previous month-end from the Cash-after ledger + this month's one-offs dated on/before the day (monthly net accrues at month end)
   var prev = null, me = null; CASH.ledger.forEach(function(x){ if(x[0] < ym) prev = x; if(x[0] === ym) me = x[1]; });
   var oo = 0; info.oneOffs.forEach(function(o){ if(o[3]) oo += o[1]; });
   info.cash = Math.round(((prev ? prev[1] : Number(cfg.start)||0) + oo)*100)/100; info.cashFrom = prev ? prev[0]+' month-end' : 'start '+(cfg.asOf||'');
   info.monthEnd = me; info.cfg = cfg;
   (W.assets && W.assets.savings || []).forEach(function(a){ if(/checking/i.test(a.name||'') && !info.__chk){ info.__chk = 1; var nc = Math.round((info.cash + (Number(cfg.card)||0))*100)/100; a.__asofTag = { k:'chg', t:'was $'+moneyAbs(a.current)+' → $'+moneyAbs(nc)+' · est. from Cash-after ledger ('+info.cashFrom+' + one-offs) + card $'+moneyAbs(cfg.card||0) }; a.current = nc; } });
   // dependency holes
   var H = info.holes;
   Object.keys(items).forEach(function(u){ if(!on(u) || !CASH.used[u]) return;
    var wp = rdItemReqs(u).slice(), rk = R[u] || {}, topA = rk.top ? rdFind(items[u].alts, rk.top) : null;
    [topA, rk.winner].forEach(function(a){ (a && a.req || []).forEach(function(r){ wp.push(r); }); });
    wp.filter(function(r, i){ return wp.indexOf(r) === i; }).forEach(function(ref){ var b = ref.split('.')[0]; if(!items[b]) return;
     if(!(R[b] && R[b].winner)) H.push(['red', (items[u].name||u)+' is active but prerequisite '+(items[b].name||b)+' is blocked']);
     else if(wS(b) > date) H.push(['amber', (items[u].name||u)+' active from '+wS(u)+' before prerequisite '+(items[b].name||b)+' ('+wS(b)+')']); }); });
   var bahU = ['ms-bah','ms-bah-er'].filter(function(u){ return R[u] && R[u].winner && CASH.used[u]; }), bahOn = bahU.some(on);
   var nextBah = bahU.map(wS).sort()[0] || 'none chosen';
   [['exp-rent','Rent'],['exp-car','Car payment']].forEach(function(x){ var a = lineAmtByUid[x[0]]; if(a > 0 && !bahOn) H.push(['amber', x[1]+' $'+moneyAbs(a)+'/mo is due but BAH has not started (first BAH '+nextBah+')']); });
   return { W:W, info:info };
  }
  function asofSet(d){
   if(ASOF){ if(WB && WB.__asofClone) WB = ASOF.live; ASOF = null; }
   RD_CACHE = null; RD_TOK_CACHE = null;
   if(d && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d) && d !== asofToday() && WB){
    var live = WB, r = asofDerive(live, d); ASOF = { date:d, live:live, info:r.info }; WB = r.W; RD_CACHE = null;
    try { var S = calcSummary(), cfg = r.info.cfg, H = r.info.holes;
     r.info.summary = S;
     if(S.surplus < 0) H.unshift(['red', 'Monthly surplus '+money(S.surplus,'auto').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'')+' (net '+moneyAbs(S.net)+' − living '+moneyAbs(S.living)+' − debt '+moneyAbs(S.debtPayments)+')']);
     var c = r.info.cash; if(c < 0) H.unshift(['red', 'Cash on '+d+' ≈ −$'+moneyAbs(-c)+' (below [REDACTED-AMOUNT])']); else if(c < cfg.efTarget) H.unshift(['amber', 'Cash on '+d+' ≈ $'+moneyAbs(c)+' (below $'+cfg.efTarget+' emergency fund)']);
     var me = r.info.monthEnd; if(me != null && me !== c){ if(me < 0) H.push(['red','Month-end '+r.info.ym+' ≈ −$'+moneyAbs(-me)]); else if(me < cfg.efTarget) H.push(['amber','Month-end '+r.info.ym+' ≈ $'+moneyAbs(me)+' (below $'+cfg.efTarget+')']); }
    } catch(eH){ if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.warn('asof holes', eH); }
   }
   renderAll();
  }

  function asofDecorate(pane){
   if(!ASOF || !pane) return; var I = ASOF.info || {};
   var CH = { 'new':['#22c55e','rgba(34,197,94,.15)'], chg:['#f59e0b','rgba(245,158,11,.15)'], future:['#94a3b8','rgba(148,163,184,.15)'], ended:['#94a3b8','rgba(148,163,184,.15)'] };
   pane.querySelectorAll('input[data-path]').forEach(function(el){
    var p = el.getAttribute('data-path').split('.'); p.pop(); var o = WB; for(var i=0;i<p.length && o;i++) o = o[p[i]];
    if(!o || !o.__asofTag) return; var tr = el.closest('tr'); if(!tr || tr.getAttribute('data-asof-tag')) return;
    var tg = o.__asofTag, c = CH[tg.k] || CH.chg; tr.setAttribute('data-asof-tag', tg.k);
    if((tg.k === 'future' && !tg.keep) || tg.k === 'ended') tr.style.opacity = '.5';
    if(tg.k === 'new') tr.style.boxShadow = 'inset 3px 0 0 #22c55e'; else if(tg.k === 'chg') tr.style.boxShadow = 'inset 3px 0 0 #f59e0b';
    var td = tr.querySelector('td.name') || el.parentNode, chip = document.createElement('div');
    chip.setAttribute('data-asof-chip', tg.k); chip.style.cssText = 'font-size:10px;margin-top:2px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:8px;display:inline-block;color:'+c[0]+';background:'+c[1];
    chip.textContent = (tg.k==='new'?'● ':tg.k==='chg'?'Δ ':tg.k==='future'?'⏳ ':'✕ ')+tg.t; td.appendChild(chip);
   });
   // timeline panels stay live (they ARE the timeline) — label + highlight the as-of month
   pane.querySelectorAll('b').forEach(function(b){ if(/^Dependencies & sequence/.test(b.textContent) && !b.getAttribute('data-asof-l')){ b.setAttribute('data-asof-l','1'); b.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',' <span style="font-size:10px;color:#f59e0b">(full timeline · live plan · as-of month '+esc(I.ym)+' highlighted)</span>'); } });
   pane.querySelectorAll('[data-rd-m="'+I.ym+'"]').forEach(function(td){ td.style.outline = '1px solid #f59e0b'; td.style.background = 'rgba(245,158,11,.10)'; });
   if(activeTab === 'EXPENSES' && (I.oneOffs||[]).length){
    var tb = pane.querySelector('table.grid');
    if(tb) tb.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', '<div data-asof-oneoff="1" style="border:1px solid #f59e0b;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 8px;margin:6px 0"><b style="font-size:12px">One-time costs in '+esc(I.ym)+'</b> <span class="calc" style="font-size:10px">(hit cash on their date; not in the monthly totals)</span><table class="grid"><tbody>'+
     I.oneOffs.map(function(o){ return '<tr style="'+(o[3]?'':'opacity:.5')+'"><td class="name">'+esc(o[2])+'</td><td class="calc">'+esc(o[0])+(o[3]?' · paid':' · after this day')+'</td><td class="calc" style="text-align:right">'+(o[1]<0?'−':'+')+'$'+moneyAbs(Math.abs(o[1]))+'</td></tr>'; }).join('')+'</tbody></table></div>');
   }
  }

      '<td>'+debtPaySelect(si, ii, it.payDebt)+'</td>'+

   });
   html += '</select>';
   return html;
  }

  function renderDebt(){
   var C=calcDebt(); var inc=calcIncome(); var exp=calcExpenses();
   var html='<p class="hint"><b>Amount due ≡ totalDurationPayment</b> (<code>test_calc_debt.js</code>): '+
    '<span class="c">durationApr = dailyRate×balance×days</span> · '+
    '<span class="c">actualPayment = balance/terms</span> · '+
    '<span class="c">amount due = sum</span>. Days=29 matches the test. Current only.</p>';

   html+='<table class="grid"><thead><tr>'+
    '<th>Creditor</th><th>Purpose</th><th>Initial</th><th>As of</th><th>Live</th><th>Gap</th><th>APR %</th><th>Terms0</th><th>Terms</th><th>Days</th>'+
    '<th>Interest</th><th>Principal</th><th>Amount due</th>'+
    '<th>Cash pay</th><th title="Months to [REDACTED-AMOUNT] if you keep paying this cash amount">Payoff</th><th>Source</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>';

   (C.lines||[]).forEach(function(d,i){
    var linked = d.fromExpense && d.fromExpense.length;
    var warn = d.underInterest ? ' style="background:rgba(239,68,68,.12)"' :
     (d.underMin ? ' style="background:rgba(245,158,11,.1)"' : '');
    var m = d.math || {};
    html+='<tr'+warn+'>'+
     '<td class="name">'+textInp('debts.'+i+'.creditor', WB.debts[i].creditor)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="name">'+textInp('debts.'+i+'.purpose', WB.debts[i].purpose)+'</td>'+
     '<td title="Initial balance snapshot">'+inp('debts.'+i+'.balanceInitial', WB.debts[i].balanceInitial != null ? WB.debts[i].balanceInitial : WB.debts[i].balance)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc" style="font-size:10px" title="As-of date for initial">'+textInp('debts.'+i+'.balanceAsOf', WB.debts[i].balanceAsOf || '')+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc" title="Live balance at calendar focus/today after pay hits">'+money(d.balanceLive != null ? d.balanceLive : d.balance,'spend')+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc" title="Initial − live (paid down since as-of)">'+money(d.balanceGap != null ? d.balanceGap : 0,'spend')+'</td>'+
     '<td>'+inp('debts.'+i+'.aprPct', WB.debts[i].aprPct != null ? WB.debts[i].aprPct : d.aprPct)+'</td>'+
     '<td title="Initial remaining terms at as-of">'+inp('debts.'+i+'.remainingTermsInitial', WB.debts[i].remainingTermsInitial != null ? WB.debts[i].remainingTermsInitial : WB.debts[i].remainingTerms)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc" title="Live terms left — drops by 1 each calendar pay since as-of">'+esc(String(d.termsLive != null ? d.termsLive : (d.remainingTerms != null ? d.remainingTerms : '')))+'</td>'+
     '<td>'+inp('debts.'+i+'.days', WB.debts[i].days != null ? WB.debts[i].days : d.days)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+money(d.durationApr,'spend')+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+money(d.principalSlice,'spend')+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc"><b>'+money(d.amountDue,'spend')+'</b></td>';
    var payoffCell = '<td class="calc">'+payoffTermsHtml(d.payoff, d.remainingTerms)+'</td>';
    if(linked){
     html+='<td class="calc">'+money(d.payment,'spend')+'</td>'+
      payoffCell+
      '<td class="calc" style="font-size:10px;text-align:left">EXP: '+esc(d.fromExpense.join(', '))+
      (d.underInterest?' ⚠&lt;interest':d.underMin?' ⚠&lt;due':'')+'</td>';
    } else {
     html+='<td>'+inp('debts.'+i+'.current_payment', WB.debts[i].current_payment)+'</td>'+
      payoffCell+
      '<td class="remarks">manual'+(d.underInterest?' ⚠':d.underMin?' ⚠ min':'')+'</td>';
    }
    html+='<td><button class="del" data-del="debts.'+i+'">&times;</button></td></tr>';
   });

   html+='<tr class="total"><td colspan="2">TOTALS</td>'+
    '<td class="calc">'+money((C.lines||[]).reduce(function(s,x){return s+(Number(x.balanceInitial)||0);},0),'spend')+'</td><td></td>'+
    '<td class="calc">'+money(C.totalBalance,'spend')+'</td>'+
    '<td class="calc">'+money((C.lines||[]).reduce(function(s,x){return s+(Number(x.balanceGap)||0);},0),'spend')+'</td><td></td>'+
    '<td class="calc">'+((C.lines||[]).reduce(function(s,x){return s+(Number(x.termsInitial)||0);},0))+'</td>'+
    '<td class="calc">'+((C.lines||[]).reduce(function(s,x){return s+(Number(x.termsLive)!=null?Number(x.termsLive):Number(x.remainingTerms)||0);},0))+'</td><td></td>'+
    '<td class="calc">'+money(C.totalInterestMonth,'spend')+'</td><td></td>'+
    '<td class="calc">'+money(C.amountDue,'spend')+'</td>'+
    '<td class="calc">'+money(C.payments,'spend')+'</td>'+
    '<td></td><td colspan="2"></td></tr>';
   html+='</tbody></table>';

   html+='<p class="hint" style="margin-top:12px"><b>Live balance</b>: Initial @ As-of walks down on calendar pay days (Car 1st, Student 25th, …). Gap = Initial − Live at focus/today. Terms drops by 1 each calendar pay since as-of. Edit Initial/As-of to re-baseline.<br><b>Sanity</b>: balance 20627.41 · APR 5.750 · terms 155 · days 29 → amount due ≈ <code>227.32</code></p>';

   html+='<div class="add-row"><input id="add-debt-c" placeholder="Creditor" /><input id="add-debt-p" placeholder="Purpose" />'+
    '<input id="add-debt-bal" type="number" step="any" placeholder="Balance" style="max-width:100px;background:var(--input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:6px" />'+
    '<input id="add-debt-apr" type="number" step="any" placeholder="APR %" style="max-width:80px;background:var(--input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:6px" />'+
    '<input id="add-debt-terms" type="number" step="1" placeholder="Terms" style="max-width:80px;background:var(--input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:6px" />'+
    '<input id="add-debt-days" type="number" step="any" placeholder="Days" style="max-width:70px;background:var(--input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:6px" />'+
    '<button class="btn" id="btn-add-debt">Add debt</button></div>';

   html+='<p class="hint">Σ amount due <span class="c">'+money(C.amountDue,'spend')+'</span> · cash <span class="c">'+money(C.payments,'spend')+'</span> · expense debt-pays <span class="c">'+money(exp.debtPays,'spend')+'</span></p>';

   html+='<h3 style="font-size:.85rem;margin-top:14px">DEBT-TO-INCOME</h3>';
   html+='<table class="grid"><tbody>';
   html+='<tr><td>Gross monthly income</td><td class="calc">'+money(inc.gross,'gain')+'</td></tr>';
   html+='<tr><td>Σ totalDurationPayment</td><td class="calc">'+money(C.amountDue,'spend')+'</td></tr>';
   html+='<tr><td>Cash payments</td><td class="calc">'+money(C.payments,'spend')+'</td></tr>';

   return html;
  }

  function renderAssets(){
   var C=calcAssets();
   var html='<p class="hint">Holdings are <b>inputs</b> — add rows per group. Liabilities pull <span class="c">DEBT.totalBalance</span>. Net worth = assets − liabilities.</p>';
   html+='<div class="add-row" style="flex-wrap:wrap">';
   html+='<select id="add-asset-sec" style="background:var(--input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px">';
   html+='<option value="savings">Savings</option><option value="real_estate">Real estate</option><option value="personal">Personal property</option>';
   html+='</select>';
   html+='<input id="add-asset-name" placeholder="New asset name…" style="flex:1;min-width:140px" />';
   html+='<input id="add-asset-val" type="number" step="any" placeholder="$" style="max-width:100px;background:var(--input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:6px" />';
   html+='<button class="btn btn-ok" id="btn-add-asset">Add row</button></div>';
   function block(title, key){
    var h='<h3 style="font-size:.85rem;color:var(--edit)">'+title+'</h3><table class="grid"><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Current</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    (WB.assets[key]||[]).forEach(function(it,i){
     h+='<tr><td class="name">'+textInp('assets.'+key+'.'+i+'.name', it.name)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+inp('assets.'+key+'.'+i+'.current', it.current)+'</td>'+
      '<td><button class="del" data-del="assets.'+key+'.'+i+'" title="Delete row">&times;</button></td></tr>';
    });
    var sum=(WB.assets[key]||[]).reduce(function(a,i){return a+(Number(i.current)||0);},0);
    h+='<tr class="total"><td>Subtotal</td><td class="calc">'+money(sum,'gain')+'</td><td></td></tr></tbody></table>';
    return h;
   }
   html+=block('SAVINGS','savings')+block('REAL ESTATE','real_estate')+block('PERSONAL PROPERTY','personal');
   html+='<table class="grid" style="margin-top:12px"><tbody>';
   html+='<tr class="total"><td>TOTAL ASSETS</td><td class="calc">'+money(C.totalAssets,'gain')+'</td></tr>';
   html+='<tr class="total"><td>TOTAL DEBT (liabilities)</td><td class="calc">'+money(C.liabilities,'spend')+'</td></tr>';
   html+='<tr class="total"><td>NET WORTH</td><td class="calc">'+money(C.netWorth,'auto')+'</td></tr>';
   html+='</tbody></table>';
   return html;
  }

  function renderRanks(){
   ensureRankState();
   var R=calcRanks();
   var dim=activeRankDim;
   var order=WB.rankOrders[dim]||[];
   var inv = !!rankDimInverted(dim) || (dim==='M' && WB.moneyMode==='ranks');
   var html='<p class="hint">Rank <b>all Board items</b> (expenses + Work/Gym/Lunch/…) for <span class="c">'+dim+' · '+esc(rankDimLabel(dim))+'</span>. ';
   if(dim==='M'){
    html+='Money is <b>inverted (cost)</b>: higher $ sorts to the top and gets the <b>worst / smallest</b> score share. '+
     'Edit $ → re-sort high→low. Drag rank → rewrite $ with inverted harmonic. Mode: <b>'+
     (WB.moneyMode==='values'?'$ → rank (high $ = worse)':'rank → $ (top = least $)')+'</b>.</p>';
    html+='<div class="add-row" style="margin-bottom:10px">';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.moneyMode==='values'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-m-values">$ sets rank</button>';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.moneyMode==='ranks'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-m-ranks">Rank sets $</button>';
    html+='</div>';
   } else if(dim==='T'){
    var fmT = rankCalendarFocusMonth();
    html+='Time/calendar ranks from <b>calendar placements</b> (hours in focus month = days×duration), like Money from $. '+
     'Mode: <b>'+(WB.timeMode==='values'?'calendar → rank (more hours = higher)':'manual drag')+'</b> · focus '+
     esc(String((fmT.m|0)+1))+'/'+esc(String(fmT.y))+'.</p>';
    html+='<div class="add-row" style="margin-bottom:10px">';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.timeMode==='values'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-t-values">Calendar sets rank</button>';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.timeMode==='ranks'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-t-ranks">Manual rank</button>';
    html+='</div>';
   } else if(dim==='D'){
    var fmD = rankCalendarFocusMonth();
    html+='Days ranks from <b>calendar placements</b> (unique days covered in focus month), parallel to Time/hours. '+
     'Mode: <b>'+(WB.daysMode==='values'?'calendar → rank (more days = higher)':'manual drag')+'</b> · focus '+
     esc(String((fmD.m|0)+1))+'/'+esc(String(fmD.y))+'.</p>';
    html+='<div class="add-row" style="margin-bottom:10px">';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.daysMode==='values'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-d-values">Calendar sets rank</button>';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.daysMode==='ranks'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-d-ranks">Manual rank</button>';
    html+='</div>';
   } else if(dim==='U'){
    html+='Debt/urgency ranks from the <b>DEBT tab</b> (interest pressure, APR×balance, payoff stress), like Money from $ and Time from calendar. '+
     'Mode: <b>'+(WB.debtMode==='values'?'debt math → rank (more urgent = higher)':'manual drag')+'</b>.</p>';
    html+='<div class="add-row" style="margin-bottom:10px">';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.debtMode==='values'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-u-values">Debt sets rank</button>';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.debtMode==='ranks'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-u-ranks">Manual rank</button>';
    html+='</div>';
   } else if(dim==='S'){
    var sumS = null;
    try { sumS = calcSummary(); } catch(_s){ sumS = null; }
    html+='Surplus/freedom ranks from <b>INCOME + EXPENSES</b> math (item contribution to surplus = income − expense; household surplus = net − living − debt). '+
     'Mode: <b>'+(WB.surplusMode==='values'?'sheet → rank (more +$ freedom = higher)':'manual drag')+'</b>'+
     (sumS ? (' · household surplus <span class="c">'+esc(String(Math.round((sumS.surplus||0)*100)/100))+'</span>') : '')+'.</p>';
    html+='<div class="add-row" style="margin-bottom:10px">';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.surplusMode==='values'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-s-values">Sheet sets rank</button>';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(WB.surplusMode==='ranks'?' active':'')+'" id="btn-s-ranks">Manual rank</button>';
    html+='</div>';
   } else if(inv){
    html+='<b>Inverted</b> (negative dim): list #1 → smallest share · score = (1/rank′)/Σ · run() live.</p>';
   } else {
    html+='List #1 → largest share · score = (1/rank)/Σ · run() live.</p>';
   }
   // Compact mirror — primary Factor importance editor lives on PREVIEW
   html+=renderFactorImportanceHtml('compact');
   html+='<div class="rank-dim-tabs">';
   allRankDims().forEach(function(d){
    var mark = rankDimInverted(d) ? ' ↓' : '';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill'+(d===dim?' active':'')+'" data-rank-dim="'+d+'">'+d+' · '+esc(rankDimLabel(d))+mark+'</button>';
   });
   html+='<button type="button" class="pill preview-add-factor" id="btn-add-rank-factor" title="Add a new score factor (rank dimension)">+ factor</button>';
   html+='</div>';
   html+='<p class="hint"><b>Score factors</b> — drag <b>every</b> Board item. + factor to add one (you’ll define what higher ranking means).</p>';
   html+='<div class="rank-higher-means" id="rank-higher-means">';
   html+='<div class="rank-higher-means-label">Higher ranking means</div>';
   html+='<p class="rank-higher-means-text">'+esc(rankDimHigherMeans(dim))+'</p>';
   html+='<button type="button" class="pill" id="btn-edit-rank-means" title="Edit what higher ranking means for this score factor">Edit meaning</button>';
   html+='</div>';
   var factorNames = [];
   var nonNames = [];
   order.forEach(function(name){
     if(isRankNonFactor(dim, name)) nonNames.push(name);
     else factorNames.push(name);
   });
   html+='<ul class="rank-list" id="rank-list">';
   factorNames.forEach(function(name,i){
    var it=R.byName[name]||{cost:0};
    var sc = dim==='H'?it.scoreH : dim==='D'?it.scoreD : dim==='T'?it.scoreT : dim==='U'?it.scoreU : dim==='S'?it.scoreS : dim==='A'?it.scoreA : dim==='M'?it.scoreM : dim==='E'?it.scoreE : (it['score'+dim] != null ? it['score'+dim] : 0);
    html+='<li class="rank-item" draggable="true" data-name="'+String(name).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'">'+
     '<span class="rn">'+(i+1)+'</span>'+
     '<span class="nm">'+esc(name)+'</span>';
    if(dim==='M'){
     if(isRankMoneyGain(it)){
      var earnShow = Number(it.incomeAmt)||0;
      html+='<span class="cost m-earn-note" title="Work/gain is earn, not a spend cost on M — rank cost stays 0">0'
        +(earnShow>0 ? ' <span class="cm">earn · not cost</span>' : '')
        +'</span>';
     } else {
      html+='<input class="m-val" type="number" step="0.01" data-mname="'+String(name).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" value="'+(Number(it.cost)||0)+'" style="width:88px;background:var(--input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--edit);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 6px;font-family:JetBrains Mono,monospace;font-size:12px;text-align:right" title="Monthly $ — edits re-rank when in $→rank mode" />';
     }
    } else if(dim==='T'){
     var hrs = (WB._timeHoursCache && WB._timeHoursCache[name] != null)
       ? Number(WB._timeHoursCache[name])
       : rankItemCalendarHours(name);
     html+='<span class="cost t-hours" title="Hours in focus month from calendar">'+esc((Number(hrs)||0).toFixed(1))+' h</span>';
    } else if(dim==='D'){
     var dys = (WB._daysCache && WB._daysCache[name] != null)
       ? Number(WB._daysCache[name])
       : rankItemCalendarDays(name);
     html+='<span class="cost d-days" title="Days covered in focus month from calendar">'+esc(String(Number(dys)||0))+' d</span>';
    } else if(dim==='U'){
     var urg = (WB._debtUrgencyCache && WB._debtUrgencyCache[name] != null)
       ? Number(WB._debtUrgencyCache[name])
       : rankItemDebtUrgency(name);
     html+='<span class="cost u-urg" title="Urgency from DEBT tab math">'+esc((Number(urg)||0).toFixed(2))+'</span>';
    } else if(dim==='S'){
     var scv = (WB._surplusContribCache && WB._surplusContribCache[name] != null)
       ? Number(WB._surplusContribCache[name])
       : rankItemSurplusContribution(name);
     var lab = (scv >= 0 ? '+' : '') + (Number(scv)||0).toFixed(2);
     html+='<span class="cost s-contrib" title="Surplus contribution (income − expense)">'+esc(lab)+'</span>';
    } else {
     html+='<span class="cost">'+money(it.cost||0,'spend')+'</span>';
    }
    html+='<span class="sc">'+scorePct(sc||0)+'</span>';
    html+='<button type="button" class="pill rank-nonfactor-btn" data-rank-nonfactor="'+String(name).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" title="Disable for this score factor (non-factor)">non-factor</button>';
    html+='</li>';
   });
   html+='</ul>';
   if(nonNames.length){
     html+='<h3 class="section-h" style="font-size:.85rem;margin:16px 0 8px">Non-factors <span class="cm">(disabled for '+esc(dim)+')</span></h3>';
     html+='<ul class="rank-list rank-list-non" id="rank-list-non">';
     nonNames.forEach(function(name){
       var it=R.byName[name]||{cost:0};
       html+='<li class="rank-item rank-item-non" data-name="'+String(name).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'">';
       html+='<span class="rn">—</span><span class="nm">'+esc(name)+'</span>';
       if(dim==='U'){
         var uu = (WB._debtUrgencyCache && WB._debtUrgencyCache[name] != null) ? Number(WB._debtUrgencyCache[name]) : rankItemDebtUrgency(name);
         html+='<span class="cost" title="Debt-tab urgency">'+esc((Number(uu)||0).toFixed(2))+'</span>';
       } else if(dim==='S'){
         var ss = (WB._surplusContribCache && WB._surplusContribCache[name] != null) ? Number(WB._surplusContribCache[name]) : rankItemSurplusContribution(name);
         html+='<span class="cost" title="Surplus contribution">'+(ss>=0?'+':'')+esc((Number(ss)||0).toFixed(2))+'</span>';
       } else {
         html+='<span class="cost">'+money(it.cost||0,'spend')+'</span>';
       }
       html+='<span class="sc cm">off</span>';
       html+='<button type="button" class="pill" data-rank-factor-on="'+String(name).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" title="Include as a factor again">factor</button>';
       html+='</li>';
     });
     html+='</ul>';
   }
   html+='<h3 style="font-size:.85rem;margin:16px 0 8px">All dimensions</h3>';
   html+='<table class="grid"><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>H%</th><th>D%</th><th>T%</th><th>U%</th><th>S%</th><th>A%</th><th>M%</th><th>E%</th><th>Cost</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
   var sorted=R.items.slice().sort(function(a,b){return (b.scoreH||0)-(a.scoreH||0);});
   sorted.forEach(function(it){
    html+='<tr><td>'+esc(it.name)+(it.fromBoard && !it.fromExpense ? ' <span class="cm">board</span>' : '')+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+scorePct(it.scoreH)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+scorePct(it.scoreD)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+scorePct(it.scoreT)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+scorePct(it.scoreU)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+scorePct(it.scoreS)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+scorePct(it.scoreA)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+scorePct(it.scoreM)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+scorePct(it.scoreE)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+money(it.cost,'spend')+'</td></tr>';
   });
   html+='</tbody></table>';
   return html;
  }

  var _mtFactorDidDrag = false;
  function bindFactorOrderDrag(){
   var lists = [];
   var a = $('factor-order-list');
   var b = $('factor-order-list-ranks');
   var c = $('factor-order-list-mt');
   if(a) lists.push(a);
   if(b) lists.push(b);
   if(c) lists.push(c);
   if(!lists.length) return;
   function orderFromDom(list){
     var out = [];
     list.querySelectorAll('.factor-order-item').forEach(function(n){
       var d = n.getAttribute('data-factor-dim');
       if(d) out.push(d);
     });
     return out;
   }
   function liveInsert(list, overLi, clientY){
     if(!dragSrc || !overLi || dragSrc === overLi) return;
     var rect = overLi.getBoundingClientRect();
     var before = (clientY - rect.top) < rect.height / 2;
     if(before) list.insertBefore(dragSrc, overLi);
     else list.insertBefore(dragSrc, overLi.nextSibling);
   }
   function remountModelToolsLight(){
     try {
       if(typeof easyPreserveScroll === 'function'){
         easyPreserveScroll(function(){ if(typeof renderPane === 'function') renderPane(); else renderAll(); });
       } else if(typeof renderPane === 'function') renderPane();
       else renderAll();
     } catch(_r){ try { renderAll(); } catch(_e){} }
   }
   lists.forEach(function(list){
    list.querySelectorAll('.factor-order-item').forEach(function(li){
     li.addEventListener('dragstart', function(e){
      dragSrc=li;
      _mtFactorDidDrag = false;
      li.classList.add('dragging');
      e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move';
      try { e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', li.getAttribute('data-factor-dim')||''); } catch(_d){}
     });
     li.addEventListener('dragover', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      e.dataTransfer.dropEffect='move';
      liveInsert(list, li, e.clientY);
      _mtFactorDidDrag = true;
     });
     li.addEventListener('dragenter', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); li.classList.add('over'); });
     li.addEventListener('dragleave', function(){ li.classList.remove('over'); });
     li.addEventListener('drop', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      liveInsert(list, li, e.clientY);
      var order = orderFromDom(list);
      if(order.length){
        ensureFactorOrder();
        WB.factorOrder = order;
      }
      try { if(typeof saveLocal === 'function') saveLocal(); } catch(_s){}
      try {
        easyCal._previewPaintTick = (easyCal._previewPaintTick || 0) + 1;
        easyCal._previewMaxes = null;
        easyCal._previewHits = Object.create(null);
      } catch(_c){}
      if(activeTab==='PREVIEW'){
        try { if(typeof renderPreviewLight === 'function') renderPreviewLight(); else renderAll(); }
        catch(_p){ renderAll(); }
      } else if(activeTab==='MODEL TOOLS'){
        remountModelToolsLight();
      } else {
        renderAll();
      }
     });
     li.addEventListener('dragend', function(){
      li.classList.remove('dragging');
      list.querySelectorAll('.over').forEach(function(n){ n.classList.remove('over'); });
      if(_mtFactorDidDrag){
        setTimeout(function(){ _mtFactorDidDrag = false; }, 0);
      }
      dragSrc = null;
     });
    });
   });
  }

  function bindRankDrag(){
   var list=$('rank-list');
   if(!list) return;
   list.querySelectorAll('.rank-item').forEach(function(li){
    li.addEventListener('dragstart', function(e){
     if(e.target && e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('m-val')){
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
     }
     dragSrc=li;
     li.classList.add('dragging');
     e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move';
    });
    li.addEventListener('dragover', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.dataTransfer.dropEffect='move'; });
    li.addEventListener('dragenter', function(){ li.classList.add('over'); });
    li.addEventListener('dragleave', function(){ li.classList.remove('over'); });
    li.addEventListener('drop', function(e){
     e.preventDefault();
     if(!dragSrc||dragSrc===li) return;
     var dim=activeRankDim;
     var order=WB.rankOrders[dim].slice();
     var src=dragSrc.getAttribute('data-name');
     var tgt=li.getAttribute('data-name');
     if(isRankNonFactor(dim, src) || isRankNonFactor(dim, tgt)) return;
     var factors = order.filter(function(n){ return !isRankNonFactor(dim, n); });
     var nons = order.filter(function(n){ return isRankNonFactor(dim, n); });
     var si=factors.indexOf(src), ti=factors.indexOf(tgt);
     if(si<0||ti<0) return;
     factors.splice(si,1);
     factors.splice(ti,0,src);
     WB.rankOrders[dim]=factors.concat(nons);
     if(dim==='M'){
      WB.moneyMode = 'ranks';
      applyMoneyRanksToValues();
     }
     if(dim==='T'){
      WB.timeMode = 'ranks';
     }
     if(dim==='D'){
      WB.daysMode = 'ranks';
     }
     if(dim==='U'){
      WB.debtMode = 'ranks';
     }
     if(dim==='S'){
      WB.surplusMode = 'ranks';
     }
     renderAll();
    });
    li.addEventListener('dragend', function(){
     li.classList.remove('dragging');
     list.querySelectorAll('.over').forEach(function(n){ n.classList.remove('over'); });
    });
   });
   // Money $ inputs: set monthly value → auto re-rank
   list.querySelectorAll('input.m-val').forEach(function(inp){
    var apply=function(){
     var name=inp.getAttribute('data-mname');
     var v=parseFloat(inp.value);
     if(isNaN(v)||v<0) v=0;
     var sheet = expenseSheetNameSet();
     if(!sheet[name]) return; // board-only / Work — no expense write
     var hit = null;
     rankItems().forEach(function(it){ if(it && it.name === name) hit = it; });
     if(isRankMoneyGain(hit)) return;
     // write to active scenario field
     setExpenseCost(name, v);
     WB.moneyMode = 'values';
     syncMoneyRankFromValues();
     renderAll();
    };
    inp.addEventListener('change', apply);
    inp.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
     if(e.key==='Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); apply(); }
    });
    // don't start drag from input
    inp.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });
   });
   document.querySelectorAll('[data-rank-dim]').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick=function(){
     activeRankDim=btn.getAttribute('data-rank-dim');
     renderAll();
    };
   });
   var bv=$('btn-m-values');
   if(bv) bv.onclick=function(){
    WB.moneyMode='values';
    syncMoneyRankFromValues();
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Money: $ drives rank','ok');
   };
   var br=$('btn-m-ranks');
   if(br) br.onclick=function(){
    WB.moneyMode='ranks';
    applyMoneyRanksToValues();
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Money: ranks set $','ok');
   };
   var tv=$('btn-t-values');
   if(tv) tv.onclick=function(){
    WB.timeMode='values';
    syncTimeRankFromCalendar();
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Time: calendar sets rank','ok');
   };
   var tr=$('btn-t-ranks');
   if(tr) tr.onclick=function(){
    WB.timeMode='ranks';
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Time: manual rank','ok');
   };
   var dv=$('btn-d-values');
   if(dv) dv.onclick=function(){
    WB.daysMode='values';
    syncDaysRankFromCalendar();
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Days: calendar sets rank','ok');
   };
   var dr=$('btn-d-ranks');
   if(dr) dr.onclick=function(){
    WB.daysMode='ranks';
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Days: manual rank','ok');
   };
   var uv=$('btn-u-values');
   if(uv) uv.onclick=function(){
    WB.debtMode='values';
    syncDebtRankFromUrgency();
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Debt: math sets urgency rank','ok');
   };
   var ur=$('btn-u-ranks');
   if(ur) ur.onclick=function(){
    WB.debtMode='ranks';
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Debt: manual rank','ok');
   };
   var sv=$('btn-s-values');
   if(sv) sv.onclick=function(){
    WB.surplusMode='values';
    syncSurplusRankFromSheet();
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Surplus: sheet sets rank','ok');
   };
   var sr=$('btn-s-ranks');
   if(sr) sr.onclick=function(){
    WB.surplusMode='ranks';
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Surplus: manual rank','ok');
   };
   document.querySelectorAll('[data-rank-nonfactor]').forEach(function(btn){
     btn.onclick=function(e){
       e.preventDefault();
       e.stopPropagation();
       var nm = btn.getAttribute('data-rank-nonfactor');
       if(!nm) return;
       setRankNonFactor(activeRankDim, nm, true);
       renderAll();
       if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus(nm+' → non-factor for '+activeRankDim, 'ok');
     };
   });
   document.querySelectorAll('[data-rank-factor-on]').forEach(function(btn){
     btn.onclick=function(e){
       e.preventDefault();
       e.stopPropagation();
       var nm = btn.getAttribute('data-rank-factor-on');
       if(!nm) return;
       setRankNonFactor(activeRankDim, nm, false);
       renderAll();
       if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus(nm+' → factor for '+activeRankDim, 'ok');
     };
   });
   var af=$('btn-add-rank-factor');
   if(af) af.onclick=function(){
     var label = window.prompt('New score factor label (e.g. Focus, Social)', '');
     if(label == null) return;
     label = String(label).trim();
     if(!label) return;
     var idGuess = label.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, '').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
     if(!idGuess) idGuess = 'X';
     if(idGuess === 'T' || (typeof HDAME_DIMS !== 'undefined' && HDAME_DIMS.indexOf(idGuess) >= 0) || DIMS.indexOf(idGuess) >= 0){
       idGuess = 'F' + idGuess.slice(0, 7);
     }
     var id = window.prompt('Short id (letters/numbers)', idGuess);
     if(id == null) return;
     var means = window.prompt('Higher ranking means… (short description shown above #1)', 'Higher = more '+label.toLowerCase()+' attention for this item.');
     if(means == null) return;
     var inv = window.confirm('Invert this factor? (OK = lower-is-better like Age/External/Money)');
     var res = addRankFactor(id, label, inv, means);
     if(!res || !res.ok){
       if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('Could not add factor: '+(res && res.err || 'error'), 'bad');
       return;
     }
     activeRankDim = res.id;
     renderAll();
     if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('Added score factor '+res.id+' · '+label, 'ok');
   };
   var em=$('btn-edit-rank-means');
   if(em) em.onclick=function(){
     var d = activeRankDim;
     var cur = rankDimHigherMeans(d);
     var next = window.prompt('Higher ranking means… ('+d+' · '+rankDimLabel(d)+')', cur);
     if(next == null) return;
     setRankFactorHigherMeans(d, next);
     renderAll();
     if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('Updated meaning for '+d, 'ok');
   };
   bindFactorOrderDrag();
  }
