  /* ========== JOYS: relationships + optimal vs actual (living-core authored) ========== */
  function joyCatalogList(){
   var cat = window.__RANKING_JOYS_CATALOG__ || {};
   var list = (cat.index && cat.index.joys) || cat.joys || [];
   if(!list.length && window.RankingJoys){
    list = Object.keys(window.RankingJoys).map(function(id){
     var a = window.RankingJoys[id] || {};
     return { id: id, title: a.title || id, polarity: a.polarity || 'neutral', relates_to: [] };
    });
   }
   // densify relates_to from live RankingJoys if missing
   return list.map(function(j){
    var id = j.id || j;
    var live = (window.RankingJoys && window.RankingJoys[id]) || {};
    return {
     id: id,
     title: j.title || live.title || id,
     polarity: j.polarity || live.polarity || 'neutral',
     status: j.status || 'probe',
     relates_to: (j.relates_to && j.relates_to.length) ? j.relates_to.slice() : []
    };
   });
  }

  function joyEdges(){
   var cat = window.__RANKING_JOYS_CATALOG__ || {};
   var edges = (cat.relations && cat.relations.length) ? cat.relations.slice() : [];
   if(!edges.length){
    joyCatalogList().forEach(function(j){
     (j.relates_to||[]).forEach(function(to){
      edges.push({ from: j.id, to: to, label: j.id + ' ↔ ' + to });
     });
    });
   }
   JOY_EDGE_LABELS = Object.create(null);
   edges.forEach(function(e){
    JOY_EDGE_LABELS[e.from + '→' + e.to] = e.label || '';
   });
   return edges;
  }

  function worldJoyCtx(){
   var C = fullCalc();
   var h = C.hdame;
   var debt = C.debt;
   var maxApr = 0;
   (debt.lines||[]).forEach(function(L){
    var a = Number(L.apr)||0;
    if(a > maxApr) maxApr = a;
   });
   var net = C.income.net;
   var living = C.expenses.grand;
   var debtCash = debt.payments;
   var surplus = C.summary.surplus;
   return {
    net: net,
    surplus: surplus,
    outflow: living + debtCash,
    x: living + debtCash,
    y: Math.max(surplus, 0),
    X: net,
    Y: h.hPerMonth || 100,
    monthsTotal: h.months,
    monthIndex: 0,
    monthsLived: 0,
    E: h.ePerMonth,
    Emax: h.ePerMonth,
    D: h.D / Math.max(h.months, 1),
    Dmax: h.D / Math.max(h.months, 1),
    apr: maxApr,
    interest: 0,
    name: 'world',
    get: function(k){
     if(k==='H') return h.hPerMonth;
     if(k==='M') return net;
     if(k==='E') return h.ePerMonth;
     if(k==='D') return h.D / Math.max(h.months, 1);
     if(k==='A') return 1;
     return null;
    },
    _C: C
   };
  }

  function scoreJoy(id, ctx){
   var api = window.RankingJoys && window.RankingJoys[id];
   if(api && typeof api.score === 'function'){
    try { return Number(api.score(ctx)) || 0; } catch(_e){ return 0; }
   }
   // fallbacks via JoyFactors
   if(id==='joy_money' && JFAC && JFAC.scoreMoneyToHappy) return Number(JFAC.scoreMoneyToHappy(ctx))||0;
   if(id==='joy_age_happiness' && JFAC && JFAC.scoreAgeTick) return Number(JFAC.scoreAgeTick(ctx))||0;
   if(id==='joy_debt_urgency' && JFAC && JFAC.scoreDebtPay) return Number(JFAC.scoreDebtPay(ctx))||0;
   if(id==='joy_external' && JFAC && JFAC.externalFactor){
    var t = JFAC.ageT ? JFAC.ageT(ctx) : 0;
    return Number(JFAC.externalFactor(ctx.name||'ext', t, ctx.E, ctx.Emax))||1;
   }
   return 0;
  }

  /**
   * Optimal: jmethod scores on world + per-expense preference order.
   * Actual: current RANKS composite + Exp6 run() stocks.
   */
  function calcOptimalVsActual(){
   var wctx = worldJoyCtx();
   var C = wctx._C;
   var joys = joyCatalogList();
   var joyScores = joys.map(function(j){
    var s = scoreJoy(j.id, wctx);
    return { id: j.id, title: j.title, polarity: j.polarity, optimal: s };
   });
   // normalize joy scores to shares (optimal attention)
   var sumJ = 0;
   joyScores.forEach(function(j){ sumJ += Math.max(0, j.optimal); });
   joyScores.forEach(function(j){
    j.optimalShare = sumJ > 0 ? Math.max(0, j.optimal) / sumJ : 0;
   });
   joyScores.sort(function(a,b){ return b.optimal - a.optimal; });

   // per-expense optimal score from joy graph
   var R = C.ranks;
   var debtByName = {};
   try {
    (C.debt.lines||[]).forEach(function(L){
     (L.fromExpense||[]).forEach(function(en){ debtByName[en] = L; });
    });
   } catch(_e){}

   var expOpt = (R.items||[]).map(function(it){
    var ctx = {
     x: it.cost,
     y: (it.scoreH || 0.1) * 10, // proxy happy units from H share
     X: wctx.X,
     Y: wctx.Y,
     name: it.name,
     monthsTotal: wctx.monthsTotal,
     monthIndex: 0,
     E: wctx.E,
     Emax: wctx.Emax,
     surplus: wctx.surplus,
     net: wctx.net,
     outflow: wctx.outflow,
     get: wctx.get
    };
    var dL = debtByName[it.name];
    if(dL){
     var ap = Number(dL.aprPct);
     if(!isFinite(ap)) ap = Number(dL.apr)||0;
     ctx.apr = ap > 1 ? ap * 0.01 : ap; // fraction for jmethod
     ctx.interest = Number(dL.durationApr)||Number(dL.interestMonth)||0;
     ctx.y = Math.abs(Number(dL.principalSlice)||it.cost);
    }
    var sMoney = scoreJoy('joy_money', ctx);
    var sDebt = dL ? scoreJoy('joy_debt_urgency', ctx) : 0;
    var sAge = scoreJoy('joy_age_happiness', { x: 1, y: ctx.y, monthsTotal: ctx.monthsTotal, monthIndex: 0 });
    var sExt = scoreJoy('joy_external', ctx);
    var sSur = scoreJoy('joy_surplus_freedom', {
     x: it.cost,
     y: Math.max(0, wctx.surplus - it.cost * 0.1),
     X: wctx.net,
     surplus: wctx.surplus,
     net: wctx.net,
     outflow: wctx.outflow,
     apr: ctx.apr || 0,
     name: it.name,
     monthsTotal: ctx.monthsTotal,
     E: ctx.E,
     Emax: ctx.Emax
    });
    // produce prefers surplus; cost dims invert contribution for "prefer this expense"
    // debt pay: higher urgency → more preferred when surplus>0
    var opt = 0.35 * sMoney + 0.25 * sDebt + 0.15 * sAge + 0.10 * sExt + 0.15 * sSur;
    if(dL && wctx.surplus > 0) opt += 0.2 * sDebt;
    return {
     name: it.name,
     cost: it.cost,
     isDebt: !!dL,
     optimalRaw: opt,
     sMoney: sMoney, sDebt: sDebt, sAge: sAge, sExt: sExt, sSur: sSur,
     actualScore: it.score || 0,
     actualRankH: it.rankH || 0,
     actualComposite: it.scoreRaw || 0
    };
   });
   var sumO = 0;
   expOpt.forEach(function(e){ sumO += Math.max(0, e.optimalRaw); });
   expOpt.forEach(function(e){
    e.optimalShare = sumO > 0 ? Math.max(0, e.optimalRaw) / sumO : 0;
   });
   var byOpt = expOpt.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return b.optimalRaw - a.optimalRaw; });
   var byAct = expOpt.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (b.actualScore||0) - (a.actualScore||0); });
   byOpt.forEach(function(e,i){ e.optimalRank = i + 1; });
   byAct.forEach(function(e,i){ e.actualRank = i + 1; });
   // merge ranks back
   var rankMap = {};
   byOpt.forEach(function(e){ rankMap[e.name] = rankMap[e.name] || {}; rankMap[e.name].optimalRank = e.optimalRank; });
   byAct.forEach(function(e){ rankMap[e.name] = rankMap[e.name] || {}; rankMap[e.name].actualRank = e.actualRank; });
   expOpt.forEach(function(e){
    e.optimalRank = rankMap[e.name].optimalRank;
    e.actualRank = rankMap[e.name].actualRank;
    e.deltaRank = e.actualRank - e.optimalRank; // + means actual ranked worse than optimal
   });

   // actual joy attention from HDAME shares + run() stocks
   var stocks = (lastBest && lastBest.ok && lastBest.stocks) ? lastBest.stocks : null;
   var actualJoy = joyScores.map(function(j){
    var act = 0;
    if(j.id === 'joy_money') act = stocks && stocks.M != null ? 1 / (1 + Math.abs(Number(stocks.M))) : (R.world && R.world.M ? 1/(1+R.world.M/1000) : 0);
    else if(j.id === 'joy_age_happiness') act = stocks && stocks.H != null ? Number(stocks.H) : (C.hdame.hPerMonth||0);
    else if(j.id === 'joy_external') act = stocks && stocks.E != null ? Number(stocks.E) : (C.hdame.ePerMonth||0);
    else if(j.id === 'joy_debt_urgency') act = C.debt.payments || 0;
    else if(j.id === 'joy_surplus_freedom') act = Math.max(0, C.summary.surplus);
    return { id: j.id, title: j.title, polarity: j.polarity, optimal: j.optimal, optimalShare: j.optimalShare, actual: act };
   });
   var sumA = 0;
   actualJoy.forEach(function(j){ sumA += Math.max(0, j.actual); });
   actualJoy.forEach(function(j){
    j.actualShare = sumA > 0 ? Math.max(0, j.actual) / sumA : 0;
    j.deltaShare = j.actualShare - j.optimalShare;
   });

   // Kendall-ish: fraction of pairs where order agrees
   var agree = 0, pairs = 0;
   for(var i=0;i<expOpt.length;i++){
    for(var k=i+1;k<expOpt.length;k++){
     var a = expOpt[i], b = expOpt[k];
     var oSign = a.optimalRank < b.optimalRank ? -1 : 1;
     var aSign = a.actualRank < b.actualRank ? -1 : 1;
     if(oSign === aSign) agree++;
     pairs++;
    }
   }
   var agreement = pairs > 0 ? agree / pairs : 1;

   return {
    world: {
     net: wctx.net,
     living: C.expenses.grand,
     debt: C.debt.payments,
     surplus: wctx.surplus,
     months: wctx.monthsTotal,
     maxApr: wctx.apr
    },
    joyScores: joyScores,
    actualJoy: actualJoy,
    expenses: expOpt.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return a.optimalRank - b.optimalRank; }),
    agreement: agreement,
    run: lastBest && lastBest.ok ? { ms: lastBest.ms, stocks: lastBest.stocks, n: lastBest.n } : null,
    edges: joyEdges(),
    joys: joys
   };
  }

  /**
   * Live relationship graph — Moho densest (living-core).
   * Animated SMIL edges/nodes; size ∝ optimal share; L13 layer fires on JOYS tab.
   * Labels sit outside node cores (radial) so text does not float/overlap insides.
   */
  function renderJoyGraphSvg(joys, edges, actualJoy){
   var n = joys.length;
   if(!n) return '<p class="hint">No joys loaded yet — living-core authors into joys/.</p>';
   var shareById = Object.create(null);
   (actualJoy || []).forEach(function(j){
    shareById[j.id] = {
     opt: Number(j.optimalShare) || 0,
     act: Number(j.actualShare) || 0
    };
   });
   // Orbit inset so external labels + bottom legend never collide with edges
   var W = 780, H = 500, pad = 56, cx = W/2, cy = H/2 + 4;
   var R = Math.min(W - pad * 2, H - pad * 2) * (n <= 4 ? 0.36 : n <= 8 ? 0.38 : 0.40) * 0.5;
   // keep R relative to half-size: min*0.5 already; clamp
   R = Math.min(R, Math.min(W, H) * 0.30);
   var pos = {};
   joys.forEach(function(j,i){
    var ang = -Math.PI/2 + (2*Math.PI * i / n);
    pos[j.id] = {
     x: cx + R * Math.cos(ang),
     y: cy + R * Math.sin(ang),
     i: i,
     ang: ang,
     cos: Math.cos(ang),
     sin: Math.sin(ang)
    };
   });
   var polColor = { cost: '#f7768e', produce: '#9ece6a', neutral: '#7dcfff', gain: '#9ece6a', spend: '#f7768e' };
   var uid = 'rg' + String(Date.now()%1e6);
   function clampLabel(x, y){
    return {
     x: Math.max(pad * 0.55, Math.min(W - pad * 0.55, x)),
     y: Math.max(pad * 0.45, Math.min(H - pad * 0.65, y))
    };
   }
   var parts = [];
   parts.push('<div class="joy-svg-wrap moho-relation-live" id="joy-relation-graph">');
   parts.push('<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Joy relationship graph" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">');
   parts.push('<style>');
   parts.push('@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ animate,animateTransform,animateMotion{display:none!important} }');
   parts.push('.rg-edge{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round}');
   parts.push('.rg-label{paint-order:stroke fill;stroke:#0a0c10;stroke-width:3px;stroke-linejoin:round}');
   parts.push('.rg-label-sm{paint-order:stroke fill;stroke:#0a0c10;stroke-width:2.2px;stroke-linejoin:round}');
   parts.push('.rg-legend{opacity:0.85}');
   parts.push('</style>');
   parts.push('<defs>');
   parts.push('<radialGradient id="'+uid+'-void" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="65%">');
   parts.push('<stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1a1b26"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0a0c10"/>');
   parts.push('</radialGradient>');
   parts.push('<linearGradient id="'+uid+'-flow" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">');
   parts.push('<stop offset="0%" stop-color="#bb9af7" stop-opacity="0.2"/>');
   parts.push('<stop offset="50%" stop-color="#7dcfff" stop-opacity="0.9"/>');
   parts.push('<stop offset="100%" stop-color="#9ece6a" stop-opacity="0.25"/>');
   parts.push('<animate attributeName="x1" values="0%;50%;0%" dur="3.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
   parts.push('</linearGradient>');
   parts.push('<filter id="'+uid+'-glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">');
   parts.push('<feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>');
   parts.push('</filter>');
   parts.push('<marker id="'+uid+'-arr" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" refX="6" refY="3.5" orient="auto">');
   parts.push('<path d="M0,0 L7,3.5 L0,7 Z" fill="#7dcfff" opacity="0.85"/>');
   parts.push('</marker>');
   parts.push('</defs>');
   parts.push('<rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#'+uid+'-void)"/>');
   // hub
   parts.push('<circle cx="'+cx+'" cy="'+cy+'" r="18" fill="#12131a" stroke="#bb9af7" stroke-width="1.4"/>');
   parts.push('<circle cx="'+cx+'" cy="'+cy+'" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#7dcfff" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.45">');
   parts.push('<animate attributeName="r" values="18;28;18" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
   parts.push('<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.45;0;0.45" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
   parts.push('</circle>');
   parts.push('<text class="rg-label" x="'+cx+'" y="'+(cy+3.5)+'" text-anchor="middle" fill="#c0caf5" font-size="8" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">HDAME</text>');
   // orbit guide
   parts.push('<circle cx="'+cx+'" cy="'+cy+'" r="'+R.toFixed(1)+'" fill="none" stroke="#3b4261" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 8" opacity="0.4">');
   parts.push('<animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="0;44" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
   parts.push('</circle>');

   // edges — curved via hub, animated flow + packets (no mid-edge labels: they float & collide)
   var ei = 0;
   edges.forEach(function(e){
    var a = pos[e.from], b = pos[e.to];
    if(!a || !b) return;
    var mx = (a.x + b.x) / 2, my = (a.y + b.y) / 2;
    var qx = mx * 0.55 + cx * 0.45;
    var qy = my * 0.55 + cy * 0.45;
    var d = 'M'+a.x.toFixed(1)+','+a.y.toFixed(1)+' Q'+qx.toFixed(1)+','+qy.toFixed(1)+' '+b.x.toFixed(1)+','+b.y.toFixed(1);
    var dur = (2.6 + (ei % 5) * 0.4).toFixed(2);
    var delay = ((ei * 0.15) % 2).toFixed(2);
    var sw = 1.1 + Math.min(1.6, ((shareById[e.from]&&shareById[e.from].opt)||0)*4);
    parts.push('<path class="rg-edge" d="'+d+'" stroke="url(#'+uid+'-flow)" stroke-width="'+sw.toFixed(2)+'" marker-end="url(#'+uid+'-arr)" opacity="0.5" stroke-dasharray="5 8">');
    parts.push('<animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="48;0" dur="'+dur+'s" begin="'+delay+'s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
    parts.push('<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.22;0.78;0.22" dur="'+dur+'s" begin="'+delay+'s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
    parts.push('</path>');
    parts.push('<circle r="2.2" fill="#c0caf5" opacity="0.85">');
    parts.push('<animateMotion dur="'+dur+'s" begin="'+delay+'s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="'+d+'"/>');
    parts.push('<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="'+dur+'s" begin="'+delay+'s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
    parts.push('</circle>');
    ei++;
   });

   // nodes — compact cores; labels OUTSIDE on radial outward so they never stack inside circles
   joys.forEach(function(j, i){
    var p = pos[j.id];
    if(!p) return;
    var sh = shareById[j.id] || { opt: 1/n, act: 0 };
    // Keep cores modest so neighbours do not collide
    var r = 14 + Math.min(10, sh.opt * 32);
    var col = polColor[j.polarity] || polColor.neutral;
    var short = (j.id || '').replace(/^joy_/, '');
    if(short.length > 10) short = short.slice(0, 9) + '…';
    var spin = (3.2 + i * 0.35).toFixed(1);
    var labelR = r + 14;
    var rawL = clampLabel(p.x + p.cos * labelR, p.y + p.sin * labelR);
    var lx = rawL.x, ly = rawL.y;
    // Prefer left/right text-anchor by side of circle so labels do not cross the node
    var anchor = Math.abs(p.cos) < 0.25 ? 'middle' : (p.cos > 0 ? 'start' : 'end');
    // Nudge vertical baseline: top of orbit sits labels above, bottom below
    var ty = ly + (Math.abs(p.cos) < 0.25 ? (p.sin < 0 ? -2 : 10) : 3);
    ty = Math.max(pad * 0.4, Math.min(H - pad * 0.5, ty));
    parts.push('<g class="rg-node" data-joy="'+esc(j.id)+'">');
    // spoke
    parts.push('<line x1="'+cx+'" y1="'+cy+'" x2="'+p.x.toFixed(1)+'" y2="'+p.y.toFixed(1)+'" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="0.7" opacity="0.14"/>');
    // pulse ring (tight, does not invade label space)
    parts.push('<circle cx="'+p.x.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+p.y.toFixed(1)+'" r="'+(r+4).toFixed(1)+'" fill="none" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.3">');
    parts.push('<animate attributeName="r" values="'+(r+2).toFixed(1)+';'+(r+8).toFixed(1)+';'+(r+2).toFixed(1)+'" dur="'+spin+'s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
    parts.push('<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.35;0;0.35" dur="'+spin+'s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
    parts.push('</circle>');
    // core — no text inside
    parts.push('<circle cx="'+p.x.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+p.y.toFixed(1)+'" r="'+r.toFixed(1)+'" fill="#141821" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="2.2" filter="url(#'+uid+'-glow)">');
    parts.push('<animate attributeName="stroke-width" values="2;2.8;2" dur="'+spin+'s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>');
    parts.push('</circle>');
    // actual share arc
    if(sh.act > 0.01){
     var arcR = r + 3;
     var circ = 2 * Math.PI * arcR;
     var dash = Math.max(2, circ * Math.min(1, sh.act));
     parts.push('<circle cx="'+p.x.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+p.y.toFixed(1)+'" r="'+arcR.toFixed(1)+'" fill="none" stroke="#e0af68" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="'+dash.toFixed(1)+' '+(circ).toFixed(1)+'" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.75" transform="rotate(-90 '+p.x.toFixed(1)+' '+p.y.toFixed(1)+')"/>');
    }
    // single mono glyph inside core (first letter) — stable, no multi-line float
    var glyph = short.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?';
    parts.push('<text class="rg-label" x="'+p.x.toFixed(1)+'" y="'+(p.y+4).toFixed(1)+'" text-anchor="middle" fill="'+col+'" font-size="11" font-weight="700" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">'+esc(glyph)+'</text>');
    // external name + share
    parts.push('<text class="rg-label" x="'+lx.toFixed(1)+'" y="'+ty.toFixed(1)+'" text-anchor="'+anchor+'" fill="'+col+'" font-size="10" font-weight="600" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">'+esc(short)+'</text>');
    parts.push('<text class="rg-label-sm" x="'+lx.toFixed(1)+'" y="'+(ty+12).toFixed(1)+'" text-anchor="'+anchor+'" fill="#a9b1d6" font-size="8" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">'+(sh.opt*100).toFixed(0)+'% opt</text>');
    parts.push('</g>');
   });

   // Legend sits in reserved bottom band (not top-left where node labels collide)
   parts.push('<text class="rg-legend rg-label-sm" x="'+pad*0.4+'" y="'+(H-28)+'" fill="#a9b1d6" font-size="9" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">relationship graph · living-core</text>');
   parts.push('<text class="rg-legend rg-label-sm" x="'+pad*0.4+'" y="'+(H-14)+'" fill="#565f89" font-size="8" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">size = optimal · gold arc = actual · labels outside nodes</text>');
   parts.push('</svg>');
   parts.push('<p class="hint joy-graph-caption">SoT: <code>joys/relations.json</code> · jmethods · in-pane motion only.</p>');
   parts.push('</div>');
   return parts.join('');
  }

  /* ========== CALENDAR: Year→Month→Week→Day→Hour→Action→Item (editable) ========== */
  function deepCloneCal(profile){
   try { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(profile || {})); }
   catch(_e){ return profile ? Object.assign({}, profile) : {}; }
  }
  function ensureCalendarsBag(){
   if(!WB) return null;
   var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
   if(!WB.calendars || typeof WB.calendars !== 'object') WB.calendars = {};
   var legacy = WB.calendar;
   SC_ORDER.forEach(function(sc){
    if(WB.calendars[sc]) return;
    var seed = deepCloneCal(legacy || {});
    if(RC && RC.ensureProfile) WB.calendars[sc] = RC.ensureProfile(seed);
    else {
     WB.calendars[sc] = (seed && typeof seed === 'object') ? seed : {
       timezone:'America/Chicago',
       work:{ enabled:true, days:[1,2,3,4,5], startHour:15, endHour:23, timezone:'CST' },
       rules:[], itemOverrides:{}, customActions:[]
     };
    }
   });
   return WB.calendars;
  }
  /** Persist profile into active scenario bag. RankingCalendar helpers often return a new object. */
  function easyCommitCalendar(profile){
   if(!WB) return profile;
   ensureCalendarsBag();
   var sc = activeSc();
   if(!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') profile = WB.calendars[sc] || {};
   WB.calendars[sc] = profile;
   WB.calendar = profile;
   return profile;
  }
  function ensureCalendar(){
   if(!WB) return null;
   ensureCalendarsBag();
   var sc = activeSc();
   var profile = WB.calendars[sc];
   WB.calendar = profile;
   return profile;
  }
  function promoteCalendar(from, to){
   from = normalizeSc(from);
   to = normalizeSc(to);
   if(!WB || from === to) return false;
   ensureCalendarsBag();
   WB.calendars[to] = deepCloneCal(WB.calendars[from] || {});
   var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
   if(RC && RC.ensureProfile) WB.calendars[to] = RC.ensureProfile(WB.calendars[to]);
   if(activeSc() === to) WB.calendar = WB.calendars[to];
   invalidateCalendarCache();
   return true;
  }

  function invalidateCalendarCache(){
   _calHorizonCache = null;
   _calHorizonKey = '';
   try { bumpWorld('invalidateCalendarCache'); } catch(_bw){}
  }

  function moneyAction(amount, polarity){
   if(polarity === 'gain' || polarity === 'produce' || polarity === '+') return money(amount, 'gain');
   return money(amount, 'spend');
  }

  /** True if act contributes chips / money on the live full-horizon sim (not Plan-only empty). */
  function easyActOnCalendar(a){
    if(!a || a.enabled === false) return false;
    var cad = String(a.cadence || '').toLowerCase();
    var keys = a.selectedKeys || a.selected || [];
    var hasMarks = !!(keys && keys.length) ||
      !!(a.yearMarks && Object.keys(a.yearMarks).length) ||
      !!(a.repeatMarks && a.repeatMarks.length);
    if(cad === 'selected' || cad === 'paint' || cad === 'none' || cad === ''){
      return hasMarks;
    }
    // rule cadences (weekdays/monthly/…) count for the full sim without paint
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * Live rollup from calendar placements only.
   * Clear calendar → all zeros. Sheet SUMMARY stays on Income/Expenses tabs.
   */

  /** Today's calendar month in America/Chicago (surplus default). */
  function easyTodayMonth(){
    try {
      if(typeof easyNowCST === 'function'){
        var n = easyNowCST();
        if(n && n.y != null && n.m != null) return { y: n.y|0, m: n.m|0 };
      }
    } catch(_e){}
    var d = new Date();
    try {
      var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Chicago', year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric' }).formatToParts(d);
      var y = d.getFullYear(), m = d.getMonth();
      parts.forEach(function(p){
        if(p.type === 'year') y = parseInt(p.value, 10);
        if(p.type === 'month') m = parseInt(p.value, 10) - 1;
      });
      return { y: y, m: m };
    } catch(_e2){
      return { y: d.getFullYear(), m: d.getMonth() };
    }
  }
  /**
   * Month used for surplus / Exp6 chips.
   * Default = today (Chicago). Only follows the calendar pager if the user left today
   * (easyCal.surplusFollowView), or if easyCal was navigated away from today.
   */
  function easyFocusMonth(){
    var today = easyTodayMonth();
    if(easyCal && easyCal.surplusFollowView && easyCal.y != null && easyCal.m != null){
      return { y: easyCal.y|0, m: easyCal.m|0 };
    }
    // If the month pager is still on today (or unset), always use today.
    if(!easyCal || easyCal.y == null || easyCal.m == null) return today;
    if((easyCal.y|0) === today.y && (easyCal.m|0) === today.m) return today;
    // User navigated the pager away from today → surplus follows the viewed month.
    return { y: easyCal.y|0, m: easyCal.m|0 };
  }
  /**
   * True if act hits the focused calendar month.
   * Rule cadences (monthly/weekdays/…) use easyRuleDaysInMonth — not paint-only occurs.
   * Painted/selected acts use easyMonthDaysOf for that y/m only.
   */
  function easyActInFocusMonth(a){
    if(!a || a.enabled === false) return false;
    if(typeof easyActOnCalendar === 'function' && !easyActOnCalendar(a)) return false;
    var f = easyFocusMonth();
    // Work / semi-monthly: in focus if weekdays hit OR paydays exist this month.
    if(a.kind === 'work' || (typeof easyChargeOn === 'function' && easyChargeOn(a) === 'payDays')){
      try {
        var wrd = (typeof easyRuleDaysInMonth === 'function') ? (easyRuleDaysInMonth(a, f.y, f.m) || []) : [];
        if(wrd.length > 0) return true;
      } catch(_wr){}
      try {
        var pds = (typeof easyPayDays === 'function') ? easyPayDays(a) : [1, 15];
        if(pds && pds.length) return true;
      } catch(_pd){}
    }
    var cad = String(a.cadence || '').toLowerCase();
    // Recurring rules: this month's hits from the rule (marks must not force paint-only path).
    if(cad === 'weekdays' || cad === 'weekends' || cad === 'daily' || cad === 'always' ||
       cad === 'weekly' || cad === 'some_days' || cad === 'monthly' || cad === 'yearly'){
      try {
        var rd = (typeof easyRuleDaysInMonth === 'function') ? (easyRuleDaysInMonth(a, f.y, f.m) || []) : [];
        return rd.length > 0;
      } catch(_r){ return false; }
    }
    // Painted / selected only — days in the focused month.
    try {
      var days = (typeof easyMonthDaysOf === 'function') ? (easyMonthDaysOf(a, f.y, f.m) || []) : [];
      return days.length > 0;
    } catch(_e){}
    if(typeof easyActInScope === 'function'){
      return easyActInScope(a, { kind: 'month', y: f.y, m: f.m });
    }
    return false;
  }


  /**
   * Deterministic this-month money from calendar acts (amountMonthly rates).
   * KPI / live rollup ALWAYS use this — never flaky Best stock leftovers.
   */

  function easyActMonthAmount(a){
    if(!a) return 0;
    var isGain = a.kind === 'work' || a.polarity === 'gain' || a.polarity === 'produce';
    if(isGain){
      try {
        var net = Number((calcIncome() || {}).net);
        if(isFinite(net)) return Math.abs(net);
      } catch(_i){}
      return Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
    }
    var name = a.expenseName || a.name;
    if(name){
      // Same $ as EXPENSES / SUMMARY: lineAmt (scenario field, honor [REDACTED-AMOUNT]; no baked amountMonthly).
      try {
        var secs = (WB && WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections) || [];
        for(var si = 0; si < secs.length; si++){
          var rows = (secs[si] && secs[si].items) || [];
          for(var ri = 0; ri < rows.length; ri++){
            var row = rows[ri];
            if(!row || row.name !== name) continue;
            if(typeof lineAmt === 'function') return Math.abs(Number(lineAmt(row)) || 0);
            var lf = (typeof lineField === 'function') ? lineField() : 'current';
            var strict = row[lf];
            if(strict !== '' && strict != null && isFinite(Number(strict))) return Math.abs(Number(strict));
            return 0;
          }
        }
      } catch(_e2){}
      try {
        var items = (typeof easyExpenseItems === 'function') ? (easyExpenseItems() || []) : [];
        for(var i = 0; i < items.length; i++){
          var it = items[i];
          if(it && it.name === name) return Math.abs(Number(it.amount) || 0);
        }
      } catch(_e){}
    }
    // Unknown non-sheet act: keep baked monthly only as last resort
    return Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
  }


  /**
   * Where this day sits in an act's consecutive occurrence span (1-based).
   * Used so accepted items stay visually spanned (i/N · $ on last).
   */
  function easySpanPosOnDay(a, y, m, d){
    if(!a || !easyOccurs || !easyOccurs(a, y, m, d)) return null;
    var declared = (typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(a) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(a.spanDays)||1));
    var isSpan = !!(a.span || declared > 1 || a.chargeOn === 'lastSpan');
    if(!isSpan && !(a.kind === 'work')){
      // single-day placement
      return { index: 1, spanDays: 1, charge: (typeof easyChargesOnDay === 'function') ? !!easyChargesOnDay(a, y, m, d) : true, presenceOnly: false };
    }
    // Walk backward to span start (consecutive occurs)
    var start = { y: y, m: m, d: d };
    var guard = 0;
    while(guard++ < 40){
      var prev = (typeof easyAddCalDays === 'function') ? easyAddCalDays(start.y, start.m, start.d, -1) : null;
      if(!prev || !easyOccurs(a, prev.y, prev.m, prev.d)) break;
      start = prev;
    }
    var index = 1;
    var cur = { y: start.y, m: start.m, d: start.d };
    guard = 0;
    while(!(cur.y === y && cur.m === m && cur.d === d) && guard++ < 40){
      cur = easyAddCalDays(cur.y, cur.m, cur.d, 1);
      index++;
    }
    var spanDays = Math.max(declared, index);
    // count forward for full run length
    cur = { y: y, m: m, d: d };
    var run = index;
    guard = 0;
    while(guard++ < 40){
      var next = easyAddCalDays(cur.y, cur.m, cur.d, 1);
      if(!next || !easyOccurs(a, next.y, next.m, next.d)) break;
      cur = next;
      run++;
    }
    spanDays = Math.max(spanDays, run);
    var charge = false;
    if(typeof easyChargesOnDay === 'function') charge = !!easyChargesOnDay(a, y, m, d);
    else charge = (index === spanDays);
    return { index: index, spanDays: spanDays, charge: charge, presenceOnly: !charge && spanDays > 1 };
  }
  function easySpanDays(a){
    var n = Number(a && a.spanDays);
    return (isFinite(n) && n >= 1) ? Math.floor(n) : 1;
  }
  /**
   * Days (D) rank → calendar span length.
   * HDAME monthly D pool ≈ 365/12 days; item.D = monthlyD * harmonic D-share.
   * Higher D-rank (#1) → longer span. Money still charges once on last span day.
   */
  function easyDSpanDays(a){
    if(!a) return 1;
    var nm = a.name || a.expenseName || '';
    var dVal = null;
    try {
      if(a.rankDDays != null && isFinite(Number(a.rankDDays))) dVal = Number(a.rankDDays);
      else if(a.D != null && isFinite(Number(a.D)) && Number(a.D) > 0) dVal = Number(a.D);
      else if(typeof calcRanks === 'function'){
        var R = calcRanks();
        var row = (R && R.byName && nm) ? R.byName[nm] : null;
        if(row && row.D != null && isFinite(Number(row.D))) dVal = Number(row.D);
      }
    } catch(_e){ dVal = null; }
    if(!(dVal > 0)){
      // Fallback from D order position if scores missing
      try {
        var ord = (WB && WB.rankOrders && WB.rankOrders.D) || [];
        var ix = ord.indexOf(nm);
        if(ix >= 0 && ord.length){
          // crude: top gets more days (harmonic-ish)
          var k = ix + 1;
          var inv = 0;
          for(var i = 1; i <= ord.length; i++) inv += 1 / i;
          dVal = (365 / 12) * ((1 / k) / Math.max(inv, 1e-9));
        }
      } catch(_f){}
    }
    if(!(dVal > 0)) return 1;
    var n = Math.round(dVal);
    if(n < 1) n = 1;
    if(n > 31) n = 31;
    return n;
  }
  /**
   * Overall score → hours for a suggest block.
   * calcRanks composite score 0–1 (or rankScore); higher → longer duration in the awake window.
   */
  function easyScore01(a){
    if(!a) return 0;
    var score = null;
    try {
      if(a.rankScore != null && isFinite(Number(a.rankScore)) && Number(a.rankScore) > 0) score = Number(a.rankScore);
      if((score == null || !(score > 0)) && a.score != null && isFinite(Number(a.score)) && Number(a.score) > 0) score = Number(a.score);
      if((score == null || !(score > 0)) && a.score1000 != null && isFinite(Number(a.score1000))) score = Number(a.score1000) / 1000;
      if((score == null || !(score > 0)) && typeof calcRanks === 'function' && (a.name || a.expenseName)){
        var R = calcRanks();
        var row = R && R.byName ? (R.byName[a.name] || R.byName[a.expenseName]) : null;
        if(row){
          if(row.score != null && Number(row.score) > 0) score = Number(row.score);
          else if(row.scoreRaw != null) score = Number(row.scoreRaw);
        }
        // Fallback: harmonic place in H or composite order
        if((score == null || !(score > 0)) && R && R.items && R.items.length){
          var items = R.items.slice().sort(function(x,y){ return (Number(y.score)||0) - (Number(x.score)||0); });
          var ix = -1, nm = a.name || a.expenseName;
          for(var i = 0; i < items.length; i++){ if(items[i] && items[i].name === nm){ ix = i; break; } }
          if(ix >= 0){
            var inv = 0, k;
            for(k = 1; k <= items.length; k++) inv += 1 / k;
            score = ((1 / (ix + 1)) / Math.max(inv, 1e-9));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch(_e){ score = null; }
    if(score == null || !isFinite(score) || !(score > 0)){
      // Appetizing/ranked suggests must not collapse to 30m — use mid floor
      if(a && (a.appetizing || a.fromRanks || a.__forceSelGap)) return 0.45;
      return 0.15;
    }
    if(score > 1.5) score = score / 1000;
    if(score < 0) score = 0;
    if(score > 1) score = 1;
    return score;
  }
  function easyScoreDurMin(a, awakeLen, openLen){
    var awake = Math.max(60, Number(awakeLen) || (12 * 60));
    var open = Math.max(60, Number(openLen) || awake);
    var s = easyScore01(a);
    var minM = 45; // easy83: fit floor, not fake fat
    var maxM = Math.min(awake, open); // full open window — no 3.5h cap
    if(maxM < 90) maxM = 90;
    var dur = Math.round(minM + (maxM - minM) * s);
    dur = Math.round(dur / 15) * 15;
    if(dur < minM) dur = minM;
    if(dur > maxM) dur = maxM;
    return dur;
  }

  function easyChargeOn(a){
    if(a && a.chargeOn) return String(a.chargeOn);
    if(a && a.kind === 'work') return 'payDays';
    if(easySpanDays(a) > 1) return 'lastSpan';
    return 'monthly';
  }
  function easyPayDays(a){
    var pd = (a && a.payDays) || (a && a.kind === 'work' ? [1, 15] : null);
    return Array.isArray(pd) && pd.length ? pd.map(Number).filter(function(d){ return d >= 1 && d <= 31; }) : [];
  }
  function easyAddCalDays(y, m, d, delta){
    var dt = new Date(y, m, d + delta);
    return { y: dt.getFullYear(), m: dt.getMonth(), d: dt.getDate() };
  }
  function easyDimOf(y, m){
    if(window.RankingCalendar && RankingCalendar.daysInMonth) return RankingCalendar.daysInMonth(y, m);
    return new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
  }

  /** Semi-monthly pay periods: 2→15 (pay 15) and 16→1 next month (pay 1). */
  function easyPrevPayDay(payDays, payD){
    var pds = (payDays || [1, 15]).slice().map(Number).filter(function(x){ return x >= 1 && x <= 31; });
    pds.sort(function(a,b){ return a - b; });
    if(!pds.length) pds = [1, 15];
    var i, prev = pds[pds.length - 1];
    for(i = 0; i < pds.length; i++){
      if(pds[i] === payD){
        prev = i > 0 ? pds[i - 1] : pds[pds.length - 1];
        break;
      }
      if(pds[i] < payD) prev = pds[i];
    }
    return prev;
  }
  /**
   * Bounds for the work span that earns payday (payY,payM,payD).
   * Start = day after previous payday (cross-month ok). End = payday inclusive.
   * Default [1,15]: pay 15 → 2..15; pay 1 → prev-month 16 .. 1.
   */
  function easyPayPeriodBounds(payY, payM, payD, payDays){
    payDays = payDays || [1, 15];
    var prev = easyPrevPayDay(payDays, payD);
    var start;
    if(prev < payD){
      start = { y: payY, m: payM, d: prev + 1 };
    } else {
      // previous payday is later in calendar month → start in prior month
      var pm = payM - 1, py = payY;
      if(pm < 0){ pm = 11; py = payY - 1; }
      var dimP = easyDimOf(py, pm);
      var sd = Math.min(prev + 1, dimP);
      if(prev + 1 > dimP){
        // prev was last day of prior? then start = this month day 1 — rare
        start = { y: payY, m: payM, d: 1 };
      } else {
        start = { y: py, m: pm, d: sd };
      }
      // Classic 15 then 1: prev=15, payD=1 → start = prev month 16
      if(prev >= payD){
        start = { y: py, m: pm, d: Math.min(prev + 1, dimP) };
        if(prev + 1 > dimP) start = { y: payY, m: payM, d: 1 };
      }
    }
    // Normalize classic case explicitly for [1,15]
    var sorted = payDays.slice().map(Number).sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; });
    if(sorted.length === 2 && sorted[0] === 1 && sorted[1] === 15){
      if(payD === 15) start = { y: payY, m: payM, d: 2 };
      else if(payD === 1){
        var pm2 = payM - 1, py2 = payY;
        if(pm2 < 0){ pm2 = 11; py2 = payY - 1; }
        start = { y: py2, m: pm2, d: 16 };
      }
    }
    return {
      start: start,
      end: { y: payY, m: payM, d: payD },
      payY: payY, payM: payM, payD: payD
    };
  }
  /** Which payday a calendar day contributes toward (work span membership). */
  function easyPayPeriodForDate(y, m, d, payDays){
    payDays = payDays || [1, 15];
    var sorted = payDays.slice().map(Number).sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; });
    if(sorted.length === 2 && sorted[0] === 1 && sorted[1] === 15){
      if(d === 1) return easyPayPeriodBounds(y, m, 1, payDays);
      if(d >= 2 && d <= 15) return easyPayPeriodBounds(y, m, 15, payDays);
      // 16..end → next month's 1st
      var nm = m + 1, ny = y;
      if(nm > 11){ nm = 0; ny = y + 1; }
      return easyPayPeriodBounds(ny, nm, 1, payDays);
    }
    // Generic: next payday on or after d, else next month first payDay
    var i, payD = null, payY = y, payM = m;
    for(i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++){
      if(d <= sorted[i]){ payD = sorted[i]; break; }
    }
    if(payD == null){
      payD = sorted[0];
      payM = m + 1;
      if(payM > 11){ payM = 0; payY = y + 1; }
    }
    return easyPayPeriodBounds(payY, payM, payD, payDays);
  }
  function easyEachDayInRange(start, end, fn){
    if(!start || !end) return;
    var cur = { y: start.y, m: start.m, d: start.d };
    var guard = 0;
    while(guard++ < 400){
      fn(cur.y, cur.m, cur.d);
      if(cur.y === end.y && cur.m === end.m && cur.d === end.d) break;
      cur = easyAddCalDays(cur.y, cur.m, cur.d, 1);
      if(cur.y > end.y || (cur.y === end.y && cur.m > end.m) || (cur.y === end.y && cur.m === end.m && cur.d > end.d)) break;
    }
  }
  /** Mon–Fri days in [start,end] inclusive (may cross months). */
  function easyWeekdaysInPayPeriod(bounds){
    var out = [];
    if(!bounds || !bounds.start || !bounds.end) return out;
    easyEachDayInRange(bounds.start, bounds.end, function(y, m, d){
      var dow = new Date(y, m, d).getDay();
      if(dow >= 1 && dow <= 5) out.push({ y: y, m: m, d: d });
    });
    return out;
  }

  /** True if d is the last day of a spanDays-length consecutive occur run ending at d. */
  function easyIsSpanEndDay(a, y, m, d){
    if(!a || !easyOccurs(a, y, m, d)) return false;
    var span = easySpanDays(a);
    if(span <= 1) return true;
    var i;
    for(i = 0; i < span; i++){
      var p = easyAddCalDays(y, m, d, -(span - 1 - i));
      if(!easyOccurs(a, p.y, p.m, p.d)) return false;
    }
    var next = easyAddCalDays(y, m, d, 1);
    if(easyOccurs(a, next.y, next.m, next.d)){
      var before = easyAddCalDays(y, m, d, -span);
      if(easyOccurs(a, before.y, before.m, before.d)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  /** True if money for this act hits calendar day y-m-d */
  function easyChargesOnDay(a, y, m, d){
    if(!a) return false;
    var mode = easyChargeOn(a);
    var dim = easyDimOf(y, m);
    if(mode === 'payDays'){
      return easyPayDays(a).some(function(pd){ return d === Math.min(pd, dim); });
    }
    if(mode === 'eachOccur') return !!easyOccurs(a, y, m, d);
    if(mode === 'monthly'){
      var days = (typeof easyRuleDaysInMonth === 'function') ? (easyRuleDaysInMonth(a, y, m) || []) : [];
      if(!days.length && typeof easyMonthDaysOf === 'function'){
        days = (easyMonthDaysOf(a, y, m) || []).map(function(p){ return p.d != null ? p.d : p; });
      }
      return !!(days.length && d === days[0]);
    }
    if(mode === 'lastSpan'){
      if(!easyOccurs(a, y, m, d)) return false;
      return easyIsSpanEndDay(a, y, m, d);
    }
    return false;
  }
  function easyAmountOnDay(a, y, m, d){
    if(!easyChargesOnDay(a, y, m, d)) return 0;
    var amt = (typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') ? easyActMonthAmount(a) : Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
    if(a.endDate){ // easy218: calendar honors end dates / final payment
      var mm = m+1, ym = y+'-'+(mm<10?'0':'')+mm, ymd = ym+'-'+(d<10?'0':'')+d;
      if(a.finalMonth && ym === a.finalMonth) amt = Math.abs(Number(a.finalAmount) || 0);
      else if((a.finalMonth && ym > a.finalMonth) || ymd > a.endDate) return 0;
    }
    if(!(amt > 0)) return 0;
    var mode = easyChargeOn(a);
    var dim = easyDimOf(y, m);
    if(mode === 'payDays'){
      var pds = easyPayDays(a);
      var hits = [];
      pds.forEach(function(pd){
        var x = Math.min(pd, dim);
        if(x >= 1 && hits.indexOf(x) < 0) hits.push(x);
      });
      var n = Math.max(1, hits.length);
      return amt / n;
    }
    if(mode === 'lastSpan'){
      var spanN2 = (typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(a) : 1;
      var lastEnd = 0;
      for(var dd = 1; dd <= dim; dd++){
        if(easyIsSpanEndDay(a, y, m, dd)) lastEnd = dd;
      }
      if(d !== lastEnd) return 0;
      return amt; // once at last span-end (monthChargeTotal also guards span1×daily)
    }
    if(mode === 'eachOccur'){
      var occ = 0;
      for(var od = 1; od <= dim; od++){
        if(easyOccurs(a, y, m, od)) occ++;
      }
      return amt / Math.max(1, occ);
    }
    return amt;
  }
  /** Month $ total for one act under chargeOn rules (never × every weekday). */
  function easyMonthChargeTotal(a, y, m){
    if(!a) return 0;
    var mode = easyChargeOn(a);
    var dim = easyDimOf(y, m);
    if(mode === 'payDays' || mode === 'eachOccur'){
      var sum = 0;
      for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++) sum += easyAmountOnDay(a, y, m, d);
      return sum;
    }
    if(mode === 'lastSpan'){
      var spanN = (typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(a) : 1;
      // spanDays<=1 + monthly cadence = one month $ (not $×each day of marks)
      var cad = String((a && a.cadence) || '').toLowerCase();
      if(spanN <= 1 && (cad === 'monthly' || cad === '' || a.monthOnce)){
        return (typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') ? easyActMonthAmount(a) : Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
      }
      var lastEnd = 0;
      var endCount = 0;
      for(var d2 = 1; d2 <= dim; d2++){
        if(easyIsSpanEndDay(a, y, m, d2)){ lastEnd = d2; endCount++; }
      }
      if(!lastEnd) return 0;
      // Multiple span-ends with span 1 would be daily — still pay month amount once
      if(spanN <= 1 && endCount > 1){
        return (typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') ? easyActMonthAmount(a) : Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
      }
      return easyAmountOnDay(a, y, m, lastEnd);
    }
    // monthly: once if in month
    return (typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') ? easyActMonthAmount(a) : Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
  }
  function easyWeekdaySpanInMonth(y, m){
    var dim = easyDimOf(y, m);
    var n = 0;
    for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
      var dow = new Date(y, m, d).getDay();
      if(dow >= 1 && dow <= 5) n++;
    }
    return n;
  }
  function easyMigrateWorkPaySpan(a){
    if(!a || a.kind !== 'work') return false;
    var ch = false;
    if(!a.chargeOn){ a.chargeOn = 'payDays'; ch = true; }
    if(!Array.isArray(a.payDays) || !a.payDays.length){ a.payDays = [1, 15]; ch = true; }
    if(a.spanMode !== 'payPeriod'){ a.spanMode = 'payPeriod'; ch = true; }
    // spanDays = weekday count of a representative period (focus month's 2→15); ranking signal
    try {
      var f = (typeof easyFocusMonth === 'function') ? easyFocusMonth() : null;
      if(f){
        var b = easyPayPeriodBounds(f.y, f.m, 15, a.payDays || [1, 15]);
        var wds = easyWeekdaysInPayPeriod(b);
        var n = Math.max(1, wds.length);
        if(Number(a.spanDays) !== n){ a.spanDays = n; ch = true; }
      } else if(a.spanDays == null || !(Number(a.spanDays) >= 1)){ a.spanDays = 1; ch = true; }
    } catch(_s){
      if(a.spanDays == null || !(Number(a.spanDays) >= 1)){ a.spanDays = 1; ch = true; }
    }
    return ch;
  }
  function easyEnsureWorkPaySpanDefaults(){
    var acts = [];
    try { acts = (WB && WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || []; } catch(_a){ acts = []; }
    var n = 0;
    acts.forEach(function(a){
      if(easyMigrateWorkPaySpan(a)){ try { easyCommitQuiet(a); } catch(_c){} n++; }
    });
    return n;
  }

  function easyMonthMoneyRoll(){
    var f = (typeof easyFocusMonth === 'function') ? easyFocusMonth() : null;
    var gain = 0, living = 0, debt = 0, nActs = 0;
    var acts = [];
    // Calendar placements = schedule SoT. Money KPI follows SUMMARY once anything is placed.
    try { acts = (WB && WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || []; } catch(_a){ acts = []; }
    // Do NOT auto-seed here — Clear must stay empty (work was coming back via reseed).
    acts.forEach(function(a){ try { if(typeof easyMigrateWorkPaySpan === 'function') easyMigrateWorkPaySpan(a); } catch(_m){} });
    acts.forEach(function(a){
      if(!a || !easyActOnCalendar(a)) return;
      if(typeof easyActInFocusMonth === 'function' && !easyActInFocusMonth(a)) return;
      var amt = (typeof easyMonthChargeTotal === 'function' && f)
        ? easyMonthChargeTotal(a, f.y, f.m)
        : ((typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') ? easyActMonthAmount(a) : Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0));
      if(!(amt > 0) && a.kind !== 'work') return;
      nActs++;
      var isGain = a.kind === 'work' || a.polarity === 'gain' || a.polarity === 'produce';
      var isDebt = !!(a.isDebtPay || a.payToDebt != null || (a.expenseName && (function(){
        try {
          var hit = false;
          (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
            (sec.items || []).forEach(function(row){
              if(row && (row.name === a.expenseName || row.name === a.name) && (row.payToDebt != null || debtPayIndex(row) >= 0)) hit = true;
            });
          });
          return hit;
        } catch(_e){ return false; }
      })()));
      if(isGain) gain += amt;
      else if(isDebt) debt += amt;
      else living += amt;
    });
    // Clear → live rollup [REDACTED-AMOUNT]
    if(!(nActs > 0) && !(gain > 0 || living > 0 || debt > 0)){
      return { gain: 0, living: 0, debt: 0, surplus: 0, nActs: 0, y: f ? f.y : null, m: f ? f.m : null, source: 'clear' };
    }
    // Calendar has money → rollup matches SUMMARY (sheet SoT)
    try {
      var S = (typeof calcSummary === 'function') ? calcSummary() : null;
      if(S){
        return {
          gain: Number(S.net) || 0,
          living: Number(S.living) || 0,
          debt: Number(S.debtPayments) || 0,
          surplus: Number(S.surplus) || 0,
          nActs: nActs,
          y: f ? f.y : null,
          m: f ? f.m : null,
          source: 'summary'
        };
      }
    } catch(_sum){}
    return {
      gain: gain,
      living: living,
      debt: debt,
      surplus: gain - living - debt,
      nActs: nActs,
      y: f ? f.y : null,
      m: f ? f.m : null,
      source: 'calendar'
    };
  }

  function easyCalendarRollup(){
    if(typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function'){
      var R = easyMonthMoneyRoll();
      return { gain:R.gain, living:R.living, debt:R.debt, surplus:R.surplus, nActs:R.nActs, nGain:0, nLive:0, nDebt:0 };
    }
    var gain = 0, living = 0, debt = 0, nGain = 0, nLive = 0, nDebt = 0, nActs = 0;
    var acts = [];
    try { acts = getCalendarCustomActions() || []; } catch(_a){ acts = []; }
    acts.forEach(function(a){
      if(!easyActOnCalendar(a)) return;
      if(typeof easyActInFocusMonth === 'function' && !easyActInFocusMonth(a)) return;
      nActs++;
      var amt = Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
      if(!(amt > 0) && a.kind !== 'work') return;
      var isGain = a.kind === 'work' || a.polarity === 'gain' || a.polarity === 'produce';
      var isDebt = !!(a.isDebtPay || a.payToDebt != null || (a.expenseName && (function(){
        try {
          var hit = false;
          (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
            (sec.items || []).forEach(function(row){
              if(row && (row.name === a.expenseName || row.name === a.name) && (row.payToDebt != null || debtPayIndex(row) >= 0)) hit = true;
            });
          });
          return hit;
        } catch(_e){ return false; }
      })()));
      if(isGain){ gain += amt; nGain++; }
      else if(isDebt){ debt += amt; nDebt++; }
      else { living += amt; nLive++; }
    });
    return {
      gain: gain,
      living: living,
      debt: debt,
      surplus: gain - living - debt,
      nActs: nActs,
      nGain: nGain,
      nLive: nLive,
      nDebt: nDebt
    };
  }
  function easyExpenseSeedAct(it){
    var amt = Number(it && it.amount) || 0;
    var isDebt = false;
    try {
      (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
        (sec.items || []).forEach(function(row){
          if(row && row.name === it.name && (row.payToDebt != null || debtPayIndex(row) >= 0)) isDebt = true;
        });
      });
    } catch(_e){}
    return {
      id: easyNewId(it.name),
      name: it.name,
      kind: 'spend',
      polarity: 'spend',
      amountMonthly: amt,
      expenseName: it.name,
      expenseSection: it.section || 'EXPENSE',
      isDebtPay: isDebt,
      cadence: 'monthly',
      day: 1,
      selectedKeys: [],
      hours: ['all'],
      allDay: true,
      lane: 'plan',
      scheduleOnly: false,
      section: it.section || 'EXPENSE',
      author: 'ranking_ui',
      enabled: true
    };
  }
  /** Place sheet $ lines + work onto a scenario calendar so live rollup matches SUMMARY. */
  function easySeedScenarioCalendar(sc){
    sc = normalizeSc(sc);
    return easyWithScenario(sc, function(){
      var added = 0, updated = 0, workAdded = 0;
      var items = [];
      try { items = easyValuedExpenseItems() || []; } catch(_e){ items = []; }
      items.forEach(function(it){
        if(!it || !it.name || !(it.amount > 0)) return;
        var existing = null;
        (easyScheduleActions() || []).forEach(function(a){
          if(a && (a.expenseName === it.name || a.name === it.name)) existing = a;
        });
        if(existing){
          var changed = false;
          if(Number(existing.amountMonthly) !== Number(it.amount)){ existing.amountMonthly = it.amount; changed = true; }
          if(!easyActOnCalendar(existing)){
            existing.cadence = 'monthly';
            existing.day = existing.day != null ? existing.day : 1;
            existing.selectedKeys = [];
            existing.hours = existing.hours && existing.hours.length ? existing.hours : ['all'];
            existing.allDay = true;
            changed = true;
          }
          existing.polarity = 'spend';
          existing.kind = existing.kind === 'work' ? existing.kind : 'spend';
          existing.expenseName = it.name;
          existing.scheduleOnly = false;
          if(changed){ easyCommitQuiet(existing); updated++; }
          return;
        }
        easyCommitQuiet(easyExpenseSeedAct(it));
        added++;
      });
      var hasWork = false;
      (easyScheduleActions() || []).forEach(function(a){
        if(a && a.kind === 'work' && easyActOnCalendar(a)) hasWork = true;
      });
      if(!hasWork){
        var w = easyBlankWorkAct('Work');
        w.scheduleOnly = false;
        easyCommitQuiet(w);
        workAdded++;
      } else {
        // refresh work $ to scenario net
        (easyScheduleActions() || []).forEach(function(a){
          if(a && a.kind === 'work'){
            var net = 0;
            try { net = Number((calcIncome() || {}).net) || 0; } catch(_n){}
            var wchg = false;
            if(Number(a.amountMonthly) !== net){
              a.amountMonthly = net; wchg = true;
            }
            if(!easyActOnCalendar(a)){
              a.cadence = 'weekdays';
              a.days = [1,2,3,4,5];
              wchg = true;
            }
            a.polarity = 'gain';
            a.scheduleOnly = false;
            if(typeof easyMigrateWorkPaySpan === 'function' && easyMigrateWorkPaySpan(a)) wchg = true;
            else {
              if(!a.chargeOn){ a.chargeOn = 'payDays'; wchg = true; }
              if(!a.payDays || !a.payDays.length){ a.payDays = [1, 15]; wchg = true; }
              if(a.spanDays == null){ a.spanDays = 1; wchg = true; }
            }
            if(wchg){
              easyCommitQuiet(a);
              updated++;
            }
          }
        });
      }
      return { sc: sc, added: added, updated: updated, workAdded: workAdded };
    });
  }
  function easySeedAllCalendarsFromSheet(){
    var out = [];
    SC_ORDER.forEach(function(sc){
      try { out.push(easySeedScenarioCalendar(sc)); }
      catch(_e){ out.push({ sc: sc, error: String(_e && _e.message || _e) }); }
    });
    invalidateCalendarCache();
    try { if(typeof _easyBestTick === 'number'){ _easyBestTick++; _easyJgAt = -1; } } catch(_t){}
    return out;
  }
  /** Ensure active scenario calendar has every valued EXPENSES line so live surplus matches SUMMARY. */
  function easyReconcileCalendarToSheet(sc){
    sc = normalizeSc(sc || (typeof activeSc === 'function' ? activeSc() : 'current'));
    var seed = easySeedScenarioCalendar(sc);
    invalidateCalendarCache();
    try { if(typeof _easyBestTick === 'number'){ _easyBestTick++; _easyJgAt = -1; } } catch(_t){}
    var sheet = null, roll = null;
    try { sheet = (typeof calcSummary === 'function') ? calcSummary() : null; } catch(_s){}
    try { roll = (typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function') ? easyMonthMoneyRoll() : null; } catch(_r){}
    return { sc: sc, seed: seed, sheet: sheet, roll: roll };
  }
  try {
    window.easyReconcileCalendarToSheet = easyReconcileCalendarToSheet;
    window.easySeedScenarioCalendar = easySeedScenarioCalendar;
    window.easyMonthMoneyRoll = easyMonthMoneyRoll;
    window.easyCalcSummary = calcSummary;
  } catch(_ex){}


  function easyCalendarTombstoneSet(){
   var set = Object.create(null);
   var list = (WB && WB.calendarActionTombstones) || [];
   (list || []).forEach(function(x){
     if(x == null || x === '') return;
     set[String(x)] = 1;
   });
   return set;
  }
  /** Remember deleted living-core catalog actions so reload can't resurrect them. */
  function easyTombstoneCalendarAction(idOrName){
   if(!WB || idOrName == null || idOrName === '') return;
   if(!Array.isArray(WB.calendarActionTombstones)) WB.calendarActionTombstones = [];
   var s = String(idOrName);
   if(WB.calendarActionTombstones.indexOf(s) < 0) WB.calendarActionTombstones.push(s);
  }
  function easyIsTombstonedAction(a, tomb){
   if(!a) return true;
   tomb = tomb || easyCalendarTombstoneSet();
   var id = a.id != null ? String(a.id) : '';
   var nm = a.name != null ? String(a.name) : '';
   return !!(tomb[id] || tomb[nm]);
  }
  function getCalendarCustomActions(){
   var fromWb = (WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || [];
   var fromCat = (window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ && window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions) || [];
   // Workbook scenario bag is SoT for money. Catalog may add lore schedule-only
   // (no $) acts, never spend/work/debt — prevents cross-scenario surplus leaks.
   // Tombstones (Save-backed) hide deleted living-core catalog rows after reload.
   var tomb = easyCalendarTombstoneSet();
   var out = [], seen = Object.create(null);
   function add(a, fromCatalog){
    if(!a || !a.name) return;
    if(easyIsTombstonedAction(a, tomb)) return;
    if(a.kind === 'work' && !(a.scheduleOnly || a.lane || a.author === 'ranking_ui')) return;
    if(fromCatalog){
      var moneyish = a.kind === 'work' || a.kind === 'spend' || a.polarity === 'spend' || a.polarity === 'gain' ||
        a.expenseName || (Number(a.amountMonthly) > 0) || (Number(a.amount) > 0) ||
        a.isDebtPay || a.payToDebt != null;
      if(moneyish) return;
    }
    var k = a.id || a.name;
    if(seen[k]) return;
    seen[k] = 1;
    out.push(a);
   }
   fromWb.forEach(function(a){ add(a, false); });
   fromCat.forEach(function(a){ add(a, true); });
   return out;
  }

  function getCalendarHorizon(){
   var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
   if(!RC || !RC.buildHorizon) return null;
   var profile = ensureCalendar();
   var years = Number(WB.hdame && WB.hdame.years) || 150;
   // Live rollup SoT = sim calendar only (lastBest from liveBest/run).
   var roll = (typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function')
    ? easyMonthMoneyRoll()
    : ((lastBest && lastBest.calendar) || { gain:0, living:0, debt:0, surplus:0, nActs:0 });
   var items = [];
   var customsAll = getCalendarCustomActions() || [];
   var customs = customsAll.filter(function(a){ return easyActOnCalendar(a); });
   customs.forEach(function(a){
    if(!a || !a.name) return;
    var amt = Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
    var isGain = a.kind === 'work' || a.polarity === 'gain' || a.polarity === 'produce';
    var isDebt = !!a.isDebtPay;
    items.push({
     id: a.id || ('cal_' + String(a.name).replace(/\W+/g, '_').slice(0, 28)),
     name: a.name,
     cost: amt,
     section: a.section || a.expenseSection || (a.kind === 'work' ? 'WORK' : 'CALENDAR'),
     isDebtPay: isDebt,
     polarity: isGain ? 'gain' : (amt ? 'spend' : 'neutral'),
     score: 0,
     rankH: 0,
     isCustom: true,
     scheduleOnly: !(amt > 0) && a.kind !== 'work'
    });
   });
   var inc = { net: roll.gain, gross: roll.gain };
   var world = { living: roll.living, debtCash: roll.debt, surplus: roll.surplus };
   // Build horizon from a shallow profile copy so merged catalog never overwrites scenario SoT.
   profile = Object.assign({}, profile, {
     customActions: customs,
     income: inc,
     world: world,
     work: profile.work ? Object.assign({}, profile.work, { monthlyIncome: roll.gain }) : profile.work
   });
   var startYear = (profile && profile.startYear) || new Date().getFullYear();
   var focus = (typeof easyFocusMonth === 'function') ? easyFocusMonth() : { y:0, m:0 };
   var key = activeSc() + '|' + years + '|' + startYear + '|F'+focus.y+'-'+focus.m+'|' + inc.net + '|' + world.surplus + '|' + world.living + '|' + world.debtCash + '|' +
    JSON.stringify(profile.work) + '|' + (customs||[]).map(function(a){
      return (a&&a.id||'')+'@'+(a&&a.at||'')+':'+(a&&a.cadence||'')+':'+(a.selectedKeys&&a.selectedKeys.length||0)+':'+(a.repeatMarks&&a.repeatMarks.length||0);
    }).join('|') + '|' +
    items.map(function(i){ return i.name + ':' + i.cost; }).join(';');
   if(_calHorizonCache && _calHorizonKey === key) return _calHorizonCache;
   _calHorizonCache = RC.buildHorizon({
    years: years,
    startYear: startYear,
    items: items,
    profile: profile,
    calendar: profile,
    income: inc,
    world: world,
    customActions: customs,
    calendarSoT: true
   });
   // Stamp live rollup onto horizon so year/month cards never keep sheet/stale $.
   var liveGain = roll.gain;
   var liveSpend = (roll.living || 0) + (roll.debt || 0);
   var liveNet = roll.surplus;
   _calHorizonCache.monthlyGain = liveGain;
   _calHorizonCache.monthlySpend = liveSpend;
   _calHorizonCache.monthlyNet = liveNet;
   _calHorizonCache.monthlyCost = liveSpend;
   _calHorizonCache.surplus = liveNet;
   _calHorizonCache.moneyWorld = Object.assign({}, _calHorizonCache.moneyWorld || {}, {
     living: roll.living, debtCash: roll.debt, surplus: liveNet,
     income: { net: liveGain, gross: liveGain },
     monthlyGain: liveGain, monthlySpend: liveSpend, monthlyNet: liveNet,
     customGain: 0, customSpend: 0,
     law: 'live rollup from placed calendar acts'
   });
   (_calHorizonCache.years || []).forEach(function(y){
     y.gain = liveGain * 12;
     y.spend = liveSpend * 12;
     y.cost = liveSpend * 12;
     y.net = liveNet * 12;
     (y.months || []).forEach(function(mo){
       mo.gain = liveGain;
       mo.spend = liveSpend;
       mo.cost = liveSpend;
       mo.net = liveNet;
     });
   });
   _calHorizonKey = key;
   return _calHorizonCache;
  }

  function startCalPaint(target){
   var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
   calPaint.active = true;
   calPaint.target = target || null;
   calPaint.yearIndex = calNav.year != null ? calNav.year : 0;
   calPaint.zoom = 'year';
   calPaint.drag = null;
   calPaint.selected = Object.create(null);
   calPaint.hours = (target && target.hours) || [10];
   calPaint.allDay = !!(target && (target.allDay || target.all_day));
   if (!calPaint.allDay && RC && RC.isAllDayRule) {
    calPaint.allDay = RC.isAllDayRule({ hours: calPaint.hours, allDay: false });
   }
   if (calPaint.allDay) calPaint.hours = ['all'];
   calPaint.repeatAllYears = false;
   calPaint.anchorKey = null;
   calPaint.rangePreview = null;
   // seed from existing rule
   try {
    var profile = ensureCalendar();
    var rule = null;
    if (target && target.kind === 'item' && RC && RC.ruleForItem) {
     rule = RC.ruleForItem({ name: target.name }, profile);
    } else if (target && target.kind === 'action') {
     var acts = getCalendarCustomActions() || [];
     var a = acts.filter(function(x){ return x && (x.id === target.id || x.name === target.name); })[0];
     if (a) {
      rule = {
       cadence: a.cadence,
       selectedKeys: a.selectedKeys,
       yearMarks: a.yearMarks,
       repeatMarks: a.repeatMarks,
       hours: a.hours,
       allDay: a.allDay
      };
      if (a.hours) calPaint.hours = Array.isArray(a.hours) ? a.hours.slice() : a.hours;
      if (a.allDay || (RC.isAllDayRule && RC.isAllDayRule(rule))) {
       calPaint.allDay = true;
       calPaint.hours = ['all'];
      }
     }
    }
    if (rule && RC.ruleToSelectionMap) calPaint.selected = RC.ruleToSelectionMap(rule);
    if (rule && RC.isAllDayRule && RC.isAllDayRule(rule)) {
     calPaint.allDay = true;
     calPaint.hours = ['all'];
    }
   } catch(_s){}
   if (typeof mohoFire === 'function') mohoFire('calendar-drill');
   invalidateCalendarCache();
   renderAll();
   showStatus('Paint “'+(target && target.name || 'item')+'” · all-day OK · Shift+click range · overlaps OK','ok');
  }

  function countPaintSelected(){
   var n = 0, k;
   for (k in calPaint.selected) if (calPaint.selected[k]) n++;
   return n;
  }

   }

   var t = calPaint.target;
   html += '<div class="cp-toolbar">';

   html += '<span class="cp-count">'+countPaintSelected()+' day(s)</span>';

   html += '<button type="button" class="btn'+(calPaint.zoom==='multi'?' btn-primary':'')+'" id="cp-zoom-multi">Multi-year</button>';
   html += '<label><input type="checkbox" id="cp-repeat-all" '+(calPaint.repeatAllYears?'checked':'')+' /> repeat marks every year</label>';

   html += '</div>';
   html += '<p class="hint" style="margin:0 0 8px"><b>Keys:</b> click / drag = paint · <b>Shift+click</b> = range first→last · Alt / right-drag = erase · dots = other events (overlap OK)</p>';

   // year chips
   html += '<div class="cal-paint-years" id="cp-years">';

   for (yi = 0; yi < yearsN; yi++) {
    var nInY = 0, k;
    for (k in calPaint.selected) {
     if (calPaint.selected[k] && k.indexOf(String(yi)+'-') === 0) nInY++;

    // mini heat per year — compact 12 month bars
    html += '<div class="cal-grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(9rem,1fr))">';
    for (yi = 0; yi < yearsN; yi++) {
     var counts = [];
     var m;
     for (m = 0; m < 12; m++) {
      var c = 0;
      for (k in calPaint.selected) {
       if (!calPaint.selected[k]) continue;
       var p = RC.parseDayKey(k);
       if (p && p.yearIndex === yi && p.monthIndex === m) c++;
      }
      counts.push(c);
     }
     html += '<div class="cal-cell" data-cp-year="'+yi+'" style="cursor:pointer">';
     html += '<div class="ct">'+(startYear+yi)+'</div>';

     });
     html += '</div></div>';
    }
    html += '</div></div>';
   } else {

    var busy = Object.create(null);
    try {

       yearIndex: calPaint.yearIndex,
       startYear: startYear,

      }) || Object.create(null);
     }
    } catch(_b){}
    var preview = calPaint.rangePreview || Object.create(null);
    html += '<p class="hint"><b>'+esc(grid.label)+'</b> · click / drag · <b>Shift+click</b> first→last · Alt / right-drag erases</p>';
    html += '<div class="cal-yv" id="cp-year-view">';
    grid.months.forEach(function(mo){
     html += '<div class="cal-yv-month" data-cp-month="'+mo.monthIndex+'">';
     html += '<div class="mn">'+esc(mo.name)+'</div>';
     html += '<div class="cal-yv-dow">';
     ['S','M','T','W','T','F','S'].forEach(function(d){ html += '<span>'+d+'</span>'; });
     html += '</div><div class="cal-yv-days">';
     mo.cells.forEach(function(cell){
      if (cell.empty) {
       html += '<div class="cal-yv-day empty"></div>';
       return;
      }
      var on = !!calPaint.selected[cell.key];
      var inRange = !!preview[cell.key];
      var occ = busy[cell.key];
      var isAnchor = calPaint.anchorKey === cell.key;
      var cls = 'cal-yv-day';
      if (on) cls += ' sel';
      if (inRange && !on) cls += ' sel-range';
      if (occ && occ.n) cls += ' busy';
      if (isAnchor) cls += ' anchor';
      if (cell.isWeekend) cls += ' weekend';
      var tip = mo.name + ' ' + cell.day;
      if (occ && occ.n) tip += ' · also: ' + occ.names.slice(0, 4).join(', ') + (occ.names.length > 4 ? '…' : '') + ' (overlap OK)';
      if (isAnchor) tip += ' · range start';
      html += '<div class="'+cls+'" data-cp-key="'+esc(cell.key)+'" data-cp-day="'+cell.day+'" title="'+esc(tip)+'">';
      html += cell.day;
      if (occ && occ.n) html += '<span class="cp-busy-dot" title="'+esc(String(occ.n)+' other event(s)')+'"></span>';
      html += '</div>';
     });
     html += '</div></div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
   }
   html += '<p class="cal-paint-hint">Overlaps allowed: paint the same days/hours for different actions. <b>Add to calendar</b> commits · Save workbook to keep.</p>';
   html += '</div>';
   return html;
  }

    });
    html += '</select></td>';
    html += '<td><input type="text" class="cal-days" data-idx="'+idx+'" value="'+esc(daysStr)+'" placeholder="1,3,5 or 11 or 12" style="width:100px;text-align:left" title="weekly: dow 0=Sun..6=Sat · every_n: N · monthly/yearly: day of month" /></td>';

     (isAd?' · ☀ all day':'')+

   });

  function calResetBelow(level){
   // clear deeper nav when going up
   var order = ['year','month','week','day','hour','actionId'];
   var idx = order.indexOf(level);
   if(idx < 0){
    calNav = { year: null, month: null, week: null, day: null, hour: null, actionId: null };
    return;
   }
   for(var i = idx + 1; i < order.length; i++){
    calNav[order[i]] = null;
   }
  }

  function easyPad2(n){
    n = String(n);
    return n.length < 2 ? '0'+n : n;
  }
  function easyNowCST(){
    try {
      var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        timeZone: 'America/Chicago',
        year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric',
        hour: 'numeric', minute: 'numeric', hourCycle: 'h23'
      }).formatToParts(new Date());
      var get = function(typ){
        for(var i=0;i<parts.length;i++) if(parts[i].type===typ) return parseInt(parts[i].value,10);
        return 0;
      };
      return { y: get('year'), m: get('month')-1, d: get('day'), h: get('hour'), min: get('minute') };
    } catch(_e){
      var n = new Date();
      return { y: n.getFullYear(), m: n.getMonth(), d: n.getDate(), h: n.getHours(), min: n.getMinutes() };
    }
  }
  function easyThisWeekDays(){
    var now = easyNowCST();
    var dt = new Date(now.y, now.m, now.d);
    var start = new Date(now.y, now.m, now.d - dt.getDay());
    var days = [];
    for(var i=0;i<7;i++){
      var x = new Date(start.getFullYear(), start.getMonth(), start.getDate()+i);
      days.push({ y: x.getFullYear(), m: x.getMonth(), d: x.getDate() });
    }
    return days;
  }
  function easyWeekRangeLabel(){
    var days = easyThisWeekDays();
    var names = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
    var a = days[0], b = days[6];
    if(a.m === b.m) return names[a.m]+' '+a.d+'–'+b.d;
    return names[a.m]+' '+a.d+'–'+names[b.m]+' '+b.d;
  }
  function easyParseHHMM(s){
    s = String(s || '').trim();
    if(!s) return null;
    var m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
    if(!m) return null;
    var h = parseInt(m[1], 10);
    var min = m[2] != null ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 0;
    if(!isFinite(h) || h < 0 || h > 23 || !isFinite(min) || min < 0 || min > 59) return null;
    return h*60 + min;
  }
  function easyFmtHHMM(min){
    min = Number(min);
    if(!isFinite(min)) return '';
    if(min >= 24*60) return '24:00';
    var h = Math.floor(((min % (24*60)) + (24*60)) % (24*60) / 60);
    var mm = Math.abs(min % 60);
    return easyPad2(h)+':'+easyPad2(mm);
  }
  function easyHourLabel(a){
    if(!a || a.allDay || (a.hours && a.hours[0]==='all') || ((a.hours == null || a.hours[0] == null) && a.startMin == null)) return '';
    if(a.startMin != null || a.endMin != null || a.endHour != null){
      var sm = a.startMin != null ? Number(a.startMin) : (Number(a.hours && a.hours[0])%24)*60;
      var em = a.endMin != null ? Number(a.endMin) : (a.endHour != null ? Number(a.endHour)*60 : ((a.hours && a.hours.length) ? (Number(a.hours[a.hours.length-1])%24+1)*60 : sm+60));
      if(!isFinite(sm)) sm = 0;
      if(!isFinite(em)) em = sm+60;
      return easyFmtHHMM(sm)+'–'+easyFmtHHMM(em);
    }
    return easyPad2(Number(a.hours[0])%24)+':00';
  }
  function easyApplyWhen(act, startStr, endStr){
    var sm = easyParseHHMM(startStr);
    var em = easyParseHHMM(endStr);
    if(sm == null && em == null){
      act.hours = ['all'];
      act.allDay = true;
      delete act.startMin;
      delete act.endMin;
      delete act.endHour;
      return act;
    }
    if(sm == null) sm = 0;
    if(em == null) em = Math.min(24*60, sm + 60);
    if(em <= sm) em = Math.min(24*60, sm + 60);
    act.allDay = false;
    act.startMin = sm;
    act.endMin = em;
    act.endHour = Math.ceil(em / 60);
    var hours = [];
    for(var h = Math.floor(sm/60); h < Math.ceil(em/60) && h < 24; h++) hours.push(h);
    if(!hours.length) hours = [Math.floor(sm/60)%24];
    act.hours = hours;
    return act;
  }
  function easyWeekWhen(a){
    var days = easyThisWeekDays();
    var names = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
    var bits = [];
    days.forEach(function(p){
      if(!easyOccurs(a, p.y, p.m, p.d)) return;
      var hr = easyHourLabel(a);
      bits.push((hr ? hr+' ' : '') + names[new Date(p.y, p.m, p.d).getDay()] + ' ' + (p.m+1) + '/' + p.d);
    });
    return bits.length ? bits.join(', ') : 'not this week';
  }
  function easyInThisWeek(a){
    var days = easyThisWeekDays();
    for(var i=0;i<days.length;i++){
      if(easyOccurs(a, days[i].y, days[i].m, days[i].d)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  function easySelRangeLabel(){
    var days = easySelList();
    if(!days.length) return 'none';
    days = days.slice().sort(function(a,b){
      return a.y-b.y || a.m-b.m || a.d-b.d;
    });
    var names = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
    if(days.length === 1) return names[days[0].m]+' '+days[0].d;
    var a = days[0], b = days[days.length-1];
    if(a.y===b.y && a.m===b.m && days.length === (b.d-a.d+1)){
      return names[a.m]+' '+a.d+'–'+b.d;
    }
    return days.length+' days';
  }
  function easySelWhen(a){
    var days = easySelList();
    var names = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
    var bits = [];
    days.forEach(function(p){
      if(!easyOccurs(a, p.y, p.m, p.d)) return;
      var hr = easyHourLabel(a);
      bits.push((hr ? hr+' ' : '') + names[new Date(p.y, p.m, p.d).getDay()] + ' ' + (p.m+1) + '/' + p.d);
    });
    return bits.length ? bits.join(', ') : 'not in selection';
  }
  function easyInSelection(a){
    var days = easySelList();
    if(!days.length) return false;
    for(var i=0;i<days.length;i++){
      if(easyOccurs(a, days[i].y, days[i].m, days[i].d)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /** Live (non-suggest) calendar act with this name/kind. */
  function easyLiveOnCalendar(aOrName){
    var nm = '';
    var kind = null;
    var id = null;
    if(typeof aOrName === 'string') nm = aOrName;
    else if(aOrName){
      nm = aOrName.name || aOrName.expenseName || '';
      kind = aOrName.kind || null;
      id = aOrName.id || null;
    }
    var acts = [];
    try { acts = (typeof easyBoardActs === 'function') ? easyBoardActs() : []; } catch(_e){ acts = []; }
    for(var i = 0; i < acts.length; i++){
      var b = acts[i];
      if(!b || b.suggestOnly) continue;
      if(String(b.id || '').indexOf('__sug_') === 0) continue;
      if(id && b.id === id) return b;
      if(kind === 'work' && b.kind === 'work') return b;
      if(nm && (b.name === nm || b.expenseName === nm)) return b;
    }
    return null;
  }
  /** True when live act is actually placed on the calendar (marks or schedule cadence). */
  function easyLivePlacedOnCalendar(aOrName){
    var b = easyLiveOnCalendar(aOrName);
    if(!b) return null;
    var keys = b.selectedKeys || b.selected || [];
    if(keys && keys.length) return b;
    if(b.repeatMarks && b.repeatMarks.length) return b;
    if(b.calcKeys && b.calcKeys.length) return b;
    if(b.calcMarks && b.calcMarks.length) return b;
    if(b.yearMarks && typeof b.yearMarks === 'object'){
      for(var yk in b.yearMarks){
        if(b.yearMarks[yk] && b.yearMarks[yk].length) return b;
      }
    }
    var cad = String(b.cadence || '').toLowerCase();
    if(cad === 'monthly' || cad === 'weekdays' || cad === 'daily' || cad === 'weekly' || cad === 'n_days') return b;
    if(b.kind === 'work' && (cad === 'weekdays' || (b.days && b.days.length))) return b;
    return null;
  }
  /** Live act covers every day in the selection (span or cadence). */

    if(!days || !days.length) return !!(typeof easyLivePlacedOnCalendar === 'function' && easyLivePlacedOnCalendar(aOrName));
    for(var i = 0; i < days.length; i++){
      if(!(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function' && easyActCoversDay(b, days[i]))) return false;

  }
