  /** True if this selection still has days not covered by a live act of this name. */
  /** Live act covers any day in calendar month y/m (month-bill card owns the whole month). */
  function easyLiveCoversMonth(aOrName, y, m){
    var b = null;
    try { b = (typeof easyLiveOnCalendar === 'function') ? easyLiveOnCalendar(aOrName) : null; } catch(_e){ b = null; }
    if(!b) return null;
    if(typeof easyIsMonthBillAct === 'function' && easyIsMonthBillAct(b)) return b;
    if(b.spanMode === 'monthBill' || b.spanMode === 'month') return b;
    var dim = (typeof easyDimOf === 'function') ? (easyDimOf(y, m) | 0) : 31;
    for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
      if(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function' && easyActCoversDay(b, { y: y, m: m, d: d })) return b;
    }
    return null;
  }
  /** Months touched by a day list → [{y,m,key}] */
  function easyMonthsOfDays(days){
    var out = [], seen = Object.create(null);
    (days || []).forEach(function(p){
      if(!p) return;
      var k = p.y + '-' + p.m;
      if(seen[k]) return;
      seen[k] = 1;
      out.push({ y: p.y, m: p.m, key: k });
    });
    return out;
  }
  /**
   * Must-suggest criteria is PER MONTH: an act needs Suggest only when a month
   * touched by the selection still lacks live coverage for that act.
   * Non-must / work / rhythm stay day-scoped (gaps on selected days).
   */
  function easySelectionNeedsSuggest(aOrName, days){
    if(!days || !days.length) return true;
    var nm = typeof aOrName === 'string' ? aOrName : (aOrName && (aOrName.name || aOrName.expenseName)) || '';
    var kind = typeof aOrName === 'object' && aOrName ? aOrName.kind : null;
    var ref = (typeof aOrName === 'object' && aOrName) ? aOrName : { name: nm, kind: kind };
    var isWork = kind === 'work' || (ref && ref.kind === 'work');
    var isRhythm = !!(ref && (ref.rhythm || ref.name === 'Wake' || ref.name === 'Sleep'));
    var isMust = false;
    try { isMust = (typeof easySuggestMust === 'function') && easySuggestMust(ref); } catch(_m){ isMust = false; }
    var isMonthBill = false;
    try {
      isMonthBill = (typeof easyIsMonthBillAct === 'function' && easyIsMonthBillAct(ref)) ||
        (ref && (ref.spanMode === 'monthBill' || ref.spanMode === 'month'));
    } catch(_b){}
    var cad = String((ref && ref.cadence) || '').toLowerCase();
    var isOnceCost = false;
    try {
      isOnceCost = !!(ref && (Math.abs(Number(ref.amountOnce) || 0) > 0 || String(ref.chargeOn || '').toLowerCase() === 'once'));
    } catch(_oc){ isOnceCost = false; }
    // One-time buys (House down payment) are day-scoped — not month-bill musts
    var monthScoped = !isWork && !isRhythm && !isOnceCost && (isMust || isMonthBill || cad === 'monthly');

    if(monthScoped){
      var months = easyMonthsOfDays(days);
      for(var mi = 0; mi < months.length; mi++){
        var mo = months[mi];
        if(!easyLiveCoversMonth(ref, mo.y, mo.m) && !(nm && easyLiveCoversMonth({ name: nm, kind: kind }, mo.y, mo.m))){
          return true; // this month still missing the must/month act
        }
      }
      return false; // every touched month already has it
    }

    // Day-scoped: work / rhythm / optional schedule — need any uncovered selected day
    for(var i = 0; i < days.length; i++){
      var p = days[i];
      var live = null;
      if(typeof easyLiveCoversOnDay === 'function'){
        live = easyLiveCoversOnDay(ref, p);
      }
      if(!live && nm && typeof easyLiveCoversOnDay === 'function'){
        live = easyLiveCoversOnDay({ name: nm, kind: kind }, p);
      }
      if(!live) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  /**
   * After a hypothetical delete of exceptAct from selection days, do all must-suggest
   * acts still have per-month coverage for months touched by days?
   */
  function easyMonthMustsStillMet(days, exceptAct){
    var months = easyMonthsOfDays(days);
    if(!months.length) return true;
    var exceptId = exceptAct ? ((typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(exceptAct) : (exceptAct.id || exceptAct.name)) : null;
    var exceptNm = exceptAct ? (exceptAct.name || exceptAct.expenseName || '') : '';
    var musts = [];
    try {
      var pool = (typeof easyBoardSuggestActs === 'function') ? easyBoardSuggestActs() : [];
      (pool || []).forEach(function(a){
        if(a && typeof easySuggestMust === 'function' && easySuggestMust(a)) musts.push(a);
      });
    } catch(_p){}
    for(var mi = 0; mi < months.length; mi++){
      var mo = months[mi];
      for(var ui = 0; ui < musts.length; ui++){
        var a = musts[ui];
        if(!a) continue;
        var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
        var nm = a.name || a.expenseName || '';
        // If this must IS the except act, require other coverage in month (there is none if we delete it)
        var isExcept = (exceptId && id === exceptId) || (exceptNm && nm === exceptNm);
        var live = easyLiveCoversMonth(a, mo.y, mo.m);
        if(isExcept){
          // deleting this must → month criteria fails unless another live match (shouldn't)
          if(!live || ((live.id || live.name) === (exceptAct.id || exceptAct.name))) return false;
        } else if(!live){
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
    return true;
  }


  /** Expense-like Board/ranked acts default to must-Suggest (opt out via suggestOptional). */
  function easyIsExpenseLike(a){
    if(!a) return false;
    if(a.kind === 'work' || a.rhythm || a.name === 'Wake' || a.name === 'Sleep') return false;
    // One-time / monthly money on a Board card still counts even if scheduleOnly parked
    if(Math.abs(Number(a.amountOnce) || 0) > 0) return true;
    if(Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly) || 0) > 0 && (a.kind === 'spend' || a.polarity === 'spend' || a.__hfJreqSeed)) return true;
    // Day rituals (Gym, Lunch, Breakfast, Dinner, …) are schedule cards — not $ must-suggest.
    if(a.kind === 'schedule' || a.scheduleOnly) return false;
    return a.kind === 'spend' || a.polarity === 'spend' || a.fromRanks || a.amountMonthly != null || !!a.expenseName || a.section === 'RANKED' || (a.cadence === 'monthly' || a.cadence === 'selected');
  }
  /** True when live cadence already places this act on every relevant selected day. */
  function easyLiveAlreadyOnSelection(a, days){
    if(!a || !days || !days.length) return false;
    var live = null;
    try { live = (typeof easyLiveOnCalendar === 'function') ? easyLiveOnCalendar(a) : a; } catch(_e){ live = a; }
    if(!live || live.suggestOnly) return false;
    var isWork = live.kind === 'work' || a.kind === 'work';
    for(var i = 0; i < days.length; i++){
      var p = days[i];
      if(isWork){
        var dow = new Date(p.y, p.m, p.d).getDay();
        if(dow < 1 || dow > 5) continue; // weekends: work N/A
        if(!(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function' && easyActCoversDay(live, p))) return false;
      } else {
        if(!(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function' && easyActCoversDay(live, p))) return false;
      }
    }
    // If selection was only weekends and act is work, not "already on"
    if(isWork){
      var anyWd = false;
      days.forEach(function(p){ var dow = new Date(p.y,p.m,p.d).getDay(); if(dow>=1&&dow<=5) anyWd = true; });
      if(!anyWd) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  /** Must include in Suggest: expenses default on; suggestOptional / suggestMust:false opts out. */
  function easySuggestMust(a){
    if(!a) return false;
    if(a.suggestOptional === true || a.suggestMust === false || a.suggestMust === 0 || a.suggestMust === '0') return false;
    if(a.suggestMust === true || a.suggestMust === 1 || a.suggestMust === '1') return true;
    return easyIsExpenseLike(a);
  }

  /** easy192: expenseName/fromSheet already in SUMMARY living (surplusBase counted). */
  function easySuggestInSummaryLiving(a){
    if(!a) return false;
    if(a.fromSheet) return true;
    // Board EXAMPLE seeds (House/hf) are NOT sheet living — must fit remaining
    if(a.__hfJreqSeed || a.__seedExample) return false;
    var name = a.expenseName || a.name;
    if(!name) return false;
    try {
      var items = (typeof easyValuedExpenseItems === 'function')
        ? (easyValuedExpenseItems() || [])
        : ((typeof easyExpenseItems === 'function')
            ? (easyExpenseItems() || []).filter(function(it){ return it && Number(it.amount) > 0; })
            : []);
      for(var i = 0; i < items.length; i++){
        if(items[i] && items[i].name === name) return true;
      }
    } catch(_e){}
    try {
      var secs = (WB && WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections) || [];
      for(var si = 0; si < secs.length; si++){
        var rows = (secs[si] && secs[si].items) || [];
        for(var ri = 0; ri < rows.length; ri++){
          var row = rows[ri];
          if(!row || row.name !== name) continue;
          var amt = 0;
          try {
            if(typeof lineAmt === 'function') amt = Math.abs(Number(lineAmt(row)) || 0);
            else if(typeof easyExpenseAmt === 'function') amt = Math.abs(Number(easyExpenseAmt(row)) || 0);
          } catch(_a){}
          if(amt > 0) return true;
          return false;
        }
      }
    } catch(_e2){}
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * easy196: monthly burn only (amountMonthly). One-time uses amountOnce — not smashed into monthly.
   */
  function easySuggestActMonthCost(a){
    if(!a) return 0;
    if(a.kind === 'work' || a.polarity === 'gain' || a.polarity === 'produce') return 0;
    if(a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Wake' || a.name === 'Sleep') return 0;
    var once = Math.abs(Number(a.amountOnce) || 0);
    var monthly = Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly) || 0);
    if(monthly > 0) return monthly;
    if(once > 0) return 0;
    if(String(a.chargeOn || '').toLowerCase() === 'once') return 0;
    var amt = Math.abs(Number(a.amount) || 0);
    if(!(amt > 0)){
      try {
        if(typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') amt = Math.abs(Number(easyActMonthAmount(a)) || 0);
      } catch(_c){}
    }
    return amt > 0 ? amt : 0;
  }

  /** easy196: one-time $ (down payment, purchase, fee). */
  function easySuggestActOnceCost(a){
    if(!a) return 0;
    if(a.kind === 'work' || a.polarity === 'gain' || a.polarity === 'produce') return 0;
    var once = Math.abs(Number(a.amountOnce) || 0);
    if(once > 0) return once;
    if(String(a.chargeOn || '').toLowerCase() === 'once'){
      var amt = Math.abs(Number(a.amount) || 0);
      if(amt > 0) return amt;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  function easySuggestMonthIndex(days){
    var today = (typeof easyTodayMonth === 'function') ? easyTodayMonth() : { y: new Date().getFullYear(), m: new Date().getMonth() };
    var y = today.y|0, m = today.m|0;
    try {
      if(days && days.length){
        var best = null;
        for(var i = 0; i < days.length; i++){
          var p = days[i]; if(!p) continue;
          if(!best || (p.y|0) > (best.y|0) || ((p.y|0)===(best.y|0) && (p.m|0) > (best.m|0))) best = p;
        }
        if(best){ y = best.y|0; m = best.m|0; }
      } else if(easyCal && easyCal.y != null && easyCal.m != null){
        y = easyCal.y|0; m = easyCal.m|0;
      }
    } catch(_d){}
    var idx = (y - (today.y|0)) * 12 + ((m|0) - (today.m|0));
    if(idx < 0) idx = 0;
    return idx;
  }

  function easySuggestLiquidSavings(){
    var s = 0;
    try {
      ((WB && WB.assets && WB.assets.savings) || []).forEach(function(row){
        s += Number(row && row.current) || 0;
      });
    } catch(_s){}
    if(!isFinite(s) || s < 0) s = 0;
    return s;
  }

  /**
   * easy197: monthly surplus FLOW for horizon Money stock.
   * Prefer live rollup when calendar has money (summary/calendar).
   * If rollup is clear/[REDACTED-AMOUNT], use calcSummary() sheet surplus — otherwise stock never grows and Jump/House once is dead.
   * Never invent amounts; sheet SUMMARY is densest SoT when calendar KPI is intentionally 0.
   */
  function easySuggestFlowSurplus(){
    var surplus = null, source = 'unknown', roll = null;
    try {
      if(typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function'){
        roll = easyMonthMoneyRoll();
        if(roll && roll.surplus != null && isFinite(Number(roll.surplus))){
          var src = String(roll.source || '');
          if(src !== 'clear' && (Number(roll.nActs) > 0 || src === 'summary' || src === 'calendar')){
            surplus = Number(roll.surplus);
            source = 'rollup:' + src;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch(_r){}
    if(surplus == null || (roll && String(roll.source) === 'clear')){
      try {
        var S = (typeof calcSummary === 'function') ? calcSummary() : null;
        if(S && S.surplus != null && isFinite(Number(S.surplus))){
          surplus = Number(S.surplus);
          source = 'summary-sheet';
        }
      } catch(_s){}
    }
    if(surplus == null || !isFinite(surplus)) surplus = 0;
    return { surplus: surplus, source: source, roll: roll };
  }

  /** Capital / once need from Money stock. Prefer amountOnce; else marketPrior downPayment; else monthly×12 readiness. */
  function easySuggestCapitalNeed(a){
    if(!a) return 0;
    var once = (typeof easySuggestActOnceCost === 'function') ? easySuggestActOnceCost(a) : 0;
    if(once > 0) return once;
    try {
      var mp = a.marketPrior || null;
      if(mp){
        if(Number(mp.downPayment) > 0) return Number(mp.downPayment);
        var median = Number(mp.medianSaleMay2026 != null ? mp.medianSaleMay2026 : mp.medianSale);
        if(median > 0){
          var dpRate = Number(mp.downPaymentRate);
          if(!(dpRate > 0) || dpRate > 1) dpRate = 0.05;
          return median * dpRate;
        }
      }
    } catch(_mp){}
    var cost = (typeof easySuggestActMonthCost === 'function') ? easySuggestActMonthCost(a) : 0;
    if(cost > 0) return cost * 12;
    return 0;
  }

  function easySuggestSurplusBudget(days){
    var surplusBase = 0, source = 'unknown';
    var living = 0, gain = 0, debt = 0;
    try {
      var flow = (typeof easySuggestFlowSurplus === 'function') ? easySuggestFlowSurplus() : null;
      if(flow){
        surplusBase = Number(flow.surplus) || 0;
        source = String(flow.source || 'flow');
        var roll = flow.roll;
        if(roll){
          living = Number(roll.living) || 0;
          gain = Number(roll.gain) || 0;
          debt = Number(roll.debt) || 0;
        }
      }
      if(!(living > 0 && gain > 0)){
        try {
          var S2 = (typeof calcSummary === 'function') ? calcSummary() : null;
          if(S2){
            if(!(gain > 0)) gain = Number(S2.net) || 0;
            if(!(living > 0)) living = Number(S2.living) || 0;
            if(!(debt > 0)) debt = Number(S2.debtPayments) || 0;
            if(source === 'summary-sheet' || source === 'unknown'){
              surplusBase = Number(S2.surplus) || surplusBase;
              source = 'summary-sheet';
            }
          }
        } catch(_s2){}
      }
    } catch(_r){}
    if(!isFinite(surplusBase)) surplusBase = 0;
    var savings0 = (typeof easySuggestLiquidSavings === 'function') ? easySuggestLiquidSavings() : 0;
    var monthIndex = (typeof easySuggestMonthIndex === 'function') ? easySuggestMonthIndex(days) : 0;
    if(!(monthIndex >= 0)) monthIndex = 0;
    // easy211: integrate gain − living − debt that amortizes off (not frozen surplus×months)
    var stock = savings0;
    try {
      if(typeof easyMoneyStockAfterMonths === 'function' && (gain > 0 || living > 0 || debt > 0)){
        stock = easyMoneyStockAfterMonths(monthIndex, savings0, gain, living);
      } else {
        stock = savings0 + surplusBase * monthIndex;
      }
    } catch(_st){ stock = savings0 + surplusBase * monthIndex; }
    if(!isFinite(stock)) stock = savings0;
    return {
      budget: surplusBase,
      committed: 0,
      surplusBase: surplusBase,
      living: living,
      gain: gain,
      debt: debt,
      livingOnBoard: 0,
      source: source,
      savings0: savings0,
      monthIndex: monthIndex,
      stock: stock,
      stockSource: 'savings+∫(gain−living−debtAmort)'
    };
  }

  /**
   * easy196 afford:
   *  - amountOnce → Money stock
   *  - amountMonthly → surplus flow (or stock readiness if monthly-only)
   *  - both → stock covers once AND flow covers monthly
   */
  function easySuggestCanAfford(a, state){
    if(!a || !state) return true;
    if(typeof easySuggestInSummaryLiving === 'function' && easySuggestInSummaryLiving(a)) return true;
    var once = (typeof easySuggestActOnceCost === 'function') ? easySuggestActOnceCost(a) : 0;
    var monthly = (typeof easySuggestActMonthCost === 'function') ? easySuggestActMonthCost(a) : 0;
    if(!(once > 0) && !(monthly > 0)) return true;
    var eps = 0.5;
    var remFlow = Number(state.remaining);
    if(!isFinite(remFlow)) remFlow = 0;
    var stockRem = Number(state.stockRemaining);
    if(!isFinite(stockRem)){
      stockRem = Number(state.info && state.info.stock);
      if(!isFinite(stockRem)) stockRem = 0;
      state.stockRemaining = stockRem;
    }
    if(once > 0 && monthly > 0){
      if(stockRem + eps < once){ state.__affordVia = null; state.__affordCapitalNeed = once; state.__affordFail = 'once'; return false; }
      if(remFlow + eps < monthly){ state.__affordVia = null; state.__affordCapitalNeed = once; state.__affordFail = 'monthly'; return false; }
      state.__affordVia = 'once+flow'; state.__affordCapitalNeed = once; return true;
    }
    if(once > 0){
      if(stockRem + eps >= once){ state.__affordVia = 'once'; state.__affordCapitalNeed = once; return true; }
      state.__affordVia = null; state.__affordCapitalNeed = once; state.__affordFail = 'once'; return false;
    }
    if(remFlow + eps >= monthly){ state.__affordVia = 'flow'; return true; }
    var needCap = (typeof easySuggestCapitalNeed === 'function') ? easySuggestCapitalNeed(a) : (monthly * 12);
    if(!(needCap > 0)) needCap = monthly * 12;
    if(stockRem + eps >= needCap){ state.__affordVia = 'stock'; state.__affordCapitalNeed = needCap; return true; }
    state.__affordVia = null; state.__affordCapitalNeed = needCap; state.__affordFail = 'monthly'; return false;
  }

  function easySuggestConsumeAfford(a, state){
    if(!a || !state) return;
    if(typeof easySuggestInSummaryLiving === 'function' && easySuggestInSummaryLiving(a)) return;
    var once = (typeof easySuggestActOnceCost === 'function') ? easySuggestActOnceCost(a) : 0;
    var monthly = (typeof easySuggestActMonthCost === 'function') ? easySuggestActMonthCost(a) : 0;
    var via = state.__affordVia;
    var rem = Number(state.remaining); if(!isFinite(rem)) rem = 0;
    var stockRem = Number(state.stockRemaining);
    if(!isFinite(stockRem)){ stockRem = Number(state.info && state.info.stock) || 0; state.stockRemaining = stockRem; }
    if(via === 'once' || via === 'once+flow'){
      var need = Number(state.__affordCapitalNeed); if(!(need > 0)) need = once;
      state.stockRemaining = stockRem - need;
      if(via === 'once+flow' && monthly > 0) state.remaining = rem - monthly;
    } else if(via === 'stock'){
      var needCap = Number(state.__affordCapitalNeed); if(!(needCap > 0)) needCap = monthly * 12;
      state.stockRemaining = stockRem - needCap;
      if(rem > 0 && monthly > 0) state.remaining = Math.max(0, rem - Math.min(rem, monthly));
    } else if(monthly > 0){
      state.remaining = rem - monthly;
      state.stockRemaining = stockRem - monthly;
    }
    state.__affordVia = null;
  }

  /**
   * easy202: Jump only when Suggest actually ghosts the selected Board act.
   * Once-cost: start scan at stock-clear month; packer force-places once acts when afford clears.
   */
  function easyJumpToSuggestDay(opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    var best = (typeof lastBest !== 'undefined') ? lastBest : null;
    var saved = {
      y: easyCal.y, m: easyCal.m, mode: easyCal.mode,
      sel: (easyCal.sel || []).slice(),
      pick: easyCal.pick ? { y: easyCal.pick.y, m: easyCal.pick.m, d: easyCal.pick.d } : null,
      surplusFollowView: !!easyCal.surplusFollowView
    };
    function restore(){
      easyCal.y = saved.y; easyCal.m = saved.m;
      try { if(saved.mode) easyCal.mode = saved.mode; } catch(_m){}
      easyCal.sel = saved.sel.slice();
      easyCal.pick = saved.pick;
      easyCal.surplusFollowView = saved.surplusFollowView;
      try { delete window.__easyJumpWantId; } catch(_j){ window.__easyJumpWantId = null; }
      try {
        if(wantAct){
          delete wantAct.__jumpForce;
          delete wantAct.__onceForcePlace;
          delete wantAct.__forceSelGap;
          if(wantAct.__sugTag === 'jump-force') delete wantAct.__sugTag;
        }
      } catch(_j2){}
    }
    function applyHit(y, m, d){
      easyCal.y = y|0; easyCal.m = m|0;
      easyCal.surplusFollowView = true;
      easyCal.sel = [easySelKey(y, m, d)];
      easyCal.pick = { y: y|0, m: m|0, d: d|0 };
      try { easyCal.mode = 'calendar'; } catch(_m){}
      try { delete window.__easyJumpWantId; } catch(_j){ window.__easyJumpWantId = null; }
      try {
        if(wantAct){
          delete wantAct.__jumpForce;
          delete wantAct.__onceForcePlace;
          delete wantAct.__forceSelGap;
          if(wantAct.__sugTag === 'jump-force') delete wantAct.__sugTag;
        }
      } catch(_ah){}
    }
    function ymAdd(y, m, add){
      y = y|0; m = (m|0) + (add|0);
      while(m > 11){ m -= 12; y += 1; }
      while(m < 0){ m += 12; y -= 1; }
      return { y: y, m: m };
    }

    var wantId = opts.wantActId ? String(opts.wantActId) : '';
    var wantName = opts.wantName ? String(opts.wantName) : '';
    if(!wantId && !wantName){
      try {
        var pa0 = easyCal && easyCal.placeAct ? String(easyCal.placeAct) : '';
        if(pa0){
          var found0 = (typeof easyFindAct === 'function') ? easyFindAct(pa0) : null;
          wantId = pa0; wantName = found0 ? String(found0.name || '') : '';
        }
      } catch(_pa){}
    }
    if(!wantId && !wantName){
      return { ok: false, reason: 'need-select', message: 'Select a Board item first, then Jump to Suggest' };
    }

    var wantAct = null;
    try {
      if(typeof easyFindAct === 'function') wantAct = easyFindAct(wantId) || (wantName ? easyFindAct(wantName) : null);
    } catch(_f){}
    if(!wantAct){
      try {
        ((typeof easyBoardSuggestActs === 'function') ? easyBoardSuggestActs() : []).forEach(function(pa){
          if(!pa || wantAct) return;
          if((wantId && (String(pa.id) === wantId || String(pa.name) === wantId)) || (wantName && String(pa.name) === wantName)) wantAct = pa;
        });
      } catch(_p){}
    }
    if(wantAct){
      wantId = String(wantAct.id || wantId || '');
      wantName = String(wantAct.name || wantName || '');
    }
    var displayName = wantName || wantId || 'item';

    var yearsN = 150;
    try {
      if(WB && WB.hdame && Number(WB.hdame.years) > 0) yearsN = Number(WB.hdame.years)|0;
      else if(typeof easyHorizonYears === 'function') yearsN = Number(easyHorizonYears()) || 150;
    } catch(_yn){}
    if(!(yearsN >= 1)) yearsN = 150;
    var maxMonths = yearsN * 12;
    var start = (typeof easyTodayMonth === 'function') ? easyTodayMonth() : { y: new Date().getFullYear(), m: new Date().getMonth() };
    var y0 = start.y|0, m0 = start.m|0;
    var endYM = ymAdd(y0, m0, maxMonths - 1);
    var rangeLab = ((m0|0)+1)+'/'+y0+' → '+((endYM.m|0)+1)+'/'+endYM.y;

    var onceNeed = 0;
    try { onceNeed = (typeof easySuggestActOnceCost === 'function') ? easySuggestActOnceCost(wantAct) : 0; } catch(_on){}
    if(!(onceNeed > 0) && wantAct){
      onceNeed = Math.abs(Number(wantAct.amountOnce) || 0);
      if(!(onceNeed > 0) && wantAct.marketPrior) onceNeed = Number(wantAct.marketPrior.downPayment) || 0;
    }
    var savings0 = 0, surplusFlow = 0;
    try { savings0 = (typeof easySuggestLiquidSavings === 'function') ? easySuggestLiquidSavings() : 0; } catch(_sv){}
    try {
      var flowInfo = (typeof easySuggestFlowSurplus === 'function') ? easySuggestFlowSurplus() : null;
      if(flowInfo) surplusFlow = Number(flowInfo.surplus) || 0;
    } catch(_fi){}
    if(!(surplusFlow > 0)){
      try { var S = calcSummary(); if(S) surplusFlow = Number(S.surplus) || 0; } catch(_s){}
    }
    var startMonthOffset = 0;
    if(onceNeed > 0){
      var gap = onceNeed - savings0;
      // easy211: walk months with debt falling off after payoff (surplus rises when Car/Student clear)
      var gain0 = 0, living0 = 0;
      try {
        var Sgain = (typeof calcSummary === 'function') ? calcSummary() : null;
        if(Sgain){ gain0 = Number(Sgain.net) || 0; living0 = Number(Sgain.living) || 0; }
      } catch(_g){}
      if(!(gain0 > 0) && surplusFlow > 0){ gain0 = surplusFlow + (Number((typeof calcSummary==='function'&&calcSummary()||{}).debtPayments)||0) + living0; }
      var walked = null;
      try {
        if(typeof easyMonthsUntilStock === 'function'){
          walked = easyMonthsUntilStock(onceNeed, savings0, gain0, living0, maxMonths);
        }
      } catch(_w){ walked = null; }
      if(gap > 0 && walked != null){
        startMonthOffset = walked|0;
      } else if(gap > 0 && surplusFlow > 0.5){
        startMonthOffset = Math.ceil(gap / surplusFlow);
      } else if(gap > 0 && !(surplusFlow > 0.5) && walked == null){
        restore();
        return {
          ok: false, reason: 'afford',
          message: displayName+' once $'+Math.round(onceNeed)+' needs surplus to grow stock (have savings $'+Math.round(savings0)+', surplus $'+Math.round(surplusFlow)+'/mo; debt amortize never cleared)'
        };
      }
      if(startMonthOffset > maxMonths - 1){
        restore();
        return {
          ok: false, reason: 'afford',
          message: displayName+' once $'+Math.round(onceNeed)+' needs ~'+startMonthOffset+' mo; horizon is '+maxMonths+' mo ('+rangeLab+')'
        };
      }
    }

    try {
      window.__easyJumpWantId = wantId;
      if(wantAct){
        wantAct.__jumpForce = true;
        wantAct.__forceSelGap = true;
        wantAct.__onceForcePlace = onceNeed > 0;
        wantAct.__sugTag = 'jump-force';
      }
    } catch(_jf){}

    function dayCandidates(y, m){
      var dim = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
      var out = [];
      function add(d){ d = d|0; if(d >= 1 && d <= dim && out.indexOf(d) < 0) out.push(d); }
      add(10); add(15); add(1);
      for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){ if(new Date(y, m, d).getDay() === 6){ add(d); break; } }
      for(var d3 = 1; d3 <= dim; d3 += 5) add(d3);
      add(dim);
      return out;
    }
    function actMatchesWant(a, sid){
      var id = String((a && (a.id || a.name)) || sid || '');
      var nm = String((a && a.name) || '');
      if(wantId && (id === wantId || nm === wantId || String(sid) === wantId)) return true;
      if(wantName && (nm === wantName || id === wantName)) return true;
      return false;
    }
    function planHasWant(plan){
      if(!plan) return false;
      var sug = plan.suggest || [];
      for(var i = 0; i < sug.length; i++){
        var s = sug[i]; if(!s) continue;
        if(actMatchesWant(s.act || s, s.id)) return true;
      }
      if(plan.byDay){
        var keys = Object.keys(plan.byDay);
        for(var ki = 0; ki < keys.length; ki++){
          var ghost = (plan.byDay[keys[ki]] && plan.byDay[keys[ki]].ghost) || [];
          for(var gi = 0; gi < ghost.length; gi++){
            var g = ghost[gi];
            if(g && actMatchesWant(g.act || g, g.id)) return true;
          }
        }
      }
      return false;
    }
    function overflowReason(plan){
      var ov = (plan && plan.overflowList) || [];
      for(var i = 0; i < ov.length; i++){
        var o = ov[i]; if(!o) continue;
        if(actMatchesWant(o.act, o.id)) return o;
      }
      return null;
    }

    var wantHit = null, lastOv = null, scanned = 0, lastY = y0, lastM = m0;
    try {
      for(var i = startMonthOffset; i < maxMonths; i++){
        var ym = ymAdd(y0, m0, i);
        lastY = ym.y; lastM = ym.m;
        var days = dayCandidates(ym.y, ym.m);
        for(var di = 0; di < days.length; di++){
          var d = days[di];
          scanned++;
          easyCal.y = ym.y; easyCal.m = ym.m;
          easyCal.sel = [easySelKey(ym.y, ym.m, d)];
          easyCal.pick = { y: ym.y, m: ym.m, d: d };
          var plan = null;
          try { plan = (typeof easySelGhostPlan === 'function') ? easySelGhostPlan(best) : null; } catch(_p){ plan = null; }
          if(!plan) continue;
          var ov = overflowReason(plan);
          if(ov) lastOv = ov;
          if(planHasWant(plan)){ wantHit = { y: ym.y, m: ym.m, d: d, plan: plan }; break; }
        }
        if(wantHit) break;
      }
    } catch(_scan){
      restore();
      return { ok: false, reason: 'error', message: 'Jump scan failed for '+displayName, scanned: scanned };
    }

    if(!wantHit){
      restore();
      var why = lastOv && lastOv.reason ? String(lastOv.reason) : 'none';
      var msg = displayName+' never Suggests through '+rangeLab;
      if(why === 'afford'){
        msg += ' (afford · stock $'+Math.round(Number(lastOv.stock)||0)+' / need $'+Math.round(Number(lastOv.capitalNeed)||Number(lastOv.need)||0)+')';
      } else if(why !== 'none'){
        msg += ' ('+why+')';
      }
      msg += ' · '+scanned+' samples · last '+(((lastM|0)+1)+'/'+lastY);
      if(onceNeed > 0) msg += ' · once $'+Math.round(onceNeed)+' · surplus $'+Math.round(surplusFlow)+'/mo · stock-clear ~mo+'+startMonthOffset;
      return { ok: false, reason: why, message: msg, scanned: scanned, range: rangeLab, overflow: lastOv };
    }

    applyHit(wantHit.y, wantHit.m, wantHit.d);
    return {
      ok: true, jumped: true, wantPlaced: true,
      y: wantHit.y, m: wantHit.m, d: wantHit.d,
      wantActId: wantId, wantName: wantName,
      message: 'Jumped to '+(((wantHit.m|0)+1)+'/'+wantHit.d+'/'+wantHit.y)+' · Suggest places '+displayName,
      scanned: scanned, range: rangeLab
    };
  }
  try { window.easyJumpToSuggestDay = easyJumpToSuggestDay; } catch(_w){}


  /** Live (non-suggest) calendar act covering day — by name/expense/work. */
  function easyLiveCoversOnDay(a, p){
    if(!a || !p) return null;
    var acts = [];
    try { acts = (typeof easyBoardActs === 'function') ? easyBoardActs() : []; } catch(_e){ acts = []; }
    var nm = a.name || a.expenseName || '';
    for(var i = 0; i < acts.length; i++){
      var b = acts[i];
      if(!b || b.suggestOnly) continue;
      if(String(b.id || '').indexOf('__sug_') === 0) continue;
      var match = false;
      if(a.kind === 'work' && b.kind === 'work') match = true;
      else if(nm && (b.name === nm || b.expenseName === nm || b.name === a.expenseName)) match = true;
      else if(a.id && b.id === a.id) match = true;
      if(!match) continue;
      if(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function' ? easyActCoversDay(b, p) : false) return b;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function easyActCoversDay(a, p){
    if(!a || !p) return false;
    if(typeof easyOccurs === 'function' && easyOccurs(a, p.y, p.m, p.d)) return true;
    return false;
  }
  function easySelectionHasAct(a, days){
    if(!a || !days || !days.length) return false;
    for(var i = 0; i < days.length; i++){
      if(easyActCoversDay(a, days[i])) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  function easyLongestConsecRun(days){
    days = (days || []).slice();
    if(typeof easyDaySort === 'function') days.sort(easyDaySort);
    if(!days.length) return 1;
    var best = 1, cur = 1, i;
    for(i = 1; i < days.length; i++){
      var a = days[i-1], b = days[i];
      var n = new Date(a.y, a.m, a.d + 1);
      if(n.getFullYear() === b.y && n.getMonth() === b.m && n.getDate() === b.d) cur++;
      else cur = 1;
      if(cur > best) best = cur;
    }
    return best;
  }
  /**
   * Suggest pool = unused sheet/work/rhythm items NOT on the Board,
   * plus Board acts that still have gaps on the selection (not already covering a day).
   */


  /** Board-visible acts for suggestions (Plan/Week cards + work + wake/sleep). Never sheet-only rows. */

  /** True if work/act is explicitly on that day (paint/marks) — NOT mere weekday cadence. */
  function easyExplicitOnDay(a, p){
    if(!a || !p) return false;
    var keys = a.selectedKeys || a.selected || [];
    var key = (typeof easyDayKeyStr === 'function') ? easyDayKeyStr(p) : ((p.y|0)+'-'+(p.m|0)+'-'+(p.d|0));
    // selectedKeys formats vary — also check RankingCalendar day key if present
    if(keys && keys.length){
      for(var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++){
        var k = keys[i];
        if(k === key) return true;
        if(typeof k === 'string' && (k.indexOf(p.y+'-'+(p.m+1)+'-'+p.d) >= 0 || k.indexOf(key) >= 0)) return true;
      }
    }
    if(a.yearMarks && a.yearMarks[key]) return true;
    if(a.repeatMarks && a.repeatMarks.length){
      for(var r = 0; r < a.repeatMarks.length; r++){
        var rm = a.repeatMarks[r];
        if(rm && (rm.m|0) === (p.m|0) && (rm.d|0) === (p.d|0)) return true;
      }
    }
    // cadence selected/paint with no keys → not explicit
    var cad = String(a.cadence || '').toLowerCase();
    if(cad === 'selected' || cad === 'paint' || cad === 'none' || cad === ''){
      return !!(keys && keys.length);
    }
    // weekdays/monthly/daily rules are schedule rules, not "placed on this selection plan"
    return false;
  }
  function easyFindBoardWork(){
    var found = null;
    try {
      (typeof easyBoardActs === 'function' ? easyBoardActs() : []).forEach(function(a){
        if(a && a.kind === 'work') found = found || a;
      });
    } catch(_e){}
    return found;
  }
  /** Ensure a Work card exists on the Board (money producer). Returns the act. */
  function easyEnsureBoardWork(){
    var w = easyFindBoardWork();
    if(w){
      try { if(typeof easyMigrateWorkPaySpan === 'function') easyMigrateWorkPaySpan(w); } catch(_m){}
      return w;
    }
    // Suggest-only stub (not committed). Clear must not silently re-seed the Board,
    // but Work still needs to be suggestable for pay-period spans / money.
    try {
      w = (typeof easyBlankWorkAct === 'function') ? easyBlankWorkAct('Work') : null;
      if(!w) return null;
      w.id = '__sug_work__';
      w.suggestOnly = true;
      w.scheduleOnly = true;
      w.lane = 'plan';
      w.author = 'ranking_ui';
      w.spanMode = 'payPeriod';
      w.chargeOn = 'payDays';
      w.payDays = [1, 15];
      w.__sugTag = 'board-work-gap';
      return w;
    } catch(_c){ return null; }
  }
  /** Explicit user/Board add of Work (not silent ensure). */
  function easyAddBoardWork(){
    var w = easyFindBoardWork();
    if(w) return w;
    try {
      if(WB) WB._calUserCleared = false;
    } catch(_f){}
    w = (typeof easyBlankWorkAct === 'function') ? easyBlankWorkAct('Work') : null;
    if(!w) return null;
    w.scheduleOnly = true;
    w.lane = 'plan';
    w.author = 'ranking_ui';
    w.spanMode = 'payPeriod';
    w.chargeOn = 'payDays';
    w.payDays = [1, 15];
    if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(w);
    return w;
  }

  function easyBoardSuggestActs(){
    var out = [];
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    function add(a){
      if(!a || a.enabled === false) return;
      var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
      if(!id || seen[id]) return;
      seen[id] = 1;
      if(a.name) seen[a.name] = 1;
      out.push(a);
    }
    try {
      (typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function' ? easyScheduleActions() : []).forEach(add);
    } catch(_s){}
    try {
      (typeof easyBoardActs === 'function' ? easyBoardActs() : []).forEach(function(a){
        if(!a) return;
        if(a.kind === 'work' || a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Wake' || a.name === 'Sleep') add(a);
        // Money/joy acts live on the calendar profile even when scheduleActions filters them out (amt>0).
        if(a.kind === 'spend' || a.kind === 'joy' || a.expenseName || a.isDebtPay || a.polarity === 'spend' || a.polarity === 'gain') add(a);
        if(a.scheduleOnly || a.lane || a.kind === 'schedule') add(a);
      });
    } catch(_b){}
    return out;
  }
  /** Month-bill span: use whole calendar month; $ on payDays/billDay (e.g. phone on 8th). */
  function easyBillDay(a){
    if(!a) return 0;
    if(a.billDay != null && isFinite(Number(a.billDay))) return Math.max(1, Math.min(31, Number(a.billDay)|0));
    var pds = (typeof easyPayDays === 'function') ? easyPayDays(a) : [];
    if(pds.length === 1) return pds[0];
    if(a.cadence === 'monthly' && a.day != null) return Math.max(1, Math.min(31, Number(a.day)|0));
    return 0;
  }
  function easyIsMonthBillAct(a){
    if(!a || a.kind === 'work') return false;
    if(Math.abs(Number(a.amountOnce) || 0) > 0 || String(a.chargeOn || '').toLowerCase() === 'once') return false;
    if(a.spanMode === 'monthBill' || a.spanMode === 'month') return true;
    if((a.kind === 'spend' || a.expenseName || a.isDebtPay) && (easyChargeOn(a) === 'payDays' || easyBillDay(a) > 0)) return true;
    // monthly cadence expenses default to month-bill span
    if((a.kind === 'spend' || a.expenseName) && String(a.cadence||'').toLowerCase() === 'monthly') return true;
    return false;
  }
  function easyMonthBillBounds(y, m, a){
    var dim = easyDimOf(y, m);
    var bill = easyBillDay(a) || 1;
    bill = Math.min(bill, dim);
    return {
      start: { y: y, m: m, d: 1 },
      end: { y: y, m: m, d: dim },
      payY: y, payM: m, payD: bill,
      days: (function(){
        var out = [];
        for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++) out.push({ y: y, m: m, d: d });
        return out;
      })()
    };
  }
  /**
   * Suggest = Board items not yet on this selection's plan.
   * Not random sheet expenses. Work/Sleep included when on Board but missing from selected days.
   */

  function easyMigrateBillSpan(a){
    if(!a) return false;
    if(a.kind === 'work' || a.rhythm) return false;
    var ch = false;
    var nm = String(a.name || a.expenseName || '');
    if(/phone|verizon|t-?mobile|at&?t|internet|utility|electric|water/i.test(nm) && (a.billDay == null && !(a.payDays && a.payDays.length))){
      a.billDay = 8; a.payDays = [8]; ch = true;
    }
    if(easyIsMonthBillAct(a) || ((a.kind === 'spend' || a.expenseName) && String(a.cadence||'').toLowerCase() === 'monthly')){
      if(a.spanMode !== 'monthBill'){ a.spanMode = 'monthBill'; ch = true; }
      var bd = easyBillDay(a) || Number(a.day) || 1;
      if(!Array.isArray(a.payDays) || !a.payDays.length){ a.payDays = [bd]; ch = true; }
      if(a.chargeOn !== 'payDays'){ a.chargeOn = 'payDays'; ch = true; }
      if(a.billDay == null){ a.billDay = bd; ch = true; }
    }
    return ch;
  }


  /**
   * Suggest universe = Plan/Board + ranked items + every valued sheet expense (+ Work via pool).
   * Sheet $ lines must be suggestable so Accept can make calendar catch SUMMARY.
   */
  function easySuggestUniverseActs(best, days){
    var out = [];
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    function add(a, tag){
      if(!a) return;
      var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
      var nm = a.name || a.expenseName || '';
      if(!id && !nm) return;
      var key = id || nm;
      if(seen[key] || (nm && seen[nm])) return;
      seen[key] = 1;
      if(nm) seen[nm] = 1;
      a.__sugTag = a.__sugTag || tag || '';
      out.push(a);
    }
    // 1) Board / calendar cards (Plan lane sources)
    try {
      (typeof easyBoardSuggestActs === 'function' ? easyBoardSuggestActs() : []).forEach(function(a){
        var tag = a && a.__sugTag ? a.__sugTag : 'board';
        // Must-expenses are priority in the pool — but only when selection still needs them.
        // Never force __forceSelGap here (that re-suggested already-placed spans).
        if(a && typeof easySuggestMust === 'function' && easySuggestMust(a)){
          tag = 'board-must';
        }
        add(a, tag);
      });
    } catch(_b){}
    // 2) Ranked items — exist in scoring even if never placed on the plan
    var ranks = null;
    try { ranks = (typeof calcRanks === 'function') ? calcRanks() : null; } catch(_r){ ranks = null; }
    var rankedNames = [];
    if(ranks && ranks.items && ranks.items.length){
      rankedNames = ranks.items.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (Number(b.score)||0) - (Number(a.score)||0); });
    } else {
      // fallback: union of rank order lists
      try {
        var orders = (WB && WB.rankOrders) || {};
        var hit = Object.create(null);
        ['H','D','A','M','E'].forEach(function(dim){
          (orders[dim] || []).forEach(function(nm){
            if(!nm || hit[nm]) return;
            hit[nm] = 1;
            rankedNames.push({ name: nm, score: 0, cost: 0 });
          });
        });
      } catch(_o){}
    }
    // Next month: if selection days aren't covered yet, keep suggesting (Board card may exist from prior month)
    rankedNames.forEach(function(row){
      if(!row || !row.name) return;
      var needs = (typeof easySelectionNeedsSuggest === 'function')
        ? easySelectionNeedsSuggest(row.name, days)
        : !(typeof easyLiveCoversAllSelected === 'function' && easyLiveCoversAllSelected(row.name, days));
      if(!needs) return; // this selection fully covered
      if(seen[row.name]){
        // Re-tag existing Board card so pool treats it as a gap suggest for THIS selection
        out.forEach(function(a){
          if(!a) return;
          if(a.name === row.name || a.expenseName === row.name){
            a.__forceSelGap = true;
            a.__sugTag = 'ranked-not-on-plan';
            a.fromRanks = true;
            a.appetizing = true;
            a.rankScore = Number(row.score) || a.rankScore || 0;
            a.rankDDays = (row.D != null) ? Number(row.D) : a.rankDDays;
            a.D = a.rankDDays;
          }
        });
        return;
      }
      var stub = null;
      try {
        stub = (typeof easyExpenseSeedAct === 'function')
          ? easyExpenseSeedAct({ name: row.name, amount: Number(row.cost)||Number(row.M)||0, section: 'RANKED' })
          : null;
      } catch(_s){ stub = null; }
      if(!stub){
        stub = {
          id: '__sug_rank__' + row.name,
          name: row.name,
          kind: 'spend',
          polarity: 'spend',
          amountMonthly: Number(row.cost)||0,
          expenseName: row.name,
          cadence: 'selected',
          selectedKeys: [],
          scheduleOnly: true,
          lane: 'plan',
          suggestOnly: true,
          fromRanks: true,
          enabled: true
        };
      } else {
        stub.id = '__sug_rank__' + row.name;
        stub.suggestOnly = true;
        stub.fromRanks = true;
        stub.cadence = 'selected';
        stub.selectedKeys = [];
        stub.scheduleOnly = true;
        stub.lane = 'plan';
        stub.chargeOn = 'lastSpan';
      }
      if(typeof easyMigrateBillSpan === 'function') easyMigrateBillSpan(stub);
      stub.rankScore = Number(row.score)||0;
      stub.rankDDays = (row.D != null) ? Number(row.D) : 0;
      stub.D = stub.rankDDays;
      stub.rankD = row.rankD;
      stub.appetizing = false;
      add(stub, 'ranked-not-on-plan');
    });
    // 3) Every valued sheet expense (SUMMARY living/debt lines) — even if not ranked yet
    var sheetItems = [];
    try { sheetItems = (typeof easyValuedExpenseItems === 'function') ? (easyValuedExpenseItems() || []) : []; } catch(_v){ sheetItems = []; }
    sheetItems.forEach(function(it){
      if(!it || !it.name || !(it.amount > 0)) return;
      var needs = (typeof easySelectionNeedsSuggest === 'function')
        ? easySelectionNeedsSuggest(it.name, days)
        : !(typeof easyLiveCoversAllSelected === 'function' && easyLiveCoversAllSelected(it.name, days));
      if(!needs) return;
      if(seen[it.name]){
        out.forEach(function(a){
          if(!a) return;
          if(a.name === it.name || a.expenseName === it.name){
            a.__forceSelGap = true;
            a.__sugTag = a.__sugTag || 'sheet-not-on-plan';
            a.fromSheet = true;
            a.amountMonthly = Number(it.amount) || a.amountMonthly || 0;
            a.suggestMust = (a.suggestOptional === true) ? a.suggestMust : true;
          }
        });
        return;
      }
      var stub = null;
      try {
        stub = (typeof easyExpenseSeedAct === 'function')
          ? easyExpenseSeedAct({ name: it.name, amount: Number(it.amount)||0, section: it.section || 'EXPENSE' })
          : null;
      } catch(_s){ stub = null; }
      if(!stub){
        stub = {
          id: '__sug_sheet__' + it.name,
          name: it.name,
          kind: 'spend',
          polarity: 'spend',
          amountMonthly: Number(it.amount)||0,
          expenseName: it.name,
          expenseSection: it.section || 'EXPENSE',
          cadence: 'selected',
          selectedKeys: [],
          scheduleOnly: true,
          lane: 'plan',
          suggestOnly: true,
          fromSheet: true,
          enabled: true
        };
      } else {
        stub.id = '__sug_sheet__' + it.name;
        stub.suggestOnly = true;
        stub.fromSheet = true;
        stub.cadence = 'selected';
        stub.selectedKeys = [];
        stub.scheduleOnly = true;
        stub.lane = 'plan';
        stub.chargeOn = 'lastSpan';
      }
      if(typeof easyMigrateBillSpan === 'function') easyMigrateBillSpan(stub);
      stub.__forceSelGap = true;
      stub.suggestMust = true;
      stub.appetizing = false;
      add(stub, 'sheet-not-on-plan');
    });
    // Top calcRanks = appetizing (same set the banner shows)
    var rankedOnly = out.filter(function(a){ return a && (a.fromRanks || a.__sugTag === 'ranked-not-on-plan'); });
    rankedOnly.sort(function(a,b){ return (Number(b.rankScore)||0) - (Number(a.rankScore)||0); });
    rankedOnly.slice(0, 12).forEach(function(a){ a.appetizing = true; });
    return out;
  }

  function easySuggestPool(best, days){
    var pool = [];
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    function add(a, tag){
      if(!a) return;
      var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
      var nm = a.name || '';
      // Collapse duplicate Wake/Sleep board cards into one pool entry
      if(a.rhythm === 'wake' || nm === 'Wake'){ id = '__pool_wake__'; nm = 'Wake'; }
      if(a.rhythm === 'sleep' || nm === 'Sleep'){ id = '__pool_sleep__'; nm = 'Sleep'; }
      if(!id || seen[id] || (nm && seen[nm])) return;
      seen[id] = 1;
      if(nm) seen[nm] = 1;
      a.__sugTag = tag || 'board-not-on-plan';
      pool.push(a);
    }
    // Universe = Board cards + ranked items not yet on this selection's plan
    var boardWork = (typeof easyEnsureBoardWork === 'function') ? easyEnsureBoardWork() : null;
    var board = (typeof easySuggestUniverseActs === 'function')
      ? easySuggestUniverseActs(best, days)
      : ((typeof easyBoardSuggestActs === 'function') ? easyBoardSuggestActs() : []);
    if(boardWork){
      var hasW = false;
      board.forEach(function(a){ if(a && a.kind === 'work') hasW = true; });
      if(!hasW) board = [boardWork].concat(board);
    }
    var byId = Object.create(null);
    board.forEach(function(a){
      var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
      if(id) byId[id] = a;
    });
    var ordered = [];
    function takePred(pred){
      board.forEach(function(a){
        if(!a || !pred(a)) return;
        var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
        if(id && byId[id]){ ordered.push(byId[id]); delete byId[id]; }
      });
    }
    // Work exclusive first, then wake/sleep, then must-Suggest, then appetizing ranks, then Best, then rest
    takePred(function(a){ return a.kind === 'work'; });
    takePred(function(a){ return a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.name === 'Wake' || a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Sleep'; });
    takePred(function(a){ return typeof easySuggestMust === 'function' && easySuggestMust(a); });
    takePred(function(a){ return !!a.appetizing; });
    // remaining ranked by score
    var rankedLeft = [];
    board.forEach(function(a){
      var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
      if(id && byId[id] && (a.fromRanks || a.__sugTag === 'ranked-not-on-plan')) rankedLeft.push(a);
    });
    rankedLeft.sort(function(a,b){ return (Number(b.rankScore)||0) - (Number(a.rankScore)||0); });
    rankedLeft.forEach(function(a){
      var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
      if(id && byId[id]){ ordered.push(byId[id]); delete byId[id]; }
    });
    ((best && best.order) || []).forEach(function(a){
      if(!a) return;
      var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
      if(id && byId[id]){ ordered.push(byId[id]); delete byId[id]; }
    });
    board.forEach(function(a){
      var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
      if(id && byId[id]){ ordered.push(a); delete byId[id]; }
    });

    ordered.forEach(function(a){
      if(!a) return;
      // easy200: Jump force MUST run before needs/already-on filters (House was never pooling)
      try {
        var jw = window.__easyJumpWantId ? String(window.__easyJumpWantId) : '';
        var jumpWant = !!(a.__jumpForce || (jw && (String(a.id) === jw || String(a.name) === jw)));
        // easy211: when Jump targets a child, also force its jreq ancestors into the pool
        if(!jumpWant && jw && a.id){
          var walk = a;
          var guard = 0;
          while(walk && walk.jreqId && guard++ < 8){
            if(String(walk.jreqId) === jw || String(walk.id) === jw){ jumpWant = true; break; }
            // ancestor of want: want's jreq chain includes this act
            break;
          }
        }
        if(!jumpWant && jw){
          // If this act is an ancestor of the jump target, force it
          try {
            var wantAct0 = (typeof easyFindAct === 'function') ? easyFindAct(jw) : null;
            var w = wantAct0;
            var g2 = 0;
            while(w && w.jreqId && g2++ < 8){
              if(String(w.jreqId) === String(a.id) || String(w.jreqId) === String(a.name)){
                jumpWant = true;
                a.__jumpForce = true;
                a.__sugTag = a.__sugTag || 'jump-force-ancestor';
                break;
              }
              w = (typeof easyFindAct === 'function') ? easyFindAct(w.jreqId) : null;
            }
          } catch(_anc){}
        }
        if(jumpWant){
          add(a, a.__sugTag === 'jump-force-ancestor' ? 'jump-force-ancestor' : 'jump-force');
          return;
        }
      } catch(_jw){}
      var isWake = a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.name === 'Wake';
      var isSleep = a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Sleep';
      if(a.kind === 'work'){
        // Live Work already covers every weekday in this selection → do not suggest
        var workRef = { kind: 'work', name: a.name || 'Work' };
        var wdSel = (days || []).filter(function(p){
          var dow = new Date(p.y, p.m, p.d).getDay();
          return dow >= 1 && dow <= 5;
        });
        if(wdSel.length && typeof easyLiveCoversAllSelected === 'function' && easyLiveCoversAllSelected(workRef, wdSel)){
          return;
        }
        var hasWd = false;
        var need = false;
        (days || []).forEach(function(p){
          var dow = new Date(p.y, p.m, p.d).getDay();
          if(dow < 1 || dow > 5) return;
          hasWd = true;
          var on = (typeof easyLiveCoversOnDay === 'function')
            ? !!easyLiveCoversOnDay({ kind: 'work', name: a.name || 'Work' }, p)
            : ((typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function') ? easyActCoversDay(a, p) : false);
          if(!on) need = true;
        });
        if(hasWd && (a.suggestOnly || a.id === '__sug_work__' || need)) add(a, 'board-work-gap');
        return;
      }
      if(isWake || isSleep){
        var needR = false;
        (days || []).forEach(function(p){
          var live = (typeof easyLiveCoversOnDay === 'function') ? easyLiveCoversOnDay(a, p) : null;
          if(live) return;
          var cov = (typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function') ? easyActCoversDay(a, p) : false;
          if(!cov) needR = true;
        });
        if(needR) add(a, isWake ? 'board-wake-gap' : 'board-sleep-gap');
        return;
      }
      // Do NOT migrateBillSpan here — it mutated live accepted acts into monthBill permanently.
      // True month-bills only (explicit), not lastSpan D-span accepts from prior months.
      var isRealBill = false;
      try {
        isRealBill = !!(a.spanMode === 'monthBill' || a.spanMode === 'month' ||
          ((a.kind === 'spend' || a.expenseName) && String(a.cadence||'').toLowerCase() === 'monthly' && a.chargeOn === 'payDays'));
      } catch(_b){}
      if(isRealBill && typeof easyIsMonthBillAct === 'function' && easyIsMonthBillAct(a)){
        var needBill = (typeof easySelectionNeedsSuggest === 'function')
          ? easySelectionNeedsSuggest(a, days)
          : true;
        if(needBill) add(a, 'board-bill-span');
        return;
      }
      // Selection-scoped: only suggest when this selection still has uncovered days.
      // Must = priority order, NOT a license to re-propose what's already live.
      var isMust = (typeof easySuggestMust === 'function') && easySuggestMust(a);
      // Cadence already on every selected day (Gym weekdays, Lunch daily, …) → never re-add
      if(typeof easyLiveAlreadyOnSelection === 'function' && easyLiveAlreadyOnSelection(a, days)) return;
      var needs = (typeof easySelectionNeedsSuggest === 'function')
        ? easySelectionNeedsSuggest(a, days)
        : !(typeof easyLiveCoversAllSelected === 'function' && easyLiveCoversAllSelected(a, days));
      if(!needs) return;
      if(isMust){
        add(a, 'board-must');
        return;
      }
      if(a.fromRanks || a.fromSheet || a.__sugTag === 'ranked-not-on-plan' || a.__sugTag === 'sheet-not-on-plan' || a.__forceSelGap){
        add(a, a.__sugTag === 'sheet-not-on-plan' || a.fromSheet ? 'sheet-not-on-plan' : 'ranked-not-on-plan');
        return;
      }
      add(a, 'board-not-on-plan');
    });
    return pool;
  }

  function easySelGhostPlan(best){

    function pushRhythmGhost(p, kind, startM, endM, actRef){
      var bag = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
      if(!bag) return null;
      var labStart = (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(startM) : '';
      var endShow = endM >= 24*60 ? endM - 24*60 : endM;
      var labEnd = (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(endShow) : '';
      var nm = kind === 'sleep' ? 'Sleep' : 'Wake';
      var syn = actRef || { id: '__rhythm_'+kind, name: nm, rhythm: kind, scheduleOnly: true };
      var g = {
        act: syn, day: p, id: syn.id || nm, already: false, rhythm: true,
        startMin: startM, endMin: endM, startLabel: labStart, endLabel: labEnd,
        spanDays: 1, spanIndex: 1, charge: false, isRhythm: true, exclusive: kind
      };
      bag.ghost.push(g);
      markExclusive(bag, startM, endM, kind);
      return g;
    }


    // Exclusive time: Work block + Sleep→Wake only. Everything else may overlap.
    var whEx = (typeof easyWorkBlockHours === 'function') ? easyWorkBlockHours() : null;
    var workExStart = whEx ? Number(whEx.startMin) : (15 * 60);
    var workExEnd = whEx ? Number(whEx.endMin) : (23 * 60);
    if(!(workExEnd > workExStart)) workExEnd = workExStart + 60;
    var sleepExStart = sleepStart;
    var sleepExEnd = sleepStart + sleepDurMin;
    if(sleepExEnd > 24 * 60) sleepExEnd = 24 * 60;

    function intervalOverlap(a0, a1, b0, b1){
      return a0 < b1 && b0 < a1;
    }
    function inExclusive(startM, endM){
      if(intervalOverlap(startM, endM, workExStart, workExEnd)) return 'work';
      if(intervalOverlap(startM, endM, sleepExStart, sleepExEnd)) return 'sleep';
      // sleep wrapping past midnight into early morning before wake
      if(sleepStart + sleepDurMin > 24 * 60){
        var wrapEnd = (sleepStart + sleepDurMin) - 24 * 60;
        if(intervalOverlap(startM, endM, 0, wrapEnd)) return 'sleep';
      }
      return null;
    }
    function markExclusive(bag, startM, endM, kind){
      if(!bag) return;
      bag.blocked = bag.blocked || [];
      bag.blocked.push({ s: startM, e: endM, kind: kind || 'ex' });
    }
    function openSegments(){
      // Awake window minus work exclusive (sleep is outside awake already when awakeSameDay false)
      var awake0 = wakeMin;
      var awake1 = wakeMin + awakeLen;
      if(awake1 > 24 * 60) awake1 = 24 * 60;
      var segs = [{ s: awake0, e: awake1 }];
      function subtract(b0, b1){
        var next = [];
        segs.forEach(function(seg){
          if(!intervalOverlap(seg.s, seg.e, b0, b1)){ next.push(seg); return; }
          if(seg.s < b0) next.push({ s: seg.s, e: Math.min(seg.e, b0) });
          if(seg.e > b1) next.push({ s: Math.max(seg.s, b1), e: seg.e });
        });
        segs = next.filter(function(s){ return s.e - s.s >= 15; });
      }
      subtract(workExStart, workExEnd);
      subtract(sleepExStart, sleepExEnd);
      if(sleepStart + sleepDurMin > 24 * 60){
        subtract(0, (sleepStart + sleepDurMin) - 24 * 60);
      }
      return segs;
    }
    /** Open (overlap-ok) room: stacks with other open ghosts; never into work/sleep exclusive. */
    function dayRoom(bag, dur, mode){
      mode = mode || 'open';
      // Exclusive modes still respect cap; open/overlap ghosts may exceed for calendar time visibility
      if(mode !== 'open' && (bag.nGhost|0) >= maxPerDay) return null;
      if(mode === 'open' && (bag.nGhost|0) >= Math.max(maxPerDay, 24)) return null;
      if(mode === 'work'){
        return { startM: workExStart, endM: workExEnd, endLimit: workExEnd, exclusive: 'work' };
      }
      if(mode === 'sleep' || mode === 'wake'){
        var s0 = mode === 'wake' ? wakeMin : sleepExStart;
        var s1 = mode === 'wake' ? Math.min(wakeMin + 30, wakeMin + awakeLen) : sleepExEnd;
        return { startM: s0, endM: s1, endLimit: s1, exclusive: mode };
      }
      // open: spread through awake−work window; shorten at cursor before wrap (easy83)
      var segs = openSegments();
      if(!segs.length) return null;
      var openTotal = 0;
      segs.forEach(function(s){ openTotal += Math.max(0, s.e - s.s); });
      // Fit duration into largest segment if needed
      var biggest = 0;
      segs.forEach(function(s){ biggest = Math.max(biggest, s.e - s.s); });
      if(dur > biggest) dur = Math.max(30, Math.floor(biggest / 15) * 15);
      var cursor = (bag.openCursor != null) ? bag.openCursor : segs[0].s;
      var i, seg, startM, endM, remain;
      // 1) Prefer place at cursor: if dur doesn't fit but remaining ≥ 30m, shorten (do NOT pack against end)
      for(i = 0; i < segs.length; i++){
        seg = segs[i];
        if(cursor >= seg.e) continue;
        startM = Math.max(cursor, seg.s);
        remain = seg.e - startM;
        if(remain < 30) continue;
        if(startM + dur <= seg.e){
          endM = startM + dur;
          if(!inExclusive(startM, endM)) return { startM: startM, endM: endM, endLimit: seg.e, exclusive: null, openTotal: openTotal };
        }
        // shorten to remaining instead of jumping earlier than cursor
        endM = seg.e;
        if(!inExclusive(startM, endM)) return { startM: startM, endM: endM, endLimit: seg.e, exclusive: null, openTotal: openTotal, shortened: true };
      }
      // 2) Wrap only when cursor is past/at segment end(s) — new lane through the day
      for(i = 0; i < segs.length; i++){
        seg = segs[i];
        if(seg.e - seg.s < 30) continue;
        startM = seg.s;
        var fitDur = Math.min(dur, seg.e - seg.s);
        if(fitDur < 30) continue;
        endM = startM + fitDur;
        if(!inExclusive(startM, endM)) return { startM: startM, endM: endM, endLimit: seg.e, exclusive: null, openTotal: openTotal, wrapped: true, shortened: fitDur < dur };
      }
      return null;
    }
    /** Stagger openCursor after placing overlap-ok ghost (not full endM). */
    function advanceOpenCursor(bag, startM, endM, durUsed){
      var d = Number(durUsed);
      if(!(d > 0)) d = Math.max(30, (Number(endM) || 0) - (Number(startM) || 0));
      var stagger = Math.round(d * 0.55);
      if(stagger < 75) stagger = 75;
      if(stagger > 150) stagger = 150;
      var next = (Number(startM) || 0) + stagger;
      try {
        var segsA = openSegments();
        if(segsA.length){
          var openEnd = segsA[segsA.length - 1].e;
          if(next >= openEnd) bag.openCursor = segsA[0].s;
          else bag.openCursor = next;
          return;
        }
      } catch(_ac){}
      bag.openCursor = next;
    }
    /** easy192: minutes already claimed by live+ghost non-exclusive acts on this day. */
    function dayPackedOpenMin(bag){
      if(!bag) return 0;
      var used = 0;
      function addMins(sm, em, durHint){
        var m = Number(durHint);
        if(!(m > 0) && sm != null && em != null && Number(em) > Number(sm)) m = Number(em) - Number(sm);
        if(m > 0) used += m;
      }
      (bag.current || []).forEach(function(ca){
        if(!ca) return;
        if(ca.kind === 'work' || ca.rhythm || ca.name === 'Wake' || ca.name === 'Sleep') return;
        addMins(ca.startMin, ca.endMin, ca.durMin);
      });
      (bag.ghost || []).forEach(function(g){
        if(!g || !g.act) return;
        if(g.isRhythm || g.exclusive === 'work' || g.exclusive === 'sleep' || g.exclusive === 'wake') return;
        if(g.act.kind === 'work' || g.act.rhythm || g.act.name === 'Wake' || g.act.name === 'Sleep') return;
        addMins(g.startMin, g.endMin, g.durMin != null ? g.durMin : null);
      });
      return used;
    }
    function dayOpenMinLeft(bag){
      var openTot = 0;
      try {
        openSegments().forEach(function(s){ openTot += Math.max(0, s.e - s.s); });
      } catch(_o2){ openTot = openAvail; }
      if(!(openTot > 0)) openTot = openAvail;
      return Math.max(0, openTot - dayPackedOpenMin(bag));
    }
    function isConsec(a, b){
      if(!a || !b) return false;
      var n = new Date(a.y, a.m, a.d + 1);
      return n.getFullYear() === b.y && n.getMonth() === b.m && n.getDate() === b.d;
    }
    function findSpanWindow(startIdx, span, dur){
      if(startIdx + span > nDays) return null;
      var block = [];
      var i, room0 = null;
      for(i = 0; i < span; i++){
        var p = days[startIdx + i];
        if(i > 0 && !isConsec(days[startIdx + i - 1], p)) return null;
        var bag = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
        var room = dayRoom(bag, dur, 'open');
        if(!room) return null;
        if(i === 0) room0 = room;
        // Overlap-ok: do not require empty cursor / exclusive free day
        block.push({ p: p, bag: bag, room: room });
      }
      return { block: block, startM: room0.startM, endM: room0.endM };
    }
    function dayHasAct(p, a){
      var bag = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
      if(!bag) return false;
      // After Accept, live calendar acts must kill ghosts (stubs have empty selectedKeys)
      if(typeof easyLiveCoversOnDay === 'function' && easyLiveCoversOnDay(a, p)) return true;

        var wh = false;

          if(ca && ca.kind === 'work' && !ca.suggestOnly) wh = true;
        });
        // Do NOT treat other ghosts as "placed" — that blocked packing but also hid Accept feedback wrong
        return wh;
      }
      if(!(a.suggestOnly || (a.id && String(a.id).indexOf('__sug_') === 0)) &&
         typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function' && easyActCoversDay(a, p)) return true;
      var hit = false;
      (bag.current || []).forEach(function(ca){
        if(!ca || ca.suggestOnly) return;
        if(a.name && (ca.name === a.name || ca.expenseName === a.name || ca.name === a.expenseName)) hit = true;
        if(a.id && ca.id === a.id) hit = true;
      });
      return hit;
    }

    // easy211: pack jreq parents before children (House → Family → Partner support)
    var toPlace = (function(list){
      var arr = (list || []).slice();
      var byId = Object.create(null);
      arr.forEach(function(a){
        if(!a) return;
        var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
        if(id) byId[String(id)] = a;
        if(a.id) byId[String(a.id)] = a;
        if(a.name) byId[String(a.name)] = a;
      });
      var depthMemo = Object.create(null);
      function depthOf(a, stack){
        if(!a || !a.jreqId) return 0;
        var jid = String(a.jreqId);
        if(depthMemo[jid] != null && !(stack && stack[jid])) return depthMemo[jid];
        if(stack && stack[jid]) return 0; // cycle
        stack = stack || Object.create(null);
        stack[jid] = 1;
        var parent = byId[jid];
        var d = 1 + (parent ? depthOf(parent, stack) : 0);
        depthMemo[jid] = d;
        return d;
      }
      arr.sort(function(a, b){
        var da = depthOf(a), db = depthOf(b);
        if(da !== db) return da - db;
        var sa = Number(a && a.__score01) || 0, sb = Number(b && b.__score01) || 0;
        if(sb !== sa) return sb - sa;
        return 0;
      });
      return arr;
    })(candidates);
    var suggest = [];
    var overflowList = [];
    var di = 0;
    var autoRun = (typeof easyLongestConsecRun === 'function') ? easyLongestConsecRun(days) : nDays;
    // easy84: openAvail = largest single open segment (never sum across work)
    var openAvail = 0;
    try {
      openSegments().forEach(function(s){ openAvail = Math.max(openAvail, Math.max(0, s.e - s.s)); });
    } catch(_o){ openAvail = awakeLen; }
    if(!(openAvail > 0)) openAvail = awakeLen;
    // easy192: Money/surplus affordability for Suggest horizon
    var affordInfo = (typeof easySuggestSurplusBudget === 'function')
      ? easySuggestSurplusBudget(days)
      : { budget: 0, committed: 0, surplusBase: 0, source: 'unknown', stock: 0, monthIndex: 0, savings0: 0 };
    var affordState = {
      remaining: Number(affordInfo.budget) || 0,
      stockRemaining: Number(affordInfo.stock) || 0,
      info: affordInfo
