            appetizing: isAppet,
            startLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(startM1) : '',
            endLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(endM1 >= 24*60 ? endM1 - 24*60 : endM1) : '',
            spanDays: 1, spanIndex: 1,
            charge: true,
            chargeOn: a.__ghostChargeOn || ((Number(a.amountOnce)>0 || String(a.chargeOn||'').toLowerCase()==='once') ? 'once' : 'monthly'),
            monthOnce: true,
            monthSpend: !!a.__monthSpendGhost,
            score01: a.__score01, durMin: dur
          };
          bag.ghost.push(ghost1);
          suggest.push(ghost1);
          satisfied[id] = 1;
          di = idx + 1;
          if(di >= nDays) di = 0;
          placed = true;
          break;
        }
      } else {
        for(var step2 = 0; step2 < nDays; step2++){
          var idx2 = (di + step2) % nDays;
          // Fit span into remaining consecutive days from idx2 (don't fail the whole month tail)
          var fit = span;
          var avail = 0;
          var ai;
          for(ai = 0; ai < span && (idx2 + ai) < nDays; ai++){
            if(ai > 0 && !isConsec(days[idx2 + ai - 1], days[idx2 + ai])) break;
            avail++;
          }
          if(avail < 1) continue;
          fit = Math.min(span, avail);
          var win = findSpanWindow(idx2, fit, dur);
          if(!win) continue;
          var anyNew = false;
          var si;
          for(si = 0; si < fit; si++){
            if(!dayHasAct(win.block[si].p, a)) anyNew = true;
          }
          if(!anyNew) continue;
          // easy83: one spread slot for the whole span presence (same clock each day)
          var spreadWin = clampOpenRoom(spreadOpenStart(win.block[0].bag, dur));
          var spanStartM = spreadWin ? spreadWin.startM : win.startM;
          var spanEndM = spreadWin ? spreadWin.endM : win.endM;
          if(inExclusive(spanStartM, spanEndM) === 'work'){
            if(spanStartM < workExStart) spanEndM = Math.min(spanEndM, workExStart);
            else continue;
            if(!(spanEndM > spanStartM) || inExclusive(spanStartM, spanEndM)) continue;
          }
          spreadIx++;
          for(si = 0; si < fit; si++){
            var bp = win.block[si];
            if(dayHasAct(bp.p, a)) continue;
            var bbag = bp.bag;
            if(isAppet && bbag && (bbag.nGhost|0) >= maxPerDay) bbag.nGhost = Math.max(0, maxPerDay - 1);
            advanceOpenCursor(bbag, spanStartM, spanEndM, dur);
            bbag.nGhost = (bbag.nGhost|0) + 1;
            var isLast = (si === fit - 1);
            var ghostS = {
              act: a, day: bp.p, id: id, already: false,
              startMin: spanStartM, endMin: spanEndM, canOverlap: true,
              appetizing: isAppet,
              startLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(spanStartM) : '',
              endLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(spanEndM >= 24*60 ? spanEndM - 24*60 : spanEndM) : '',
              spanDays: fit, spanIndex: si + 1,
              charge: !!isLast,
              chargeOn: 'lastSpan',
              monthOnce: true,
              monthSpend: !!a.__monthSpendGhost,
              dSpan: a.__dSpan || fit,
              presenceOnly: !isLast,
              score01: a.__score01, durMin: dur
            };
            bbag.ghost.push(ghostS);
            suggest.push(ghostS);
          }
          satisfied[id] = 1;
          // Overlap-ok: advance by 1 so the next item can start soon and fill later days
          di = idx2 + 1;
          if(di >= nDays) di = 0;
          placed = true;
          break;
        }
        // Fallback: park a 1-day charge ghost on the thinnest selected day (not only wake/sleep/work)
        if(!placed && isAppet){
          var bestIdx = -1, bestLoad = 1e9;
          for(var ti = 0; ti < nDays; ti++){
            var tp = days[ti];
            if(dayHasAct(tp, a)) continue;
            var tbag = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(tp)];
            var load = 0;
            (tbag.ghost || []).forEach(function(g){
              if(!g || !g.act) return;
              if(g.isRhythm || g.act.rhythm || g.act.name === 'Wake' || g.act.name === 'Sleep') return;
              if(g.act.kind === 'work') return;
              load++;
            });
            if(load < bestLoad){ bestLoad = load; bestIdx = ti; }
          }
          if(bestIdx >= 0){
            var pThin = days[bestIdx];
            var bagThin = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(pThin)];
            var roomT = clampOpenRoom(spreadOpenStart(bagThin, dur) || dayRoom(bagThin, dur, 'open')) || clampOpenRoom({ startM: wakeMin, endM: Math.min(wakeMin + Math.min(dur, 60), workExStart) });
            if(roomT){
              advanceOpenCursor(bagThin, roomT.startM, roomT.endM, dur);
              spreadIx++;
              bagThin.nGhost = (bagThin.nGhost|0) + 1;
              var gThin = {
                act: a, day: pThin, id: id, already: false,
                startMin: roomT.startM, endMin: roomT.endM, canOverlap: true,
                appetizing: true,
                startLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(roomT.startM) : '',
                endLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(roomT.endM) : '',
                spanDays: 1, spanIndex: 1,
                charge: true, chargeOn: 'lastSpan', monthOnce: true,
                monthSpend: !!a.__monthSpendGhost, dSpan: a.__dSpan || 1, presenceOnly: false
              };
              bagThin.ghost.push(gThin);
              suggest.push(gThin);
              satisfied[id] = 1;
              di = bestIdx + 1;
              if(di >= nDays) di = 0;
              placed = true;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if(!placed){
        var mustA = (typeof easySuggestMust === 'function') && easySuggestMust(a);
        var onceForce = false;
        try {
          onceForce = !!(a.__onceForcePlace || a.__jumpForce || a.__sugTag === 'jump-force' ||
            a.__sugTag === 'jump-force-ancestor' ||
            Math.abs(Number(a.amountOnce) || 0) > 0 || String(a.chargeOn || '').toLowerCase() === 'once');
          // easy211: schedule/joy dependents unlock when jreq parent is satisfied this pass
          if(!onceForce && a.jreqId && satisfied[a.jreqId] &&
             (a.kind === 'schedule' || a.kind === 'joy' || a.scheduleOnly)){
            onceForce = true;
          }
        } catch(_of){ onceForce = !!a.__onceForcePlace; }
        if(mustA || onceForce){
          // Degrade D-span to 1-day charge; try any selected day without the act
          var forceDur = Math.max(45, Math.min(60, Number(dur) || 60));
          var forceIdx = -1, forceLoad = 1e9;
          for(var mi = 0; mi < nDays; mi++){
            var mp = days[mi];
            if(dayHasAct(mp, a)) continue;
            var mbag = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(mp)];
            var mload = (mbag && mbag.ghost) ? mbag.ghost.length : 0;
            if(mload < forceLoad){ forceLoad = mload; forceIdx = mi; }
          }
          if(forceIdx < 0){
            // all days already have it live — skip ghost OK
            placed = true;
          } else {
            var pM = days[forceIdx];
            var bagM = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(pM)];
            var roomM = clampOpenRoom(spreadOpenStart(bagM, forceDur) || dayRoom(bagM, forceDur, 'open'));
            if(!roomM){
              var wake30 = wakeMin + 30;
              var end30 = Math.min(wake30 + forceDur, workExStart);
              if(!(end30 > wake30)) end30 = wake30 + Math.min(forceDur, 45);
              roomM = clampOpenRoom({ startM: wake30, endM: end30 });
            }
            if(!roomM){
              // last resort: still push shortened ghost (may sit near wake)
              var sF = wakeMin + 30;
              var eF = sF + 45;
              if(eF > workExStart && sF < workExStart) eF = workExStart;
              roomM = { startM: sF, endM: Math.max(sF + 30, eF), mustForced: true };
            }
            if(roomM){
              try { advanceOpenCursor(bagM, roomM.startM, roomM.endM, forceDur); } catch(_ac){}
              spreadIx++;
              bagM.nGhost = (bagM.nGhost|0) + 1;
              var gMust = {
                act: a, day: pM, id: id, already: false,
                startMin: roomM.startM, endMin: roomM.endM, canOverlap: true,
                appetizing: true, mustForced: true,
                startLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(roomM.startM) : '',
                endLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(roomM.endM >= 24*60 ? roomM.endM - 24*60 : roomM.endM) : '',
                spanDays: 1, spanIndex: 1,
                charge: true,
                chargeOn: a.__ghostChargeOn || ((Number(a.amountOnce)>0 || String(a.chargeOn||'').toLowerCase()==='once') ? 'once' : 'lastSpan'),
                monthOnce: true,
                monthSpend: !!a.__monthSpendGhost, dSpan: 1, presenceOnly: false,
                score01: a.__score01, durMin: Math.max(30, roomM.endM - roomM.startM),
                onceCost: a.__onceCost || Number(a.amountOnce) || 0
              };
              bagM.ghost.push(gMust);
              suggest.push(gMust);
              satisfied[id] = 1;
              di = forceIdx + 1;
              if(di >= nDays) di = 0;
              placed = true;
            }
          }
        }
        if(!placed){
          overflowList.push({ act: a, id: id, reason: span > 1 ? 'span' : 'time' });
        }
      }
      } finally {
        // easy192: consume month $ once per act when newly satisfied (not per span day)
        if(!satBefore && satisfied[id]){
          try {
            if(typeof easySuggestConsumeAfford === 'function') easySuggestConsumeAfford(a, affordState);
          } catch(_af){}
        }
      }
    });
    // Fill days that only have wake/sleep/work with leftover overflow appetizing (1-day)
    try {
      var leftovers = [];
      overflowList.forEach(function(o){
        if(!o || !o.act) return;
        if(o.reason === 'afford' || o.reason === 'jreq') return;
        if(o.act.kind === 'work' || o.act.rhythm) return;
        if(o.act.name === 'Wake' || o.act.name === 'Sleep') return;
        leftovers.push(o.act);
      });
      if(leftovers.length){
        days.forEach(function(p){
          var bagF = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
          if(!bagF) return;
          var extras = 0;
          (bagF.ghost || []).forEach(function(g){
            if(!g || !g.act) return;
            if(g.isRhythm || g.act.rhythm || g.act.name === 'Wake' || g.act.name === 'Sleep') return;
            if(g.act.kind === 'work') return;
            extras++;
          });
          if(extras > 0) return;
          if(!leftovers.length) return;
          var aF = leftovers.shift();
          var idF = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(aF) : (aF.id || aF.name);
          if(satisfied[idF]) return;
          var durF = (aF.__durMin != null) ? aF.__durMin : ((aF.__rankDurMin != null) ? aF.__rankDurMin : slotMin);
          var roomF = clampOpenRoom(spreadOpenStart(bagF, durF) || dayRoom(bagF, durF, 'open')) || clampOpenRoom({ startM: wakeMin, endM: Math.min(wakeMin + Math.min(durF, 60), workExStart) });
          if(!roomF) return;
          advanceOpenCursor(bagF, roomF.startM, roomF.endM, durF);
          spreadIx++;
          bagF.nGhost = (bagF.nGhost|0) + 1;
          var gF = {
            act: aF, day: p, id: idF, already: false,
            startMin: roomF.startM, endMin: roomF.endM, canOverlap: true, appetizing: true,
            startLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(roomF.startM) : '',
            endLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(roomF.endM) : '',
            spanDays: 1, spanIndex: 1, charge: true, chargeOn: 'lastSpan', monthOnce: true,
            monthSpend: true, presenceOnly: false, fillPass: true
          };
          bagF.ghost.push(gF);
          suggest.push(gF);
          satisfied[idF] = 1;
          // remove from overflowList
          overflowList = overflowList.filter(function(o){ return !(o && (o.id === idF || (o.act && (o.act.id===idF || o.act.name===aF.name)))); });
        });
      }
      // Never leave must-Suggest only in overflow — force 1-day ghost
      var stillMust = [];
      overflowList.forEach(function(o){
        if(!o || !o.act) return;
        if(o.reason === 'afford') return; // easy192: never silently place unaffordable musts/House-scale
        if(typeof easySuggestMust === 'function' && easySuggestMust(o.act)) stillMust.push(o);
      });
      stillMust.forEach(function(o){
        var aF2 = o.act;
        var idF2 = o.id || ((typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(aF2) : (aF2.id || aF2.name));
        if(satisfied[idF2]){
          overflowList = overflowList.filter(function(x){ return !(x && (x.id === idF2 || (x.act && (x.act.id===idF2 || x.act.name===aF2.name)))); });
          return;
        }
        var placedM2 = false;
        for(var di2 = 0; di2 < nDays && !placedM2; di2++){
          var p2 = days[di2];
          if(dayHasAct(p2, aF2)) continue;
          var bag2 = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p2)];
          var dur2 = 45;
          var room2 = clampOpenRoom(spreadOpenStart(bag2, dur2) || dayRoom(bag2, dur2, 'open')) || clampOpenRoom({ startM: wakeMin + 30, endM: Math.min(wakeMin + 30 + dur2, workExStart) });
          if(!room2){
            room2 = { startM: wakeMin + 30, endM: wakeMin + 30 + 45, mustForced: true };
          }
          try { advanceOpenCursor(bag2, room2.startM, room2.endM, dur2); } catch(_a2){}
          spreadIx++;
          bag2.nGhost = (bag2.nGhost|0) + 1;
          var g2 = {
            act: aF2, day: p2, id: idF2, already: false,
            startMin: room2.startM, endMin: room2.endM, canOverlap: true, appetizing: true, mustForced: true,
            startLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(room2.startM) : '',
            endLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(room2.endM) : '',
            spanDays: 1, spanIndex: 1, charge: true, chargeOn: 'lastSpan', monthOnce: true,
            monthSpend: true, presenceOnly: false, durMin: Math.max(30, room2.endM - room2.startM)
          };
          bag2.ghost.push(g2);
          suggest.push(g2);
          satisfied[idF2] = 1;
          placedM2 = true;
          overflowList = overflowList.filter(function(x){ return !(x && (x.id === idF2 || (x.act && (x.act.id===idF2 || x.act.name===aF2.name)))); });
        }
      });
    } catch(_fill){}

    days.forEach(function(p){
      var bagR = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
      var hasWake = false, hasSleep = false;
      if(wakeAct && easyActCoversDay(wakeAct, p)) hasWake = true;
      if(sleepAct && easyActCoversDay(sleepAct, p)) hasSleep = true;
      if(typeof easyLiveCoversOnDay === 'function'){
        if(easyLiveCoversOnDay({ rhythm:'wake', name:'Wake' }, p)) hasWake = true;
        if(easyLiveCoversOnDay({ rhythm:'sleep', name:'Sleep' }, p)) hasSleep = true;
      }
      (bagR.current || []).forEach(function(ca){
        if(!ca) return;
        if(ca.rhythm === 'wake' || ca.name === 'Wake') hasWake = true;
        if(ca.rhythm === 'sleep' || ca.name === 'Sleep') hasSleep = true;
      });
      // Already ghosted from Board wake/sleep gap pack — do not double
      (bagR.ghost || []).forEach(function(g){
        if(!g || !g.act) return;
        if(g.isRhythm || g.rhythm || g.act.rhythm === 'wake' || g.act.name === 'Wake' || g.exclusive === 'wake') hasWake = true;
        if(g.act.rhythm === 'sleep' || g.act.name === 'Sleep' || g.exclusive === 'sleep') hasSleep = true;
      });
      if(!hasWake){
        var gw = pushRhythmGhost(p, 'wake', wakeMin, Math.min(wakeMin + 30, wakeMin + awakeLen), wakeAct);
        if(gw) suggestRhythm.push(gw);
      }
      if(!hasSleep){
        var gs = pushRhythmGhost(p, 'sleep', sleepStart, (sleepStart + sleepDurMin > 24*60 ? 24*60 : (sleepStart + sleepDurMin)), sleepAct);
        if(gs) suggestRhythm.push(gs);
      }
    });


    var overflow = overflowList.length;

    var selWeekdays = days.filter(function(p){
      var dow = new Date(p.y, p.m, p.d).getDay();
      return dow >= 1 && dow <= 5;
    });
    var workHave = 0;
    selWeekdays.forEach(function(p){
      var bag = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
      var ok = false;
      (bag.current || []).forEach(function(ca){ if(ca && ca.kind === 'work') ok = true; });
      (bag.ghost || []).forEach(function(g){ if(g && g.act && g.act.kind === 'work') ok = true; });
      if(ok) workHave++;
    });
    var workQuota = {
      need: selWeekdays.length,
      have: workHave,
      ok: !selWeekdays.length || workHave >= selWeekdays.length,
      payDays: [1, 15]
    };

    suggest = (suggestRhythm || []).concat(suggest || []);

    // ---- Delete / rearrange ops (within selection) ----
    // Criteria = every must-suggest still covered PER MONTH for months touched by selection.
    // Never propose delete of a must that is the sole month cover; optional live can drop/move.
    try {
      var liveOnSel = [];
      (typeof easyBoardActs === 'function' ? easyBoardActs() : []).forEach(function(b){
        if(!b || b.suggestOnly || String(b.id||'').indexOf('__sug_')===0) return;
        var hitDays = [];
        days.forEach(function(p){
          if(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function' && easyActCoversDay(b, p)) hitDays.push(p);
        });
        if(hitDays.length) liveOnSel.push({ act: b, days: hitDays });
      });
      liveOnSel.forEach(function(rec){
        var b = rec.act;
        var isMustB = (typeof easySuggestMust === 'function') && easySuggestMust(b);
        var isRhythmB = !!(b.rhythm || b.name === 'Wake' || b.name === 'Sleep');
        var isWorkB = b.kind === 'work';
        var bid = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(b) : (b.id || b.name);
        // Skip if we already have an add-ghost for this act (gap fill wins)
        var hasAdd = false;
        (suggest || []).forEach(function(g){
          if(!g || !g.act) return;
          if((g.act.id && g.act.id === b.id) || (g.act.name && g.act.name === b.name)) hasAdd = true;
        });
        if(hasAdd) return;
        // Schedule rituals already on the day via cadence (Gym/Lunch/meals) — not delete/move fodder.
        // Gym intentionally sits in the work block; Lunch may too — don't "rearrange" them away.
        if(b.kind === 'schedule' || b.scheduleOnly){
          if(typeof easyLiveAlreadyOnSelection === 'function' && easyLiveAlreadyOnSelection(b, days)) return;
          if(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function'){
            var allOn = true;
            rec.days.forEach(function(p){ if(!easyActCoversDay(b, p)) allOn = false; });
            if(allOn) return;
          }
        }

        // DELETE: optional live only when it fights the day (exclusive clash / overcrowded)
        // and month must-suggest set still holds without it.
        if(!isMustB && !isRhythmB && !isWorkB){
          var okDel = (typeof easyMonthMustsStillMet === 'function') ? easyMonthMustsStillMet(days, b) : true;
          if(okDel){
            rec.days.forEach(function(p){
              var bag = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
              if(!bag) return;
              var tp = (typeof easyActTimePair === 'function') ? easyActTimePair(b) : { s:'', e:'' };
              var sm = (b.startMin != null) ? Number(b.startMin) : ((typeof easyParseHHMM === 'function' && tp.s) ? easyParseHHMM(tp.s) : null);
              var em = (b.endMin != null) ? Number(b.endMin) : ((typeof easyParseHHMM === 'function' && tp.e) ? easyParseHHMM(tp.e) : null);
              var fights = false;
              if(sm != null && em != null && em > sm && typeof inExclusive === 'function' && inExclusive(sm, em)) fights = true;
              if((bag.current || []).length + (bag.nGhost|0) > maxPerDay) fights = true;
              if(!fights) return;
              if(sm == null){ sm = wakeMin; em = wakeMin + 60; }
              if(!(em > sm)) em = sm + 60;
              var gd = {
                act: b, day: p, id: bid, already: true,
                op: 'delete', suggestOp: 'delete',
                startMin: sm, endMin: em, canOverlap: true,
                startLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(sm) : '',
                endLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(em >= 24*60 ? em - 24*60 : em) : '',
                spanDays: 1, spanIndex: 1, charge: false,
                presenceOnly: true
              };
              bag.ghost.push(gd);
              suggest.push(gd);
              bag.nGhost = (bag.nGhost|0) + 1;
            });
          }
        }

        // REARRANGE: live timed act overlapping work/sleep exclusive → propose open-window slot
        // Musts may rearrange (same month cover); work/rhythm keep exclusive slots (no move here).
        if(!isRhythmB && !isWorkB && b.startMin != null && b.endMin != null){
          var sm0 = Number(b.startMin), em0 = Number(b.endMin);
          if(em0 > sm0 && typeof inExclusive === 'function' && inExclusive(sm0, em0)){
            rec.days.forEach(function(p){
              var bag = byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
              if(!bag) return;
              var room = (typeof dayRoom === 'function') ? dayRoom(bag, Math.max(30, em0 - sm0), 'open') : null;
              if(!room) return;
              var gm = {
                act: b, day: p, id: bid, already: true,
                op: 'move', suggestOp: 'move',
                startMin: room.startM, endMin: room.endM, canOverlap: true,
                fromStartMin: sm0, fromEndMin: em0,
                startLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(room.startM) : '',
                endLabel: (typeof easyFmtHHMM === 'function') ? easyFmtHHMM(room.endM >= 24*60 ? room.endM - 24*60 : room.endM) : '',
                spanDays: 1, spanIndex: 1, charge: false
              };
              bag.ghost.push(gm);
              suggest.push(gm);
              bag.nGhost = (bag.nGhost|0) + 1;
            });
          }
        }
      });
    } catch(_ops){}

    return {
      current: current,
      suggest: suggest,
      byDay: byDay,
      days: days,
      nSlots: nDays,
      nGhost: suggest.length,
      overflow: overflow,
      overflowList: overflowList,
      afford: affordInfo,
      affordRemaining: affordState ? Number(affordState.remaining) : null,
      maxPerDay: maxPerDay,
      hardCap: hardCap,
      toPlace: toPlace.length,
      rhythm: rhythm,
      quotaJreqId: quotaJreqId || '__sleep__',
      sleepActId: sleepActId,
      sleepReserved: !!sleepActId,
      sleepDurMin: sleepDurMin,
      awakeLen: awakeLen,
      wakeMin: wakeMin,
      sleepStartMin: sleepStart,
      workQuota: workQuota,
      appetizing: (function(){
        try {
          var ranksA = (typeof calcRanks === 'function') ? calcRanks() : null;
          var itemsA = (ranksA && ranksA.items) ? ranksA.items.slice() : [];
          itemsA.sort(function(a,b){ return (Number(b.score)||0) - (Number(a.score)||0); });
          return itemsA.slice(0, 12).map(function(it){
            return { name: it.name, score: Number(it.score)||0, score1000: Math.round((Number(it.score)||0)*1000) };
          });
        } catch(_e){ return []; }
      })()
    };
  }

  function easyExpenseAmt(it){
    if(!it) return 0;
    // Match SUMMARY / EXPENSES tab: same lineAmt order (honor [REDACTED-AMOUNT] on active field).
    try { if(typeof lineAmt === 'function') return Number(lineAmt(it)) || 0; } catch(_e){}
    var lf = (typeof lineField === 'function') ? lineField() : 'current';
    try {
      var strict = it[lf];
      if(strict !== '' && strict != null && isFinite(Number(strict))) return Number(strict);
    } catch(_s){}
    var n = Number(it.current != null && it.current !== '' ? it.current : it.projected);
    return isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
  }
  function easyExpenseItems(){
    var out = [];
    var secs = (WB && WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections) || [];
    secs.forEach(function(sec){
      (sec.items || []).forEach(function(it){
        if(!it || !it.name) return;
        if(/\bTOTAL\b/i.test(it.name) || /^GRAND\b/i.test(it.name)) return;
        out.push({ name: it.name, section: sec.name || 'EXPENSE', amount: easyExpenseAmt(it) });
      });
    });
    return out;
  }
  function easyValuedExpenseItems(){
    return easyExpenseItems().filter(function(it){ return it && it.amount > 0; });
  }
  function easyJoyList(){
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    var list = [];
    function add(id, title){
      if(!id || seen[id]) return;
      seen[id] = true;
      list.push({ id: id, title: title || id });
    }
    var labels = (typeof DIM_LABEL === 'object' && DIM_LABEL) ? DIM_LABEL : { H:'Happy', D:'Days', A:'Age', M:'Money', E:'External' };
    var dims = (typeof DIMS !== 'undefined' && DIMS && DIMS.length) ? DIMS : ['H','D','A','M','E'];
    dims.forEach(function(d){ add(d, labels[d] || d); });
    add('surplus', 'Surplus');
    add('debt', 'Debt');
    var map = {};
    try { map = (calcHdame() && calcHdame().joyMap) || {}; } catch(_m){}
    Object.keys(map).forEach(function(k){
      if(seen[k]) return;
      var id = k;
      var title = labels[k] || k.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+k.slice(1);
      add(id, title);
    });
    return list;
  }
  function easyJoyTitle(id){
    var joys = easyJoyList();
    for(var i=0;i<joys.length;i++){ if(joys[i].id===id) return joys[i].title; }
    var labels = (typeof DIM_LABEL === 'object' && DIM_LABEL) ? DIM_LABEL : {};
    if(labels[id]) return labels[id];
    return id || '';
  }
  function easyRelationMethods(){
    var list = [];
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    function add(id, title){
      if(!id || seen[id]) return;
      seen[id] = true;
      list.push({ id: id, title: title || id });
    }
    if(window.RankingJoys){
      Object.keys(window.RankingJoys).forEach(function(id){
        var j = window.RankingJoys[id] || {};
        var methods = j.methods || (typeof j.score === 'function' ? ['score'] : []);
        methods.forEach(function(m){
          add(id+'.'+m, (j.title||id)+' · '+m);
        });
      });
    }
    var cat = (window.__RANKING_JOYS_CATALOG__ && (window.__RANKING_JOYS_CATALOG__.index || window.__RANKING_JOYS_CATALOG__)) || {};
    var joys = (cat.joys) || [];
    joys.forEach(function(j){
      var id = j.id || j;
      var title = j.title || id;
      (j.methods || ['score']).forEach(function(m){ add(id+'.'+m, title+' · '+m); });
    });
    return list;
  }
  function easyJUnit(x, y){
    var ax = Math.abs(Number(x) || 0);
    var ay = Math.abs(Number(y) || 0);
    var raw = ax + ay;
    try {
      if(window.JF && window.JF.JBlueprint && window.JF.JBlueprint.norm)
        return window.JF.JBlueprint.norm.unit(raw, 1);
    } catch(_n){}
    return raw / (1 + raw);
  }
  function easyParseAmt(s, fallback){
    if(s == null || String(s).trim() === '') return fallback;
    var n = Number(s);
    return isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
  }
  function easyFmtAmt(n){
    n = Number(n);
    if(!isFinite(n)) return '0';
    if(n === 0) return '0';
    return (n > 0 ? '' : '−') + String(Math.abs(n));
  }
  function easyJmethodList(){
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    var list = [];
    function add(id, title){
      if(!id || seen[id]) return;
      seen[id] = true;
      list.push({ id: id, title: title || id });
    }
    add('JUnit', '0–1');
    add('JDirect', 'Direct');
    add('JIndirect', 'Indirect');
    add('JNeutral', 'Neutral');
    easyRelationMethods().forEach(function(m){ add(m.id, m.title); });
    var fac = [];
    try { if(window.JoyFactors && window.JoyFactors.listFactors) fac = window.JoyFactors.listFactors() || []; } catch(_e){}
    fac.forEach(function(id){ add(id, id); });
    return list;
  }

  function easyActOnCal(a){
    if(!a) return false;
    if(a.selectedKeys && a.selectedKeys.length) return true;
    if(a.repeatMarks && a.repeatMarks.length) return true;
    if(a.yearMarks && typeof a.yearMarks === 'object'){
      for(var k in a.yearMarks){
        if(a.yearMarks[k] && a.yearMarks[k].length) return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  function easyActTimePair(a){
    var s = '', e = '';
    if(!a || a.allDay || (a.hours && a.hours[0]==='all')) return { s: s, e: e };
    if(a.startMin != null){
      s = easyFmtHHMM(a.startMin);
      var em = a.endMin != null ? a.endMin : (a.endHour != null ? Number(a.endHour)*60 : Number(a.startMin)+60);
      e = easyFmtHHMM(em);
    } else if(a.hours && a.hours[0] != null && a.hours[0] !== 'all'){
      s = easyPad2(Number(a.hours[0])%24)+':00';
      e = easyPad2((Number(a.hours[a.hours.length-1])%24)+1)+':00';
    }
    return { s: s, e: e };
  }
  function easyFindAct(id){
    var acts = easyScheduleActions();
    for(var i=0;i<acts.length;i++){
      if(acts[i] && (acts[i].id===id || acts[i].name===id)) return acts[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function easyActId(a){ return a ? (a.id || a.name) : ''; }
  function easyFindJreqTarget(act){
    var id = act && act.jreqId;
    if(!id) return null;
    return (typeof easyFindAct === 'function') ? easyFindAct(id) : null;
  }
  function easyJreqOptions(excludeId){
    return (typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function' ? easyScheduleActions() : []).filter(function(a){
      if(!a) return false;
      var id = easyActId(a);
      return id && id !== excludeId;
    });
  }
  function easyJreqReadyInOrder(act, priorIdsSet){
    if(!act || !act.jreqId) return true;
    return !!(priorIdsSet && priorIdsSet[act.jreqId]);
  }
  function easyFindSleepAct(){
    var acts = (typeof getCalendarCustomActions === 'function' ? getCalendarCustomActions() : []) || [];
    for(var i=0;i<acts.length;i++){
      var a = acts[i];
      if(!a) continue;
      if(a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Sleep') return a;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function easyDayQuotaJreq(){
    var s = easyFindSleepAct();
    return s ? easyActId(s) : null;
  }
  function easyActMeta(a){
    if(!a) return 'action';
    var meta;
    if(a.kind === 'work'){
      var tp = easyActTimePair(a);
      var clock = (tp.s && tp.e) ? (tp.s+'–'+tp.e) : (a.allDay ? 'all day' : 'work');
      meta = 'work · '+clock;
    } else if(a.expenseName){
      meta = 'expense · '+a.expenseName;
    } else if(a.kind === 'joy' || a.joyFrom || a.joyTo || a.jmethod){
      var aT = a.joyFromTitle || a.joyTitle || a.joyFrom || a.joyId || 'joy';
      var bT = a.joyToTitle || a.joyTo || '';
      var mT = a.jmethodTitle || a.jmethod || '';
      var ax = a.x != null ? a.x : a.joyFromAmt;
      var ay = a.y != null ? a.y : a.joyToAmt;
      var bits = [aT + (ax != null ? ' '+easyFmtAmt(ax) : '')];
      if(bT) bits.push('→ '+bT + (ay != null ? ' '+easyFmtAmt(ay) : ''));
      if(mT) bits.push('· '+mT);
      meta = 'joy jaction · '+bits.join(' ');
    } else if(a.joyId){
      meta = 'joy · '+(a.joyTitle || a.joyId);
    } else if(a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Sleep'){
      meta = 'rhythm · sleep';
    } else if(a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.name === 'Wake'){
      meta = 'rhythm · wake';
    } else {
      meta = 'action';
    }
    if(a.jreqId){
      var jt = (typeof easyFindJreqTarget === 'function') ? easyFindJreqTarget(a) : null;
      var jn = jt ? (jt.name || a.jreqId) : a.jreqId;
      meta += ' · jreq→'+jn;
    }
    if(a.simView) meta += ' · sim';
    var sd = (typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(a) : (Number(a.spanDays)||1);
    if(sd > 1) meta += ' · span '+sd;
    var co = (typeof easyChargeOn === 'function') ? easyChargeOn(a) : a.chargeOn;
    if(co === 'payDays' || a.kind === 'work'){
      var pds = (typeof easyPayDays === 'function') ? easyPayDays(a) : (a.payDays || [1, 15]);
      if(pds && pds.length) meta += ' · pay '+pds.join('&');
    }
    try {
      var onceM = Math.abs(Number(a.amountOnce) || 0);
      var monM = Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly) || 0);
      if(onceM > 0) meta += ' · once $'+Math.round(onceM);
      if(monM > 0) meta += ' · $'+Math.round(monM)+'/mo';
    } catch(_mm){}
    return meta;
  }


  function easyMonthDay(m, d){
    return String(m) + '-' + String(d);
  }
  function easyPlaceMarks(act, y, m, d){
    if(!act) return act;
    act.cadence = 'selected';
    if(easyCal.allYears){
      act.repeatMarks = (act.repeatMarks || []).slice();
      var md = easyMonthDay(m, d);
      if(act.repeatMarks.indexOf(md) < 0) act.repeatMarks.push(md);
    } else {
      act.selectedKeys = (act.selectedKeys || []).slice();
      var key = easyDayKey(y, m, d);
      if(act.selectedKeys.indexOf(key) < 0) act.selectedKeys.push(key);
    }
    return act;
  }
  function easyDaySort(a, b){
    return (a.y - b.y) || (a.m - b.m) || (a.d - b.d);
  }
  function easyCalcKey(y, m, d){
    return easyCal.allYears ? easyMonthDay(m, d) : easyDayKey(y, m, d);
  }
  function easyAddCalc(act, y, m, d){
    if(easyCal.allYears){
      act.calcMarks = (act.calcMarks || []).slice();
      var md = easyMonthDay(m, d);
      if(act.calcMarks.indexOf(md) < 0) act.calcMarks.push(md);
    } else {
      act.calcKeys = (act.calcKeys || []).slice();
      var key = easyDayKey(y, m, d);
      if(act.calcKeys.indexOf(key) < 0) act.calcKeys.push(key);
    }
  }
  function easyIsCalcDay(act, y, m, d){
    if(!act) return false;
    // Prefer chargeOn / span / payDays when present — don't bill every appearance day.
    if(typeof easyChargesOnDay === 'function' && (act.chargeOn || act.kind === 'work' || (Number(act.spanDays)||0) > 1)){
      return easyChargesOnDay(act, y, m, d);
    }
    var has = (act.calcKeys && act.calcKeys.length) || (act.calcMarks && act.calcMarks.length);
    if(!has) return true;
    if(act.calcKeys && act.calcKeys.length && act.calcKeys.indexOf(easyDayKey(y, m, d)) >= 0) return true;
    if(act.calcMarks && act.calcMarks.length && act.calcMarks.indexOf(easyMonthDay(m, d)) >= 0) return true;
    return false;
  }
  function easyPlaceOnDays(act, days, span){
    if(!act || !days || !days.length) return act;
    var sorted = days.slice().sort(easyDaySort);
    sorted.forEach(function(p){ easyPlaceMarks(act, p.y, p.m, p.d); });
    if(span){
      act.span = true;
      act.spanDays = Math.max(1, sorted.length);
      if(act.kind === 'work'){
        act.chargeOn = act.chargeOn || 'payDays';
        if(!act.payDays || !act.payDays.length) act.payDays = [1, 15];
      } else if(!act.chargeOn || act.chargeOn === 'monthly'){
        act.chargeOn = 'lastSpan';
      }
      var last = sorted[sorted.length - 1];
      easyAddCalc(act, last.y, last.m, last.d);
    } else {
      sorted.forEach(function(p){ easyAddCalc(act, p.y, p.m, p.d); });
    }
    return act;
  }

  function easyGhostActKey(g){
    if(!g) return '';
    if(g.id) return String(g.id);
    if(g.act) return String(g.act.id || g.act.name || '');
    return '';
  }

  /** Board Selection: detect timed overlaps for clash color-coding (easy85). */
  function easyBoardTimeOverlaps(liveActs, ghosts){
    var DAY = 24 * 60;
    var intervals = [];
    function tagKind(a, s){
      if((s && (s.isWork || (s.act && s.act.kind === 'work'))) || (a && a.kind === 'work')) return 'work';
      if(s && (s.isRhythm || s.rhythm)) return 'rhythm';
      if(a && (a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.rhythm || a.name === 'Wake' || a.name === 'Sleep')) return 'rhythm';
      return 'open';
    }
    function pushRanges(key, name, start, end, kind, meta){
      if(start == null || end == null || !isFinite(start) || !isFinite(end)) return;
      start = Number(start); end = Number(end);
      var ranges;
      if(end > start){
        ranges = [[start, end]];
      } else if(end === start){
        return; // zero-length: no clash
      } else {
        // overnight: [start, DAY) U [0, end)
        ranges = [[start, DAY], [0, end]];
      }
      ranges.forEach(function(r){
        intervals.push({
          key: String(key),
          name: name || String(key),
          start: r[0],
          end: r[1],
          kind: kind,
          meta: meta || null
        });
      });
    }
    (liveActs || []).forEach(function(a){
      if(!a) return;
      if(a.allDay || (a.hours && a.hours[0] === 'all')) return;
      var tp = (typeof easyActTimePair === 'function') ? easyActTimePair(a) : { s: '', e: '' };
      if(!tp.s || !tp.e) return;
      var sm = (typeof easyParseHHMM === 'function') ? easyParseHHMM(tp.s) : null;
      var em = (typeof easyParseHHMM === 'function') ? easyParseHHMM(tp.e) : null;
      if(sm == null || em == null) return;
      var key = a.id || a.name;
      if(!key) return;
      pushRanges(key, a.name || String(key), sm, em, tagKind(a, null), { live: true });
    });
    var ghostKeyCount = Object.create(null);
    (ghosts || []).forEach(function(s, gi){
      if(!s) return;
      var a = s.act || null;
      var sm = (s.startMin != null && isFinite(Number(s.startMin))) ? Number(s.startMin) : null;
      var em = (s.endMin != null && isFinite(Number(s.endMin))) ? Number(s.endMin) : null;
      if(sm == null || em == null){
        var sl = s.startLabel || '';
        var el = s.endLabel || '';
        if(sl && el && typeof easyParseHHMM === 'function'){
          sm = easyParseHHMM(sl);
          em = easyParseHHMM(el);
        }
      }
      if(sm == null || em == null) return;
      var base = (typeof easyGhostActKey === 'function' && easyGhostActKey(s)) || (s.id || (a && (a.id || a.name)) || ('g'+gi));
      base = String(base || ('g'+gi));
      var dayKey = '';
      if(s.day){
        dayKey = (typeof easyDayKeyStr === 'function') ? easyDayKeyStr(s.day) : [s.day.y, s.day.m, s.day.d].join('-');
      }
      var key = 'ghost:' + base + (dayKey ? (':' + dayKey) : '');
      // If multiple ghost rows share same key without day, disambiguate
      if(ghostKeyCount[key] != null){
        ghostKeyCount[key]++;
        key = key + '#' + ghostKeyCount[key];
      } else {
        ghostKeyCount[key] = 0;
      }
      var nm = (a && a.name) || s.name || base;
      pushRanges(key, nm, sm, em, tagKind(a, s), { live: false, ghost: s, base: base });
    });

    var byKey = Object.create(null);
    function ensure(k){
      if(!byKey[k]) byKey[k] = { clashWork: false, clashRhythm: false, clashPeer: false, peerGroup: -1, partners: [] };
      return byKey[k];
    }
    intervals.forEach(function(iv){ ensure(iv.key); });

    function overlaps(a, b){
      return a.start < b.end && b.start < a.end;
    }

    // Index unique keys -> representative interval indices (may have overnight splits)
    var n = intervals.length;
    var adj = [];
    for(var i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = [];

    for(var i = 0; i < n; i++){
      for(var j = i + 1; j < n; j++){
        var A = intervals[i], B = intervals[j];
        if(A.key === B.key) continue; // same item overnight halves
        if(!overlaps(A, B)) continue;
        var ea = ensure(A.key), eb = ensure(B.key);
        if(ea.partners.indexOf(B.name) < 0) ea.partners.push(B.name);
        if(eb.partners.indexOf(A.name) < 0) eb.partners.push(A.name);
        if(A.kind === 'work') eb.clashWork = true;
        if(B.kind === 'work') ea.clashWork = true;
        if(A.kind === 'rhythm') eb.clashRhythm = true;
        if(B.kind === 'rhythm') ea.clashRhythm = true;
        if(B.kind === 'open') ea.clashPeer = true;
        if(A.kind === 'open') eb.clashPeer = true;
        // Graph: open↔open plus attach work/rhythm for partner labeling / shared cluster
        adj[i].push(j);
        adj[j].push(i);
      }
    }

    var seen = Object.create(null);
    var compId = 0;
    for(var i = 0; i < n; i++){
      if(seen[i] || !adj[i].length) continue;
      var stack = [i], members = [];
      seen[i] = 1;
      while(stack.length){
        var u = stack.pop();
        members.push(u);
        for(var ai = 0; ai < adj[u].length; ai++){
          var v = adj[u][ai];
          if(!seen[v]){ seen[v] = 1; stack.push(v); }
        }
      }
      var gid = compId++;
      var keyed = Object.create(null);
      members.forEach(function(u){
        var k = intervals[u].key;
        if(keyed[k]) return;
        keyed[k] = 1;
        ensure(k).peerGroup = gid;
      });
    }

    return { byKey: byKey };
  }

  /** Turn a suggest stub into a real calendar act (or reuse Board/live). */
  function easyMaterializeSuggestAct(src){
    if(!src) return null;
    try {
      var live = null;
      // Prefer existing live act by name first (Accept must never mint duplicates)
      if(src.name && typeof easyFindAct === 'function') live = easyFindAct(src.name);
      if(!live && src.expenseName && typeof easyFindAct === 'function') live = easyFindAct(src.expenseName);
      if(!live && src.id && String(src.id).indexOf('__sug_') !== 0 && typeof easyFindAct === 'function') live = easyFindAct(src.id);
      if(live && !live.suggestOnly && String(live.id || '').indexOf('__sug_') !== 0) return live;
    } catch(_l){}
    if(src.kind === 'work' || src.id === '__sug_work__'){
      var w = null;
      try {
        // Any live Work on the board/calendar
        (typeof easyBoardActs === 'function' ? easyBoardActs() : []).forEach(function(b){
          if(b && b.kind === 'work' && !b.suggestOnly && String(b.id||'').indexOf('__sug_') !== 0) w = w || b;
        });
      } catch(_w){}
      if(w) return w;
      try { w = (typeof easyFindBoardWork === 'function') ? easyFindBoardWork() : null; } catch(_w2){}
      if(w && !w.suggestOnly && String(w.id||'').indexOf('__sug_') !== 0) return w;
      w = (typeof easyBlankWorkAct === 'function') ? easyBlankWorkAct(src.name || 'Work') : null;
      if(!w) return null;
      w.author = 'ranking_ui';
      w.lane = 'plan';
      w.scheduleOnly = true;
      w.spanMode = 'payPeriod';
      w.chargeOn = 'payDays';
      w.payDays = (src.payDays && src.payDays.length) ? src.payDays.slice() : [1, 15];
      if(src.startMin != null){
        w.allDay = false;
        w.startMin = Number(src.startMin);
        w.endMin = Number(src.endMin != null ? src.endMin : (Number(src.startMin) + 60));
      }
      if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(w);
      return w;
    }
    var act = {
      id: (typeof easyNewId === 'function') ? easyNewId(src.name) : ('act_' + Date.now()),
      name: src.name,
      kind: src.kind || 'spend',
      polarity: src.polarity || (src.kind === 'work' ? 'gain' : 'spend'),
      amountMonthly: Number(src.amountMonthly != null ? src.amountMonthly : src.amount) || 0,
      expenseName: src.expenseName || src.name,
      expenseSection: src.expenseSection || src.section || 'EXPENSE',
      isDebtPay: !!src.isDebtPay,
      cadence: 'selected',
      selectedKeys: [],
      lane: 'plan',
      scheduleOnly: true,
      author: 'ranking_ui',
      enabled: true
    };
    if(src.jreqId) act.jreqId = src.jreqId;
    if(src.rhythm) act.rhythm = src.rhythm;
    if(src.startMin != null){
      act.allDay = false;
      act.startMin = Number(src.startMin);
      act.endMin = Number(src.endMin != null ? src.endMin : (Number(src.startMin) + 60));
    }
    if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(act);
    return act;
  }
  function easyApplyGhostTime(act, g){
    if(!act || !g || g.startMin == null) return act;
    var sm = Number(g.startMin);
    var em = Number(g.endMin != null ? g.endMin : sm + 60);
    if(!(em > sm)) em = sm + 60;
    act.allDay = false;
    act.startMin = sm;
    act.endMin = em;
    act.endHour = Math.ceil(em / 60);
    var hours = [];
    for(var h = Math.floor(sm / 60); h < Math.ceil(em / 60) && h < 24; h++) hours.push(h);
    if(!hours.length) hours = [Math.floor(sm / 60) % 24];
    act.hours = hours;
    return act;
  }
  /**
   * Accept one suggested act (all its ghost days / D-span) onto the real calendar.
   * quiet=true skips render (for Accept all).
   */
  function easyAcceptSuggestKey(key, plan, quiet){
    if(!key) return 0;
    plan = plan || ((typeof easySelGhostPlan === 'function')
      ? easySelGhostPlan((typeof easyBestRank === 'function') ? easyBestRank() : null)
      : null);
    if(!plan) return 0;
    var ghosts = (plan.suggest || []).filter(function(g){ return easyGhostActKey(g) === key; });
    if(!ghosts.length) return 0;
    // Delete / move ops act on LIVE calendar acts (month musts already gated at plan time)
    var op0 = ghosts[0] && (ghosts[0].op || ghosts[0].suggestOp);
    if(op0 === 'delete' || op0 === 'move'){
      var live = null;
      try {
        live = (typeof easyLiveOnCalendar === 'function') ? easyLiveOnCalendar(ghosts[0].act) : null;
      } catch(_l){ live = null; }
      if(!live) return 0;
      if(op0 === 'delete'){
        var keys = (live.selectedKeys || live.selected || []).slice();
        var drop = Object.create(null);
        ghosts.forEach(function(g){
          if(!g || !g.day) return;
          drop[(typeof easyDayKeyStr === 'function') ? easyDayKeyStr(g.day) : (g.day.y+'-'+g.day.m+'-'+g.day.d)] = 1;
        });
        live.selectedKeys = keys.filter(function(k){
          if(drop[k]) return false;
          // also drop alt formats
          for(var dk in drop){
            if(String(k).indexOf(dk) >= 0) return false;
          }
          return true;
        });
        live.selected = live.selectedKeys;
        try { if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(live); } catch(_c){}
        if(!quiet && typeof easyPreserveScroll === 'function'){
          easyPreserveScroll(function(){ if(typeof renderAll === 'function') renderAll(); });
        }
        return ghosts.length;
      }
      if(op0 === 'move'){
        var timed = ghosts[0];
        for(var ti0 = 0; ti0 < ghosts.length; ti0++){
          if(ghosts[ti0] && ghosts[ti0].startMin != null){ timed = ghosts[ti0]; break; }
        }
        if(timed && typeof easyApplyGhostTime === 'function') easyApplyGhostTime(live, timed);
        try { if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(live); } catch(_c2){}
        if(!quiet && typeof easyPreserveScroll === 'function'){
          easyPreserveScroll(function(){ if(typeof renderAll === 'function') renderAll(); });
        }
        return ghosts.length;
      }
    }
    var dayMap = Object.create(null);
    var days = [];
    ghosts.forEach(function(g){
      if(!g || !g.day) return;
      var dk = (typeof easyDayKeyStr === 'function') ? easyDayKeyStr(g.day) : (g.day.y+'-'+g.day.m+'-'+g.day.d);
      if(dayMap[dk]) return;
      dayMap[dk] = 1;
      days.push(g.day);
    });
    if(!days.length) return 0;
    if(typeof easyDaySort === 'function') days.sort(easyDaySort);
    var src = ghosts[0].act;
    // Already accepted? every ghost day already has a live act
    var already = 0;
    days.forEach(function(p){
      if(typeof easyLiveCoversOnDay === 'function' && easyLiveCoversOnDay(src, p)) already++;
    });
    if(already >= days.length){
      return -1; // signal: already on calendar
    }
    var act = easyMaterializeSuggestAct(src);
    if(!act) return 0;
    var timed = null;
    for(var ti = 0; ti < ghosts.length; ti++){
      if(ghosts[ti] && ghosts[ti].startMin != null){ timed = ghosts[ti]; break; }
    }
        if(timed) easyApplyGhostTime(act, timed);
    var maxSpan = 1;
    ghosts.forEach(function(g){ if((g.spanDays|0) > maxSpan) maxSpan = (g.spanDays|0); });
    if(src && src.__dSpan) maxSpan = Math.max(maxSpan, Number(src.__dSpan)|0);
    if(ghosts[0] && ghosts[0].dSpan) maxSpan = Math.max(maxSpan, Number(ghosts[0].dSpan)|0);
    // If ghosts declare a longer D-span than collected days, extend consecutive days from the first ghost day
    if(maxSpan > days.length && days.length){
      var origin = days[0];
      var filled = [];
      var fi;
      for(fi = 0; fi < maxSpan; fi++){
        var fp = (typeof easyAddCalDays === 'function') ? easyAddCalDays(origin.y, origin.m, origin.d, fi) : null;
        if(!fp) break;
        filled.push(fp);
      }
      if(filled.length > days.length) days = filled;
      if(typeof easyDaySort === 'function') days.sort(easyDaySort);
    }
    var useSpan = (days.length > 1) || (maxSpan > 1);
    if(act.kind === 'work' || (ghosts[0] && ghosts[0].isWorkSpan)){
      act.chargeOn = 'payDays';
      if(!act.payDays || !act.payDays.length) act.payDays = [1, 15];
      act.span = !!useSpan;
      act.spanDays = Math.max(maxSpan, days.length);
    } else {
      act.chargeOn = 'lastSpan';
      act.span = !!useSpan;
      act.spanDays = Math.max(maxSpan, days.length);
      act.monthOnce = true;
      if(ghosts[0] && (ghosts[0].monthSpend || ghosts[0].dSpan)) act.__fromDSpan = true;
    }
    if(typeof easyPlaceOnDays === 'function') easyPlaceOnDays(act, days, useSpan);
    else days.forEach(function(p){ if(typeof easyPlaceMarks === 'function') easyPlaceMarks(act, p.y, p.m, p.d); });
    // Re-assert span after placeOnDays (it can normalize spanDays to sorted.length)
    if(useSpan){
      act.span = true;
      act.spanDays = Math.max(1, days.length, maxSpan);
      if(act.kind !== 'work') act.chargeOn = 'lastSpan';
    }


    if(quiet){
      if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(act);
    } else {
      if(typeof easyCommit === 'function') easyCommit(act);
      else if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function'){ easyCommitQuiet(act); if(typeof renderAll === 'function') renderAll(); }
    }
    return days.length;
  }

  function easyHardClearScenarioCalendar(sc){
    sc = normalizeSc(sc);
    ensureCalendarsBag();
    var bag = WB.calendars[sc] || {};
    bag.customActions = [];
    bag.rules = bag.rules || [];
    WB.calendars[sc] = bag;
    if(activeSc() === sc) WB.calendar = bag;
    try { WB._calUserCleared = false; } catch(_c){}
    // Drop leaked money acts from the shared catalog (legacy commits).
    try {
      if(window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ && Array.isArray(window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions)){
        window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions = window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions.filter(function(a){
          if(!a) return false;
          var moneyish = a.kind === 'work' || a.kind === 'spend' || a.polarity === 'spend' || a.polarity === 'gain' ||
            a.expenseName || (Number(a.amountMonthly) > 0) || (Number(a.amount) > 0) ||
            a.author === 'ranking_ui' || a.lane === 'plan';
          return !moneyish;
        });
      }
    } catch(_cat){}
    invalidateCalendarCache();
    return 0;
  }
  /** One expense name → one act; rewrite amountMonthly from active sheet lineAmt. */
  function easyDedupeAndSyncExpenseAmounts(){
    var acts = [];
    try { acts = (WB && WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || []; } catch(_a){ acts = []; }
    var kept = [];
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    var dropped = 0, synced = 0;
    acts.forEach(function(a){
      if(!a) return;
      var isGain = a.kind === 'work' || a.polarity === 'gain' || a.polarity === 'produce';
      var key = isGain ? ('work:'+String(a.name||'Work')) : ('exp:'+String(a.expenseName || a.name || '').toLowerCase());
      if(!isGain && !key.slice(4)) { kept.push(a); return; }
      if(seen[key]){ dropped++; return; }
      seen[key] = 1;
      if(!isGain){
        var amt = (typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') ? easyActMonthAmount(a) : 0;
        if(Number(a.amountMonthly) !== amt){ a.amountMonthly = amt; synced++; }
        a.polarity = 'spend';
      } else {
        try {
          var net = Number((calcIncome()||{}).net)||0;
          if(Number(a.amountMonthly) !== net){ a.amountMonthly = net; synced++; }
        } catch(_n){}
      }
      kept.push(a);
    });
    if(WB && WB.calendar) WB.calendar.customActions = kept;
    try { if(typeof easyCommitCalendar === 'function') easyCommitCalendar(WB.calendar); } catch(_c){}
    invalidateCalendarCache();
    return { kept: kept.length, dropped: dropped, synced: synced };
  }

  /**
   * Fill gaps across the HDAME/calendar horizon — Phone-batch *equivalent* that
   * NEVER clears/wipes. Places missing musts/rituals/work/wake/sleep via cadence
   * rules only when coverage is missing. Skip if already present. Idempotent.
   */
  function easyFillGapsHorizon(){
    var report = { version: 1, added: 0, skipped: 0, ensured: 0, years: 0, months: 0, acts: 0, errors: [] };
    if(window.__easyFillGapsRunning){
      report.errors.push('already_running');
      try { if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('Fill gaps already running — wait','bad'); } catch(_s){}
      return report;
    }
    window.__easyFillGapsRunning = true;
    try {
      var sy = (typeof easyStartYear === 'function') ? easyStartYear() : new Date().getFullYear();
      var yearsN = (typeof easyHorizonYears === 'function') ? easyHorizonYears() : 150;
      if(!(yearsN > 0)) yearsN = 150;
      report.years = yearsN;
      report.months = yearsN * 12;

      // Additive ensure: Wake / Sleep / Work cards if missing (never wipe bags)
      try {
        var hasWake = false, hasSleep = false, hasWork = false;
        ((WB && WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || []).forEach(function(a){
          if(!a || a.suggestOnly) return;
          if(a.kind === 'work') hasWork = true;
          if(a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.name === 'Wake') hasWake = true;
          if(a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Sleep') hasSleep = true;
        });
        if(!hasWake && typeof easyBlankWakeAct === 'function' && typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function'){
          easyCommitQuiet(easyBlankWakeAct());
          report.ensured++;
        }
        if(!hasSleep && typeof easyBlankSleepAct === 'function' && typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function'){
          easyCommitQuiet(easyBlankSleepAct());
          report.ensured++;
        }
        if(!hasWork && typeof easyBlankWorkAct === 'function' && typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function'){
          var wAct = easyBlankWorkAct('Work');
          wAct.scheduleOnly = false;
          wAct.lane = 'plan';
          wAct.author = 'ranking_ui';
          wAct.cadence = 'weekdays';
          wAct.days = [1,2,3,4,5];
          wAct.chargeOn = 'payDays';
          wAct.payDays = [1, 15];
          try { wAct.amountMonthly = Number((calcIncome()||{}).net)||0; } catch(_n0){}
          easyCommitQuiet(wAct);
          report.ensured++;
        }
        try {
          if(typeof easyEnsureMorningCanvasActs === 'function'){
            var mcr = easyEnsureMorningCanvasActs();
            if(mcr){
              report.ensured += ((mcr.added|0) + (mcr.updated|0));
              report.mcr = mcr;
              if(((mcr.added|0) + (mcr.updated|0)) > 0){
                try { if(typeof saveWorkbook === 'function') saveWorkbook({ silent: true }); } catch(_svM){}
              }
            }
          }
        } catch(_mcr){ report.errors.push('mcr: '+(_mcr && _mcr.message || _mcr)); }
      } catch(eEns){ report.errors.push('ensure: '+(eEns && eEns.message || eEns)); }

      var best = null;
      try { best = (typeof easyBestRank === 'function') ? easyBestRank() : null; } catch(_b){ best = null; }
      var board = [];
      try {
        board = ((typeof easyBoardActs === 'function') ? easyBoardActs() : []) || [];
        board = board.filter(function(a){ return a && !a.suggestOnly && String(a.id || '').indexOf('__sug_') !== 0; });
      } catch(_a){ board = []; }

      var ordered = [];
      var seen = Object.create(null);
      function pushAct(a){
        if(!a) return;
        var id = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(a) : (a.id || a.name);
        var nm = a.name || a.expenseName || '';
        if(a.rhythm === 'wake' || nm === 'Wake'){ id = '__fill_wake__'; nm = 'Wake'; }
        if(a.rhythm === 'sleep' || nm === 'Sleep'){ id = '__fill_sleep__'; nm = 'Sleep'; }
        if(!id || seen[id] || (nm && seen[nm])) return;
        seen[id] = 1;
        if(nm) seen[nm] = 1;
        ordered.push(a);
      }
      // Best order first (Suggest pool style), then H rank names, then rest
      ((best && best.order) || []).forEach(pushAct);
      try {
        ((WB && WB.rankOrders && WB.rankOrders.H) || []).forEach(function(nm){
          if(!nm) return;
          board.forEach(function(a){
            if(a && (a.name === nm || a.expenseName === nm)) pushAct(a);
          });
        });
      } catch(_h){}
      board.forEach(pushAct);

      var targets = ordered.filter(function(a){
        if(!a) return false;
        if(a.kind === 'work') return true;
        if(a.rhythm || a.name === 'Wake' || a.name === 'Sleep') return true;
        try { if(typeof easySuggestMust === 'function' && easySuggestMust(a)) return true; } catch(_m){}
        if(a.kind === 'schedule' || a.scheduleOnly) return true;
        return false;
      });
      report.acts = targets.length;

      function billDayOf(a){
        var bd = 0;
        try { if(typeof easyBillDay === 'function') bd = easyBillDay(a)|0; } catch(_b){}
        if(bd >= 1 && bd <= 28) return bd;
        if(a && a.billDay != null && isFinite(Number(a.billDay))){
          var b2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(28, Number(a.billDay)|0));
          if(b2 >= 1) return b2;
        }
        if(a && a.day != null && isFinite(Number(a.day))){
          var b3 = Math.max(1, Math.min(28, Number(a.day)|0));
          if(b3 >= 1) return b3;
        }
        var nm = String((a && (a.expenseName || a.name)) || '');
        var h = 0;
        for(var i = 0; i < nm.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) - h + nm.charCodeAt(i))|0;
        return 1 + (Math.abs(h) % 28);
      }

      function monthHasAct(a, y, m){
        try {
          if(typeof easyLiveCoversMonth === 'function'){
            var live = easyLiveCoversMonth(a, y, m);
            if(live) return true;
          }
        } catch(_l){}
        var dim = 31;
        try { dim = (typeof easyDimOf === 'function') ? (easyDimOf(y, m)|0) : 31; } catch(_d){ dim = 31; }
        for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
          try {
            if(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function' && easyActCoversDay(a, { y: y, m: m, d: d })) return true;
          } catch(_o){}
        }
        return false;
      }

      function horizonHasGap(a, predDay){
        for(var yi = 0; yi < yearsN; yi++){
          for(var m = 0; m < 12; m++){
            var y = sy + yi;
            if(predDay){
              if(!predDay(a, y, m)) return true;
            } else if(!monthHasAct(a, y, m)){
              return true;
            }
          }
        }
        return false;
      }

      targets.forEach(function(a){
        if(!a) return;
        var changed = false;
        var cad = String(a.cadence || '').toLowerCase();
        try {
          if(a.kind === 'work'){
            if(cad === 'weekdays' && a.days && a.days.length){ report.skipped++; return; }
            var needW = horizonHasGap(a, function(act, y, m){
              // pred true = month OK (no weekday gap). horizonHasGap → true if any month fails.
              var dim = 31;
              try { dim = (typeof easyDimOf === 'function') ? (easyDimOf(y, m)|0) : 31; } catch(_d){ dim = 31; }
              var anyWd = false, allOn = true;
              for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
                var dow = new Date(y, m, d).getDay();
                if(dow < 1 || dow > 5) continue;
                anyWd = true;
                if(!(typeof easyActCoversDay === 'function' && easyActCoversDay(act, { y: y, m: m, d: d }))) allOn = false;
              }
              return !anyWd || allOn;
            });
            if(!needW){ report.skipped++; return; }
            // Set weekdays WITHOUT clearing selectedKeys / marks
            a.cadence = 'weekdays';
            a.days = [1,2,3,4,5];
            a.chargeOn = a.chargeOn || 'payDays';
            if(!a.payDays || !a.payDays.length) a.payDays = [1, 15];
            changed = true;
          } else if(a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.name === 'Wake' || a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Sleep'){
            if(cad === 'daily'){ report.skipped++; return; }
            if(!horizonHasGap(a)){ report.skipped++; return; }
            a.cadence = 'daily';
            a.scheduleOnly = true;
            changed = true;
          } else if((typeof easySuggestMust === 'function' && easySuggestMust(a)) ||
                    cad === 'monthly' ||
                    (typeof easyIsMonthBillAct === 'function' && easyIsMonthBillAct(a))){
            if(cad === 'monthly' && a.day != null){ report.skipped++; return; }
            if(!horizonHasGap(a)){ report.skipped++; return; }
            // Prefer monthly cadence — fills missing months; never clears keys/marks
            a.cadence = 'monthly';
            a.day = billDayOf(a);
            a.monthOnce = true;
            a.chargeOn = a.chargeOn || 'lastSpan';
            if(!(a.spanDays > 0)) a.spanDays = 1;
            changed = true;
          } else if(a.kind === 'schedule' || a.scheduleOnly){
            if(cad === 'daily' || cad === 'weekdays'){ report.skipped++; return; }
            if(!horizonHasGap(a)){ report.skipped++; return; }
            var nm = String(a.name || '').toLowerCase();
            if(/gym|workout|exercise/.test(nm)){
              a.cadence = 'weekdays';
              a.days = [1,2,3,4,5];
            } else {
              a.cadence = 'daily';
            }
            changed = true;
          } else {
            report.skipped++;
            return;
          }
          if(changed){
            if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(a);
            report.added++;
          }
        } catch(eAct){
          report.errors.push((a && (a.name || a.id) || '?')+': '+(eAct && eAct.message || eAct));
        }
      });

      try { if(typeof invalidateCalendarCache === 'function') invalidateCalendarCache(); } catch(_i){}
      try { if(typeof _easyBestTick === 'number'){ _easyBestTick++; _easyJgAt = -1; } } catch(_t){}
    } catch(e){
      report.errors.push(String(e && e.message || e));
    }
    window.__easyFillGapsRunning = false;
    try { window.__easyFillGapsReport = report; } catch(_w){}
    return report;
  }

    function fillOneScenario(sc){
      var local = { sc: sc, months: [], years: 0, stripped: 0, normalized: 0, cadenceActs: 0 };
      if(typeof setActiveSc === 'function') setActiveSc(sc);
      if(typeof invalidateCalendarCache === 'function') invalidateCalendarCache();
      easyCal.allYears = false;
      easyCal.jgOption = sc;
      var sy = (typeof easyStartYear === 'function') ? easyStartYear() : new Date().getFullYear();
      var yearsN = (typeof easyHorizonYears === 'function') ? easyHorizonYears() : 150;
      local.years = yearsN;
      easyCal.y = sy;
      try {
        if(typeof easyAddAllExpenses === 'function') easyAddAllExpenses();
        else if(typeof easySeedExpensesFromSheet === 'function') easySeedExpensesFromSheet();
        try { easyDedupeAndSyncExpenseAmounts(); } catch(_d0){}
      } catch(eSeed){ report.errors.push('seed '+sc+': '+(eSeed && eSeed.message || eSeed)); }
      try { if(typeof easyEnsureBoardWork === 'function') easyEnsureBoardWork(); } catch(_w){}
      try {
        var hasWork = false;
        ((WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || []).forEach(function(a){
          if(a && a.kind === 'work' && !a.suggestOnly) hasWork = true;
        });
        if(!hasWork && typeof easyBlankWorkAct === 'function' && typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function'){
          var wAct = easyBlankWorkAct('Work');
          wAct.scheduleOnly = false;
          wAct.lane = 'plan';
          wAct.author = 'ranking_ui';
          wAct.cadence = 'weekdays';
          wAct.days = [1,2,3,4,5];
          wAct.chargeOn = 'payDays';

          try { wAct.amountMonthly = Number((calcIncome()||{}).net)||0; } catch(_n0){}
          easyCommitQuiet(wAct);
        }
      } catch(_ww){}

            if(a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.name === 'Wake') hasWake = true;

          });
