          if(!hasSleep && typeof easyBlankSleepAct === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(easyBlankSleepAct());
        }
      } catch(_rs){}
      // Horizon-wide cadences — NOT Accept-Suggest on full months (that stuffed Jan / year 0 only).
      function dayForExpense(a){
        var nm = String((a && (a.expenseName || a.name)) || '');
        var h = 0;
        for(var i = 0; i < nm.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) - h + nm.charCodeAt(i))|0;
        var spread = 1 + (Math.abs(h) % 28);
        var bd = 0;
        try { if(typeof easyBillDay === 'function') bd = easyBillDay(a)|0; } catch(_b){}
        // Keep explicit bill days (e.g. phone on 8); treat bare day-1 defaults as unset → spread
        if(bd >= 2 && bd <= 28) return bd;
        if(a && a.billDay != null && isFinite(Number(a.billDay))){
          var b2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(28, Number(a.billDay)|0));
          if(b2 >= 2) return b2;
        }
        return spread;
      }
      ((WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || []).forEach(function(a){
        if(!a) return;
        // Drop paint so rule cadences apply across every horizon year
        a.selectedKeys = [];
        a.selected = [];
        a.repeatMarks = [];
        a.yearMarks = {};
        a.calcKeys = [];
        a.calcMarks = [];
        a.days = [];
        try { delete a.day; } catch(_dd){ a.day = null; }
        if(a.kind === 'work'){
          a.cadence = 'weekdays';
          a.days = [1,2,3,4,5];
          a.chargeOn = 'payDays';
          if(!a.payDays || !a.payDays.length) a.payDays = [1, 15];
          a.spanDays = 1;
          a.scheduleOnly = false;
          a.lane = a.lane || 'plan';
          try {
            var net = Number((calcIncome()||{}).net)||0;
            if(net > 0) a.amountMonthly = net;
          } catch(_n){}
        } else if(a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.name === 'Wake' || a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Sleep'){
          a.cadence = 'daily';
          a.scheduleOnly = true;
          a.lane = a.lane || 'plan';
        } else if(a.polarity === 'spend' || a.kind === 'spend' || a.expenseName || (Number(a.amountMonthly)>0)){
          a.cadence = 'monthly';
          a.day = dayForExpense(a);
          a.chargeOn = 'lastSpan';
          a.monthOnce = true;
          a.spanDays = 1;
          a.scheduleOnly = false;
          a.lane = a.lane || 'plan';
          a.polarity = 'spend';
          a.kind = a.kind === 'work' ? a.kind : 'spend';
        } else {
          // generic schedule → daily so it exists every year
          a.cadence = a.cadence && a.cadence !== 'selected' && a.cadence !== 'paint' ? a.cadence : 'daily';
        }
        if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(a);
        local.cadenceActs++;
      });
      try { local.normalized = normalizeSpendCharges(); } catch(_n){}
      // Verify chips across first/mid/last year sample months (not only year 0)
      var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
      var sampleYears = [0, Math.floor(yearsN/2), yearsN-1].filter(function(yi, idx, arr){ return yi >= 0 && arr.indexOf(yi) === idx; });
      sampleYears.forEach(function(yi){
        var y = sy + yi;
        [0, 5, 11].forEach(function(m){
          easyCal.y = y; easyCal.m = m;
          var ver = countMonthChips(y, m);
          local.months.push({ year: y, month: m + 1, verifyChips: ver.chips, verifyDays: ver.daysHit });
          if(!(ver.daysHit > 0)) report.errors.push(sc+' '+y+'-'+(m+1)+' still blank');
        });
      });
      local.nCustom = ((WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || []).length;
      try { local.roll = (typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function') ? easyMonthMoneyRoll() : null; } catch(_r){}
      try { local.sheet = (typeof calcSummary === 'function') ? calcSummary() : null; } catch(_s){}
      return local;
    }
    try {
      // Calendar-only. Never mutate EXPENSES / income / debts. Never mirror calendars.
      if(typeof SC_ORDER === 'undefined') throw new Error('no SC_ORDER');
      if(typeof easyCal === 'undefined' || !easyCal) throw new Error('no easyCal');
      var expenseStash = null, incomeStash = null, debtStash = null, goalsStash = null, rankStash = null;
      try {
        expenseStash = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WB.expenses || null));
        incomeStash = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WB.income || null));
        debtStash = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WB.debts || null));
        goalsStash = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WB.goals || null));
        rankStash = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WB.rankOrders || null));
      } catch(_es){ expenseStash = null; }
      var y = (typeof easyStartYear === 'function') ? easyStartYear() : easyCal.y;
      if(!(y > 2000)) y = new Date().getFullYear();
      easyCal.y = y;
      report.year = y;
      report.years = (typeof easyHorizonYears === 'function') ? easyHorizonYears() : 150;
      // Clear each bag, then fill each scenario independently from THAT scenario's sheet $
      SC_ORDER.forEach(function(sc){
        try {
          if(typeof setActiveSc === 'function') setActiveSc(sc);
          easyHardClearScenarioCalendar(sc);
          report.scenariosCleared[sc] = 'hard';
        } catch(e){ report.errors.push('clear '+sc+': '+(e && e.message || e)); }
      });
      report.perScenario = {};
      SC_ORDER.forEach(function(sc){
        try {
          report.perScenario[sc] = fillOneScenario(sc);
          report.seeded[sc] = true;
          report.monthsBySc[sc] = (report.perScenario[sc] && report.perScenario[sc].months) || [];
        } catch(eFill){
          report.errors.push('fill '+sc+': '+(eFill && eFill.message || eFill));
        }
      });
      // Land on CURRENT — no promote/mirror between calendars
      if(typeof setActiveSc === 'function') setActiveSc('current');
      easyCal.allYears = false;
      easyCal.jgOption = 'current';
      easyCal.m = (new Date()).getMonth();
      easyCal.y = y;
      try { if(typeof invalidateCalendarCache === 'function') invalidateCalendarCache(); } catch(_i){}
      // Restore sheet BEFORE any final paint/save (renderAll → ensureDebtPayLinks mutates payDebt)
      try {
        if(expenseStash) WB.expenses = expenseStash;
        if(incomeStash) WB.income = incomeStash;
        if(debtStash) WB.debts = debtStash;
        if(goalsStash) WB.goals = goalsStash;
        if(rankStash) WB.rankOrders = rankStash;
        report.verify.expensesUntouched = true;
      } catch(_er){ report.errors.push('expenseRestore: '+(_er && _er.message || _er)); }
      try { if(typeof renderAll === 'function') renderAll(); } catch(_r){}
      // renderAll may have linked payDebt again — restore sheet once more
      try {
        if(expenseStash) WB.expenses = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(expenseStash));
        if(incomeStash) WB.income = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(incomeStash));
        if(debtStash) WB.debts = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(debtStash));
        if(goalsStash) WB.goals = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(goalsStash));
        if(rankStash) WB.rankOrders = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rankStash));
      } catch(_er2){}
      report.sheetSummary = (typeof calcSummary === 'function') ? calcSummary() : null;
      report.calRoll = (typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function') ? easyMonthMoneyRoll() : null;
      report.verify.final = countMonthChips(y, easyCal.m);
      report.verify.nCustom = ((WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || []).length;
      report.verify.mirrored = false;
      try {
        if(typeof saveWorkbook === 'function'){
          report.saved = !!saveWorkbook({ silent: true, skipReview: true });
        }
      } catch(e3){ report.errors.push('save: '+(e3 && e3.message || e3)); report.saved = false; }
      // Save/render must not leave mutated sheet either
      try {
        if(expenseStash) WB.expenses = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(expenseStash));
        if(incomeStash) WB.income = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(incomeStash));
        if(debtStash) WB.debts = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(debtStash));
      } catch(_er3){}
      try {
        if(typeof showStatus === 'function'){
          var bits = [];
          SC_ORDER.forEach(function(sc){
            var row = report.perScenario && report.perScenario[sc];
            var td = 0;
            ((row && row.months) || []).forEach(function(m){ td += m.verifyDays|0; });
            bits.push((SC_LABEL[sc]||sc)+':'+td+'d');
          });
          var sur = report.calRoll && report.calRoll.surplus;
          showStatus(
            'Phone batch v6 · all '+ (report.years||'?') +'y cadences (no Jan dump) · '+bits.join(' · ')+
            ' · CURRENT cal '+(sur!=null?('$'+Number(sur).toFixed(2)):'?')+
            ' · '+(report.saved?'Saved':'SAVE FAIL')+(report.errors.length?(' · errs '+report.errors.length):''),
            report.errors.length?'bad':'ok'
          );
        }
      } catch(_s){}
    } catch(e){
      report.errors.push(String(e && e.message || e));
    }
    try { window.__easyPhoneBatchReport = report; } catch(_w){}
    window.__easyPhoneBatchRunning = false;
    return report;
  }

  function easyAcceptAllSuggest(){
    var plan = (typeof easySelGhostPlan === 'function')
      ? easySelGhostPlan((typeof easyBestRank === 'function') ? easyBestRank() : null)
      : null;
    if(!plan || !(plan.suggest || []).length){
      if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('No suggestions to accept','bad');
      return { acts: 0, days: 0 };
    }
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    var nActs = 0, nDays = 0;
    (plan.suggest || []).forEach(function(g){
      var k = easyGhostActKey(g);
      if(!k || seen[k]) return;
      seen[k] = 1;
      var n = easyAcceptSuggestKey(k, plan, true);
      if(n > 0){ nActs++; nDays += n; }
    });
    try { if(typeof invalidateCalendarCache === 'function') invalidateCalendarCache(); } catch(_i){}
    if(typeof easyPreserveScroll === 'function') easyPreserveScroll(function(){ if(typeof renderAll === 'function') renderAll(); });
    else if(typeof renderAll === 'function') renderAll();
    if(typeof showStatus === 'function'){
      showStatus(nActs
        ? ('Accepted '+nActs+' suggestion'+(nActs===1?'':'s')+' · '+nDays+' day mark'+(nDays===1?'':'s')+' · Save to keep')
        : 'Nothing new to accept','ok');
    }
    return { acts: nActs, days: nDays };
  }


  function easyRemoveAct(id){
    if(!id) return false;
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var profile = ensureCalendar();
    var delName = null;
    try {
      ((profile && profile.customActions) || []).concat(((window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ && window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions) || [])).forEach(function(a){
        if(a && (a.id === id || a.name === id)) delName = a.name || delName;
      });
    } catch(_n){}
    if(RC && RC.removeCustomAction) profile = RC.removeCustomAction(profile, id);
    else profile.customActions = (profile.customActions||[]).filter(function(a){ return a && a.id !== id && a.name !== id; });
    profile.customActions = (profile.customActions || []).filter(function(a){
      return a && a.id !== id && a.name !== id;
    });
    try {
      if(window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ && Array.isArray(window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions)){
        window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions = window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions.filter(function(a){
          return a && a.id !== id && a.name !== id;
        });
      }
    } catch(_r){}
    try {
      if(typeof easyTombstoneCalendarAction === 'function'){
        easyTombstoneCalendarAction(id);
        if(delName) easyTombstoneCalendarAction(delName);
      }
    } catch(_t){}
    easyCommitCalendar(profile);
    invalidateCalendarCache();
    if(typeof mohoFire === 'function') mohoFire('calendar-drill');
    if(easyCal.placeAct === id) easyCal.placeAct = null;
    try { if(typeof _easyBestTick === 'number'){ _easyBestTick++; _easyJgAt = -1; } } catch(_t){}
    renderAll();
    return true;
  }
  function easyPromoteVisibleMonth(){
    var y = easyCal.y, m = easyCal.m;
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var dim = (RC && RC.daysInMonth) ? RC.daysInMonth(y, m) : 31;
    var acts = easyScheduleActions();
    var n = 0;
    var profile = ensureCalendar();
    acts.forEach(function(a){
      var cad = String((a && a.cadence) || '').toLowerCase();
      // Only add repeatMarks for paint/selected (or empty/none) — never rule cadences
      if(cad && cad !== 'selected' && cad !== 'paint' && cad !== 'none') return;
      var added = false;
      for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
        if(!easyOccurs(a, y, m, d)) continue;
        a.repeatMarks = (a.repeatMarks || []).slice();
        var md = easyMonthDay(m, d);
        if(a.repeatMarks.indexOf(md) < 0){ a.repeatMarks.push(md); added = true; }
      }
      if(added){
        n++;
        if(RC && RC.upsertCustomAction) profile = RC.upsertCustomAction(profile, a);
      }
    });
    if(n){
      easyCommitCalendar(profile);
      invalidateCalendarCache();
      if(typeof mohoFire === 'function') mohoFire('calendar-drill');
    }
    return n;
  }


  function easySelKey(y, m, d){
    return String(y)+'-'+String(m)+'-'+String(d);
  }
  function easySelList(){
    return (easyCal.sel || []).map(function(k){
      var p = String(k).split('-');
      return { y: parseInt(p[0],10), m: parseInt(p[1],10), d: parseInt(p[2],10) };
    }).filter(function(p){ return isFinite(p.y) && isFinite(p.m) && isFinite(p.d); });
  }
  function easySelHas(y, m, d){
    return (easyCal.sel || []).indexOf(easySelKey(y, m, d)) >= 0;
  }
  function easySelToggle(y, m, d){
    easyCal.sel = easyCal.sel || [];
    var k = easySelKey(y, m, d);
    var i = easyCal.sel.indexOf(k);
    if(i >= 0) easyCal.sel.splice(i, 1);
    else easyCal.sel.push(k);
    easyCal.pick = easyCal.sel.length ? { y: y, m: m, d: d } : null;
  }
  function easySelAddRange(y, m, a, b){
    easyCal.sel = easyCal.sel || [];
    var lo = Math.min(a, b), hi = Math.max(a, b);
    for(var d = lo; d <= hi; d++){
      var k = easySelKey(y, m, d);
      if(easyCal.sel.indexOf(k) < 0) easyCal.sel.push(k);
    }
    easyCal.pick = { y: y, m: m, d: b };
  }
  function easyUnmarkDay(act, y, m, d){
    if(!act) return false;
    var changed = false;
    var key = easyDayKey(y, m, d);
    if(act.selectedKeys && act.selectedKeys.length){
      var next = act.selectedKeys.filter(function(k){ return k !== key; });
      if(next.length !== act.selectedKeys.length){ act.selectedKeys = next; changed = true; }
    }
    var md = easyMonthDay(m, d);
    if(act.repeatMarks && act.repeatMarks.length){
      var r = act.repeatMarks.filter(function(x){ return x !== md; });
      if(r.length !== act.repeatMarks.length){ act.repeatMarks = r; changed = true; }
    }
    if(act.yearMarks && typeof act.yearMarks === 'object'){
      var yi = String(y - easyStartYear());
      var list = act.yearMarks[yi] || act.yearMarks[y - easyStartYear()] || [];
      if(list && list.length){
        var yl = list.filter(function(x){ return x !== md; });
        if(yl.length !== list.length){ act.yearMarks[yi] = yl; changed = true; }
      }
    }
    if(act.calcKeys && act.calcKeys.length){
      var ck = act.calcKeys.filter(function(k){ return k !== key; });
      if(ck.length !== act.calcKeys.length){ act.calcKeys = ck; changed = true; }
    }
    if(act.calcMarks && act.calcMarks.length){
      var cm = act.calcMarks.filter(function(x){ return x !== md; });
      if(cm.length !== act.calcMarks.length){ act.calcMarks = cm; changed = true; }
    }
    return changed;
  }
  function easyHorizonYears(){
    return Number(WB && WB.hdame && WB.hdame.years) || 150;
  }
  function easyCollectOccurs(act){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var sy = easyStartYear();
    var years = easyHorizonYears();
    var out = [];
    if(!RC || !RC.daysInMonth) return out;
    for(var yi = 0; yi < years; yi++){
      var y = sy + yi;
      for(var m = 0; m < 12; m++){
        var dim = RC.daysInMonth(y, m);
        for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
          if(easyOccurs(act, y, m, d)) out.push({ y: y, m: m, d: d });
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  function easyRewriteOccurs(act, keep){
    act.cadence = 'selected';
    act.days = [];
    act.nDays = 0;
    act.day = null;
    act.month = null;
    keep = keep || [];
    if(easyCal.allYears){
      var mds = [];
      keep.forEach(function(p){
        var md = easyMonthDay(p.m, p.d);
        if(mds.indexOf(md) < 0) mds.push(md);
      });
      act.repeatMarks = mds;
      act.selectedKeys = [];
      act.yearMarks = {};
    } else {
      var keys = [];
      keep.forEach(function(p){
        var k = easyDayKey(p.y, p.m, p.d);
        if(keys.indexOf(k) < 0) keys.push(k);
      });
      act.selectedKeys = keys;
      act.repeatMarks = [];
      act.yearMarks = {};
    }
    return act;
  }
  function easySyncAct(act){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var profile = ensureCalendar();
    if(RC && RC.upsertCustomAction) profile = RC.upsertCustomAction(profile, act);
    else {
      profile.customActions = (profile.customActions || []).filter(function(x){ return x && x.id !== act.id && x.name !== act.name; });
      profile.customActions.push(act);
    }
    easyCommitCalendar(profile);
    try {
      window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ = window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ || { actions: [] };
      var cat = window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions || [];
      cat = cat.filter(function(x){ return x && x.id !== act.id && x.name !== act.name; });
      cat.push(act);
      window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions = cat;
    } catch(_c){}
    return profile;
  }
  function easyFlushCal(){
    invalidateCalendarCache();
    if(typeof mohoFire === 'function') mohoFire('calendar-drill');
  }
  function easyIsPainted(act){
    var keys = (act && (act.selectedKeys || act.selected)) || [];
    var hasKeys = !!(keys && keys.length);
    var hasYear = !!(act && act.yearMarks && Object.keys(act.yearMarks).length);
    var hasRep = !!(act && act.repeatMarks && act.repeatMarks.length);
    var cad = String((act && act.cadence) || '').toLowerCase();
    // selected/paint with no day marks = Plan-only / cleared — not on the calendar
    if(cad === 'selected' || cad === 'paint' || cad === 'none' || cad === ''){
      return hasKeys || hasYear || hasRep;
    }
    return hasKeys || hasYear || hasRep;
  }
  function easyKeepFromPaint(act, pred){
    var sy = easyStartYear();
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var keep = [];
    var seen = Object.create(null);
    function add(rec){
      if(!rec || !pred(rec)) return;
      var id = easySelKey(rec.y, rec.m, rec.d);
      if(seen[id]) return;
      seen[id] = 1;
      keep.push(rec);
    }
    (act.selectedKeys || []).forEach(function(k){
      var p = RC && RC.parseDayKey ? RC.parseDayKey(k) : null;
      if(!p) return;
      add({ y: sy + p.yearIndex, m: p.monthIndex, d: p.day });
    });
    var ym = act.yearMarks || {};
    Object.keys(ym).forEach(function(yi){
      (ym[yi] || []).forEach(function(md){
        var parts = String(md).split('-');
        add({ y: sy + (parseInt(yi, 10) || 0), m: parseInt(parts[0], 10), d: parseInt(parts[1], 10) });
      });
    });
    (act.repeatMarks || []).forEach(function(md){
      var parts = String(md).split('-');
      add({ y: easyCal.y, m: parseInt(parts[0], 10), d: parseInt(parts[1], 10) });
    });
    return keep;
  }
  function easyClearSelectedDays(){
    var days = easySelList();
    if(!days.length) return 0;
    var allY = !!easyCal.allYears;
    var punchMd = Object.create(null);
    var punchKey = Object.create(null);
    days.forEach(function(p){
      punchMd[easyMonthDay(p.m, p.d)] = 1;
      punchKey[easyDayKey(p.y, p.m, p.d)] = 1;
    });
    function keepPred(rec){
      if(allY) return !punchMd[easyMonthDay(rec.m, rec.d)];
      return !punchKey[easyDayKey(rec.y, rec.m, rec.d)];
    }
    var n = 0;
    easyScheduleActions().forEach(function(a){
      var hit = days.some(function(p){ return easyOccurs(a, p.y, p.m, p.d); });
      if(!hit) return;
      var keep;
      if(easyIsPainted(a)){
        keep = easyKeepFromPaint(a, keepPred);
      } else if(allY){
        keep = [];
        var y = easyCal.y;
        for(var m = 0; m < 12; m++){
          easyRuleDaysInMonth(a, y, m).forEach(function(d){
            if(punchMd[easyMonthDay(m, d)]) return;
            keep.push({ y: y, m: m, d: d });
          });
        }
      } else {
        var y0 = days[0].y, m0 = days[0].m;
        keep = easyKeepExceptMonth(a, y0, m0);
        easyRuleDaysInMonth(a, y0, m0).forEach(function(d){
          if(punchKey[easyDayKey(y0, m0, d)]) return;
          keep.push({ y: y0, m: m0, d: d });
        });
      }
      easyRewriteOccurs(a, keep);
      easySyncAct(a);
      n++;
    });
    if(n) easyFlushCal();
    easyCal.sel = [];
    easyCal.pick = null;
    return n;
  }

  function easyMonthDaysOf(act, y, m){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var dim = (RC && RC.daysInMonth) ? RC.daysInMonth(y, m) : 31;
    var out = [];
    for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
      if(easyOccurs(act, y, m, d)) out.push(d);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function easyRuleDaysInMonth(act, y, m){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var dim = (RC && RC.daysInMonth) ? RC.daysInMonth(y, m) : 31;
    var cad = String((act && act.cadence) || '').toLowerCase();
    var keys = (act && (act.selectedKeys || act.selected)) || [];
    var painted = cad === 'selected' || cad === 'paint' || (keys && keys.length) ||
      (act.yearMarks && Object.keys(act.yearMarks).length) ||
      (act.repeatMarks && act.repeatMarks.length);
    if(painted) return easyMonthDaysOf(act, y, m);
    var out = [];
    var dows = act.days || [];
    var dom = Number(act.day) || 1;
    var mo = act.month != null ? Number(act.month) : 0;
    if(mo >= 1 && mo <= 12) mo = mo - 1;
    for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
      var dow = new Date(y, m, d).getDay();
      if(cad === 'always' || cad === 'daily') out.push(d);
      else if(cad === 'weekdays' && dow >= 1 && dow <= 5) out.push(d);
      else if(cad === 'weekends' && (dow === 0 || dow === 6)) out.push(d);
      else if((cad === 'weekly' || cad === 'some_days') && dows.indexOf(dow) >= 0) out.push(d);
      else if(cad === 'monthly' && d === Math.min(dom, dim)) out.push(d);
      else if(cad === 'yearly' && m === mo && d === Math.min(dom, dim)) out.push(d);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function easyKeepExceptMonth(act, skipY, skipM){
    var sy = easyStartYear();
    var years = easyHorizonYears();
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var keep = [];
    var cad = String(act.cadence || '').toLowerCase();
    var painted = cad === 'selected' || cad === 'paint' ||
      (act.selectedKeys && act.selectedKeys.length) ||
      (act.yearMarks && Object.keys(act.yearMarks||{}).length) ||
      (act.repeatMarks && act.repeatMarks.length);
    if(painted && RC && RC.parseDayKey && act.selectedKeys && act.selectedKeys.length){
      act.selectedKeys.forEach(function(k){
        var p = RC.parseDayKey(k);
        if(!p) return;
        var yy = sy + p.yearIndex;
        if(yy === skipY && p.monthIndex === skipM) return;
        keep.push({ y: yy, m: p.monthIndex, d: p.day });
      });
      var ym = act.yearMarks || {};
      Object.keys(ym).forEach(function(yi){
        (ym[yi] || []).forEach(function(md){
          var parts = String(md).split('-');
          var mm = parseInt(parts[0], 10), dd = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
          var yy = sy + (parseInt(yi, 10) || 0);
          if(yy === skipY && mm === skipM) return;
          if(isFinite(mm) && isFinite(dd)) keep.push({ y: yy, m: mm, d: dd });
        });
      });
      if(act.repeatMarks && act.repeatMarks.length){
        for(var yi = 0; yi < years; yi++){
          var yy = sy + yi;
          act.repeatMarks.forEach(function(md){
            var parts = String(md).split('-');
            var mm = parseInt(parts[0], 10), dd = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
            if(yy === skipY && mm === skipM) return;
            if(isFinite(mm) && isFinite(dd)) keep.push({ y: yy, m: mm, d: dd });
          });
        }
      }
      return keep;
    }
    for(var yi = 0; yi < years; yi++){
      var yy = sy + yi;
      for(var mm = 0; mm < 12; mm++){
        if(yy === skipY && mm === skipM) continue;
        easyRuleDaysInMonth(act, yy, mm).forEach(function(d){
          keep.push({ y: yy, m: mm, d: d });
        });
      }
    }
    return keep;
  }

  function easyClearCalendar(){
    try { if(WB){ WB._calUserCleared = true; WB._calSeededFromSheet = true; } } catch(_f){}
    var acts = getCalendarCustomActions() || [];

    var n = 0;
    var wasAll = !!easyCal.allYears;
    easyCal.allYears = false;
    var removeIds = [];
    acts.forEach(function(a){
      if(!a) return;
      if(!easyActOnCalendar(a) && !easyIsPainted(a)){
        var cad = String(a.cadence || '').toLowerCase();
        var ruleCad = cad === 'weekdays' || cad === 'daily' || cad === 'always' || cad === 'weekends' ||
          cad === 'weekly' || cad === 'some_days' || cad === 'monthly' || cad === 'yearly';
        if(!ruleCad) return;
      }
      // Drop money acts fully so Add-all can re-seed; hollow selected+empty was skipped forever.
      if(a.kind === 'work' || a.kind === 'spend' || a.expenseName || a.polarity === 'spend' || a.polarity === 'gain' ||
         a.rhythm === 'wake' || a.rhythm === 'sleep' || a.name === 'Wake' || a.name === 'Sleep'){
        removeIds.push(a.id || a.name);
        if(a.name && removeIds.indexOf(a.name) < 0) removeIds.push(a.name);
        if(a.id && removeIds.indexOf(a.id) < 0) removeIds.push(a.id);
        n++;
        return;
      }
      easyRewriteOccurs(a, []);
      a.cadence = 'selected';
      a.selectedKeys = [];
      a.repeatMarks = [];
      a.yearMarks = {};
      a.days = [];
      easySyncAct(a);
      n++;
    });
    if(removeIds.length){
      try {
        var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
        var profile = ensureCalendar() || {};
        removeIds.forEach(function(id){
          if(RC && RC.removeCustomAction) profile = RC.removeCustomAction(profile, id);
        });
        profile.customActions = (profile.customActions || []).filter(function(a){
          if(!a) return false;
          var id = a.id || a.name;
          return removeIds.indexOf(id) < 0;
        });
        easyCommitCalendar(profile);
      } catch(_rm){}
    }
    easyCal.allYears = wasAll;
    // Always flush so live rollup rebuilds even if n==0 edge cases
    easyFlushCal();
    try { if(typeof _easyBestTick === 'number'){ _easyBestTick++; _easyJgAt = -1; } } catch(_t){}
    easyCal.sel = [];
    easyCal.pick = null;
    return n;
  }
  function easyCopyYear(){
    var y = easyCal.y;
    var sy = easyStartYear();
    var yearsN = easyHorizonYears();
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var n = 0, placed = 0;
    var acts = easyScheduleActions();
    var wasAll = !!easyCal.allYears;
    easyCal.allYears = false;
    acts.forEach(function(a){
      var src = [];
      for(var m = 0; m < 12; m++){
        easyMonthDaysOf(a, y, m).forEach(function(d){
          src.push({ y: y, m: m, d: d });
        });
      }
      if(!src.length) return;
      var keep = [];
      for(var yi = 0; yi < yearsN; yi++){
        var yy = sy + yi;
        if(yy >= y) continue;
        for(var mm = 0; mm < 12; mm++){
          easyMonthDaysOf(a, yy, mm).forEach(function(d){
            keep.push({ y: yy, m: mm, d: d });
          });
        }
      }
      src.forEach(function(p){ keep.push(p); });
      for(var yi2 = 0; yi2 < yearsN; yi2++){
        var yy2 = sy + yi2;
        if(yy2 <= y) continue;
        src.forEach(function(p){
          var dim = (RC && RC.daysInMonth) ? RC.daysInMonth(yy2, p.m) : 31;
          var dd = Math.min(p.d, dim);
          if(dd >= 1){
            keep.push({ y: yy2, m: p.m, d: dd });
            placed++;
          }
        });
      }
      easyRewriteOccurs(a, keep);
      easySyncAct(a);
      n++;
    });
    easyCal.allYears = wasAll;
    if(n) easyFlushCal();
    easyCal.sel = [];
    easyCal.pick = null;
    var laterYears = Math.max(0, (sy + yearsN - 1) - y);
    return { n: n, placed: placed, y: y, laterYears: laterYears };
  }

  function easyCopyPrevMonth(){
    var y = easyCal.y, m = easyCal.m;
    var py = y, pm = m - 1;
    if(pm < 0){ pm = 11; py -= 1; }
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var dimC = (RC && RC.daysInMonth) ? RC.daysInMonth(y, m) : 31;
    var n = 0, placed = 0;
    var acts = easyScheduleActions();
    var snaps = acts.map(function(a){
      return { a: a, prev: easyMonthDaysOf(a, py, pm), cur: easyMonthDaysOf(a, y, m) };
    });
    snaps.forEach(function(s){
      if(!s.prev.length && !s.cur.length) return;
      var keep = easyKeepExceptMonth(s.a, y, m);
      s.prev.forEach(function(d){
        if(d >= 1 && d <= dimC) keep.push({ y: y, m: m, d: d });
      });
      easyRewriteOccurs(s.a, keep);
      easySyncAct(s.a);
      n++;
      placed += s.prev.length;
    });
    if(n) easyFlushCal();
    easyCal.sel = [];
    easyCal.pick = null;
    return { n: n, placed: placed, py: py, pm: pm, y: y, m: m };
  }



  function easyStartYear(){
    var p = ensureCalendar() || {};
    return Number(p.startYear) || new Date().getFullYear();
  }
  function easyDayKey(y, m, d){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    if(!RC || !RC.dayKey) return (y - easyStartYear()) + '-' + m + '-' + d;
    return RC.dayKey(y - easyStartYear(), m, d);
  }
  function easyScheduleActions(){
    return (getCalendarCustomActions() || []).filter(function(a){
      if(!a || a.enabled === false) return false;
      // Auto work-block stays off the Board. User-added work (lane/scheduleOnly) shows.
      if(a.kind === 'work' && !(a.scheduleOnly || a.lane || a.author === 'ranking_ui')) return false;
      if(a.kind === 'work') return true;
      var amt = Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
      return !!(a.scheduleOnly || a.kind === 'schedule' || a.kind === 'joy' || a.lane || amt === 0);
    });
  }
  function easyWorkBlockHours(){
    var profile = (typeof ensureCalendar === 'function') ? ensureCalendar() : (WB && WB.calendar) || {};
    var work = (profile && profile.work) || {};
    var sh = Number(work.startHour);
    var eh = Number(work.endHour);
    if(!isFinite(sh)) sh = 15;
    if(!isFinite(eh)) eh = 23;
    if(eh <= sh) eh = Math.min(24, sh + 1);
    var hours = [];
    for(var h = Math.floor(sh); h < Math.ceil(eh) && h < 24; h++) hours.push(h);
    if(!hours.length) hours = [Math.floor(sh)%24];
    return {
      startMin: Math.round(sh * 60),
      endMin: Math.round(eh * 60),
      endHour: Math.ceil(eh),
      hours: hours,
      startLabel: easyPad2(Math.floor(sh))+':'+easyPad2(Math.round((sh%1)*60)),
      endLabel: (eh >= 24 ? '24:00' : (easyPad2(Math.floor(eh))+':'+easyPad2(Math.round((eh%1)*60))))
    };
  }
  /**
   * Day rhythm: for now sleep = 8h after work end, with 1h buffer.
   * sleepStart = workEnd + 1h; wake = sleepStart + 8h (mod 24h).
   * Awake window for suggestions = [wake, sleepStart) wrapping midnight if needed.
   */
  function easyDayRhythm(){
    var wh = easyWorkBlockHours();
    var workEnd = Number(wh.endMin) || (23 * 60);
    var bufferMin = 60;
    var sleepDur = 8 * 60;
    var sleepStart = (workEnd + bufferMin) % (24 * 60);
    var wakeMin = (sleepStart + sleepDur) % (24 * 60);
    return {
      bufferMin: bufferMin,
      sleepDurMin: sleepDur,
      workEndMin: workEnd,
      sleepStartMin: sleepStart,
      wakeMin: wakeMin,
      sleepStartLabel: easyFmtHHMM(sleepStart),
      wakeLabel: easyFmtHHMM(wakeMin),
      // true if awake window does not wrap (wake < sleepStart same calendar day)
      awakeSameDay: wakeMin < sleepStart
    };
  }

  /**
   * easy182: idempotent Board upsert into active calendar profile (calendars[sc] SoT).
   * Board-only: never auto-place on the calendar grid (cadence selected + empty keys).
   * Prefer times stay on startMin/hours for Suggest/Fill gaps later.
   */

  /** easy187: emitted/seeded Board acts must not keep forced suggestMust — Expenses remain must via easySuggestMust. */
  function easyClearForcedSuggestMustOnEmittedActs(){
    var report = { cleared: 0, names: [] };
    function touch(a){
      if(!a || typeof a !== 'object') return;
      var tagged = !!(a.__boardEmit || a.__seedExample || a.__mcrSeed || a.__hfJreqSeed || a.jmethod === 'localEconomy' || a.jmethod === 'localWeekend' || a.jmethod === 'morningCanvasRoi' || a.jmethod === 'householdEconomy' || a.jmethod === 'energy' || a.jmethod === 'robinhoodGold');
      if(!tagged) return;
      if(a.suggestMust === true || a.suggestMust === 1 || a.suggestMust === '1'){
        delete a.suggestMust;
        report.cleared++;
        report.names.push(a.name || a.id || '?');
      }
    }
    try {
      var pools = [];
      if(typeof getCalendarCustomActions === 'function') pools.push(getCalendarCustomActions() || []);
      if(WB && WB.calendar && Array.isArray(WB.calendar.customActions)) pools.push(WB.calendar.customActions);
      if(WB && WB.calendars){
        ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){
          var bag = WB.calendars[sc];
          if(bag && Array.isArray(bag.customActions)) pools.push(bag.customActions);
        });
      }
      pools.forEach(function(arr){ (arr||[]).forEach(touch); });
    } catch(_e){}
    return report;
  }

  function easyBoardParkOnly(act, spec){
    if(!act) return act;
    spec = spec || {};
    /* remember preferred schedule for Suggest without painting */
    if(Array.isArray(spec.days)) act.preferDays = spec.days.slice();
    else if(Array.isArray(act.days) && !act.preferDays) act.preferDays = act.days.slice();
    if(spec.cadence) act.preferCadence = String(spec.cadence);
    else if(act.cadence && act.cadence !== 'selected' && act.cadence !== 'paint' && act.cadence !== 'none' && act.cadence !== '')
      act.preferCadence = String(act.cadence);
    act.cadence = 'selected';
    act.selectedKeys = [];
    act.selected = [];
    act.repeatMarks = [];
    if(act.yearMarks && typeof act.yearMarks === 'object') act.yearMarks = {};
    act.days = [];
    return act;
  }
  function easyBoardUpsert(spec, opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    if(!spec || typeof spec !== 'object') return { ok:false, error:'no_spec' };
    var nm = String(spec.name || '').trim();
    if(!nm) return { ok:false, error:'no_name' };
    var id = String(spec.id || '').trim() || ((typeof easyNewId === 'function') ? easyNewId(nm) : ('act_emit_'+Date.now()));
    var jmethod = String(spec.jmethod || opts.jmethod || '').trim();
    var existing = null;
    try {
      var pool = (typeof getCalendarCustomActions === 'function') ? (getCalendarCustomActions() || []) : [];
      for(var i=0;i<pool.length;i++){
        var a = pool[i];
        if(!a || a.suggestOnly) continue;
        if((id && a.id === id) || String(a.name||'') === nm){ existing = a; break; }
      }
    } catch(_f){}
    var act = existing || ((typeof easyBlankAct === 'function') ? easyBlankAct(nm) : {
      id: id, name: nm, kind: 'schedule', polarity: 'neutral', amountMonthly: 0,
      cadence: 'weekdays', selectedKeys: [], hours: ['all'], allDay: true,
      lane: 'plan', scheduleOnly: true, section: 'SCHEDULE', author: 'ranking_ui', enabled: true
    });
    act.id = existing && existing.id ? existing.id : id;
    act.name = nm;
    act.kind = spec.kind || 'schedule';
    act.polarity = spec.polarity != null ? spec.polarity : (act.polarity || 'neutral');
    act.amountMonthly = Number(spec.amountMonthly != null ? spec.amountMonthly : (act.amountMonthly || 0)) || 0;
    act.enabled = spec.enabled === false ? false : true;
    act.lane = spec.lane || 'plan';
    act.scheduleOnly = spec.scheduleOnly !== false;
    act.section = spec.section || act.section || 'SCHEDULE';
    act.author = spec.author || act.author || 'ranking_ui';
    act.cadence = spec.cadence || act.cadence || 'weekdays';
    if(Array.isArray(spec.days)) act.days = spec.days.slice();
    else if(act.days == null && act.cadence === 'weekdays') act.days = [1,2,3,4,5];
    if(spec.allDay != null) act.allDay = !!spec.allDay;
    else if(spec.startMin != null) act.allDay = false;
    if(spec.startMin != null) act.startMin = Number(spec.startMin)|0;
    if(spec.endMin != null) act.endMin = Number(spec.endMin)|0;
    if(Array.isArray(spec.hours)) act.hours = spec.hours.slice();
    else if(spec.startMin != null){
      var h0 = Math.floor((Number(spec.startMin)|0) / 60) % 24;
      var h1 = Math.floor(((Number(spec.endMin)|0) - 1) / 60) % 24;
      var hs = [], hh = h0;
      for(var k=0;k<24;k++){ hs.push(hh); if(hh === h1) break; hh = (hh+1)%24; }
      act.hours = hs.length ? hs : [h0];
    }
    if(Array.isArray(spec.selectedKeys)) act.selectedKeys = spec.selectedKeys.slice();
    if(spec.note != null) act.note = String(spec.note);
    if(spec.marketPrior != null) act.marketPrior = spec.marketPrior;
    /* easy182: Board strip only — do not place on calendar (ignore spec.selectedKeys for emit/seed) */
    if(opts.placeOnCalendar !== true && spec.placeOnCalendar !== true){
      easyBoardParkOnly(act, spec);
    }
    /* easy187: Board emit/seed default NOT must-suggest — only Expenses are must by default (easySuggestMust → expense-like). */
    if(spec.suggestMust === true || spec.suggestMust === 1 || spec.suggestMust === '1' || opts.suggestMust === true)
      act.suggestMust = true;
    else if(spec.suggestMust === false || spec.suggestMust === 0 || spec.suggestMust === '0' || opts.suggestMust === false)
      act.suggestMust = false;
    else {
      delete act.suggestMust; /* unset → easySuggestMust uses expense-like only */
    }
    if(jmethod){
      act.jmethod = jmethod;
      act.jmethodTitle = String(spec.jmethodTitle || opts.jmethodTitle || jmethod);
    }
    if(spec.__seedExample || opts.seedExample) act.__seedExample = true;
    if(spec.__boardEmit || opts.fromEmit) act.__boardEmit = true;
    if(spec.__mcrSeed) act.__mcrSeed = true;
    if(spec.__hfJreqSeed || opts.hfJreqSeed) act.__hfJreqSeed = true;
    if(spec.simView) act.simView = String(spec.simView);
    if(spec.simExport != null) act.simExport = !!spec.simExport;
    if(spec.fromRanks) act.fromRanks = true;
    /* easy192: jreq + Exp6 joy/scoring fields from Board upsert specs */
    if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(spec, 'jreqId')){
      if(spec.jreqId == null || spec.jreqId === ''){ try { delete act.jreqId; } catch(_dj){ act.jreqId = undefined; } }
      else act.jreqId = String(spec.jreqId);
    }
    if(spec.joyFrom != null) act.joyFrom = String(spec.joyFrom);
    if(spec.joyTo != null) act.joyTo = String(spec.joyTo);
    if(spec.x != null && isFinite(Number(spec.x))) act.x = Number(spec.x);
    if(spec.y != null && isFinite(Number(spec.y))) act.y = Number(spec.y);
    if(spec.joyFromAmt != null && isFinite(Number(spec.joyFromAmt))) act.joyFromAmt = Number(spec.joyFromAmt);
    if(spec.joyToAmt != null && isFinite(Number(spec.joyToAmt))) act.joyToAmt = Number(spec.joyToAmt);
    if(spec.rankScore != null && isFinite(Number(spec.rankScore))) act.rankScore = Number(spec.rankScore);
    if(spec.milesOneWay != null && isFinite(Number(spec.milesOneWay))) act.milesOneWay = Number(spec.milesOneWay);
    if(spec.mpg != null && isFinite(Number(spec.mpg))) act.mpg = Number(spec.mpg);
    if(spec.gasUsdPerGal != null && isFinite(Number(spec.gasUsdPerGal))) act.gasUsdPerGal = Number(spec.gasUsdPerGal);
    if(Array.isArray(spec.preferDays)) act.preferDays = spec.preferDays.slice();
    if(spec.preferCadence) act.preferCadence = String(spec.preferCadence);
    if(act.spanDays == null) act.spanDays = 1;
    if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(act);
    else {
      var profile = (typeof ensureCalendar === 'function') ? ensureCalendar() : (WB && WB.calendar);
      if(!profile) return { ok:false, error:'no_profile', act:act };
      if(!Array.isArray(profile.customActions)) profile.customActions = [];
      var hit = -1;
      for(var j=0;j<profile.customActions.length;j++){
        var x = profile.customActions[j];
        if(x && (x.id === act.id || x.name === act.name)){ hit = j; break; }
      }
      if(hit >= 0) profile.customActions[hit] = act;
      else profile.customActions.push(act);
      if(typeof easyCommitCalendar === 'function') easyCommitCalendar(profile);
    }
    /* mirror into other scenario bags when missing (peer pattern) */
    try {
      if(WB && WB.calendars && opts.mirror !== false){
        var blob = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(act));
        ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){
          var bag = WB.calendars[sc];
          if(!bag) return;
          if(!Array.isArray(bag.customActions)) bag.customActions = [];
          var ix = -1;
          for(var t=0;t<bag.customActions.length;t++){
            var y = bag.customActions[t];
            if(y && (y.id === act.id || y.name === act.name)){ ix = t; break; }
          }
          if(ix >= 0){
            var keepSel = bag.customActions[ix].selectedKeys;
            bag.customActions[ix] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(act));
            if(keepSel && keepSel.length && !(act.selectedKeys && act.selectedKeys.length))
              bag.customActions[ix].selectedKeys = keepSel;
          } else {
            bag.customActions.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(blob)));
          }
        });
        try {
          var scNow = (typeof activeSc === 'function') ? activeSc() : (WB.activeScenario || 'current');
          if(WB.calendars[scNow]) WB.calendar = WB.calendars[scNow];
        } catch(_sc){}
      }
    } catch(_m){}
    return { ok:true, added: !existing, updated: !!existing, act: act, name: nm, id: act.id };
  }

  /** Emit Board acts from jmethod idea.boardItems[] (and optional board.emit Blueprint nodes). */
  function easyEmitBoardFromJmethod(jmOrId, opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    var report = { added: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, names: [], errors: [], jmethod: '' };
    var st = null;
    var jid = '';
    if(typeof jmOrId === 'string'){
      jid = String(jmOrId||'').trim();
      try {
        var mt = (typeof ensureModelTools === 'function') ? ensureModelTools() : (WB && WB.modelTools);
        st = mt && mt.jmethods && mt.jmethods[jid];
      } catch(_s){}
      if(!st && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.packGraph){
        try { st = ModelToolsScript.packGraph('builtins', jid); } catch(_p){}
      }
    } else if(jmOrId && typeof jmOrId === 'object'){
      st = jmOrId;
      jid = String(st.id || opts.jmethod || '').trim();
    }
    report.jmethod = jid;
    if(!st){ report.errors.push('jmethod_not_found'); return report; }
    var idea = (st.idea && typeof st.idea === 'object') ? st.idea : {};
    var items = [];
    var itemsSource = 'none';
    /* easy184: prefer economy.firms[].services as SoT (multi-firm simNet); boardItems = fallback */
    try {
      if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.boardItemsFromIdeaEconomy){
        var _ecoBag = ModelToolsScript.boardItemsFromIdeaEconomy(idea, {});
        if(_ecoBag && _ecoBag.items && _ecoBag.items.length && _ecoBag.source === 'economy.firms'){
          items = _ecoBag.items.slice();
          itemsSource = 'economy.firms';
        }
      } else if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.economyServicesFromIdea){
        var _pairs = ModelToolsScript.economyServicesFromIdea(idea) || [];
        if(_pairs.length){
          itemsSource = 'economy.firms';
          _pairs.forEach(function(p){
            var sim = ModelToolsScript.simNetForService(p.service, p.firm);
            var sp = ModelToolsScript.boardSpecFromEconomyService(p.service, p.firm, sim);
            if(sp && sp.name) items.push(sp);
          });
        }
      }
    } catch(_eco){}
    if(!items.length){
      items = Array.isArray(idea.boardItems) ? idea.boardItems.slice() : [];
      if(items.length) itemsSource = 'boardItems';
    }
    /* also collect board.emit node specs from script (additive unless firms SoT already filled) */
    try {
      if(itemsSource !== 'economy.firms' && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.collectBoardEmits){
        var more = ModelToolsScript.collectBoardEmits(st.script) || [];
        more.forEach(function(it){ if(it && it.name) items.push(it); });
        if(more.length && itemsSource === 'none') itemsSource = 'board.emit';
      }
    } catch(_c){}
    if(!items.length && Array.isArray(opts.boardItems)){ items = opts.boardItems.slice(); itemsSource = 'opts'; }
    if(!items.length){ report.errors.push('no_board_items'); return report; }
    report.boardItemsSource = itemsSource;
    var title = (st.label || idea.name || jid || '').trim();
    var emitMin = (opts.emitMin != null) ? Number(opts.emitMin) : ((idea.emitMin != null) ? Number(idea.emitMin) : 0.55);
    if(!(emitMin >= 0)) emitMin = 0.55;
    report.emitMin = emitMin;
    items.forEach(function(spec){
      if(!spec || !spec.name){ report.skipped++; return; }
      if(spec.skipEmit === true){ report.skipped++; report.names.push(spec.name+':skipEmit'); return; }
      try {
        var _spec = Object.assign({}, spec);
        /* ensure simNet when missing (fallback boardItems path) */
        if(_spec.simNet == null && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.simNetForService){
          try {
            var _sim = ModelToolsScript.simNetForService({
              benefitPrior: _spec.benefitPrior,
              frictionIndex: _spec.frictionIndex,
              minutesOneWay: _spec.minutesOneWay,
              milesOneWay: _spec.milesOneWay,
              mpg: _spec.mpg,
              gasUsdPerGal: _spec.gasUsdPerGal,
              costUsd: _spec.costUsd,
              serviceUsd: _spec.serviceUsd,
              parkingUsd: _spec.parkingUsd,
              daysUse: _spec.daysUse,
              demand: _spec.demand,
              supply: _spec.supply,
              startMin: _spec.startMin,
              endMin: _spec.endMin,
              hours: _spec.hours
            }, { capacity: _spec.firmCapacity, id: _spec.firmId });
            if(_sim && isFinite(_sim.net)) _spec.simNet = Math.round(_sim.net * 1000) / 1000;
            if(_spec.frictionIndex == null && _sim) _spec.frictionIndex = _sim.friction;
            if(_sim){
              if(_spec.simMoney == null && _sim.money != null) _spec.simMoney = _sim.money;
              if(_spec.simTimeH == null && _sim.timeH != null) _spec.simTimeH = _sim.timeH;
              if(_spec.simDays == null && _sim.days != null) _spec.simDays = _sim.days;
            }
          } catch(_sn){}
        }
        /* easy184: primary gate = simNet; secondary benefitPrior only if simNet absent */
        if(_spec.simNet != null && isFinite(Number(_spec.simNet))){
          if(Number(_spec.simNet) < emitMin){
            report.skipped++; report.names.push(spec.name+':netGate('+_spec.simNet+')'); return;
          }
        } else if(_spec.benefitPrior != null && Number(_spec.benefitPrior) < emitMin){
          report.skipped++; report.names.push(spec.name+':gate'); return;
        }
        if(_spec.note && _spec.simNet != null && String(_spec.note).indexOf('simNet') < 0){
          _spec.note = String(_spec.note) + ' · simNet≈' + _spec.simNet + ' (EXAMPLE)';
        }
        /* easy187: if note mentions friction, include money/time/days breakdown when present */
        if(_spec.note && /friction/i.test(String(_spec.note))
            && String(_spec.note).indexOf('simMoney') < 0 && String(_spec.note).indexOf('$≈') < 0){
          var _bits = [];
          if(_spec.simMoney != null && isFinite(Number(_spec.simMoney))) _bits.push('$≈'+(Math.round(Number(_spec.simMoney)*100)/100));
          if(_spec.simTimeH != null && isFinite(Number(_spec.simTimeH))) _bits.push('timeH≈'+(Math.round(Number(_spec.simTimeH)*100)/100));
          if(_spec.simDays != null && isFinite(Number(_spec.simDays))) _bits.push('days≈'+(Math.round(Number(_spec.simDays)*1000)/1000));
          if(_bits.length) _spec.note = String(_spec.note) + ' · friction breakdown ' + _bits.join(' / ') + ' (EXAMPLE)';
        }
        var r = easyBoardUpsert(Object.assign({}, _spec, {
          jmethod: _spec.jmethod || jid,
          jmethodTitle: _spec.jmethodTitle || title
        }), { jmethod: jid, jmethodTitle: title, fromEmit: true, seedExample: !!_spec.__seedExample, mirror: opts.mirror !== false });
        if(!r || !r.ok){ report.skipped++; report.names.push(spec.name+':err'); return; }
        /* stamp economy fields onto parked Board act */
        try {
          if(r.act){
            if(_spec.firmId != null) r.act.firmId = String(_spec.firmId);
            if(_spec.benefitPrior != null) r.act.benefitPrior = Number(_spec.benefitPrior);
            if(_spec.frictionIndex != null) r.act.frictionIndex = Number(_spec.frictionIndex);
            if(_spec.simNet != null) r.act.simNet = Number(_spec.simNet);
            if(_spec.simMoney != null) r.act.simMoney = Number(_spec.simMoney);
            if(_spec.simTimeH != null) r.act.simTimeH = Number(_spec.simTimeH);
            if(_spec.simDays != null) r.act.simDays = Number(_spec.simDays);
            if(_spec.benefitWhy != null) r.act.benefitWhy = String(_spec.benefitWhy);
            if(_spec.__seedExample || opts.seedExample) r.act.__seedExample = true;
            if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(r.act);
          }
        } catch(_st){}
        if(r.added){ report.added++; report.names.push(spec.name+':add'); }
        else { report.updated++; report.names.push(spec.name+':update'); }
      } catch(e){ report.skipped++; report.errors.push(String(e && e.message || e)); }
    });
    return report;
  }

  /** Soft-seed demo pack localWeekend → Board (idempotent). */
  function easyEnsureLocalWeekendBoardActs(){
    var report = { added: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, names: [], jmethod: 'localWeekend' };
    try {
      var st = null;
      if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.packGraph){
        st = ModelToolsScript.packGraph('builtins', 'localWeekend');
      }
      if(!st){
        try {
          var mt = (typeof ensureModelTools === 'function') ? ensureModelTools() : null;
          st = mt && mt.jmethods && mt.jmethods.localWeekend;
        } catch(_m){}
      }
      if(st){
        var r = easyEmitBoardFromJmethod(st, { jmethod: 'localWeekend' });
        return Object.assign(report, r, { jmethod: 'localWeekend' });
      }
    } catch(_e){ report.errors = [String(_e && _e.message || _e)]; }
    report.errors = report.errors || ['localWeekend_pack_missing'];
    return report;
  }

  /** Idempotent Board/calendar seeds for morning canvas ROI (Fill-gaps style — never clear).
   * easy178: write through ensureCalendar/easyCommitQuiet (calendars.current SoT), not orphan WB.calendar-only.
   * Schedule acts need suggestMust:true so Suggest/Fill gaps pick them up (easySuggestMust defaults expense-like only). */
  function easyEnsureMorningCanvasActs(){
    var report = { added: 0, skipped: 0, updated: 0, names: [] };
    var specs = [
      {
        name: 'Deep work (morning canvas)',
        id: 'act_mcr_deep_work_morning_canvas',
        startMin: 8*60+30, endMin: 11*60,
        hours: [8,9,10],
        note: 'High-leverage deep work in morning canvas · 08:30–11:00 before work'
      },
      {
        name: 'Admin batch (morning)',
        id: 'act_mcr_admin_batch_morning',
        startMin: 11*60+15, endMin: 12*60,
        hours: [11],
        note: 'Short admin batch in morning canvas · keep deep work intact'
      },
      {
        name: 'Protect canvas',
        id: 'act_mcr_protect_canvas',
        startMin: 14*60+30, endMin: 15*60,
        hours: [14],
        note: 'Buffer before 15:00 work start — protect morning canvas'
      }
    ];
    function findExisting(nm, id){
      var bags = [];
      try {
        if(typeof getCalendarCustomActions === 'function') bags.push(getCalendarCustomActions() || []);
      } catch(_g){}
      try {
        var p = (typeof ensureCalendar === 'function') ? ensureCalendar() : (WB && WB.calendar);
        if(p && Array.isArray(p.customActions)) bags.push(p.customActions);
      } catch(_e){}
      try {
        if(WB && WB.calendars){
          ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){
            var b = WB.calendars[sc];
            if(b && Array.isArray(b.customActions)) bags.push(b.customActions);
          });
        }
      } catch(_c){}
      var i, j, a;
      for(i = 0; i < bags.length; i++){
        for(j = 0; j < bags[i].length; j++){
          a = bags[i][j];
          if(!a || a.suggestOnly) continue;
          if((id && a.id === id) || String(a.name||'') === nm) return a;
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    function paintFlags(act, sp){
      act.name = sp.name;
      if(sp.id && !act.id) act.id = sp.id;
      act.kind = 'schedule';
      act.polarity = act.polarity || 'neutral';
      act.amountMonthly = Number(act.amountMonthly)||0;
      act.scheduleOnly = true;
      act.lane = 'plan';
      act.enabled = true;
      /* easy187: not must-suggest by default (Expenses only) */
      if(act.suggestMust === true) delete act.suggestMust;
      act.allDay = false;
      act.startMin = sp.startMin;
      act.endMin = sp.endMin;
      act.hours = sp.hours.slice();
      act.preferCadence = 'weekdays';
      act.preferDays = [1,2,3,4,5];
      act.section = 'SCHEDULE';
      act.author = act.author || 'ranking_ui';
      act.note = sp.note;
      act.__mcrSeed = true;
      act.jmethod = 'morningCanvasRoi';
      act.jmethodTitle = 'Morning canvas ROI';
      if(act.spanDays == null) act.spanDays = 1;
      /* Board only — not on calendar until Suggest/place */
      if(typeof easyBoardParkOnly === 'function') easyBoardParkOnly(act, { cadence:'weekdays', days:[1,2,3,4,5] });
      else {
        act.cadence = 'selected';
        act.selectedKeys = [];
        act.days = [];
      }
      return act;
    }
    function needsUpgrade(a){
      if(!a) return true;
      if(a.suggestMust === true) return true; /* easy187: clear forced must on mcr seeds */
      if(a.jmethod !== 'morningCanvasRoi') return true;
      if(a.enabled === false) return true;
      if(!a.scheduleOnly || a.lane !== 'plan') return true;
      /* easy182: un-place if still on calendar via rule cadence or paint */
      var cad = String(a.cadence||'').toLowerCase();
      if(cad !== 'selected' && cad !== 'paint' && cad !== 'none' && cad !== '') return true;
      if((a.selectedKeys && a.selectedKeys.length) || (a.repeatMarks && a.repeatMarks.length)) return true;
      return false;
    }
    specs.forEach(function(sp){
      try {
        var existing = findExisting(sp.name, sp.id);
        if(existing && !needsUpgrade(existing)){
          report.skipped++;
          report.names.push(sp.name+':skip');
          return;
        }
        var act = existing || ((typeof easyBlankAct === 'function') ? easyBlankAct(sp.name) : {
          id: sp.id || ((typeof easyNewId === 'function') ? easyNewId(sp.name) : ('act_mcr_'+Date.now())),
          name: sp.name, kind: 'schedule', polarity: 'neutral', amountMonthly: 0,
          cadence: 'weekdays', selectedKeys: [], hours: ['all'], allDay: true,
          lane: 'plan', scheduleOnly: true, section: 'SCHEDULE', author: 'ranking_ui', enabled: true
        });
        if(sp.id) act.id = sp.id;
        paintFlags(act, sp);
        if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function'){
          easyCommitQuiet(act);
          // Mirror into projected/review if missing there (peer calendar bags)
          try {
            if(WB && WB.calendars){
              ['projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){
                var bag = WB.calendars[sc];
                if(!bag) return;
                if(!Array.isArray(bag.customActions)) bag.customActions = [];
                var hit = null;
                for(var i=0;i<bag.customActions.length;i++){
                  var x = bag.customActions[i];
                  if(x && (x.id === act.id || x.name === act.name)){ hit = x; break; }
                }
                if(hit){
                  paintFlags(hit, sp);
                  if(act.id) hit.id = act.id;
                } else {
                  bag.customActions.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(act)));
                }
              });
            }
          } catch(_m){}
        } else {
          var profile = (typeof ensureCalendar === 'function') ? ensureCalendar() : (WB && WB.calendar);
          if(!profile) return;
          if(!Array.isArray(profile.customActions)) profile.customActions = [];
          profile.customActions.push(act);
          if(typeof easyCommitCalendar === 'function') easyCommitCalendar(profile);
        }
        if(existing){ report.updated++; report.names.push(sp.name+':update'); }
        else { report.added++; report.names.push(sp.name+':add'); }
      } catch(_e){ report.skipped++; report.names.push(sp.name+':err'); }
    });
    return report;
  }

      if(Array.isArray(sp.preferDays)) act.preferDays = sp.preferDays.slice();
      if(sp.preferCadence) act.preferCadence = String(sp.preferCadence);
      if(sp.marketPrior) act.marketPrior = sp.marketPrior;
      if(sp.note != null) act.note = String(sp.note);
      if(act.suggestMust === true) delete act.suggestMust;
      return act;
    }
    specs.forEach(function(sp){
      try {
        var existing = findExisting(sp.name, sp.id);
        if(existing && !needsUpgrade(existing, sp)){
          report.skipped++;
          report.names.push(sp.name+':skip');
          return;
        }
        var parkSpec = {
          id: sp.id,
          name: sp.name,
          kind: sp.kind || 'schedule',
          polarity: sp.polarity != null ? sp.polarity : 'neutral',
          amountMonthly: sp.amountMonthly != null ? sp.amountMonthly : 0,
          section: sp.section || 'SCHEDULE',
          scheduleOnly: true,
          cadence: 'selected',
          note: sp.note,
          jreqId: sp.jreqId,
          joyFrom: sp.joyFrom,
          joyTo: sp.joyTo,
          x: sp.x,
          y: sp.y,
          joyFromAmt: sp.joyFromAmt,
          joyToAmt: sp.joyToAmt,
          rankScore: sp.rankScore,
          milesOneWay: sp.milesOneWay,
          mpg: sp.mpg,
          gasUsdPerGal: sp.gasUsdPerGal,
          preferDays: sp.preferDays,
          preferCadence: sp.preferCadence,
          marketPrior: sp.marketPrior,
          __hfJreqSeed: true,
          __seedExample: true
        };
        if(sp.startMin != null) parkSpec.startMin = sp.startMin;
        if(sp.endMin != null) parkSpec.endMin = sp.endMin;
        if(Array.isArray(sp.hours)) parkSpec.hours = sp.hours.slice();
        if(sp.allDay != null) parkSpec.allDay = !!sp.allDay;
        var r = (typeof easyBoardUpsert === 'function')
          ? easyBoardUpsert(parkSpec, { placeOnCalendar: false, suggestMust: false, seedExample: true, mirror: true })
          : { ok:false };
        if(!r || !r.ok || !r.act){
          report.skipped++;
          report.names.push(sp.name+':err');
          return;
        }
        stampHf(r.act, sp);
        if(typeof easyBoardParkOnly === 'function'){
          easyBoardParkOnly(r.act, {
            cadence: 'selected',
            days: Array.isArray(sp.preferDays) ? sp.preferDays : undefined
          });
        }
        if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(r.act);
        if(existing || r.updated){ report.updated++; report.names.push(sp.name+':update'); }
        else { report.added++; report.names.push(sp.name+':add'); }
      } catch(_e){
        report.skipped++;
        report.names.push(sp.name+':err');
      }
    });
    return report;
  }

  /** easy213: Board-only selfless training-days act. Carries own sim (training_days.html).
   * No hard House/Family jreq — public_good unlocks without House. Idempotent via id + __hfJreqSeed. */
  function easyEnsureTrainingDaysAct(){
    var report = { added: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, names: [], id: 'act_hf_training_days' };
    var spec = {
      id: 'act_hf_training_days',
      name: 'Design training days (selfless)',
      kind: 'joy',
      polarity: 'neutral',
      amountMonthly: 0,
      section: 'SCHEDULE',
      scheduleOnly: true,
      cadence: 'selected',
      jmethod: 'householdEconomy',
      jmethodTitle: 'Household economy (selfless)',
      simView: 'training_days.html',
      simExport: true,
      note: 'Selfless public-good shop tool. Action carries own simulation (training_days.html). EXAMPLE C-130J/MXS-flavored — not classified. No hard House/Family jreq.',
      joyFrom: 'H',
      joyTo: 'E',
      x: 0.2,
      y: 0.55,
      joyFromAmt: 0.2,
      joyToAmt: 0.55,
      rankScore: 0.5
    };
    function findExisting(){
      var bags = [];
      try { if(typeof getCalendarCustomActions === 'function') bags.push(getCalendarCustomActions() || []); } catch(_g){}
      try {
        var p = (typeof ensureCalendar === 'function') ? ensureCalendar() : (WB && WB.calendar);
        if(p && Array.isArray(p.customActions)) bags.push(p.customActions);
      } catch(_e){}
      try {
        if(WB && WB.calendars){
          ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){
            var b = WB.calendars[sc];
            if(b && Array.isArray(b.customActions)) bags.push(b.customActions);
          });
        }
      } catch(_c){}
      var i, j, a;
      for(i = 0; i < bags.length; i++){
        for(j = 0; j < bags[i].length; j++){
          a = bags[i][j];
          if(!a || a.suggestOnly) continue;
          if(a.id === spec.id || String(a.name||'') === spec.name) return a;
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    function needsUpgrade(a){
      if(!a) return true;
      if(!a.__hfJreqSeed) return true;
      if(String(a.simView||'') !== spec.simView) return true;
      if(a.simExport !== true) return true;
      if(a.jmethod !== 'householdEconomy') return true;
      if(a.jreqId) return true;
      if(a.suggestMust === true || a.suggestMust === 1 || a.suggestMust === '1') return true;
      if(a.enabled === false) return true;
      if(a.scheduleOnly === false) return true;
      if(String(a.name||'') !== spec.name) return true;
      return false;
    }
    try {
      var existing = findExisting();
      if(existing && !needsUpgrade(existing)){
        report.skipped++;
        report.names.push(spec.name+':skip');
        return report;
      }
      var r = (typeof easyBoardUpsert === 'function')
        ? easyBoardUpsert({
            id: spec.id,
            name: spec.name,
            kind: spec.kind,
            polarity: spec.polarity,
            amountMonthly: spec.amountMonthly,
            section: spec.section,
            scheduleOnly: true,
            cadence: 'selected',
            note: spec.note,
            jmethod: spec.jmethod,
            jmethodTitle: spec.jmethodTitle,
            simView: spec.simView,
            simExport: spec.simExport,
            joyFrom: spec.joyFrom,
            joyTo: spec.joyTo,
            x: spec.x,
            y: spec.y,
            joyFromAmt: spec.joyFromAmt,
            joyToAmt: spec.joyToAmt,
            rankScore: spec.rankScore,
            __hfJreqSeed: true,
            __seedExample: true
          }, { placeOnCalendar: false, suggestMust: false, seedExample: true, hfJreqSeed: true, mirror: true })
        : { ok:false };
      if(!r || !r.ok || !r.act){
        report.skipped++;
        report.names.push(spec.name+':err');
        return report;
      }
      r.act.__hfJreqSeed = true;
      r.act.__seedExample = true;
      r.act.simView = spec.simView;
      r.act.simExport = true;
      r.act.jmethod = spec.jmethod;
      r.act.jmethodTitle = spec.jmethodTitle;
      r.act.suggestMust = false;
      try { delete r.act.jreqId; } catch(_j){ r.act.jreqId = undefined; }
      if(typeof easyBoardParkOnly === 'function'){
        easyBoardParkOnly(r.act, { cadence: 'selected' });
      }
      if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(r.act);
      if(existing || r.updated){ report.updated++; report.names.push(spec.name+':update'); }
      else { report.added++; report.names.push(spec.name+':add'); }
    } catch(_e){
      report.skipped++;
      report.names.push(spec.name+':err');
    }
    return report;
  }

  function easyBlankSleepAct(){

    var sm = r.sleepStartMin;

    };

    if(typeof mohoFire === 'function') mohoFire('calendar-drill');
    renderAll();
    showStatus('Wake '+r.wakeLabel+' · Sleep '+r.sleepStartLabel+' (8h after work + 1h buffer) · Save to keep','ok');
  }

  function easyOccurs(a, y, m, d){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    if(!RC || !RC.occursOnDay) return false;
    // easy211+: act.startDate YYYY-MM-DD — no hits before that civil day (leases begin Oct 16)
    try {
      if(a && a.startDate){
        var sm = String(a.startDate).trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
        if(sm){
          var sy=+sm[1], smo=+sm[2]-1, sd=+sm[3];
          if(y < sy) return false;
          if(y === sy && m < smo) return false;
          if(y === sy && m === smo && d < sd) return false;
        }
      }
    } catch(_sd){}
    var keys = a.selectedKeys || a.selected || [];
    if((a.cadence === 'selected' || a.cadence === 'paint' || a.cadence === 'none') && (!keys || !keys.length) && !a.yearMarks && !(a.repeatMarks && a.repeatMarks.length)){
      return false;
    }
    var sy = easyStartYear();
    var dim = RC.daysInMonth(y, m);
    var dow = new Date(y, m, d).getDay();
    var abs = 0;
    try {
      if(RC.absoluteDayIndex) abs = RC.absoluteDayIndex(y - sy, m, d - 1, sy) | 0;
      else {
        var t0 = Date.UTC(sy, 0, 1);
        var t1 = Date.UTC(y, m, d);
        abs = Math.round((t1 - t0) / [REDACTED-ACCOUNT-DIGITS]) | 0;
      }
    } catch(_abs){ abs = 0; }
    var ctx = { dow: dow, day: d, monthIndex: m, yearIndex: y - sy, nDaysMonth: dim, absoluteDay: abs };
    var rule = {
      cadence: a.cadence || 'selected',
      days: a.days, nDays: a.nDays, day: a.day, month: a.month,
      selectedKeys: keys, yearMarks: a.yearMarks, repeatMarks: a.repeatMarks
    };
    return RC.occursOnDay(rule, ctx);
  }
  function easyLaneOf(a){
    if(easyInThisWeek(a)) return 'week';
    return 'plan';
  }
  function easyCommitQuiet(act){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var profile = ensureCalendar();
    if(RC && RC.upsertCustomAction) profile = RC.upsertCustomAction(profile, act);
    else {
      profile.customActions = (profile.customActions || []).filter(function(x){ return x && x.id !== act.id && x.name !== act.name; });
      profile.customActions.push(act);
    }
    // Do NOT mirror money/Board acts into window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.
    // That global catalog is shared across CURRENT/PROJECTED/REVIEW and was
    // leaking placements + $ so switching scenarios changed other calendars'
    // readings and phone-batch re-imported stale projected amounts.
    easyCommitCalendar(profile);
    return act;
  }

    renderAll();
  }

  /** Put / revive sheet expenses on the calendar as monthly spends (no Work). */
  function easySeedExpensesFromSheet(){
    var items = easyValuedExpenseItems();
    var added = 0, revived = 0, skipped = 0;
    items.forEach(function(it){
      if(!it || !it.name || !(it.amount > 0)) return;
      var existing = easyFindExpenseAct(it.name);
      if(existing){
        var changed = false;
        if(Number(existing.amountMonthly) !== Number(it.amount)){ existing.amountMonthly = it.amount; changed = true; }
        if(!easyActOnCalendar(existing)){
          existing.cadence = 'monthly';
          existing.day = existing.day != null ? existing.day : 1;
          existing.selectedKeys = [];
          existing.repeatMarks = [];
          existing.yearMarks = {};
          existing.days = [];
          existing.hours = ['all'];
          existing.allDay = true;
          existing.scheduleOnly = false;
          existing.polarity = 'spend';
          if(existing.kind !== 'work') existing.kind = 'spend';
          existing.expenseName = it.name;
          changed = true;
          revived++;
        } else {
          skipped++;
        }
        if(changed) easyCommitQuiet(existing);
        return;
      }
      easyCommitQuiet(easyExpenseSeedAct(it));
      added++;
    });
    try { if(WB) WB._calUserCleared = false; } catch(_c){}
    invalidateCalendarCache();
    try { if(typeof _easyBestTick === 'number'){ _easyBestTick++; _easyJgAt = -1; } } catch(_t){}
    return { added: added, revived: revived, skipped: skipped, n: items.length };
  }
  function easyAddAllExpenses(){
    var r = easySeedExpensesFromSheet();
    if(typeof mohoFire === 'function') mohoFire('calendar-drill');
    renderAll();
    var zeros = easyExpenseItems().length - (r.n || 0);
    if(!(r.n > 0)) showStatus('No EXPENSES lines with a $ value','bad');
    else if(!(r.added + r.revived)) showStatus('All valued expenses already on the calendar'+(zeros?(' · '+zeros+' [REDACTED-AMOUNT] skipped'):''),'ok');
    else showStatus('Expenses on calendar: +'+(r.added||0)+' new · '+(r.revived||0)+' revived'+(r.skipped?(' · '+r.skipped+' already live'):'')+(zeros?(' · '+zeros+' [REDACTED-AMOUNT] skipped'):'')+' · Save to keep','ok');
  }

  }

  function easyDateDiffDays(a, b){
    if(!a || !b) return 0;
    var da = Date.UTC(a.y, a.m, a.d);
    var db = Date.UTC(b.y, b.m, b.d);
    return Math.round((da - db) / [REDACTED-ACCOUNT-DIGITS]);
  }
  function easyEarliestOccur(act){
    if(!act) return null;
    var best = null;
    function consider(p){
      if(!p || !isFinite(p.y) || !isFinite(p.m) || !isFinite(p.d)) return;
      if(!best || easyDaySort(p, best) < 0) best = { y: p.y, m: p.m, d: p.d };
    }
    if(typeof easyIsPainted === 'function' && easyIsPainted(act)){
      var painted = easyKeepFromPaint(act, function(){ return true; });
      for(var pi = 0; pi < painted.length; pi++) consider(painted[pi]);
      if(best) return best;
    }
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var sy = easyStartYear();
    var years = easyHorizonYears();
    if(!RC || !RC.daysInMonth) return best;
    for(var yi = 0; yi < years; yi++){
      var y = sy + yi;
      for(var m = 0; m < 12; m++){
        var dim = RC.daysInMonth(y, m);
        for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
          if(easyOccurs(act, y, m, d)) return { y: y, m: m, d: d };
        }
      }
    }
    return best;
  }
  function easyMapJmethod(name, exp){
    var n = String(name || 'JDirect');
    if(n === 'JIndirect' && exp && exp.JIndirect) return exp.JIndirect;
    if(n === 'JNeutral' && exp && exp.JNeutral) return exp.JNeutral;
    if(n === 'JDirect' && exp && exp.JDirect) return exp.JDirect;
    if(n === 'JUnit') return function(x, y){ return easyJUnit(x, y); };
    if(exp && exp.JDirect) return exp.JDirect;
    return function(x, y){ return easyJUnit(x, y); };
  }
  function easyIsJoyAct(a){
    return !!(a && (a.kind === 'joy' || a.joyFrom || a.joyTo));
  }
  function easyExpenseNameOf(a){
    if(!a) return '';
    if(a.expenseName) return a.expenseName;
    return a.name || '';
  }
  function easyFallbackCmp(ranks){
    return function(a, b){
      var na = easyExpenseNameOf(a), nb = easyExpenseNameOf(b);
      var ra = ranks && ranks.byName && ranks.byName[na];
      var rb = ranks && ranks.byName && ranks.byName[nb];
      var sa = -1, sb = -1;
      if(ra) sa = Number(ra.score) || 0;
      if(rb) sb = Number(rb.score) || 0;
      if(easyIsJoyAct(a) && !ra) sa = easyJUnit(a.x != null ? a.x : a.joyFromAmt, a.y != null ? a.y : a.joyToAmt);
      if(easyIsJoyAct(b) && !rb) sb = easyJUnit(b.x != null ? b.x : b.joyFromAmt, b.y != null ? b.y : b.joyToAmt);
      if(sb !== sa) return sb - sa;
      var ja = easyIsJoyAct(a) ? easyJUnit(a.x != null ? a.x : a.joyFromAmt, a.y != null ? a.y : a.joyToAmt) : 0;
      var jb = easyIsJoyAct(b) ? easyJUnit(b.x != null ? b.x : b.joyFromAmt, b.y != null ? b.y : b.joyToAmt) : 0;
      if(jb !== ja) return jb - ja;
      return String(a && a.name || '').localeCompare(String(b && b.name || ''));
    };
  }
  function easyScore01Of(a, ranks){
    var name = easyExpenseNameOf(a);
    var row = ranks && ranks.byName && ranks.byName[name];
    if(row && (a.expenseName || !easyIsJoyAct(a))){
      var s = row.score;
      if(s == null || !isFinite(Number(s))) s = row.scoreRaw;
      s = Number(s) || 0;
      if(s < 0) s = 0;
      return s;
    }
    if(easyIsJoyAct(a)){
      return easyJUnit(a.x != null ? a.x : a.joyFromAmt, a.y != null ? a.y : a.joyToAmt);
    }
    if(row){
      var s2 = Number(row.score);
      return isFinite(s2) ? Math.max(0, s2) : 0;
    }
    return 0;
  }
  function easySelTabHtml(kind, y, m, d, predDate, predName, rating){
    var daysAhead = easyDateDiffDays({ y: y, m: m, d: d }, predDate);
    var label = (daysAhead > 0 ? '+' : '') + String(daysAhead) + ' · ' + String(rating);
    var who = predName || 'today';
    var rel;
    if(daysAhead > 0) rel = daysAhead + ' days after ' + who;
    else if(daysAhead < 0) rel = (-daysAhead) + ' days before ' + who;
    else rel = 'same day as ' + who;
    var title = rel + ' · score ' + rating + '/1000';
    return '<span class="easy-sel-tab '+kind+'" title="'+esc(title)+'">'+esc(label)+'</span>';
  }

  function easyCalViewScope(){
    if(easyCal && easyCal.mode === 'board') return { kind: 'board' };
    if(easyCal && easyCal.allYears) return { kind: 'month-all', m: easyCal.m };
    return { kind: 'month', y: easyCal.y, m: easyCal.m };
  }
  function easyActInScope(act, scope){
    if(!act) return false;
    if(!scope || scope.kind === 'board' || scope.kind === 'years') return true;
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var sy = easyStartYear();
    var years = (typeof easyHorizonYears === 'function') ? easyHorizonYears() : 150;
    function occursMonth(y, m){
      var dim = (RC && RC.daysInMonth) ? RC.daysInMonth(y, m) : 31;
      for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
        if(easyOccurs(act, y, m, d)) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    if(scope.kind === 'month') return occursMonth(scope.y, scope.m);
    if(scope.kind === 'month-all'){
      for(var yi = 0; yi < years; yi++){
        if(occursMonth(sy + yi, scope.m)) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    if(scope.kind === 'year'){
      for(var m = 0; m < 12; m++){
        if(occursMonth(scope.y, m)) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  function easyApplyViewRatings(best, scope, extraAct){
    if(!best || !best.byId) return best;
    var n = (best.order || []).length;
    var viewIds = [];
    (best.order || []).forEach(function(a){
      if(!a) return;
      if(easyActInScope(a, scope)) viewIds.push(a.id || a.name);
    });
    // View pool only if it actually compares 2+ items. A lone unplaced
    // action must not max to 1000.
    var useView = viewIds.length >= 2;
    var max = 0, min = Infinity, seen = 0;
    function take(id){
      var row = best.byId[id];
      var s = row ? (Number(row.score01) || 0) : 0;
      if(s > max) max = s;
      if(s < min) min = s;
      seen++;
    }
    if(useView) viewIds.forEach(take);
    else (best.order || []).forEach(function(a){ if(a) take(a.id || a.name); });
    if(!seen){ min = 0; max = 0; }
    var spread = (max - min) > (max * 0.05 + 1e-9);
    var byId = {};
    Object.keys(best.byId).forEach(function(id){
      var row = best.byId[id];
      var rating;
      if(spread && max > 0){
        rating = easyClampRating((row.score01 || 0) / max);
      } else if(n > 1 && row.rank){
        rating = Math.round(1000 * (n - row.rank + 1) / n);
        if(rating < 1) rating = 1;
        if(rating > 1000) rating = 1000;
      } else {
        rating = row.rank === 1 ? 1000 : easyClampRating(row.score01 || 0);
      }
      byId[id] = {
        rank: row.rank,
        score01: row.score01,
        rating1000: rating,
        predId: row.predId,
        predName: row.predName
      };
    });
    return { order: best.order, byId: byId, source: best.source, view: useView ? (scope && scope.kind) : 'board' };
  }
  function easyWithScenario(sc, fn){
    sc = normalizeSc(sc);
    var prevSc = activeSc();
    var prevCal = WB && WB.calendar;
    try {
      if(WB){
        WB.activeScenario = sc;
        if(WB.calendars && WB.calendars[sc]) WB.calendar = WB.calendars[sc];
        else if(typeof ensureCalendar === 'function') ensureCalendar();
      }
      if(typeof invalidateCalendarCache === 'function') invalidateCalendarCache();
      return fn(sc);
    } finally {
      if(WB){
        WB.activeScenario = prevSc;
        if(prevCal) WB.calendar = prevCal;
        else if(WB.calendars && WB.calendars[prevSc]) WB.calendar = WB.calendars[prevSc];
      }
      if(typeof invalidateCalendarCache === 'function') invalidateCalendarCache();
    }
  }
  /** Build one atomic JGroup for a scenario's calendar actions (Exp6 option). */
  /** Snapshot live rollup + calendar board under one scenario (same path as horizon). */
  function easyScenarioSnap(sc){
    sc = normalizeSc(sc);
    return easyWithScenario(sc, function(){
      var roll = { gain:0, living:0, debt:0, surplus:0, nActs:0 };
      try {
        // withScenario sets activeSc()===sc, so lastBest must never be reused here.
        if(typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function') roll = easyMonthMoneyRoll() || roll;
        else if(typeof easyCalendarRollup === 'function') roll = easyCalendarRollup() || roll;
      } catch(_r){}
      var summary = {
        gross: Number(roll.gain)||0,
        net: Number(roll.gain)||0,
        living: Number(roll.living)||0,
        debtPayments: Number(roll.debt)||0,
        surplus: Number(roll.surplus)||0,
        dti: 0
      };
      var ranks = { items: [], byName: {} };
      try { ranks = calcRanks() || ranks; } catch(_r){}
      var acts = [];
      try { acts = easyScheduleActions() || []; } catch(_a){}
      var happySum = 0, costSum = 0;
      var dimSum = { H:0, D:0, A:0, M:0, E:0 };
      (ranks.items || []).forEach(function(it){
        if(!it) return;
        costSum += Math.abs(Number(it.cost) || 0);
        var y = (it.scoreRaw != null && isFinite(Number(it.scoreRaw))) ? Number(it.scoreRaw) : Number(it.score);
        happySum += Math.abs(y) || 0;
        dimSum.H += Math.abs(Number(it.H)||0);
        dimSum.D += Math.abs(Number(it.D)||0);
        dimSum.A += Math.abs(Number(it.A)||0);
        dimSum.M += Math.abs(Number(it.M)||Number(it.cost)||0);
        dimSum.E += Math.abs(Number(it.E)||0);
      });
      var built = [];
      acts.forEach(function(act){
        if(!act) return;
        var id = act.id || act.name;
        var name = (typeof easyExpenseNameOf === 'function') ? easyExpenseNameOf(act) : (act.expenseName || act.name);
        var row = ranks.byName && ranks.byName[name];
        var isExp = !!(act.expenseName || row);
        if(isExp && !(typeof easyIsJoyAct === 'function' && easyIsJoyAct(act))){
          var cost = row && row.cost != null ? Number(row.cost) || 0 : 0;
          var yAmt = 0;
          if(row){
            if(row.scoreRaw != null && isFinite(Number(row.scoreRaw))) yAmt = Number(row.scoreRaw) || 0;
            else yAmt = Number(row.score) || 0;
          }
          built.push({ id: id, name: name || id, kind: 'expense', x: cost, y: yAmt, jmethod: act.jmethod || 'JDirect' });
          return;
        }
        if(typeof easyIsJoyAct === 'function' && easyIsJoyAct(act)){
          var x = act.x != null ? Number(act.x) : Number(act.joyFromAmt);
          var yv = act.y != null ? Number(act.y) : Number(act.joyToAmt);
          if(!isFinite(x)) x = 0;
          if(!isFinite(yv)) yv = 0;
          built.push({ id: id, name: act.name || id, kind: 'joy', x: x, y: yv, jmethod: act.jmethod || 'JDirect', from: act.joyFrom || act.joyId || 'H', to: act.joyTo || 'M' });
          return;
        }
