        var amt = Math.abs(Number(act.amountMonthly != null ? act.amountMonthly : act.amount) || 0);
        if(act.kind === 'work' || act.polarity === 'gain'){
          built.push({ id: id, name: act.name || id, kind: 'work', x: -amt, y: amt ? 1 : 0, jmethod: 'JDirect' });
        }
      });
      return {
        sc: sc,
        label: SC_LABEL[sc] || sc,
        summary: summary,
        built: built,
        nActs: built.length,
        happySum: happySum,
        costSum: costSum,
        dimSum: dimSum
      };
    });
  }
  /**
   * Build atomic scenario JGroup on SHARED Joy capacities (max across scenarios).
   * Per-scenario jmax was washing absolute rollup $ gaps — live calendar/horizon
   * showed deltas while Exp6 strip tied at 1000.
   */
  function easyBuildScenarioGroupFromSnap(snap, shared, exp, into){
    var JGroupC = exp && exp.JGroup;
    var JActionC = exp && exp.JAction;
    var JoyCtor = exp && exp.Joy;
    if(!snap || !JGroupC || !JActionC || !JoyCtor) return null;
    var POS = Number.MIN_VALUE;
    var mixInto = into && into.group && into.joys;
    var moneyJmax = shared.moneyJmax;
    var happyJmax = shared.happyJmax;
    var daysJmax = shared.daysJmax || 1;
    var ageJmax = shared.ageJmax || 1;
    var extJmax = shared.extJmax || 1;
    var joys = mixInto ? into.joys : {};
    if(!mixInto){
      try {
        joys.M = new JoyCtor(moneyJmax, POS);
        joys.H = new JoyCtor(happyJmax, POS);
        joys.D = new JoyCtor(daysJmax, POS);
        joys.A = new JoyCtor(ageJmax, POS);
        joys.E = new JoyCtor(extJmax, POS);
      } catch(_j){ return null; }
    }
    function joyFor(id, amt){
      if(id === 'M' || id === 'money' || id === 'Money') return joys.M;
      if(id === 'H' || id === 'happy' || id === 'Happy') return joys.H;
      if(id === 'D' || id === 'days' || id === 'Days') return joys.D || joys.H;
      if(id === 'A' || id === 'age' || id === 'Age') return joys.A || joys.H;
      if(id === 'E' || id === 'external' || id === 'External') return joys.E || joys.H;
      if(!joys[id]){
        try { joys[id] = new JoyCtor(Math.max(Math.abs(amt)||0, 1), POS); }
        catch(_g){ joys[id] = joys.H; }
      }
      return joys[id];
    }
    var group;
    if(mixInto){
      group = into.group;
    } else {
      try { group = new JGroupC(); }
      catch(_g){ return null; }
      group.name = snap.label;
      group.__scenarioId = snap.sc;
      group.jatomic = true;
    }
    var n = 0;
    var jmDirect = easyMapJmethod('JDirect', exp);
    // Live rollup as first-class JFactor acts (same numbers as calendar horizon).
    var S = snap.summary || {};
    var living = Math.abs(Number(S.living) || 0);
    var debt = Math.abs(Number(S.debtPayments) || 0);
    var surplus = Number(S.surplus) || 0;
    var net = Number(S.net) || 0;
    try {
      var ds = snap.dimSum || {};
      // Spend living against shared money → happy (composite ranks mass as y)
      var jaLive = new JActionC(jmDirect, null, living, snap.happySum || 0, joys.M, joys.H);
      jaLive.__scenarioId = snap.sc; jaLive.__world = 'living';
      group.Consider(jaLive); n++;
      // Days / age / external ranked joys (not only H)
      var jaDays = new JActionC(jmDirect, null, Math.max(Number(ds.D)||0, living * 0.01), Math.max(Number(ds.D)||0, 0), joys.D, joys.H);
      jaDays.__scenarioId = snap.sc; jaDays.__world = 'days';
      group.Consider(jaDays); n++;
      var jaAge = new JActionC(jmDirect, null, Math.max(Number(ds.A)||0.01, 0.01), Math.max(Number(ds.E)||0, 0), joys.A, joys.E);
      jaAge.__scenarioId = snap.sc; jaAge.__world = 'age';
      group.Consider(jaAge); n++;
      var jaExt = new JActionC(jmDirect, null, Math.max((Number(ds.E)||0) * 0.05, 0.01), Math.max(Number(ds.E)||0, 0), joys.E, joys.H);
      jaExt.__scenarioId = snap.sc; jaExt.__world = 'external';
      group.Consider(jaExt); n++;
      var jaDebt = new JActionC(jmDirect, null, debt, 0, joys.M, joys.H);
      jaDebt.__scenarioId = snap.sc; jaDebt.__world = 'debt';
      group.Consider(jaDebt); n++;
      // Surplus: negative x = money gain in board convention; y tracks leftover joy
      var jaSur = new JActionC(jmDirect, null, -surplus, Math.max(surplus, 0), joys.M, joys.H);
      jaSur.__scenarioId = snap.sc; jaSur.__world = 'surplus';
      group.Consider(jaSur); n++;
      // Net income as money produce anchor
      var jaNet = new JActionC(jmDirect, null, -Math.abs(net), 0, joys.M, joys.H);
      jaNet.__scenarioId = snap.sc; jaNet.__world = 'net';
      group.Consider(jaNet); n++;
    } catch(_w){}
    (snap.built || []).forEach(function(b){
      var jm = easyMapJmethod(b.jmethod, exp);
      var jX = (b.kind === 'expense') ? joys.M : joyFor(b.from, b.x);
      var jY = (b.kind === 'expense') ? joys.H : joyFor(b.to, b.y);
      try {
        var ja = new JActionC(jm, null, b.x, b.y, jX, jY);
        ja.__boardId = b.id;
        ja.__scenarioId = snap.sc;
        group.Consider(ja);
        n++;
      } catch(_a){}
    });
    if(mixInto){
      return { sc: snap.sc, nActs: n, surplus: surplus, net: net, living: living, debt: debt };
    }
    try { group.SimulatedBest(); } catch(_s){}
    return {
      sc: snap.sc,
      label: snap.label,
      group: group,
      j: Number(group.j) || 0,
      nActs: n,
      summary: snap.summary,
      surplus: surplus,
      net: net,
      living: living,
      debt: debt
    };
  }

  /** Local score to pick one parallel-scenario variant of the same named item. */
  function easyMixLocalScore(c){
    if(!c) return -Infinity;
    var x = Math.abs(Number(c.x) || 0);
    var y = Math.abs(Number(c.y) || 0);
    if(c.world === 'surplus') return (Number(c.surplus) != null && isFinite(Number(c.surplus))) ? Number(c.surplus) : (Number(c.x) < 0 ? Math.abs(c.x) : y);
    if(c.world === 'net') return x;
    if(c.world === 'living' || c.world === 'debt' || c.world === 'days' || c.world === 'age' || c.world === 'external'){
      return y / (1 + x);
    }
    return y / (1 + x);
  }
  /** Identity key across CURRENT/PROJECTED/REVIEW parallel views (one real item). */
  function easyMixItemKey(c){
    if(!c) return '';
    if(c.world) return 'world:' + String(c.world).toLowerCase();
    var nm = String(c.name || c.label || c.boardId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if(!nm) return '';
    if(c.kind === 'joy') return 'joy:' + nm;
    return 'item:' + nm;
  }
  /**
   * Non-atomic mix: scenarios are parallel views of the same items.
   * Collect leaves → keep ONE per item name (best local score) tagged with source scenario
   * → SimulatedBest order is the optimal path (array left→right).
   */
  function easyBuildScenarioMix(snaps, shared, exp){
    var JGroupC = exp && exp.JGroup;
    var JActionC = exp && exp.JAction;
    var JoyCtor = exp && exp.Joy;
    if(!JGroupC || !JActionC || !JoyCtor || !snaps || !snaps.length) return null;
    var POS = Number.MIN_VALUE;
    var candidates = [];

    function pushCand(c){
      if(!c) return;
      var key = easyMixItemKey(c);
      if(!key) return;
      c.key = key;
      c.local = easyMixLocalScore(c);
      candidates.push(c);
    }

    snaps.forEach(function(snap){
      if(!snap) return;
      var sc = snap.sc;
      var S = snap.summary || {};
      var living = Math.abs(Number(S.living) || 0);
      var debt = Math.abs(Number(S.debtPayments) || 0);
      var surplus = Number(S.surplus) || 0;
      var net = Number(S.net) || 0;
      var ds = snap.dimSum || {};
      pushCand({ sc: sc, world: 'living', name: 'Living', kind: 'world', x: living, y: snap.happySum || 0, surplus: surplus });
      pushCand({ sc: sc, world: 'days', name: 'Days', kind: 'world', x: Math.max(Number(ds.D)||0, living * 0.01), y: Math.max(Number(ds.D)||0, 0), surplus: surplus });
      pushCand({ sc: sc, world: 'age', name: 'Age', kind: 'world', x: Math.max(Number(ds.A)||0.01, 0.01), y: Math.max(Number(ds.E)||0, 0), surplus: surplus });
      pushCand({ sc: sc, world: 'external', name: 'External', kind: 'world', x: Math.max((Number(ds.E)||0) * 0.05, 0.01), y: Math.max(Number(ds.E)||0, 0), surplus: surplus });
      pushCand({ sc: sc, world: 'debt', name: 'Debt', kind: 'world', x: debt, y: 0, surplus: surplus });
      pushCand({ sc: sc, world: 'surplus', name: 'Surplus', kind: 'world', x: -surplus, y: Math.max(surplus, 0), surplus: surplus });
      pushCand({ sc: sc, world: 'net', name: 'Net', kind: 'world', x: -Math.abs(net), y: 0, surplus: surplus });
      (snap.built || []).forEach(function(b){
        if(!b) return;
        var label = b.name || b.id || '';
        pushCand({
          sc: sc,
          kind: b.kind || 'expense',
          name: label,
          label: label,
          boardId: b.id || label,
          x: b.x,
          y: b.y,
          jmethod: b.jmethod || 'JDirect',
          from: b.from,
          to: b.to,
          surplus: surplus
        });
      });
    });

    var byName = {};
    candidates.forEach(function(c){
      var k = c.key;
      if(!byName[k]) byName[k] = [];
      byName[k].push(c);
    });
    var winners = [];
    Object.keys(byName).forEach(function(k){
      var list = byName[k].slice().sort(function(a, b){
        if(b.local !== a.local) return b.local - a.local;
        var ds = (Number(b.surplus)||0) - (Number(a.surplus)||0);
        if(ds) return ds;
        return SC_ORDER.indexOf(a.sc) - SC_ORDER.indexOf(b.sc);
      });
      var w = list[0];
      w.__fromGroup = w.sc;
      w.__alts = list.map(function(x){ return x.sc; });
      winners.push(w);
    });

    var parent;
    try { parent = new JGroupC(); }
    catch(_g){ return null; }
    parent.name = 'scenario_mix';
    parent.jatomic = false;
    var joys = {};
    try {
      joys.M = new JoyCtor(shared.moneyJmax || 1, POS);
      joys.H = new JoyCtor(shared.happyJmax || 1, POS);
      joys.D = new JoyCtor(shared.daysJmax || 1, POS);
      joys.A = new JoyCtor(shared.ageJmax || 1, POS);
      joys.E = new JoyCtor(shared.extJmax || 1, POS);
    } catch(_j){ return null; }
    function joyFor(id, amt){
      if(id === 'M' || id === 'money' || id === 'Money') return joys.M;
      if(id === 'H' || id === 'happy' || id === 'Happy') return joys.H;
      if(id === 'D' || id === 'days' || id === 'Days') return joys.D || joys.H;
      if(id === 'A' || id === 'age' || id === 'Age') return joys.A || joys.H;
      if(id === 'E' || id === 'external' || id === 'External') return joys.E || joys.H;
      if(!joys[id]){
        try { joys[id] = new JoyCtor(Math.max(Math.abs(amt)||0, 1), POS); }
        catch(_g){ joys[id] = joys.H; }
      }
      return joys[id];
    }
    var jmDirect = easyMapJmethod('JDirect', exp);
    var n = 0;
    winners.forEach(function(w){
      try {
        var jm = w.jmethod ? easyMapJmethod(w.jmethod, exp) : jmDirect;
        var jX, jY;
        if(w.world || w.kind === 'expense' || w.kind === 'work' || w.kind === 'world'){
          if(w.world === 'days'){ jX = joys.D; jY = joys.H; }
          else if(w.world === 'age'){ jX = joys.A; jY = joys.E; }
          else if(w.world === 'external'){ jX = joys.E; jY = joys.H; }
          else { jX = joys.M; jY = joys.H; }
        } else {
          jX = joyFor(w.from || 'H', w.x);
          jY = joyFor(w.to || 'M', w.y);
        }
        var ja = new JActionC(jm || jmDirect, null, w.x, w.y, jX, jY);
        ja.__scenarioId = w.sc;
        ja.__fromGroup = w.sc;
        ja.__mixName = w.name || w.world || w.key;
        ja.__mixKey = w.key;
        ja.__world = w.world || null;
        ja.__boardId = w.boardId || null;
        ja.__alts = w.__alts || [w.sc];
        try { ja.name = String(w.name || w.world || w.key || 'item'); } catch(_n){}
        parent.Consider(ja);
        n++;
      } catch(_a){}
    });

    var sim = null;
    try { sim = parent.SimulatedBest(); } catch(_s){ sim = null; }
    if(!(sim && sim.length)){
      try { sim = parent.Best(); } catch(_b){ sim = null; }
    }
    var steps = [];
    var seenSc = {};
    (sim || []).forEach(function(ja, idx){
      if(!ja) return;
      var sc = ja.__fromGroup || ja.__scenarioId || null;
      var world = ja.__world || null;
      var label = ja.__mixName || world || ja.__boardId || ja.name || ('step '+(idx+1));
      if(world) label = world.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + world.slice(1);
      var scLab = sc ? (SC_LABEL[sc] || sc) : '?';
      if(sc) seenSc[sc] = (seenSc[sc] || 0) + 1;
      steps.push({
        i: idx + 1,
        sc: sc,
        scLabel: scLab,
        fromGroup: sc,
        world: world,
        boardId: ja.__boardId || null,
        mixKey: ja.__mixKey || null,
        alts: ja.__alts || (sc ? [sc] : []),
        label: String(label),
        x: Number(ja.x) || 0,
        y: Number(ja.y) || 0
      });
    });
    var mixSeq = [];
    steps.forEach(function(s){
      if(s.sc && mixSeq.indexOf(s.sc) < 0) mixSeq.push(s.sc);
    });
    return {
      steps: steps,
      mixSeq: mixSeq,
      scCounts: seenSc,
      j: Number(parent.j) || 0,
      nActs: n,
      nCands: candidates.length,
      nUnique: winners.length,
      nSteps: steps.length,
      group: parent,
      source: 'exp6-mix-dedupe'
    };
  }

  /** Rank CURRENT / PROJECTED / REVIEW as Exp6 jgroups for the calendar decision strip. */
  function easyScenarioJOptions(){
    _easyJgCache = null;
    _easyJgAt = -1;
    var exp = easyExp6();
    var JGroupC = exp && exp.JGroup;
    var snaps = [];
    SC_ORDER.forEach(function(sc){
      try { snaps.push(easyScenarioSnap(sc)); }
      catch(_e){ snaps.push({ sc: sc, label: SC_LABEL[sc]||sc, summary:{}, built:[], nActs:0, happySum:0, costSum:0 }); }
    });
    // SHARED capacities — max across scenarios so absolute rollup deltas survive JFactor.
    var moneyJmax = 1, happyJmax = 1, daysJmax = 1, ageJmax = 1, extJmax = 1;
    snaps.forEach(function(s){
      var S = s.summary || {};
      var need = Math.max(
        Math.abs(Number(S.net)||0),
        Math.abs(Number(S.living)||0) + Math.abs(Number(S.debtPayments)||0),
        Math.abs(Number(S.surplus)||0),
        Number(s.costSum)||0,
        1
      );
      if(need > moneyJmax) moneyJmax = need;
      var hh = Math.max(Number(s.happySum)||0, 1);
      if(hh > happyJmax) happyJmax = hh;
      var ds = s.dimSum || {};
      if(Math.max(Number(ds.D)||0, 1) > daysJmax) daysJmax = Math.max(Number(ds.D)||0, 1);
      if(Math.max(Number(ds.A)||0, 1) > ageJmax) ageJmax = Math.max(Number(ds.A)||0, 1);
      if(Math.max(Number(ds.E)||0, 1) > extJmax) extJmax = Math.max(Number(ds.E)||0, 1);
    });
    var shared = { moneyJmax: moneyJmax, happyJmax: happyJmax, daysJmax: daysJmax, ageJmax: ageJmax, extJmax: extJmax };
    var opts = [];
    snaps.forEach(function(snap){
      var built = null;
      try { built = easyBuildScenarioGroupFromSnap(snap, shared, exp); } catch(_e){ built = null; }
      if(built) opts.push(built);
      else opts.push({
        sc: snap.sc, label: snap.label, group: null, j: 0, nActs: 0,
        summary: snap.summary, surplus: (snap.summary&&snap.summary.surplus)||0,
        net: (snap.summary&&snap.summary.net)||0,
        living: (snap.summary&&snap.summary.living)||0,
        debt: (snap.summary&&snap.summary.debtPayments)||0
      });
    });
    var sequence = opts.map(function(o){ return o.sc; });
    var mix = null;
    if(JGroupC){
      try {
        // Whole-scenario order (atomic children) — still useful for strip ranking.
        var parent = new JGroupC();
        parent.name = 'scenarios';
        parent.jatomic = false;
        opts.forEach(function(o){ if(o.group) parent.Consider(o.group); });
        var sim = parent.SimulatedBest();
        if(sim && sim.length){
          var seq = [];
          sim.forEach(function(node){
            var id = node && node.__scenarioId;
            if(!id && node && node.name){
              for(var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++){
                if(opts[i].label === node.name || opts[i].sc === node.name){ id = opts[i].sc; break; }
              }
            }
            if(id && seq.indexOf(id) < 0) seq.push(id);
          });
          if(seq.length) sequence = seq;
        }
      } catch(_p){}
      // True interweave: non-atomic leaf mix across CURRENT / PROJECTED / REVIEW.
      try { mix = easyBuildScenarioMix(snaps, shared, exp); } catch(_m){ mix = null; }
      if(mix && mix.mixSeq && mix.mixSeq.length){
        // Prefer mix's first-seen scenario order when it found a path.
        sequence = mix.mixSeq.slice();
        opts.forEach(function(o){ if(sequence.indexOf(o.sc) < 0) sequence.push(o.sc); });
      }
    }
    var maxJ = -Infinity, minJ = Infinity;
    opts.forEach(function(o){
      var jj = Number(o.j) || 0;
      o.j = jj;
      if(jj > maxJ) maxJ = jj;
      if(jj < minJ) minJ = jj;
    });
    if(!isFinite(maxJ)) maxJ = 0;
    if(!isFinite(minJ)) minJ = 0;
    var spread = maxJ - minJ;
    var tied = !(spread > 1e-9);
    var byJ = opts.slice().sort(function(a, b){
      if(b.j !== a.j) return b.j - a.j;
      // surplus as honest secondary when j still flat
      var ds = (Number(b.surplus)||0) - (Number(a.surplus)||0);
      if(ds) return ds;
      return SC_ORDER.indexOf(a.sc) - SC_ORDER.indexOf(b.sc);
    });
    var jSeq = byJ.map(function(o){ return o.sc; });
    if(tied || !sequence.length) sequence = jSeq;
    else {
      var merged = sequence.slice();
      jSeq.forEach(function(sc){ if(merged.indexOf(sc) < 0) merged.push(sc); });
      sequence = merged;
    }
    // If Exp6 j still tied but rollup surplus differs, use surplus for relative strip.
    var maxSur = -Infinity, minSur = Infinity;
    opts.forEach(function(o){
      var s = Number(o.surplus);
      if(!isFinite(s)) s = 0;
      o.surplus = s;
      if(s > maxSur) maxSur = s;
      if(s < minSur) minSur = s;
    });
    var surSpread = maxSur - minSur;
    var useSurplus = tied && (surSpread > 0.005);
    if(useSurplus){
      tied = false;
      sequence = opts.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return b.surplus - a.surplus; }).map(function(o){ return o.sc; });
    }
    var bySc = {};
    opts.forEach(function(o){
      if(useSurplus){
        o.rel01 = surSpread > 0 ? (o.surplus - minSur) / surSpread : 1;
        o.rating1000 = easyClampRating(o.rel01);
        o.tied = false;
        o.deltaJ = o.surplus - maxSur;
        o.scoreBasis = 'surplus';
      } else if(tied){
        o.rel01 = 1;
        o.rating1000 = 1000;
        o.tied = true;
        o.deltaJ = 0;
        o.scoreBasis = 'tied';
      } else {
        o.rel01 = (o.j - minJ) / spread;
        o.rating1000 = easyClampRating(o.rel01);
        o.tied = false;
        o.deltaJ = o.j - maxJ;
        o.scoreBasis = 'exp6';
      }
      bySc[o.sc] = o;
    });
    var ranked = [];
    sequence.forEach(function(sc, i){
      var o = bySc[sc] || { sc: sc, label: SC_LABEL[sc]||sc, j: 0, rel01: 0, rating1000: 0, nActs: 0, tied: true, deltaJ: 0 };
      o.rank = i + 1;
      ranked.push(o);
    });
    opts.forEach(function(o){
      if(sequence.indexOf(o.sc) < 0){
        o.rank = ranked.length + 1;
        ranked.push(o);
      }
    });
    var uniqueBest = !tied && ranked.length && (
      useSurplus
        ? ranked[0].surplus >= maxSur - 1e-9
        : ranked[0].j >= maxJ - 1e-12
    );
    _easyJgCache = {
      options: ranked,
      sequence: sequence,
      best: uniqueBest ? ranked[0].sc : null,
      tied: tied,
      maxJ: maxJ,
      minJ: minJ,
      moneyJmax: moneyJmax,
      happyJmax: happyJmax,
      scoreBasis: useSurplus ? 'surplus' : (tied ? 'tied' : 'exp6'),
      source: JGroupC ? 'exp6' : 'fallback',
      mix: mix
    };
    _easyJgAt = _easyBestTick;
    return _easyJgCache;
  }

  function easyJgBarHtml(){
    var pack = easyScenarioJOptions();
    var cur = activeSc();
    var basis = pack.scoreBasis || 'exp6';
    var html = '<div class="easy-jg-bar" id="easy-jg-bar" title="Same sim as calendar rollup (active scenario $ + calendar). Scores use shared Joy capacity across scenarios so absolute surplus gaps count.">';
    html += '<span class="easy-jg-label">Exp6</span>';
    (pack.options || []).forEach(function(o){
      var active = o.sc === cur;
      var sur = Math.round((Number(o.surplus)||0)*100)/100;
      var title = o.label+' · rank '+o.rank+(o.tied?' · tied':'')+' · '+o.rating1000+'/1000 · j='+(Math.round((o.j||0)*1000)/1000)+' · surplus '+sur+' · net '+(Math.round((Number(o.net)||0)*100)/100)+' · '+o.nActs+' acts · basis '+basis;
      html += '<button type="button" class="pill easy-jg-opt'+(active?' active':'')+'" data-easy-jg="'+esc(o.sc)+'" title="'+esc(title)+'">';
      html += esc(o.label);
      html += ' <span class="easy-jg-score">'+o.rating1000+'</span>';
      html += ' <span class="easy-jg-sur">'+(sur>=0?'+':'')+sur+'</span>';
      if(pack.tied) html += ' <span class="easy-jg-best">tied</span>';
      else if(pack.best && o.sc === pack.best) html += ' <span class="easy-jg-best">best</span>';
      html += '</button>';
    });
    if(pack.tied){
      html += '<span class="easy-jg-seq">Tied — rollup $ and calendars match across scenarios</span>';
    } else {
      var seqLabel = (pack.sequence || []).map(function(sc){ return SC_LABEL[sc] || sc; }).join(' → ');
      var basisNote = basis === 'surplus' ? ' (surplus)' : '';
      if(seqLabel) html += '<span class="easy-jg-seq">Scenario order'+basisNote+': '+esc(seqLabel)+'</span>';
    }
    html += '</div>';
    html += easyMixPathHtml(pack);
    return html;
  }

  function easyMixPathHtml(pack){
    pack = pack || easyScenarioJOptions();
    var mix = pack && pack.mix;
    var html = '<div class="easy-mix-bar" id="easy-mix-bar" title="Optimal mix order (JGroup array left→right). Items deduped by name across CURRENT/PROJECTED/REVIEW; each step tagged with the source scenario kept.">';
    html += '<span class="easy-jg-label">Mix</span>';
    if(!(mix && mix.steps && mix.steps.length)){
      html += '<span class="easy-jg-seq">No optimal path yet</span>';
      html += '</div>';
      return html;
    }
    var uniq = (mix.nUnique != null) ? mix.nUnique : mix.nActs;
    var dropped = (mix.nCands != null && uniq != null) ? Math.max(0, mix.nCands - uniq) : 0;
    html += '<span class="easy-mix-meta">'+esc(mix.nSteps+' in order')+(uniq!=null?(' · '+uniq+' unique'):'')+(dropped?(' · −'+dropped+' dupes'):'')+' · j='+(Math.round((mix.j||0)*1000)/1000)+'</span>';
    html += '<div class="easy-mix-steps" aria-label="Optimal mix order">';
    mix.steps.forEach(function(s, idx){
      if(idx > 0) html += '<span class="easy-mix-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span>';
      var lab = s.label || s.boardId || 'act';
      if(lab && lab.length > 32) lab = lab.slice(0, 30)+'…';
      var tip = (s.scLabel||'?')+' kept · '+s.label+(s.alts && s.alts.length > 1 ? (' · also saw '+s.alts.map(function(a){ return SC_LABEL[a]||a; }).join('/')) : '')+' · x='+s.x+' y='+s.y;
      html += '<span class="easy-mix-step" data-easy-mix-sc="'+esc(s.sc||'')+'" title="'+esc(tip)+'">';
      html += '<b>'+esc(s.scLabel || '?')+'</b> '+esc(lab);
      html += '</span>';
    });
    html += '</div></div>';
    return html;
  }

  function easyBestRankFresh(){
    _easyBestTick++;
    _easyJgAt = -1;
    return easyBestRank();
  }
  function easyBestRank(){
    if(_easyBestCache && _easyBestAt === _easyBestTick) return _easyBestCache;
    _easyBestCache = easyComputeBestRank();
    _easyBestAt = _easyBestTick;
    return _easyBestCache;
  }
  function easyComputeBestRank(){
    var acts = easyScheduleActions();
    var ranks = null;
    try { ranks = calcRanks(); } catch(_r){ ranks = { items: [], byName: {} }; }
    var cmp = easyFallbackCmp(ranks);
    function finish(order, source){
      var byId = {};
      for(var i = 0; i < order.length; i++){
        var a = order[i];
        if(!a) continue;
        var id = a.id || a.name;
        var pred = i > 0 ? order[i - 1] : null;
        var score01 = easyScore01Of(a, ranks);
        byId[id] = {
          rank: i + 1,
          score01: score01,
          rating1000: easyClampRating(score01),
          predId: pred ? (pred.id || pred.name) : null,
          predName: pred ? pred.name : null
        };
      }
      return { order: order, byId: byId, source: source };
    }
    function ranksOrder(){
      return finish(acts.slice().sort(cmp), 'ranks');
    }
    if(!acts.length) return finish([], 'ranks');
    var exp = easyExp6();
    var JGroupC = exp && exp.JGroup;
    var JActionC = exp && exp.JAction;
    var JoyCtor = exp && exp.Joy;
    if(!JGroupC || !JActionC || !JoyCtor) return ranksOrder();

    var incomeNet = 0;
    try { incomeNet = Number(calcIncome().net) || 0; } catch(_i){}
    var expItems = [];
    try { expItems = easyExpenseItems() || []; } catch(_e){}
    var expAmt = {};
    expItems.forEach(function(it){ if(it && it.name) expAmt[it.name] = Number(it.amount) || 0; });

    var POS = Number.MIN_VALUE;
    var moneyNeed = 0, happyNeed = 0, maxCost = 0;
    var joyNeed = {};
    function addJoyNeed(id, amt){
      if(!id) return;
      joyNeed[id] = (joyNeed[id] || 0) + Math.abs(Number(amt) || 0);
    }
    var built = [];
    acts.forEach(function(act){
      if(!act) return;
      var id = act.id || act.name;
      var name = easyExpenseNameOf(act);
      var row = ranks.byName && ranks.byName[name];
      var isExp = !!(act.expenseName || row);
      if(isExp && !easyIsJoyAct(act)){
        var cost = 0;
        if(row && row.cost != null) cost = Number(row.cost) || 0;
        else if(expAmt[name] != null) cost = Number(expAmt[name]) || 0;
        var yAmt = 0;
        if(row){
          if(row.scoreRaw != null && isFinite(Number(row.scoreRaw))) yAmt = Number(row.scoreRaw) || 0;
          else yAmt = Number(row.score) || 0;
        }
        moneyNeed += Math.abs(cost);
        happyNeed += Math.abs(yAmt);
        if(Math.abs(cost) > maxCost) maxCost = Math.abs(cost);
        if(row){
          addJoyNeed('D', row.D);
          addJoyNeed('A', row.A);
          addJoyNeed('E', row.E);
          addJoyNeed('H', row.H || yAmt);
        }
        built.push({ act: act, id: id, kind: 'expense', x: cost, y: yAmt, jmethod: act.jmethod || 'JDirect',
          jreqId: act.jreqId || null,
          spanDays: (typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(act) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(act.spanDays)||1)),
          dims: row ? { H: row.H, D: row.D, A: row.A, M: row.M || cost, E: row.E, scoreRaw: yAmt } : null });
        return;
      }
      if(easyIsJoyAct(act)){
        var x = act.x != null ? Number(act.x) : Number(act.joyFromAmt);
        var yv = act.y != null ? Number(act.y) : Number(act.joyToAmt);
        if(!isFinite(x)) x = 0;
        if(!isFinite(yv)) yv = 0;
        addJoyNeed(act.joyFrom || act.joyId || 'H', x);
        addJoyNeed(act.joyTo || 'M', yv);
        built.push({ act: act, id: id, kind: 'joy', x: x, y: yv, jmethod: act.jmethod || 'JDirect', from: act.joyFrom || act.joyId || 'H', to: act.joyTo || 'M', jreqId: act.jreqId || null, spanDays: (typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(act) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(act.spanDays)||1)) });
        return;
      }
      // Schedule-only / work / rhythm: tiny H→H so they exist for jreq targets (esp. Sleep).
      var ox = 0.01, oy = 0.01;
      var spanSig = (typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(act) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(act.spanDays)||1));
      if(act.kind === 'work'){
        try {
          var fm = (typeof easyFocusMonth === 'function') ? easyFocusMonth() : null;
          if(fm && typeof easyWeekdaySpanInMonth === 'function'){
            spanSig = Math.max(spanSig, easyWeekdaySpanInMonth(fm.y, fm.m) || spanSig);
          }
        } catch(_ws){}
        addJoyNeed('D', spanSig);
        ox = Math.max(spanSig, 0.01);
        oy = Math.max(spanSig, 0.001);
      } else if(spanSig > 1){
        addJoyNeed('D', spanSig);
        ox = Math.max(spanSig, 0.01);
        oy = Math.max(spanSig, 0.001);
      }
      built.push({ act: act, id: id, kind: 'other', x: ox, y: oy, jmethod: 'JDirect', from: act.kind === 'work' || spanSig > 1 ? 'D' : 'H', to: 'H', jreqId: act.jreqId || null, rhythm: act.rhythm || null, spanDays: spanSig });
    });

    var moneyJmax = incomeNet > 0 ? incomeNet : moneyNeed;
    if(moneyJmax < maxCost) moneyJmax = maxCost;
    if(!(moneyJmax > 0)) moneyJmax = 1;
    else if(!(incomeNet > 0) && moneyNeed > 0) moneyJmax = moneyNeed + 1e-6;
    var happyJmax = happyNeed > 0 ? (happyNeed + 1e-6) : 1;
    if(joyNeed.M) moneyJmax = Math.max(moneyJmax, joyNeed.M);
    if(joyNeed.H) happyJmax = Math.max(happyJmax, joyNeed.H);

    var joys = {};
    try {
      joys.M = new JoyCtor(moneyJmax, POS);
      joys.H = new JoyCtor(happyJmax, POS);
    } catch(_j){
      return ranksOrder();
    }
    function joyFor(id, amt){
      if(id === 'M' || id === 'money' || id === 'Money') return joys.M;
      if(id === 'H' || id === 'happy' || id === 'Happy') return joys.H;
      if(!joys[id]){
        var need = Math.max(joyNeed[id] || 0, Math.abs(amt) || 0, 1);
        try { joys[id] = new JoyCtor(need, POS); }
        catch(_g){ joys[id] = joys.H; }
      }
      return joys[id];
    }

    var group;
    try { group = new JGroupC(); }
    catch(_g){ return ranksOrder(); }

    // Phase 1: create all JActions with null jreq; index by board id for wiring.
    var byBoardId = Object.create(null);
    var jaAll = [];
    built.forEach(function(b){
      var jm = easyMapJmethod(b.jmethod || 'JDirect', exp);
      var jX, jY;
      if(b.kind === 'expense'){
        jX = joys.M;
        jY = joys.H;
      } else {
        jX = joyFor(b.from || 'H', b.x);
        jY = joyFor(b.to || 'H', b.y);
      }
      var companions = [];
      try {
        var ja = new JActionC(jm, null, b.x, b.y, jX, jY);
        ja.__boardId = b.id;
        if(b.rhythm) ja.__rhythm = b.rhythm;
        group.Consider(ja);
        jaAll.push(ja);
        byBoardId[b.id] = ja;
      } catch(_a){}
      // Companion ranked-joy acts so SimulatedBest sees D/A/E, not only M→H.
      if(b.kind === 'expense' && b.dims){
        try {
          var d = b.dims;
          if(Number(d.D) > 0){
            var jaD = new JActionC(jm, null, Math.max(Number(d.D), 0.01), Math.max(Number(d.D), 0.001), joyFor('D', d.D), joys.H);
            jaD.__boardId = b.id; group.Consider(jaD); companions.push(jaD); jaAll.push(jaD);
          }
          if(Number(d.E) > 0){
            var jaE = new JActionC(jm, null, Math.max(Number(d.E)*0.05, 0.01), Math.max(Number(d.E), 0.001), joyFor('E', d.E), joys.H);
            jaE.__boardId = b.id; group.Consider(jaE); companions.push(jaE); jaAll.push(jaE);
          }
          if(Number(d.A) > 0){
            var jaA = new JActionC(jm, null, Math.max(Math.min(Number(d.A), 1), 0.01), 0.01, joyFor('A', d.A), joyFor('E', d.E||1));
            jaA.__boardId = b.id; group.Consider(jaA); companions.push(jaA); jaAll.push(jaA);
          }
        } catch(_dim){}
      }
      // Span length → Days joy companion (longer/shorter span participates in Best).
      try {
        var spanN = (b.spanDays != null) ? Number(b.spanDays) : ((b.act && typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(b.act) : 1);
        if(!(spanN >= 1)) spanN = 1;
        if(b.act && b.act.kind === 'work' && typeof easyWeekdaySpanInMonth === 'function'){
          try {
            var fmw = (typeof easyFocusMonth === 'function') ? easyFocusMonth() : null;
            if(fmw) spanN = Math.max(spanN, easyWeekdaySpanInMonth(fmw.y, fmw.m) || spanN);
          } catch(_fw){}
        }
        if(spanN > 1 || (b.act && b.act.kind === 'work')){
          var jaSpan = new JActionC(jm, null, Math.max(spanN, 0.01), Math.max(spanN, 0.001), joyFor('D', spanN), joys.H);
          jaSpan.__boardId = b.id;
          jaSpan.__spanDays = spanN;
          group.Consider(jaSpan);
          companions.push(jaSpan);
          jaAll.push(jaSpan);
        }
      } catch(_sp){}
      b.__companions = companions;
    });
    // Phase 2: wire Exp6 identity jreq references (and inherit onto companions).
    built.forEach(function(b){
      if(!b || !b.jreqId) return;
      var req = byBoardId[b.jreqId];
      if(!req){
        // Name fallback: find built entry whose act name/id matches jreqId
        for(var bi=0; bi<built.length; bi++){
          var bb = built[bi];
          if(!bb) continue;
          if(bb.id === b.jreqId || (bb.act && (bb.act.id === b.jreqId || bb.act.name === b.jreqId))){
            req = byBoardId[bb.id];
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if(!req) return;
      var primary = byBoardId[b.id];
      if(primary) primary.jreq = req;
      (b.__companions || []).forEach(function(c){ if(c) c.jreq = req; });
    });

    function mapOption(option, source){
      var byBoard = {};
      acts.forEach(function(a){ if(a) byBoard[a.id || a.name] = a; });
      var order = [];
      var seen = Object.create(null);
      (option || []).forEach(function(ja){
        var bid = ja && ja.__boardId;
        if(!bid || seen[bid] || !byBoard[bid]) return;
        seen[bid] = 1;
        order.push(byBoard[bid]);
      });
      if(!order.length) return null;
      var rest = acts.filter(function(a){ return a && !seen[a.id || a.name]; });
      rest.sort(cmp);
      return finish(order.concat(rest), source);
    }

    try {
      var sim = group.SimulatedBest();
      if(sim && sim.length){
        var mapped = mapOption(sim, 'sim');
        if(mapped) return mapped;
      }
    } catch(_s){}

    try {
      var bestOpt = group.Best();
      if(bestOpt && bestOpt.length){
        var mappedB = mapOption(bestOpt, 'best');
        if(mappedB) return mappedB;
      }
    } catch(_b){}

    return ranksOrder();
  }

  function renderEasyMonth(){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var y = easyCal.y, m = easyCal.m;
    var dim = (RC && RC.daysInMonth) ? RC.daysInMonth(y, m) : 31;
    var firstDow = new Date(y, m, 1).getDay();
    var monthName = (RC && RC.MONTH_NAMES) ? RC.MONTH_NAMES[m] : ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][m];
    var best = easyBestRankFresh();
    var placeForView = easyFindAct(easyCal.placeAct) || (best.order && best.order[0]) || null;
    best = easyApplyViewRatings(best, easyCalViewScope(), placeForView);
    // Day chips = placed calendar acts (SoT). Best order only ranks/highlights —
    // expense $ edits reshuffle Best and used to hide chips ("calendar clears").
    var placed = [];
    try {
      placed = (typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function' ? easyScheduleActions() : []) || [];
    } catch(_pl){ placed = []; }
    if(!placed.length){
      try { placed = (typeof getCalendarCustomActions === 'function' ? getCalendarCustomActions() : []) || []; } catch(_g){}
    }
    placed = placed.filter(function(a){ return a && (typeof easyActOnCalendar !== 'function' || easyActOnCalendar(a)); });
    var acts = placed.length ? placed : ((best.order && best.order.length) ? best.order.slice() : []);
    var today = new Date();
    var monthSel = easySelList().filter(function(p){ return p.y===y && p.m===m; }).sort(function(a,b){ return a.d-b.d; });
    var startD = monthSel.length ? monthSel[0].d : 0;
    var endD = monthSel.length ? monthSel[monthSel.length-1].d : 0;
    var placeAct = easyFindAct(easyCal.placeAct) || (acts[0] || null);
    var placeInfo = placeAct ? (best.byId[placeAct.id || placeAct.name] || null) : null;
    var predAct = (placeInfo && placeInfo.predId) ? easyFindAct(placeInfo.predId) : null;
    var predDate = predAct ? easyEarliestOccur(predAct) : null;
    if(!predDate){
      var nowCst = easyNowCST();
      predDate = { y: nowCst.y, m: nowCst.m, d: nowCst.d };
    }
    var tabRating = placeInfo ? placeInfo.rating1000 : 0;
    var tabPredName = (placeInfo && placeInfo.predName) ? placeInfo.predName : 'today';
    var html = '<div class="easy-month" id="easy-month">';
    html += easyJgBarHtml();
    html += '<div class="easy-month-bar">';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn" data-easy-nav="-1">‹</button>';
    html += '<h2 class="easy-month-title">'+esc(monthName)+(easyCal.allYears ? ' · all years' : ' '+y)+'</h2>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn" data-easy-nav="1">›</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn" data-easy-today>Today</button>';
    (function(){
      var ja = null;
      try { ja = (typeof easyFindAct === 'function' && easyCal.placeAct) ? easyFindAct(easyCal.placeAct) : null; } catch(_ja){}
      var jn = ja ? (ja.name || easyCal.placeAct) : '';
      var jTitle = jn
        ? ('Jump to a day where Suggest places “'+jn+'”')
        : 'Select a Board item first, then jump to a day where Suggest places it';
      var jLab = jn ? ('Jump · '+jn) : 'Jump to Suggest';
      var jCls = 'btn'+(jn ? '' : ' easy-jump-need-sel');
      html += '<button type="button" class="'+jCls+'" data-easy-jump-suggest title="'+esc(jTitle)+'">'+esc(jLab)+'</button>';
    })();
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+(easyCal.allYears?' active':'')+'" data-easy-allyears title="Use this month as the template for every year">All years</button>';
    if(easyCal.allYears) html += '<span class="easy-year-ghost">'+y+' weekdays</span>';
    var selN = easySelList().filter(function(p){ return p.y===y && p.m===m; }).length;
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn" data-easy-copymonth title="Replace this month with the previous month">Copy previous month</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn" data-easy-copyyear title="Stamp this year onto later years in the horizon">Copy year</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn" data-easy-clearcal title="Remove calendar placements, Work, spends, Wake/Sleep. Set cleared so Work will not auto-return.">Clear calendar</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="easy-phone-batch" title="Fill CURRENT/PROJECTED/REVIEW for every horizon year via monthly/weekdays/daily cadences — no mirror, no EXPENSES edits">Phone batch v6: fill all years</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="easy-fill-gaps" data-easy-fill-gaps title="Fill missing musts/rituals across the calendar horizon into empty gaps only. Never clears or wipes existing placements. Safe / idempotent.">Fill gaps</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="easy-seed-morning-canvas" data-easy-seed-morning-canvas title="Idempotent: add Deep work / Admin batch / Protect canvas to the Board only (not placed on calendar). Soft-saves.">Seed morning canvas to Board</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn'+(selN?'':' dim')+'" data-easy-delete title="Clear selected days">Delete</button>';
    if(selN) html += '<span class="easy-year-ghost">'+selN+' day'+(selN===1?'':'s')+'</span>';
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<div class="easy-dows">';
    ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'].forEach(function(d){ html += '<div class="easy-dow">'+d+'</div>'; });
    html += '</div>';
    var ghostPlan = (typeof easySelGhostPlan === 'function') ? easySelGhostPlan(best) : null;
    if(ghostPlan && ghostPlan.days && ghostPlan.days.length){
      html += '<div class="easy-ghost-banner" title="Suggested schedule — Accept to commit onto the calendar">';
      html += '<b>Suggest</b> '+(ghostPlan.nGhost||0)+' across '+ghostPlan.days.length+' day'+(ghostPlan.days.length===1?'':'s')+' · ranks+Board→plan'+(ghostPlan.toPlace!=null?(' · pool '+ghostPlan.toPlace):'');
      html += ' · ≤'+(ghostPlan.maxPerDay||0)+'/day';
      if(ghostPlan.overflow){
        var jn = 0, bn = 0, an = 0, tn = 0;
        (ghostPlan.overflowList || []).forEach(function(o){
          if(!o) return;
          if(o.reason === 'jreq') jn++;
          else if(o.reason === 'afford') an++;
          else if(o.reason === 'time') tn++;
          else bn++;
        });
        var oBits = [];
        if(an){
          var stockHint = '';
          try {
            var ao = (ghostPlan.overflowList || []).filter(function(o){ return o && o.reason === 'afford'; })[0];
            if(ao && ao.capitalNeed != null){
              stockHint = ' (stock $'+Math.round(Number(ao.stock)||0)+' / need $'+Math.round(Number(ao.capitalNeed)||0)+' · mo+'+Math.round(Number(ao.monthIndex)||0)+')';
            }
          } catch(_sh){}
          oBits.push(an+' waiting on afford'+stockHint);
        }
        if(jn) oBits.push(jn+' waiting on jreq');
        if(tn) oBits.push(tn+' waiting on time');
        if(bn) oBits.push(bn+' need more days or shorter blocks');
        html += ' · <span class="easy-ghost-overflow">'+(oBits.join(' · ') || (ghostPlan.overflow+' overflow'))+'</span>';
      } else if(!(ghostPlan.nGhost) && !(ghostPlan.toPlace)) html += ' · no Best sequence to suggest';
      html += ' · Wake/Sleep on each selected day · Board has the schedule';

      // What Best/ranks are appetizing (even if not all packed into ghosts)
      try {
        var appetBits = [];
        var ranksA = (typeof calcRanks === 'function') ? calcRanks() : null;
        var itemsA = (ranksA && ranksA.items) ? ranksA.items.slice() : [];
        itemsA.sort(function(a,b){ return (Number(b.score)||0) - (Number(a.score)||0); });
        itemsA.slice(0, 8).forEach(function(it){
          if(!it || !it.name) return;
          var sc = Math.round((Number(it.score)||0) * 1000);
          appetBits.push(esc(it.name)+' '+sc);
        });
        if(appetBits.length){
          var appetWhen = [];
          (ghostPlan.suggest || []).forEach(function(g){
            if(!g || !g.appetizing || !g.act) return;
            var nm = g.act.name || '';
            var clock = (g.startLabel && g.endLabel) ? (g.startLabel+'-'+g.endLabel) : '';
            var dd = g.day ? ((g.day.m+1)+'/'+g.day.d) : '';
            if(nm && clock) appetWhen.push(esc(nm)+' '+dd+' '+clock);
          });
          html += '<div class="easy-appet-banner" title="calcRanks composite appetizing — times are ghosted onto selected calendar hours">appetizing · '+appetBits.join(' · ');
          if(appetWhen.length) html += '<div class="easy-appet-when">'+appetWhen.slice(0, 16).join(' · ')+'</div>';
          else html += '<div class="easy-appet-when">select days — span length from D (Days) rank; month $ on last span day only</div>';
          html += '</div>';
        }
      } catch(_ap){}

      if((ghostPlan.overflowList||[]).some(function(o){ return o && o.reason==='span'; })){
        html += ' · <span class="easy-ghost-overflow">span needs consecutive selected days</span>';
      }

      if((ghostPlan.nGhost|0) > 0){
        html += ' <button type="button" class="pill easy-accept-all" data-easy-accept-all title="Commit all suggested ghosts onto the calendar (D-span · month $ on last day)">Accept all</button>';
      }
      html += '</div>';
      var sleepQuotaId = (typeof easyDayQuotaJreq === 'function') ? easyDayQuotaJreq() : (ghostPlan.sleepActId || null);
      if(!sleepQuotaId){
        html += '<div class="easy-quota-banner easy-quota-missing" title="Day capacity jreqs Sleep">day-quota · Add Wake/Sleep so day-quota can jreq Sleep</div>';
      } else {
        var awakeH = ghostPlan.awakeLen ? (Math.round((ghostPlan.awakeLen/60)*10)/10) : '?';
        html += '<div class="easy-quota-banner" title="Packer reserves Sleep first; awake budget is what\'s left">day-quota jreq→Sleep · awake ≤'+awakeH+'h</div>';
      }
      var wq = ghostPlan.workQuota;
      if(wq && wq.need > 0){
        var wcls = wq.ok ? 'easy-work-quota-banner' : 'easy-work-quota-banner easy-quota-missing';
        var wtip = wq.ok
          ? 'Work span = full pay period weekdays (2→15 / 16→1); ghosts only on selection; $ on 1st & 15th'
          : ('Work quota '+wq.have+'/'+wq.need+' selected weekdays · packer prefers work ghosts');
        html += '<div class="'+wcls+'" title="'+esc(wtip)+'">work · two spans 2→15 & 16→1 · pay 1&15'+(wq.ok?'':' · '+wq.have+'/'+wq.need)+'</div>';
      }
    }
    
      // Cross-month / full-period span rail (selection is a window; spans may leave the month)
      if(ghostPlan && ghostPlan.suggest && ghostPlan.suggest.length){
        var rails = Object.create(null);
        ghostPlan.suggest.forEach(function(s){
          if(!s || !s.act) return;
          if(!(s.isWorkSpan || s.isBillSpan || (s.payPeriod && s.spanDays > 1))) return;
          var pp = s.payPeriod || {};
          var rk = (s.act.id || s.act.name)+'::'+(pp.payY||'')+'-'+(pp.payM||'')+'-'+(pp.payD||'');
          if(!rails[rk]){
            rails[rk] = {
              name: s.act.name,
              payD: pp.payD,
              start: pp.start,
              end: pp.end,
              spanDays: s.spanDays,
              beyond: s.spanBeyond || 0,
              kind: s.isWorkSpan ? 'work' : (s.isBillSpan ? 'bill' : 'span')
            };
          }
        });
        var rkeys = Object.keys(rails);
        if(rkeys.length){
          html += '<div class="easy-span-rail" title="Full span range — selection is only a window; may cross months">';
          rkeys.forEach(function(rk){
            var r = rails[rk];
            var a = r.start, b = r.end;
            function md(p){ return p ? (((p.m|0)+1)+'/'+p.d) : '?'; }
            var lab = esc(r.name)+' · '+md(a)+'→'+md(b);
            if(r.payD) lab += ' · bill/pay '+r.payD;
            if(r.beyond) lab += ' · '+r.beyond+' beyond sel';
            if(a && b && a.m !== b.m) lab += ' · crosses month';
            html += '<span class="easy-span-rail-chip easy-span-rail-'+esc(r.kind)+'">'+lab+'</span>';
          });
          html += '</div>';
        }
      }

    
      // Span rail from Board work/bills even when no ghosts (already placed — still show span shape)
      try {
        var boardRails = Object.create(null);
        var focusY = easyCal.y, focusM = easyCal.m;
        var bw = (typeof easyFindBoardWork === 'function') ? easyFindBoardWork() : null;
        if(bw && typeof easyPayPeriodBounds === 'function'){
          [1, 15].forEach(function(pd){
            var b = null;
            if(pd === 1) b = easyPayPeriodBounds(focusY, focusM, 1, [1, 15]);
            else b = easyPayPeriodBounds(focusY, focusM, 15, [1, 15]);
            if(!b) return;
            var rk = 'work::'+b.payY+'-'+b.payM+'-'+b.payD;
            function md(p){ return p ? (((p.m|0)+1)+'/'+p.d+(p.y!==focusY?('/'+p.y):'')) : '?'; }
            boardRails[rk] = 'Work · '+md(b.start)+'→'+md(b.end)+' · pay '+b.payD+((b.start && b.end && b.start.m!==b.end.m)?' · crosses month':'');
          });
        }
        (typeof easyBoardSuggestActs === 'function' ? easyBoardSuggestActs() : []).forEach(function(a){
          if(!a || !(typeof easyIsMonthBillAct === 'function' && easyIsMonthBillAct(a))) return;
          if(typeof easyMigrateBillSpan === 'function') easyMigrateBillSpan(a);
          var bb = easyMonthBillBounds(focusY, focusM, a);
          var rk = (a.id||a.name)+'::bill';
          function md2(p){ return p ? (((p.m|0)+1)+'/'+p.d) : '?'; }
          boardRails[rk] = (a.name||'bill')+' · '+md2(bb.start)+'→'+md2(bb.end)+' · bill '+bb.payD;
        });
        var brk = Object.keys(boardRails);
        if(brk.length){
          html += '<div class="easy-span-rail easy-span-rail-board" title="Span shapes from Board (visible even when already placed / no ghosts)">';
          brk.forEach(function(rk){
            html += '<span class="easy-span-rail-chip">'+esc(boardRails[rk])+'</span>';
          });
          html += '</div>';
        }
      } catch(_rail){}

    html += '<div class="easy-grid">';
    var i;
    for(i = 0; i < firstDow; i++) html += '<div class="easy-day empty"></div>';
    for(var d = 1; d <= dim; d++){
      var isToday = (today.getFullYear()===y && today.getMonth()===m && today.getDate()===d);
      var picked = easySelHas(y, m, d);
      var overIdeal = !!(picked && predDate && easyDateDiffDays({ y: y, m: m, d: d }, predDate) > 0);
      var dayActs = acts.filter(function(a){ return easyOccurs(a, y, m, d); });
      html += '<button type="button" class="easy-day'+(isToday?' today':'')+(picked?' pick':'')+(overIdeal?' pick-over':'')+'" data-easy-day="'+d+'">';
      if(picked && monthSel.length){
        if(d === startD) html += easySelTabHtml('start', y, m, d, predDate, tabPredName, tabRating);
        if(d === endD) html += easySelTabHtml('end', y, m, d, predDate, tabPredName, tabRating);
      }
      html += '<span class="easy-num">'+d+'</span>';
      if(dayActs.length){
        html += '<span class="easy-day-count" title="'+dayActs.length+' on calendar · open Board for the day schedule">'+dayActs.length+' item'+(dayActs.length===1?'':'s')+'</span>';
      }
      var gBag = (ghostPlan && ghostPlan.byDay) ? ghostPlan.byDay[y+'-'+m+'-'+d] : null;
      var ghosts = (gBag && gBag.ghost) || [];
      if(ghosts.length){
        html += '<span class="easy-day-sug-count" title="'+ghosts.length+' suggested (visual only)">'+ghosts.length+' sug</span>';
      }
      html += '<div class="easy-day-items">';
      // live acts
      dayActs.forEach(function(a){
        if(!a) return;
        var sp = (typeof easySpanPosOnDay === 'function') ? easySpanPosOnDay(a, y, m, d) : null;
        var lab = (a.name || '').slice(0, 12);
        if(sp && sp.spanDays > 1) lab = (a.name || '').slice(0, 6)+' '+sp.index+'/'+sp.spanDays;
        var hcls = 'easy-hchip';
        if(a.kind === 'work') hcls += ' easy-hchip-work';
        if(a.rhythm || a.name === 'Wake' || a.name === 'Sleep') hcls += ' easy-hchip-rhythm';
        if(sp && sp.presenceOnly) hcls += ' easy-hchip-presence';
        if(sp && sp.charge && sp.spanDays > 1) hcls += ' easy-hchip-cost';
        var tip = a.name || '';
        if(sp && sp.spanDays > 1) tip += ' · span '+sp.index+'/'+sp.spanDays+(sp.charge?' · $ day':' · presence');
        html += '<span class="'+hcls+'" title="'+esc(tip)+'">'+esc(lab)+'</span>';
      });
      // ghosts
      ghosts.forEach(function(g){
        var a = g && g.act ? g.act : g;
        if(!a) return;
        var lab = (a.name || '').slice(0, 10);
        if(g.spanDays > 1) lab = lab.slice(0, 6)+' '+((g.spanIndex||'?'))+'/'+g.spanDays;
        var gcls = 'easy-hchip easy-hchip-ghost';
        if(g.isRhythm || g.rhythm) gcls += ' easy-hchip-rhythm';
        if(a.kind === 'work') gcls += ' easy-hchip-work';
        if(g.charge && !g.presenceOnly) gcls += ' easy-hchip-cost';
        if(g.presenceOnly) gcls += ' easy-hchip-presence';
        if(g.appetizing) gcls += ' easy-hchip-appet';
        var tip = a.name || '';
        if(g.startLabel && g.endLabel) tip += ' '+g.startLabel+'–'+g.endLabel; // tip only, not shown as clock UI
        if(g.presenceOnly) tip += ' · presence';
        else if(g.charge) tip += ' · $ day';
        if(g.appetizing) tip += ' · appetizing';
        html += '<span class="'+gcls+'" title="'+esc(tip)+'">'+esc(lab)+'</span>';
      });
      html += '</div>';
      html += '</button>';
    }
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<div class="easy-composer" id="easy-composer">';
    var selDays = monthSel;
    if(selDays.length){
      var whenLabel = selDays.length === 1
        ? (monthName+' '+selDays[0].d+(easyCal.allYears?' · every year':''))
        : (selDays.length+' days'+(easyCal.allYears?' · every year':''));
      html += '<div class="easy-composer-row">';
      html += '<span class="easy-composer-when">'+esc(whenLabel)+'</span>';
      html += '<select id="easy-place-act">';
      if(!acts.length) html += '<option value="">Add an action on the Board first</option>';
      acts.forEach(function(a){
        var id = a.id || a.name;
        html += '<option value="'+esc(id)+'"'+(easyCal.placeAct===id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(a.name)+'</option>';
      });
      html += '</select>';
      html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+(easyCal.span?' active':'')+'" data-easy-span title="Show on every selected day. Calculation settles on the last day.">Span</button>';
      var pre = easyFindAct(easyCal.placeAct) || (acts[0] || null);
      var preS = '', preE = '';
      if(pre && !pre.allDay && pre.startMin != null){
        preS = easyFmtHHMM(pre.startMin);
        preE = easyFmtHHMM(pre.endMin != null ? pre.endMin : (pre.endHour != null ? Number(pre.endHour)*60 : Number(pre.startMin)+60));
      } else if(pre && !pre.allDay && pre.hours && pre.hours[0] !== 'all' && pre.hours[0] != null){
        preS = easyPad2(Number(pre.hours[0])%24)+':00';
        preE = easyPad2((Number(pre.hours[pre.hours.length-1])%24)+1)+':00';
      }
      html += '<input type="text" id="easy-add-start" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="09:30" title="Start 24-hour HH:MM" style="width:5.6rem" value="'+esc(preS)+'" />';
      html += '<span class="easy-year-ghost">to</span>';
      html += '<input type="text" id="easy-add-end" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="17:00" title="End 24-hour HH:MM" style="width:5.6rem" value="'+esc(preE)+'" />';
      html += '<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="easy-add-go">Place</button>';
      html += '<button type="button" class="btn" data-easy-delete>Delete</button>';
      html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="easy-add-cancel">Cancel</button>';
      html += '</div>';
      html += '<p class="hint">'+(selDays.length>1 ? (selDays.map(function(p){ return p.d; }).join(', ')+' · ') : '')+(easyCal.span ? 'Span on: chips on every selected day, calc on the last. ' : '')+'Start HH:MM to end HH:MM (24-hour). Blank = all day. Place, or Delete those days.</p>';
    } else {
      html += easyCal.allYears
        ? '<p class="hint">All years is on. Select days, pick an action, Place. Span shows it every day and settles on the last.</p>'
        : '<p class="hint">Click days (shift-click a range). Calendar shows item counts + suggested ghosts; Board Selection has the day schedule. Span = every day, calc on the last.</p>';
    }
    html += '</div></div>';
    return html;
  }
  function renderEasyBoard(){
    var best = easyBestRankFresh();
    best = easyApplyViewRatings(best, { kind: 'board' }, null);
    // Board cards = placed/schedule acts; Best order is sort preference only.
    var acts = [];
    try { acts = (typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function' ? easyScheduleActions() : []) || []; } catch(_a){ acts = []; }
    if(!acts.length){
      try { acts = (typeof getCalendarCustomActions === 'function' ? getCalendarCustomActions() : []) || []; } catch(_g){}
    }
    if(best.order && best.order.length && acts.length){
      var rank = Object.create(null);
      best.order.forEach(function(a, i){ if(a) rank[a.id || a.name] = i; });
      acts = acts.slice().sort(function(a, b){
        var ia = rank[a.id || a.name]; if(ia == null) ia = 1e9;
        var ib = rank[b.id || b.name]; if(ib == null) ib = 1e9;
        return ia - ib;
      });
    }
    var kind = easyCal.boardKind === 'joy' ? 'joy' : (easyCal.boardKind === 'work' ? 'work' : (easyCal.boardKind === 'rhythm' ? 'rhythm' : 'expense'));
    var html = '<div class="easy-board" id="easy-board">';
    html += '<div class="easy-board-add">';
    html += '<div class="easy-kind">';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+(kind==='expense'?' active':'')+'" data-easy-kind="expense">Expense item</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+(kind==='joy'?' active':'')+'" data-easy-kind="joy">Joy jaction</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+(kind==='work'?' active':'')+'" data-easy-kind="work">Work</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+(kind==='rhythm'?' active':'')+'" data-easy-kind="rhythm">Wake / Sleep</button>';
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<div class="easy-board-row'+(kind==='joy'?' joy':'')+(kind==='work'?' work':'')+(kind==='rhythm'?' rhythm':'')+'">';
    if(kind === 'joy'){
      var joys = easyJoyList();
      var methods = easyJmethodList();
      var ja = easyCal.joyA || 'H';
      var jb = easyCal.joyB || 'M';
      if(!jb || jb===ja){
        for(var ji=0;ji<joys.length;ji++){ if(joys[ji].id!==ja){ jb = joys[ji].id; break; } }
      }
      if(!jb) jb = ja;
      var jm = easyCal.jmethod || 'JUnit';
      var xa = (easyCal.joyAX != null && easyCal.joyAX !== '') ? easyCal.joyAX : '1';
      var yb = (easyCal.joyBY != null && easyCal.joyBY !== '') ? easyCal.joyBY : '1';
      html += '<select id="easy-board-joy-a" title="First joy">';
      joys.forEach(function(j){
        html += '<option value="'+esc(j.id)+'"'+(j.id===ja?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(j.title)+'</option>';
      });
      html += '</select>';
      html += '<input type="text" id="easy-board-amt-a" class="easy-amt" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="1" title="Consume this joy. Negative adds." value="'+esc(String(xa))+'" />';
      html += '<span class="easy-year-ghost">→</span>';
      html += '<select id="easy-board-joy-b" title="Second joy">';
      joys.forEach(function(j){
        html += '<option value="'+esc(j.id)+'"'+(j.id===jb?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(j.title)+'</option>';
      });
      html += '</select>';
      html += '<input type="text" id="easy-board-amt-b" class="easy-amt" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="1" title="Consume this joy. Negative adds." value="'+esc(String(yb))+'" />';
      html += '<select id="easy-board-jmethod" title="jmethod">';
      methods.forEach(function(m){
        html += '<option value="'+esc(m.id)+'"'+(m.id===jm?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(m.title)+'</option>';
      });
      html += '</select>';
    } else if(kind === 'work'){
      var wh = easyWorkBlockHours();
      html += '<span class="hint" style="margin:0">Default '+esc(wh.startLabel)+'–'+esc(wh.endLabel)+' from work block · INCOME net</span>';
    } else if(kind === 'rhythm'){
      var rh = easyDayRhythm();
      html += '<span class="hint" style="margin:0">Wake '+esc(rh.wakeLabel)+' · Sleep '+esc(rh.sleepStartLabel)+' (8h after work end + 1h buffer)</span>';
    } else {
      html += '<select id="easy-board-src">';
      easyExpenseItems().forEach(function(it){
        html += '<option value="'+esc(it.name)+'">'+esc(it.name)+' · '+esc(it.section)+'</option>';
      });
      html += '</select>';
    }
    if(kind !== 'rhythm') html += '<input type="text" id="easy-board-name" placeholder="'+(kind==='joy'?'Name this jaction':(kind==='work'?'Name this work shift':'Name this action'))+'" />';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="easy-board-go">'+(kind==='work'?'Add work':(kind==='rhythm'?'Add wake / sleep':'Add to Plan'))+'</button>';
    if(kind==='expense') html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="easy-board-all">Add all expenses</button>';
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<p class="hint">'+(kind==='joy'
      ? 'Amount is consume; negative adds. Default jmethod (0–1) scores any pair. Name optional. [REDACTED-AMOUNT]. Schedule from the calendar.'
      : (kind==='work'
        ? 'Adds Mon–Fri work (quota) at work-block hours. Paid on the 1st & 15th (half monthly net each) — not once per weekday. Place still pins days; Selection edits time.'
        : (kind==='rhythm'
          ? 'Adds daily Wake + Sleep from work end + 1h buffer, then 8h sleep. Suggestions only pack in the awake window (won\'t compress into sleep).'
          : 'Name it, or Add all expenses that have a $ value on EXPENSES. [REDACTED-AMOUNT] and already-on-the-board lines are skipped. Schedule from the calendar.')))+'</p>';
    html += '</div>';
    html += easyJgBarHtml();
    html += '<div class="easy-board-jump-row" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin:6px 0 8px">';
    (function(){
      var ja = null;
      try { ja = (typeof easyFindAct === 'function' && easyCal.placeAct) ? easyFindAct(easyCal.placeAct) : null; } catch(_ja){}
      var jn = ja ? (ja.name || easyCal.placeAct) : '';
      var jTitle = jn
        ? ('Jump calendar to a day where Suggest places “'+jn+'”')
        : 'Click a Board card to select it, then Jump';
      var jLab = jn ? ('Jump to Suggest · '+jn) : 'Jump to Suggest (select a card)';
      var jCls = 'btn'+(jn ? '' : ' easy-jump-need-sel');
      html += '<button type="button" class="'+jCls+'" data-easy-jump-suggest title="'+esc(jTitle)+'">'+esc(jLab)+'</button>';
      if(jn) html += '<span class="hint" style="margin:0">Selected: '+esc(jn)+'</span>';
      else html += '<span class="hint" style="margin:0">Click a Plan card to select</span>';
    })();
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<div class="easy-lanes">';
    EASY_LANES.forEach(function(lane){
      var cards = acts.slice();
      if(lane.id === 'week') cards = acts.filter(function(a){ return easyInThisWeek(a); });
      else if(lane.id === 'sel'){
        var gp = (typeof easySelGhostPlan === 'function') ? easySelGhostPlan(best) : null;
        cards = (gp && gp.current && gp.current.length) ? gp.current.slice() : acts.filter(function(a){ return easyInSelection(a); });
      }
      html += '<div class="easy-lane" data-easy-lane="'+lane.id+'">';
      var laneTitle = lane.label;
      if(lane.id === 'week') laneTitle = lane.label+' · '+easyWeekRangeLabel();
      if(lane.id === 'sel') laneTitle = lane.label+' · '+easySelRangeLabel();
      var gpLane = (lane.id === 'sel' && typeof easySelGhostPlan === 'function') ? easySelGhostPlan(best) : null;
      var sugN = 0;
      if(gpLane && gpLane.byDay && gpLane.days){
        gpLane.days.forEach(function(p){
          var bag = gpLane.byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
          sugN += (bag && bag.ghost) ? bag.ghost.length : 0;
        });
      } else if(gpLane && gpLane.suggest) sugN = gpLane.suggest.length;
      if(lane.id === 'sel'){
        html += '<h3>'+esc(laneTitle)+'</h3>';
        if(!(easyCal.sel && easyCal.sel.length)){
          html += '<p class="hint">Click days on Calendar. This lane is those days · two categories below.</p>';
        }
      } else {
        html += '<h3>'+esc(laneTitle)+' <span class="easy-count">'+cards.length+(sugN?(' +'+sugN+' sug'):'')+'</span></h3>';
      }
      var selClashByKey = null;
      var boardGhosts = [];
      if(lane.id === 'sel'){
        if(gpLane){
          if(gpLane.byDay && gpLane.days && gpLane.days.length){
            gpLane.days.forEach(function(p){
              var bag = gpLane.byDay[easyDayKeyStr(p)];
              (bag && bag.ghost || []).forEach(function(g){ boardGhosts.push(g); });
            });
          } else {
            boardGhosts = (gpLane.suggest || []).slice();
          }
        }
        if(typeof easyBoardTimeOverlaps === 'function'){
          try {
            var ovPack = easyBoardTimeOverlaps(cards, boardGhosts);
            selClashByKey = (ovPack && ovPack.byKey) ? ovPack.byKey : Object.create(null);
          } catch(_ov){ selClashByKey = Object.create(null); }
        } else {
          selClashByKey = Object.create(null);
        }
      }
      function easyClashInfo(key){
        if(!selClashByKey || !key) return null;
        return selClashByKey[key] || null;
      }
      function easyClashAny(info){
        return !!(info && (info.clashWork || info.clashRhythm || info.clashPeer));
      }
      function easyClashClassBits(info){
        if(!easyClashAny(info)) return '';
        var bits = '';
        if(info.clashWork) bits += ' easy-card-clash-work';
        if(info.clashRhythm) bits += ' easy-card-clash-rhythm';
        if(info.clashPeer) bits += ' easy-card-clash-peer';
        if(info.peerGroup != null && info.peerGroup >= 0) bits += ' easy-card-clash-g'+(info.peerGroup % 6);
        return bits;
      }
      function easyClashBadgeHtml(info){
        if(!easyClashAny(info)) return '';
        var names = (info.partners || []).slice();
        var tip = names.length ? ('Overlaps: '+names.join(', ')) : 'Time overlap';
        var lab;
        if(info.clashWork) lab = 'overlap work'+(names.length ? (' · '+names.join(', ')) : '');
        else if(info.clashRhythm) lab = 'overlap rhythm'+(names.length ? (' · '+names.join(', ')) : '');
        else lab = 'overlap'+(names.length ? (' · '+names.join(', ')) : '');
        return '<span class="easy-clash-badge" title="'+esc(tip)+'">'+esc(lab)+'</span>';
      }
      function easyGhostClashKey(s, gi){
        if(!s) return '';
        var a = s.act || null;
        var base = (typeof easyGhostActKey === 'function' && easyGhostActKey(s)) || (s.id || (a && (a.id || a.name)) || ('g'+gi));
        base = String(base || ('g'+gi));
        var dayKey = '';
        if(s.day){
          dayKey = (typeof easyDayKeyStr === 'function') ? easyDayKeyStr(s.day) : [s.day.y, s.day.m, s.day.d].join('-');
        }
        return 'ghost:' + base + (dayKey ? (':' + dayKey) : '');
      }
      function easySeqClashForGhost(s){
        if(!selClashByKey || !s) return false;
        var base = (typeof easyGhostActKey === 'function' && easyGhostActKey(s)) || (s.id || (s.act && (s.act.id || s.act.name)) || '');
        base = String(base || '');
        if(!base) return false;
        var prefix = 'ghost:' + base;
        for(var k in selClashByKey){
          if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(selClashByKey, k)) continue;
          if(k === prefix || k.indexOf(prefix + ':') === 0 || k.indexOf(prefix + '#') === 0){
            if(easyClashAny(selClashByKey[k])) return true;
          }
        }
        return false;
      }
      if(lane.id === 'sel' && gpLane && (cards.length || sugN)){
        html += '<div class="easy-sel-seq" title="Best order on selection · ghosts fill empty days through selection end (visual only)">';
        var seqBits = [];
        cards.forEach(function(a, idx){
          if(idx) seqBits.push('<span class="easy-mix-arrow">→</span>');
          var sd0 = Number(a.spanDays)||0;
          var lab0 = a.name;
          if(a.span || sd0 > 1) lab0 = a.name+'×'+Math.max(sd0,1);
          var cInfo = easyClashInfo(a.id || a.name);
          var cClash = easyClashAny(cInfo) ? ' easy-sel-seq-clash' : '';
          seqBits.push('<span class="easy-sel-seq-cur'+(a.span||sd0>1?' easy-sel-seq-span':'')+cClash+'" title="'+esc((a.span||sd0>1)?(a.name+' · committed span '+Math.max(sd0,1)+'d · $ last'):a.name)+'">'+esc(lab0)+'</span>');
        });
        var seenSpan = Object.create(null);
        (gpLane.suggest || []).forEach(function(s, idx){
          var nm = s.act ? s.act.name : '';
          var sid = s.id || nm;
          var sd = Number(s.spanDays) || 1;
          if(sd > 1){
            if(seenSpan[sid]) return;
            seenSpan[sid] = 1;
          }
          seqBits.push('<span class="easy-mix-arrow">→</span>');
          var dd = s.day ? ((s.day.m+1)+'/'+s.day.d) : '';
          var clock = (s.startLabel && s.endLabel) ? (s.startLabel+'–'+s.endLabel) : '';
          var lab = (s.startLabel?s.startLabel+' ':'')+nm;
          var tip = 'Selection suggested '+dd+' '+clock;
          if(sd > 1){
            lab = nm+'×'+sd;
            tip = nm+' (span '+sd+' → cost last)';
          }
          var sClash = easySeqClashForGhost(s) ? ' easy-sel-seq-clash' : '';
          seqBits.push('<span class="easy-sel-seq-sug'+sClash+'" title="'+esc(tip)+'">'+esc(lab)+'</span>');
        });
        html += seqBits.join(' ');
        html += '</div>';
        if(sugN) html += '<p class="hint">Ghosts: add gaps, or delete/rearrange within selection — month must-suggests stay covered · Place to apply.</p>';
      }
      if(lane.id === 'sel'){
        html += '<div class="easy-lane-cat" data-easy-cat="selection">';
        html += '<h4 class="easy-lane-cat-title">Selection <span class="easy-count">'+cards.length+'</span></h4>';
        if(!cards.length){
          html += '<p class="hint">'+(easyCal.sel && easyCal.sel.length ? 'Nothing placed on these days yet.' : 'Click days on Calendar.')+'</p>';
        }
      }
      cards.forEach(function(a){
        var when;
        if(lane.id === 'sel') when = easySelWhen(a);
        else if(lane.id === 'week' || easyInThisWeek(a)) when = easyWeekWhen(a);
        else if(a.repeatMarks && a.repeatMarks.length) when = 'every year · '+a.repeatMarks.length+' day'+(a.repeatMarks.length>1?'s':'');
        else if(a.selectedKeys && a.selectedKeys.length) when = a.selectedKeys.length+' day'+(a.selectedKeys.length>1?'s':'');
        else when = 'unscheduled';
        var cardId = a.id || a.name;
        var liveClash = (lane.id === 'sel') ? easyClashInfo(cardId) : null;
        var cardCls = 'easy-card' + ((lane.id === 'sel') ? easyClashClassBits(liveClash) : '');
        try {
          var selAct = easyCal && easyCal.placeAct != null ? String(easyCal.placeAct) : '';
          if(selAct && (selAct === String(cardId) || selAct === String(a.id || '') || selAct === String(a.name || ''))){
            cardCls += ' easy-card-selected';
          }
        } catch(_selc){}
        html += '<div class="'+cardCls+'" data-easy-card="'+esc(cardId)+'" title="Click to select · then Jump to Suggest">';
        html += '<input type="text" class="easy-card-name" data-easy-rename="'+esc(cardId)+'" value="'+esc(a.name)+'" title="Name this action" />';
        var info = best.byId[a.id || a.name];
        html += '<div class="easy-card-meta">'+esc(easyActMeta(a))+' · '+esc(when);
        if(info && info.rank) html += ' · #'+info.rank+' · '+info.rating1000;
        var sd = Number(a.spanDays) || 0;
        if(a.span || sd > 1){
          html += ' · <span class="easy-live-span-tag" title="Committed D-span · month $ on last day">span '+Math.max(sd,1)+'d</span>';
          if(a.chargeOn === 'lastSpan') html += ' · $ last';
        }
        if(lane.id === 'sel') html += easyClashBadgeHtml(liveClash);
        html += '</div>';
        if(lane.id === 'sel'){
          var tp = easyActTimePair(a);
          var id = cardId;
          html += '<div class="easy-card-when" title="Time on the selected days. Blank = all day.">';
          html += '<input type="text" class="easy-card-start" data-easy-time="'+esc(id)+'" data-easy-time-which="start" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="all day" value="'+esc(tp.s)+'" />';
          html += '<span class="easy-year-ghost">to</span>';
          html += '<input type="text" class="easy-card-end" data-easy-time="'+esc(id)+'" data-easy-time-which="end" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="HH:MM" value="'+esc(tp.e)+'" />';
          html += '</div>';
        }
        html += '<div class="easy-card-jreq" title="Requires this action first (Exp6 jreq)">';
        html += '<label>jreq</label>';
        html += '<select data-easy-jreq="'+esc(cardId)+'">';
        html += '<option value="">— none —</option>';
        (typeof easyJreqOptions === 'function' ? easyJreqOptions(cardId) : []).forEach(function(opt){
          var oid = (typeof easyActId === 'function') ? easyActId(opt) : (opt.id || opt.name);
          var sel = (a.jreqId && (a.jreqId === oid || a.jreqId === opt.id || a.jreqId === opt.name)) ? ' selected' : '';
          html += '<option value="'+esc(oid)+'"'+sel+'>'+esc(opt.name || oid)+'</option>';
        });
        html += '</select></div>';
        var onceVal = Math.abs(Number(a.amountOnce) || 0);
        var monVal = Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly) || 0);
        html += '<div class="easy-card-money" title="One-time $ draws Money stock; monthly $ is surplus flow. Both allowed.">';
        html += '<label>once $</label>';
        html += '<input type="number" min="0" step="1" data-easy-once="'+esc(cardId)+'" value="'+esc(String(onceVal || ''))+'" placeholder="0" />';
        html += '<label>$/mo</label>';
        html += '<input type="number" min="0" step="1" data-easy-monthly="'+esc(cardId)+'" value="'+esc(String(monVal || ''))+'" placeholder="0" />';
        html += '</div>';
        var spanVal = (typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(a) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(a.spanDays)||1));
        html += '<div class="easy-card-span" title="Consecutive days at the same clock; cost/gain on last day (or paydays for work)">';
        html += '<label>span</label>';
        html += '<input type="number" min="1" max="60" data-easy-span="'+esc(cardId)+'" value="'+esc(String(spanVal))+'" />';
        if(a.kind === 'work' || ((typeof easyChargeOn === 'function') ? easyChargeOn(a) : a.chargeOn) === 'payDays'){
          html += '<span class="easy-year-ghost"> · pay 1·15</span>';
        } else if(spanVal > 1){
          html += '<span class="easy-year-ghost"> · cost last</span>';
        }
        html += '</div>';
        var mustChk = (typeof easySuggestMust === 'function') ? easySuggestMust(a) : false;
        html += '<label class="easy-card-must" title="Always include in Suggest (for testing). Survives packer cuts.">';
        html += '<input type="checkbox" data-easy-suggest-must="'+esc(cardId)+'"'+(mustChk?' checked':'')+' />';
        html += ' must suggest';
        html += '</label>';
        if(a.simView){
          html += '<div class="easy-card-sim" title="This action carries its own simulation">';
          html += '<button type="button" class="btn" data-easy-open-sim="'+esc(String(a.simView))+'">Open sim</button>';
          if(a.simExport) html += '<button type="button" class="btn" data-easy-export-sim="'+esc(String(a.simView))+'">Export sim</button>';
          html += '</div>';
        }
        html += '<div class="easy-card-moves">';
        html += '<button type="button" class="btn easy-del" data-easy-del-act="'+esc(a.id||a.name)+'">Delete</button>';
        html += '</div></div>';
      });
      if(lane.id === 'sel'){
        html += '</div>'; // easy-lane-cat selection
        html += '<div class="easy-lane-cat" data-easy-cat="selection-suggested">';
        html += '<h4 class="easy-lane-cat-title">Selection suggested <span class="easy-count">'+(boardGhosts.length||0)+'</span></h4>';
        if(!(gpLane && boardGhosts.length)){
          html += '<p class="hint">'+(easyCal.sel && easyCal.sel.length ? 'No suggestions for this selection.' : 'Select days to see suggestions.')+'</p>';
        }
      }
      if(lane.id === 'sel' && gpLane){
        // boardGhosts already collected above for clash detection
        var ghostKeySeen = Object.create(null);
        boardGhosts.forEach(function(s, gi){
          var a = s.act;
          if(!a) return;
          var dd = s.day ? ((s.day.m+1)+'/'+s.day.d) : '';
          var clock = (s.startLabel && s.endLabel) ? (s.startLabel+'–'+s.endLabel) : '';
          var isR = !!(s.isRhythm || s.rhythm || a.rhythm);
          var isW = a.kind === 'work';
          var gKey = easyGhostClashKey(s, gi);
          if(ghostKeySeen[gKey] != null){
            ghostKeySeen[gKey]++;
            gKey = gKey + '#' + ghostKeySeen[gKey];
          } else {
            ghostKeySeen[gKey] = 0;
          }
          var gClash = easyClashInfo(gKey);
          var gcls = 'easy-card easy-card-ghost' + easyClashClassBits(gClash);
          if(isR) gcls += ' easy-card-ghost-rhythm';
          if(isW) gcls += ' easy-card-ghost-work';
          if(s.charge && !s.presenceOnly) gcls += ' easy-card-ghost-cost';
          if(s.presenceOnly) gcls += ' easy-card-ghost-presence';
          var isMustG = (typeof easySuggestMust === 'function' && easySuggestMust(a)) || !!s.mustForced;
          if(isMustG) gcls += ' easy-card-ghost-must';
          var opLab = s.op || s.suggestOp || '';
          var kindLab = opLab === 'delete' ? 'suggest delete'
            : (opLab === 'move' ? 'suggest rearrange'
            : (isR ? (a.rhythm || a.name || 'rhythm') : (isW ? 'work' : 'selection suggested')));
          if(opLab === 'delete') gcls += ' easy-card-ghost-delete';
          if(opLab === 'move') gcls += ' easy-card-ghost-move';
          var spanLab = (Number(s.spanDays)>1) ? (' · span '+s.spanIndex+'/'+s.spanDays) : '';
          var payLab = '';
          if(isW || s.isWorkSpan || s.isBillSpan){
            payLab = s.charge ? ' · PAY day' : ' · work span';
            if(s.payPeriod) payLab += ' →'+s.payPeriod.payD;
            if(s.spanDays) payLab += ' · '+s.spanIndex+'/'+s.spanDays;
            if(s.spanBeyond) payLab += ' · '+s.spanBeyond+' beyond sel';
          } else if(s.monthSpend || s.dSpan){
            if(s.presenceOnly) payLab = ' · D-span presence (no $)';
            else if(s.charge) payLab = ' · D-span '+((s.dSpan||s.spanDays)||'?')+'d · month $ once';
            else payLab = ' · D-span';
          } else if(s.presenceOnly){
            payLab = ' · presence (no $)';
          } else if(s.charge && Number(s.spanDays)>1){
            payLab = ' · $ on last span day';
          }
          html += '<div class="'+gcls+'" data-easy-ghost-card="'+esc(a.id||a.name)+'" title="'+esc(kindLab+' · '+dd+' '+clock+' · visual only')+'">';
          if(s.durMin && !isR && !isW){
            var hrsL = Number(s.durMin)/60;
            var durLab = (hrsL >= 1) ? ((Math.round(hrsL*10)/10)+'h') : (s.durMin+'m');
            payLab += ' · '+durLab;
            if(s.score01 != null) payLab += ' score '+Math.round(Number(s.score01)*1000);
          }
          html += '<div class="easy-card-name">'+esc(a.name)+(isMustG?'<span class="easy-must-badge" title="must Suggest">must</span>':'')+'</div>';
          html += '<div class="easy-card-meta">'+esc(kindLab)+' · '+esc(dd)+(clock?(' · '+esc(clock)):'')+esc(spanLab)+esc(payLab)+easyClashBadgeHtml(gClash)+'</div>';
          var showAccept = !(Number(s.spanDays) > 1) || (Number(s.spanIndex) === 1);
          var alreadyLive = false;
          try {
            if(s.day && typeof easyLiveCoversOnDay === 'function' && easyLiveCoversOnDay(a, s.day)) alreadyLive = true;
          } catch(_al){}
          if(showAccept && !alreadyLive){
            var ak = (s.id || (a && (a.id || a.name)) || '');
            html += '<button type="button" class="pill easy-accept-one" data-easy-accept-ghost="'+esc(ak)+'" title="Commit this suggestion (full D-span) onto the calendar">Accept</button>';
          } else if(showAccept && alreadyLive){
            html += '<span class="easy-accepted-tag" title="Already on the calendar">on calendar</span>';
          }
          html += '</div>';
        });
      }
      if(lane.id === 'sel') html += '</div>'; // easy-lane-cat selection-suggested
      html += '</div>';
    });
    html += '</div></div>';
    return html;
  }
  /** Always-visible calendar live rollup — numbers come from the run() loop (lastBest.calendar). */
  function renderCalendarRollupHtml(){
    var work = {};
    try {
      var profile = ensureCalendar() || {};
      work = profile.work || {};
    } catch(_w){}
    var roll = (lastBest && lastBest.calendar) || null;
    if(!roll){
      roll = { gain:0, living:0, debt:0, surplus:0, nActs:0 };
    }
    var mGain = Number(roll.gain) || 0;
    var mSpend = (Number(roll.living) || 0) + (Number(roll.debt) || 0);
    var mNet = Number(roll.surplus) || 0;
    var ms = (lastBest && lastBest.ok && lastBest.ms != null) ? lastBest.ms : (roll.ms != null ? roll.ms : null);
    var nRun = (lastBest && lastBest.n != null) ? lastBest.n : roll.nActs;
    var html = '<div class="cal-live-rollup" id="cal-live-rollup">';
    html += '<p class="hint"><b>CALENDAR</b> · Year → Month → Week → Day → Hour → <b>Action</b> → <b>Item</b>. ';
    html += '<b>Work '+(work.startHour||15)+':00–'+(work.endHour||23)+':00 '+(work.timezone||'CST')+'</b>. ';
    html += 'Money law: <b>live rollup ← run()</b> on <b>this month</b> placed acts';
    if(ms != null) html += ' · '+ms+'ms';
    html += ' · n='+nRun+'. Sheet SUMMARY stays on Income/Expenses. ';
    try {
      var fm = (roll && roll.y != null && roll.m != null) ? { y: roll.y, m: roll.m } : (typeof easyFocusMonth==='function' ? easyFocusMonth() : null);
      if(fm){
        var mm = (fm.m|0)+1;
        html += 'Focus '+fm.y+'-'+(mm<10?'0':'')+mm+' · ';
      }
    } catch(_fm){}
    html += 'Cal surplus '+money(mNet,'auto')+' · mo '+money(mGain,'gain')+' / '+money(mSpend,'spend')+' · cal net '+money(mNet,'auto');
    html += ' · '+((roll.nActs!=null)?roll.nActs:0)+' acts this month (not ×12 year total).</p>';
    html += '</div>';
    return html;
  }
