  function renderEasyShell(advancedHtml){
    var html = '<div class="easy-cal" id="easy-cal">';
    html += renderCalendarRollupHtml();
    html += '<div class="easy-switch">';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+(easyCal.mode==='calendar'?' active':'')+'" data-easy-mode="calendar">Calendar</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+(easyCal.mode==='board'?' active':'')+'" data-easy-mode="board">Board</button>';
    html += '</div>';
    html += easyCal.mode === 'board' ? renderEasyBoard() : renderEasyMonth();
    html += '<details class="easy-advanced"><summary>Advanced · year drill + money cadences</summary>'+advancedHtml+'</details>';
    html += '</div>';
    return html;
  }
  function bindEasyCal(){
    var root = $('pane');
    if(!root) return;
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-easy-mode]').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        easyCal.mode = btn.getAttribute('data-easy-mode') || 'calendar';
        easyCal.pick = null;
        renderAll();
      };
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-easy-nav]').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.onclick = function(){
        var dir = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-easy-nav'), 10) || 0;
        easyCal.m += dir;
        if(easyCal.m > 11){ easyCal.m = 0; easyCal.y += 1; }
        if(easyCal.m < 0){ easyCal.m = 11; easyCal.y -= 1; }
        easyCal.surplusFollowView = true;
        easyCal.pick = null;
        renderAll();
      };
    });
    var todayBtn = root.querySelector('[data-easy-today]');
    if(todayBtn) todayBtn.onclick = function(){
      var n = (typeof easyTodayMonth === 'function') ? easyTodayMonth() : { y: new Date().getFullYear(), m: new Date().getMonth() };
      var day = new Date().getDate();
      try { if(typeof easyNowCST === 'function'){ var c = easyNowCST(); if(c && c.d != null) day = c.d|0; } } catch(_d){}
      easyCal.y = n.y;
      easyCal.m = n.m;
      easyCal.surplusFollowView = false;
      easyCal.sel = [easySelKey(easyCal.y, easyCal.m, day)];
      easyCal.pick = { y: easyCal.y, m: easyCal.m, d: day };
      renderAll();
    };
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-easy-jump-suggest]').forEach(function(jumpSug){
      jumpSug.onclick = function(){
        var r = null;
        var want = (easyCal && easyCal.placeAct) ? String(easyCal.placeAct) : '';
        if(!want){
          if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('Select a Board item first (click a Plan card), then Jump','warn');
          try { easyCal.mode = 'board'; renderAll(); } catch(_b){}
          return;
        }
        var found = (typeof easyFindAct === 'function') ? easyFindAct(want) : null;
        try {
          r = (typeof easyJumpToSuggestDay === 'function') ? easyJumpToSuggestDay({
            wantActId: want,
            wantName: found ? found.name : ''
          }) : null;
        } catch(_j){ r = { ok: false, message: String(_j && _j.message || _j) }; }
        // easy201: calendar must show the landed month
        try {
          if(r && r.ok && r.wantPlaced && r.y != null && r.m != null){
            easyCal.y = r.y|0; easyCal.m = r.m|0;
            easyCal.mode = 'calendar';
            easyCal.surplusFollowView = true;
            if(r.d != null){
              easyCal.sel = [easySelKey(r.y, r.m, r.d)];
              easyCal.pick = { y: r.y|0, m: r.m|0, d: r.d|0 };
            }
          }
        } catch(_land){}
        if(typeof renderAll === 'function') renderAll();
        if(typeof showStatus === 'function'){
          var ok = !!(r && r.ok && r.wantPlaced);

    function easySimHref(view, wantExport){
      var v = String(view || '').replace(/^\/+/, '');
      if(!v) return '';
      var origin = '';
      try { origin = (location.origin && location.origin !== 'null') ? location.origin : ''; } catch(_o){}
      var href = (origin ? (origin.replace(/\/+$/,'') + '/') : './') + v;
      if(wantExport) href += (href.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + 'export=1';
      return href;
    }

      var save = function(){
        var card = inp.closest ? inp.closest('.easy-card') : null;
        var id = inp.getAttribute('data-easy-time');
        var found = easyFindAct(id);
        if(!found || !card) return;
        var sEl = card.querySelector('[data-easy-time-which="start"]');
        var eEl = card.querySelector('[data-easy-time-which="end"]');
        easyApplyWhen(found, sEl ? sEl.value : '', eEl ? eEl.value : '');
        easyCommitQuiet(found);
        invalidateCalendarCache();
        var tp = easyActTimePair(found);
        if(sEl) sEl.value = tp.s;
        if(eEl) eEl.value = tp.e;
        showStatus('Time on “'+found.name+'” · Save to keep','ok');
      };
      inp.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });
      inp.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
        if(e.key === 'Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); inp.blur(); }
      });
      inp.addEventListener('blur', function(e){
        var rt = e.relatedTarget;
        if(rt && inp.closest && inp.closest('.easy-card') && inp.closest('.easy-card').contains(rt) && rt.getAttribute && rt.getAttribute('data-easy-time')){
          return;
        }
        save();
      });
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-easy-jreq]').forEach(function(sel){
      sel.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });
      sel.addEventListener('change', function(){
        var id = sel.getAttribute('data-easy-jreq');
        var found = easyFindAct(id);
        if(!found) return;
        var v = sel.value || '';
        if(!v) delete found.jreqId; else found.jreqId = v;
        easyCommitQuiet(found);
        invalidateCalendarCache();
        try { if(typeof _easyBestTick === 'number'){ _easyBestTick++; _easyJgAt = -1; } } catch(_t){}
        renderAll();
        showStatus('jreq on “'+found.name+'” → '+(v||'none'),'ok');
      });
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-easy-suggest-must]').forEach(function(inp){
      inp.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });
      inp.addEventListener('change', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var id = inp.getAttribute('data-easy-suggest-must');
        var found = easyFindAct(id);
        if(!found) return;
        if(inp.checked){
          found.suggestMust = true;
          try { delete found.suggestOptional; } catch(_d){ found.suggestOptional = false; }
        } else {
          found.suggestOptional = true;
          found.suggestMust = false;
        }
        easyCommitQuiet(found);
        invalidateCalendarCache();
        try { if(typeof _easyBestTick === 'number'){ _easyBestTick++; _easyJgAt = -1; } } catch(_t){}
        renderAll();
        showStatus('must suggest on “'+found.name+'” → '+(inp.checked?'on':'off'),'ok');
      });
    });
  }


  function renderCalendar(){
   var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
   if(!RC){
    return '<p class="hint cmp-bad">calendar_model.js missing — re-author via living-core write_asset vendor/calendar_model.js</p>';
   }
   var horizon = getCalendarHorizon();
   if(!horizon){
    return '<p class="hint">No calendar horizon.</p>';
   }
   var profile = horizon.profile || ensureCalendar();
   var work = (profile && profile.work) || {};
   var resolved = RC.resolvePath(horizon, {
    year: calNav.year,
    month: calNav.month,
    week: calNav.week,
    day: calNav.day,
    hour: calNav.hour,
    actionId: calNav.actionId
   });
   var level = resolved.level;
   var node = resolved.node;
   var html = '';
   // Year/month cards use the same run-loop calendar snapshot as the live rollup.
   var rollLive = (lastBest && lastBest.calendar) || { gain:0, living:0, debt:0, surplus:0, nActs:0 };
   var mGain = Number(rollLive.gain) || 0;
   var mSpend = (Number(rollLive.living) || 0) + (Number(rollLive.debt) || 0);
   var mNet = Number(rollLive.surplus) || 0;
   var sur = mNet;
   var mw = horizon.moneyWorld || {};
   html += '<p class="cal-legend">Year card = <span class="m-gain">+income/yr</span> · <span class="m-spend">−spend/yr</span> · <b>net/yr</b>. Work carries daily NET. Purple = work shift.</p>';
   try {
    var rv = typeof buildLiveReview === 'function' ? buildLiveReview() : null;
    if(rv && rv.dirty){
     html += '<p class="hint cmp-bad"><b>REVIEW gate open</b> — joys/actions/expenses differ from baseline or off-sheet custom spend. '+
      'Open <b>REVIEW</b> tab before trusting year money. '+esc((rv.gate&&rv.gate.note)||'')+'</p>';
    }
   } catch(_re){}

   // living-core densest map deep-link (attention only — not a second ledger)
   html += '<details class="cal-densest" id="cal-densest-map" style="margin:0.5rem 0 0.75rem;padding:0.5rem 0.75rem;border:1px solid var(--border,#333);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(187,154,247,0.06)">'+
    '<summary style="cursor:pointer;color:var(--accent,#bb9af7);font-weight:600">living-core densest map · Year→Month→Week→Day→Hour→Action→Item</summary>'+
    '<p class="hint" style="margin:0.5rem 0 0.35rem">Attention structure from <span class="c">views/calendar_layers.md</span> · '+
    '<b>never invent $</b> · money SoT = EXPENSES + SUMMARY surplus. Motion (moho L11) is decorative.</p>'+
    '<div class="cal-grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(7rem,1fr));gap:0.35rem">'+
    '<div class="cal-cell" data-cal-densest="year" style="cursor:default"><div class="ct">Year</div><div class="cm">surplus×12 · HDAME</div></div>'+
    '<div class="cal-cell" data-cal-densest="month" style="cursor:default"><div class="ct">Month</div><div class="cm">living+debt cash</div></div>'+
    '<div class="cal-cell" data-cal-densest="week" style="cursor:default"><div class="ct">Week</div><div class="cm">PSN · Apple Dev</div></div>'+
    '<div class="cal-cell" data-cal-densest="day" style="cursor:default"><div class="ct">Day</div><div class="cm">work 15–23 CST</div></div>'+
    '<div class="cal-cell" data-cal-densest="hour" style="cursor:default"><div class="ct">Hour</div><div class="cm">action slots</div></div>'+
    '<div class="cal-cell" data-cal-densest="action" style="cursor:default"><div class="ct">Action→Item</div><div class="cm">sheet only</div></div>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<p class="hint" style="margin:0.4rem 0 0">Deep-link: open densest view in repo · '+
    '<a href="./views/calendar_layers.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--accent,#bb9af7)">views/calendar_layers.md</a> · '+
    '<a href="./views/moho_roadmap.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--accent,#bb9af7)">moho_roadmap</a></p>'+
    '</details>';

   // editor always visible at top when on calendar
   html += renderCalendarEditor(horizon);

   // breadcrumb
   html += '<div class="cal-crumb" id="cal-crumb">';
   resolved.trail.forEach(function(t, i){
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+(i===resolved.trail.length-1?' active':'')+'" data-cal-trail="'+i+'">'+esc(t.label)+'</button>';
    if(i < resolved.trail.length - 1) html += '<span style="color:var(--muted)">›</span>';
   });
   html += '</div>';

   if(level === 'years'){
    html += '<h3 class="section-h">Years · net = calendar surplus × 12</h3><div class="cal-grid">';
    horizon.years.forEach(function(y){
     html += '<div class="cal-cell" data-cal-year="'+y.yearIndex+'">'+
      '<div class="ct">'+esc(y.label)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cs">'+money(mNet * 12, 'auto')+'/yr net</div>'+
      '<div class="cm">'+money(mGain*12,'gain')+' · '+money(mSpend*12,'spend')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cm">= '+money(mNet,'auto')+' × 12 mo</div></div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
   } else if(level === 'year'){
    html += '<h3 class="section-h">Months in '+esc(node.label)+' · yr net '+money(node.net!=null?node.net:mNet*12,'auto')+'</h3><div class="cal-grid">';
    (node.months || []).forEach(function(m){
     html += '<div class="cal-cell" data-cal-month="'+m.monthIndex+'">'+
      '<div class="ct">'+esc(m.name)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cs">'+money(m.net != null ? m.net : mNet, 'auto')+' net</div>'+
      '<div class="cm">'+money(m.gain||mGain,'gain')+' · '+money(m.spend!=null?m.spend:mSpend,'spend')+'</div></div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
   } else if(level === 'month'){
    html += '<h3 class="section-h">Weeks · '+esc(node.label)+' · net '+money(node.net!=null?node.net:mNet,'auto')+
     ' · '+money(node.gain||mGain,'gain')+' / '+money(node.spend!=null?node.spend:mSpend,'spend')+'</h3><div class="cal-grid">';
    (node.weeks || []).forEach(function(w){
     html += '<div class="cal-cell" data-cal-week="'+w.weekIndex+'">'+
      '<div class="ct">Week '+w.week+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cs">'+money(w.net != null ? w.net : -w.cost, 'auto')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cm">'+w.dayCount+' days</div></div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<h3 class="section-h">All days</h3><div class="cal-grid">';
    (node.days || []).forEach(function(d){
     html += '<div class="cal-cell'+(d.isWeekend?' weekend':'')+(d.isWorkDay?' work-hour':'')+'" data-cal-day="'+d.dayIndex+'" data-cal-week-of-day="'+Math.floor(d.dayIndex/7)+'">'+
      '<div class="ct">'+esc(d.dowName)+' '+d.day+(d.isWorkDay?' · work':'')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cs">'+money(d.net != null ? d.net : -d.cost, 'auto')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cm">'+d.actionCount+' actions</div></div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<h3 class="section-h">Month actions (work income + expenses + living-core customs)</h3>';
    html += '<p class="hint">Money law: sheet $ is <b>monthly once</b> — cadence (daily, 2 days, paint…) only schedules when it shows, never multiplies $ × days.</p>';
    if(node.moneyCheck && node.moneyCheck.attributionOk === false){
     html += '<p class="hint cmp-mid">Attribution shares '+money(node.scheduledSpend,'spend')+' vs monthly-once '+money(node.spend,'spend')+' (ok if yearly off-month / empty paint).</p>';
    }
    (node.actions || []).forEach(function(a){
     var pol = a.polarity || (a.kind === 'work' ? 'gain' : 'spend');
     var occ = a.occurs;
     var occLbl = (occ != null && pol !== 'gain')
      ? (occ > 0 ? ' · '+occ+' day'+(occ===1?'':'s')+' scheduled' : ' · not scheduled this month')
      : (occ != null ? ' · '+occ+' work day'+(occ===1?'':'s') : '');
     html += '<div class="cal-action" style="cursor:default">'+
      '<div><span class="an">'+esc(a.name)+'</span><span class="ak">'+esc((a.cadence||a.kind||'')+' · '+pol)+'</span>'+
      '<span class="cs" style="float:right">'+moneyAction(a.monthBill != null ? a.monthBill : a.cost, pol)+'/mo once'+occLbl+'</span></div>';
     if(a.note) html += '<div class="cm">'+esc(a.note)+'</div>';
     if(a.scheduleOnly) html += '<div class="cm">schedule only · [REDACTED-AMOUNT]</div>';
     (a.items || []).forEach(function(it){
      html += '<div class="cal-item-row"><span>'+esc(it.name)+'</span><span class="calc">'+moneyAction(it.monthBill != null ? it.monthBill : it.cost, it.polarity||pol)+'/mo</span></div>';
     });
     html += '</div>';
    });
   } else if(level === 'week'){
    html += '<h3 class="section-h">Days · Week '+(node.week)+' · net '+money(node.net!=null?node.net:-node.cost,'auto')+'</h3><div class="cal-grid">';
    (node.days || []).forEach(function(d){
     html += '<div class="cal-cell'+(d.isWeekend?' weekend':'')+(d.isWorkDay?' work-hour':'')+'" data-cal-day="'+d.dayIndex+'">'+
      '<div class="ct">'+esc(d.dowName)+' '+d.day+(d.isWorkDay?' · work':'')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cs">'+money(d.net != null ? d.net : -d.cost, 'auto')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cm">'+d.itemCount+' items</div></div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
   } else if(level === 'day'){
    html += '<h3 class="section-h">Hours · '+esc(resolved.trail[resolved.trail.length-1].label)+
     ' · net '+money(node.net!=null?node.net:-node.cost,'auto')+
     (node.isWorkDay ? ' · <span class="c">work '+(work.startHour||15)+'–'+(work.endHour||23)+' CST</span>' : '')+
     '</h3>';
    html += '<p class="hint">☀ <b>All day</b> band = whole-day items (many at once). Timed hours run <b>alongside</b>. Purple = work. <b>Drag</b> a custom action onto an hour to re-place (P49). <b>Free/busy densest</b> (P55): free = no work + no timed action.</p>';
    // P55 densest free/busy summary for this weekday
    try {
     var dayDow = null;
     if(node.dow != null) dayDow = node.dow;
     else if(node.dowName){
      var dn = String(node.dowName).slice(0,3).toLowerCase();
      var map = {sun:0,mon:1,tue:2,wed:3,thu:4,fri:5,sat:6};
      dayDow = map[dn];
     }
     var freeN = 0, busyN = 0;
     (node.hours || []).forEach(function(h){
      var nAct = (h.actions && h.actions.length) || 0;
      var busy = !!(h.isWork || nAct);
      if(busy) busyN++; else freeN++;
     });
     html += '<div class="cal-fb-bar" style="margin:6px 0 10px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border,#333);font-size:0.78rem">';
     html += '<b>Free/busy</b> · free <span class="c">'+freeN+'h</span> · busy <span class="c">'+busyN+'h</span>';
     html += ' · work purple · timed actions count as busy · <span class="cm">planning only · no auto-reschedule · $ not from freebusy</span>';
     html += '</div>';
    } catch(_fb){}
    // —— All-day band (Google style) ——
    var ads = node.allDayActions || [];
    html += '<div class="cal-allday-band">';
    html += '<div class="cal-allday-label">All day'+(ads.length?' · '+ads.length:'')+'</div>';
    if(!ads.length){
     html += '<p class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 0">No all-day items — paint with <b>all day</b> checked, or hours = <code>all</code>.</p>';
    } else {
     html += '<div class="cal-allday-chips">';
     ads.forEach(function(a){
      var pol = a.polarity || 'spend';
      var canDrag = a.kind !== 'work' && a.id && String(a.id).indexOf('act_') === 0;
      html += '<div class="cal-allday-chip'+(canDrag?' cal-act-drag':'')+'" data-cal-action="'+esc(a.id)+'" data-cal-allday="1"'+(canDrag?' draggable="true" data-act-drag-id="'+esc(a.id)+'"':'')+' title="'+esc(a.name)+(canDrag?' · drag to hour':'')+'">';
      html += '<span class="an">'+esc(a.name)+'</span>';
      if(!a.scheduleOnly && pol !== 'neutral') html += '<span class="cs">'+moneyAction(a.cost, pol)+'</span>';
      else html += '<span class="ak">sched</span>';
      html += '</div>';
     });
     html += '</div>';
    }
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<div class="cal-hours">';
    (node.hours || []).forEach(function(h){
     var nAct = (h.actions && h.actions.length) || 0;
     var nAd = (h.allDayAlongside && h.allDayAlongside.length) || ads.length;
     var empty = nAct === 0;
     var multi = nAct > 1;
     var cls = 'cal-cell cal-hour-drop';
     if(empty) cls += ' hour-empty';
     if(multi) cls += ' hour-overlap';
     if(nAd && empty) cls += ' hour-allday-only';
     if(h.isWork) cls += ' work-hour';
     var hNet = h.net != null ? h.net : ((h.gain||0) - (h.spend!=null?h.spend:h.cost||0));
     // all hours clickable so free slots can still be inspected / added via paint
     html += '<div class="'+cls+'" data-cal-hour="'+h.hour+'" data-hour-drop="'+h.hour+'">'+
      '<div class="ct">'+esc(h.label)+(h.isWork?' · W':'')+(multi?' · ⧉'+nAct:'')+(nAd?' · ☀':'')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cs">'+(empty && !h.isWork && !nAd ? '—' : money(hNet,'auto'))+'</div>';
     if(empty && !nAd){
      html += '<div class="cm">'+(h.isWork?'BUSY work':'FREE')+' · drop here</div>';
     } else {
      var names = (h.actions||[]).map(function(a){ return a.name; }).slice(0, 3);
      if(names.length) html += '<div class="cm cal-overlap-names">'+esc(names.join(' · '))+(nAct>3?' +'+(nAct-3):'')+'</div>';
      if(nAd){
       var adNames = (h.allDayAlongside && h.allDayAlongside.length)
        ? h.allDayAlongside
        : ads.map(function(a){ return a.name; });
       html += '<div class="cm cal-allday-alongside">☀ '+esc(adNames.slice(0,3).join(' · '))+(adNames.length>3?'…':'')+'</div>';
      }
      html += '<div class="cm">'+(h.isWork||nAct?'BUSY ':'')+nAct+' timed'+(nAd?' · '+nAd+' all-day':'')+' · drop</div>';
     }
     html += '</div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
   } else if(level === 'hour'){
    var hGain = node.gain || 0, hSpend = node.spend != null ? node.spend : (node.cost || 0);
    var nOv = (node.actions && node.actions.length) || 0;
    var adList = node.allDayActions || [];
    html += '<h3 class="section-h">Actions at '+esc(node.label || ('hour '+node.hour))+
     ' · '+money(hGain,'gain')+' / '+money(hSpend,'spend')+(node.isWork?' · WORK CST':'')+
     (nOv>1?' · <span class="c">'+nOv+' timed</span>':'')+
     (adList.length?' · <span class="c">☀'+adList.length+' all-day</span>':'')+'</h3>';
    if(adList.length){
     html += '<div class="cal-allday-band" style="margin-bottom:10px">';
     html += '<div class="cal-allday-label">Also all day (alongside this hour)</div>';
     html += '<div class="cal-allday-chips">';
     adList.forEach(function(a){
      html += '<div class="cal-allday-chip" data-cal-action="'+esc(a.id)+'" data-cal-allday="1">';
      html += '<span class="an">'+esc(a.name)+'</span></div>';
     });
     html += '</div></div>';
    }
    if(nOv > 1){
     html += '<p class="hint">Overlapping timed actions. Money is monthly once from sheet SoT.</p>';
    }
    if(!(node.actions && node.actions.length)){
     html += '<p class="hint">'+(node.isWork?'On shift (work block).':'No timed actions this hour.')+(adList.length?' All-day items above still apply.':' Paint timed or all-day via schedule editor.')+'</p>';
    }
    (node.actions || []).forEach(function(a, ai){
     var pol = a.polarity || (a.kind === 'work' ? 'gain' : 'spend');
     var clickable = a.items && a.items.length;
     var canDrag = a.kind !== 'work' && a.id && String(a.id).indexOf('act_') === 0;
     html += '<div class="cal-action'+(nOv>1?' cal-action-overlap':'')+(canDrag?' cal-act-drag':'')+'"'+(clickable?' data-cal-action="'+esc(a.id)+'"':' style="cursor:default"')+(canDrag?' draggable="true" data-act-drag-id="'+esc(a.id)+'" title="Drag to another hour on Day view"':'')+'>'+
      '<div><span class="an">'+esc(a.name)+'</span>'+
      (nOv>1?'<span class="ak">#'+(ai+1)+' of '+nOv+'</span>':'')+
      '<span class="ak">'+esc((a.cadence||a.kind||'')+' · '+pol)+(canDrag?' · drag':'')+'</span>'+
      '<span class="cs" style="float:right">'+moneyAction(a.amount != null ? a.amount : a.cost, pol)+'</span></div>'+
      (a.note ? '<div class="cm">'+esc(a.note)+'</div>' : '')+
      '<div class="cm">'+(a.kind==='work'?(a.spanHours||8)+'h shift · click for income':((a.items&&a.items.length)||0)+' items'+(clickable?' · click':'')+(canDrag?' · drag to re-hour':''))+'</div></div>';
    });
    html += '<p class="hint" style="margin-top:8px">P49: open <b>Day</b> view to drop this action on another hour (or all-day → timed).</p>';
   } else if(level === 'action'){
    var apol = node.polarity || (node.kind === 'work' ? 'gain' : 'spend');
    html += '<h3 class="section-h">Items · “'+esc(node.name)+'” · '+esc(apol)+(node.cadence?' · '+esc(node.cadence):'')+'</h3>';
    if(node.note) html += '<p class="hint">'+esc(node.note)+'</p>';
    if(node.kind === 'work'){
     html += '<p class="hint">Work income from <b>INCOME.NET</b>. Day share = monthly net ÷ work days. Month '+moneyAction(node.monthAmount != null ? node.monthAmount : node.cost, 'gain')+' <b>once</b>.</p>';
    } else if(node.allDay){
     html += '<p class="hint">☀ <b>All day</b> — runs the whole day alongside timed actions and other all-day items. Day share of monthly-once bill.</p>';
    } else {
     html += '<p class="hint">Day/hour $ = share of the <b>monthly once</b> bill (cadence never multiplies). Month column is SoT.</p>';
    }
    html += '<table class="grid"><thead><tr><th>Item</th><th>Day share</th><th>Month once</th><th>Pol</th><th>Note</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    (node.items || []).forEach(function(it){
     var ip = it.polarity || apol;
     var mo = it.monthBill != null ? it.monthBill : (it.monthCost != null ? it.monthCost : it.cost);
     html += '<tr><td>'+esc(it.name)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="calc">'+moneyAction(it.cost, ip)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="calc">'+moneyAction(mo, ip)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(ip)+'</td>'+
      '<td style="text-align:left;font-size:10px">'+esc((it.moneyLaw==='monthly_once'?'once/mo · ':'')+(it.note||''))+'</td></tr>';
    });
    if(!(node.items && node.items.length) && node.kind === 'work'){
     html += '<tr><td>Work income (NET)</td><td class="calc">'+moneyAction(node.amount||node.cost,'gain')+'</td><td class="calc">'+moneyAction(node.monthAmount||0,'gain')+'</td><td>gain</td><td>from INCOME</td></tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';
    if(window.RankingJoys && window.RankingJoys.joy_calendar){
     var sc = window.RankingJoys.joy_calendar.score({
      x: Math.abs(node.cost)||0,
      y: apol === 'gain' ? Math.abs(node.cost)||1 : 1,
      hour: calNav.hour,
      kind: node.kind,
      daysUsed: 1,
      D: 30,
      isWorkDay: true,
      workStart: work.startHour||15,
      workEnd: work.endHour||23,
      allowWorkHours: !!node.allowWorkHours
     });
     html += '<p class="hint">joy_calendar score: <span class="c">'+Number(sc).toFixed(3)+'</span></p>';
    }
   }

   return renderEasyShell(html);
  }

  function bindCalendar(){
   bindEasyCal();
   var root = $('pane');
   if(!root) return;
   root.querySelectorAll('[data-cal-trail]').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){
     var i = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-cal-trail'), 10);
     var horizon = getCalendarHorizon();
     if(!horizon) return;
     var resolved = window.RankingCalendar.resolvePath(horizon, calNav);
     var t = resolved.trail[i];
     if(!t) return;
     if(t.level === 'years'){

      calNav.week = t.week != null ? t.week : null;
      calNav.day = t.day != null ? t.day : null;
      calNav.hour = t.hour != null ? t.hour : null;
      calNav.actionId = t.actionId != null ? t.actionId : null;
      // clear deeper than this trail level
      if(t.level === 'year'){ calNav.month = null; calNav.week = null; calNav.day = null; calNav.hour = null; calNav.actionId = null; }
      if(t.level === 'month'){ calNav.week = null; calNav.day = null; calNav.hour = null; calNav.actionId = null; }
      if(t.level === 'week'){ calNav.day = null; calNav.hour = null; calNav.actionId = null; }
      if(t.level === 'day'){ calNav.hour = null; calNav.actionId = null; }
      if(t.level === 'hour'){ calNav.actionId = null; }
     }
     renderAll();
    };

      cat.push(res.action || res);
      window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions = cat;
     } catch(_c){}
     easyCommitCalendar(profile);
     invalidateCalendarCache();
     calNav.hour = hour;
     calNav.actionId = null;
     if(typeof mohoFire === 'function') mohoFire('calendar-drill');
     renderAll();
     showStatus('Moved “'+(res.action && res.action.name || id)+'” → hour '+hour+' · Save to keep','ok');
    });
   });

   // P53: densest quick-add (Fantastical-lite · always [REDACTED-AMOUNT])
   function densestQuickParse(line){
    var raw = String(line||'').trim();
    if(!raw) return null;
    var lower = raw.toLowerCase();
    var cadence = 'weekly', days = null, nDays = null, hours = [10], allDay = false;
    var DOW = {sun:0,sunday:0,mon:1,monday:1,tue:2,tues:2,tuesday:2,wed:3,wednesday:3,thu:4,thur:4,thursday:4,fri:5,friday:5,sat:6,saturday:6};
    if(/\ball\s*day\b|\ballday\b/.test(lower)){ allDay = true; hours = ['all']; }
    if(/\bweekdays?\b|\bm-?f\b/.test(lower)){ cadence = 'weekdays'; days = [1,2,3,4,5]; }
    else if(/\bdaily\b|\bevery\s*day\b/.test(lower)){ cadence = 'daily'; }
    else if(/\bevery\s+(\d+)\s*days?\b/.test(lower)){ cadence = 'every_n_days'; nDays = parseInt(RegExp.[REDACTED-AMOUNT],10)||2; }
    var dayHits = [];
    Object.keys(DOW).forEach(function(k){ if(new RegExp('\\b'+k+'\\b','i').test(lower)) dayHits.push(DOW[k]); });
    if(dayHits.length){
     var seen={}; days=[]; dayHits.forEach(function(d){ if(!seen[d]){ seen[d]=1; days.push(d); } });
     if(!/\bweekdays?\b|\bdaily\b/.test(lower)) cadence = 'weekly';
    }
    if(!allDay){
     var hm = lower.match(/(?:@\s*)?(\d{1,2})(?::\d{2})?\s*-\s*(\d{1,2})/);
     if(hm){ hours = [parseInt(hm[1],10)]; }
     else {
      var hm2 = lower.match(/(?:@\s*|at\s+)?(\d{1,2})(?::\d{2})?\s*(am|pm)?\b/);
      if(hm2){
       var h = parseInt(hm2[1],10); var ap = hm2[3];
       if(ap==='pm'&&h<12) h+=12; if(ap==='am'&&h===12) h=0;
       if(h>=0&&h<=23) hours=[h];
      }
     }
    }
    var name = raw
     .replace(/\b(weekdays?|m-?f|daily|every\s+day|every\s+\d+\s*days?|all\s*day|allday)\b/gi,' ')
     .replace(/\b(sun(day)?|mon(day)?|tue(s|sday)?|wed(nesday)?|thu(r|rsday)?|fri(day)?|sat(urday)?)\b/gi,' ')
     .replace(/(?:@\s*|at\s+)?\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(am|pm)?(?:\s*-\s*\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?)?/gi,' ')
     .replace(/[,]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() || 'Schedule block';
    var id = 'act_'+name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g,'').slice(0,40);
    var act = {
     id:id, name:name, kind:'schedule', polarity:'neutral', amountMonthly:0,
     scheduleOnly:true, section:'SCHEDULE', cadence:cadence,
     hours: allDay?['all']:hours, allDay:allDay, enabled:true,
     author:'ranking_ui-quick', note:'quick-add densest · [REDACTED-AMOUNT] · never invent money'
    };
    if(days) act.days = days;
    if(nDays) act.nDays = nDays;
    return act;
   }
   var quickGo = $('cal-quick-go');

   // P51: densest ICS export (schedule · never invent $ into calendar)
   var icsBtn = $('cal-ics-export');
   if(icsBtn) icsBtn.onclick = function(){
    try {
     var customs = getCalendarCustomActions() || [];
     var lines = [
      'BEGIN:VCALENDAR','VERSION:2.0','PRODID:-//living-core//ranking_ui//EN',
      'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN','METHOD:PUBLISH',
      'X-WR-CALNAME:living-core schedule',
      'X-LIVING-LAW:schedule only · money SoT sheet · never invent $'
     ];
     var DOW = ['SU','MO','TU','WE','TH','FR','SA'];
     function escI(s){ return String(s||'').replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/;/g,'\\;').replace(/,/g,'\\,').replace(/\n/g,'\\n'); }
     function pad(n){ return (n<10?'0':'')+n; }
     customs.forEach(function(a){
      if(!a || a.enabled===false) return;
      var allDay = !!(a.allDay || (Array.isArray(a.hours)&&a.hours[0]==='all'));
      var h = allDay ? 0 : (Array.isArray(a.hours)?parseInt(a.hours[0],10):10);
      if(!isFinite(h)) h=10;
      var ymd = '[REDACTED-ACCOUNT-DIGITS]';
      var start = allDay ? ymd : (ymd+'T'+pad(h)+'0000');
      var endH = Math.min(23, h+1);
      var end = allDay ? '[REDACTED-ACCOUNT-DIGITS]' : (ymd+'T'+pad(endH)+'0000');
      var days = a.days;
      if(a.cadence==='weekdays') days=[1,2,3,4,5];
      var by = Array.isArray(days) ? days.map(function(d){ return DOW[d]; }).filter(Boolean).join(',') : 'MO,WE,FR';
      var rr = 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY='+by;
      if(a.cadence==='daily'||a.cadence==='always') rr='FREQ=DAILY';
      if(a.cadence==='every_n_days'&&a.nDays) rr='FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL='+Math.max(1,parseInt(a.nDays,10)||1);
      var amt = Number(a.amountMonthly!=null?a.amountMonthly:a.amount)||0;
      var desc = (a.note||'')+' · '+(amt>0?'money SoT sheet (not ICS)':'schedule only [REDACTED-AMOUNT]');
      lines.push('BEGIN:VEVENT');
      lines.push('UID:'+escI((a.id||a.name)+'@living-core.ranking_ui'));
      lines.push('SUMMARY:'+escI(a.name||a.id));
      if(allDay){ lines.push('DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:'+start); lines.push('DTEND;VALUE=DATE:'+end); }
      else { lines.push('DTSTART:'+start); lines.push('DTEND:'+end); }
      lines.push('RRULE:'+rr);
      lines.push('DESCRIPTION:'+escI(desc));
      lines.push('END:VEVENT');
     });
     lines.push('END:VCALENDAR');
     var blob = new Blob([lines.join('\r\n')+'\r\n'], { type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8' });
     var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
     var a = document.createElement('a');
     a.href = url;
     a.download = 'living_calendar_export.ics';
     document.body.appendChild(a);
     a.click();
     setTimeout(function(){ try{ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); a.remove(); }catch(_r){} }, 500);
     showStatus('ICS exported · schedule only · sheet $ unchanged','ok');
    } catch(err){
     showStatus('ICS export failed: '+(err&&err.message||err),'bad');
    }
   };
   // Manage actions: add / update / remove (workbook SoT; top Save → localStorage)
   function parseActDaysCad(cad, ds){
    var o = {};
    ds = (ds || '').trim();
    if(cad === 'weekly' || cad === 'some_days'){
     o.days = ds ? ds.split(/[,\s]+/).map(function(x){ return parseInt(x,10); }).filter(function(n){ return isFinite(n); }) : [1,3,5];
    } else if(cad === 'every_n_days'){
     o.nDays = parseInt(ds, 10) || 11;
    } else if(cad === 'monthly'){
     o.day = parseInt(ds, 10) || 1;
    } else if(cad === 'yearly'){
     o.day = parseInt(ds, 10) || 15;
     o.month = 6;
    } else if(cad === 'weekdays'){
     o.days = [1,2,3,4,5];
    }
    return o;
   }

    var prev = null;
    if(editId){
     var allActs = getCalendarCustomActions() || [];
     for(var pi=0; pi<allActs.length; pi++){
      if(allActs[pi] && allActs[pi].id === editId){ prev = allActs[pi]; break; }
     }
    }
    var act = Object.assign({}, prev || {}, {
     id: id,
     name: name,
     kind: kind,
     polarity: pol,
     amountMonthly: amt,
     cadence: cad,
     hours: hours,
     allDay: allDay,
     note: note,
     scheduleOnly: amt === 0 || kind === 'schedule' || kind === 'joy',
     section: (amt === 0 || kind === 'schedule' || kind === 'joy') ? 'SCHEDULE' : 'CUSTOM',
     author: 'ranking_ui',
     enabled: true
    }, extra);
    if(RC && RC.upsertCustomAction) profile = RC.upsertCustomAction(profile, act);
    else {
     profile.customActions = (profile.customActions||[]).filter(function(a){ return a && a.id !== id && a.name !== name; });
     profile.customActions.push(act);
    }
    // mirror into live catalog so getCalendarCustomActions sees it without reload
    try {
     window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ = window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ || { actions: [] };
     var cat = window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions || [];
     cat = cat.filter(function(a){ return a && a.id !== id && a.name !== name; });
     cat.push(act);
     window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions = cat;
    } catch(_c){}
    easyCommitCalendar(profile);
    invalidateCalendarCache();
    if(typeof mohoFire === 'function') mohoFire('calendar-drill');
    clearActEditForm();
    renderAll();
    showStatus((editId?'Updated':'Added')+' “'+name+'” · id '+id+' · Save to keep on disk','ok');
   };
   var cancelBtn = $('cal-act-cancel');
   if(cancelBtn) cancelBtn.onclick = function(){
    clearActEditForm();
    if($('cal-act-name')) $('cal-act-name').value = '';
    if($('cal-act-note')) $('cal-act-note').value = '';
    if($('cal-act-amt')) $('cal-act-amt').value = '0';
    showStatus('Edit cancelled','ok');
   };
   root.querySelectorAll('.cal-act-edit').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){
     var id = btn.getAttribute('data-act-id');
     if(!id) return;
     var acts = getCalendarCustomActions() || [];
     var found = null;
     for(var i=0; i<acts.length; i++){
      if(acts[i] && acts[i].id === id){ found = acts[i]; break; }
     }
     if(!found){ showStatus('Action not found: '+id,'bad'); return; }
     fillActEditForm(found);
    };
   });
   root.querySelectorAll('.cal-act-del').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){
     var id = btn.getAttribute('data-act-id');
     if(!id) return;
     var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
     var profile = ensureCalendar();
     var delName = null;
     try {
      ((profile && profile.customActions) || []).forEach(function(a){
        if(a && (a.id === id || a.name === id)) delName = a.name;
      });
      ((window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ && window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions) || []).forEach(function(a){
        if(a && (a.id === id || a.name === id)) delName = delName || a.name;
      });
     } catch(_n){}
     if(RC && RC.removeCustomAction) profile = RC.removeCustomAction(profile, id);
     else profile.customActions = (profile.customActions||[]).filter(function(a){ return a && a.id !== id && a.name !== id; });
     try {
      if(window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ && Array.isArray(window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions)){
       window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions = window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions.filter(function(a){
        return a && a.id !== id && a.name !== id;
       });
      }
     } catch(_r){}
     try {
      if(typeof easyTombstoneCalendarAction === 'function'){
        easyTombstoneCalendarAction(id);
        if(delName) easyTombstoneCalendarAction(delName);
      }
     } catch(_t){}
     easyCommitCalendar(profile);
     invalidateCalendarCache();
     clearActEditForm();
     renderAll();
     showStatus('Removed action '+id+' · Save to keep (stays gone on reload)','ok');
    };
   });

   // —— Visual year paint handlers ——
   function paintSetKey(key, on){
    if(!key) return;
    if(on) calPaint.selected[key] = 1;
    else delete calPaint.selected[key];
    var el = root.querySelector('.cal-yv-day[data-cp-key="'+key+'"]');
    if(el){
     if(on) el.classList.add('sel');
     else el.classList.remove('sel');
     el.classList.remove('sel-range');
    }
    var cnt = root.querySelector('.cp-count');
    if(cnt) cnt.textContent = countPaintSelected() + ' day(s)';
   }
   function paintSetRange(keyA, keyB, on){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    if(!RC || !RC.keysInRange || !keyA || !keyB) return;
    var profile = ensureCalendar();
    var startYear = (profile && profile.startYear) || new Date().getFullYear();
    var keys = RC.keysInRange(keyA, keyB, startYear);
    keys.forEach(function(k){ paintSetKey(k, on !== false); });
    return keys;
   }
   function paintPreviewRange(keyA, keyB){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var yv = $('cp-year-view');
    if(!yv) return;
    // clear prior preview classes
    yv.querySelectorAll('.cal-yv-day.sel-range').forEach(function(el){
     el.classList.remove('sel-range');
    });
    calPaint.rangePreview = Object.create(null);
    if(!RC || !RC.keysInRange || !keyA || !keyB) return;
    var profile = ensureCalendar();
    var startYear = (profile && profile.startYear) || new Date().getFullYear();
    var keys = RC.keysInRange(keyA, keyB, startYear);
    keys.forEach(function(k){
     calPaint.rangePreview[k] = 1;
     var el = yv.querySelector('.cal-yv-day[data-cp-key="'+k+'"]');
     if(el && !el.classList.contains('sel')) el.classList.add('sel-range');
    });
   }
   function markAnchor(key){
    calPaint.anchorKey = key || null;
    var yv = $('cp-year-view');
    if(!yv) return;
    yv.querySelectorAll('.cal-yv-day.anchor').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.remove('anchor'); });
    if(key){
     var el = yv.querySelector('.cal-yv-day[data-cp-key="'+key+'"]');
     if(el) el.classList.add('anchor');
    }
   }
   function readPaintHours(){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var adEl = $('cp-allday-live') || $('cp-allday');
    if(adEl) calPaint.allDay = !!adEl.checked;
    var el = $('cp-hours-live') || $('cp-hours');
    var hs = ((el && el.value) || (calPaint.allDay ? 'all' : '10')).trim();
    if(calPaint.allDay || /^(all|allday|\*)$/i.test(hs)){
     calPaint.allDay = true;
     calPaint.hours = ['all'];
     return calPaint.hours;
    }
    if(RC && RC.parseHoursField){
     var ph = RC.parseHoursField(hs);
     if(ph.allDay){ calPaint.allDay = true; calPaint.hours = ['all']; }
     else { calPaint.allDay = false; calPaint.hours = ph.hours.length ? ph.hours : [10]; }
    } else {
     var hours = hs.split(/[,\s]+/).map(function(x){ return parseInt(x,10); }).filter(function(n){ return isFinite(n) && n>=0 && n<=23; });
     calPaint.hours = hours.length ? hours : [10];
     calPaint.allDay = false;
    }
    return calPaint.hours;
   }
   var adLive = $('cp-allday-live');
   if(adLive) adLive.onchange = function(){
    calPaint.allDay = !!adLive.checked;
    var hi = $('cp-hours-live');
    if(hi){
     hi.disabled = calPaint.allDay;
     if(calPaint.allDay) hi.value = 'all';
     else if(hi.value === 'all') hi.value = '10';
    }
   };
   var cpStart = $('cp-start');
   if(cpStart) cpStart.onclick = function(){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var pick = ($('cp-pick-item') && $('cp-pick-item').value) || '';
    var newName = (($('cp-new-name') && $('cp-new-name').value) || '').trim();
    var hs = (($('cp-hours') && $('cp-hours').value) || '10').trim();
    var allDay = !!($('cp-allday') && $('cp-allday').checked);
    var hours = [10];
    if(allDay){ hours = ['all']; }
    else if(RC && RC.parseHoursField){
     var ph = RC.parseHoursField(hs);
     allDay = ph.allDay; hours = allDay ? ['all'] : ph.hours;
    } else if(/^(all|allday|\*)$/i.test(hs)){ allDay = true; hours = ['all']; }
    else {
     hours = hs.split(/[,\s]+/).map(function(x){ return parseInt(x,10); }).filter(function(n){ return isFinite(n); });
     if(!hours.length) hours = [10];
    }
    var target = null;
    if(newName){
     target = { kind: 'action', id: 'act_'+newName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'_').slice(0,40), name: newName, hours: hours, allDay: allDay };
    } else if(pick.indexOf('item:')===0){
     target = { kind: 'item', id: pick.slice(5), name: pick.slice(5), hours: hours, allDay: allDay };
    } else if(pick.indexOf('action:')===0){
     var aid = pick.slice(7);
     var acts = getCalendarCustomActions() || [];
     var a = acts.filter(function(x){ return x && (x.id===aid || x.name===aid); })[0];
     target = { kind: 'action', id: (a && a.id) || aid, name: (a && a.name) || aid, hours: hours, allDay: allDay || !!(a && a.allDay) };
    }
    if(!target){ showStatus('Pick an expense/action or type a new name','bad'); return; }
    startCalPaint(target);
   };
   root.querySelectorAll('.cal-paint-item').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){
     var name = btn.getAttribute('data-item-name');
     if(!name) return;
     startCalPaint({ kind: 'item', id: name, name: name, hours: [10] });
    };
   });
   root.querySelectorAll('.cal-paint-act').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){
     startCalPaint({
      kind: 'action',
      id: btn.getAttribute('data-act-id'),
      name: btn.getAttribute('data-act-name'),
      hours: [10]
     });
    };
   });
   var cpPaintNew = $('cal-act-paint-new');
   if(cpPaintNew) cpPaintNew.onclick = function(){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    var name = (($('cal-act-name')&&$('cal-act-name').value)||'').trim();
    if(!name){ showStatus('Enter action name first','bad'); return; }
    var hs = (($('cal-act-hrs')&&$('cal-act-hrs').value)||'10').trim();
    var allDay = !!($('cal-act-allday') && $('cal-act-allday').checked);
    var hours = [10];
    if(allDay) hours = ['all'];
    else if(RC && RC.parseHoursField){
     var ph = RC.parseHoursField(hs);
     allDay = ph.allDay; hours = allDay ? ['all'] : (ph.hours.length?ph.hours:[10]);
    } else if(/^(all|allday|\*)$/i.test(hs)){ allDay = true; hours = ['all']; }
    else {
     hours = hs.split(/[,\s]+/).map(function(x){return parseInt(x,10);}).filter(function(n){return isFinite(n);});
     if(!hours.length) hours = [10];
    }
    startCalPaint({
     kind: 'action',
     id: 'act_'+name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'_').slice(0,40),
     name: name,
     hours: hours,
     allDay: allDay
    });
   };
   var zy = $('cp-zoom-year');
   if(zy) zy.onclick = function(){ calPaint.zoom = 'year'; renderAll(); };
   var zm = $('cp-zoom-multi');
   if(zm) zm.onclick = function(){ calPaint.zoom = 'multi'; renderAll(); };
   root.querySelectorAll('[data-cp-year]').forEach(function(chip){
    chip.onclick = function(){
     calPaint.yearIndex = parseInt(chip.getAttribute('data-cp-year'), 10) || 0;
     calPaint.zoom = 'year';
     renderAll();
    };
   });
   var ra = $('cp-repeat-all');
   if(ra) ra.onchange = function(){ calPaint.repeatAllYears = !!ra.checked; };
   var cl = $('cp-clear');
   if(cl) cl.onclick = function(){
    var yi = calPaint.yearIndex;
    Object.keys(calPaint.selected).forEach(function(k){
     if(k.indexOf(String(yi)+'-')===0) delete calPaint.selected[k];
    });
    renderAll();
   };
   var ca = $('cp-clear-all');
   if(ca) ca.onclick = function(){ calPaint.selected = Object.create(null); renderAll(); };
   var cc = $('cp-cancel');
   if(cc) cc.onclick = function(){
    calPaint.active = false;
    calPaint.target = null;
    calPaint.selected = Object.create(null);
    calPaint.anchorKey = null;
    calPaint.rangePreview = null;
    renderAll();
   };
   var add = $('cp-add');
   if(add) add.onclick = function(){
    var RC = window.RankingCalendar;
    if(!calPaint.target){ showStatus('No paint target','bad'); return; }
    readPaintHours();
    var n = countPaintSelected();
    if(!n && !calPaint.repeatAllYears){ showStatus('Select at least one day','bad'); return; }
    var rule = RC.selectionToRule(calPaint.selected, {
     hours: calPaint.allDay ? ['all'] : calPaint.hours,
     allDay: !!calPaint.allDay,
     note: 'painted · ' + calPaint.target.name + (calPaint.allDay ? ' · all day' : ''),
     repeatAllYears: calPaint.repeatAllYears,
     allowWorkHours: true,
     overlap: true
    });
    var profile = ensureCalendar();
    if(calPaint.target.kind === 'item'){
     if(RC.setItemOverride) profile = RC.setItemOverride(profile, calPaint.target.name, rule);
     else {
      profile.itemOverrides = profile.itemOverrides || {};
      profile.itemOverrides[calPaint.target.name] = Object.assign({}, profile.itemOverrides[calPaint.target.name], rule);
     }
     easyCommitCalendar(profile);
     showStatus('Painted '+n+' day(s) on “'+calPaint.target.name+'”'+(calPaint.allDay?' · ALL DAY':'')+' · Save to keep','ok');
    } else {
     var act = {
      id: calPaint.target.id,
      name: calPaint.target.name,
      kind: 'schedule',
      polarity: 'neutral',
      amountMonthly: 0,
      cadence: 'selected',
      hours: calPaint.allDay ? ['all'] : calPaint.hours,
      allDay: !!calPaint.allDay,
      selectedKeys: rule.selectedKeys,
      yearMarks: rule.yearMarks,
      repeatMarks: rule.repeatMarks,
      allowWorkHours: true,
      scheduleOnly: true,
      section: 'SCHEDULE',
      note: rule.note,
      author: 'ranking_ui-paint',
      enabled: true
     };
     if(RC.upsertCustomAction) profile = RC.upsertCustomAction(profile, act);
     else {
      profile.customActions = (profile.customActions||[]).filter(function(a){ return a && a.id !== act.id; });
      profile.customActions.push(act);
     }
     try {
      window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ = window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ || { actions: [] };
      var cat = (window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions || []).filter(function(a){ return a && a.id !== act.id; });
      cat.push(act);
      window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions = cat;
     } catch(_m){}
     easyCommitCalendar(profile);
     showStatus('Added “'+act.name+'” · '+n+' day(s) · same hour as others OK · Save to keep','ok');
    }
    calPaint.active = false;
    calPaint.target = null;
    calPaint.anchorKey = null;
    calPaint.rangePreview = null;
    // showStatus('ok') already pulses the toast — no second save FX
    invalidateCalendarCache();
    renderAll();
   };

   // paint: click/drag · Shift+click range first→last · Alt/right erase
   // Overlaps: painting action B on days already used by A is intentional.
   var yv = $('cp-year-view');
   if(yv){
    function keyFromEvt(e){
     var el = e.target;
     if(!el) return null;
     // allow clicks on busy-dot child
     if(el.classList && el.classList.contains('cp-busy-dot')) el = el.parentElement;
     if(!el || !el.getAttribute) return null;
     if(!el.classList.contains('cal-yv-day') || el.classList.contains('empty')) return null;
     return el.getAttribute('data-cp-key');
    }
    yv.onmousedown = function(e){
     var key = keyFromEvt(e);
     if(!key) return;
     e.preventDefault();
     var erase = e.button === 2 || e.altKey;
     // Shift+click / shift-drag: range from first (anchor) to last (this key)
     if(e.shiftKey && !erase){
      var from = calPaint.anchorKey || key;
      paintSetRange(from, key, true);
      markAnchor(from);
      calPaint.drag = { mode: 'range', from: from };
      calPaint.rangePreview = null;
      return;
     }
     if(erase){
      calPaint.drag = { mode: 'erase' };
      paintSetKey(key, false);
      return;
     }
     // plain click: set anchor + paint (or toggle with meta/ctrl)
     var on = true;
     if(e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey){
      on = !calPaint.selected[key];
     } else if(calPaint.selected[key] && !e.shiftKey){
      // second click on same selected day toggles off (without killing range workflow)
      on = false;
     }
     markAnchor(key);
     calPaint.drag = { mode: on ? 'paint' : 'erase' };
     paintSetKey(key, on);
    };
    yv.onmouseover = function(e){
     var key = keyFromEvt(e);
     if(!key) return;
     if(calPaint.drag){
      if(calPaint.drag.mode === 'range' && calPaint.drag.from){
       // live-extend range while shift-dragging
       paintSetRange(calPaint.drag.from, key, true);
       paintPreviewRange(calPaint.drag.from, key);
       return;
      }
      paintSetKey(key, calPaint.drag.mode === 'paint');
      return;
     }
     // hover preview when holding Shift with an anchor
     if(e.shiftKey && calPaint.anchorKey){
      paintPreviewRange(calPaint.anchorKey, key);
     }
    };
    yv.onmousemove = function(e){
     if(!e.shiftKey || calPaint.drag) return;
     var key = keyFromEvt(e);
     if(key && calPaint.anchorKey) paintPreviewRange(calPaint.anchorKey, key);
    };
    yv.onmouseup = function(){
     calPaint.drag = null;
     calPaint.rangePreview = null;
    };
    yv.oncontextmenu = function(e){ e.preventDefault(); };
    // clear range preview when leaving shift
    yv.onmouseleave = function(){
     if(!calPaint.drag){
      calPaint.rangePreview = null;
      yv.querySelectorAll('.cal-yv-day.sel-range').forEach(function(el){
       el.classList.remove('sel-range');
      });
     }
    };
   }
   if(!window.__cpPaintDocUp){
    window.__cpPaintDocUp = true;
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', function(){ calPaint.drag = null; });
    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){
     if(e.key === 'Shift'){
      calPaint.rangePreview = null;
      var y = document.getElementById('cp-year-view');
      if(y) y.querySelectorAll('.cal-yv-day.sel-range').forEach(function(el){
       el.classList.remove('sel-range');
      });
     }
    });
   }
  }



  /* ========== REVIEW gate: per-item accept/reject → Save ========== */
  function buildLiveReview(){
   if(typeof RankingReview === 'undefined' || !RankingReview.buildReview){
    return {
     ok: false,
     error: 'review_model missing — hard-reload (vendor/review_model.js failed to parse). Offline still works once loaded: baseline in localStorage.'
    };
   }
   var money = { net:0, living:0, debtCash:0, surplus:0 };
   try {
    var I = calcIncome(), E = calcExpenses(), D = calcDebt(), S = calcSummary();
    money = { net:I.net, living:E.grand, debtCash:D.payments, surplus:S.surplus };
   } catch(_e){}
   // Offline densest: disk fetch optional; localStorage baseline always available
   var baseline = window.__REVIEW_BASELINE_DISK__ ||
    (RankingReview.loadLocalBaseline && RankingReview.loadLocalBaseline()) ||
    null;
   var pending = window.__REVIEW_PENDING__ || { proposals: [] };
   var rep;
   try {
    rep = RankingReview.buildReview({
     workbook: WB,
     money: money,
     joyCatalog: window.__RANKING_JOYS_CATALOG__,
     calendarActions: (window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__ && window.__CALENDAR_ACTIONS__.actions) ||
      (WB.calendar && WB.calendar.customActions) || [],
     baseline: baseline,
     pending: pending,
     moho: (window.__MOHO_LAYERS__ ? {
      rev: window.__MOHO_LAYERS__.rev,
      svg_first: !!window.__MOHO_LAYERS__.svg_first,
      layers_n: (window.__MOHO_LAYERS__.layers||[]).length,
      events_n: window.__MOHO_LAYERS__.events ? Object.keys(window.__MOHO_LAYERS__.events).length : 0,
      catalog_hash: null
     } : null)
    });
   } catch(err){
    return { ok:false, error: 'review build failed: ' + (err && err.message || err) };
   }
   rep.has_baseline = !!(baseline && (baseline.joys || baseline.at));
   if(!rep.items && RankingReview.listReviewItems) rep.items = RankingReview.listReviewItems(rep);
   _lastReview = rep;
   return rep;
  }

  function reviewDecisionMap(){
   return (typeof RankingReview !== 'undefined' && RankingReview.loadDecisions)
    ? RankingReview.loadDecisions()
    : {};
  }

  function renderReview(){
   var rep = buildLiveReview();
   var html = '';
   html += '<p class="hint"><b>REVIEW</b> — accept/reject paints <b>PROJ+REVIEW</b> live (before Save). '+
    '<b>Save</b> commits staging + rebaselines catalog. '+
    'Promote: <b>Review→Proj</b> then <b>Proj→Current</b> when ready. '+
    'Budget cuts never touch CURRENT until you promote. Undecided → <span class="cmp-bad">reject</span>.</p>';

   if(!rep || !rep.ok){
    html += '<p class="hint cmp-bad">Review offline: '+esc(rep && rep.error || 'unknown')+'</p>';
    return html;
   }

   var dec = reviewDecisionMap();
   var items = rep.items || [];
   var nAcc = 0, nRej = 0, nPend = 0;
   items.forEach(function(it){
    if(dec[it.key]==='accept') nAcc++;
    else if(dec[it.key]==='reject') nRej++;
    else nPend++;
   });

   html += '<div class="cal-edit">';
   html += '<h3>Per-item decisions · '+items.length+' items · '+
    '<span class="cmp-ok">'+nAcc+' accept</span> · '+
    '<span class="cmp-bad">'+nRej+' reject</span> · '+
    '<span class="cmp-mid">'+nPend+' undecided→reject</span></h3>';
   html += '<p class="hint">'+(rep.gate && rep.gate.note ? esc(rep.gate.note) : '')+
    ' · baseline '+(rep.has_baseline ? 'yes' : 'none')+
    (rep.dirty ? ' · <b class="cmp-bad">dirty</b>' : ' · <span class="cmp-ok">clean</span>')+
    ' · <b>Save</b> top bar applies</p>';
   html += '<div class="row">';
   html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="btn-review-accept-all">Accept all</button>';
   html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="btn-review-reject-all">Reject all</button>';
   html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="btn-review-refresh">Recompute</button>';
   html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="btn-review-disk">Load disk pending</button>';
   html += '</div>';
   html += '</div>';

   var L = rep.live || {}, M = L.money || {};
   html += '<p class="hint">Live money: NET '+money(M.net,'gain')+' · living '+money(M.living,'spend')+
    ' · debt '+money(M.debtCash,'spend')+' · surplus '+money(M.surplus,'auto')+'</p>';

   if(!items.length){
    var diskN = (window.__REVIEW_PENDING__ && window.__REVIEW_PENDING__.proposals)
      ? window.__REVIEW_PENDING__.proposals.length : 0;
    html += '<p class="hint cmp-ok">Nothing to review — SoT matches baseline and no leakage.</p>';
    html += '<p class="hint">If living-core hop0 says REVIEW pending: press <b>Load disk pending</b> or hard-reload (cache). Disk discover lives in joys/review/pending.json.</p>';
    if(diskN) html += '<p class="hint cmp-mid">Pending buffer has '+diskN+' proposal(s) — Recompute if table empty.</p>';
    return html;
   }

   html += '<table class="grid"><thead><tr>'+
    '<th>Decision</th><th>Domain</th><th>Op</th><th>Item</th><th>Detail</th>'+
    '</tr></thead><tbody>';
   items.forEach(function(it){
    var d = dec[it.key] || '';
    var accActive = d === 'accept' ? ' active' : '';
    var rejActive = d === 'reject' ? ' active' : '';
    html += '<tr data-review-key="'+esc(it.key)+'">';
    html += '<td style="text-align:left;white-space:nowrap">';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+accActive+'" data-rev-dec="accept" data-key="'+esc(it.key)+'">Accept</button> ';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill'+rejActive+'" data-rev-dec="reject" data-key="'+esc(it.key)+'">Reject</button>';
    html += '</td>';
    html += '<td class="calc">'+esc(it.domain)+'</td>';
    html += '<td>'+esc(it.op)+'</td>';
    html += '<td style="text-align:left">'+esc(it.title)+'<div class="cm">'+esc(it.id)+'</div></td>';
    html += '<td style="text-align:left;font-size:10px;max-width:280px">'+esc(it.detail)+'</td>';
    html += '</tr>';
   });
   html += '</tbody></table>';
   html += '<p class="hint">Accept/Reject updates <b>PROJ+REVIEW</b> immediately. <b>Save</b> keeps it. Use scenario toggle to compare CURRENT / PROJECTED / PROJ+REVIEW.</p>';
   return html;
  }

  function bindReview(){
   var root = $('pane');
   if(!root) return;
   function afterDecision(msg, kind){
    try { liveReviewPreview(); } catch(_lp){}
    try { if(window.JWorkbookMoho&&JWorkbookMoho.reviewFlash) JWorkbookMoho.reviewFlash(); } catch(_m){}
    renderAll();
    if(msg) showStatus(msg, kind || 'ok');
   }
   root.querySelectorAll('[data-rev-dec]').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.onclick = function(){
     var key = btn.getAttribute('data-key');
     var val = btn.getAttribute('data-rev-dec');
     if(typeof RankingReview !== 'undefined' && RankingReview.setDecision){
      RankingReview.setDecision(key, val);
     }
     afterDecision('Decision '+val+' · PROJ+REVIEW updated live','ok');
    };
   });
   var sa = $('btn-review-accept-all');
   if(sa) sa.onclick = function(){
    var rep = buildLiveReview();
    var m = {};
    (rep.items||[]).forEach(function(it){ m[it.key] = 'accept'; });
    if(RankingReview.saveDecisionsMap) RankingReview.saveDecisionsMap(m);
    afterDecision('All accept · PROJ+REVIEW live · Save to commit','ok');
   };
   var sr = $('btn-review-reject-all');
   if(sr) sr.onclick = function(){
    var rep = buildLiveReview();
    var m = {};
    (rep.items||[]).forEach(function(it){ m[it.key] = 'reject'; });
    if(RankingReview.saveDecisionsMap) RankingReview.saveDecisionsMap(m);
    afterDecision('All reject · PROJ+REVIEW = projected base · Save to commit','info');
   };
   var ref = $('btn-review-refresh');
   if(ref) ref.onclick = function(){ renderAll(); };
   var diskBtn = $('btn-review-disk');
   if(diskBtn) diskBtn.onclick = function(){
    // Drop stale local Save hide so joys/review/pending.json reappears
    try {
     if(typeof RankingReview !== 'undefined' && RankingReview.LOCAL_PENDING_KEY){
      localStorage.removeItem(RankingReview.LOCAL_PENDING_KEY);
     } else {
      localStorage.removeItem('jworkbook_review_pending_v1');
     }
    } catch(_ls){}
    fetch('./joys/review/pending.json', { cache: 'no-store' })
     .then(function(r){ return r.ok ? r.json() : { proposals: [] }; })
     .catch(function(){ return { proposals: [] }; })
     .then(function(disk){
      window.__REVIEW_PENDING__ = disk || { proposals: [] };
      var n = (window.__REVIEW_PENDING__.proposals || []).length;
      try {
       if(typeof RankingReview !== 'undefined' && RankingReview.saveLocalPending){
        RankingReview.saveLocalPending({
         proposals: window.__REVIEW_PENDING__.proposals || [],
         at: new Date().toISOString(),
         after_save: false,
         from_disk: true
        });
       }
      } catch(_s){}
      renderAll();
      showStatus('Loaded disk pending: '+n+' proposal(s)','ok');
     });
   };
  }

  /** Apply REVIEW accept/reject into localStorage (called only from top Save). */
  function applyReviewOnSave(){
   if(typeof RankingReview === 'undefined' || !RankingReview.applyDecisionsLocal){
    return null;
   }
   var rep = buildLiveReview();
   if(!rep || !rep.ok) return null;
   var items = rep.items || [];
   var decisions = reviewDecisionMap();
   var hasDec = Object.keys(decisions).length > 0;
   var hasPend = !!(rep.pending && rep.pending.proposals && rep.pending.proposals.length);
   // Apply when dirty / pending proposals / user marked decisions
   if(!items.length) return null;
   if(!rep.dirty && !hasDec && !hasPend) return null;
   items.forEach(function(it){
    if(decisions[it.key] !== 'accept' && decisions[it.key] !== 'reject'){
     decisions[it.key] = 'reject';
    }
   });
   var result = RankingReview.applyDecisionsLocal(rep, decisions);
   if(!result || !result.ok) return result;
   // budget cut accepts → PROJ+REVIEW [REDACTED-AMOUNT] only (CURRENT/PROJECTED stay until promote)
   try {
    var cuts = result.budget_projected_cuts || [];
    if(cuts.length && typeof applyBudgetProposalsToReview === 'function'){
     var nCut = applyBudgetProposalsToReview(cuts.map(function(c){
      return { payload: { discovery: c.discovery || 'cut_expense', expenseName: c.expenseName } };
     }));
     result.review_cuts_applied = nCut;
    } else {
     try { liveReviewPreview(); } catch(_lp2){}
    }
   } catch(_bc){}
   // NEVER replace WB.calendar.customActions with REVIEW snapshot.actions.
   // That catalog has no selectedKeys/day marks — Save after an expense edit was
   // wiping every scenario calendar placement. Calendar SoT stays the scenario bags.
   // Accepted proposal actions (with real placements) can be merged in later if needed.
   try { if(typeof invalidateCalendarCache === 'function') invalidateCalendarCache(); } catch(_ic){}
   return result;
  }

   var html = '';
   html += '<h3 class="section-h">Joy models · many lenses (money→happy is one)</h3>';
   if(!cat || !cat.models || !cat.models.length){
    html += '<p class="hint cmp-mid">No models.json yet — living-core modality <code>joy_models</code> + '+
     '<code>living_ranking action=discover</code> writes it. Until then: classic money/H/E only.</p>';
    return html;
   }
   html += '<p class="hint">Authored by living-core <b>joy_models</b> · discovery → REVIEW. '+
    'Each row is a realistic relationship model over the same joys + sheet. '+
    'Law: never invent $. Updated '+(cat.at ? esc(String(cat.at).slice(0,19)) : '—')+'.</p>';
   html += '<table class="grid"><thead><tr><th>Model</th><th>Status</th><th>Class</th><th>Joys</th><th>Law / explore</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
   cat.models.forEach(function(m){

    if(m.candidate_joys && m.candidate_joys.length){
     html += '<div class="cm">+cand '+esc(m.candidate_joys.join(', '))+'</div>';
