     '<div class="cm">'+esc(m.explore||'')+'</div></td>';
    html += '</tr>';
   });
   html += '</tbody></table>';
   return html;
  }


  /* ========== PREVIEW: score breakdown for Board-selected items (easy108) ========== */
  /** PREVIEW portions ↔ HDAME+T (+ custom) rank factors. Values come from RANKS, not this tab. */
  var PREVIEW_PORTIONS = [
    { id: 'happy', label: 'H · Happy', joyId: 'joy_age_happiness', dim: 'H' },
    { id: 'days', label: 'D · Days', joyId: 'joy_calendar', dim: 'D' },
    { id: 'time', label: 'T · Time/calendar', joyId: 'joy_calendar', dim: 'T' },
    { id: 'money', label: 'M · Money', joyId: 'joy_money', dim: 'M' },
    { id: 'age', label: 'A · Age (↓better)', joyId: 'joy_age_happiness', dim: 'A', inverted: true },
    { id: 'external', label: 'E · External (↓better)', joyId: 'joy_external', dim: 'E', inverted: true },
    { id: 'debt', label: 'U · Debt/urgency', joyId: 'joy_debt_urgency', dim: 'U' },
    { id: 'surplus', label: 'S · Surplus/freedom', joyId: 'joy_surplus_freedom', dim: 'S' }
  ];

  function previewPortionsList(){
    var base = PREVIEW_PORTIONS.slice();
    var extra = (WB && Array.isArray(WB.customRankDims)) ? WB.customRankDims : [];
    extra.forEach(function(d){
      if(!d || !d.id) return;
      var pid = 'dim_' + d.id;
      var exists = false;
      base.forEach(function(p){ if(p && (p.dim === d.id || p.id === pid)) exists = true; });
      if(exists) return;
      base.push({
        id: pid,
        label: d.id + ' · ' + (d.label || d.id) + (d.invert ? ' (↓better)' : ''),
        dim: d.id,
        inverted: !!d.invert,
        joyId: null
      });
    });
    return base;
  }

  function portionIdToDim(it){
    if(!it) return null;
    if(it.dim) return it.dim;
    var id = it.id || '';
    if(!id) return null;
    var list = null;
    try { list = previewPortionsList(); } catch(_p){ list = PREVIEW_PORTIONS; }
    if(!list) list = PREVIEW_PORTIONS;
    for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
      if(list[i] && list[i].id === id) return list[i].dim || null;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function previewEnsureState(){
    if(!easyCal.previewSub) easyCal.previewSub = 'breakdown';
    if(easyCal.previewPortion == null || easyCal.previewPortion === '') easyCal.previewPortion = 'time';
    if(!easyCal.previewJmethods || typeof easyCal.previewJmethods !== 'object') easyCal.previewJmethods = {};
    if(!Array.isArray(easyCal.previewActIds)) easyCal.previewActIds = [];
    if(easyCal.previewPickBoard == null) easyCal.previewPickBoard = false;
    if(!easyCal.previewFactors || typeof easyCal.previewFactors !== 'object') easyCal.previewFactors = {};
  }

  function previewFactorActKey(act){
    if(!act) return '';
    return String(act.id || act.expenseName || act.name || '');
  }

  /** Portion on/off for this act’s PREVIEW total — values themselves live on RANKS (HDAME+T+…). */
  function previewDefaultFactors(act){
    var portions = {};
    var actName = '';
    try { actName = (typeof easyExpenseNameOf === 'function') ? easyExpenseNameOf(act) : ((act && (act.expenseName || act.name)) || ''); } catch(_n){ actName = (act && (act.expenseName || act.name)) || ''; }
    if(!actName && act) actName = act.name || act.expenseName || '';
    previewPortionsList().forEach(function(p){
      if(!p) return;
      if(p.dim && actName && typeof isRankNonFactor === 'function' && isRankNonFactor(p.dim, actName)){
        portions[p.id] = false;
      } else {
        portions[p.id] = true;
      }
    });
    return { portions: portions };
  }

  function previewGetFactors(act){
    previewEnsureState();
    var key = previewFactorActKey(act);
    var base = previewDefaultFactors(act);
    var ov = (key && easyCal.previewFactors[key]) ? easyCal.previewFactors[key] : null;
    var portions = ov ? Object.assign({}, base.portions, ov.portions || {}) : Object.assign({}, base.portions);
    var actName = '';
    try { actName = (typeof easyExpenseNameOf === 'function') ? easyExpenseNameOf(act) : ((act && (act.expenseName || act.name)) || ''); } catch(_n){ actName = (act && (act.expenseName || act.name)) || ''; }
    if(!actName && act) actName = act.name || act.expenseName || '';
    if(actName){
      previewPortionsList().forEach(function(p){
        if(!p || !p.dim) return;
        if(typeof isRankNonFactor === 'function' && isRankNonFactor(p.dim, actName)){
          portions[p.id] = false;
        }
      });
    }
    return { portions: portions };
  }

  function previewSetFactor(act, field, value){
    previewEnsureState();
    var key = previewFactorActKey(act);
    if(!key) return;
    if(!easyCal.previewFactors[key]) easyCal.previewFactors[key] = { portions: {} };
    var bag = easyCal.previewFactors[key];
    if(field === 'portion'){
      if(!bag.portions) bag.portions = {};
      if(value && value.id) bag.portions[value.id] = !!value.on;
    }
  }

  function previewResetFactors(act){
    previewEnsureState();
    var key = previewFactorActKey(act);
    if(key) delete easyCal.previewFactors[key];
  }

  function previewFactorsHtml(act, portions){
    if(!act) return '';
    var f = previewGetFactors(act);
    var row = null;
    try { row = previewActScoreRow(act); } catch(_r){ row = null; }
    var actName = '';
    try { actName = (typeof easyExpenseNameOf === 'function') ? easyExpenseNameOf(act) : ((act && (act.expenseName || act.name)) || ''); } catch(_n){ actName = (act && (act.expenseName || act.name)) || ''; }
    if(!actName && act) actName = act.name || act.expenseName || '';
    var html = '';
    html += '<div class="preview-factors" id="preview-factors">';
    html += '<div class="preview-factors-head">';
    html += '<h3 class="section-h" style="margin:8px 0 4px">Score factors</h3>';
    html += '<div class="preview-factors-actions">';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill" data-preview-goto-ranks="1" title="Edit drag-order / values on RANKS">Edit on RANKS</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill" data-preview-add-factor="1" title="Add a new rank score factor">+ factor</button>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="pill preview-factors-reset" data-preview-factor-reset="1" title="Reset which factors count for this item">Reset</button>';
    html += '</div></div>';
    html += '<p class="hint">Toggle which score factors count toward /1000 for <b>this item</b>. '
      + 'Factor-vs-factor <b>weights</b> (how H/M/D… weigh against each other) are edited in <b>Factor importance</b> above. '
      + 'Per-item drag order / $ values live on <b>RANKS</b>. Non-factors stay off automatically.</p>';
    html += '<div class="preview-factor-toggles">';
    (portions || previewPortionsList()).forEach(function(p){
      if(!p || p.world) return;
      var ranksNF = !!(p.dim && actName && typeof isRankNonFactor === 'function' && isRankNonFactor(p.dim, actName));
      var on = ranksNF ? false : !(f.portions && f.portions[p.id] === false);
      var rankBit = '';
      if(row && p.dim){
        var rk = row['rank'+p.dim];
        var sc = row['score'+p.dim];
        if(rk != null) rankBit = ' · #'+rk;
        if(sc != null && isFinite(Number(sc))) rankBit += ' · '+((Number(sc)*100).toFixed(2))+'%';
      }
      if(ranksNF) rankBit += ' · non-factor on RANKS';
      html += '<label class="preview-factor-tog'+(on?' on':'')+(p.inverted?' invert':'')+(ranksNF?' ranks-nf':'')+'">';
      html += '<input type="checkbox" data-preview-factor-portion="'+esc(p.id)+'"'+(on?' checked':'')+(ranksNF?' disabled':'')+' />';
      html += ' '+esc(p.label)+esc(rankBit);
      html += '</label>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
    if(!row){
      html += '<p class="hint">Not on RANKS yet — open RANKS (all Board items are included) or click Edit on RANKS.</p>';
    }
    html += '</div>';
    return html;
  }

  /** Selected Board/calendar acts for PREVIEW — prefer Selection lane / easyInSelection. */
  function previewSelectedActs(){
    previewEnsureState();
    var acts = [];
    try { acts = (typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function') ? (easyScheduleActions() || []) : []; } catch(_a){ acts = []; }
    /* Explicit “back to Board items” — ignore calendar Selection until a tile is picked again */
    if(easyCal.previewPickBoard){
      if(easyCal.previewActIds && easyCal.previewActIds.length){
        /* still picking — show only already-toggled board ids if any (usually empty after Clear) */
      } else {
        return [];
      }
    }
    /* Board multi-select wins — never run Suggest packer just to preview a tile */
    if(easyCal.previewActIds && easyCal.previewActIds.length){
      var set = Object.create(null);
      easyCal.previewActIds.forEach(function(id){ if(id) set[String(id)] = true; });
      return acts.filter(function(a){
        if(!a) return false;
        var id = a.id || a.name;
        var nm = a.name;
        return (id && set[String(id)]) || (nm && set[String(nm)]);
      });
    }
    if(easyCal.sel && easyCal.sel.length){
      /* cheap: acts covering selection days — skip easySelGhostPlan (was freezing Safari) */
      return acts.filter(function(a){
        return a && typeof easyInSelection === 'function' && easyInSelection(a);
      });
    }
    return [];
  }

  function previewFocusAct(list){
    previewEnsureState();
    if(!list || !list.length) return null;
    if(easyCal.previewItemId){
      for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
        var id = list[i] && (list[i].id || list[i].name);
        if(id === easyCal.previewItemId) return list[i];
      }
    }
    var first = list[0];
    easyCal.previewItemId = first ? (first.id || first.name) : null;
    return first;
  }

  function previewActScoreRow(act){
    if(!act) return null;
    /* NEVER call easyBestRank here — Exp6 SimulatedBest freezes/crashes Safari on tile click. */
    var ranks = null;
    try { ranks = calcRanks(); } catch(_r){ ranks = null; }
    var nm = null;
    try { nm = (typeof easyExpenseNameOf === 'function') ? easyExpenseNameOf(act) : (act.expenseName || act.name); } catch(_n){ nm = act.expenseName || act.name; }
    var row = ranks && ranks.byName && nm ? ranks.byName[nm] : null;
    if(row){
      var s = Number(row.score);
      if(!isFinite(s)) s = Number(row.scoreRaw) || 0;
      if(s < 0) s = 0;
      var items = (ranks.items || []).slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (Number(b.score)||0) - (Number(a.score)||0); });
      var rank = 0;
      for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++){
        if(items[i] && (items[i].name === nm)){ rank = i + 1; break; }
      }
      /* Remap composite share so board-best score01 → 1000 (harmonic #1 is ~0.25 raw). */
      var rating1000 = 0;
      try {
        var cMaxes = previewBoardRankShareMaxes();
        var cMax = cMaxes ? Number(cMaxes._composite) : 0;
        if(cMax > 0) rating1000 = previewRating1000From01(s / cMax);
        else if(typeof easyClampRating === 'function') rating1000 = easyClampRating(s);
        else rating1000 = Math.round(s * 1000);
      } catch(_rm){
        rating1000 = (typeof easyClampRating === 'function') ? easyClampRating(s) : Math.round(s * 1000);
      }
      /* Return full calcRanks row (scoreH/D/T/U/S/A/M/E, ranks, name, …) so PREVIEW dim portions are not 0. */
      var out = {};
      for(var k in row){ if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(row, k)) out[k] = row[k]; }
      out.rank = rank || null;
      out.score01 = s;
      out.rating1000 = rating1000;
      out.source = 'calcRanks';
      return out;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function previewAmtOf(act){
    if(!act) return 0;
    try {
      if(typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function') return Math.abs(Number(easyActMonthAmount(act)) || 0);
    } catch(_e){}
    return Math.abs(Number(act.amountMonthly != null ? act.amountMonthly : act.amount) || 0);
  }

  function previewRating1000From01(score01){
    if(typeof easyClampRating === 'function') return easyClampRating(score01);
    var n = Math.round((Number(score01) || 0) * 1000);
    if(n < 0) n = 0;
    if(n > 1000) n = 1000;
    return n;
  }

  /**
   * Map horizon contribution → 0–1000.
   * Uses log1p so one huge Work earn (or 13y×daily) does not pin every month-bill under 100.
   * Best Board contribution on that portion still lands at 1000.
   */
  function previewHorizonTo1000(contrib, maxContrib){
    var c = Number(contrib);
    if(!isFinite(c) || c < 0) c = 0;
    var m = Number(maxContrib);
    if(!isFinite(m) || m <= 0){
      return previewRating1000From01(Math.log1p(c) / Math.log1p(c + 1));
    }
    if(c <= 0) return 0;
    return previewRating1000From01(Math.log1p(c) / Math.log1p(m));
  }

  /** Unique months (and day-hits) this act fires across the HDAME horizon — cached per paint. */
  function previewHorizonHits(act){
    previewEnsureState();
    if(!act) return { months: 1, days: 1, years: (typeof easyHorizonYears === 'function' ? easyHorizonYears() : 150) };
    var id = String(act.id || act.name || '');
    var tick = easyCal._previewPaintTick || 0;
    if(!easyCal._previewHits) easyCal._previewHits = Object.create(null);
    var cache = easyCal._previewHits[id];
    if(cache && cache.tick === tick) return cache;

    var years = (typeof easyHorizonYears === 'function') ? easyHorizonYears() : 150;
    if(!isFinite(years) || years < 1) years = 150;
    var monthsHit = 0, daysHit = 0;
    var monthSet = Object.create(null);

    /* Fast path from cadence — avoids 13×365 walk when we can estimate honestly */
    var cad = String(act.cadence || '');
    var isWork = !!(act.kind === 'work' || act.polarity === 'gain');
    var nDays = Number(act.nDays);
    var estimated = false;
    try {
      if(isWork || cad === 'weekdays' || (act.days && act.days.length === 5)){
        /* liveBest charges work once per focus month; horizon months = years*12 */
        monthsHit = Math.round(years * 12);
        daysHit = Math.round(years * 261);
        estimated = true;
      } else if(cad === 'daily'){
        monthsHit = Math.round(years * 12);
        daysHit = Math.round(years * 365.25);
        estimated = true;
      } else if(cad === 'monthly' || (act.day != null && act.day !== '' && cad !== 'every_n_days' && cad !== 'selected')){
        monthsHit = Math.round(years * 12);
        daysHit = monthsHit;
        estimated = true;
      } else if(cad === 'yearly' || cad === 'annual'){
        monthsHit = Math.round(years);
        daysHit = monthsHit;
        estimated = true;
      } else if(cad === 'every_n_days' || (isFinite(nDays) && nDays > 0)){
        var n = Math.max(1, nDays || 11);
        daysHit = Math.max(1, Math.floor(years * 365.25 / n));
        monthsHit = Math.min(Math.round(years * 12), Math.max(1, daysHit));
        estimated = true;
      }
    } catch(_est){ estimated = false; }

    if(!estimated){
      try {
        var occ = (typeof easyCollectOccurs === 'function') ? (easyCollectOccurs(act) || []) : [];
        for(var i = 0; i < occ.length; i++){
          var p = occ[i];
          if(!p) continue;
          daysHit++;
          var mk = String(p.y) + '-' + String(p.m);
          if(!monthSet[mk]){ monthSet[mk] = true; monthsHit++; }
        }
      } catch(_o){}
    }
    if(monthsHit < 1) monthsHit = 1;
    if(daysHit < 1) daysHit = 1;

    cache = { months: monthsHit, days: daysHit, years: years, tick: tick, estimated: estimated };
    easyCal._previewHits[id] = cache;
    return cache;
  }

  /**
   * Per-tick raw → horizon contribution.
   * Money/debt/external accumulate by months (run() is month-layered).
   * Time accumulates by day-hits (daysUse fires with calendar span).
   * Gain vs spend money use separate max buckets so earn-$ does not crush moneyToHappy.
   */
  function previewHorizonContrib(portionId, raw, act){
    var hits = previewHorizonHits(act);
    var r = Number(raw);
    if(!isFinite(r) || r < 0) r = 0;
    var pid = String(portionId || '');
    if(pid === 'time') return r * hits.days;
    return r * hits.months;
  }

  function previewMoneyBucket(act){
    if(act && (act.kind === 'work' || act.polarity === 'gain')) return 'moneyGain';
    return 'moneySpend';
  }

  function previewBoardHorizonMaxes(){
    previewEnsureState();
    if(easyCal._previewMaxes && easyCal._previewMaxesTick === easyCal._previewPaintTick){
      return easyCal._previewMaxes;
    }
    var maxes = { moneyGain: 0, moneySpend: 0, time: 0, debt: 0, external: 0 };
    var board = [];
    try { board = (typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function') ? (easyScheduleActions() || []) : []; } catch(_b){}
    for(var i = 0; i < board.length; i++){
      var a = board[i];
      if(!a) continue;
      var parts = previewBuildBreakdownRaw(a);
      for(var j = 0; j < parts.length; j++){
        var p = parts[j];
        if(!p || p.world || !p.known) continue;
        var rv = Number(p.raw != null ? p.raw : p.value);
        if(!isFinite(rv)) continue;
        var h = previewHorizonContrib(p.id, rv, a);
        var key = (p.id === 'money') ? previewMoneyBucket(a) : p.id;
        if(maxes[key] == null) continue;
        if(h > maxes[key]) maxes[key] = h;
      }
    }
    easyCal._previewMaxes = maxes;
    easyCal._previewMaxesTick = easyCal._previewPaintTick;
    return maxes;
  }

  /**
   * Per-tick max RANKS dim share (score{D}) across calcRanks items that are factors on that dim.
   * Also tracks _composite = max score01 / score so board best → 1000 when remapped.
   */
  function previewBoardRankShareMaxes(){
    previewEnsureState();
    if(easyCal._previewRankMaxes && easyCal._previewRankMaxesTick === easyCal._previewPaintTick){
      return easyCal._previewRankMaxes;
    }
    var maxes = Object.create(null);
    var dims = [];
    try { dims = (typeof allRankDims === 'function') ? allRankDims() : ['H','D','A','M','E','T','U','S']; } catch(_d){ dims = ['H','D','A','M','E','T','U','S']; }
    for(var di = 0; di < dims.length; di++){ maxes[dims[di]] = 0; }
    maxes._composite = 0;
    var items = [];
    try {
      var ranks = (typeof calcRanks === 'function') ? calcRanks() : null;
      items = (ranks && ranks.items) || [];
      if(!items.length && typeof rankItems === 'function'){
        /* Fallback: join rankItems names with byName scores if items empty */
        var ri = rankItems() || [];
        var byName = (ranks && ranks.byName) || {};
        items = ri.map(function(it){
          if(!it) return null;
          var nm = it.name;
          return (nm && byName[nm]) ? byName[nm] : it;
        }).filter(Boolean);
      }
    } catch(_r){ items = []; }
    for(var i = 0; i < items.length; i++){
      var it = items[i];
      if(!it) continue;
      var nm = it.name || '';
      var sComp = Number(it.score);
      if(!isFinite(sComp)) sComp = Number(it.scoreRaw) || 0;
      if(sComp > maxes._composite) maxes._composite = sComp;
      for(var dj = 0; dj < dims.length; dj++){
        var d = dims[dj];
        if(nm && typeof isRankNonFactor === 'function' && isRankNonFactor(d, nm)) continue;
        var sv = Number(it['score' + d]);
        if(!isFinite(sv) || sv < 0) continue;
        if(sv > maxes[d]) maxes[d] = sv;
      }
    }
    easyCal._previewRankMaxes = maxes;
    easyCal._previewRankMaxesTick = easyCal._previewPaintTick;
    return maxes;
  }

  /** Months for this act’s rate to match `targetContrib` (same portion bucket). */
  function previewMonthsToMatch(actContribPerMonth, targetHorizonContrib, hits){
    var rate = Number(actContribPerMonth);
    var target = Number(targetHorizonContrib);
    if(!(rate > 0) || !(target > 0)) return null;
    var months = target / rate;
    if(!isFinite(months) || months < 0) return null;
    return months;
  }

  /** PREVIEW total = factor-weighted mean of horizon-log portion ratings (factorOrder / factorWeights). */
  function previewTotalRating1000(act, portions){
    var row = previewActScoreRow(act);
    var fac = previewGetFactors(act);
    var fw = {};
    try {
      ensureFactorOrder();
      fw = factorWeights() || {};
    } catch(_fw){ fw = {}; }
    var included = [];
    (portions || []).forEach(function(p){
      if(!p || p.world || !p.known) return;
      if(fac.portions && fac.portions[p.id] === false) return;
      var v = Number(p.value);
      if(!isFinite(v)) return;
      var dim = p.dim || portionIdToDim(p);
      included.push({ v: v, dim: dim, id: p.id });
    });
    var hits = previewHorizonHits(act);
    if(!included.length){
      return {
        rating1000: 0,
        source: 'no applicable portions',
        rank: row && row.rank,
        months: hits.months,
        days: hits.days,
        years: hits.years
      };
    }
    /* Prefer factor-weight when possible; never require every portion to have a weight.
       Weight dims that have fw[dim]>0; equal-split (w=1) the rest. */
    var sumW = 0, sumWV = 0, nFactor = 0, nFill = 0;
    var factorSumW = 0;
    included.forEach(function(it){
      var dim = it.dim || portionIdToDim(it);
      var w = (dim && isFinite(Number(fw[dim])) && Number(fw[dim]) > 0) ? Number(fw[dim]) : null;
      if(w != null){
        factorSumW += w;
        nFactor++;
        it._w = w;
      } else {
        nFill++;
        it._w = null;
      }
    });
    var fillW = (nFactor > 0) ? (factorSumW / nFactor) : 1;
    var usedFactor = nFactor > 0;
    included.forEach(function(it){
      var w = (it._w != null) ? it._w : fillW;
      sumW += w;
      sumWV += w * it.v;
    });
    return {
      rating1000: Math.round(sumWV / sumW),
      source: usedFactor
        ? 'factor-weighted · horizon×jmethod · log 0–1000'
        : 'horizon×jmethod · log 0–1000',
      rank: row && row.rank,
      months: hits.months,
      days: hits.days,
      years: hits.years
    };
  }


  function previewSortActsByScore(acts){
    var list = (acts || []).filter(Boolean).slice();
    list.sort(function(a,b){
      var ta = 0, tb = 0;
      try { ta = previewTotalRating1000(a, previewBuildBreakdown(a)).rating1000 || 0; } catch(_a){}
      try { tb = previewTotalRating1000(b, previewBuildBreakdown(b)).rating1000 || 0; } catch(_b){}
      if(tb !== ta) return tb - ta;
      return String(a.name||a.id||'').localeCompare(String(b.name||b.id||''));
    });
    return list;
  }

  function previewBuildBreakdown(act){
    var rawParts = previewBuildBreakdownRaw(act);
    var maxes = previewBoardHorizonMaxes();
    var hits = previewHorizonHits(act);
    return rawParts.map(function(p){
      if(!p) return p;
      if(p.world){
        return p;
      }
      if(!p.known){
        p.raw = p.raw != null ? p.raw : p.value;
        p.value = null;
        p.horizon = null;
        return p;
      }
      var raw = (p.raw != null) ? Number(p.raw) : Number(p.value);
      p.raw = raw;
      /* RANKS dim shares: remap so board-best share on that dim → 1000 (raw harmonic #1 ≈ 0.25). */
      if(p.dim && String(p.source || '').indexOf('RANKS') === 0){
        p.horizon = raw;
        var rankMaxes = previewBoardRankShareMaxes();
        var maxShare = rankMaxes ? Number(rankMaxes[p.dim]) : 0;
        if(!(maxShare > 0) || !(Number(raw) > 0)){
          p.value = 0;
        } else {
          p.value = previewRating1000From01(Number(raw) / maxShare);
        }
        p.scale = '0-1000';
        p.note = (p.note ? p.note + ' · ' : '') + 'rank share · remapped so board best = 1000 (edit on RANKS)';
        return p;
      }
      var horizon = previewHorizonContrib(p.id, raw, act);
      p.horizon = horizon;
      p.hitsMonths = hits.months;
      p.hitsDays = hits.days;
      var key = (p.id === 'money') ? previewMoneyBucket(act) : p.id;
      var boardMax = maxes[key];
      p.value = previewHorizonTo1000(horizon, boardMax);
      p.scale = '0-1000';
      var perMo = (p.id === 'time') ? (raw) : raw; /* raw is per tick; money tick ≈ per month in run() */
      var matchTop = previewMonthsToMatch(perMo, boardMax, hits);
      p.note = (p.note ? p.note + ' · ' : '')
        + 'raw/tick ' + (isFinite(raw) ? raw.toFixed(4) : '—')
        + ' · ×' + (p.id === 'time' ? (hits.days + 'd') : (hits.months + 'mo'))
        + ' over ' + hits.years + 'y'
        + ' → horizon ' + (isFinite(horizon) ? horizon.toFixed(2) : '—')
        + (boardMax > 0 ? (' · boardMax ' + boardMax.toFixed(2)) : '')
        + (matchTop != null && matchTop > hits.months * 1.05
            ? (' · ~' + (matchTop >= 12 ? ((matchTop/12).toFixed(1) + 'y') : (Math.ceil(matchTop) + 'mo'))
               + ' of this rate to match top on this portion')
            : '');
      return p;
    }).filter(function(p){
      /* n/a and world surplus are not score components */
      return !!(p && p.known && !p.world);
    });
  }

  function previewBuildBreakdownRaw(act){

    var amt = previewAmtOf(act);
    var row = previewActScoreRow(act);
    var isWork = !!(act && (act.kind === 'work' || act.polarity === 'gain'));
    var isDebt = !!(act && (act.isDebtPay || /loan|debt|car|credit|[REDACTED-INSTITUTION]|student/i.test(String(act.name||'')+' '+String(act.expenseName||''))));
    var isSpend = !!(act && (act.kind === 'spend' || act.expenseName || act.amountMonthly));
    var isSched = !!(act && (act.scheduleOnly || act.kind === 'schedule' || act.rhythm));
    var spanN = 1;
    try { spanN = (typeof easySpanDays === 'function') ? easySpanDays(act) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(act.spanDays)||1)); } catch(_s){ spanN = 1; }
    if(isWork){
      try {
        var fm = (typeof easyFocusMonth === 'function') ? easyFocusMonth() : null;
        if(fm && typeof easyWeekdaySpanInMonth === 'function') spanN = Math.max(spanN, easyWeekdaySpanInMonth(fm.y, fm.m) || spanN);
      } catch(_w){}
    }
    var happyY = 0;
    if(row && row.score01 != null && isFinite(Number(row.score01)) && Number(row.score01) > 0){
      happyY = Number(row.score01);
    } else if(row && row.scoreH != null){
      happyY = Number(row.scoreH);
    } else if(amt > 0){
      happyY = Math.max(amt * 0.01, 0.001);
    } else if(isWork){
      happyY = Math.max(spanN, 0.001);
    }

    var apr = null, interest = 0;
    try {
      var C = fullCalc();
      var debtByName = {};
      (C.debt && C.debt.lines || []).forEach(function(L){
        (L.fromExpense || []).forEach(function(en){ debtByName[en] = L; });
      });
      var en = (typeof easyExpenseNameOf === 'function') ? easyExpenseNameOf(act) : (act.expenseName || act.name);
      var dL = debtByName[en];
      if(dL){
        isDebt = true;
        var ap = Number(dL.aprPct);
        if(!isFinite(ap)) ap = Number(dL.apr) || 0;
        apr = ap > 1 ? ap * 0.01 : ap;
        interest = Number(dL.durationApr) || Number(dL.interestMonth) || 0;
      }
    } catch(_d){}

    function runRec(portionId){
      try {
        var am = lastBest && lastBest.actMethods;
        var keys = [act && (act.id || act.name), act && act.expenseName, act && act.name];
        for(var i=0;i<keys.length;i++){
          var k = keys[i];
          if(k && am && am[k] && am[k][portionId]) return am[k][portionId];
        }
      } catch(_r){}
      return null;
    }

    function scorePortion(portionId, methodId, ctx){
      var val = null, source = 'n/a';
      try {
        if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.score === 'function' && RunJMethods.get(methodId)){
          val = RunJMethods.score(methodId, ctx);
          source = 'run():'+methodId;
        }
      } catch(_s){}
      return { val: val, source: source };
    }

    var actNameNF = '';
    try { actNameNF = (typeof easyExpenseNameOf === 'function') ? easyExpenseNameOf(act) : ((act && (act.expenseName || act.name)) || ''); } catch(_n){ actNameNF = (act && (act.expenseName || act.name)) || ''; }
    if(!actNameNF && act) actNameNF = act.name || act.expenseName || '';

    return previewPortionsList().map(function(p){
      if(p && p.dim && actNameNF && typeof isRankNonFactor === 'function' && isRankNonFactor(p.dim, actNameNF)){
        return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:null, known:false, source:'n/a', note:'non-factor on RANKS', ranksNonFactor:true, methodId:p.dim, dim:p.dim, inverted:!!p.inverted };
      }
      var applicable = true;
      var val = null;
      var source = 'n/a';
      var note = '';
      var methodId = (typeof previewRunMethodForPortion === 'function') ? previewRunMethodForPortion(p.id, act) : p.id;
      var rec = runRec(p.id);

      /* HDAME+T (+custom) portions: score from RANKS shares */
      if(p.dim && p.id !== 'money' && p.id !== 'time' && p.id !== 'days' && p.id !== 'external'){
        applicable = !!row;
        if(!applicable){
          note = 'rank on RANKS tab';
          return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:null, known:false, source:'n/a', note:note, methodId:p.dim, dim:p.dim, inverted:!!p.inverted };
        }
        var sDim = row['score'+p.dim];
        if(sDim == null || !isFinite(Number(sDim))) sDim = 0;
        val = Number(sDim);
        source = 'RANKS · '+p.dim;
        note = 'rank #'+(row['rank'+p.dim] != null ? row['rank'+p.dim] : '—')+' · share '+(val*100).toFixed(3)+'%';
        methodId = p.dim;
        return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:val, raw:val, known:true, source:source, note:note, methodId:methodId, dim:p.dim, inverted:!!p.inverted };
      }
      if(p.id === 'happy' || (p.dim === 'H' && p.id !== 'money')){
        applicable = !!row || isWork || isSpend || isSched;
        var sH = row && row.scoreH != null ? Number(row.scoreH) : happyY;
        val = sH; source = row ? 'RANKS · H' : 'fallback';
        note = row && row.rankH != null ? ('rank #'+row.rankH) : 'no rank row';
        return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:val, raw:val, known:val!=null && isFinite(val), source:source, note:note, methodId:'H', dim:'H' };
      }
      if(p.id === 'days' || p.dim === 'D'){
        applicable = !!row || isWork || isSched || isSpend;
        var sD = row && row.scoreD != null ? Number(row.scoreD) : 0;
        val = sD; source = 'RANKS · D';
        note = row && row.rankD != null ? ('rank #'+row.rankD+' · Days') : 'rank on RANKS';
        return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:val, raw:val, known:!!row, source:source, note:note, methodId:'D', dim:'D' };
      }
      if(p.id === 'age' || p.dim === 'A'){
        applicable = !!row;
        var sA = row && row.scoreA != null ? Number(row.scoreA) : 0;
        val = sA; source = 'RANKS · A ↓';
        note = row && row.rankA != null ? ('rank #'+row.rankA) : 'rank on RANKS';
        return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:val, raw:val, known:!!row, source:source, note:note, methodId:'A', dim:'A', inverted:true };
      }
      if(p.id === 'time' || p.dim === 'T'){
        applicable = !!row || isWork || isSched || isSpend;
        var sTT = row && row.scoreT != null ? Number(row.scoreT) : (row && row.scoreD != null ? Number(row.scoreD) : 0);
        val = sTT; source = 'RANKS · T · Time/calendar';
        note = row && row.rankT != null ? ('rank #'+row.rankT) : 'rank Time/calendar on RANKS';
        /* also keep jmethod path for viz */
        methodId = (typeof previewRunMethodForPortion === 'function') ? previewRunMethodForPortion('time', act) : 'daysUse';
        return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:val, raw:val, known:true, source:source, note:note, methodId:methodId, dim:'T' };
      }
      if(p.id === 'money'){
        applicable = isWork || isSpend || amt > 0;
        if(!applicable){ note = 'not a money act'; return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:null, known:false, source:'n/a', note:note, methodId:methodId, dim:p.dim||'M' }; }
        var mx = rec && rec.x != null ? Math.abs(Number(rec.x)) : (isWork ? Math.max(spanN, 0.01) : Math.max(amt, 0.01));
        var my = rec && rec.y != null ? Math.abs(Number(rec.y)) : happyY;
        if(row && row.scoreH != null && !(my > 0)) my = Number(row.scoreH);
        var sc = scorePortion(p.id, methodId, { x: mx, y: my, name: act && act.name });
        val = sc.val; source = sc.source;
        note = methodId+' · x='+mx+' y='+my+(rec ? ' · from run() do()' : '');
        return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:val, raw:val, known:val!=null && isFinite(Number(val)), source:source, note:note, methodId:methodId, dim:p.dim||'M' };
      } else if(p.id === 'time'){
        applicable = isWork || isSched || isSpend || (act && act.startMin != null) || spanN > 1;
        if(!applicable){ note = 'no time placement'; return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:null, known:false, source:'n/a', note:note, methodId:methodId, dim:p.dim||'T' }; }
        var tx = rec && rec.x != null ? Math.abs(Number(rec.x)) : Math.max(spanN, (act && act.startMin != null ? 1 : 0.01));
        if(row && row.D != null && isFinite(Number(row.D)) && Number(row.D) > 0) tx = Math.max(tx, Number(row.D));
        if(p.dim === 'T' && row && row.scoreT != null) tx = Math.max(0.01, Number(row.scoreT) * 31);
        var ty = rec && rec.y != null ? Math.abs(Number(rec.y)) : Math.max(tx, 0.001);
        if(row && row.score01 != null) ty = Math.max(ty, Number(row.score01));
        var dCap = 30;
        var scT = scorePortion(p.id, methodId, { x: tx, y: ty, D: dCap, Dmax: dCap, name: act && act.name });
        val = scT.val; source = scT.source;
        note = methodId+' · days/span '+tx+(act && act.startMin != null ? ' · startMin '+act.startMin : '');
      } else if(p.id === 'debt'){
        applicable = isDebt && amt > 0;
        if(!applicable){ note = 'no debt link on this act'; return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:null, known:false, source:'n/a', note:note, methodId:'debtPay', dim:p.dim||'U' }; }
        var aprUse = apr || 0;
        if(aprUse > 1) aprUse = aprUse * 0.01;
        var scD = scorePortion(p.id, 'debtPay', { x: Math.max(amt, 0.01), y: Math.max(happyY, amt * 0.01), apr: aprUse, interest: interest, name: act && act.name });
        val = scD.val; source = scD.source;
        note = 'debtPay · apr '+(aprUse*100).toFixed(2)+'%';
        return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:val, raw:val, known:val!=null && isFinite(Number(val)), source:source, note:note, methodId:'debtPay', dim:p.dim||'U' };
      } else if(p.id === 'surplus' && !p.dim){
        /* legacy world surplus only when not a rank dim */
        applicable = true;
        var sur = null, net = null;
        try {
          if(lastBest && lastBest.ok && lastBest.calendar){
            sur = Number(lastBest.calendar.surplus);
            net = Number(lastBest.stocks && lastBest.stocks.M);
          }
        } catch(_su){}
        val = sur;
        source = (sur != null && isFinite(sur)) ? 'run() stocks' : 'n/a';
        note = 'world surplus after run()';
        return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:val, known: val != null && isFinite(val), source:source, note:note, methodId:'(world)', world:true };
      } else if(p.id === 'external'){
        /* E is inverted in HDAME: lower external is better. Score the inverted burden. */
        applicable = isSpend || isSched || !!(row && (row.rankE != null || row.E != null));
        if(!applicable){ note = 'n/a'; return { id:p.id, label:p.label, value:null, known:false, source:'n/a', note:note, methodId:'extUse', dim:p.dim||'E', inverted:true }; }
        var ex = rec && rec.x != null ? Math.abs(Number(rec.x)) : null;
        var burden = null;
        if(row && row.rankE != null && isFinite(Number(row.rankE)) && Number(row.rankE) > 0){
          burden = Number(row.rankE);
        } else if(ex != null){
          burden = ex;
        } else if(row && row.E != null && isFinite(Number(row.E))){
          burden = 1 / (Math.max(Number(row.E), 0) + 1e-6);
        } else {
          burden = 0.05;
        }
        val = 1 / (1 + Math.max(0, burden));
        source = 'external↓ better';
        note = 'inverted · burden ' + (isFinite(burden) ? burden.toFixed(4) : '—')
          + (row && row.rankE != null ? (' · sheet E #' + row.rankE) : '');
        methodId = 'extUse';
        return {
          id: p.id,
          label: p.label,
          value: val,
          raw: val,
          known: val != null && isFinite(Number(val)),
          source: source,
          note: note,
          methodId: methodId,
          dim: p.dim || 'E',
          inverted: true
        };
      }
      return {
        id: p.id,
        label: p.label,
        value: val,
        raw: val,
        known: val != null && isFinite(Number(val)),
        source: source,
        note: note,
        methodId: methodId,
        dim: p.dim,
        inverted: !!p.inverted
      };
    });
  }


  /** Map PREVIEW portions → blueprint method ids that liveBest/run() actually .do()'s. */
  var PREVIEW_RUN_METHOD = {
    money: 'moneyToHappy',
    time: 'daysUse',
    days: 'daysUse',
    happy: 'moneyToHappy',
    age: 'ageTick',
    debt: 'debtPay',
    surplus: 'moneyToHappy',
    external: 'extUse'
  };

  /** Prefer MODEL TOOLS factor→jmethod attachment when present. */
  function previewAttachedJmethodForPortion(portionId){
    try {
      var mt = WB && WB.modelTools;
      if(!mt || !mt.factorModels) return '';
      var dim = null;
      var list = previewPortionsList();
      for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){
        if(list[i] && list[i].id === portionId){ dim = list[i].dim; break; }
      }
      if(!dim && portionId){
        /* portion id may already be a dim (H/D/…) */
        if(mt.factorModels[portionId]) dim = portionId;
      }
      if(!dim) return '';
      var fm = mt.factorModels[dim];
      var jm = fm && fm.jmethod ? String(fm.jmethod).trim() : '';
      return jm;
    } catch(_a){ return ''; }
  }

  function previewRunMethodForPortion(portionId, act){
    var pid = String(portionId || '');
    if(act && (act.kind === 'work' || act.polarity === 'gain') && (pid === 'money' || !pid)) return 'earn';
    var attached = previewAttachedJmethodForPortion(pid);
    if(attached) return attached;
    if(PREVIEW_RUN_METHOD[pid]) return PREVIEW_RUN_METHOD[pid];
    return 'moneyToHappy';
  }

  /** jmethod for PREVIEW: override → run() actMethods → act.jmethod → factor attachment → run()-map. */
  function previewJmethodForPortion(portionId, act){
    previewEnsureState();
    var actKey = act ? String(act.id || act.name || '') : '';
    // Manual override only if user explicitly set one this session
    if(portionId && easyCal.previewJmethods && easyCal.previewJmethods[portionId] && easyCal.previewJmethods[portionId + '.__override']){
      return easyCal.previewJmethods[portionId];
    }
    // Per-act methods recorded from the last liveBest/run()
    try {
      var am = lastBest && lastBest.actMethods;
      if(am && actKey && am[actKey] && am[actKey][portionId] && am[actKey][portionId].method){
        return am[actKey][portionId].method;
      }
      // also try by expense/name
      var nm = act && (act.expenseName || act.name);
      if(am && nm && am[nm] && am[nm][portionId] && am[nm][portionId].method){
        return am[nm][portionId].method;
      }
    } catch(_am){}
    // Do not break existing act.jmethod overrides
    if(act && act.jmethod) return act.jmethod;
    // MODEL TOOLS factor attachment preferred over static PREVIEW_RUN_METHOD map
    var attached = previewAttachedJmethodForPortion(portionId);
    if(attached) return attached;
    // Blueprint method this portion corresponds to in run()
    var runM = previewRunMethodForPortion(portionId, act);
    if(runM) return runM;
    return 'JDirect';
  }

  function previewJmethodSource(portionId, act){
    previewEnsureState();
    if(portionId && easyCal.previewJmethods && easyCal.previewJmethods[portionId + '.__override']) return 'override';
    try {
      var actKey = act ? String(act.id || act.name || '') : '';
      var am = lastBest && lastBest.actMethods;
      if(am && ((actKey && am[actKey] && am[actKey][portionId]) || (act && am[act.expenseName||act.name] && am[act.expenseName||act.name][portionId]))) return 'run()';
    } catch(_s){}
    if(act && act.jmethod) return 'act.jmethod';
    if(previewAttachedJmethodForPortion(portionId)) return 'factorModels';
    return 'run()-map';
  }

  function previewJmethodViewDesc(jmId){
    try {
      /* Prefer live registered method._view (Blueprint view.out) — same SoT as Model Tools curve */
      if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.get === 'function'){
        var meth = RunJMethods.get(jmId);
        if(meth && meth._view && typeof meth._view === 'object') return meth._view;
      }
    } catch(_m){}
    try {
      var mt = (typeof WB !== 'undefined' && WB && WB.modelTools) ? WB.modelTools : null;
      if(!mt && typeof ensureModelTools === 'function') mt = ensureModelTools();
      var jm = mt && mt.jmethods && mt.jmethods[jmId];
      if(jm && jm.view && typeof jm.view === 'object') return jm.view;
      if(jm && jm.viewGraph && typeof jm.viewGraph === 'object') return jm.viewGraph;
      /* compile builtin Blueprint view when not yet saved in WB */
      if(typeof modelToolsBuiltinBlueprint === 'function' && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.compileView){
        var bp = modelToolsBuiltinBlueprint(jmId);
        if(bp && bp.script) return ModelToolsScript.compileView(bp.script);
      }
    } catch(_v){}
    return null;
  }

  function previewJmethodSuggests3d(jmId){
    try {
      var vd = previewJmethodViewDesc(jmId);
      if(vd && (vd.space3d || vd.previewKind === '3d' || vd.previewKind === 'both')) return true;
      var mt = (typeof WB !== 'undefined' && WB && WB.modelTools) ? WB.modelTools : null;
      var jm = mt && mt.jmethods && mt.jmethods[jmId];
      if(jm && jm.script && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.normalizeGraph){
        var g = ModelToolsScript.normalizeGraph(jm.script);
        if((g.nodes||[]).some(function(n){ return n && n.type === 'view.3d'; })) return true;
      }
    } catch(_e){}
    var s = String(jmId || '').toLowerCase();
    return /3d|sim3d|sim|webgpu|volume|spatial|voxel/.test(s);
  }

  function previewPlacementPoint(act){
    var amt = previewAmtOf(act);
    var sm = (act && act.startMin != null && isFinite(Number(act.startMin))) ? Number(act.startMin) : null;
    var billDay = null;
    try {
      if(act && act.selectedKeys && act.selectedKeys.length){
        var k0 = String(act.selectedKeys[0]);
        var m = k0.match(/(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})/) || k0.match(/(\d{4})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})/);
        if(m) billDay = parseInt(m[3], 10);
      }
    } catch(_k){}
    if(billDay == null && act && act.dayOfMonth != null) billDay = Number(act.dayOfMonth);
    var xTime = sm != null ? (sm / 60) : (billDay != null ? (billDay / 31) * 24 : 12);
    var yMoney = amt;
    return { xHours: xTime, yMoney: yMoney, startMin: sm, billDay: billDay, amountMonthly: amt };
  }

  function previewMonthFiresFast(act, mi, hits, totalMo){
    if(!act) return false;
    var cad = String(act.cadence || '');
    if(act.kind === 'work' || act.polarity === 'gain' || cad === 'weekdays' || cad === 'daily' || cad === 'monthly') return true;
    if(cad === 'yearly' || cad === 'annual') return (mi % 12) === 0;
    var nDays = Number(act.nDays);
    if(cad === 'every_n_days' || (isFinite(nDays) && nDays > 0)){
      var n = Math.max(1, nDays || 11);
      var everyMo = Math.max(1, Math.round(n / 30.44));
      return (mi % everyMo) === 0;
    }
    var hm = (hits && hits.months) || 1;
    if(hm >= totalMo) return true;
    if(mi <= 0) return true;
    return Math.floor(mi * hm / totalMo) !== Math.floor((mi - 1) * hm / totalMo);
  }

  /** Build cumulative jmethod score trail across the HDAME horizon (sim line, not a landing). */
  function previewSimTrail(act, jmId, portion){
    var out = { ideal: [], actual: [] };
    try {
      if(typeof RunJMethods === 'undefined' || !RunJMethods || !RunJMethods.get) return out;
      var meth = RunJMethods.get(jmId);
      if(!meth) return out;

      try {
        out.ideal = (typeof meth.sampleCurve === 'function') ? (meth.sampleCurve(40) || []) : [];
      } catch(_i){ out.ideal = []; }

      var actForPlace = act ? Object.assign({}, act) : {};
      var row = null;
      try { row = previewActScoreRow(act); } catch(_r){}
      if(row){
        if(row.score01 != null) actForPlace.score01 = row.score01;
        if(row.scoreRaw != null) actForPlace.scoreRaw = row.scoreRaw;
        if(row.H != null) actForPlace.H = row.H;
        if(row.D != null) actForPlace.D = row.D;
        if(row.rankE != null) actForPlace.rankE = row.rankE;
      }

      var ctx = { name: act && act.name, D: 30, Dmax: 31, E: 10, Emax: 20 };
      if(row && row.score01 != null) ctx.y = Number(row.score01) > 1.5 ? Number(row.score01) : Number(row.score01);
      /* pass rank happy into place for moneyToHappy */
      if(row && row.score01 != null && Number(row.score01) > 0){
        var amt0 = (typeof previewAmtOf === 'function') ? previewAmtOf(act) : 0;
        var s01 = Number(row.score01);
        ctx.y = (s01 <= 1.5) ? (s01 * Math.max(amt0, 1) * 0.15) : s01;
      }

      var land = null;
      try { land = meth.place(actForPlace, ctx); } catch(_p){ land = null; }
      if(!land || land.x == null){
        land = { x: 1, y: 0 };
      }
      land.x = Math.abs(Number(land.x)) || 0.01;
      land.y = Math.abs(Number(land.y)) || 0;
      /* NEVER overwrite land.y with idealY — gap vs model is the point */

      var idealY = null;
      try {
        if(typeof meth.idealY === 'function') idealY = Number(meth.idealY(land.x, ctx));
      } catch(_iy){}

      /* Actual = chord to real landing (not along the dashed curve) */
      out.actual.push({ x: 0, y: 0 });
      out.actual.push({ x: land.x, y: land.y, label: act && (act.name || act.id), idealY: idealY });
    } catch(_t){}
    return out;
  }

  function previewVizHtml(act, portion, jmId, peers){
    peers = peers || [];
    var pt = previewPlacementPoint(act);
    var annot = 'placement · $'+Number(pt.amountMonthly||0).toFixed(2)+'/mo'
      + ' · portion '+(portion && portion.label || '—')
      + ' · jmethod '+esc(jmId || 'JDirect');
    try {
      if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.get === 'function' && RunJMethods.get(jmId)){
        function prepAct(a){
          var row = null;
          try { row = previewActScoreRow(a); } catch(_r){ row = null; }
          var actForPlace = a ? Object.assign({}, a) : {};
          if(row){
            if(row.score01 != null) actForPlace.score01 = row.score01;
            if(row.scoreRaw != null) actForPlace.scoreRaw = row.scoreRaw;
            if(row.H != null) actForPlace.H = row.H;
            if(row.D != null) actForPlace.D = row.D;
            if(row.rankE != null) actForPlace.rankE = row.rankE;
            if(row.rating1000 != null && actForPlace.score01 == null) actForPlace.score01 = Number(row.rating1000)/1000;
          }
          return { actForPlace: actForPlace, row: row };
        }

        /* Focus + peers that share this jmethod for this portion */
        var pool = [];
        var seen = Object.create(null);
        function addAct(a){
          if(!a) return;
          var id = String(a.id || a.name || '');
          if(!id || seen[id]) return;
          var jm = (typeof previewJmethodForPortion === 'function')
            ? previewJmethodForPortion(portion && portion.id, a)
            : jmId;
          if(String(jm) !== String(jmId)) return;
          seen[id] = true;
          pool.push(a);
        }
        addAct(act);
        (peers || []).forEach(addAct);

        var overlays = [];
        var focusPlacement = null;
        var focusCtx = {};
        var focusActForPlace = null;
        var trails0 = null;

        pool.forEach(function(a, idx){
          var prep = prepAct(a);
          var placeCtx = { name: a && a.name, D: 30, Dmax: 31, E: 10, Emax: 20 };
          var amt = (typeof previewAmtOf === 'function') ? previewAmtOf(a) : 0;
          if(!(placeCtx.x > 0)) placeCtx.x = Math.max(amt, jmId === 'earn' ? 8 : 0.01);
          if(!(placeCtx.y > 0)) placeCtx.y = Math.max(placeCtx.x * 0.01, 0.5);
          var placement = null;
          try {
            var meth = RunJMethods.get(jmId);
            if(meth && typeof meth.place === 'function') placement = meth.place(prep.actForPlace, placeCtx);
          } catch(_pl){}
          var trails = (typeof previewSimTrail === 'function') ? previewSimTrail(a, jmId, portion) : { ideal: [], actual: [] };
          if(idx === 0){
            focusPlacement = placement;
            focusCtx = placeCtx;
            focusActForPlace = prep.actForPlace;
            trails0 = trails;
          }
          overlays.push({
            name: a.name || a.id || ('item '+idx),
            trail: (trails && trails.actual) || [],
            place: placement
          });
        });

        /* Board peers for fit (same jmethod) so ±1σ is meaningful */
        var calibratePoints = [];
        try {
          var board = (typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function') ? (easyScheduleActions() || []) : [];
          board.forEach(function(ba){
            if(!ba) return;
            var jmB = (typeof previewJmethodForPortion === 'function')
              ? previewJmethodForPortion(portion && portion.id, ba)
              : jmId;
            if(String(jmB) !== String(jmId)) return;
            var prepB = prepAct(ba);
            var ctxB = { name: ba.name, D: 30, Dmax: 31, E: 10, Emax: 20, workdaysPerMonth: 22 };
            if(prepB.row && prepB.row.score01 != null){
              var sB = Number(prepB.row.score01);
              var aB = (typeof previewAmtOf === 'function') ? previewAmtOf(ba) : 0;
              ctxB.y = (sB <= 1.5) ? (sB * Math.max(aB, 1) * 0.15) : sB;
            }
            try {
              var plB = RunJMethods.get(jmId).place(prepB.actForPlace, ctxB);
              if(plB && plB.x > 0) calibratePoints.push({ x: plB.x, y: plB.y, name: ba.name });
            } catch(_pb){}
          });
        } catch(_board){}
        overlays.forEach(function(ov){
          if(ov && ov.place) calibratePoints.push({ x: ov.place.x, y: ov.place.y, name: ov.name });
        });

        var yearsN = (typeof easyHorizonYears === 'function') ? easyHorizonYears() : 150;
        /* easy170: PREVIEW = same Blueprint-backed method as get(jmId) (view.out domain already on register) */
        var _vizNote3d = '';
        try {
          if(typeof previewJmethodSuggests3d === 'function' && previewJmethodSuggests3d(jmId)){
            _vizNote3d = ' · 3D view available (view.out)';
          }
        } catch(_n3){}
        return RunJMethods.vizHtml(jmId, focusPlacement, {
          portion: portion,
          act: focusActForPlace || act,
          ctx: focusCtx,
          idealTrail: (trails0 && trails0.ideal) || [],
          trail: (trails0 && trails0.actual) || [],
          overlays: overlays,
          calibratePoints: calibratePoints,
          years: yearsN,
          forceDual: true,
          viewNote: _vizNote3d
        });
      }
    } catch(_rj){}
    if(previewJmethodSuggests3d(jmId)){
      return '<div class="preview-viz preview-viz-3d">'
        + '<div class="preview-viz-label">3D simulation placeholder · prototype</div>'
        + '<p class="preview-annot">'+esc(annot)+'</p></div>';
    }
    return '<div class="preview-viz"><p class="hint">No RunJMethods graph for '+esc(jmId||'?')+'</p></div>';
  }

  
  function renderPreview(){
    previewEnsureState();
    easyCal._previewPaintTick = (easyCal._previewPaintTick || 0) + 1;
    easyCal._previewMaxes = null;
    easyCal._previewHits = Object.create(null);
    var html = '';
    html += '<div class="preview-root" id="preview-root">';
    html += '<p class="hint"><b>PREVIEW</b> · score debug for Board / calendar selection. '

      + 'Breakdown = this act’s <span class="c">run()</span> jmethod scores (easy111+). Click a Board tile to select.</p>';

    var selected = previewSelectedActs();

    /* Primary place to view/edit factor-vs-factor composite model (always on PREVIEW) */

          html += '</button>';
        });
      }
      html += '</div></div>';
      return html;
    }

    /* item picker when multiple */
    selected = previewSortActsByScore(selected);
    html += '<div class="preview-items">';
    selected.forEach(function(a){

      var id = a.id || a.name;

      html += '<details class="preview-jm-override"><summary>Override jmethod (optional)</summary>';

      try { methods = (typeof easyJmethodList === 'function') ? easyJmethodList() : []; } catch(_m){}

        var on = p.id === portion.id;
        var off = !!(facUI.portions && facUI.portions[p.id] === false);
        html += '<button type="button" class="preview-portion'+(on?' on':'')+(off?' off':'')+(p.inverted?' invert':'')+'" data-preview-portion="'+esc(p.id)+'">';
        html += '<div class="preview-p-label">'+esc(p.label)+(p.inverted?' <span class="cm">↓better</span>':'')+(off?' <span class="cm">off</span>':'')+'</div>';

        if(p.methodId) html += '<div class="preview-p-note">method '+esc(p.methodId)+'</div>';
        if(p.note) html += '<div class="preview-p-note">'+esc(p.note)+'</div>';
        html += '</button>';
      });
      html += '</div>';
      var jmSrc = (typeof previewJmethodSource === 'function') ? previewJmethodSource(portion.id, focus) : 'run()';
      html += '<p class="hint">Selected portion: <b>'+esc(portion.label)+'</b> · jmethod <span class="c">'+esc(jmId)+'</span>'+
        ' <span class="easy-year-ghost">(from '+esc(jmSrc)+')</span>'
        + (selected.length > 1 ? (' · graph overlays acts sharing <span class="c">'+esc(jmId)+'</span>') : '')
        + '</p>';
      html += previewVizHtml(focus, portion, jmId, selected);
    }

    /* Always keep Board item picker reachable while previewing */
    html += '<details class="preview-fallback" open>';
    html += '<summary>Board items <span class="cm">(sorted high→low · toggle to change selection)</span></summary>';
    html += '<p class="hint">Click to add/remove. Use <b>← Select items</b> to clear and start over.</p>';
    var board2 = [];
    try { board2 = (typeof easyScheduleActions === 'function') ? (easyScheduleActions() || []) : []; } catch(_b2){}
    board2 = previewSortActsByScore(board2);
    html += '<div class="preview-board-list">';
    if(!board2.length){
      html += '<p class="hint">No Board acts yet.</p>';
    } else {
      board2.forEach(function(a){
        if(!a) return;
        var id2 = a.id || a.name;
        var on2 = easyCal.previewActIds.indexOf(id2) >= 0
          || (!easyCal.previewActIds.length && focus && (focus.id === id2 || focus.name === id2));
        var tot2 = previewTotalRating1000(a, previewBuildBreakdown(a));
        html += '<button type="button" class="preview-board-item'+(on2?' on':'')+'" data-preview-toggle="'+esc(id2)+'">';
        html += '<span class="preview-bi-name">'+esc(a.name || id2)+'</span>';
        html += '<span class="preview-bi-score">'+(tot2.rank ? ('#'+tot2.rank+' · ') : '')+tot2.rating1000+'/1000</span>';
        html += '</button>';
      });
    }
    html += '</div></details>';

    html += '</div>';
    return html;
  }

    /** PREVIEW-only paint — skip liveBest/Exp6 (was freezing Safari on Board tile click). */
  function renderPreviewLight(){
    if(!WB) return;
    previewEnsureState();
    easyCal._previewPaintTick = (easyCal._previewPaintTick || 0) + 1;
    easyCal._previewMaxes = null;
    easyCal._previewHits = Object.create(null);
    try { renderTabs(); } catch(_t){}
    try { renderPane(); } catch(_p){
      try {
        var pane = $('pane');
        if(pane) pane.innerHTML = '<p class="hint">PREVIEW render error: '+String(_p && _p.message || _p)+'</p>';
      } catch(_e){}
      if(typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.warn) console.warn('renderPreviewLight', _p);
    }
    try {
      if(activeTab==='PREVIEW' || activeTab==='JOYS') bindPreview();
    } catch(_b){}
  }

  function bindPreview(){
    previewEnsureState();
    try { bindFactorOrderDrag(); } catch(_bfd){}
    var root = $('pane');
    if(!root) return;
    function previewFocusFromState(){
      var selected = previewSelectedActs();
      return previewFocusAct(selected);
    }
    root.onchange = function(ev){
      var t = ev.target;
      if(!t || !t.getAttribute) return;
      var por = t.getAttribute('data-preview-factor-portion');
      if(por){
        var act = previewFocusFromState();
        if(!act) return;
        previewSetFactor(act, 'portion', { id: por, on: !!t.checked });
        easyCal._previewPaintTick = (easyCal._previewPaintTick || 0) + 1;
        easyCal._previewMaxes = null;
        easyCal._previewHits = Object.create(null);
        renderPreviewLight();
        return;
      }
    };
    /* Event delegation — board tiles re-render; per-button onclick was flaky in smoke */
    root.onclick = function(ev){
      var t = ev.target;
      if(!t || !t.closest) return;
      var reset = t.closest('[data-preview-factor-reset]');
      if(reset){
        var actR = previewFocusFromState();
        if(actR) previewResetFactors(actR);
        renderPreviewLight();
        return;
      }
      var goR = t.closest('[data-preview-goto-ranks]');
      if(goR){
        activeTab = 'RANKS';
        if(easyCal.previewPortion === 'time' || easyCal.previewPortion === 'days') activeRankDim = (easyCal.previewPortion === 'time' ? 'T' : 'D');
        else if(easyCal.previewPortion === 'money') activeRankDim = 'M';
        else if(easyCal.previewPortion === 'happy') activeRankDim = 'H';
        else if(easyCal.previewPortion === 'external') activeRankDim = 'E';
        else if(easyCal.previewPortion === 'age') activeRankDim = 'A';
        else activeRankDim = 'T';
        renderAll();
        return;
      }
      var addF = t.closest('[data-preview-add-factor]');
      if(addF){
        var label = window.prompt('New score factor label (e.g. Focus, Social)', '');
        if(label == null) return;
        label = String(label).trim();
        if(!label) return;
        var idGuess = label.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, '').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
        if(!idGuess) idGuess = 'X';
        if(DIMS.indexOf(idGuess) >= 0) idGuess = 'F' + idGuess.slice(0, 7);
        var id = window.prompt('Short id (letters/numbers)', idGuess);
        if(id == null) return;
        var means = window.prompt('Higher ranking means… (shown above #1 on RANKS)', 'Higher = more '+label.toLowerCase()+' attention for this item.');
        if(means == null) return;
        var inv = window.confirm('Invert this factor? (OK = lower-is-better)');
        var res = addRankFactor(id, label, inv, means);
        if(!res || !res.ok){
          if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('Could not add factor: '+(res && res.err || 'error'), 'bad');
          return;
        }
        renderPreviewLight();
        try { ensureFactorOrder(); } catch(_e){}
        if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('Added '+res.id+' · weight it in Factor importance above', 'ok');
        return;
      }
      var sub = t.closest('[data-preview-sub]');
      if(sub){
        easyCal.previewSub = sub.getAttribute('data-preview-sub') || 'breakdown';
        renderPreviewLight();
        return;
      }
      var por = t.closest('[data-preview-portion]');
      if(por){
        easyCal.previewPortion = por.getAttribute('data-preview-portion') || 'money';
        renderPreviewLight();
        return;
      }
      var jm = t.closest('[data-preview-jm]');
      if(jm){
        var jid = jm.getAttribute('data-preview-jm');
        var pid = easyCal.previewPortion || 'money';
        if(!easyCal.previewJmethods) easyCal.previewJmethods = {};
        easyCal.previewJmethods[pid] = jid;
        easyCal.previewJmethods[pid + '.__override'] = true;
        renderPreviewLight();
        return;
      }
      var item = t.closest('[data-preview-item]');
      if(item){
        easyCal.previewItemId = item.getAttribute('data-preview-item');
        renderPreviewLight();
        return;
      }
      var back = t.closest('[data-preview-back]');
      if(back){
        easyCal.previewActIds = [];
        easyCal.previewItemId = null;
        easyCal.previewPickBoard = true;
        easyCal.previewSub = 'breakdown';
        renderPreviewLight();
        return;
      }
      var tog = t.closest('[data-preview-toggle]');
      if(tog){
        var id = tog.getAttribute('data-preview-toggle');
        if(!id) return;
        if(!Array.isArray(easyCal.previewActIds)) easyCal.previewActIds = [];
        var i = easyCal.previewActIds.indexOf(id);
        if(i >= 0) easyCal.previewActIds.splice(i, 1);
        else easyCal.previewActIds.push(id);
        easyCal.previewPickBoard = false;
        easyCal.previewItemId = easyCal.previewActIds.length ? id : null;
        easyCal.previewSub = 'breakdown';
        renderPreviewLight();
        return;
      }
    };
  }

     else if (window.JWorkbookMoho && JWorkbookMoho.relationGraph) JWorkbookMoho.relationGraph();

    ' · debt cash '+money(cmp.world.debt,'spend')+' · surplus <span class="c">'+money(cmp.world.surplus,'spend')+'</span>'+
    (cmp.run ? ' · run() H='+fmtBest(cmp.run.stocks.H)+' M='+fmtBest(cmp.run.stocks.M) : ' · run() pending')+
    ' · pair agreement <b class="'+(cmp.agreement>=0.7?'cmp-ok':cmp.agreement>=0.45?'cmp-mid':'cmp-bad')+'">'+
    (cmp.agreement*100).toFixed(1)+'%</b></p>';
   html += '<table class="grid"><thead><tr><th>Joy</th><th>Pol</th><th>Optimal</th><th>Opt %</th><th>Actual</th><th>Act %</th><th>Δ share</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
   cmp.actualJoy.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return b.optimalShare - a.optimalShare; }).forEach(function(j){
    var d = j.deltaShare || 0;
    var cls = Math.abs(d) < 0.05 ? 'cmp-ok' : (d > 0 ? 'cmp-mid' : 'cmp-bad');
    html += '<tr><td>'+esc(j.id)+'</td><td>'+esc(j.polarity)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+Number(j.optimal).toFixed(3)+'</td>'+
     '<td class="calc">'+scorePct(j.optimalShare)+'</td>'+

   html += '<h3 class="section-h">Optimal vs actual — expense rank (what ranking did)</h3>';

    'Actual order from composite rank scores after your RANKS drag + harmonic. Δrank &gt; 0 means actual ranked that line worse than optimal.</p>';
   html += '<table class="grid"><thead><tr><th>#opt</th><th>#act</th><th>Δ</th><th>Name</th><th>Cost</th><th>Opt %</th><th>Act %</th><th>Debt?</th></tr></thead><tbody>';

   });
   html += '</tbody></table>';
   html += '<p class="hint">Views on disk: <span class="c">views/optimal_vs_actual.md</span> · re-author via living-core <code>living_ranking</code>.</p>';
   return html;
  }


  /* ========== MODEL TOOLS (3D entities + meetup sims) ========== */
  function ensureModelTools(){
   if(!WB) return null;
   if(!WB.modelTools || typeof WB.modelTools !== 'object') WB.modelTools = {};
   var mt = WB.modelTools;
   if(!Array.isArray(mt.entities)) mt.entities = [];
   if(!mt.camera || typeof mt.camera !== 'object') mt.camera = { yaw:-35, pitch:42, dist:28, target:[0,0,0] };
   if(!mt.map || typeof mt.map !== 'object') mt.map = { gridSize:20, showAxes:true, note:'stub grid (OSM later)' };
   if(!Array.isArray(mt.meetups)) mt.meetups = [];
   if(mt.version == null) mt.version = 1;
   if(!mt.you || typeof mt.you !== 'object'){
    mt.you = { id:'you', name:'You', kind:'person', pos:{x:0,y:0,z:0}, color:'#7CFFB2', enabled:true };
   }
   if(!mt.factorModels || typeof mt.factorModels !== 'object') mt.factorModels = {};
   if(!mt.jmethods || typeof mt.jmethods !== 'object') mt.jmethods = {};
   /* easy176/easy175: optional seed packs (libraries). Packs ≠ SoT; saved jmethods are. */
   if(!mt.packs || typeof mt.packs !== 'object') mt.packs = {};
   if(mt.packs.builtins == null){
     mt.packs.builtins = { loaded: true, source: 'vendor/jmethod_packs/builtins', note: 'optional library' };
   }
   return mt;
  }
  function modelToolsNewId(prefix){
   return String(prefix||'ent') + '_' + Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random()*1e4).toString(36);
  }
  function modelToolsPersistSoft(){
   try {
    if(typeof saveWorkbook === 'function') saveWorkbook({ silent:true, skipReview:true });
   } catch(_s){}
  }
  function modelToolsDist(a, b){
   var ax = Number(a && a.x)||0, az = Number(a && a.z)||0;
   var bx = Number(b && b.x)||0, bz = Number(b && b.z)||0;
   return Math.hypot(ax-bx, az-bz);
  }
  function modelToolsRunSims(opts){
   opts = opts || {};
   var mt = ensureModelTools();
   if(!mt) return { ok:false, added:0 };
   var ents = (mt.entities||[]).filter(function(e){ return e && e.enabled !== false; });
   var you = mt.you && mt.you.enabled !== false ? mt.you : null;
   var pool = ents.slice();
   if(you) pool = pool.concat([you]);
   var added = 0;
   var nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
   function pairKey(a,b){
    var ids = [String(a.id), String(b.id)].sort();
    return ids[0]+'|'+ids[1];
   }
   var seen = {};
   (mt.meetups||[]).forEach(function(m){
    if(m && m.a && m.b) seen[pairKey({id:m.a},{id:m.b})] = true;
   });
   for(var i=0;i<pool.length;i++){
    var A = pool[i];
    if(!A || !A.run || !A.run.emitMeetup) continue;
    var every = Math.max(1, Number(A.run.everyTicks)||1);
    A._mtTick = (A._mtTick|0) + 1;
    if((A._mtTick % every) !== 0 && !opts.force) continue;
    var radius = Math.max(0.1, Number(A.run.radius)||2.5);
    for(var j=0;j<pool.length;j++){
     if(i===j) continue;
     var B = pool[j];
     if(!B) continue;
     // only emit once per unordered pair per run batch (idempotent log)
     var pk = pairKey(A,B);
     if(seen[pk] && !opts.allowDup) continue;
     if(modelToolsDist(A.pos, B.pos) <= radius){
      var mid = {
       at: nowIso,
       a: A.name || A.id,
       b: B.name || B.id,
       aId: A.id,
       bId: B.id,
       pos: {
        x: ((Number(A.pos&&A.pos.x)||0) + (Number(B.pos&&B.pos.x)||0)) / 2,
        y: 0,
        z: ((Number(A.pos&&A.pos.z)||0) + (Number(B.pos&&B.pos.z)||0)) / 2
      }
      };
      mt.meetups.push(mid);
      seen[pk] = true;
      added++;
     }
    }
   }
   // keep log bounded
   if(mt.meetups.length > 200) mt.meetups = mt.meetups.slice(-200);
   return { ok:true, added:added, total: mt.meetups.length };
  }
  /** Idempotent Board upsert: Meetup: A × B as scheduleOnly once — never clears calendar. */
  function modelToolsSyncMeetupsToBoard(){
   var mt = ensureModelTools();
   if(!mt) return { ok:false, upserted:0 };
   var profile = null;
   try { profile = (typeof ensureCalendar === 'function') ? ensureCalendar() : (WB && WB.calendar); } catch(_e){}
   if(!profile) return { ok:false, upserted:0, reason:'no_calendar' };
   if(!Array.isArray(profile.customActions)) profile.customActions = [];
   var upserted = 0;
   (mt.meetups||[]).forEach(function(m){
    if(!m) return;
    var label = 'Meetup: ' + String(m.a||'?') + ' × ' + String(m.b||'?');
    var existing = null;
    profile.customActions.forEach(function(a){
     if(a && a.name === label) existing = a;
    });
    if(existing){
     // already on Board — leave placements alone
     if(existing.scheduleOnly == null) existing.scheduleOnly = true;
     if(!existing.cadence) existing.cadence = 'once';
     return;
    }
    var act = {
     id: (typeof easyNewId === 'function') ? easyNewId(label) : modelToolsNewId('meetup'),
     name: label,
     kind: 'schedule',
     polarity: 'neutral',
     amountMonthly: 0,
     cadence: 'once',
     selectedKeys: [],
     hours: [12],
     allDay: false,
     lane: 'plan',
     scheduleOnly: true,
     section: 'MODEL TOOLS',
     author: 'model_tools',
     enabled: true,
     notes: 'From MODEL TOOLS meetup sim @ ' + (m.at || '')
    };
    try {
     if(typeof easyCommitQuiet === 'function') easyCommitQuiet(act);
     else profile.customActions.push(act);
     upserted++;
    } catch(_c){
     profile.customActions.push(act);
     upserted++;
    }
   });
   return { ok:true, upserted:upserted, board: (profile.customActions||[]).length };
  }

  function mtJmCloneScript(script){
    try { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(script || { version:1, nodes:[], edges:[] })); } catch(_e){ return { version:1, nodes:[], edges:[] }; }
  }
  /* easy171: undo snapshots script + curve math/domain so Fit landings / CP drag revert */
  function mtJmSnapshotDraft(d){
    d = d || _mtJmDraft;
    return {
      script: mtJmCloneScript(d && d.script),
      math: (function(){ try { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify((d && d.math) || null)); } catch(_m){ return null; } })(),
      xMax: d ? d.xMax : null,
      yMax: d ? d.yMax : null,
      xLabel: d ? d.xLabel : null,
      yLabel: d ? d.yLabel : null
    };
  }
  function mtJmRestoreSnapshot(snap){
    if(!snap || !_mtJmDraft) return;
    /* compat: older undo entries were bare script graphs */
    if(snap && snap.nodes && !snap.script){
      _mtJmDraft.script = snap;
      return;
    }
    _mtJmDraft.script = snap.script || mtJmCloneScript(null);
    if(snap.math) _mtJmDraft.math = snap.math;
    if(snap.xMax > 0) _mtJmDraft.xMax = snap.xMax;
    if(snap.yMax > 0) _mtJmDraft.yMax = snap.yMax;
    if(snap.xLabel != null) _mtJmDraft.xLabel = snap.xLabel;
    if(snap.yLabel != null) _mtJmDraft.yLabel = snap.yLabel;
    try {
      if(_mtJmDraft.script && _mtJmDraft.script.nodes){
        _mtJmDraft.script.nodes.forEach(function(n){
          if(!n || n.type !== 'view.curve') return;
          if(!n.params) n.params = {};
          if(_mtJmDraft.math) n.params.math = _mtJmDraft.math;
          if(_mtJmDraft.xMax > 0) n.params.xMax = _mtJmDraft.xMax;
          if(_mtJmDraft.yMax > 0) n.params.yMax = _mtJmDraft.yMax;
          if(_mtJmDraft.xLabel != null) n.params.xLabel = _mtJmDraft.xLabel;
          if(_mtJmDraft.yLabel != null) n.params.yLabel = _mtJmDraft.yLabel;
        });
      }
    } catch(_sync){}
  }
  function mtJmPushUndo(d){
    if(!d || !d.script) return;
    _mtJmUndoStack.push(mtJmSnapshotDraft(d));
    if(_mtJmUndoStack.length > 80) _mtJmUndoStack.shift();
    _mtJmRedoStack = [];
  }
  function mtJmUndo(){
    if(!_mtJmUndoStack.length || !_mtJmDraft) return;
    _mtJmRedoStack.push(mtJmSnapshotDraft(_mtJmDraft));
    mtJmRestoreSnapshot(_mtJmUndoStack.pop());
    _mtJmScriptSel = null; _mtJmScriptEdgeSel = null; _mtJmScriptSelSet = {};
    remountUI();
  }
  function mtJmRedo(){
    if(!_mtJmRedoStack.length || !_mtJmDraft) return;
    _mtJmUndoStack.push(mtJmSnapshotDraft(_mtJmDraft));
    mtJmRestoreSnapshot(_mtJmRedoStack.pop());
    _mtJmScriptSel = null; _mtJmScriptEdgeSel = null; _mtJmScriptSelSet = {};
    remountUI();
  }

    H:'#7CFFB2', M:'#FFD166', D:'#4ea1ff', T:'#a78bfa',
    A:'#fb7185', E:'#94a3b8', U:'#f97316', S:'#34d399'
  };
  var MT_FACTOR_KIND_DEFAULTS = {
    D:'calendar_days', T:'calendar_hours', M:'money_values',
    U:'debt_urgency', S:'surplus'
  };
  var MT_FACTOR_KINDS = [
    { id:'rank_share', label:'Rank share (drag order)' },
    { id:'calendar_days', label:'Calendar days' },
    { id:'calendar_hours', label:'Calendar hours' },
    { id:'money_values', label:'Money values ($)' },
