  function modelToolsFactorColor(dim){
   if(MT_FACTOR_COLORS[dim]) return MT_FACTOR_COLORS[dim];
   // stable hash for customs
   var s = String(dim||'X'), h = 0;
   for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++) h = ((h<<5)-h) + s.charCodeAt(i);
   var hue = Math.abs(h) % 360;
   return 'hsl('+hue+' 70% 55%)';
  }
  function modelToolsDefaultFactorKind(dim){
   return MT_FACTOR_KIND_DEFAULTS[dim] || 'rank_share';
  }
  function modelToolsEnsureFactorModel(dim){
   var mt = ensureModelTools();
   if(!mt || !dim) return null;
   if(!mt.factorModels[dim] || typeof mt.factorModels[dim] !== 'object'){
    mt.factorModels[dim] = {
     kind: modelToolsDefaultFactorKind(dim),
     jmethod: ''
    };
   } else {
    if(!mt.factorModels[dim].kind) mt.factorModels[dim].kind = modelToolsDefaultFactorKind(dim);
    if(mt.factorModels[dim].jmethod == null) mt.factorModels[dim].jmethod = '';
   }
   return mt.factorModels[dim];
  }
  /** Re-register saved WB.modelTools.jmethods first; optional pack `builtins` fills PREVIEW gaps. Packs = libraries; saved = SoT. */
  function modelToolsHydrateJmethods(){
   var mt = ensureModelTools();
   if(!mt) return 0;
   if(typeof RunJMethods === 'undefined' || !RunJMethods || typeof RunJMethods.register !== 'function') return 0;
   var n = 0;
   /* easy175 hydrate: saved jmethods[id] first, then pack library when present (skipIfSaved). */
   var bag = mt.jmethods || {};
   Object.keys(bag).forEach(function(id){
    var st = bag[id];
    if(!st || !st.id) return;
    try {
      var isBuiltin = RunJMethods.isBuiltin && RunJMethods.isBuiltin(st.id);
      var scriptOk = modelToolsJmScriptUsable(st.script);
      /* empty stubs do not override pack/library */
      if(!scriptOk && isBuiltin) return;
      if(!scriptOk && !st.math) return;
      var def = RunJMethods.buildFromMath(st.math || { type:'linear', params:{ a:1, b:0 } }, {
        id: st.id,
        label: st.label || st.id,
        xMax: st.xMax,
        yMax: st.yMax,
        factorDim: st.factorDim || null,
        scoreMode: st.scoreMode || 'ideal_over_ymax',
        xLabel: st.xLabel || null,
        yLabel: st.yLabel || null,
        script: st.script || null,
        clampScriptScore: isBuiltin ? false : true,
        fromBlueprint: true,
        view: st.view || st.viewGraph || null,
        place: (function(){
          try {
            if(st.script && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.compilePlace){
              var _pc = ModelToolsScript.compilePlace(st.script);
              if(_pc && _pc.ok && typeof _pc.placeFn === 'function') return _pc.placeFn;
            }
          } catch(_p){}
          return (isBuiltin && RunJMethods.BUILTIN_PLACES && RunJMethods.BUILTIN_PLACES[st.id]) || null;
        })()
      });
      def.replaceBuiltin = !!isBuiltin;
      def.fromBlueprint = true;
      def.seedOverride = true;
      def.fromSaved = true;
      if(RunJMethods.register(def)) n++;
    } catch(_r){}
   });
   /* pack = optional default library (not editor privilege). Present when packs.builtins.loaded. */
   try {
     var packOn = !(mt.packs && mt.packs.builtins && mt.packs.builtins.loaded === false);
     if(packOn && typeof RunJMethods.hydrateBuiltinsFromBlueprints === 'function'){
       n += RunJMethods.hydrateBuiltinsFromBlueprints({ skipIfSaved: true }) || 0;
     }
     /* easy177: soft-attach morningCanvasRoi → T when unset (never overwrite user attach) */
     try {
       var fmT = modelToolsEnsureFactorModel('T');
       if(fmT && !String(fmT.jmethod||'').trim()){
         fmT.jmethod = 'morningCanvasRoi';
         if(!fmT.kind) fmT.kind = modelToolsDefaultFactorKind('T');
       }
     } catch(_tAtt){}
   } catch(_hb){}
   /* easy212: live JWorld householdEconomy must win over pack math hydrate */
   try {
     if(typeof HouseholdEconomy !== 'undefined' && HouseholdEconomy && typeof HouseholdEconomy.registerJMethod === 'function'){
       if(HouseholdEconomy.registerJMethod()) n++;
     }
   } catch(_hh){}
   return n;
  }

  function modelToolsJmSuggest(dim){
   return MT_FACTOR_JM_SUGGEST[dim] || '';
  }

  function modelToolsJmListOptions(selectedId){
   selectedId = String(selectedId || '');
   var opts = [];
   opts.push('<option value="">— none —</option>');
   var seen = {};
   try {
     if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.list === 'function'){
       RunJMethods.list().forEach(function(m){
         if(!m || !m.id) return;
         seen[m.id] = true;
         var lab = m.label || m.id;
         var kind = m.kind === 'custom' ? 'custom' : 'built-in';
         if(m.blueprintExample) kind += ' · Blueprint';
         opts.push('<option value="'+esc(m.id)+'"'+(selectedId===m.id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(m.id)+' · '+esc(lab)+' ('+kind+')</option>');
       });
     }
   } catch(_l){}
   var mt = ensureModelTools();
   if(mt && mt.jmethods){
     Object.keys(mt.jmethods).forEach(function(id){
       if(seen[id]) return;
       var st = mt.jmethods[id];
       if(!st) return;
       opts.push('<option value="'+esc(id)+'"'+(selectedId===id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(id)+' · '+esc(st.label||id)+' (saved)</option>');
     });
   }
   return opts.join('');
  }

  function modelToolsDefaultMath(type){
   type = String(type || 'linear');
   if(type === 'sqrt') return { type:'sqrt', params:{ k:1 } };
   if(type === 'log1p') return { type:'log1p', params:{ k:1 } };
   if(type === 'power') return { type:'power', params:{ k:1, p:0.5 } };
   if(type === 'bezier') return { type:'bezier', params:{ points:[{x:0,y:0},{x:25,y:0.4},{x:60,y:0.75},{x:100,y:1}] } };
   return { type:'linear', params:{ a:0.01, b:0 } };
  }

  function modelToolsJmScriptUsable(script){
   if(!script || typeof script !== 'object') return false;
   if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.scriptHasAuthoredNodes)
     return ModelToolsScript.scriptHasAuthoredNodes(script);
   if(!Array.isArray(script.nodes) || !script.nodes.length) return false;
   /* easy175: emptyGraph sinks (score.out + view.out) alone are not a real Blueprint SoT */
   var sinks = { 'score.out':1, 'view.out':1, 'place.out':1, 'viz.out':1 };
   return script.nodes.some(function(n){ return n && n.type && !sinks[n.type]; });
  }
  function modelToolsBuiltinBlueprint(id){
   id = String(id || '');
   if(!id) return null;
   try {
     if(typeof ModelToolsScript === 'undefined') return null;
     if(typeof ModelToolsScript.packGraph === 'function'){
       var fromPack = ModelToolsScript.packGraph('builtins', id);
       if(fromPack) return fromPack;
     }
     var getter = ModelToolsScript.builtinBlueprints || ModelToolsScript.exampleBlueprints;
     if(typeof getter !== 'function') return null;
     var map = getter() || {};
     return map[id] || null;
   } catch(_e){ return null; }
  }
  function modelToolsPackLoaded(packId){
   packId = String(packId || 'builtins');
   try {
     var mt = ensureModelTools();
     if(mt && mt.packs && mt.packs[packId] && mt.packs[packId].loaded === false) return false;
   } catch(_p){}
   try {
     if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.getPack)
       return !!ModelToolsScript.getPack(packId);
   } catch(_g){}
   return true;
  }
  function modelToolsJmEmptyDraft(id, factorDim, label){
   id = String(id || ('jm_' + Date.now().toString(36)));
   var dim = factorDim || _mtFactorDim || null;
   return {
     id: id,
     label: label || id,
     factorDim: dim,
     math: modelToolsDefaultMath('linear'),
     xMax: 100, yMax: 1,
     xLabel: 'x', yLabel: 'ideal y',
     scoreMode: 'ideal_over_ymax',
     idea: modelToolsDefaultIdea(),
     world: modelToolsEmptyJmWorld(),
     tool: '2d',
     paper: { source:'', notes:'', extracted:null },
     space: { entityIds:[], notes:'' },
     script: (typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.emptyGraph)
       ? ModelToolsScript.emptyGraph() : { version:1, nodes:[{id:'score_out',type:'score.out',x:320,y:110,params:{}},{id:'view_out',type:'view.out',x:320,y:200,params:{}}], edges:[] },
     designerPane: 'script',
     _packOffer: modelToolsPackLoaded('builtins') ? 'builtins' : null
   };
  }
  function modelToolsJmDraftFromBuiltin(id, factorDim){
   var bp = modelToolsBuiltinBlueprint(id);
   if(!bp || !bp.script) return null;
   var script = (typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.normalizeGraph)
     ? ModelToolsScript.normalizeGraph(bp.script) : bp.script;
   var view = null;
   try {
     if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.compileView)
       view = ModelToolsScript.compileView(script);
   } catch(_v){ view = null; }
   var math = bp.math || modelToolsDefaultMath('linear');
   if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeMath)
     math = RunJMethods.normalizeMath(math);
   var xMax = Number(bp.xMax) > 0 ? Number(bp.xMax) : 100;
   var yMax = Number(bp.yMax) > 0 ? Number(bp.yMax) : 1;
   var xLabel = bp.xLabel != null ? String(bp.xLabel) : 'x';
   var yLabel = bp.yLabel != null ? String(bp.yLabel) : 'ideal y';
   var scoreMode = bp.scoreMode || 'ideal_over_ymax';
   try {
     if(view && view.curve){
       if(view.curve.math) math = (typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeMath)
         ? RunJMethods.normalizeMath(view.curve.math) : view.curve.math;
       if(view.curve.xMax > 0) xMax = Number(view.curve.xMax);
       if(view.curve.yMax > 0) yMax = Number(view.curve.yMax);
       if(view.curve.xLabel) xLabel = String(view.curve.xLabel);
       if(view.curve.yLabel) yLabel = String(view.curve.yLabel);
     }
   } catch(_cv){}
   if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeScoreMode)
     scoreMode = RunJMethods.normalizeScoreMode(scoreMode);
   return {
     id: id,
     label: bp.label || id,
     factorDim: factorDim || _mtFactorDim || null,
     math: math,
     xMax: xMax,
     yMax: yMax,
     xLabel: xLabel,
     yLabel: yLabel,
     scoreMode: scoreMode,
     idea: (bp.idea ? modelToolsNormalizeIdea(bp.idea, { notes: bp.note || '' }) : modelToolsDefaultIdea()),
     world: modelToolsEmptyJmWorld(),
     tool: '2d',
     paper: { source:'', notes: bp.note || '', extracted:null },
     space: { entityIds:[], notes:'' },
     script: script,
     view: view,
     designerPane: 'script'
   };
  }
  function modelToolsJmDraftFromStored(id){
   id = String(id || '').trim();
   if(!id) return null;
   var mt = ensureModelTools();
   var st = mt && mt.jmethods && mt.jmethods[id];
   var builtin = modelToolsBuiltinBlueprint(id);
   if(st){
     var scriptS = (typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.normalizeGraph)
       ? ModelToolsScript.normalizeGraph(st.script) : (st.script || null);
     /* easy175: saved usable wins. Empty stub → empty editor + pack offer (no silent seed inject). */
     if(!modelToolsJmScriptUsable(scriptS)){
       var emptySt = modelToolsJmEmptyDraft(st.id || id, st.factorDim || _mtFactorDim || null, st.label || id);
       emptySt.factorDim = st.factorDim || emptySt.factorDim;
       if(st.idea) emptySt.idea = modelToolsNormalizeIdea(st.idea, st.paper);
       if(st.world) emptySt.world = (function(){ var b={world:st.world}; return modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(b); })();
       if(st.tool === '3d' || st.tool === '2d') emptySt.tool = st.tool;
       if(st.math) emptySt.math = (typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeMath) ? RunJMethods.normalizeMath(st.math) : st.math;
       if(Number(st.xMax)>0) emptySt.xMax = Number(st.xMax);
       if(Number(st.yMax)>0) emptySt.yMax = Number(st.yMax);
       emptySt._packOffer = (builtin && modelToolsPackLoaded('builtins')) ? 'builtins' : emptySt._packOffer;
       emptySt._packAvailable = !!builtin;
       return emptySt;
     }
     var xMaxS = Number(st.xMax) > 0 ? Number(st.xMax) : 100;
     var yMaxS = Number(st.yMax) > 0 ? Number(st.yMax) : 1;
     var scoreModeS = (typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeScoreMode)
       ? RunJMethods.normalizeScoreMode(st.scoreMode) : (st.scoreMode || 'ideal_over_ymax');
     var viewS = (st.view && typeof st.view === 'object') ? st.view : ((st.viewGraph && typeof st.viewGraph === 'object') ? st.viewGraph : null);
     try {
       if(!viewS && scriptS && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.compileView)
         viewS = ModelToolsScript.compileView(scriptS);
     } catch(_vs){}
     var mathS = (typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeMath)
       ? RunJMethods.normalizeMath(st.math) : (st.math || modelToolsDefaultMath('linear'));
     var xLabS = st.xLabel != null ? String(st.xLabel) : 'x';
     var yLabS = st.yLabel != null ? String(st.yLabel) : 'ideal y';
     try {
       if(viewS && viewS.curve){
         if(viewS.curve.math) mathS = (typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeMath)
           ? RunJMethods.normalizeMath(viewS.curve.math) : viewS.curve.math;
         if(viewS.curve.xMax > 0) xMaxS = Number(viewS.curve.xMax);
         if(viewS.curve.yMax > 0) yMaxS = Number(viewS.curve.yMax);
         if(viewS.curve.xLabel) xLabS = String(viewS.curve.xLabel);
         if(viewS.curve.yLabel) yLabS = String(viewS.curve.yLabel);
       }
     } catch(_sync){}
     return {
       id: st.id || id,
       label: st.label || st.id || id,
       factorDim: st.factorDim || _mtFactorDim || null,
       math: mathS,
       xMax: xMaxS,
       yMax: yMaxS,
       xLabel: xLabS,
       yLabel: yLabS,
       scoreMode: scoreModeS,
       idea: modelToolsNormalizeIdea(st.idea, st.paper),
       world: (function(){ var b={world:st.world}; return modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(b); })(),
       tool: (st.tool === '3d' || st.tool === '2d') ? st.tool : '2d',
       paper: (st.paper && typeof st.paper === 'object') ? {
         source: st.paper.source || '',
         notes: st.paper.notes || '',
         extracted: st.paper.extracted != null ? st.paper.extracted : null
       } : { source:'', notes:'', extracted:null },
       space: (st.space && typeof st.space === 'object') ? {
         entityIds: Array.isArray(st.space.entityIds) ? st.space.entityIds.slice() : [],
         notes: st.space.notes || ''
       } : { entityIds:[], notes:'' },
       script: scriptS || ((typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.emptyGraph)
         ? ModelToolsScript.emptyGraph() : { version:1, nodes:[{id:'score_out',type:'score.out',x:320,y:110,params:{}}], edges:[] }),
       view: viewS,
       designerPane: 'script'
     };
   }
   /* easy175: no silent pack inject on Edit — empty + offer Load from pack when library has id */
   if(builtin && builtin.script){
     var emptyBi = modelToolsJmEmptyDraft(id, _mtFactorDim || null, (builtin.label || id));
     emptyBi._packOffer = modelToolsPackLoaded('builtins') ? 'builtins' : null;
     emptyBi._packAvailable = true;
     if(builtin.xMax) emptyBi.xMax = Number(builtin.xMax) || emptyBi.xMax;
     if(builtin.yMax) emptyBi.yMax = Number(builtin.yMax) || emptyBi.yMax;
     if(builtin.xLabel) emptyBi.xLabel = String(builtin.xLabel);
     if(builtin.yLabel) emptyBi.yLabel = String(builtin.yLabel);
     if(builtin.math) emptyBi.math = builtin.math;
     if(builtin.scoreMode) emptyBi.scoreMode = builtin.scoreMode;
     if(builtin.idea) emptyBi.idea = modelToolsNormalizeIdea(builtin.idea, { notes: builtin.note || '' });
     else if(builtin.note) emptyBi.idea = modelToolsNormalizeIdea(null, { notes: builtin.note || '' });
     return emptyBi;
   }
   /* legacy RunJMethods-only ids without pack graph */
   try {
     var m = RunJMethods && RunJMethods.get && RunJMethods.get(id);
     if(m){
       var bx = Number(m._xMax) > 0 ? Number(m._xMax) : 100;
       var by = Number(m._yMax) > 0 ? Number(m._yMax) : 1;
       return {
         id: id,
         label: m.label || id,
         factorDim: _mtFactorDim || null,
         math: (m.math && typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeMath)
           ? RunJMethods.normalizeMath(m.math) : modelToolsDefaultMath('linear'),
         xMax: bx,
         yMax: by,
         xLabel: (m.axes && m.axes.x && m.axes.x.label) || 'x',
         yLabel: (m.axes && m.axes.y && m.axes.y.label) || 'ideal y',
         scoreMode: m.scoreMode || 'ideal_over_ymax',
         idea: modelToolsDefaultIdea(),
         world: modelToolsEmptyJmWorld(),
         tool: '2d',
         paper: { source:'', notes:'', extracted:null },
         space: { entityIds:[], notes:'' },
         script: (typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.emptyGraph)
           ? ModelToolsScript.emptyGraph() : { version:1, nodes:[{id:'score_out',type:'score.out',x:320,y:110,params:{}}], edges:[] },
         designerPane: 'script'
       };
     }
   } catch(_g){}
   return null;
  }

       ? ModelToolsScript.emptyGraph() : { version:1, nodes:[{id:'score_out',type:'score.out',x:320,y:110,params:{}}], edges:[] },
     designerPane: 'script'
   };
  }

  /** Heuristic paper → math (no network). Prefer RunJMethods.suggestMathFromPaper when present. */
  function modelToolsSuggestMathFromPaper(text){
   var raw = String(text || '');
   if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.suggestMathFromPaper === 'function'){
     try { return RunJMethods.suggestMathFromPaper(raw); } catch(_s){}
   }
   var t = raw.toLowerCase();
   var out = {
     toolSuggest: null,
     math: null,
     caption: '',
     extracted: { keywords: [], patterns: [] }
   };
   var kw = [];
   if(/\b3d\b|spatial|geospatial|\bgeo\b|\bmap\b|latitude|longitude|xyz|voxel/.test(t)){
     out.toolSuggest = '3d'; kw.push('spatial/3d');
   }
   if(/bezier|spline|\bcurve\b|control\s*point/.test(t)){ out.math = modelToolsDefaultMath('bezier'); kw.push('bezier'); }
   else if(/\blog\b|\bln\b|log1p|logarithmic|log\s*\(/.test(t)){ out.math = modelToolsDefaultMath('log1p'); kw.push('log'); }
   else if(/sqrt|square\s*root/.test(t) || /√/.test(raw)){ out.math = modelToolsDefaultMath('sqrt'); kw.push('sqrt'); }
   else if(/power|exponent|\^|x\s*\*\*|x\s*\^/.test(t)){ out.math = modelToolsDefaultMath('power'); kw.push('power'); }
   else if(/linear|regression|\bslope\b|y\s*=\s*a\s*\*?\s*x/.test(t)){ out.math = modelToolsDefaultMath('linear'); kw.push('linear'); }
   var mLin = raw.match(/y\s*=\s*([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)\s*\*?\s*x\s*([-+]\s*\d*\.?\d+)?/i);
   if(mLin){
     var a = parseFloat(String(mLin[1]).replace(/\s/g,''));
     var b = mLin[2] != null ? parseFloat(String(mLin[2]).replace(/\s/g,'')) : 0;
     if(!isFinite(a)) a = 0.01;
     if(!isFinite(b)) b = 0;
     out.math = { type:'linear', params:{ a:a, b:b } };
     out.extracted.patterns.push('y=a*x+b');
     kw.push('linear-pattern');
   }
   var mSqrt = raw.match(/(?:y\s*=\s*)?([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)\s*\*?\s*(?:sqrt|√)\s*\(?\s*x\s*\)?/i);
   if(mSqrt){
     var k = mSqrt[1] != null ? parseFloat(mSqrt[1]) : 1;
     if(!isFinite(k)) k = 1;
     out.math = { type:'sqrt', params:{ k:k } };
     out.extracted.patterns.push('k*sqrt(x)');
     kw.push('sqrt-pattern');
   }
   var mPow = raw.match(/y\s*=\s*([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)?\s*\*?\s*x\s*\^\s*([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)/i)
     || raw.match(/x\s*\^\s*([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)/i);
   if(mPow && !(out.extracted.patterns && out.extracted.patterns.length)){
     var kk = 1, pp = 0.5;
     if(mPow.length > 2 && mPow[2] != null){ kk = (mPow[1] != null && mPow[1] !== '') ? parseFloat(mPow[1]) : 1; pp = parseFloat(mPow[2]); }
     else { pp = parseFloat(mPow[1]); }
     if(!isFinite(kk)) kk = 1;
     if(!isFinite(pp)) pp = 0.5;
     out.math = { type:'power', params:{ k:kk, p:pp } };
     out.extracted.patterns.push('x^p');
     kw.push('power-pattern');
   }
   if(!out.math) out.math = modelToolsDefaultMath('linear');
   out.extracted.keywords = kw;
   try {
     out.caption = (typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.mathFormulaText)
       ? RunJMethods.mathFormulaText(out.math) : (out.math.type || '');
   } catch(_c){ out.caption = out.math.type || ''; }
   return out;
  }

  function modelToolsPaperIntakeHtml(draft){
   /* legacy name — Idea → model workspace (no suggest-from-paper) */
   return modelToolsIdeaIntakeHtml(draft);
  }


  function modelToolsJmToolPickerHtml(draft){
   var d = draft || _mtJmDraft;
   if(!d) return '<p class="hint">No jmethod draft.</p>';
   var html = '';
   html += '<div class="mt-jm-toolpick" data-jm-id="'+esc(d.id)+'" style="margin-top:10px;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(20,28,40,.65)">';
   html += '<div class="add-row" style="justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px">';
   html += '<h3 style="font-size:.85rem;margin:0;color:var(--edit)">New jmethod · Blueprint</h3>';
   html += '<button type="button" class="pill" id="mt-jm-close">Close</button>';
   html += '</div>';
   html += '<p class="hint" style="margin:0 0 8px"><b>Blueprint owns Curve view + 3D view nodes; world content via BP nodes; PREVIEW views.</b> Wire inputs → math/view → score.out. Add <code>view.curve</code> / <code>view.3d</code> / <code>world.add.*</code> from the palette — no world point id for the jmethod. <code>score.out → run()/rank · view.out → PREVIEW</code>.</p>';
   html += modelToolsPaperIntakeHtml(d);
   html += '<div class="add-row" style="flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px">';
   html += '<button type="button" class="btn btn-ok" id="mt-jm-pick-2d" title="Enter Blueprint editor" style="min-width:180px">Enter Blueprint</button>';
   html += '</div>';
   html += '<p class="hint" style="margin:8px 0 0">Palette: Inputs · <b>Jfactor</b> · Data · Math · View · World/3D · Out. Pull x/y/xMax/yMax/Jgroup via <code>jfactor.*</code> / <code>data.*</code> — not forced fixed domain. Selecting <code>view.curve</code> opens Curve view; <code>view.3d</code> opens Fusion-esc 3D.</p>';
   html += '</div>';

  }

  function modelToolsSpawnJmethodEntity(draft){
   /* DISABLED: jmethods are attachments, not scene entities. Blank world only. */
   var d = draft || _mtJmDraft;
   if(d && typeof modelToolsEnsureJmWorld === 'function') modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(d);
   return null;
  }
  function modelToolsSnapNice(v){
   v = Number(v);
   if(!(v > 0) || !isFinite(v)) return 1;
   var exp = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(v)));
   var n = v / exp;
   var nice;
   if(n <= 1) nice = 1;
   else if(n <= 1.5) nice = 1.5;
   else if(n <= 2) nice = 2;
   else if(n <= 3) nice = 3;
   else if(n <= 5) nice = 5;
   else nice = 10;
   return nice * exp;
  }

  /** Empty per-jmethod 3D world — isolated from global factor entities. */
  function modelToolsEmptyJmWorld(){
   return {
     entities: [],
     components: [],
     camera: { yaw:-35, pitch:42, dist:28, target:[0,0,0] },
     map: { gridSize:20, showAxes:true, note:'blank jmethod sim world' },
     meetups: []
   };
  }

  /** Ensure draft/stored jmethod has nested .world {entities,components,camera,map,meetups}. */
  function modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(bag){
   if(!bag || typeof bag !== 'object') return modelToolsEmptyJmWorld();
   if(!bag.world || typeof bag.world !== 'object') bag.world = modelToolsEmptyJmWorld();
   var w = bag.world;
   if(!Array.isArray(w.entities)) w.entities = [];
   if(!Array.isArray(w.components)) w.components = [];
   if(!w.camera || typeof w.camera !== 'object') w.camera = { yaw:-35, pitch:42, dist:28, target:[0,0,0] };
   if(!w.map || typeof w.map !== 'object') w.map = { gridSize:20, showAxes:true, note:'blank jmethod sim world' };
   if(!Array.isArray(w.meetups)) w.meetups = [];
   return w;
  }

  function modelToolsEnsureScript(draft){
   if(!draft) return null;
   if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.normalizeGraph){
     draft.script = ModelToolsScript.normalizeGraph(draft.script);
   } else if(!draft.script || typeof draft.script !== 'object'){
     draft.script = { version:1, nodes:[{ id:'score_out', type:'score.out', x:520, y:160, params:{} }], edges:[] };
   }
   return draft.script;
  }

  function modelToolsScriptCompileStatus(draft){
   if(!draft || !draft.script) return { ok:false, error:'no script' };
   if(typeof ModelToolsScript === 'undefined' || !ModelToolsScript.compile) return { ok:false, error:'ModelToolsScript missing' };
   try { return ModelToolsScript.compile(draft.script); } catch(e){ return { ok:false, error:String(e && e.message || e) }; }
  }

  /* easy172: sample ctx from draft mid-domain or first board landing */
  function modelToolsJmProbeSample(draft){
   var d = draft || _mtJmDraft;
   var xMax = Math.max(Number(d && d.xMax) || 100, 1e-6);
   var yMax = Math.max(Number(d && d.yMax) || 1, 1e-6);
   var ctx = {
     x: xMax * 0.5,
     y: yMax * 0.5,
     xMax: xMax,
     yMax: yMax,
     D: 30, Dmax: 31, E: 10, Emax: 20,
     name: (d && d.id) || 'probe',
     act: {}
   };
   try {
     var pts = modelToolsJmLandingPoints(d && d.id, d);
     if(pts && pts.length && pts[0].x > 0){
       ctx.x = pts[0].x;
       ctx.y = pts[0].y > 0 ? pts[0].y : ctx.y;
       ctx.name = pts[0].name || ctx.name;
       ctx._fromBoard = true;
     }
   } catch(_lp){}
   if(d && d._lastSim){
     ctx._lastSim = d._lastSim;
     if(d._lastSim.score != null) ctx._simScore = d._lastSim.score;
     if(d._lastSim.x != null) ctx.x = d._lastSim.x;
     if(d._lastSim.y != null) ctx.y = d._lastSim.y;
   }
   return ctx;
  }

  function modelToolsJmRefreshProbe(draft){
   var d = draft || _mtJmDraft;
   if(!d || !d.script || typeof ModelToolsScript === 'undefined' || !ModelToolsScript.probePins){
     _mtJmLastProbe = null;
     return null;
   }
   var ctx = modelToolsJmProbeSample(d);
   var probe = null;
   try { probe = ModelToolsScript.probePins(d.script, ctx); } catch(_p){ probe = null; }
   var bpScore = (probe && probe.score != null) ? probe.score : null;
   try {
     if(bpScore == null) bpScore = modelToolsJmScoreAt(d, ctx.x, ctx.y);
   } catch(_b){ bpScore = null; }
   var rjScore = null;
   try {
     if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.score && d.id)
       rjScore = RunJMethods.score(d.id, ctx);
   } catch(_r){ rjScore = null; }
   var domain = { bpX: null, bpY: null, draftX: ctx.xMax, draftY: ctx.yMax, match: null, note: '' };
   try {
     var viewDesc = (probe && probe.view) ? probe.view : (ModelToolsScript.compileView ? ModelToolsScript.compileView(d.script) : null);
     if(viewDesc && viewDesc.curve){
       domain.bpX = Number(viewDesc.curve.xMax) || null;
       domain.bpY = Number(viewDesc.curve.yMax) || null;
     }
     if(viewDesc && viewDesc.curveSource) domain.curveSource = viewDesc.curveSource;
     else domain.curveSource = 'unknown';
     var meth = (typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.get) ? RunJMethods.get(d.id) : null;
     var prevX = meth && meth._xMax != null ? Number(meth._xMax) : Number(d.xMax);
     var prevY = meth && meth._yMax != null ? Number(meth._yMax) : Number(d.yMax);
     domain.previewX = prevX;
     domain.previewY = prevY;
     if(domain.bpX > 0 && prevX > 0){
       var rx = Math.abs(domain.bpX - prevX) / Math.max(domain.bpX, prevX);
       var ry = (domain.bpY > 0 && prevY > 0) ? Math.abs(domain.bpY - prevY) / Math.max(domain.bpY, prevY) : 0;
       domain.match = (rx < 0.02 && ry < 0.02);
       domain.note = domain.match ? 'view.out domain matches PREVIEW chart' : 'view.out domain ≠ PREVIEW chart domain';
     } else {
       domain.note = 'domain compare unavailable';
     }
   } catch(_d){ domain.note = 'domain compare error'; }
   _mtJmLastProbe = {
     ctx: ctx,
     values: (probe && probe.values) || {},
     score: bpScore,
     place: probe && probe.place,
     bpScore: bpScore,
     rjScore: rjScore,
     domain: domain,
     ok: !!(probe && probe.ok)
   };
   return _mtJmLastProbe;
  }

  function modelToolsBpPreviewDiffHtml(draft){
   var d = draft || _mtJmDraft;
   if(!d) return '';
   var probe = _mtJmLastProbe;
   try { if(!probe || (probe.ctx && d.id && probe.ctx.name === 'probe')) probe = modelToolsJmRefreshProbe(d); } catch(_r){}
   if(!probe) probe = modelToolsJmRefreshProbe(d);
   if(!probe) return '';
   var bp = probe.bpScore;
   var rj = probe.rjScore;
   var diff = (bp != null && rj != null && isFinite(bp) && isFinite(rj)) ? (bp - rj) : null;
   var abs = diff != null ? Math.abs(diff) : null;
   var okish = abs != null && (abs < 1e-6 || abs / (Math.abs(rj) + 1e-9) < 0.02);
   var col = okish ? '#9ece6a' : (diff != null ? '#e0af68' : '#7aa2f7');
   var src = (probe.ctx && probe.ctx._fromBoard) ? 'board landing' : ((d._lastSim) ? 'last sim' : 'mid-domain');
   var html = '';
   html += '<div class="mt-jm-bp-preview-diff" style="margin:0 0 8px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid '+col+';border-radius:6px;background:rgba(125,207,255,.05)">';
   html += '<div class="hint" style="margin:0;color:'+col+'"><b>BP ↔ PREVIEW</b> · sample <code>x='+esc(String(Number(probe.ctx.x).toFixed(3)))+'</code> <code>y='+esc(String(Number(probe.ctx.y).toFixed(3)))+'</code> ('+esc(src)+')';
   html += ' · BP score <b>'+esc(bp!=null && isFinite(bp) ? Number(bp).toPrecision(6) : '—')+'</b>';
   html += ' · RunJMethods.score <b>'+esc(rj!=null && isFinite(rj) ? Number(rj).toPrecision(6) : '—')+'</b>';
   if(diff != null) html += ' · Δ <b>'+esc(Number(diff).toPrecision(4))+'</b>'+(okish?' · match':' · diverge');
   html += '</div>';
   if(probe.domain){
     html += '<div class="hint" style="margin:2px 0 0;color:#a9b1d6;font-size:.72rem">'+esc(probe.domain.note||'');
     if(probe.domain.bpX != null) html += ' · view.out xMax/yMax='+esc(String(probe.domain.bpX))+'/'+esc(String(probe.domain.bpY));
     if(probe.domain.previewX != null) html += ' · PREVIEW _xMax/_yMax='+esc(String(probe.domain.previewX))+'/'+esc(String(probe.domain.previewY));
     if(probe.domain.curveSource) html += ' · curve <b>'+esc(probe.domain.curveSource)+'</b>';
     html += '</div>';
   }
   html += '</div>';
   return html;
  }

  function modelToolsPinTypeColor(t){
   t = String(t||'any');
   if(t==='number') return '#7aa2f7';
   if(t==='view') return '#bb9af7';
   if(t==='world') return '#e0af68';
   if(t==='jgroup') return '#c0a0f0';
   if(t==='place') return '#f7768e';
   return '#565f89';
  }

  function modelToolsFmtPinVal(v){
   if(v == null || !isFinite(Number(v))) return '';
   var n = Number(v);
   if(Math.abs(n) >= 1000) return n.toFixed(1);
   if(Math.abs(n) >= 10) return n.toFixed(2);
   if(Math.abs(n) >= 1) return n.toFixed(3);
   return n.toPrecision(3);
  }

  function modelToolsScriptCanvasHtml(draft){

     var ports = isIn ? (metaN.ins||[]) : (metaN.outs||[]);

   /* easy175: subgraph / collapse frames */

     if(gr.collapsed){

     }
     html += '</g>';
   });
   var _pinVals = (_mtJmLastProbe && _mtJmLastProbe.values) ? _mtJmLastProbe.values : {};
   (g.edges||[]).forEach(function(e, ei){
     var a = nodeMap[e.from], b = nodeMap[e.to];
     if(!a || !b) return;
     if(_collapsedIds && (_collapsedIds[e.from] || _collapsedIds[e.to])){
       /* hide internal; if crosses group boundary, stub later — skip for lightweight collapse */
       if(_collapsedIds[e.from] && _collapsedIds[e.to] && _collapsedIds[e.from]===_collapsedIds[e.to]) return;
       if(_collapsedIds[e.from] || _collapsedIds[e.to]) return;
     }
     var p0 = portXY(a, e.fromPort||'out', false);
     var p1 = portXY(b, e.toPort||'in', true);
     var mx = (p0.x + p1.x) / 2;
     var edgeKey = e.from+'|'+e.fromPort+'|'+e.to+'|'+e.toPort;
     var isEdgeSel = (_mtJmScriptEdgeSel === edgeKey);
     var eInfo = null;
     try {
       if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.edgeTypeInfo)
         eInfo = ModelToolsScript.edgeTypeInfo(g, e);
     } catch(_ei){ eInfo = null; }
     var bad = eInfo && eInfo.ok === false;
     var soft = eInfo && eInfo.soft;
     var stroke = isEdgeSel ? '#f7768e' : (bad ? '#f7768e' : (soft ? '#e0af68' : '#7dcfff'));
     var sw = isEdgeSel ? 2.4 : (bad ? 2.2 : 1.6);

     html += '<path class="mt-jm-script-edge" data-edge-key="'+esc(edgeKey)+'" d="M'+p0.x.toFixed(1)+','+p0.y.toFixed(1)+' C'+mx.toFixed(1)+','+p0.y.toFixed(1)+' '+mx.toFixed(1)+','+p1.y.toFixed(1)+' '+p1.x.toFixed(1)+','+p1.y.toFixed(1)+'" fill="none" stroke="'+stroke+'" stroke-width="'+sw+'"'+dash+' marker-end="url(#mt-script-arrow)" opacity="0.9" style="cursor:pointer"/>';
   });
   (g.nodes||[]).forEach(function(n){
     if(!n) return;
     if(_collapsedIds && _collapsedIds[n.id]) return; /* hidden inside collapsed subgraph */
     var m = meta[n.type] || { label:n.type, ins:[], outs:['out'] };
     var isSel = (sel === n.id) || !!_mtJmScriptSelSet[n.id];
     var w = nw(n.type), h = nh(n.type);
     var fill = isSel ? '#1a2740' : '#121a28';
     var stroke = isSel ? '#bb9af7' : (n.type==='score.out'||n.type==='view.out'||n.type==='place.out' ? '#9ece6a' : (m.kind==='view'||m.kind==='view3d'||m.kind==='cad'||m.kind==='cad3d'?'#7aa2f7':(m.kind==='score'?'#c0a0f0':(m.kind==='place'?'#f7768e':(m.kind==='world'||m.kind==='measure'?'#e0af68':'#565f89')))));
     html += '<g class="mt-jm-script-node" data-nid="'+esc(n.id)+'" transform="translate('+Number(n.x)+','+Number(n.y)+')" style="cursor:grab">';
     html += '<rect width="'+w+'" height="'+h+'" rx="7" fill="'+fill+'" stroke="'+stroke+'" stroke-width="'+(isSel?2:1.2)+'"/>';
     html += '<text x="8" y="14" fill="#c0caf5" font-size="10" font-family="system-ui,sans-serif">'+esc(m.label||n.type)+'</text>';
     html += '<text x="8" y="26" fill="#565f89" font-size="7.5" font-family="system-ui,sans-serif">'+esc(n.type)+'</text>';
     if(isConst(n.type)){
       var ref = (n.params && n.params.ref) || '';
       var cv = ref ? ('ref:'+ref) : String((n.params && n.params.value) != null ? n.params.value : 0);
       html += '<foreignObject x="6" y="'+(h-22)+'" width="'+(w-12)+'" height="18">';
       html += '<div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" style="margin:0;padding:0">';
       html += '<input class="mt-jm-script-const-inline" data-nid="'+esc(n.id)+'" type="number" step="any" value="'+esc(String((n.params&&n.params.value)!=null?n.params.value:0))+'" style="width:100%;height:16px;font-size:10px;background:#1a1b26;color:#e0af68;border:1px solid #565f89;border-radius:3px;padding:0 3px" />';
       html += '</div></foreignObject>';
     }
     (m.ins||[]).forEach(function(pp, idx){
       var py = 18 + (idx + 1) * ((h - 18) / ((m.ins.length||1) + 1));
       var ptIn = 'any';
       try { if(ModelToolsScript.portTypeOf) ptIn = ModelToolsScript.portTypeOf(n.type, pp, 'in'); } catch(_t){}

       html += '<text x="7" y="'+(py+3).toFixed(1)+'" fill="'+colIn+'" font-size="7.5">'+esc(pp)+'</text>';

       if(iv != null && isFinite(Number(iv))){
         html += '<text x="7" y="'+(py+11).toFixed(1)+'" fill="#a9b1d6" font-size="6.5">'+esc(modelToolsFmtPinVal(iv))+'</text>';
       }

     (m.outs||[]).forEach(function(pp, idx){

       html += '<text x="'+(w-8)+'" y="'+(py+3).toFixed(1)+'" text-anchor="end" fill="'+colOut+'" font-size="7.5">'+esc(pp)+'</text>';
       var ov = _pinVals[n.id+'#'+pp];
       if(ov != null && isFinite(Number(ov))){
         html += '<text x="'+(w-8)+'" y="'+(py+11).toFixed(1)+'" text-anchor="end" fill="#a9b1d6" font-size="6.5">'+esc(modelToolsFmtPinVal(ov))+'</text>';
       }
     });
     html += '</g>';
   });
   html += '<rect id="mt-jm-bp-marquee" x="0" y="0" width="0" height="0" fill="rgba(125,207,255,0.12)" stroke="#7dcfff" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 3" visibility="hidden"/>';
   html += '</g>'; /* world */
   html += '</svg></div>';
   html += '</div>'; /* layout */
   var selNode = null;
   (g.nodes||[]).forEach(function(n){ if(n.id === sel) selNode = n; });
   if(selNode && isConst(selNode.type)){

  function modelToolsJmCad3dPanelHtml(draft){
   var d = draft || _mtJmDraft;

   if(!d.world || !d.world.spatial) {
     modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(d);
     if(!d.world.spatial) d.world.spatial = { transforms:'', measures:'', mapLinks:'', scale:'local', measureA:'', measureB:'' };
   }
   var sp = d.world.spatial;
   var open = !!_mtJmCad3dOpen;
   var wents = (d.world && Array.isArray(d.world.entities)) ? d.world.entities.length : 0;
   var html = '';
   html += '<div class="mt-jm-3d-extras" style="margin-top:10px;padding:8px;border:1px dashed var(--edit);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(126,200,227,.06)">';
   html += '<div class="hint" style="margin:0 0 6px"><b>3D view</b> (Fusion-esc) · hosted by Blueprint <code>view.3d</code> · world of <code>'+esc(d.id)+'</code> only · select component · Move gizmo translate · segments as lines · fields as volumes · measure.distance live label · grid from world bounds · PREVIEW via view.out</div>';
   var _wcN = (d.world && Array.isArray(d.world.components)) ? d.world.components.length : 0;
   if(!_wcN && d.script && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.collectWorldComponents){
     try { _wcN = (ModelToolsScript.collectWorldComponents(d.script)||[]).length; } catch(_wn){ _wcN = 0; }
   }
   html += '<p class="hint" style="margin:0 0 6px;color:#9ece6a">BP world components: <b>'+_wcN+'</b> (tool-emitted viz — not factor/jmethod entities)</p>';
   html += '<div class="add-row" style="flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px">';
   html += open
     ? '<button type="button" class="btn" id="mt-jm-cad3d-close">Close 3D view</button>'
     : '<button type="button" class="btn btn-ok" id="mt-jm-cad3d-open" title="Orbit viewport for this jmethod .world only">Open 3D view (Fusion-esc)</button>';
   html += '<button type="button" class="pill" id="mt-jm-switch-2d" title="Drop 3D-specific tools">2D tools only</button>';

   if(open){
     html += '<div class="mt-jm-cad3d-viewport" style="margin:0 0 8px">';
     html += '<div class="add-row" style="flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px">';

     html += '<button type="button" class="pill mt-jm-cad3d-gizmo" data-mt-mode="navigate" title="Orbit / pan">Orbit</button>';
     html += '<button type="button" class="pill mt-jm-cad3d-gizmo" data-cad3d-gizmo="move" title="Move (translate)">Move</button>';
     html += '<button type="button" class="pill mt-jm-cad3d-gizmo" data-cad3d-gizmo="rotate" title="Rotate">Rotate</button>';
     html += '<button type="button" class="pill mt-jm-cad3d-gizmo" data-cad3d-gizmo="scale" title="Scale">Scale</button>';
     html += '<span class="hint" id="mt-jm-cad3d-gizmo-label" style="margin:0">active: orbit · world=<code>'+esc(d.id)+'</code></span>';
     html += '</div>';
     html += '<canvas id="mt-jm-cad3d-canvas" width="640" height="360" style="width:100%;max-width:640px;height:360px;background:#0a0e14;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;display:block;touch-action:none"></canvas>';
     html += '<p class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 0">Loads/saves only this jmethod <code>.world</code> · <code>measure.distance</code> updates live overlay when A/B set · no factor/jmethod entities.</p>';
     html += '</div>';
     html += '<div class="add-row" style="flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px">';
     html += '<label class="hint">Measure distance (A)<br/><input id="mt-jm-3d-measure-a" type="text" value="'+esc(sp.measureA||'')+'" placeholder="point / object A" style="width:140px" /></label>';

  function modelToolsJmScoreAt(draft, x, y){
   if(!draft) return 0;
   var math = draft.math || modelToolsDefaultMath('linear');
   var xMax = Math.max(Number(draft.xMax)||100, 1e-6);
   var yMax = Math.max(Number(draft.yMax)||1, 1e-6);
   var yIdeal = 0;
   try {
     if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.idealYFromMath)
       yIdeal = RunJMethods.idealYFromMath(math, x);
   } catch(_y){ yIdeal = 0; }
   if(!isFinite(yIdeal) || yIdeal < 0) yIdeal = 0;
   /* Blueprint overrides scoreMode when compiled ok */
   if(draft.script && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.compile){
     try {
       var compiled = ModelToolsScript.compile(draft.script);
       if(compiled && compiled.ok && compiled.scoreFn){
         return compiled.scoreFn({
           x:x, y:y, xMax:xMax, yMax:yMax, idealY:yIdeal,
           idealYAt: function(xx){
             try { return RunJMethods.idealYFromMath(math, xx); } catch(_i){ return yIdeal; }
           }
         });
       }
     } catch(_sc){}
   }
   var mode = draft.scoreMode || 'ideal_over_ymax';
   if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.scoreFromRecipe){
     return RunJMethods.scoreFromRecipe(mode, { x:x, y:y, idealY:yIdeal, xMax:xMax, yMax:yMax });
   }
   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, yIdeal / (yMax||1)));
  }

  /**
   * PIPELINE LAW: overall run() → item.jmethod → simulate world[jmethod] → score.
   * Stub: tick this jmethod's isolated world entities; score from draft/math + itemCtx.
   * liveBest/Exp6 run() will call this when wiring is complete — designer "Sim this world" uses it now.
   */
  function modelToolsSimulateJmethodWorld(jmethodId, itemCtx){
   itemCtx = itemCtx || {};
   var mt = ensureModelTools();
   var id = String(jmethodId || (_mtJmDraft && _mtJmDraft.id) || '');
   var st = (mt && mt.jmethods && mt.jmethods[id]) || null;
   var draft = (_mtJmDraft && _mtJmDraft.id === id) ? _mtJmDraft : null;
   var bag = draft || st;
   if(!bag){
     return { ok:false, score:0, world:null, reason:'no_jmethod', id:id };
   }
   var world = modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(bag);
   var ents = (world.entities||[]).filter(function(e){ return e && e.enabled !== false; });
   var added = 0;
   var nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
   for(var i=0;i<ents.length;i++){
     var A = ents[i];
     if(!A || !A.run || !A.run.emitMeetup) continue;
     var radius = Math.max(0.1, Number(A.run.radius)||2.5);
     for(var j=i+1;j<ents.length;j++){
       var B = ents[j];
       if(!B) continue;
       if(modelToolsDist(A.pos, B.pos) <= radius){
         world.meetups.push({
           at: nowIso, a: A.name||A.id, b: B.name||B.id, aId:A.id, bId:B.id,
           pos: { x:((Number(A.pos&&A.pos.x)||0)+(Number(B.pos&&B.pos.x)||0))/2, y:0,
                  z:((Number(A.pos&&A.pos.z)||0)+(Number(B.pos&&B.pos.z)||0))/2 },
           jmethodId: id
         });
         added++;
       }
     }
   }
   if(world.meetups.length > 100) world.meetups = world.meetups.slice(-100);
   var x = itemCtx.x != null ? Number(itemCtx.x) : ((Number(bag.xMax)||100)*0.5);
   var y = itemCtx.y != null ? Number(itemCtx.y) : ((Number(bag.yMax)||1)*0.5);
   if(!(x >= 0)) x = (Number(bag.xMax)||100) * 0.5;
   if(!(y >= 0)) y = (Number(bag.yMax)||1) * 0.5;
   var score = modelToolsJmScoreAt(bag, x, y);
   /* easy172: if graph has sim.step → prefer its score out when wired (via _simScore ctx) */
   try {
     if(bag.script && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.compile){
       var hasSim = (bag.script.nodes||[]).some(function(n){ return n && n.type === 'sim.step'; });
       if(hasSim){
         var compiledSim = ModelToolsScript.compile(bag.script);
         if(compiledSim && compiledSim.ok && compiledSim.scoreFn){
           var simCtx = {
             x:x, y:y,
             xMax: Number(bag.xMax)||100,
             yMax: Number(bag.yMax)||1,
             _simScore: score,
             _lastSim: { score: score, x:x, y:y, ok:true }
           };
           var scored = compiledSim.scoreFn(simCtx);
           if(isFinite(scored)) score = scored;
         }
       }
     }
   } catch(_simG){}
   var lastSim = { ok:true, score:score, x:x, y:y, at: Date.now(), meetupsAdded:added };
   if(st){ st.world = world; st._lastSim = lastSim; }
   if(draft){ draft.world = world; draft._lastSim = lastSim; }
   try { _mtJmLastProbe = null; } catch(_lp){}
   return { ok:true, score:score, world:world, meetupsAdded:added, id:id, x:x, y:y, lastSim:lastSim };
  }


  function modelToolsDefaultIdea(){
   return { name:'', mechanism:'', inputs:'', outputs:'', assumptions:'', boardItems:[], boardItemsSource:null, economy:null, emitMin:null };
  }
  function modelToolsNormalizeIdea(idea, paper){
   var out = modelToolsDefaultIdea();
   if(idea && typeof idea === 'object'){
     out.name = idea.name != null ? String(idea.name) : '';
     out.mechanism = idea.mechanism != null ? String(idea.mechanism) : '';
     out.inputs = idea.inputs != null ? String(idea.inputs) : '';
     out.outputs = idea.outputs != null ? String(idea.outputs) : '';
     out.assumptions = idea.assumptions != null ? String(idea.assumptions) : '';
     if(Array.isArray(idea.boardItems)) out.boardItems = idea.boardItems.slice();
     if(idea.boardItemsSource && typeof idea.boardItemsSource === 'object') out.boardItemsSource = idea.boardItemsSource;
     if(idea.economy && typeof idea.economy === 'object') out.economy = idea.economy;
     if(idea.emitMin != null) out.emitMin = idea.emitMin;
   } else if(paper && typeof paper === 'object'){
     /* migrate legacy paper.source → mechanism (no suggest) */
     out.mechanism = String(paper.source || paper.notes || '');
     out.name = '';
   }
   return out;
  }
  /** Idea → model workspace: capture mechanism; CAD encodes domain/score. No auto-guess. */
  function modelToolsIdeaIntakeHtml(draft){
   var d = draft || {};
   var idea = modelToolsNormalizeIdea(d.idea, d.paper);
   var html = '';
   html += '<div class="mt-jm-idea" style="margin:0 0 10px;padding:8px;border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(12,18,28,.55)">';
   html += '<div class="hint" style="margin:0 0 6px"><b>Idea → model</b> — capture the paper\'s mechanism, then author domain &amp; score with CAD. Authored here → viewed on <b>PREVIEW</b> → <code>run()</code> simulates this jmethod\'s world.</div>';
   html += '<label class="hint">Idea name</label>';
   html += '<input id="mt-jm-idea-name" type="text" value="'+esc(idea.name)+'" placeholder="e.g. diminishing returns on hours" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:6px" />';
   html += '<label class="hint">How it works (mechanism)</label>';
   html += '<textarea id="mt-jm-idea-mechanism" style="width:100%;min-height:56px;background:var(--input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:6px;margin:4px 0 6px" placeholder="Prose: what causes what; how inputs become the response…">'+esc(idea.mechanism)+'</textarea>';
   html += '<div class="add-row" style="flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px">';
   html += '<label class="hint" style="flex:1;min-width:140px">Inputs (→ x / domain)<br/><input id="mt-jm-idea-inputs" type="text" value="'+esc(idea.inputs)+'" placeholder="hours, $ spend, days…" style="width:100%" /></label>';
   html += '<label class="hint" style="flex:1;min-width:140px">Outputs (→ y / score)<br/><input id="mt-jm-idea-outputs" type="text" value="'+esc(idea.outputs)+'" placeholder="utility, happiness, urgency…" style="width:100%" /></label>';
   html += '</div>';
   html += '<label class="hint">Assumptions</label>';
   html += '<textarea id="mt-jm-idea-assumptions" style="width:100%;min-height:40px;background:var(--input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:6px;margin:4px 0 0" placeholder="ceteris paribus, bounds, what we ignore…">'+esc(idea.assumptions)+'</textarea>';
   html += '<p class="hint" style="margin:6px 0 0">Pipeline: <code>idea → Blueprint → Emit to Board</code> · <code>run() → item.jmethod → score</code></p>';
   var biN = (idea.boardItems && idea.boardItems.length) ? idea.boardItems.length : 0;
   var biSrc = (idea.boardItemsSource && idea.boardItemsSource.type) ? String(idea.boardItemsSource.type) : 'none';
   html += '<p class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 0">Board emitters: <b>'+biN+'</b> in <code>idea.boardItems</code> · source <code>'+esc(biSrc)+'</code>'
     + (biN ? ' · use <b>Emit to Board</b> (idempotent upsert; not must-suggest by default)' : '')+'</p>';
   var firmsN = (idea.economy && Array.isArray(idea.economy.firms)) ? idea.economy.firms.length : 0;
   var hasEco = firmsN > 0 || (d && d.id === 'localEconomy') || (idea.boardItemsSource && (idea.boardItemsSource.type === 'economy.firms' || idea.boardItemsSource.ingest));
   if(hasEco){
     var ingestTag = (idea.boardItemsSource && idea.boardItemsSource.ingest) ? String(idea.boardItemsSource.ingest) : 'stub';
     var nextTag = (idea.boardItemsSource && idea.boardItemsSource.next) ? String(idea.boardItemsSource.next) : 'connect listings/hours API or paste firms JSON';
     html += '<p class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 0">Economy firms: <b>'+firmsN+'</b> · ingest <code>'+esc(ingestTag)+'</code>'
       + ' · <span style="opacity:.85">'+esc(nextTag)+'</span></p>';
     html += '<div class="add-row" style="flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:6px">';
     html += '<button type="button" class="btn" id="mt-jm-refresh-ingest" title="Live listings ingest stub — does not invent businesses/hours/prices. Returns status:stub unless you paste/import firms JSON.">Refresh ingest (stub)</button>';
     html += '<span class="hint" id="mt-jm-ingest-status" style="align-self:center">honesty: no live listings yet</span>';
     html += '</div>';
   }
   html += '</div>';
   return html;
  }


  /* easy171: board/PREVIEW-style place landings for this jmethod (same units as place/score) */
  function modelToolsJmLandingPoints(jmId, draft){
   var pts = [];
   jmId = String(jmId || (draft && draft.id) || '').trim();
   if(!jmId) return pts;
   try {
     if(typeof RunJMethods === 'undefined' || !RunJMethods || typeof RunJMethods.get !== 'function') return pts;
     var meth = RunJMethods.get(jmId);
     if(!meth || typeof meth.place !== 'function') return pts;
     var acts = [];
     try {
       if(typeof easyBoardActs === 'function') acts = easyBoardActs() || [];
       else if(WB && Array.isArray(WB.acts)) acts = WB.acts;
       else if(WB && WB.board && Array.isArray(WB.board.acts)) acts = WB.board.acts;
     } catch(_a){ acts = []; }
     var seen = Object.create(null);
     (acts || []).forEach(function(a){
       if(!a) return;
       var id = String(a.id || a.name || '');
       if(!id || seen[id]) return;
       var jm = null;
       try {
         if(typeof previewJmethodForPortion === 'function'){
           jm = previewJmethodForPortion('H', a) || previewJmethodForPortion(null, a);
         }
       } catch(_j){}
       if(!jm && a.jmethod) jm = a.jmethod;
       /* also include when factor model attaches this jmethod and act has no override */
       if(!jm && draft && draft.factorDim){
         try {
           var fm = modelToolsEnsureFactorModel(draft.factorDim);
           if(fm && fm.jmethod && String(fm.jmethod) === jmId) jm = jmId;
         } catch(_fm){}
       }
       if(String(jm) !== jmId && String(a.jmethod||'') !== jmId) return;
       seen[id] = true;
       var actForPlace = Object.assign({}, a);
       try {
         if(typeof previewActScoreRow === 'function'){
           var row = previewActScoreRow(a);
           if(row){
             if(row.score01 != null) actForPlace.score01 = row.score01;
             if(row.scoreRaw != null) actForPlace.scoreRaw = row.scoreRaw;
             if(row.H != null) actForPlace.H = row.H;
             if(row.D != null) actForPlace.D = row.D;
           }
         }
       } catch(_r){}
       var placeCtx = { name: a.name, D: 30, Dmax: 31, E: 10, Emax: 20 };
       try {
         var amt = (typeof previewAmtOf === 'function') ? previewAmtOf(a) : (Number(a.amount)||Number(a.cost)||0);
         if(!(placeCtx.x > 0)) placeCtx.x = Math.max(amt, jmId === 'earn' ? 8 : 0.01);
         if(!(placeCtx.y > 0)) placeCtx.y = Math.max(placeCtx.x * 0.01, 0.5);
       } catch(_c){}
       var pl = null;
       try { pl = meth.place(actForPlace, placeCtx); } catch(_p){ pl = null; }
       if(!pl) return;
       var px = Math.abs(Number(pl.x)) || 0;
       var py = Math.abs(Number(pl.y)) || 0;
       if(!(px > 0) && !(py > 0)) return;
       pts.push({ x: px, y: py, name: a.name || a.id || id });
     });
   } catch(_e){}
   return pts;
  }

  function modelToolsMathChartSvg(draft, dim){
   if(!draft) return '<p class="hint">No jmethod draft.</p>';
   var math = draft.math || modelToolsDefaultMath('linear');
   var xMax = Math.max(Number(draft.xMax)||100, 1e-6);
   var yMax = Math.max(Number(draft.yMax)||1, 1e-6);
   /* easy171: larger first-class curve surface */
   var W = 560, H = 280, padL = 44, padR = 16, padT = 28, padB = 40;
   var iw = W - padL - padR, ih = H - padT - padB;
   var n = 64;
   var d = '';
   var dScore = '';
   var i, started = false, startedS = false;
   for(i = 0; i <= n; i++){
     var x = (i / n) * xMax;
     var y = 0;
     try {
       if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.idealYFromMath)
         y = RunJMethods.idealYFromMath(math, x);
     } catch(_y){ y = 0; }
     if(!isFinite(y) || y < 0) y = 0;
     var px = padL + (x / xMax) * iw;
     var py = padT + ih - (Math.min(y, yMax) / yMax) * ih;
     d += (started ? ' L' : 'M') + px.toFixed(1) + ',' + py.toFixed(1);
     started = true;
     var sc = modelToolsJmScoreAt(draft, x, y);
     if(!isFinite(sc)) sc = 0;
     var pys = padT + ih - Math.max(0, Math.min(1, sc)) * ih;
     dScore += (startedS ? ' L' : 'M') + px.toFixed(1) + ',' + pys.toFixed(1);
     startedS = true;
   }
   /* Landing dots in place units (board/PREVIEW), not factor-score ranks */
   var dots = '';
   var landings = [];
   try { landings = modelToolsJmLandingPoints(draft.id, draft) || []; } catch(_lp){ landings = []; }
   landings.slice(0, 60).forEach(function(lp, idx){
     if(!lp) return;
     var xv = Math.max(0, Number(lp.x)||0);
     var yv = Math.max(0, Number(lp.y)||0);
     var px2 = padL + (Math.min(xv, xMax) / xMax) * iw;
     var py2 = padT + ih - (Math.min(yv, yMax) / yMax) * ih;
     var col = ['#f7768e','#e0af68','#9ece6a','#7dcfff','#bb9af7','#ff9e64'][idx % 6];
     dots += '<circle class="mt-jm-landing" cx="'+px2.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+py2.toFixed(1)+'" r="3.5" fill="'+col+'" stroke="#1a1b26" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.9">'
       + '<title>'+esc(lp.name||('act '+idx))+' · ('+xv.toFixed(2)+','+yv.toFixed(2)+')</title></circle>';
   });
   var cps = '';
   if(math.type === 'bezier' && math.params && Array.isArray(math.params.points)){
     math.params.points.forEach(function(pt, idx){
       var cx = padL + (Math.min(Math.max(0, Number(pt.x)||0), xMax) / xMax) * iw;
       var cy = padT + ih - (Math.min(Math.max(0, Number(pt.y)||0), yMax) / yMax) * ih;
       cps += '<circle class="mt-jm-cp" data-cp-i="'+idx+'" cx="'+cx.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+cy.toFixed(1)+'" r="7" fill="#e0af68" stroke="#c0caf5" stroke-width="1.5" style="cursor:grab"/>';
     });
   }
   var formula = '';
   try {
     formula = (RunJMethods && RunJMethods.mathFormulaText) ? RunJMethods.mathFormulaText(math) : '';
   } catch(_f){}
   var xLab = draft.xLabel || 'x';
   var yLab = draft.yLabel || 'ideal y';
   var domainCap = 'domain 0…'+esc(String(xMax))+' × 0…'+esc(String(yMax));
   var worldLab = 'world of '+esc(String(draft.id||'jmethod'));
   var landNote = landings.length ? (landings.length+' landing'+(landings.length===1?'':'s')) : 'no board landings yet';
   return '<svg id="mt-jm-chart" viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" width="100%" height="'+H+'" style="background:#0f141c;border:1px solid #7aa2f7;border-radius:8px;display:block;cursor:crosshair;max-width:100%;touch-action:none" data-chart-w="'+W+'" data-chart-h="'+H+'" data-pad-l="'+padL+'" data-pad-r="'+padR+'" data-pad-t="'+padT+'" data-pad-b="'+padB+'">'
     + '<text x="'+(W/2)+'" y="14" fill="#c0caf5" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">Curve view · idealY + landings · '+worldLab+'</text>'
     + '<text x="6" y="28" fill="#7aa2f7" font-size="9" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">idealY</text>'
     + '<text x="60" y="28" fill="#bb9af7" font-size="9" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">score</text>'
     + '<text x="'+(W-8)+'" y="28" fill="#9ece6a" font-size="9" text-anchor="end" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">'+esc(landNote)+'</text>'
     + '<rect x="'+padL+'" y="'+padT+'" width="'+iw+'" height="'+ih+'" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 3" opacity="0.55"/>'
     + '<line x1="'+padL+'" y1="'+padT+'" x2="'+padL+'" y2="'+(padT+ih)+'" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1"/>'
     + '<line x1="'+padL+'" y1="'+(padT+ih)+'" x2="'+(padL+iw)+'" y2="'+(padT+ih)+'" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1"/>'
     + (d ? '<path d="'+d+'" fill="none" stroke="#7aa2f7" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>' : '')
     + (dScore ? '<path d="'+dScore+'" fill="none" stroke="#bb9af7" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="2 3" opacity="0.85"/>' : '')
     + dots + cps
     + '<text x="'+(W/2)+'" y="'+(H-18)+'" fill="#9fb3c8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">'+esc(xLab)+' · 0…'+esc(String(xMax))+'</text>'
     + '<text x="'+(W/2)+'" y="'+(H-6)+'" fill="#64748b" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">'+domainCap+' · '+esc(yLab)+' · drag CP · Fit landings</text>'
     + '</svg>'
     + '<p class="hint mt-jm-formula" style="margin-top:4px"><b>Formula:</b> '+esc(formula)+' · <b>'+worldLab+'</b> · landings in place units · authored → view.out / PREVIEW</p>';
  }


  function modelToolsMathDesignerHtml(){
   if(!_mtJmEditId || !_mtJmDraft){
     return '<p class="hint">Select <b>New jmethod</b> or <b>Edit attached</b> to open the Blueprint editor (wire inputs → score.out). Each jmethod has its own world/space.</p>';
   }
   var d = _mtJmDraft;
   if(_mtJmToolPick || !d.tool){
     return modelToolsJmToolPickerHtml(d);
   }
   /* easy166: Blueprint primary — Curve view / 3D view are nodes; no score-recipe pills / heavy domain panel. */
   modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(d);
   modelToolsEnsureScript(d);
   var math = d.math || modelToolsDefaultMath('linear');
   var selNode = null;
   try {
     if(_mtJmScriptSel && d.script && d.script.nodes){
       d.script.nodes.forEach(function(n){ if(n && n.id === _mtJmScriptSel) selNode = n; });
     }
   } catch(_sn){}
   var showCadCurve = !!(selNode && selNode.type === 'view.curve');
   var showCad3d = !!(selNode && selNode.type === 'view.3d');
   if(showCad3d){
     d.tool = '3d';
     _mtJmCad3dOpen = true;
   }
   /* Sync view.curve params → draft domain/math when selected (fallback only; wires win at score) */

     if(selNode.params.math) math = selNode.params.math;
     if(selNode.params.xMax > 0) d.xMax = selNode.params.xMax;
     if(selNode.params.yMax > 0) d.yMax = selNode.params.yMax;
     if(selNode.params.xLabel) d.xLabel = selNode.params.xLabel;
     if(selNode.params.yLabel) d.yLabel = selNode.params.yLabel;
     d.math = math;
   }
   var html = '';
   html += '<div class="mt-jm-designer" data-jm-id="'+esc(d.id)+'" style="margin-top:10px;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(20,28,40,.65)">';

No world point id — jmethod is not a scene object. Score shaping lives in the graph (<code>view.curve</code> + score nodes).</p>';
   html += modelToolsPaperIntakeHtml(d);
   html += '<label class="hint">Label</label>';
   html += '<input id="mt-jm-label" type="text" value="'+esc(d.label||'')+'" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:6px" />';
   if(!d.scoreMode) d.scoreMode = 'ideal_over_ymax';
   if(d.xLabel == null) d.xLabel = 'x';
   if(d.yLabel == null) d.yLabel = 'ideal y';
   /* easy166: probeX/probeY removed from designer */
   _mtJmDesignerPane = 'script';
   d.designerPane = 'script';
   html += modelToolsScriptCanvasHtml(d);

   /* ---- view.curve inspector: easy171 first-class Curve view surface ---- */
   if(showCadCurve){
     html += '<div class="mt-jm-cad-curve-panel" style="margin:10px 0;padding:12px;border:2px solid #7aa2f7;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(122,162,247,.10);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(122,162,247,.25) inset">';
     var _vcWiredX = false, _vcWiredY = false;
     try {
       if(d.script && d.script.edges && selNode){
         d.script.edges.forEach(function(e){
           if(e && e.to === selNode.id && e.toPort === 'xMax') _vcWiredX = true;
           if(e && e.to === selNode.id && e.toPort === 'yMax') _vcWiredY = true;
         });
       }
     } catch(_vw){}
     var _landN = 0;
     try { _landN = (modelToolsJmLandingPoints(d.id, d)||[]).length; } catch(_ln){ _landN = 0; }
     html += '<div class="hint" style="margin:0 0 8px"><b style="color:#7aa2f7;font-size:.95rem">Curve view</b> · <b>CAD edits sugar → wires · view.out plots wired idealY</b>'
       + ' · xMax '+(_vcWiredX?'<span style="color:#9ece6a">wired ✓</span>':'fallback')+' · yMax '+(_vcWiredY?'<span style="color:#9ece6a">wired ✓</span>':'fallback')
       + ' · outs idealY · xMax · yMax · scoreFromCurve · prefer <code>view.sample</code> → <code>view.out</code>'
       + ' · board landings: <b>'+_landN+'</b></div>';

     html += '<label class="hint"><b>yMax</b> <span class="cm">'+(_vcWiredY?'(wired — fallback only)':'(fallback)')+'</span><br/><input id="mt-jm-ymax" type="number" step="any" min="0.001" value="'+(d.yMax)+'" style="width:110px"'+(_vcWiredY?' title="Wired from jfactor/data — this is fallback only"':'')+' /></label>';
     html += '<label class="hint">xLabel<br/><input id="mt-jm-xlabel" type="text" value="'+esc(d.xLabel||'x')+'" style="width:100px" /></label>';
     html += '<label class="hint">yLabel<br/><input id="mt-jm-ylabel" type="text" value="'+esc(d.yLabel||'ideal y')+'" style="width:100px" /></label>';
     html += '<button type="button" class="pill" id="mt-jm-fit-ymax" title="yMax = idealY(xMax)">Fit yMax</button>';
     html += '<button type="button" class="pill" id="mt-jm-snap-domains" title="Round xMax/yMax">Snap</button>';
     html += '<button type="button" class="btn btn-ok" id="mt-jm-fit-landings" title="Fit curve math to board/PREVIEW place landings (undoable)">Fit to landings</button>';
     html += '</div>';
     html += '<label class="hint"><b>Math type</b></label>';
     html += '<select id="mt-jm-type" style="width:100%;max-width:320px;margin-bottom:8px">';
     ['linear','sqrt','log1p','power','bezier'].forEach(function(t){
       html += '<option value="'+t+'"'+(math.type===t?' selected':'')+'>'+t+'</option>';
     });
     html += '</select>';
     html += '<div class="add-row" style="flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px">';
     if(math.type === 'linear'){
       html += '<label class="hint">a <input id="mt-jm-a" type="number" step="any" value="'+(math.params.a)+'" style="width:80px" /></label>';
       html += '<label class="hint">b <input id="mt-jm-b" type="number" step="any" value="'+(math.params.b)+'" style="width:80px" /></label>';
     } else if(math.type === 'sqrt' || math.type === 'log1p'){
       html += '<label class="hint">k <input id="mt-jm-k" type="number" step="any" value="'+(math.params.k)+'" style="width:80px" /></label>';
     } else if(math.type === 'power'){
       html += '<label class="hint">k <input id="mt-jm-k" type="number" step="any" value="'+(math.params.k)+'" style="width:80px" /></label>';
       html += '<label class="hint">p <input id="mt-jm-p" type="number" step="any" value="'+(math.params.p)+'" style="width:80px" /></label>';
     }
     html += '</div>';
     if(math.type === 'bezier'){
       html += '<label class="hint">Control points (x, y) · <b>drag on chart</b> · click empty to add · table edits sync</label>';
       html += '<table class="grid" id="mt-jm-pts"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>x</th><th>y</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>';
       (math.params.points||[]).forEach(function(pt, idx){
         html += '<tr data-cp-row="'+idx+'"><td class="cm">'+idx+'</td>';
         html += '<td><input class="mt-jm-ptx" data-i="'+idx+'" type="number" step="any" value="'+pt.x+'" style="width:80px" /></td>';
         html += '<td><input class="mt-jm-pty" data-i="'+idx+'" type="number" step="any" value="'+pt.y+'" style="width:80px" /></td>';
         html += '<td><button type="button" class="del mt-jm-ptdel" data-i="'+idx+'" title="Remove">×</button></td></tr>';
       });
       html += '</tbody></table>';
       html += '<button type="button" class="pill" id="mt-jm-ptadd" style="margin:6px 0">+ point</button>';
     }
     html += modelToolsMathChartSvg(d, d.factorDim || _mtFactorDim);
     html += '</div>';
   } else {
     /* hidden domain fields so apply still has values when view.curve not selected */
     html += '<input type="hidden" id="mt-jm-xmax" value="'+(d.xMax)+'" />';
     html += '<input type="hidden" id="mt-jm-ymax" value="'+(d.yMax)+'" />';
     html += '<input type="hidden" id="mt-jm-xlabel" value="'+esc(d.xLabel||'x')+'" />';
     html += '<input type="hidden" id="mt-jm-ylabel" value="'+esc(d.yLabel||'ideal y')+'" />';
   }

   try {
     var _stProbe = modelToolsScriptCompileStatus(d);
     d._scriptStatus = { ok: !!_stProbe.ok, error: _stProbe.error||null };
   } catch(_sp){ d._scriptStatus = { ok:false, error:null }; }
   /* easy175: packs optional; New = empty; Load from pack on demand */

   html += '</div>';

Apply writes to <code>WB.modelTools.jmethods[id]</code> (wins on hydrate). PREVIEW can still register pack graphs when pack is present and no saved override.</p>';

   if(showCad3d || d.tool === '3d'){
     d.tool = '3d';
     html += modelToolsJmCad3dPanelHtml(d);
   }

   html += '</div>';
   return html;
  }

  function modelToolsFactorSlot(dim){
   ensureFactorOrder();
   var order = WB.factorOrder || [];
   var i = order.indexOf(dim);
   if(i < 0) i = order.length;
   var col = i % 6;
   var row = Math.floor(i / 6);
   return { x: -8 + col * 3.2, y: 0, z: -6 + row * 3.2 };
  }
  function modelToolsSpawnFactorMarker(dim){
   /* DISABLED: score factors are metadata/attachments, not 3D scene objects. */
   return null;
  }
  function modelToolsFactorMiniVizHtml(dim){
   dim = String(dim||'');
   if(!dim) return '<p class="hint">Select a factor to plot.</p>';
   var R = null;
   try { R = calcRanks(); } catch(_c){ return '<p class="hint">calcRanks unavailable.</p>'; }
   var items = (R && R.items) || [];
   if(!items.length) return '<p class="hint">No board/rank items to plot.</p>';
   var fm = modelToolsEnsureFactorModel(dim);
   var kind = (fm && fm.kind) || modelToolsDefaultFactorKind(dim);
   var xLab = 'rank#';
   if(kind === 'calendar_days') xLab = 'days';
   else if(kind === 'calendar_hours') xLab = 'hours';
   else if(kind === 'money_values') xLab = '$';
   else if(kind === 'debt_urgency') xLab = 'urgency';
   else if(kind === 'surplus') xLab = 'surplus';
   var pts = [];
   items.forEach(function(it){
    if(!it || !it.name) return;
    if(typeof isRankNonFactor === 'function' && isRankNonFactor(dim, it.name)) return;
    var score = Number(it['score'+dim]);
    if(!isFinite(score)) score = 0;
    var rankKey = 'rank'+dim;
    var rank = it[rankKey];
    var xVal = null;
    if(kind === 'calendar_days'){
      xVal = (WB._daysCache && WB._daysCache[it.name] != null)
        ? Number(WB._daysCache[it.name])
        : (typeof rankItemCalendarDays === 'function' ? rankItemCalendarDays(it.name) : 0);
    } else if(kind === 'calendar_hours'){
      xVal = (WB._timeHoursCache && WB._timeHoursCache[it.name] != null)
        ? Number(WB._timeHoursCache[it.name])
        : (typeof rankItemCalendarHours === 'function' ? rankItemCalendarHours(it.name) : 0);
    } else if(kind === 'money_values'){
      xVal = Number(it.cost)||0;
    } else if(kind === 'debt_urgency'){
      xVal = (WB._debtUrgencyCache && WB._debtUrgencyCache[it.name] != null)
        ? Number(WB._debtUrgencyCache[it.name])
        : (typeof rankItemDebtUrgency === 'function' ? rankItemDebtUrgency(it.name) : 0);
    } else if(kind === 'surplus'){
      xVal = (WB._surplusContribCache && WB._surplusContribCache[it.name] != null)
        ? Number(WB._surplusContribCache[it.name])
        : (typeof rankItemSurplusContribution === 'function' ? rankItemSurplusContribution(it.name) : 0);
    } else {
      xVal = (rank != null && isFinite(Number(rank))) ? Number(rank) : 0;
    }
    pts.push({ name: it.name, x: Number(xVal)||0, y: score, rank: rank });
   });
   if(!pts.length) return '<p class="hint">No factor items for '+esc(dim)+'.</p>';
   var minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = 0;
   pts.forEach(function(p){
    if(p.x < minX) minX = p.x;
    if(p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
    if(p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
   });
   if(!(maxX > minX)){ minX -= 1; maxX += 1; }
   if(!(maxY > 0)) maxY = 1;
   var W = 320, H = 140, padL = 28, padR = 10, padT = 12, padB = 22;
   var iw = W - padL - padR, ih = H - padT - padB;
   var dots = '';
   pts.forEach(function(p){
    var px = padL + ((p.x - minX) / (maxX - minX)) * iw;
    var py = padT + ih - (p.y / maxY) * ih;
    dots += '<circle cx="'+px.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+py.toFixed(1)+'" r="3" fill="'+modelToolsFactorColor(dim)+'" opacity="0.85">'
      + '<title>'+esc(p.name)+' · '+xLab+'='+p.x+' · score='+(p.y*100).toFixed(2)+'%</title></circle>';
   });
   var svg = '<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" width="100%" height="'+H+'" style="background:#0f141c;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;display:block">'
     + '<text x="4" y="12" fill="#9fb3c8" font-size="9" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">score'+esc(dim)+'</text>'
     + '<text x="'+(W/2)+'" y="'+(H-4)+'" fill="#9fb3c8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono,monospace">'+esc(xLab)+'</text>'
     + '<line x1="'+padL+'" y1="'+padT+'" x2="'+padL+'" y2="'+(padT+ih)+'" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1"/>'
     + '<line x1="'+padL+'" y1="'+(padT+ih)+'" x2="'+(padL+iw)+'" y2="'+(padT+ih)+'" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1"/>'
     + dots + '</svg>';
   var curveNote = (kind === 'curve')
     ? '<p class="hint" style="margin-top:4px"><b>curve</b> kind → use <b>New jmethod · pick 2D/3D CAD</b>.</p>'
     : '<p class="hint" style="margin-top:4px">Read-only from <code>calcRanks()</code> · '+pts.length+' items · kind=<code>'+esc(kind)+'</code></p>';
   return svg + curveNote;
  }
