  function bindModelTools(){
   var mt = ensureModelTools();
   try { modelToolsHydrateJmethods(); } catch(_h){}
   /* easy178/179/182/183/184/185/188: once per page session — ensure morning canvas + localWeekend + localEconomy + HouseFamily jreq + training days on Board SoT */
   try {
     if(!window.__easy178McrEnsured){
       window.__easy178McrEnsured = true;
       var _seedMt = false;
       if(typeof easyEnsureMorningCanvasActs === 'function'){
         var _mcrMt = easyEnsureMorningCanvasActs();
         if(_mcrMt && ((_mcrMt.added|0) + (_mcrMt.updated|0)) > 0) _seedMt = true;
       }
       if(typeof easyEnsureLocalWeekendBoardActs === 'function'){
         var _lwMt = easyEnsureLocalWeekendBoardActs();
         if(_lwMt && ((_lwMt.added|0) + (_lwMt.updated|0)) > 0) _seedMt = true;
       }
       if(typeof easyEnsureLocalEconomyBoardActs === 'function'){
         var _leMt = easyEnsureLocalEconomyBoardActs();
         if(_leMt && ((_leMt.added|0) + (_leMt.updated|0)) > 0) _seedMt = true;
       }
       if(typeof easyEnsureHouseFamilyJreqChain === 'function'){
         var _hfMt = easyEnsureHouseFamilyJreqChain();
         if(_hfMt && ((_hfMt.added|0) + (_hfMt.updated|0)) > 0) _seedMt = true;
       }
       if(typeof easyEnsureTrainingDaysAct === 'function'){
         var _tdMt = easyEnsureTrainingDaysAct();
         if(_tdMt && ((_tdMt.added|0) + (_tdMt.updated|0)) > 0) _seedMt = true;
       }
       if(typeof easyClearForcedSuggestMustOnEmittedActs === 'function'){
         var _clrMt = easyClearForcedSuggestMustOnEmittedActs();
         if(_clrMt && (_clrMt.cleared|0) > 0) _seedMt = true;
       }
       if(_seedMt){
         try { if(typeof saveWorkbook === 'function') saveWorkbook({ silent: true }); } catch(_sv){}
       }
     }
   } catch(_mcrMtE){}
   var canvas = document.getElementById('mt-jm-cad3d-canvas') || document.getElementById('model-tools-canvas');
   var MT3 = window.ModelTools3D;
   /* Only mount orbit viewport when user opened Fusion-esc 3D view (or legacy canvas present). Never default toolbench 3D. */
   if(!_mtJmCad3dOpen && canvas && canvas.id === 'mt-jm-cad3d-canvas'){ canvas = null; }
   if(!_mtJmCad3dOpen && !document.getElementById('model-tools-canvas')){
     try { if(MT3 && MT3.isMounted && MT3.isMounted() && !document.getElementById('mt-jm-cad3d-canvas')) MT3.unmount(); } catch(_uu){}
   }
   function mtJmActiveWorld(){
    /* Open 3D view for a jmethod → that jmethod's .world only (never global mt.entities). */
    if(_mtJmCad3dOpen && _mtJmDraft){
      modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(_mtJmDraft);
      return _mtJmDraft.world;
    }
    return null;
   }
   function mtJmComponentsAsEntities(comps){
    /* easy175: segments as lines, fields as volumes, points as markers — per-jmethod .world only */
    var out = [];
    (comps || []).forEach(function(c){
      if(!c) return;
      var kind = String(c.type || 'point');
      if(kind === 'segment'){
        out.push({
          id: String(c.id||('seg_'+out.length)),
          name: c.label || 'segment',
          kind: 'world_segment',
          _compType: 'segment',
          pos: { x: Number(c.x)||0, y: Number(c.y)||0, z: Number(c.z)||0 },
          pos2: { x: Number(c.x2)||0, y: Number(c.y2)||0, z: Number(c.z2)||0 },
          color: '#7dcfff',
          enabled: true,
          notes: c.note || '',
          _fromComponent: c.id
        });
      } else if(kind === 'viz'){
        out.push({
          id: String(c.id||'viz'),
          name: c.label || 'viz',
          kind: 'world_viz',
          pos: { x: Number(c.x)||0, y: Number(c.y)||0.5, z: Number(c.z)||0 },
          color: '#bb9af7',
          enabled: true,
          notes: c.note || '',
          _fromComponent: c.id
        });
      } else if(kind === 'field'){
        out.push({
          id: String(c.id || ('field_'+out.length)),
          name: c.label || 'field',
          kind: 'world_field',
          _compType: 'field',
          pos: { x: Number(c.x)||0, y: Number(c.y)||0, z: Number(c.z)||0 },
          sizeX: Number(c.sizeX)||1.2, sizeY: Number(c.sizeY)||0.9, sizeZ: Number(c.sizeZ)||1.2,
          color: '#9ece6a',
          enabled: true,
          notes: c.note || '',
          _fromComponent: c.id
        });
      } else {
        out.push({
          id: String(c.id || ('comp_'+out.length)),
          name: c.label || kind,
          kind: 'world_point',
          _compType: 'point',
          pos: { x: Number(c.x)||0, y: Number(c.y)||0, z: Number(c.z)||0 },
          color: '#e0af68',
          enabled: true,
          notes: c.note || '',
          _fromComponent: c.id
        });
      }
    });
    return out;
   }
   function refreshScene(){
    if(!MT3 || !MT3.isMounted || !MT3.isMounted()) return;
    var jw = mtJmActiveWorld();
    var list;
    if(jw){
      list = (jw.entities||[]).slice();
      /* BP-driven components from world.add.* / emit.viz */
      var comps = jw.components;
      if((!comps || !comps.length) && _mtJmDraft && _mtJmDraft.script && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.collectWorldComponents){
        try {
          comps = ModelToolsScript.collectWorldComponents(_mtJmDraft.script);
          jw.components = comps;
          if(_mtJmDraft.world) _mtJmDraft.world.components = comps;
        } catch(_cw){ comps = []; }
      }
      list = list.concat(mtJmComponentsAsEntities(comps));
    } else {
      list = (mt.entities||[]).slice();
      if(mt.you) list = list.concat([mt.you]);
    }
    MT3.setEntities(list);
    MT3.setSelectedId(_mtSelectedId);
    MT3.setMode(_mtMode);
    var map = jw ? jw.map : mt.map;
    if(map){
     if(typeof MT3.setGridSize === 'function') MT3.setGridSize(map.gridSize||20);
     if(typeof MT3.setShowAxes === 'function') MT3.setShowAxes(map.showAxes!==false);
    }
    try {
      if(jw && list && list.length && typeof MT3.fitGridToEntities === 'function'){
        var b = MT3.fitGridToEntities();
        if(b && jw.map){
          jw.map.gridSize = Math.max(4, Math.ceil((b.size||10)*0.75+2));
          jw.map.bounds = b;
        }
      }
    } catch(_fit){}
    try {
      if(typeof MT3.setMeasureLabel === 'function' && _mtJmDraft){
        var ml = null;
        var sp = _mtJmDraft.world && _mtJmDraft.world.spatial;
        if(sp && sp.measureA && sp.measureB){
          var ents = list || [];
          var A=null,B=null;
          ents.forEach(function(e){
            if(!e) return;
            if(e.id===sp.measureA || e.name===sp.measureA || e._fromComponent===sp.measureA) A=e;
            if(e.id===sp.measureB || e.name===sp.measureB || e._fromComponent===sp.measureB) B=e;
          });
          if(A && B && A.pos && B.pos){
            var dlt = Math.hypot((A.pos.x||0)-(B.pos.x||0),(A.pos.y||0)-(B.pos.y||0),(A.pos.z||0)-(B.pos.z||0));
            ml = { a:A.pos, b:B.pos, text:'measure.distance = '+dlt.toFixed(3) };
            sp.measureOut = dlt.toFixed(3);
          }
        }
        MT3.setMeasureLabel(ml);
      }
    } catch(_ml){}
   }
   function remountUI(){
    // re-render pane only for MODEL TOOLS without full KPI churn when possible
    try {
     if(typeof easyPreserveScroll === 'function'){
      easyPreserveScroll(function(){ renderPane(); });
     } else renderPane();
    } catch(_r){ try { renderPane(); } catch(_e){} }
   }
   if(canvas && MT3 && typeof MT3.mount === 'function'){
    try {
     // unmount previous if any
     try { MT3.unmount(); } catch(_u){}
     // persist prior camera if any
     try {
      if(MT3.getCamera){
        var prevCam = MT3.getCamera();
        if(prevCam){
          var camObj = { yaw: prevCam.yaw, pitch: prevCam.pitch, dist: prevCam.dist, target: prevCam.target, _rad: true };
          var jwPrev = mtJmActiveWorld();
          if(jwPrev){ jwPrev.camera = camObj; if(_mtJmDraft) _mtJmDraft.world = jwPrev; }
          else mt.camera = camObj;
        }
      }
     } catch(_pc){}
     var _jwMount = mtJmActiveWorld();
     var _mapMount = _jwMount ? _jwMount.map : mt.map;
     var _camMount = _jwMount ? _jwMount.camera : mt.camera;
     MT3.mount(canvas, {
      mode: _mtMode,
      gridSize: (_mapMount && _mapMount.gridSize) || 20,
      showAxes: !(_mapMount && _mapMount.showAxes === false),
      camera: _camMount,
      onPlace: function(hit){
       var jw = mtJmActiveWorld();
       var bag = jw || mt;
       if(!Array.isArray(bag.entities)) bag.entities = [];
       var ent = {
        id: modelToolsNewId('ent'),
        name: 'Entity ' + (bag.entities.length + 1),
        kind: 'person',
        pos: { x: Math.round(hit.x*10)/10, y: 0, z: Math.round(hit.z*10)/10 },
        color: '#'+('000000'+Math.floor(Math.random()*0xffffff).toString(16)).slice(-6),
        enabled: true,
        notes: '',
        run: { everyTicks: 1, radius: 2.5, emitMeetup: true }
       };
       bag.entities.push(ent);
       if(jw && _mtJmDraft){ _mtJmDraft.world = jw; }
       _mtSelectedId = ent.id;
       _mtMode = 'select';
       modelToolsPersistSoft();
       remountUI();
       try { showStatus((jw?'jmethod world ':'')+'Placed '+ent.name+' @ '+ent.pos.x+', '+ent.pos.z+' · Save to keep','ok'); } catch(_s){}
      },
      onSelect: function(ent){
       _mtSelectedId = ent ? ent.id : null;
       if(ent && ent.kind === 'factor'){
        var d = ent.dim || (String(ent.name||'').match(/^Factor:\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)/i)||[])[1];
        if(d) _mtFactorDim = String(d).toUpperCase();
       }
       remountUI();
      },
      onMove: function(ent, pos){
       /* translate gizmo → update jmethod .world component / entity only */
       if(!ent || !pos) return;
       var jw = mtJmActiveWorld();
       if(!jw) return;
       if(ent._fromComponent && Array.isArray(jw.components)){
         jw.components.forEach(function(c){
           if(!c || c.id !== ent._fromComponent) return;
           c.x = pos.x; c.y = pos.y != null ? pos.y : c.y; c.z = pos.z;
         });
         if(_mtJmDraft && _mtJmDraft.script && Array.isArray(_mtJmDraft.script.nodes)){
           _mtJmDraft.script.nodes.forEach(function(n){
             if(!n || n.id !== ent._fromComponent) return;
             if(!n.params) n.params = {};
             n.params.x = pos.x; n.params.z = pos.z;
             if(pos.y != null) n.params.y = pos.y;
           });
         }
       } else if(Array.isArray(jw.entities)){
         jw.entities.forEach(function(e){
           if(e && e.id === ent.id){ e.pos = { x:pos.x, y:pos.y||0, z:pos.z }; }
         });
       }
       if(_mtJmDraft) _mtJmDraft.world = jw;
       modelToolsPersistSoft();
       try {
         var lab = document.getElementById('mt-jm-cad3d-gizmo-label');
         if(lab) lab.textContent = 'active: move · '+ent.name+' @ '+pos.x+', '+pos.z;
       } catch(_l){}
      }
     });
     refreshScene();
    } catch(errM){
     console.error('ModelTools3D mount failed', errM);
     try { showStatus('3D mount failed: '+(errM && errM.message || errM),'err'); } catch(_e){}
    }
   } else if(!MT3){
    try { showStatus('model_tools_3d.js missing','err'); } catch(_e){}
   }

   var pane = (typeof $ === 'function') ? $('pane') : document.getElementById('pane');
   if(!pane) return;

   };
   var apply = document.getElementById('mt-ed-apply');
   if(apply) apply.onclick = function(){
    var sel = null;
    (mt.entities||[]).forEach(function(e){ if(e && e.id === _mtSelectedId) sel = e; });
    if(!sel) return;
    sel.name = (document.getElementById('mt-ed-name')||{}).value || sel.name;

      }
    }
    sel.color = (document.getElementById('mt-ed-color')||{}).value || sel.color;
    sel.notes = (document.getElementById('mt-ed-notes')||{}).value || '';

    sel.run.everyTicks = Math.max(1, parseInt((document.getElementById('mt-ed-every')||{}).value,10)||1);
    sel.run.radius = Math.max(0.1, parseFloat((document.getElementById('mt-ed-radius')||{}).value)||2.5);
    sel.run.emitMeetup = !!(document.getElementById('mt-ed-emit')||{}).checked;

   };

   var afMt = document.getElementById('btn-add-rank-factor-mt');

     var label = window.prompt('New score factor label (e.g. Focus, Social)', '');

     if(!label) return;

     if(!idGuess) idGuess = 'X';
     if(idGuess === 'T' || (typeof HDAME_DIMS !== 'undefined' && HDAME_DIMS.indexOf(idGuess) >= 0) || DIMS.indexOf(idGuess) >= 0){
       idGuess = 'F' + idGuess.slice(0, 7);
     }
     var id = window.prompt('Short id (letters/numbers)', idGuess);
     if(id == null) return;
     var means = window.prompt('Higher ranking means… (short description shown above #1)', 'Higher = more '+label.toLowerCase()+' attention for this item.');
     if(means == null) return;
     var inv = window.confirm('Invert this factor? (OK = lower-is-better like Age/External/Money)');
     var res = addRankFactor(id, label, inv, means);
     if(!res || !res.ok){
       if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('Could not add factor: '+(res && res.err || 'error'), 'bad');
       return;

     _mtFactorDim = res.id;
     modelToolsEnsureFactorModel(res.id);

     if(typeof showStatus === 'function') showStatus('Added score factor '+res.id+' · '+label, 'ok');
   };

   function mtJmReadDraftFromDom(){
     if(!_mtJmDraft) return null;
     var d = _mtJmDraft;
     var labEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-label');
     if(labEl) d.label = String(labEl.value||'').trim() || d.id;
     var typeEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-type');
     /* Only rewrite math when 2D CAD controls are mounted (not 3D / picker). */
     if(typeEl){
       var type = String(typeEl.value||'linear');
       var params = {};
       if(type === 'linear'){
         params.a = parseFloat((document.getElementById('mt-jm-a')||{}).value); if(!isFinite(params.a)) params.a = 1;
         params.b = parseFloat((document.getElementById('mt-jm-b')||{}).value); if(!isFinite(params.b)) params.b = 0;
       } else if(type === 'sqrt' || type === 'log1p'){
         params.k = parseFloat((document.getElementById('mt-jm-k')||{}).value); if(!isFinite(params.k)) params.k = 1;
       } else if(type === 'power'){
         params.k = parseFloat((document.getElementById('mt-jm-k')||{}).value); if(!isFinite(params.k)) params.k = 1;
         params.p = parseFloat((document.getElementById('mt-jm-p')||{}).value); if(!isFinite(params.p)) params.p = 0.5;
       } else if(type === 'bezier'){
         params.points = [];
         pane.querySelectorAll('.mt-jm-ptx').forEach(function(inp){
           var i = parseInt(inp.getAttribute('data-i'),10);
           var yEl = pane.querySelector('.mt-jm-pty[data-i="'+i+'"]');
           params.points.push({
             x: Math.max(0, parseFloat(inp.value)||0),
             y: Math.max(0, yEl ? (parseFloat(yEl.value)||0) : 0)
           });
         });
         if(!params.points.length) params.points = [{x:0,y:0},{x:100,y:1}];
       }
       d.math = (typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeMath)
         ? RunJMethods.normalizeMath({ type:type, params:params })
         : { type:type, params:params };
     } else if(!d.math){
       d.math = modelToolsDefaultMath('linear');
     }
     var xmaxEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-xmax');
     var ymaxEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-ymax');
     if(xmaxEl) d.xMax = Math.max(0.001, parseFloat(xmaxEl.value) || d.xMax || 100);
     if(ymaxEl) d.yMax = Math.max(0.001, parseFloat(ymaxEl.value) || d.yMax || 1);
     if(!(d.xMax > 0)) d.xMax = 100;
     if(!(d.yMax > 0)) d.yMax = 1;
     var xlabEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-xlabel');
     var ylabEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-ylabel');
     if(xlabEl) d.xLabel = String(xlabEl.value||'').trim() || 'x';
     if(ylabEl) d.yLabel = String(ylabEl.value||'').trim() || 'ideal y';
     /* easy166: probeX/probeY no longer bound from DOM */
     if(!d.scoreMode) d.scoreMode = 'ideal_over_ymax';
     if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.normalizeScoreMode) d.scoreMode = RunJMethods.normalizeScoreMode(d.scoreMode);
     var ideaName = document.getElementById('mt-jm-idea-name');
     var ideaMech = document.getElementById('mt-jm-idea-mechanism');
     var ideaIn = document.getElementById('mt-jm-idea-inputs');
     var ideaOut = document.getElementById('mt-jm-idea-outputs');
     var ideaAs = document.getElementById('mt-jm-idea-assumptions');
     if(ideaName || ideaMech || ideaIn || ideaOut || ideaAs){
       var _prevIdea = (d.idea && typeof d.idea === 'object') ? d.idea : {};
       d.idea = {
         name: ideaName ? String(ideaName.value||'') : (_prevIdea.name||''),
         mechanism: ideaMech ? String(ideaMech.value||'') : (_prevIdea.mechanism||''),
         inputs: ideaIn ? String(ideaIn.value||'') : (_prevIdea.inputs||''),
         outputs: ideaOut ? String(ideaOut.value||'') : (_prevIdea.outputs||''),
         assumptions: ideaAs ? String(ideaAs.value||'') : (_prevIdea.assumptions||''),
         boardItems: Array.isArray(_prevIdea.boardItems) ? _prevIdea.boardItems : [],
         boardItemsSource: _prevIdea.boardItemsSource || null,
         economy: (_prevIdea.economy && typeof _prevIdea.economy === 'object') ? _prevIdea.economy : null,
         emitMin: (_prevIdea.emitMin != null) ? _prevIdea.emitMin : null
       };
     } else if(!d.idea){
       d.idea = (typeof modelToolsDefaultIdea === 'function') ? modelToolsDefaultIdea() : { name:'', mechanism:'', inputs:'', outputs:'', assumptions:'' };
     }
     modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(d);
     if(!d.world.spatial || typeof d.world.spatial !== 'object') d.world.spatial = { transforms:'', measures:'', mapLinks:'', scale:'local' };
     var tEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-3d-transforms');
     var mEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-3d-measures');
     var lEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-3d-maplinks');
     var sEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-3d-scale');
     if(tEl) d.world.spatial.transforms = String(tEl.value||'');
     if(mEl) d.world.spatial.measures = String(mEl.value||'');
     if(lEl) d.world.spatial.mapLinks = String(lEl.value||'');
     if(sEl) d.world.spatial.scale = String(sEl.value||'local');
     var spaceNotesEl = document.getElementById('mt-jm-space-notes');
     if(spaceNotesEl){
       if(!d.space || typeof d.space !== 'object') d.space = { entityIds:[], notes:'' };
       d.space.notes = String(spaceNotesEl.value||'');
     }
     if(!d.tool) d.tool = '2d';
     d.designerPane = 'script';
     _mtJmDesignerPane = 'script';
     modelToolsEnsureScript(d);
     /* const node params from DOM when selected */
     if(_mtJmScriptSel && d.script && d.script.nodes){
       var cv = document.getElementById('mt-jm-script-const-val');
       var cr = document.getElementById('mt-jm-script-const-ref');
       if(cv || cr){
         d.script.nodes.forEach(function(n){
           if(n && n.id === _mtJmScriptSel && (n.type === 'const' || n.type === 'const.number')){
             if(!n.params) n.params = {};
             if(cr) n.params.ref = String(cr.value||'');
             if(cv) n.params.value = parseFloat(cv.value);
             if(!isFinite(n.params.value)) n.params.value = 0;
           }
         });
       }
     }
     /* inline const inputs + world.add params + view.curve sync */
     if(d.script && d.script.nodes){
       var inlines = document.querySelectorAll('.mt-jm-script-const-inline');
       if(inlines && inlines.length){
         inlines.forEach(function(inp){
           var nid = inp.getAttribute('data-nid');
           var v = parseFloat(inp.value);
           d.script.nodes.forEach(function(n){
             if(n && n.id === nid && (n.type==='const' || n.type==='const.number')){
               if(!n.params) n.params = {};
               n.params.value = isFinite(v) ? v : 0;
             }
           });
         });
       }
       var wparams = document.querySelectorAll('.mt-jm-world-param');
       if(wparams && wparams.length && _mtJmScriptSel){
         wparams.forEach(function(inp){
           var key = inp.getAttribute('data-key');
           d.script.nodes.forEach(function(n){
             if(n && n.id === _mtJmScriptSel && n.type && n.type.indexOf('world.add.')===0){
               if(!n.params) n.params = {};
               if(key==='label' || key==='note') n.params[key] = String(inp.value||'');
               else {
                 var nv = parseFloat(inp.value);
                 n.params[key] = isFinite(nv) ? nv : 0;
               }
             }
           });
         });
       }
       function applySelNodeParams(sel, cls, typePred){
         var els = document.querySelectorAll(cls);
         if(!els || !els.length || !sel) return;
         els.forEach(function(inp){
           var key = inp.getAttribute('data-key');
           d.script.nodes.forEach(function(n){
             if(n && n.id === sel && typePred(n.type)){
               if(!n.params) n.params = {};
               if(key==='field' || key==='fn' || key==='metric' || key==='unit' || key==='dim') n.params[key] = String(inp.value||'');
               else {
                 var nv = parseFloat(inp.value);
                 if(inp.value === '' || inp.value == null) { /* leave unset */ }
                 else n.params[key] = isFinite(nv) ? nv : 0;
               }
             }
           });
         });
       }
       applySelNodeParams(_mtJmScriptSel, '.mt-jm-jfactor-param', function(t){ return t && String(t).indexOf('jfactor.')===0; });
       applySelNodeParams(_mtJmScriptSel, '.mt-jm-data-param', function(t){ return t && String(t).indexOf('data.')===0; });
       applySelNodeParams(_mtJmScriptSel, '.mt-jm-input-domain-param', function(t){ return t==='input.xMax' || t==='input.yMax'; });
       /* easy171: measure.distance a/b world-point refs */
       (function(){
         var mels = document.querySelectorAll('.mt-jm-measure-param');
         if(!mels || !mels.length || !_mtJmScriptSel) return;
         mels.forEach(function(inp){
           var key = inp.getAttribute('data-key');
           d.script.nodes.forEach(function(n){
             if(n && n.id === _mtJmScriptSel && n.type === 'measure.distance'){
               if(!n.params) n.params = {};
               n.params[key] = String(inp.value||'');
               if(key === 'a') n.params.pointA = n.params.a;
               if(key === 'b') n.params.pointB = n.params.b;
             }
           });
         });
       })();
       /* push draft math/domain into selected (or first) view.curve node */
       d.script.nodes.forEach(function(n){
         if(!n || n.type !== 'view.curve') return;
         if(!_mtJmScriptSel || n.id === _mtJmScriptSel){
           if(!n.params) n.params = {};
           n.params.math = d.math || n.params.math;
           n.params.xMax = d.xMax;
           n.params.yMax = d.yMax;
           n.params.xLabel = d.xLabel || 'x';
           n.params.yLabel = d.yLabel || 'ideal y';
         }
       });
     }
     /* measure fields when 3D CAD open */
     if(d.world && d.world.spatial){
       var ma = document.getElementById('mt-jm-3d-measure-a');
       var mb = document.getElementById('mt-jm-3d-measure-b');
       if(ma) d.world.spatial.measureA = String(ma.value||'');
       if(mb) d.world.spatial.measureB = String(mb.value||'');
     }
     return d;
   }

   function mtJmApplyDraft(persistAttach){
     var d = mtJmReadDraftFromDom();
     if(!d) return;
     var mt2 = ensureModelTools();
     if(!mt2.jmethods) mt2.jmethods = {};
     if(!d.tool) d.tool = '2d';
     if(!d.paper || typeof d.paper !== 'object') d.paper = { source:'', notes:'', extracted:null };
     if(!d.space || typeof d.space !== 'object') d.space = { entityIds:[], notes:'' };
     var prev = mt2.jmethods[d.id] || {};
     if(!d.idea || typeof d.idea !== 'object') d.idea = (typeof modelToolsDefaultIdea==='function') ? modelToolsDefaultIdea() : {name:'',mechanism:'',inputs:'',outputs:'',assumptions:''};
     modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(d);
     modelToolsEnsureScript(d);
     var viewDesc = null;
     try {
       if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.compileView){
         viewDesc = ModelToolsScript.compileView(d.script);
       } else if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.compile){
         var _cv = ModelToolsScript.compile(d.script);
         viewDesc = (_cv && _cv.view) || null;
       }
     } catch(_vd){ viewDesc = null; }
     if(!viewDesc || typeof viewDesc !== 'object') viewDesc = { previewKind: 'none' };
     d.view = viewDesc;
     mt2.jmethods[d.id] = {
       id: d.id,
       label: d.label || d.id,
       factorDim: d.factorDim || _mtFactorDim || null,
       math: d.math || modelToolsDefaultMath('linear'),
       xMax: d.xMax,
       yMax: d.yMax,
       xLabel: d.xLabel || 'x',
       yLabel: d.yLabel || 'ideal y',
       scoreMode: d.scoreMode || 'ideal_over_ymax',
       /* probeX/probeY omitted easy166 */
       idea: {
         name: d.idea.name || '',
         mechanism: d.idea.mechanism || '',
         inputs: d.idea.inputs || '',
         outputs: d.idea.outputs || '',
         assumptions: d.idea.assumptions || '',
         boardItems: Array.isArray(d.idea.boardItems) ? d.idea.boardItems : [],
         boardItemsSource: d.idea.boardItemsSource || null,
         economy: (d.idea.economy && typeof d.idea.economy === 'object') ? d.idea.economy : null,
         emitMin: (d.idea.emitMin != null) ? d.idea.emitMin : null
       },
       world: d.world,
       tool: d.tool === '3d' ? '3d' : '2d',
       space: { entityIds: [], notes: (d.space && d.space.notes) || '' },
       script: d.script || null,
       view: viewDesc,
       viewGraph: viewDesc,
       designerPane: 'script',
       createdAt: prev.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
     };
     try {
       if(typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.collectWorldComponents){
         var comps = ModelToolsScript.collectWorldComponents(d.script);
         modelToolsEnsureJmWorld(mt2.jmethods[d.id]);
         mt2.jmethods[d.id].world.components = comps;
         if(d.world) d.world.components = comps;
       }
     } catch(_wc){}
     try {
       if(viewDesc && viewDesc.curve){
         if(viewDesc.curve.math) d.math = viewDesc.curve.math;
         if(viewDesc.curve.xMax > 0){ d.xMax = viewDesc.curve.xMax; mt2.jmethods[d.id].xMax = d.xMax; mt2.jmethods[d.id].math = d.math; }
         if(viewDesc.curve.yMax > 0){ d.yMax = viewDesc.curve.yMax; mt2.jmethods[d.id].yMax = d.yMax; }
         if(viewDesc.curve.xLabel){ d.xLabel = viewDesc.curve.xLabel; mt2.jmethods[d.id].xLabel = d.xLabel; }
         if(viewDesc.curve.yLabel){ d.yLabel = viewDesc.curve.yLabel; mt2.jmethods[d.id].yLabel = d.yLabel; }
       }
     } catch(_vs){}
     try {
       if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods.buildFromMath){
         var _isBi = RunJMethods.isBuiltin && RunJMethods.isBuiltin(d.id);
         var def = RunJMethods.buildFromMath(d.math, {
           id: d.id, label: d.label, xMax: d.xMax, yMax: d.yMax, factorDim: d.factorDim,
           scoreMode: d.scoreMode, xLabel: d.xLabel, yLabel: d.yLabel,
           script: d.script || null,
           clampScriptScore: _isBi ? false : true,
           fromBlueprint: !!_isBi,
           view: viewDesc || d.view || null,
           place: (function(){
             try {
               if(d.script && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.compilePlace){
                 var _pc2 = ModelToolsScript.compilePlace(d.script);
                 if(_pc2 && _pc2.ok && typeof _pc2.placeFn === 'function') return _pc2.placeFn;
               }
             } catch(_p2){}
             return (_isBi && RunJMethods.BUILTIN_PLACES && RunJMethods.BUILTIN_PLACES[d.id]) || null;
           })()
         });
         if(_isBi){ def.replaceBuiltin = true; def.fromBlueprint = true; }
         RunJMethods.register(def);
       }
     } catch(_reg){}
     if(persistAttach !== false){
       var dim = d.factorDim || _mtFactorDim;
       if(dim){
         var fm = modelToolsEnsureFactorModel(dim);
         fm.jmethod = d.id;
       }
     }
     _mtJmEditId = d.id;
     _mtJmDraft = d;
     modelToolsPersistSoft();
     remountUI();
     try { showStatus('jmethod '+d.id+' applied · attached to '+(d.factorDim||_mtFactorDim||'?')+' · Save to keep','ok'); } catch(_s){}
   }

   var jmNew = document.getElementById('mt-fac-jm-new');
   if(jmNew) jmNew.onclick = function(){
     var dim = _mtFactorDim;
     if(!dim){ try { showStatus('Select a score factor first','err'); } catch(_e){} return; }

     remountUI();
   }

   function mtJmDeleteSelectedScript(){
     var d = mtJmReadDraftFromDom() || _mtJmDraft;
     if(!d) return;
     mtJmPushUndo(d);
     if(_mtJmScriptEdgeSel && d.script && Array.isArray(d.script.edges)){
       var parts = String(_mtJmScriptEdgeSel).split('|');
       if(parts.length === 4){
         d.script.edges = d.script.edges.filter(function(e){
           return !(e.from===parts[0] && e.fromPort===parts[1] && e.to===parts[2] && e.toPort===parts[3]);
         });
       }
       _mtJmScriptEdgeSel = null;
     } else {
       var ids = Object.keys(_mtJmScriptSelSet||{});
       if(_mtJmScriptSel && ids.indexOf(_mtJmScriptSel)<0) ids.push(_mtJmScriptSel);
       if(ids.length && typeof ModelToolsScript !== 'undefined' && ModelToolsScript.deleteNode){
         ids.forEach(function(nid){ d.script = ModelToolsScript.deleteNode(d.script, nid); });
       }
       _mtJmScriptSel = null;
       _mtJmScriptSelSet = {};
     }
     _mtJmDraft = d;
     remountUI();
   }

   (function bindScriptCanvas(){
     var svg = document.getElementById('mt-jm-script-svg');
     if(!svg || !_mtJmDraft) return;
     var drag = null;
     var panDrag = null;
     var marquee = null;
     var moveUndoPushed = false;
     var W = 720, H = 420;
     var world = document.getElementById('mt-jm-bp-world');
     function applyWorldXform(){
       if(!world) world = document.getElementById('mt-jm-bp-world');
       if(world) world.setAttribute('transform', 'translate('+(_mtJmBpPanX||0)+','+(_mtJmBpPanY||0)+') scale('+(Number(_mtJmBpZoom)||1)+')');
     }
     function clientToWorld(ev){
       var rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
       var sx = W / Math.max(1, rect.width);
       var sy = H / Math.max(1, rect.height);
       var zx = Number(_mtJmBpZoom)||1;
       var x = (ev.clientX - rect.left) * sx;
       var y = (ev.clientY - rect.top) * sy;

     function mtJmCopySelection(){
       var d = _mtJmDraft;
       if(!d || !d.script) return;
       var ids = Object.keys(_mtJmScriptSelSet||{});
       if(_mtJmScriptSel && ids.indexOf(_mtJmScriptSel)<0) ids.push(_mtJmScriptSel);
       if(!ids.length) return;
       var idset = {}; ids.forEach(function(i){ idset[i]=true; });
       var nodes = (d.script.nodes||[]).filter(function(n){ return n && idset[n.id] && n.type !== 'score.out'; });
       var edges = (d.script.edges||[]).filter(function(e){ return e && idset[e.from] && idset[e.to]; });
       _mtJmClipboard = mtJmCloneScript({ version:1, nodes:nodes, edges:edges });
       try { showStatus('Copied '+nodes.length+' node(s)','ok'); } catch(_s){}
     }
     function mtJmPasteSelection(){
       var d = mtJmReadDraftFromDom() || _mtJmDraft;
       if(!d || !_mtJmClipboard || !(_mtJmClipboard.nodes||[]).length) return;
       mtJmPushUndo(d);
       if(!d.script) d.script = { version:1, nodes:[], edges:[] };
       var map = {};
       var newSel = {};
       (_mtJmClipboard.nodes||[]).forEach(function(n){
         if(!n) return;
         if(n.type === 'score.out') return;
         if(n.type === 'place.out' && (d.script.nodes||[]).some(function(x){ return x && x.type==='place.out'; })) return;
         if(n.type === 'view.out' && (d.script.nodes||[]).some(function(x){ return x && x.type==='view.out'; })) return;
         var nid = (typeof ModelToolsScript!=='undefined' && ModelToolsScript.newId) ? ModelToolsScript.newId('n') : ('n'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8));
         map[n.id] = nid;
         var nn = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(n));
         nn.id = nid;
         nn.x = (Number(nn.x)||0) + 30;
         nn.y = (Number(nn.y)||0) + 30;
         d.script.nodes = d.script.nodes || [];
         d.script.nodes.push(nn);
         newSel[nid] = true;
       });
       (_mtJmClipboard.edges||[]).forEach(function(e){
         if(!e || !map[e.from] || !map[e.to]) return;
         d.script.edges = d.script.edges || [];
         d.script.edges.push({ from:map[e.from], fromPort:e.fromPort, to:map[e.to], toPort:e.toPort });
       });
       _mtJmScriptSelSet = newSel;
       var ids = Object.keys(newSel);
       _mtJmScriptSel = ids.length ? ids[0] : null;
       _mtJmDraft = d;
       remountUI();
     }

     if(!fromBp){ try { showStatus('Pack '+packId+' has no graph for '+id,'err'); } catch(_e2){} return false; }

       fromBp.factorDim = d.factorDim || fromBp.factorDim;

   }

     function chartGeom(){
       var vbW = parseFloat(chart.getAttribute('data-chart-w')) || 560;
       var vbH = parseFloat(chart.getAttribute('data-chart-h')) || 280;
       var padL = parseFloat(chart.getAttribute('data-pad-l')) || 44;
       var padR = parseFloat(chart.getAttribute('data-pad-r')) || 16;
       var padT = parseFloat(chart.getAttribute('data-pad-t')) || 28;
       var padB = parseFloat(chart.getAttribute('data-pad-b')) || 40;
       return { vbW:vbW, vbH:vbH, padL:padL, padR:padR, padT:padT, padB:padB, iw: vbW-padL-padR, ih: vbH-padT-padB };
     }
     function clientToDomain(ev, d){
       var g = chartGeom();
       var rect = chart.getBoundingClientRect();
       var sx = (ev.clientX - rect.left) / Math.max(rect.width, 1) * g.vbW;
       var sy = (ev.clientY - rect.top) / Math.max(rect.height, 1) * g.vbH;
       var x = ((sx - g.padL) / g.iw) * d.xMax;
       var y = (1 - (sy - g.padT) / g.ih) * d.yMax;
       return {
         sx:sx, sy:sy, g:g,
         x: Math.max(0, Math.min(d.xMax, x)),
         y: Math.max(0, Math.min(d.yMax, y)),
         inPlot: sx >= g.padL && sx <= g.padL+g.iw && sy >= g.padT && sy <= g.padT+g.ih
       };
     }
     var _cpDrag = null; /* { i, pushed } */
     chart.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(ev){
       var d = mtJmReadDraftFromDom() || _mtJmDraft;
       if(!d || !d.math || d.math.type !== 'bezier') return;
       var t = ev.target;
       if(!t || !t.classList || !t.classList.contains('mt-jm-cp')) return;
       var i = parseInt(t.getAttribute('data-cp-i'), 10);
       if(!isFinite(i)) return;
       ev.preventDefault();
       ev.stopPropagation();
       try { chart.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId); } catch(_c){}
       mtJmPushUndo(d);
       _cpDrag = { i: i, pointerId: ev.pointerId };
       t.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
     });
     chart.addEventListener('pointermove', function(ev){
       if(!_cpDrag) return;
       var d = _mtJmDraft;
       if(!d || !d.math || d.math.type !== 'bezier') return;
       var pts = d.math.params && d.math.params.points;
       if(!pts || !_cpDrag.i && _cpDrag.i !== 0) return;
       if(!pts[_cpDrag.i]) return;
       var dom = clientToDomain(ev, d);
       pts[_cpDrag.i].x = dom.x;
       pts[_cpDrag.i].y = dom.y;
       /* live move CP circle without full remount */
       var circ = chart.querySelector('.mt-jm-cp[data-cp-i="'+_cpDrag.i+'"]');
       if(circ){
         var g = dom.g;
         var cx = g.padL + (dom.x / d.xMax) * g.iw;
         var cy = g.padT + g.ih - (dom.y / d.yMax) * g.ih;
         circ.setAttribute('cx', cx.toFixed(1));
         circ.setAttribute('cy', cy.toFixed(1));
       }
       var xin = pane.querySelector('.mt-jm-ptx[data-i="'+_cpDrag.i+'"]');
       var yin = pane.querySelector('.mt-jm-pty[data-i="'+_cpDrag.i+'"]');
       if(xin) xin.value = String(Math.round(dom.x * 1000) / 1000);
       if(yin) yin.value = String(Math.round(dom.y * 1000) / 1000);
     });
     function endCpDrag(ev){
       if(!_cpDrag) return;
       var d = _mtJmDraft;
       if(d && d.math && d.math.type === 'bezier' && d.math.params && d.math.params.points){
         d.math.params.points.sort(function(a,b){ return a.x - b.x; });
         mtJmSyncCurveNodeFromDraft(d);
       }
       _cpDrag = null;
       remountUI();
     }
     chart.addEventListener('pointerup', endCpDrag);
     chart.addEventListener('pointercancel', endCpDrag);
     chart.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
       if(ev.target && ev.target.classList && ev.target.classList.contains('mt-jm-cp')) return;
       var d = mtJmReadDraftFromDom() || _mtJmDraft;
       if(!d || !d.math || d.math.type !== 'bezier') return;
       var dom = clientToDomain(ev, d);
       if(!dom.inPlot) return;
       mtJmPushUndo(d);
       d.math.params.points.push({ x: dom.x, y: dom.y });
       d.math.params.points.sort(function(a,b){ return a.x - b.x; });
       mtJmSyncCurveNodeFromDraft(d);
       _mtJmDraft = d;
       remountUI();
     });
   }

  function renderPane(){
   var pane=$('pane');
   var html='';
   switch(activeTab){
    case 'SUMMARY': html=renderSummary(); break;
    case 'INCOME': html=renderIncome(); break;
    case 'EXPENSES': html=renderExpenses(); break;
    case 'DEBT': html=renderDebt(); break;
    case 'ASSETS': html=renderAssets(); break;
    case 'RANKS': html=renderRanks(); break;
    case 'CALENDAR': html=renderCalendar(); break;
    case 'REVIEW': html=renderReview(); break;
    case 'PREVIEW':
    case 'JOYS':
      try { html=renderPreview(); }
      catch(errP){
        console.error('PREVIEW render failed', errP);
        html='<p class="hint"><b>PREVIEW error</b> · '+esc(String(errP && errP.message || errP))+'</p>';
      }
      break;
    case 'GOALS': html=renderGoals(); break;
    case 'MODEL TOOLS':
      try { html=renderModelTools(); }
      catch(errMT){
        console.error('MODEL TOOLS render failed', errMT);
        html='<p class="hint"><b>MODEL TOOLS error</b> · '+esc(String(errMT && errMT.message || errMT))+'</p>';
      }

   }
