  function easyPreserveScroll(fn){
   var x = window.scrollX || window.pageXOffset || 0;
   var y = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0;
   var saved = [];
   try {
     var pane = (typeof $ === 'function') ? $('pane') : document.getElementById('pane');
     if(pane) saved.push({ el: pane, t: pane.scrollTop, l: pane.scrollLeft });
     document.querySelectorAll('.easy-month, .easy-cal, .easy-board, .easy-grid, [data-preserve-scroll]').forEach(function(el){
       saved.push({ el: el, t: el.scrollTop, l: el.scrollLeft });
     });
   } catch(_s){}
   var out;
   try { out = fn(); } finally {
     try { window.scrollTo(x, y); } catch(_w){}
     saved.forEach(function(s){
       try { s.el.scrollTop = s.t; s.el.scrollLeft = s.l; } catch(_e){}
     });
     // second frame: layout/min-height changes (pick cells) settle, then restore again
     try {
       requestAnimationFrame(function(){
         try { window.scrollTo(x, y); } catch(_w2){}
         saved.forEach(function(s){
           try { s.el.scrollTop = s.t; s.el.scrollLeft = s.l; } catch(_e2){}
         });
       });
     } catch(_r){}
   }
   return out;
  }
  function renderAll(){
   if(!WB) return;
   // Do NOT yank easyCal.y/m back to today here — expense edits call renderAll and
   // were jumping the calendar away from placed months (looked like a clear).
   // Today button / surplusFollowView still control focus explicitly.
   ensureDebtPayLinks();
   ensureRankState(); // structure only — values sync via traversalTick / lastEmit
   renderTabs();
   renderPane();
   // Paint never calls liveBest / calendar walks; engine work is traversal-budgeted
   try {
    renderKpis();
   } catch (eKpi) {
    if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.warn) console.warn('renderKpis', eKpi);
   }
   requestTraversal();
   var C=fullCalc();
   updateLiveBadge();
   var bestLine = lastBest&&lastBest.ok
    ? ('→ run() '+lastBest.ms+'ms · H='+fmtBest(lastBest.stocks.H)+' M='+fmtBest(lastBest.stocks.M)+' A='+fmtBest(lastBest.stocks.A))
    : (lastBest&&lastBest.err ? '→ run() failed: '+lastBest.err : '→ run() pending');
   var jcat = window.__RANKING_JOYS_CATALOG__;
   var jn = (jcat && jcat.loaded && jcat.loaded.length) || Object.keys(window.RankingJoys||{}).length || 0;
   log([
    '✅ Live workbook · current only · rank dim='+activeRankDim+(activeTab==='REVIEW'?' · REVIEW gate':(activeTab==='PREVIEW'||activeTab==='JOYS')?' · PREVIEW tab':activeTab==='MODEL TOOLS'?' · MODEL TOOLS':''),
    // moneyText — log() escapes HTML; never pass money() spans here
    'INCOME net '+moneyText(C.income.net,'gain')+' · EXPENSES living '+moneyText(C.expenses.grand,'spend')+' · DEBT cash '+moneyText(C.debt.payments,'spend'),
    'SURPLUS '+moneyText(C.summary.surplus,'auto')+' · DTI '+pct(C.summary.dti)+' · net worth '+moneyText(C.assets.netWorth,'auto'),
    'RANKS '+C.ranks.items.length+' expense items · JOYS '+jn+' (living-core bridge)',
    bestLine,
    JFAC ? '✅ joy_factors: money dep · age×H · external · debt · surplus · calendar' : '⚠ joy_factors missing',
    (window.RankingCalendar ? '✅ CALENDAR Year→…→Item live' : '⚠ calendar_model missing'),
    JF?'✅ Exp6 blueprint run() realtime':'❌ Exp6 offline',
    (window.JWorkbookMotion ? '✅ motion (Grok/Moho-soft)' : '⚠ motion offline')
   ]);
   // Grok Build-like / Moho-soft enter (living-core jworkbook_motion)
   try {
    if (window.JWorkbookMotion && typeof JWorkbookMotion.afterRender === 'function') {
     JWorkbookMotion.afterRender();
    }
   } catch (_mot) { /* */ }
   try {
    if (window.JWorkbookMoho && typeof JWorkbookMoho.afterRender === 'function') {
     JWorkbookMoho.afterRender();
    }
   } catch (_moho) { /* */ }
  }
  // joys loader (async) can refresh after catalog lands
  window.__rankingRenderAll = function(){ try { renderAll(); } catch(_e){} };
  function fmtBest(v){
   if(v==null||!isFinite(v)) return '—';
   return Number(v).toFixed(2);
  }

  /* ========== Exp6: build + run() with realistic joy_factors jmethods ========== */
  function nowMs(){
   return (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now)
    ? performance.now()
    : Date.now();
  }
  function liveBest(){
   var t0 = nowMs();
   var zeroCal = { gain:0, living:0, debt:0, surplus:0, nActs:0, ms:0 };
   if(!JF||!WB){
    lastBest={ok:false,err:'no_jf',ms:0,n:0,stocks:{},calendar:Object.assign({}, zeroCal)};
    return lastBest;
   }
   try{
    var C=fullCalc();
    var h=C.hdame;
    var months = Math.max(h.months, 1);
    // Money stocks start at 0 — rollup comes from run() Income/Living/Debt/M only.
    var dMonth = h.D / months;
    var eMonth = h.ePerMonth || 20;
    var eStart = Math.max(eMonth, 1e6);
    var discountRate = (WB.hdame && WB.hdame.discountRate != null) ? WB.hdame.discountRate : 0.04;
    var snap = { H: h.hPerMonth||100, D: dMonth, A: 1, M: 0, E: eStart };

    function methodCtx(base, name){
     return function(ctx){
      ctx = ctx || {};
      ctx.name = name || ctx.name;
      ctx.monthsTotal = months;
      ctx.monthIndex = 0;
      ctx.discountRate = discountRate;
      ctx.Emax = eMonth;
      ctx.Dmax = dMonth;
      ctx.E = snap.E;
      ctx.D = snap.D;
      if(typeof ctx.get !== 'function'){
       ctx.get = function(k){ return snap[k]; };
      }
      // prefer live X/Y from engine if present
      if(ctx.X != null) snap.M = Math.abs(Number(ctx.X)) || snap.M;
      if(ctx.Y != null && String(ctx.to||'') === 'H') { /* H pool */ }
      return base(ctx);
     };
    }

    var scoreMH = JFAC && JFAC.scoreMoneyToHappy
     ? JFAC.scoreMoneyToHappy
     : function(ctx){
       var cost=Math.abs(Number(ctx.x)||0), gain=Math.abs(Number(ctx.y)||0);
       return cost<1e-9?gain:gain/Math.sqrt(cost);
      };
    var scoreAge = JFAC && JFAC.scoreAgeTick
     ? JFAC.scoreAgeTick
     : function(){ return 0.1; };
    var scoreDebtFn = JFAC && JFAC.scoreDebtPay
     ? JFAC.scoreDebtPay
     : function(ctx){ return Math.abs(ctx.x)||0; };
    var scoreDays = function(ctx){
      ctx = ctx || {};
      var days = Math.abs(Number(ctx.x)||0);
      var gain = Math.abs(Number(ctx.y)||0);
      var D = ctx.D != null ? ctx.D : (ctx.Dmax != null ? ctx.Dmax : 30);
      var dayW = (JFAC && JFAC.daysCapacityWeight) ? JFAC.daysCapacityWeight(days, D, ctx.Dmax) : (1 / (1 + days / Math.max(Number(D)||1, 1e-6)));
      return (gain + 1e-6) * dayW * 10;
    };
    var scoreExt = function(ctx){
      ctx = ctx || {};
      var used = Math.abs(Number(ctx.x)||0);
      var gain = Math.abs(Number(ctx.y)||0);
      var tt = (JFAC && JFAC.ageT) ? JFAC.ageT(ctx) : 0;
      var ext = (JFAC && JFAC.externalFactor) ? JFAC.externalFactor(ctx.name||'ext', tt, ctx.E, ctx.Emax) : 1;
      return (gain + 1e-6) * ext / (1 + used);
    };
    /** Happy units for Exp6: prefer composite (H+D+A+M+E ranks), else H share. */
    function easyRankHappyUnits(row, cost){
      if(!row) return Math.max((Number(cost)||0) * 0.01, 0.001);
      var pool = Math.max(Number(h && h.hPerMonth) || Number(snap && snap.H) || 100, 1);
      if(row.scoreRaw != null && isFinite(Number(row.scoreRaw)) && Number(row.scoreRaw) > 0){
        return Math.max(Number(row.scoreRaw) * pool, 0.001);
      }
      return Math.max(0, Number(row.H)||Number(row.score)||0) || Math.max((Number(cost)||0) * 0.01, 0.001);
    }

    var debtCalc = null;
    try { debtCalc = calcDebt(); } catch(_d) { debtCalc = null; }
    // map expense name → debt line for APR urgency
    var debtByExpense = {};
    if(debtCalc && debtCalc.lines){
     debtCalc.lines.forEach(function(L){
      (L.fromExpense||[]).forEach(function(en){ debtByExpense[en] = L; });
     });
    }

    var bp=JF.JBlueprint.create()
     .resource('H',{start:snap.H})
     .resource('D',{start:snap.D, polarity:'-'})
     .resource('A',{start:1, polarity:'-'})
     .resource('M',{start:0, kind:'joy'})
     .resource('E',{start:snap.E})
     .resource('Income',{start:0, kind:'joy'})
     .resource('Living',{start:0, kind:'joy'})
     .resource('Debt',{start:0, kind:'joy'})
     .method('earn', methodCtx(function(ctx){
      if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.score === 'function' && RunJMethods.get('earn')){
        return RunJMethods.score('earn', ctx);
      }
      return Math.abs(ctx.y)||0.01;
     }))
     .method('moneyToHappy', methodCtx(function(ctx){
      // stamp action name from do() if engine passes group context
      if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.score === 'function' && RunJMethods.get('moneyToHappy')){
        return RunJMethods.score('moneyToHappy', ctx);
      }
      return scoreMH(ctx);
     }))
     .method('daysUse', methodCtx(function(ctx){
      if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.score === 'function' && RunJMethods.get('daysUse')){
        return RunJMethods.score('daysUse', ctx);
      }
      return scoreDays(ctx);
     }, 'days_use'))
     .method('extUse', methodCtx(function(ctx){
      if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.score === 'function' && RunJMethods.get('extUse')){
        return RunJMethods.score('extUse', ctx);
      }
      return scoreExt(ctx);
     }, 'ext_use'))
     .method('ageTick', methodCtx(function(ctx){
      if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.score === 'function' && RunJMethods.get('ageTick')){
        return RunJMethods.score('ageTick', ctx);
      }
      return scoreAge(ctx);
     }, 'age_tick'))
     .method('debtPay', methodCtx(function(ctx){
      var nm = String(ctx.name || '');
      var hit = debtByExpense[nm.replace(/^debt:/, '')] || debtByExpense[nm];
      if(!hit && nm.indexOf('debt:') === 0){
       var en = nm.slice(5);
       hit = debtByExpense[en];
      }
      if(hit){
       var ap = Number(hit.aprPct)||0;
       ctx.apr = ap > 1 ? ap * 0.01 : ap;
       ctx.interest = hit.durationApr || 0;
      }
      if(typeof RunJMethods !== 'undefined' && RunJMethods && typeof RunJMethods.score === 'function' && RunJMethods.get('debtPay')){
        return RunJMethods.score('debtPay', ctx);
      }
      return scoreDebtFn(ctx);
     }))
     .fn('mirrorIncomeToM', function(ctx){ return ctx.amount; })
     .onGain('Income', { give: { M: 'mirrorIncomeToM' } })
     .layer('Month',{atomic:true});

    var n=0;
    var ranksBy = (C.ranks && C.ranks.byName) || {};
    // Ensure seed before building blueprint (same helper as KPI).
    try { if(typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function') easyMonthMoneyRoll(); } catch(_mr){}
    var calActs = [];
    try {
      calActs = (getCalendarCustomActions() || []).filter(function(a){
        return easyActOnCalendar(a) && (typeof easyActInFocusMonth !== 'function' || easyActInFocusMonth(a));
      });
    } catch(_ca){ calActs = []; }
    var actMethods = Object.create(null);
    function previewRecordRunMethod(actName, portionId, method, x, y){
      if(!actName || !method) return;
      if(!actMethods[actName]) actMethods[actName] = Object.create(null);
      actMethods[actName][portionId] = { method: method, x: x, y: y, at: Date.now() };
    }

    calActs.forEach(function(a){
     if(!a) return;
     var amt = Math.abs(Number(a.amountMonthly != null ? a.amountMonthly : a.amount) || 0);
     var isGain = a.kind === 'work' || a.polarity === 'gain' || a.polarity === 'produce';
     if(isGain){
      if(!(amt > 0)) return;
      var enm = a.name || a.expenseName || ('earn_'+n);
      previewRecordRunMethod(enm, 'money', 'earn');
      bp.do('earn:'+enm, {
       method: 'earn',
       from: 'E',
       to: 'Income',
       x: 0.01,
       y: -amt
      });
      n++;
      return;
     }
     var cost = amt;
     // Prefer live sheet/$ row so Exp6 matches calendar KPI when amountMonthly lagged.
     try {
       if(typeof easyActMonthAmount === 'function'){
         var liveAmt = easyActMonthAmount(a);
         if(liveAmt > 0) cost = liveAmt;
       }
     } catch(_la){}
     if(!(cost > 0)) return;
     var nm = a.expenseName || a.name || ('act_'+n);
     var row = ranksBy[nm];
     if(!row && ranksBy[a.name]) row = ranksBy[a.name];
     var happy = easyRankHappyUnits(row, cost);
     var isDebt = !!(a.isDebtPay || debtByExpense[nm]);
     if(isDebt){
      previewRecordRunMethod(nm, 'debt', 'debtPay', Math.max(cost, 0.01), -Math.max(happy || cost * 0.01, 0.001));
      bp.do('debt:'+nm, {
       method: 'debtPay',
       from: 'M',
       to: 'Debt',
       x: Math.max(cost, 0.01),
       y: -Math.max(happy || cost * 0.01, 0.001)
      });
      n++;
     } else {
      previewRecordRunMethod(nm, 'money', 'moneyToHappy', Math.max(cost, 0.01), -Math.max(happy, 0.001));
      bp.do('cal:'+nm, {
       method: 'moneyToHappy',
       from: 'M',
       to: 'Living',
       x: Math.max(cost, 0.01),
       y: -Math.max(happy, 0.001)
      });
      n++;
      // Other ranked joys (D/A/E) — Exp6 Best must see them, not only H.
      if(row){
        var dU = Math.max(Number(row.D)||0, 0);
        if(dU > 0){
          previewRecordRunMethod(nm, 'time', 'daysUse', Math.max(dU, 0.01), -Math.max(dU, 0.001));
          bp.do('calD:'+nm, {
            method: 'daysUse',
            from: 'D',
            to: 'H',
            x: Math.max(dU, 0.01),
            y: -Math.max(dU, 0.001)
          });
          n++;
        }
        var aU = Math.max(Number(row.A)||0, 0);
        if(aU > 0){
          bp.do('calA:'+nm, {
            method: 'ageTick',
            from: 'A',
            to: 'E',
            x: Math.max(Math.min(aU, 1), 0.01),
            y: -0.01
          });
          n++;
        }
        var eU = Math.max(Number(row.E)||0, 0);
        if(eU > 0){
          previewRecordRunMethod(nm, 'external', 'extUse');
          bp.do('calE:'+nm, {
            method: 'extUse',
            from: 'E',
            to: 'H',
            x: Math.max(eU * 0.05, 0.01),
            y: -Math.max(eU, 0.001)
          });
          n++;
        }
      }
     }
    });

    // Always run() — empty calendar is a valid 0-act sim (~2ms).
    bp.do('age_tick',{method:'ageTick', from:'A', to:'E', x:1, y:-0.01});
    bp.repeat(1);

    var built=bp.build();
    if(typeof built.run!=='function'){
     throw new Error('blueprint has no run()');
    }
    // Custom scorers often make FastBest incomplete (ok:false) with no stock writes.
    // Force classic Best so Income/Living/Debt actually move.
    try { built._useFastBest = false; } catch(_fb){}
    built.run();
    var fast = built._lastFastRun || null;
    var g = function(k){ return typeof built.get==='function'?built.get(k):null; };
    var stocks={
     H: g('H'),
     D: g('D'),
     A: g('A'),
     M: g('M'),
     E: g('E'),
     Income: g('Income'),
     Living: g('Living'),
     Debt: g('Debt')
    };
    // Surplus KPI is ALWAYS deterministic this-month act rates (same every click).
    var roll = (typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function')
      ? easyMonthMoneyRoll()
      : { gain:0, living:0, debt:0, surplus:0, nActs:n, y:null, m:null };
    var ms = Math.round((nowMs()-t0)*10)/10;
    lastBest={
     ok:true,
      actMethods: actMethods,
     ms:ms,
     n: roll.nActs != null ? roll.nActs : n,
     stocks:stocks,
     err:null,
     path:'month',
     fastOk: fast ? !!fast.ok : null,
     factors: JFAC ? 'joy_factors' : 'fallback',
     calendar: {
      gain: Number(roll.gain)||0,
      living: Number(roll.living)||0,
      debt: Number(roll.debt)||0,
      surplus: Number(roll.surplus)||0,
      mLeft: Number(stocks.M)||0,
      nActs: Number(roll.nActs)||0,
      ms: ms,
      y: roll.y,
      m: roll.m
     }
    };
    WB._built = null;
   }catch(e){
    lastBest={
     ok:false,
     ms:Math.round((nowMs()-t0)*10)/10,
     n:0,
     stocks:{},
     err:String(e&&e.message||e),
     calendar: Object.assign({}, zeroCal, { ms: Math.round((nowMs()-t0)*10)/10 })
    };
    if(typeof console!=='undefined'&&console.warn) console.warn('liveBest', e);
   }
   return lastBest;
  }

  /* ========== Nanite-style traversal budget: exact passes, paint uses lastEmit ========== */
  function bumpWorld(reason){
   worldGen++;
   requestTraversal();
  }
  function requestTraversal(){
   if(travTimer) return; // coalesce like scheduleLiveBest
   travTimer = setTimeout(function(){
    travTimer = null;
    try { traversalTick(); } catch(e){
     if(typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.warn) console.warn('traversalTick', e);
    }
  }, 0);
  }
  function cloneRankOrdersSlice(src){
   var out = {};
   if(!src) return out;
   ['D','T','M','U','S'].forEach(function(d){
    out[d] = (src[d] && src[d].slice) ? src[d].slice() : [];
   });
   return out;
  }
  function scratchOrderFromMap(dim, map){
   var items = rankItems().slice().sort(function(a,b){
    var va = Number(map[a.name])||0, vb = Number(map[b.name])||0;
    if(vb !== va) return vb - va;
    return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name));
   });
   var names = items.map(function(i){ return i.name; });
   var factors = names.filter(function(n){ return !isRankNonFactor(dim, n); });
   var nons = names.filter(function(n){ return isRankNonFactor(dim, n); });
   return factors.concat(nons);
  }
  function scratchMoneyOrder(){
   var items = rankItems().slice().sort(function(a,b){
    var ca = Number(a.cost)||0, cb = Number(b.cost)||0;
    if(cb !== ca) return cb - ca;
    return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name));
   });
   var names = items.map(function(i){ return i.name; });
   var factors = names.filter(function(n){ return !isRankNonFactor('M', n); });
   var nons = names.filter(function(n){ return isRankNonFactor('M', n); });
   return factors.concat(nons);
  }
  function updateLiveBadge(){
   var badge = $('live-badge');
   if(!badge) return;
   if(!JF){
    badge.textContent = 'Exp6 offline';
    badge.className = 'live-badge off';
    return;
   }
   if(travState && travState.worldGen === worldGen){
    var spent = (travState.spentMs != null) ? (Math.round(travState.spentMs*10)/10) : 0;
    badge.textContent = 'trav '+spent+'/'+TRAV_BUDGET_MS+'ms · resolving';
    badge.className = 'live-badge';
    badge.title = 'phase='+(travState.phase||'?')+' · worldGen='+worldGen;
    return;
   }
   if(lastEmit && lastEmit.traversal){
    var tr = lastEmit.traversal;
    var tSpent = tr.spentMs != null ? (Math.round(Number(tr.spentMs)*10)/10) : 0;
    var tBud = tr.budgetMs != null ? tr.budgetMs : TRAV_BUDGET_MS;
    var runMs = (lastBest && lastBest.ms != null) ? lastBest.ms : '—';
    var n = (lastBest && lastBest.n != null) ? lastBest.n : '—';
    if(lastBest && lastBest.ok){
     badge.textContent = 'trav '+tSpent+'/'+tBud+'ms · run() '+runMs+'ms · n='+n;
     badge.className = 'live-badge on';
     badge.title = (tr.phasesDone && tr.phasesDone.join) ? ('phases: '+tr.phasesDone.join(',')) : '';
    } else if(lastBest && !lastBest.ok){
     badge.textContent = 'trav '+tSpent+'/'+tBud+'ms · run() err';
     badge.className = 'live-badge off';
     badge.title = lastBest.err || '';
    } else {
     badge.textContent = 'trav '+tSpent+'/'+tBud+'ms · run()…';
     badge.className = 'live-badge';
    }
    return;
   }
   if(lastBest && lastBest.ok){
    badge.textContent = 'run() '+lastBest.ms+'ms · n='+lastBest.n;
    badge.className = 'live-badge on';
   } else if(lastBest && !lastBest.ok){
    badge.textContent = 'run() err';
    badge.title = lastBest.err || '';
    badge.className = 'live-badge off';
   } else {
    badge.textContent = 'run()…';
    badge.className = 'live-badge';
   }
  }
  function patchCalLiveRollup(){
   try {
    var el = $('cal-live-rollup');
    if(el && typeof renderCalendarRollupHtml === 'function'){
     var wrap = document.createElement('div');
     wrap.innerHTML = renderCalendarRollupHtml();
     var next = wrap.firstChild;
     if(next) el.replaceWith(next);
    }
   } catch(_ru){}
  }
  function traversalCommit(st){
   // Apply scratch rank orders (coherent full pass) then publish lastEmit
   if(st.scratchOrders){
    if(!WB.rankOrders) WB.rankOrders = { H:[], D:[], A:[], M:[], E:[], T:[], U:[], S:[] };
    ['D','T','M','U','S'].forEach(function(d){
     if(st.scratchOrders[d]) WB.rankOrders[d] = st.scratchOrders[d].slice();
    });
    if(st.scratchHours) WB._timeHoursCache = st.scratchHours;
    if(st.scratchDays) WB._daysCache = st.scratchDays;
    if(st.scratchUrg) WB._debtUrgencyCache = st.scratchUrg;
    if(st.scratchSurp) WB._surplusContribCache = st.scratchSurp;
   }
   lastEmit = {
    at: Date.now(),
    worldGen: st.worldGen,
    rankOrders: cloneRankOrdersSlice(WB.rankOrders),
    lastBest: lastBest,
    traversal: {
     spentMs: st.spentMs,
     budgetMs: TRAV_BUDGET_MS,
     phasesDone: (st.phasesDone || []).slice()
    }
   };
   travState = null;
   updateLiveBadge();
   try { renderKpis(); } catch(_k){}
   patchCalLiveRollup();
  }
  function traversalTick(){
   if(!WB) return;
   var tTick0 = nowMs();
   var deadline = tTick0 + TRAV_BUDGET_MS;
   // Already have coherent emit for this worldGen and no active pass → idle
   if(!travState && lastEmit && lastEmit.worldGen === worldGen){
    updateLiveBadge();
    return;
   }
   if(!travState || travState.worldGen !== worldGen){
    travState = {
     worldGen: worldGen,
     phase: 'time',
     itemCursor: 0,
     scratchHours: Object.create(null),
     scratchDays: Object.create(null),
     scratchOrders: {},
     scratchUrg: null,
     scratchSurp: null,
     budgetMs: TRAV_BUDGET_MS,
     spentMs: 0,
     startedAt: Date.now(),
     phasesDone: []
    };
   }
   var st = travState;
   function budgetLeft(){ return nowMs() < deadline; }
   function noteSpend(){ st.spentMs += Math.max(0, nowMs() - tTick0); }

   if(st.phase === 'time'){
    var items = rankItems();
    while(budgetLeft() && st.itemCursor < items.length){
     var it = items[st.itemCursor];
     var nm = it && it.name;
     if(nm){
      if(WB.timeMode === 'values' || WB.daysMode === 'values'){
       var cover = rankItemCalendarCover(nm);
       st.scratchHours[nm] = (WB.timeMode === 'values')
         ? cover.hours
         : ((WB._timeHoursCache && WB._timeHoursCache[nm] != null) ? WB._timeHoursCache[nm] : 0);
       st.scratchDays[nm] = (WB.daysMode === 'values')
         ? cover.days
         : ((WB._daysCache && WB._daysCache[nm] != null) ? WB._daysCache[nm] : 0);
      } else {
       st.scratchHours[nm] = (WB._timeHoursCache && WB._timeHoursCache[nm] != null)
        ? WB._timeHoursCache[nm] : 0;
       st.scratchDays[nm] = (WB._daysCache && WB._daysCache[nm] != null)
        ? WB._daysCache[nm] : 0;
      }
     }
     st.itemCursor++;
    }
    if(st.itemCursor >= items.length){
     if(WB.timeMode === 'values'){
      st.scratchOrders.T = scratchOrderFromMap('T', st.scratchHours);
     } else {
      st.scratchOrders.T = (WB.rankOrders.T && WB.rankOrders.T.slice) ? WB.rankOrders.T.slice() : [];
     }
     if(WB.daysMode === 'values'){
      st.scratchOrders.D = scratchOrderFromMap('D', st.scratchDays);
     } else {
      st.scratchOrders.D = (WB.rankOrders.D && WB.rankOrders.D.slice) ? WB.rankOrders.D.slice() : [];
     }
     st.phasesDone.push('time');
     st.phase = 'money';
     st.itemCursor = 0;
    } else {
     noteSpend();
     updateLiveBadge();
     requestTraversal();
     return;
    }
   }

   if(st.phase === 'money'){
    if(!budgetLeft()){ noteSpend(); updateLiveBadge(); requestTraversal(); return; }
    if(WB.moneyMode === 'values'){
     st.scratchOrders.M = scratchMoneyOrder();
    } else {
     st.scratchOrders.M = (WB.rankOrders.M && WB.rankOrders.M.slice) ? WB.rankOrders.M.slice() : [];
    }
    st.phasesDone.push('money');
    st.phase = 'debt';
   }

   if(st.phase === 'debt'){
    if(!budgetLeft()){ noteSpend(); updateLiveBadge(); requestTraversal(); return; }
    if(WB.debtMode === 'values'){
     var urg = rankDebtUrgencyMap();
     st.scratchUrg = urg;
     st.scratchOrders.U = scratchOrderFromMap('U', urg);
    } else {
     st.scratchOrders.U = (WB.rankOrders.U && WB.rankOrders.U.slice) ? WB.rankOrders.U.slice() : [];
    }
    st.phasesDone.push('debt');
    st.phase = 'surplus';
   }

   if(st.phase === 'surplus'){
    if(!budgetLeft()){ noteSpend(); updateLiveBadge(); requestTraversal(); return; }
    if(WB.surplusMode === 'values'){
     var surp = rankSurplusContributionMap();
     st.scratchSurp = surp;
     st.scratchOrders.S = scratchOrderFromMap('S', surp);
    } else {
     st.scratchOrders.S = (WB.rankOrders.S && WB.rankOrders.S.slice) ? WB.rankOrders.S.slice() : [];
    }
    st.phasesDone.push('surplus');
    st.phase = 'liveBest';
   }

   if(st.phase === 'liveBest'){
    // liveBest/run() is atomic (bp.repeat(1)) — never pause mid-run(); own tick if needed
    if(!budgetLeft() && st.phasesDone.indexOf('surplus') >= 0 && (nowMs() - tTick0) > 1){
     noteSpend();
     updateLiveBadge();
     requestTraversal();
     return;
    }
    // Commit scratch ranks before run so calcRanks/liveBest see coherent orders
    if(st.scratchOrders){
     if(!WB.rankOrders) WB.rankOrders = { H:[], D:[], A:[], M:[], E:[], T:[], U:[], S:[] };
     ['D','T','M','U','S'].forEach(function(d){
      if(st.scratchOrders[d]) WB.rankOrders[d] = st.scratchOrders[d].slice();
     });
     if(st.scratchHours) WB._timeHoursCache = st.scratchHours;
     if(st.scratchDays) WB._daysCache = st.scratchDays;
     if(st.scratchUrg) WB._debtUrgencyCache = st.scratchUrg;
     if(st.scratchSurp) WB._surplusContribCache = st.scratchSurp;
    }
    try {
     liveBest();
    } catch(eLive){
     var prevCal = (lastBest && lastBest.calendar) ? lastBest.calendar : { gain:0, living:0, debt:0, surplus:0, nActs:0 };
     lastBest = { ok: false, err: String(eLive && eLive.message || eLive), ms: 0, n: 0, stocks: {}, calendar: prevCal };
     if(typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.warn) console.warn('liveBest', eLive);
    }
    st.phasesDone.push('liveBest');
    noteSpend();
    traversalCommit(st);
    return;
   }

   noteSpend();
   updateLiveBadge();
   requestTraversal();
  }
  function scheduleLiveBest(){
   // Paint-driven paths: bump world + request traversal (no setTimeout(liveBest))
   bumpWorld('scheduleLiveBest');
  }

  /* ========== SAVE / LOAD (localStorage survives refresh) ========== */
  var SAVE_KEY = 'joy_ee_workbook_v1';

  /** Serializable snapshot only — never include Exp6 blueprint (_built has cycles). */
  function workbookSnapshot(){
   if(!WB) return null;
   var raw;
   try {
    raw = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WB, function(key, val){
     if(key === '_built' || key === '_fromExpense') return undefined;
     if(typeof val === 'function') return undefined;
     if(typeof val === 'number' && !isFinite(val)) return 0;
     return val;
    }));
   } catch(e){
    throw new Error('snapshot failed: '+(e&&e.message||e));
   }
   // stamp for debugging
   raw._savedAt = new Date().toISOString();
   raw.activeScenario = activeSc();
   raw.moneyMode = WB.moneyMode || raw.moneyMode || 'values';
   raw.timeMode = WB.timeMode || raw.timeMode || 'values';
   raw.daysMode = WB.daysMode || raw.daysMode || 'values';
   if(typeof activeRankDim === 'string') raw._activeRankDim = activeRankDim;
   return raw;
  }

  /** Flush live WB.calendar into WB.calendars so Save cannot drop placements. */
  function easySyncCalendarsForSave(){
   if(!WB) return;
   try { if(typeof ensureCalendarsBag === 'function') ensureCalendarsBag(); } catch(_e){}
   WB.calendars = WB.calendars || {};
   var sc = (typeof activeSc === 'function') ? activeSc() : 'current';
   if(WB.calendar && typeof WB.calendar === 'object'){
    WB.calendars[sc] = WB.calendar;
   }
   ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(k){
    if(!WB.calendars[k] || typeof WB.calendars[k] !== 'object'){
     WB.calendars[k] = WB.calendars[k] || { customActions: [], rules: [], work: {}, itemOverrides: {} };
    }
   });
   if(WB.calendars[sc]) WB.calendar = WB.calendars[sc];
  }
  /** Drop ephemeral suggest/ghost fields so Save stays under localStorage quota. */
  function easyCompactWorkbookForSave(raw){
   if(!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return raw;
   function scrubAct(a){
    if(!a || typeof a !== 'object') return a;
    var drop = ['__sugTag','__forceSelGap','__ghostChargeOn','__ghostSpanDays','__monthSpendGhost','__dSpan','__packSpan','__score01','__rankDurMin','__fromDSpan','suggestOnly'];
    drop.forEach(function(k){ try { delete a[k]; } catch(_d){} });
    // keep selectedKeys/repeatMarks/yearMarks — those ARE the save
    return a;
   }
   function scrubBag(bag){
    if(!bag || typeof bag !== 'object') return;
    if(Array.isArray(bag.customActions)) bag.customActions = bag.customActions.map(scrubAct).filter(Boolean);
   }
   if(raw.calendars){
    ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){ scrubBag(raw.calendars[sc]); });
   }
   scrubBag(raw.calendar);
   return raw;
  }
  function easyCalSaveStats(cals){
   var bits = [];
   ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){
    var acts = (cals && cals[sc] && cals[sc].customActions) || [];
    var on = 0, keys = 0;
    acts.forEach(function(a){
     if(!a) return;
     var k = (a.selectedKeys && a.selectedKeys.length) || 0;
     keys += k;
     try {
      if(typeof easyActOnCalendar === 'function' ? easyActOnCalendar(a) : (k || (a.repeatMarks && a.repeatMarks.length) || a.cadence)) on++;
     } catch(_o){ if(k) on++; }
    });
    bits.push(sc[0].toUpperCase()+':'+on+'/'+acts.length);
   });
   return bits.join(' ');
  }

  /* easy216 phase-1 save guard helpers */
  var EASY_REV_BC = null;
  try { if(typeof BroadcastChannel === 'function'){ EASY_REV_BC = new BroadcastChannel('ranking_ui_rev');
    EASY_REV_BC.onmessage = function(ev){ var r = ev && ev.data && ev.data.rev; if(r != null && WB && WB._rev !== r) easyStaleBanner('Another tab saved (rev '+r+'). Reload before editing.'); }; } } catch(_bc){}
  function easyRevAnnounce(rev){ try { if(EASY_REV_BC) EASY_REV_BC.postMessage({ rev: rev }); } catch(_e){} }
  function easyStaleBanner(msg){
   try {
    var b = document.getElementById('easy-stale-banner');
    if(!b){
     b = document.createElement('div'); b.id = 'easy-stale-banner';
     b.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:99999;background:#7f1d1d;color:#fff;padding:8px 14px;font:12px ui-monospace,monospace;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:center';
     document.body.appendChild(b);
    }
    b.innerHTML = '<b>Out of date</b><span></span><button class="btn" id="easy-stale-reload" style="background:#fff;color:#7f1d1d">Reload</button>';
    b.querySelector('span').textContent = msg;
    document.getElementById('easy-stale-reload').onclick = function(){ location.reload(); };
   } catch(_e){}
  }
  function saveWorkbook(opts){
   opts = opts || {};
   // easy222: as-of view never persists — save the live WB (or drop a stale as-of if WB was reloaded underneath)
   if(ASOF && !opts.__asofInner){
    if(!(WB && WB.__asofClone)){ ASOF = null; }
    else { var _asCl = WB, _asR; WB = ASOF.live; RD_CACHE = null;
     try { _asR = saveWorkbook(Object.assign({}, opts, { __asofInner:true })); } finally { if(ASOF){ ASOF.live = WB; WB = _asCl; } RD_CACHE = null; }
     return _asR; }
   }
   if(!WB){
    showStatus('Nothing to save','err');
    return false;
   }
   try{
    // Always pin live calendar into scenario bags before anything else.
    try { easySyncCalendarsForSave(); } catch(_sy){}
    // Stash scenario calendars so Save/REVIEW can never blank placements.
    var calStash = null;
    try {
      if(WB && WB.calendars){
        calStash = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WB.calendars));
      }
    } catch(_cs){ calStash = null; }
    // Single Save path: REVIEW decisions → localStorage, then workbook
    // skipReview: phone/calendar-only saves must not rebaseline or rewrite EXPENSES
    var rev = null;
    if(!opts.skipReview){
      try { rev = applyReviewOnSave(); } catch(re){
       if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.warn('review apply on Save', re);
      }
    }
    // Restore calendars if review apply (or anything) emptied placements.
    try {
      if(calStash && WB){
        WB.calendars = WB.calendars || {};
        ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){
          var before = calStash[sc];
          var after = WB.calendars[sc];
          var bN = before && Array.isArray(before.customActions) ? before.customActions.length : 0;
          var aN = after && Array.isArray(after.customActions) ? after.customActions.length : 0;
          var bOn = 0, aOn = 0;
          if(before && before.customActions){
            before.customActions.forEach(function(a){
              try { if(typeof easyActOnCalendar === 'function' ? easyActOnCalendar(a) : (a && a.selectedKeys && a.selectedKeys.length)) bOn++; } catch(_b){}
            });
          }
          if(after && after.customActions){
            after.customActions.forEach(function(a){
              try { if(typeof easyActOnCalendar === 'function' ? easyActOnCalendar(a) : (a && a.selectedKeys && a.selectedKeys.length)) aOn++; } catch(_a){}
            });
          }
          // If we lost placed acts, restore this scenario bag.
          if(bOn > 0 && aOn < bOn){
            WB.calendars[sc] = before;
          } else if(bN > 0 && aN === 0){
            WB.calendars[sc] = before;
          }
        });
        var scNow = (typeof activeSc === 'function') ? activeSc() : 'current';
        if(WB.calendars[scNow]) WB.calendar = WB.calendars[scNow];
      }
    } catch(_rest){}
    try { easySyncCalendarsForSave(); } catch(_sy2){}
    // Mark so reload never reseeds over this Save
    try {
      WB._calSeededFromSheet = true;
      if(WB._calUserCleared == null) WB._calUserCleared = false;
    } catch(_fl){}
    var snap = workbookSnapshot();
    snap = easyCompactWorkbookForSave(snap);
    var json = JSON.stringify(snap);
    function writeLocal(payload){
      localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, payload);
      var check = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
      if(!check || check.length < 10) throw new Error('localStorage write empty (private mode / blocked?)');
      var parsed = JSON.parse(check);
      if(!parsed.expenses && !parsed.income) throw new Error('save verify failed — incomplete payload');
      if(!parsed.calendars || typeof parsed.calendars !== 'object'){
        throw new Error('save verify failed — calendars missing');
      }
      return parsed;
    }
    var parsed;
    var localOk = false;
    var localPrev = null; try { localPrev = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY); } catch(_lp){}
    try {
      parsed = writeLocal(json);
      localOk = true;
    } catch(qe){
      var qmsg = String(qe && qe.message || qe);
      if(/quota|QuotaExceeded/i.test(qmsg)){
        snap = easyCompactWorkbookForSave(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snap)));
        json = JSON.stringify(snap);
        try { parsed = writeLocal(json); localOk = true; }
        catch(_q2){ qmsg = String(_q2 && _q2.message || _q2); }
      }
      if(!localOk && !/quota|QuotaExceeded/i.test(qmsg) && qmsg){
        // keep going — disk save may still work
        if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.warn('localStorage save failed', qmsg);
      }
    }
    // Disk SoT (Safari-proof): POST to serve_ranking.py
    var diskOk = false, diskInfo = null, diskErr = null;
    try {
      var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhr.open('POST', './api/save-workbook', false); // sync so Save status is honest
      xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Base-Rev', String(WB._rev != null ? WB._rev : ''));
      xhr.send(json);
      if(xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300){
        diskOk = true;
        try { diskInfo = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText || '{}'); } catch(_p){ diskInfo = {}; }
        // easy216 save guard: adopt new rev, keep local copy in step, tell other tabs
        if(diskInfo && diskInfo.rev != null){
          WB._rev = diskInfo.rev;
          try { var _lj = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY)||'null'); if(_lj){ _lj._rev = diskInfo.rev; localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(_lj)); } } catch(_lr){}
          easyRevAnnounce(diskInfo.rev);
        }
      } else if(xhr.status === 409){
        // Stale tab: never force. Roll local copy back so reload prefers disk, show banner.
        try { if(localPrev != null) localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, localPrev); else localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY); } catch(_rb){}
        localOk = false;
        var _r409 = {}; try { _r409 = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText||'{}'); } catch(_x){}
        easyStaleBanner('Out of date — disk is rev '+(_r409.rev!=null?_r409.rev:'?')+', this tab has rev '+(WB._rev!=null?WB._rev:'none')+'. Not saved.');
        if(opts.silent){ if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.warn('silent save 409 (stale) — not forced'); return false; }
        throw new Error('Out of date — Reload (disk changed since this tab loaded)');
      } else {
        diskErr = 'HTTP '+xhr.status+' '+(xhr.responseText||'').slice(0,120);
      }
    } catch(de){
      diskErr = String(de && de.message || de);
    }
    if(!localOk && !diskOk){
      throw new Error(diskErr || 'localStorage and disk save both failed');
    }
    if(!parsed){
      try { parsed = JSON.parse(json); } catch(_j){ parsed = snap; }
    }
    var calBits = easyCalSaveStats(parsed.calendars);
    if(!opts.silent){
     var extra = '';
     if(rev && rev.ok){
      extra = ' · review '+rev.accepted_n+' accept / '+rev.rejected_n+' reject';
     }
     var where = (localOk?'local':'') + (localOk&&diskOk?'+':'') + (diskOk?'disk':'');
     if(!diskOk && diskErr) extra += ' · disk fail: '+diskErr;
     showStatus('Saved ('+where+') · reload keeps this · '+Math.round(json.length/1024)+' KB · '+calBits+extra,'ok');
    } else {
     try { if(window.JWorkbookMoho&&JWorkbookMoho.saveOk) JWorkbookMoho.saveOk(); } catch(_m){}
     if(!diskOk){
       if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.warn('silent save disk fail', diskErr);
     }
    }
    // refresh REVIEW pane after top Save cleared pending
    try { if(!opts.silent) renderAll(); } catch(_ra){}
    return true;
   }catch(e){
    var msg = String(e&&e.message||e);
    if(/quota|QuotaExceeded/i.test(msg)){
     msg = 'Storage full — free browser storage, then Save again';
    }
    showStatus('Save failed: '+msg,'err');
    if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.error('saveWorkbook', e);
    return false;
   }
  }

  function normalizeWorkbook(w){
   if(!w || typeof w !== 'object') return null;
   // CURRENT + PROJECTED + REVIEW (PROJ+REVIEW staging). Fill missing only.
   function ensureLine(it){
    if(!it || typeof it !== 'object') return;
    var c = Number(it.current), p = Number(it.projected), r = Number(it.review);
    if((it.current == null || it.current === '') && isFinite(p)) it.current = p;
    if((it.projected == null || it.projected === '') && isFinite(c)) it.projected = c;
    if(!isFinite(Number(it.current))) it.current = 0;
    if(!isFinite(Number(it.projected))) it.projected = Number(it.current) || 0;
    // review defaults to projected (staging starts as plan)
    if(it.review == null || it.review === '' || !isFinite(r)){
     it.review = Number(it.projected) || 0;
    }
   }
   if(!w.income) w.income={entitlements:[],deductions:[]};
   if(!w.expenses) w.expenses={sections:[]};
   if(!w.debts) w.debts=[];
   if(!w.assets) w.assets={savings:[],real_estate:[],personal:[]};
   if(!w.hdame) w.hdame={years:150,hPerMonth:100,ePerMonth:20};
   if(!w.goals) w.goals={short:'',medium:'',long:''};
   if(!w.moneyMode) w.moneyMode='values';
   if(!w.timeMode) w.timeMode='values';
   if(!w.daysMode) w.daysMode='values';
   if(!w.rankOrders) w.rankOrders={H:[],D:[],A:[],M:[],E:[]};
   if(!Array.isArray(w.calendarActionTombstones)) w.calendarActionTombstones = [];
   // Per-scenario calendars (CURRENT / PROJECTED / PROJ+REVIEW). Legacy WB.calendar seeds all three once.
   if(!w.calendars || typeof w.calendars !== 'object') w.calendars = {};
   var _calLegacy = w.calendar;
   ['current','projected','review'].forEach(function(sc){
    if(!w.calendars[sc]){
     try { w.calendars[sc] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(_calLegacy || {})); }
     catch(_e){ w.calendars[sc] = Object.assign({}, _calLegacy || {}); }
    }
    if(typeof RankingCalendar !== 'undefined' && RankingCalendar.ensureProfile){
     w.calendars[sc] = RankingCalendar.ensureProfile(w.calendars[sc]);
    } else if(!w.calendars[sc] || typeof w.calendars[sc] !== 'object'){
     w.calendars[sc] = { timezone:'America/Chicago', work:{ enabled:true, days:[1,2,3,4,5], startHour:15, endHour:23, timezone:'CST' }, rules:[], itemOverrides:{}, customActions:[] };
    }
   });
   (w.income.entitlements||[]).forEach(ensureLine);
   (w.income.deductions||[]).forEach(ensureLine);
   (w.expenses.sections||[]).forEach(function(sec){
    (sec.items||[]).forEach(ensureLine);
   });
   (w.debts||[]).forEach(function(d){
    if(!(Number(d.current_payment)>0) && Number(d.projected_payment)>0){
     d.current_payment = Number(d.projected_payment);
    }
    if(!(Number(d.projected_payment)>0) && Number(d.current_payment)>0){
     d.projected_payment = Number(d.current_payment);
    }
    if(!(Number(d.review_payment)>0)){
     d.review_payment = Number(d.projected_payment) || Number(d.current_payment) || 0;
    }
   });
   w.activeScenario = normalizeSc(w.activeScenario);
   w.calendar = (w.calendars && (w.calendars[w.activeScenario] || w.calendars.current)) || w.calendar;
   // MODEL TOOLS authoring state (entities + map stub + meetup sim log)
   if(!w.modelTools || typeof w.modelTools !== 'object') w.modelTools = {};
   if(!Array.isArray(w.modelTools.entities)) w.modelTools.entities = [];
   if(!w.modelTools.camera || typeof w.modelTools.camera !== 'object'){
    w.modelTools.camera = { yaw: -35, pitch: 42, dist: 28, target: [0,0,0] };
   }
   if(!w.modelTools.map || typeof w.modelTools.map !== 'object'){
    w.modelTools.map = { gridSize: 20, showAxes: true, note: 'stub grid (OSM later)' };
   }
   if(!Array.isArray(w.modelTools.meetups)) w.modelTools.meetups = [];
   if(w.modelTools.version == null) w.modelTools.version = 1;
   if(!w.modelTools.you || typeof w.modelTools.you !== 'object'){
    w.modelTools.you = { id: 'you', name: 'You', kind: 'person', pos: {x:0,y:0,z:0}, color: '#7CFFB2', enabled: true };
   }
   if(!w.modelTools.factorModels || typeof w.modelTools.factorModels !== 'object'){
    w.modelTools.factorModels = {};
   }
   if(!w.modelTools.jmethods || typeof w.modelTools.jmethods !== 'object'){
    w.modelTools.jmethods = {};
   }
   delete w._built;
   return w;
  }


  /**
   * Ensure a Cursor Ultra row exists (distinct from Grok [REDACTED-AMOUNT]).
   * NEVER overwrite an authored amount — [REDACTED-AMOUNT] is a real Save, not "missing".
   * Only seed [REDACTED-AMOUNT] when adding a brand-new row (seed / Budget disk).
   */
  function easyEnsureCursorUltra(opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    if(!WB || !WB.expenses) return { ok:false, reason:'no_wb' };
    var secs = WB.expenses.sections || [];
    var hit = null, leisure = null;
    secs.forEach(function(sec){
      if(!sec) return;
      var nm = String(sec.name||'');
      if(/LEISURE|HOBBIES|ENTERTAINMENT/i.test(nm)) leisure = sec;
      (sec.items || []).forEach(function(it){
        if(!it || !it.name) return;
        if(it.name === 'Cursor Ultra' || it.name === 'Grok Bot') hit = it;
      });
    });
    if(hit){
      hit.name = 'Cursor Ultra';
      // drop duplicate Grok Bot rows only — leave current/projected/review alone
      secs.forEach(function(sec){
        if(!sec || !sec.items) return;
        sec.items = sec.items.filter(function(it){ return !(it && it.name === 'Grok Bot'); });
      });
      return { ok:true, updated:false, kept:true, current: Number(hit.current), projected: Number(hit.projected) };
    }
    if(opts.createOnly === false){
      return { ok:true, skipped:true, reason:'no_row' };
    }
    var target = leisure || secs[0];
    if(!target) return { ok:false, reason:'no_section' };
    if(!target.items) target.items = [];
    var grokIdx = -1;
    target.items.forEach(function(it, i){ if(it && it.name === 'Grok') grokIdx = i; });
    var row = { name: 'Cursor Ultra', current: 200, projected: 200, review: 0 };
    if(grokIdx >= 0) target.items.splice(grokIdx + 1, 0, row);
    else target.items.push(row);
    return { ok:true, added:true, current: 200 };
  }

  async function loadWorkbook(){
   // ?budgetdisk=1 → drop Save and reload vendor/workbook_data.json (Cursor Ultra / sheet SoT)
   var forceDisk = false;
   var forceLocalDisk = false;
   try {
     forceDisk = /(?:\?|&)budgetdisk=1(?:&|$)/.test(String(location.search||''));
     forceLocalDisk = /(?:\?|&)budgetlocal=1(?:&|$)/.test(String(location.search||''));
   } catch(_q){}
   if(forceDisk || forceLocalDisk){
    try { localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY); } catch(_c){}
   }
   // 1) Prefer last Save (survives page refresh) — but if disk Save is newer, take disk (easy211).
   //    Otherwise Safari localStorage silently shadows expense/debt edits written to workbook_local.json.
   if(!forceDisk){
    try{
     var local=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
     if(local){
      var parsed=JSON.parse(local);
      var useLocal = true;
      try{
        var locResNewer = await fetch('./vendor/workbook_local.json',{cache:'no-store'});
        if(locResNewer.ok){
          var locJsonNewer = await locResNewer.json();
          var diskAt = locJsonNewer && (locJsonNewer._ashSheetAt || locJsonNewer._savedAt);
          var localAt = parsed && (parsed._ashSheetAt || parsed._savedAt);
          var diskLock = !!(locJsonNewer && locJsonNewer._ashSheetLock);
          var diskRevNewer = Number(locJsonNewer && locJsonNewer._rev || 0) > Number(parsed && parsed._rev || 0); // easy216
          if(diskLock || diskRevNewer || (diskAt && (!localAt || String(diskAt) > String(localAt)))){
            WB=normalizeWorkbook(locJsonNewer);
            if(locJsonNewer._activeRankDim) activeRankDim = locJsonNewer._activeRankDim;
            if(!WB) throw new Error('bad newer disk shape');
            try { localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(locJsonNewer)); } catch(_ws){}
            try { easyEnsureCursorUltra({ createOnly: false }); } catch(_u0){}
            showStatus('Restored newer disk Save'+(diskAt?' · '+formatStatusTime(diskAt):'')+' · vendor/workbook_local.json','ok');
            return { source: 'disk-newer', at: diskAt };
          }
        }
      }catch(_dn){
        if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.warn('disk-newer check failed', _dn);
      }
      if(useLocal){
        WB=normalizeWorkbook(parsed);
        if(parsed._activeRankDim) activeRankDim = parsed._activeRankDim;
        if(!WB) throw new Error('bad save shape');
        try { easyEnsureCursorUltra({ createOnly: false }); } catch(_u){}
        showStatus('Restored saved workbook'+(parsed._savedAt?' · '+formatStatusTime(parsed._savedAt):''),'ok');
        return { source: 'localStorage', at: parsed._savedAt };
      }
     }
    }catch(e){
     if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.warn('load local failed', e);
     // fall through to seed
    }
   }

   // 2) Disk Save (Safari-proof) — vendor/workbook_local.json from serve_ranking.py
   if(!forceDisk){
    try{
     var locRes = await fetch('./vendor/workbook_local.json',{cache:'no-store'});
     if(locRes.ok){
      var locJson = await locRes.json();
      WB = normalizeWorkbook(locJson);
      if(locJson && locJson._activeRankDim) activeRankDim = locJson._activeRankDim;
      if(!WB) throw new Error('bad disk save shape');
      try { easyEnsureCursorUltra({ createOnly: false }); } catch(_u1){}
      showStatus('Restored disk Save'+(locJson._savedAt?' · '+formatStatusTime(locJson._savedAt):'')+' · vendor/workbook_local.json','ok');
      return { source: 'disk', at: locJson._savedAt };
     }
    }catch(eDisk){
     if(typeof console!=='undefined') console.warn('load disk save failed', eDisk);
    }
   }

   // 3) Seed from vendor JSON
   var res=await fetch('./vendor/workbook_data.json',{cache:'no-store'});
   if(!res.ok) throw new Error('workbook_data.json missing');
   WB=normalizeWorkbook(await res.json());
   try { easyEnsureCursorUltra(); } catch(_u2){}
   showStatus(forceDisk ? 'Loaded Budget disk (Save cleared) · press Save to keep' : 'Loaded seed workbook (not saved yet — press Save)','info');
   return { source: forceDisk ? 'budgetdisk' : 'seed' };
  }

  /**
   * Copy all line/debt fields from one scenario to another.
   * from/to: current | projected | review
   */
  function promoteScenario(from, to){
   from = normalizeSc(from);
   to = normalizeSc(to);
   if(from === to || !WB) return { ok:false, error:'same_or_no_wb' };
   var fromLine = lineField(from);
   var toLine = lineField(to);
   var fromDebt = debtPayField(from);
   var toDebt = debtPayField(to);
   var n = 0;
   function copyLine(it){
    if(!it) return;
    var v = Number(it[fromLine]);
    if(!isFinite(v)) v = lineAmt(it, from);
    it[toLine] = v;
    n++;
   }
   (WB.income && WB.income.entitlements || []).forEach(copyLine);
   (WB.income && WB.income.deductions || []).forEach(copyLine);
   (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
    (sec.items || []).forEach(copyLine);
   });
   (WB.debts || []).forEach(function(d){
    var v = Number(d[fromDebt]);
    if(!isFinite(v) || v < 0) v = Number(d.current_payment) || 0;
    d[toDebt] = v;
    n++;
   });
   return { ok:true, from:from, to:to, n:n };
  }

  /**
   * Reset PROJ+REVIEW layer from PROJECTED, then apply open REVIEW accepts live.
   * Does not touch CURRENT or PROJECTED until promote / Save side-effects.
   */
  function liveReviewPreview(){
   if(!WB) return { ok:false, n:0 };
   // 1) review := projected (fresh staging base)
   promoteScenario('projected', 'review');
   var n = 0;
   var decisions = reviewDecisionMap();
   // 2) accepted budget cuts → review [REDACTED-AMOUNT] (from pending + items)
   var pending = (window.__REVIEW_PENDING__ && window.__REVIEW_PENDING__.proposals) || [];
   pending.forEach(function(p){
    if(!p || !p.id) return;
    var accepted = false;
    Object.keys(decisions).forEach(function(k){
     if(decisions[k] === 'accept' && k.indexOf(String(p.id)) >= 0) accepted = true;
    });
    if(!accepted) return;
    var pay = p.payload || {};
    if(pay.discovery !== 'cut_expense' && pay.discovery !== 'budget_cut') return;
    var name = String(pay.expenseName || pay.name || '').toLowerCase();
    if(!name) return;
    (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
     (sec.items || []).forEach(function(row){
      if(String(row.name || '').toLowerCase() === name){
       row.review = 0;
       n++;
      }
     });
    });
   });
   WB._review_preview_at = new Date().toISOString();
   WB._review_preview_cuts = n;
   return { ok:true, n:n };
  }

  /**
   * Apply accepted budget proposals to PROJ+REVIEW (review field) only.
   */
  function applyBudgetProposalsToReview(proposals){
   proposals = proposals || [];
   var n = 0;
   proposals.forEach(function(p){
    var pay = (p && p.payload) || p || {};
    if(pay.discovery !== 'cut_expense' && pay.discovery !== 'budget_cut') return;
    var name = String(pay.expenseName || pay.name || '').toLowerCase();
    if(!name) return;
    (WB.expenses && WB.expenses.sections || []).forEach(function(sec){
     (sec.items || []).forEach(function(it){
      if(String(it.name || '').toLowerCase() === name){
       it.review = 0;
       n++;
      }
     });
    });
   });
   return n;
  }
  // back-compat alias
  function applyBudgetProposalsToProjected(proposals){
   return applyBudgetProposalsToReview(proposals);
  }

  function wire(){
   $('btn-reload').onclick=function(){
    if(!confirm('Reload seed from disk and clear saved workbook?')) return;
    try{ localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY); }catch(_e){}
    loadWorkbook().then(function(){
     setActiveSc((WB && WB.activeScenario) || 'current');
     liveReviewPreview();
     renderAll();
    });
   };
   $('btn-save').onclick=function(){
    // commit open accepts into PROJ+REVIEW before snapshot
    try { liveReviewPreview(); } catch(_lp){}
    saveWorkbook({});
   };
   function bindSc(id, sc, msg){
    var el = $(id);
    if(!el) return;
    el.onclick = function(){
     if(sc === 'review') try { liveReviewPreview(); } catch(_e){}
     setActiveSc(sc);
     renderAll();
     showStatus(msg,'ok');
    };
   }
   bindSc('btn-sc-current', 'current', 'Scenario CURRENT · sheet + calendar');
   bindSc('btn-sc-projected', 'projected', 'Scenario PROJECTED · plan + calendar');
   bindSc('btn-sc-review', 'review', 'Scenario PROJ+REVIEW · staging $ + calendar');
   var prp = $('btn-promote-rev-proj');
   if(prp) prp.onclick = function(){
    if(!confirm('Copy PROJ+REVIEW → PROJECTED? (overwrites projected plan)')) return;
    try { liveReviewPreview(); } catch(_e){}
    var r = promoteScenario('review', 'projected');
    promoteCalendar('review', 'projected');
    setActiveSc('projected');
    renderAll();
    showStatus(r.ok ? 'Promoted Review→Projected ('+r.n+' fields + calendar)' : 'Promote failed','ok');
   };
   var ppc = $('btn-promote-proj-cur');
   if(ppc) ppc.onclick = function(){
    if(!confirm('Copy PROJECTED → CURRENT? (overwrites current sheet now)')) return;
    var r = promoteScenario('projected', 'current');
    promoteCalendar('projected', 'current');
    setActiveSc('current');
    renderAll();
    showStatus(r.ok ? 'Promoted Projected→Current ('+r.n+' fields + calendar)' : 'Promote failed','ok');
   };
   var loadBud = $('btn-load-budget');
   if(loadBud) loadBud.onclick = function(){
    if(!confirm('Load Budget disk (vendor/workbook_data.json) and replace local Save?')) return;
    try{ localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY); }catch(_e){}
    fetch('./vendor/workbook_data.json', { cache: 'no-store' })
     .then(function(r){
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error('workbook_data.json missing');
      return r.json();
     })
     .then(function(j){
      WB = normalizeWorkbook(j);
      try { easyEnsureCursorUltra(); } catch(_cu){}
      try { modelToolsHydrateJmethods(); } catch(_hj){}
      liveReviewPreview();
      setActiveSc((WB && WB.activeScenario) || 'current');
      try { if(typeof easyReconcileCalendarToSheet === 'function') easyReconcileCalendarToSheet('current'); } catch(_r){}
      renderAll();
      showStatus('Loaded Budget disk · '+((j && j.source) || 'workbook_data')+' · press Save to keep','ok');
     })
     .catch(function(e){
      showStatus('Budget load failed: '+(e && e.message || e),'err');
     });
   };
  }

  wire();
  loadWorkbook().then(function(info){
   setActiveSc((WB && WB.activeScenario) || 'current');
   try { liveReviewPreview(); } catch(_e){}
   try {
    // Never reseed over a restored Save — that was wiping Accept/phone placements on reload.
    // Also never use nLive (easyCalendarRollup zeros it when month-roll is active).
    var fromSave = !!(info && (info.source === 'localStorage' || info.source === 'disk'));
    if(fromSave){
      try { if(WB) WB._calSeededFromSheet = true; } catch(_fs){}
    } else if(!(WB && (WB._calSeededFromSheet || WB._calUserCleared))){
      var roll0 = (typeof easyMonthMoneyRoll === 'function') ? easyMonthMoneyRoll() : (typeof easyCalendarRollup === 'function' ? easyCalendarRollup() : null);
      var hasCalMoney = !!(roll0 && ((roll0.nActs|0) > 0 || roll0.gain > 0 || roll0.living > 0 || roll0.debt > 0));
      if(!hasCalMoney){
        var seeded = easySeedAllCalendarsFromSheet();

        (seeded || []).forEach(function(s){ nAdd += (s && (s.added||0)) + (s && (s.workAdded||0)) + (s && (s.updated||0)); });
        if(nAdd) showStatus('Calendars seeded from sheet ('+nAdd+' fixes) · live rollup follows calendar · Save to keep','ok');
      }
      if(WB) WB._calSeededFromSheet = true;
    }
   } catch(_seed){ try { if(WB) WB._calSeededFromSheet = true; } catch(_f){} }
   try { modelToolsHydrateJmethods(); } catch(_hj){}
   /* easy178/179/182/183/184/185/188: soft-seed morning canvas + localWeekend + localEconomy + HouseFamily jreq + training days after workbook load */
   try {
     var _seedDirty = false;
     if(typeof easyEnsureMorningCanvasActs === 'function'){
       var _mcrBoot = easyEnsureMorningCanvasActs();
       if(_mcrBoot && ((_mcrBoot.added|0) + (_mcrBoot.updated|0)) > 0) _seedDirty = true;
       try { if(typeof console !== 'undefined') console.log('easy178 morningCanvas seed', _mcrBoot); } catch(_cl){}
     }
     if(typeof easyEnsureLocalWeekendBoardActs === 'function'){
       var _lwBoot = easyEnsureLocalWeekendBoardActs();
       if(_lwBoot && ((_lwBoot.added|0) + (_lwBoot.updated|0)) > 0) _seedDirty = true;
       try { if(typeof console !== 'undefined') console.log('easy187 localWeekend seed', _lwBoot); } catch(_cl2){}
     }
     if(typeof easyEnsureLocalEconomyBoardActs === 'function'){
       var _leBoot = easyEnsureLocalEconomyBoardActs();
       if(_leBoot && ((_leBoot.added|0) + (_leBoot.updated|0)) > 0) _seedDirty = true;
       try { if(typeof console !== 'undefined') console.log('easy187 localEconomy seed', _leBoot); } catch(_cl3){}
     }
     if(typeof easyEnsureHouseFamilyJreqChain === 'function'){
       var _hfBoot = easyEnsureHouseFamilyJreqChain();
       if(_hfBoot && ((_hfBoot.added|0) + (_hfBoot.updated|0)) > 0) _seedDirty = true;
       try { if(typeof console !== 'undefined') console.log('easy192 houseFamilyJreq seed', _hfBoot); } catch(_cl4){}
     }
     if(typeof easyEnsureTrainingDaysAct === 'function'){
       var _tdBoot = easyEnsureTrainingDaysAct();
       if(_tdBoot && ((_tdBoot.added|0) + (_tdBoot.updated|0)) > 0) _seedDirty = true;
       try { if(typeof console !== 'undefined') console.log('easy213 trainingDays seed', _tdBoot); } catch(_cl5){}
     }
     if(typeof easyClearForcedSuggestMustOnEmittedActs === 'function'){
       var _clrMust = easyClearForcedSuggestMustOnEmittedActs();
       if(_clrMust && (_clrMust.cleared|0) > 0) _seedDirty = true;
       try { if(typeof console !== 'undefined') console.log('easy187 clearForcedSuggestMust', _clrMust); } catch(_clm){}
     }
     if(_seedDirty){
       try { if(typeof saveWorkbook === 'function') saveWorkbook({ silent: true }); } catch(_sv){}
     }
   } catch(_mcrB){}
   renderAll();
   if(info && info.source==='localStorage'){
    log(['✅ Restored from Save (localStorage)','CURRENT · PROJECTED · PROJ+REVIEW · Review→Proj · Proj→Current']);
   } else {
    log(['✅ Loaded '+((WB && WB.source) || 'workbook'),'3 scenarios · Budget disk · promote buttons']);
   }
  }).catch(function(e){
   log(['❌ '+e.message,'Place vendor/workbook_data.json next to this HTML']);
   showStatus(e.message,'err');
  });
 })();
